en.description: The most stable signal is colons in titles and fields, especially as subtitle separators or in time formats. There are also word-initial Th fragments and assorted title, abstract, and file-format fragments, with insufficient evidence to attribute them to the same mechanism.

patterns.name: Title separator after a colon
patterns.context: A colon appears in a title or phrase, separating the topic from a subtitle, explanation, or following content; the colon in [6] has weak activation.
patterns.domain: Primarily PubMed titles; also structured Enron fields

patterns.name: Colon in a time field
patterns.context: A colon occurs in a time field, with the field name or numeric time format providing structured context.
patterns.domain: GitHub file records and Enron electricity-trading emails

patterns.name: Lowercase th-initial word in a title or phrase
patterns.context: A word at the beginning of a title is split into fragments beginning with Th, forming Thinking and Thyroid; there are only two examples and no shared meaning is apparent.

patterns.name: Other sporadic structural or formatting triggers
patterns.context: Examples involve abstract lead-ins, title openings, path/version/date formats, and line breaks; apart from colons, there is insufficient evidence of a shared trigger pattern.

10_19.description: 最稳定的信号是标题、字段中的冒号，尤其用于副标题分隔或时刻格式。另有 Th 词首及若干标题、摘要和文件格式碎片，证据不足以归为同一机制。

patterns.name: 冒号后的标题分隔符
patterns.context: 冒号出现在标题或短语中，用来分隔主题与副标题、说明或后续内容；[6]的冒号激活较弱。
patterns.domain: 主要是 PubMed 标题，也见 Enron 结构化字段

patterns.name: 时间字段中的冒号
patterns.context: 冒号位于时刻字段中，字段名或数字时间格式提供结构化上下文。
patterns.domain: GitHub 文件记录与 Enron 电力交易邮件

patterns.name: 标题/短语中的小写 th 起始词
patterns.context: 标题开头的词被拆分为以 Th 起始的片段，分别组成 Thinking 和 Thyroid；仅有两例，未见统一词义。

patterns.name: 其他零散结构性或格式触发
patterns.context: 分别涉及摘要导语、标题开头、路径/版本号/日期格式和换行；除冒号外没有足够证据表明是共同触发模式。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、GitHub 文件记录

en.description: Primarily responds to colons at headings or field boundaries, especially in titles, subtitles, and email date/time fields; also activates on some heading openers, an HIV introduction, and code timestamps, with sporadic triggers.

patterns.name: Colons in titles
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on colon punctuation; colons often separate a main title from a subtitle, or a topic from an explanatory phrase.
patterns.domain: PubMed paper titles and other structured text

patterns.name: Titles beginning with Thinking
patterns.context: A title begins with Thinking about a reader's mind, followed by a colon and subtitle.

patterns.name: Medical titles beginning with Thyroid
patterns.context: A title begins with a split-marked Thyroid, followed by medical terms such as transcription factors and lung adenocarcinoma.

patterns.name: Dates and times in journal titles
patterns.context: The fixed fields Start Date and Hour Ahead hour are followed by a date, an hour value, and a semicolon; the two passages are nearly identical.
patterns.domain: Enron electricity-trading emails or scheduling data

patterns.name: Paths or version strings with timestamps
patterns.context: File paths, version numbers, and date-time stamps appear consecutively, followed by truncated text.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code or version-control records

patterns.name: HIV introduction in a title
patterns.context: Begins with the question-like phrase What’s new in HIV, followed on a new line by This issue goes to press as.

10_19.concept: 冒号及结构化文本边界
10_19.description: 主要响应标题或字段分隔处的冒号，尤其是标题、副标题及邮件日期时间字段；另对若干标题开头、HIV导语和代码时间戳有激活，触发较分散。

patterns.name: 标题中的冒号
patterns.context: 激活集中在冒号标点；冒号常用于主标题与副标题、题目与解释性短语之间。
patterns.domain: PubMed论文标题及其他结构化文本

patterns.name: 以 Thinking 开头的标题
patterns.context: 标题开头的 Thinking about a reader's mind，后接冒号与副标题。

patterns.name: 以 Thyroid 开头的医学标题
patterns.context: 标题开头出现被拆分标记的 Thyroid，后接转录因子与肺腺癌等医学术语。

patterns.name: 期刊标题中的日期和时间
patterns.context: 固定字段 Start Date 与 Hour Ahead hour 后接日期、小时值和分号；两段内容几乎重复。
patterns.domain: Enron电力交易邮件或排程数据

patterns.name: 带时间戳的路径或版本字符串
patterns.context: 文件路径、版本号与日期时间戳连续出现，随后接有截断的文本。

patterns.name: 标题中的 HIV 导语
patterns.context: 以问句式短语 What’s new in HIV 起头，换行后接 This issue goes to press as。

en.description: The main pattern is the word-initial fragment «Th», spanning various Th-initial words; other sporadic triggers include title colons, dates and times, year ranges, technical compounds, parenthetical abbreviations, and film years.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment Th
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the initial subword fragment of words beginning with Th; subsequent words may be thyroid, thinking, Thirst, or thin. It is not triggered by any one fixed complete word
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including medical abstracts, grant text, and Wikipedia

patterns.name: Colons in titles
patterns.context: Appears in paper or project titles, usually separating a main title from a subtitle; adjacent to the preceding topic and the following descriptive phrase

patterns.name: File-path separators and timestamps
patterns.context: A punctuated date-time string appears after a path or filename

patterns.name: Numeric years and ranges
patterns.context: A hyphenated year range in a title, followed by a period
patterns.domain: Scientific history or social-science paper titles

patterns.name: Hyphens in technical compounds
patterns.context: Modifiers, technical terms, or compounds in biomedical titles; the activation marker does not specifically land on all hyphens

patterns.name: Parenthetical abbreviations and symbols
patterns.context: A hormone name is followed by a parenthetical letter abbreviation and a comma-separated list

patterns.name: Film-year notes in parentheses
patterns.context: A title entry is followed by a parenthetical note giving the work’s year and media category

patterns.name: Numbered colon titles
patterns.context: A proper name or title is followed by a numeric identifier, then a colon introducing an explanation

patterns.name: Fragment activation in ordinary English titles and phrases
patterns.context: These phrases show no clear local trigger shared with the other passages; activation lands on different subword fragments
patterns.domain: Paper titles, abstracts, or project text

10_19.description: 主要模式是词首片段«Th»，覆盖多种 Th- 开头词；另有标题冒号、日期时间、年份范围、专业复合词、括号缩写及影视年份等零散触发。

patterns.name: 词首片段 Th
patterns.context: 激活集中在以 Th 开头的词的起始子词片段，后续词可为 thyroid、thinking、Thirst、thin；并非由某个固定完整词触发
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、资助文本、维基百科等多种文体

patterns.name: 标题中的冒号
patterns.context: 出现在论文或项目标题中，通常将主标题与副标题分开；与前面的主题及后续描述性短语相邻
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 文件路径分隔符及时间戳
patterns.context: 路径或文件名之后出现带标点的日期时间串

patterns.name: 数字年份与范围
patterns.context: 标题中以连字符连接的年份范围，后接句号
patterns.domain: 科学史或社会科学论文标题

patterns.name: 技术复合词中的连字符
patterns.context: 生物医学标题中的修饰语、技术术语或复合词；激活标记并未专门落在所有连字符上
patterns.domain: 生殖生物学与移植研究

patterns.name: 括号内缩写与符号
patterns.context: 激素名称后给出括号内的字母缩写，并以逗号继续列举
patterns.domain: NIH 项目文本，内分泌学

patterns.name: 括号中的影视年份说明
patterns.context: 条目标题后用括号补充作品年份与媒介类别

patterns.name: 编号式冒号标题
patterns.context: 专名或标题后接数字编号，再以冒号引出说明

patterns.name: 普通英语标题与短语中的碎片激活
patterns.context: 这些词组未显示与其他段共享的明确局部触发条件；激活落在不同词片段上
patterns.domain: 论文标题、摘要或项目文本

en.description: All fragments mark capital Th at the beginning of a word, while subsequent activation varies across words; the content spans papers, medicine, biology, and encyclopedic text, with no stable thematic or semantic condition apparent.

patterns.name: Word-initial Th subword fragment
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a word, usually followed by one or more subword fragments continuing that word; this token is marked in all 10 segments and has the highest intensity.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; including paper abstracts, medical and biological texts, film entries, and Wikipedia titles

patterns.name: Subsequent fragments of Th-initial words
patterns.context: «Th» is followed by fragments forming Thinking, Thyroid, Thirst, Thin, Thirty, Thoracic, Thrombolytic, and Thalidomide; the specific continuations of different words are all activated.
patterns.domain: General English and medical and biological terminology

patterns.name: Title-style word-initial position
patterns.context: Capital Th at the beginning of a word appears in titles, entries, or sentence openings; this form also occurs in Wikipedia titles.
patterns.domain: Paper titles, abstract openings, and encyclopedia entries

10_19.description: 所有片段均在词首标记大写 Th，后续激活随不同词而异；内容横跨论文、医学、生物学与百科文本，未见稳定的主题或语义条件。

patterns.name: 词首 Th 子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在词首，通常紧接着是一个或多个延续该词的子词片段；该 token 在全部 10 段中均被标记，且强度最高。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；包括论文摘要、医学与生物学文本、电影条目及维基百科标题

patterns.name: Th 开头词的后续片段
patterns.context: «Th» 后接续组成 Thinking、Thyroid、Thirst、Thin、Thirty、Thoracic、Thrombolytic、Thalidomide；不同词的具体延续均有激活。
patterns.domain: 一般英语及医学、生物学术语

patterns.name: 标题式词首
patterns.trigger: «Th» 后接词语或标题内容，如 «Th»«ruxton»
patterns.context: 词首大写 Th 出现在标题、条目或句子开头；维基百科标题中也有此形式。
patterns.domain: 论文标题、摘要开头及百科条目

en.description: All passages show strong activation at the first token of words or proper names beginning with capitalized Th; a few subsequent subwords also activate. Trigger words span medical terminology and ordinary words, titles, and proper names.

patterns.name: Tokenization activation at word-initial Th
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the first subword token of words beginning with uppercase T, h; subsequent tokens sometimes also activate, but less strongly. The corpus types vary; see each passage

patterns.name: Medical and biomedical terms
patterns.context: Medical, disease, treatment, or biological terms beginning with Th; some subsequent subwords also activate

patterns.name: Th in ordinary words and proper names
patterns.context: Also triggered by nonmedical words, titles, or proper names beginning with Th; medical context is not required

10_19.concept: 大写 Th 词首 token
10_19.description: 所有片段都在以大写 Th 开头的词或专名首 token 处强激活；少数后续子词也激活。触发词横跨医学术语与普通词、标题和专名。

patterns.name: 词首 Th 的分词激活
patterns.trigger: 各段开头的 «Th»；后续分词包括 «inking»、«y»、«irst»、«in»、«irty»、«or»、«romb»、«al» 和 «ruxton»
patterns.context: 激活集中在以大写 T、h 起始的词的首个子词 token；后续 token 有时也激活，但强度较低。语料类型不一，见各段

patterns.name: 医学与生物医学术语
patterns.trigger: «Th»；后续如 «y»«roid»、«in» filament-associated actin-binding proteins、«or»«acic» aortic injury、«romb»«olytic» therapy、«al»«id»omide
patterns.context: 以 Th 开头的医学、疾病、治疗或生物学术语；部分后续子词也有激活
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 与 PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: 普通词与专名中的 Th
patterns.context: 同样触发于以 Th 开头的非医学词语、标题或专名，不要求医学上下文

en.description: Activation primarily falls on colons after titles or label phrases, and also sporadically appears at title-initial words, proper nouns, medical terms, intra-word subword fragments, and webpage line breaks; all-caps press-release labels and math-problem formats also occur.

patterns.name: Colon in a title or subtitle
patterns.context: A colon appears after a title or label-like phrase, often followed by a subtitle or body heading; activation concentrates on the colon itself.
patterns.domain: Paper titles, webpage titles, email subjects, and math problems

patterns.name: Word fragment at the beginning of a title
patterns.context: A word at the beginning of a sentence or title is split into multiple tokens; activation falls on the initial fragment, with varying strength.

patterns.name: All-caps press-release label
patterns.context: An all-caps organization or section name appears at the beginning of a short press-release headline.

patterns.name: Proper noun or brand-related word in a title
patterns.context: A title begins with a proper noun, section name, or brand-related word, activating its word fragments.

patterns.name: Line breaks after a subtitle
patterns.context: Consecutive line breaks follow a webpage title or update notice heading, activating the newline token.

patterns.name: Line openings and relation symbols in math problems
patterns.context: A math problem introduces a setup with a line break and Let, then uses a colon in a question to introduce the objects being compared.

patterns.name: Topic terms and punctuation in paper titles
patterns.context: Topic words, hyphens, periods, and other internal title elements occur in medical paper titles, with sporadic activation.

patterns.name: Intra-word subword fragments
patterns.context: Compound or longer words are split by the tokenizer, with some internal tokens activated; no stable semantic condition is apparent.

10_19.description: 激活主要落在标题或标签短语后的冒号，也零散出现在标题词首、专名、医学术语、词内子词片段及网页换行；另见全大写新闻稿标签和数学题格式。

patterns.name: 标题/小标题中的冒号
patterns.context: 冒号出现在标题或标签式短语之后，常接副标题或正文标题；激活集中在冒号本身。
patterns.domain: 论文标题、网页标题、邮件主题及数学题

patterns.name: 标题开头的词片段
patterns.context: 句首或标题开头的词被分成多个 token；激活落在词首片段，强弱不一。
patterns.domain: 论文标题或标题式文本

patterns.name: 新闻稿大写标签
patterns.context: 全大写机构或栏目名出现在简短新闻稿标题开头。

patterns.name: 标题中的专名或品牌词
patterns.context: 标题开头为专名、栏目名或品牌相关词，激活其词片段。
patterns.domain: 体育与饮食相关网页标题

patterns.name: 小标题后的换行符
patterns.context: 网页标题或更新通知的标题后出现连续换行，激活换行 token。

patterns.name: 数学题中的行首与关系符号
patterns.context: 数学题以换行和 Let 引入设定，随后在问句中用冒号引出比较对象。

patterns.name: 论文标题中的主题术语及标点
patterns.context: 医学论文标题里出现主题词、连字符或句点等标题内部成分，零散激活。

patterns.name: 词内子词片段
patterns.context: 复合词或较长词被分词器拆分，部分内部 token 激活；未见稳定语义条件。

en.description: Activation occurs mainly in expressions of thanks and epithelial-related word fragments; it also appears in specific words such as registered, New, material, and Of, as well as terminology and punctuation in a genomic-island paper. The examples span domains and lack a unified semantics.

patterns.name: Expression of thanks
patterns.context: At the beginning of an expression of thanks, often in an email or direct acknowledgment; may include a hyphen, line break, or following salutation

patterns.name: Epithelial-related words
patterns.context: Occurs within epithelial or nonepithelial, referring to epithelial tissue or cells

patterns.name: Forms of registered
patterns.context: Occurs in a compound describing preregistered nursing students

patterns.name: New in a place name
patterns.context: Capitalized as part of a street name
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entries about places and churches

patterns.name: Legal language of judgment
patterns.context: Occurs in a court's legal statement about the relevance of evidence

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Of
patterns.context: Introduces patient counts or sample statistics in medical research

patterns.name: Genomic-island terminology
patterns.context: Discusses predicted genomic islands in bacterial genomes and figure references

10_19.description: 主要在致谢语及上皮相关词片段中激活；另见于 registered、New、material、Of 等特定词语，以及基因组岛论文中的术语和标点，跨领域且缺少统一语义。

patterns.name: 感谢表达
patterns.context: 感谢语开头，常见于邮件或直接致谢；可带连字符、换行或后续称呼

patterns.name: 上皮相关词
patterns.context: 出现在 epithelial 或 nonepithelial 词内，涉及上皮组织或细胞

patterns.name: registered 词形
patterns.context: 出现在描述预注册护理学生的复合词中

patterns.name: 地名中的 New
patterns.context: 作为街道名称的一部分，首字母大写
patterns.domain: 维基百科地方与教会介绍

patterns.name: 法律判断用语
patterns.context: 出现在法院对证据相关性的法律表述中

patterns.name: 句首 Of
patterns.context: 医学研究中引出患者数量或样本统计

patterns.name: 基因组岛术语
patterns.context: 讨论细菌基因组中的预测基因组岛及图表引用

en.description: Activation concentrates on the English initial fragment multif (multifocal, multifactorial, multifaceted), and the stem constit in constitutions in legal contexts; these occur across medical papers and legal texts, respectively.

patterns.name: multif in forms of multifocal
patterns.context: Medical text describes a disease, lesion, or intraocular lens as multifocal; activation falls within multif

patterns.name: multif in forms of multifactorial
patterns.context: Describes a mechanism of action as multifactorial

patterns.name: multif in forms of multifaceted
patterns.context: Describes a drug's multifaceted therapeutic potential or a multifaceted research approach

patterns.name: constit in forms of constitution
patterns.context: Mentions state or federal constitutions, common in legal discussion

10_19.description: 激活集中于英语词首片段 multif（multifocal、multifactorial、multifaceted），以及法律语境中 constitutions 的词干 constit；分别跨医学论文和法律文本出现。

patterns.name: multifocal 词形中的 multif
patterns.context: 医学文本中描述疾病、病变或人工晶体为多灶性；激活落在 multif 内

patterns.name: multifactorial 词形中的 multif
patterns.context: 描述作用机制为多因素的

patterns.name: multifaceted 词形中的 multif
patterns.context: 描述药物具有多方面治疗潜力，或研究方法多方面

patterns.name: 宪法词形中的 constit
patterns.context: 提及州或联邦宪法，常见于法律论述

en.concept: Word fragments and local lexical triggers
en.description: Activation is distributed across several word types: words containing per, such as perceive, self-perceived, repertoire, performed, and hamper, as well as end-stage, hallmarks, caveolae, and facial; contexts vary from medical papers to literature and technical discussion.

patterns.name: self-perceived
patterns.context: In the compound self-perceived, strong activation falls on the split per subword fragment; it refers to people's perceptions or assessments of their abilities.

patterns.name: repertoire
patterns.context: Repertoire in the medical immunology term TCR-repertoire; strong activation falls on the per fragment.

patterns.name: performed
patterns.context: The past participle performed, beginning with per-, appears in literary narration about a play being staged in a theater.

patterns.name: perceive loudness
patterns.context: Explains that the frequency bands of audio equipment focus on loudness as perceived by the human ear; perceive is linked to the object of perception.

patterns.name: end-stage
patterns.context: Describes end-stage renal failure caused by complications of a disease; activation hits end.

patterns.name: hamper
patterns.context: Explains that missing information hampers understanding of disease pathogenesis; activation is on the final per in hamper.

patterns.name: hallmarks
patterns.context: Epigenetic changes are described as cancer hallmarks of tumor development; activation is at the beginning of hallmarks.

patterns.name: caveolae
patterns.context: Mentions a lack of caveolae in asthma and fibrosis research; activation covers the beginning of the technical term and subsequent subwords.

patterns.name: facial aesthetics
patterns.context: Describes receiving facial aesthetics training after a traumatic experience; strong activation falls on facial, with no apparent shared word-form pattern.

10_19.concept: 词片段及局部词汇触发
10_19.description: 激活分布在多类词项中：perceive、self-perceived、repertoire、performed、hamper 等含 per 的词，以及 end-stage、hallmarks、caveolae、facial；语境从医学论文到文学和技术讨论不一。

patterns.name: self-perceived
patterns.context: 复合词 self-perceived 中，强激活落在被拆分的 per 子词片段；分别指人的感知或能力评价。
patterns.domain: 社会科学、心理健康研究

patterns.name: repertoire
patterns.context: 医学免疫学术语 TCR-repertoire 中的 repertoire；强激活落在 per 片段。

patterns.name: performed
patterns.context: 文学叙述中，per- 开头的过去分词 performed；提及戏剧在剧院上演。

patterns.name: perceive loudness
patterns.context: 解释音频设备的频段关注人耳会感知到的响度；perceive 与感知对象相连。

patterns.name: end-stage
patterns.context: 医学中描述疾病并发症导致的终末期肾衰竭；激活命中 end。

patterns.name: hamper
patterns.context: 说明未知信息妨碍理解疾病发病机制；激活位于 hamper 的词尾 per。

patterns.name: hallmarks
patterns.context: 表观遗传变化被称为肿瘤发展的癌症标志；激活位于 hallmarks 的词首。

patterns.name: caveolae
patterns.context: 哮喘与纤维化研究中提及 caveolae 缺乏；激活覆盖该专业术语的词首及后续子词。

patterns.name: facial aesthetics
patterns.context: 描述受创经历后接受面部美学训练；强激活落在 facial，非明显共享的词形模式。

en.description: Activation is distributed across common structures such as infinitives, definite articles, email whitespace, and line breaks, as well as medical terminology, place names, biological genera, legal language, and political phrasing; no single stable semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: “to” and following infinitive constructions
patterns.context: Appears before a verb to form infinitive constructions expressing purpose, ability, plans, or intention; surrounding topics vary.

patterns.name: “the” and following noun phrases
patterns.context: The definite article appears before a noun or noun phrase; highlighting is relatively strong in these examples.

patterns.name: “of” linking a proportion and a population
patterns.context: Appears after the proportion “15-20%” in the population description “among women of reproductive age”.

patterns.name: Words related to tidiness and organization
patterns.context: Describes a person's tidiness habits; later text discusses kitchen clutter and food. The word may be the cross-token phrase “tidy person”.

patterns.name: Word fragments in a travel destination name
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence about whether to travel somewhere, forming the place name Foz do Iguaçu across multiple tokens; activation concentrates on the name fragments and following whitespace.

patterns.name: Whitespace or line-break boundaries in email body text
patterns.context: Activation markers fall near spaces or line breaks, commonly at sentence, quotation, or formatting boundaries in email; the marker location does not always identify a single function.

patterns.name: List item markers in a numbered list
patterns.context: A list of positions begins after a colon, with activation near the colon and parenthesized numbers.
patterns.domain: Legal records, Q&A, or testimony transcripts

patterns.name: Word fragment in nasopharyngeal swab
patterns.context: A consecutive word fragment within “nasopharyngeal”, modifying swabs; no clear shared syntactic trigger can be confirmed from this single example.

patterns.name: Word fragment in a mosquito genus name
patterns.context: Forms the genus name Coquillettia, followed by mosquitoes; later text concerns viral hosts and test results.

patterns.name: Date or subsequent time phrase in text
patterns.context: Segment 1 refers to the sixth day after transplantation, and segment 6 to next Friday; these may be local activations near time expressions, but evidence is limited.

patterns.name: Damages language in a legal dispute
patterns.context: “treble damages” appears in an account of a legal dispute involving a contract and interference with business relations; this is a single example of one word fragment.

patterns.name: English inflectional or intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across a presidential abbreviation, plural suffixes, and verb endings or forms, with no shared context; these may be local word-fragment effects.

patterns.name: Discussion of an issue and passage of an amendment
patterns.context: Describes the political process of passing an amendment and committing to later revisions; this is a single example and cannot establish a specific political-term trigger.

10_19.description: 激活分散于不定式、定冠词、邮件空白与换行等常见结构，也覆盖医学术语、地名、生物属名、法律和政治措辞；单一稳定语义主题不明显。

patterns.name: “to”及后接不定式结构
patterns.context: 出现在动词前，构成目的、能力、计划或意愿等不定式结构；周围上下文题材各异。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的普通英文语法

patterns.name: “the”及其后名词短语
patterns.context: 定冠词位于名词或名词短语前；高亮强度在这些例子中较突出。
patterns.domain: 医学、政治讨论、普通邮件

patterns.name: “of”连接比例与人群
patterns.context: 出现在比例“15-20%”之后，构成“among women of reproductive age”人群描述。

patterns.name: 整洁与收纳相关词
patterns.context: 描述人的整洁习惯；后文谈厨房杂物和食物，词语可能是跨分词的“tidy person”。

patterns.name: 旅行目的地名称中的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在讨论是否去某地旅行的句子中，跨多个 token 拼出地名 Foz do Iguaçu；激活集中于地名片段和其后的空白。

patterns.name: 邮件正文中的空白或换行边界
patterns.context: 激活标记落在空格或换行附近，常见于邮件中句段、引用或排版边界；标记位置并不总能据此确定单一功能。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及邮件格式文本

patterns.name: 编号列表的项目标记
patterns.context: 冒号后开始列举职位，激活出现在冒号和括号编号附近。
patterns.domain: 法律记录、问答或证词转录

patterns.name: 鼻咽拭子词中的词片段
patterns.context: 作为“nasopharyngeal”的连续词片段，修饰 swabs；没有明显共享的句法触发条件可从单例确认。

patterns.name: 蚊子属名中的词片段
patterns.context: 组成属名 Coquillettia，后接 mosquitoes；后文是病毒宿主和检测结果。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、动物疾病研究

patterns.name: 文本中的日期或后续时间短语
patterns.context: 段1为移植后的第6天，段6为下周五；可能只是时间表达附近的局部激活，二者证据有限。

patterns.name: 法律争议中的损害赔偿措辞
patterns.context: “treble damages”出现在合同与干扰商业关系的法律争议叙述中；仅为一个词片段的单例。

patterns.name: 英语屈折或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活散落在总统缩写、复数词尾以及动词词尾或词形中，缺少共同语境，可能是局部词片段效应。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的普通英文文本

patterns.name: 议题讨论与修正案通过
patterns.context: 描述修正案通过以及承诺后续修改的政治过程；单例，无法确定是特定政治术语触发。

en.description: Activation is distributed across body and medical vocabulary, prostate terminology, fist gestures, migration narratives, plot language, bibliographic fragments, and code punctuation and examples; there is no unified semantic theme that adequately covers all the material.

patterns.name: Body / human-body-related words
patterns.context: body combines with compound suffixes, referring respectively to virtual-character body parts, body image disorder, and body in a radiotherapy term
patterns.domain: Virtual worlds, diet and health, medicine

patterns.name: Prostate medical terminology
patterns.context: prostate and terms formed from it, such as cancer and resection terminology, recur

patterns.name: Structural boundary markers in code
patterns.context: Syntax punctuation such as colons and right braces is marked in code examples; another code snippet is triggered near a mapping assignment

patterns.name: Gestures and fist bumping
patterns.context: Describes replacing handshakes with fist bumps; fist appears twice in the same segment

patterns.name: Persecution and expressions of possibility
patterns.context: Describes people from multiple countries, some of whom migrated because of persecution, followed later by could build a...

patterns.name: Behavior and justification vocabulary in a narrative
patterns.context: A character tries to make up for past wrongs, using threats such as foreclosure to force the town's villain to do the right thing

patterns.name: Compound words for fictional abilities
patterns.context: Lists surreal abilities that characters in a virtual world may have; the same sentence also lists spellcasting, flight, and others
patterns.domain: Patent background text discussing virtual worlds

patterns.name: Bibliographic and German-title fragments
patterns.context: Introduces an author and their work, followed by the beginning of the German title Handbuch

patterns.name: Mapping syntax in code examples
patterns.context: Explains processing dictionaries with map() and reduce(), and gives a Python-like example

patterns.name: Hash-table access example in code
patterns.context: Shows a nested hash/array structure and an example of accessing its keys

10_19.description: 激活分散于身体与医学词汇、前列腺术语、拳头手势、迁移叙事、剧情用语、书目片段及代码标点和示例；没有足以覆盖全部材料的统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 身体／人体部位相关词
patterns.context: body 与复合词后缀相连，分别指虚拟角色的身体部件、身体形象障碍，以及放疗术语中的体部
patterns.domain: 虚拟世界、饮食与健康、医学

patterns.name: 前列腺医学术语
patterns.context: 反复出现 prostate 及其构成的癌症、切除术术语

patterns.name: 代码中的结构边界标记
patterns.context: 代码示例中，冒号和右花括号等语法标点被标记；另一个代码片段的触发位置是映射赋值附近

patterns.name: 手势与拳头碰拳
patterns.context: 描述以碰拳代替握手；fist 在同一片段出现两次

patterns.name: 被迫害及可能性表达
patterns.context: 叙述来自多国的人群，其中一些人因遭迫害而迁移，后文接 could build a...

patterns.name: 叙事中的行为与正当性词汇
patterns.context: 人物试图弥补过去的错误，以取消抵押等威胁迫使镇上恶棍做正确的事

patterns.name: 虚构能力词汇中的复合词
patterns.context: 列举虚拟世界角色可拥有的超现实能力；同句还列有施法、飞行等
patterns.domain: 专利背景文本，讨论虚拟世界

patterns.name: 书目与德语书名片段
patterns.context: 介绍一位作者及其著作，后接德语书名开头 Handbuch
patterns.domain: 维基百科人物／作品条目

patterns.name: 代码示例的映射语法
patterns.context: 解释用 map() 和 reduce() 处理字典，并给出 Python 式示例

patterns.name: 代码中的散列表访问示例
patterns.context: 展示嵌套哈希／数组结构以及对其键进行访问的示例

en.concept: Local vocabulary and structure in heterogeneous contexts
en.description: Activation is distributed across passive-agent and behavioral-consequence narratives, medical treatment terms, an isolated poisoning death, and fragments within numbers and proper names; some samples also involve religious acts and evaluations. There is no strong shared semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Destruction, harm, or adverse consequences
patterns.context: Highlights often land on short words such as by, the, and done/doing; surrounding text includes passive or agentive structures and consequences such as destruction, punishment, wrongdoing, or attempts to correct a wrong.

patterns.name: Medical terminology and treatment
patterns.context: Medical or disease-treatment contexts, especially cancer, radiotherapy, symptoms, or medical works; activation lands on technical terms or nearby ordinary words.

patterns.name: Drug overdose and death narrative
patterns.context: A specific biographical event uses passive structure to describe a person being poisoned by their spouse and dying.

patterns.name: Numbers, proper names, and within-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation appears in proper names, years, or within segmented words; topics vary, with no shared semantic condition apparent.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, including religious, historical, and biographical works

patterns.name: Actions and evaluations in religious contexts
patterns.context: Religious discussion mentions divine punishment, sins, or ritual acts; this partially overlaps with destruction and consequence narratives, but trigger forms are inconsistent.

10_19.concept: 异质语境中的局部词汇与结构
10_19.description: 激活分散在被动施事及行为后果叙述、医学治疗术语、单例下毒死亡，以及数字和专名内部片段；若干样本还涉及宗教行为与评价。共同语义模式不强。

patterns.name: 毁坏、伤害或造成不良后果
patterns.trigger: «destroyed»4« by»10（[4]）；«destroyed»3« by»9（[5]）；«done»6« the»9« same»7« wicked»5 things（[6]）；«doing»6« the»9« right»6 thing（[10]）
patterns.context: 高亮常落在 by、the、done/doing 等短词上；周围出现被动或施事结构，以及被毁、受罚、做错事或试图纠正过错等后果叙述。
patterns.domain: 历史、宗教论述、剧情摘要

patterns.name: 医学术语与治疗
patterns.context: 医学或疾病治疗语境，尤其是癌症、放疗、症状或医学著作；激活落在专业词或其邻近的普通词上。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、病例法律文书、传记

patterns.name: 药物过量与死亡叙述
patterns.context: 具体传记事件中，以被动结构叙述某人遭配偶下毒及死亡。

patterns.name: 数字、专名及词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在专名、年份或被切分的词内部；上下文主题各异，未见共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 百科条目，含宗教、历史及人物著作信息

patterns.name: 宗教语境中的行为与评价
patterns.trigger: «involved»9« spiritual»4« appe»1asement« with»4« animal»7 sacrifice（[9]）；«God’s wrath« against»3« Gent»1ile… wicked»1ness（[6]）
patterns.context: 宗教论述中谈及神罚、罪行或仪式性行为；与破坏、后果叙述有部分重叠，但触发形式不统一。
patterns.domain: 宗教讨论、民族宗教百科

en.concept: Misfortune and involvement in historical events
en.description: Primarily occurs in historical accounts of damage, casualties, or misfortune, and also in expressions of participating in or becoming involved in events; there are also local triggers such as “the same” and “confessed to the facts”.

patterns.name: Being ... or suffering a major blow
patterns.context: Historical accounts describe people, buildings, or institutions suffering destruction, casualties, or other negative events; related verbs often appear in prepositional constructions with by, from, in, or during.

patterns.name: Participation or involvement in events
patterns.context: Describes people or groups participating in or becoming involved in an action, practice, or conflict, often in constructions such as involved in, engaged in, participated in, and embroiled in.
patterns.domain: Historical accounts, religious anthropology, and older letters

patterns.name: Specific phrase ‘the same’ and its emphasis
patterns.context: Refers in an argument to the same behavior as mentioned earlier; nearby context compares moral failings across groups.

patterns.name: to followed by facts or information
patterns.context: In an account of a criminal case, confessed to is followed by the facts being admitted; activation falls on the consecutive phrase “to the facts”.

10_19.concept: 历史事件中的不幸遭遇与卷入
10_19.description: 主要见于历史叙述中的受损、伤亡或遭遇不幸事件，也见于参与或卷入事件的表达；另有“the same”和“confessed to the facts”这类局部触发。

patterns.name: 被……或遭受重大打击
patterns.trigger: [2] “destroyed by”；[6] “destroyed by the forces”；[7] “damage from the earthquake”；[9] “killed by being shot down”；[10] “killed in … an assassination”；另有 [3] “injured during a patrol”
patterns.context: 历史叙述中，人物、建筑或机构遭遇破坏、伤亡或其他负面事件；相关动词常出现在 by、from、in、during 等介词结构中。
patterns.domain: 百科全书式历史、生平叙述

patterns.name: 事件中的参与或卷入
patterns.trigger: [4] “engaged in a Duel”；[5] “practice involved spiritual appeasement”；[8] “participated in several actions”；[10] “embroiled in Chinese internal politics”
patterns.context: 描述人物或群体参与、卷入某种行动、实践或冲突，常见 involved in、engaged in、participated in、embroiled in 等结构。
patterns.domain: 历史叙述、宗教人类学及旧式书信

patterns.name: 特定词项‘the same’及其强调
patterns.trigger: [1] “done the same wicked things”，激活集中在 “the” 与 “same”
patterns.context: 论述中指称与前文相同的行为；附近语境比较不同群体的道德过失。

patterns.name: to 后接事实或信息内容
patterns.context: 刑事案件叙述中，confessed to 后接所承认的事实；激活落在连续的 “to the facts” 上。

en.concept: Expressions of causation and damaging events
en.description: Activation often lands near agents or causes introduced by by in historical narratives, and outcomes such as destruction, damage, burning, or death; it also covers local phrases involving same wicked things, causing damage, mass-casualty scenarios, and eye-injury treatment, without forming a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Passive destruction or casualty outcomes
patterns.context: Often appears in passive structures describing something damaged, burned, or destroyed by a force, disaster, or event, or causing death; [1] also includes “killed in” and “assassination”.

patterns.name: By introducing a cause or agent
patterns.context: The preposition is followed by an agent, force, or cause; activation clusters around causal or agentive expressions, but not every example describes a destructive outcome.

patterns.name: the same and emphatic objects
patterns.context: Discusses readers doing the same thing as before; activation spans a determiner, an emphatic word, and an object phrase.

patterns.name: Attribution of responsibility for all the damage
patterns.context: Criticizes parents for causing damage, followed by references to brainwashing and continuing to insist.

patterns.name: Mass-casualty scenarios
patterns.context: Lists accidents, natural disasters, hostile actions, and explosions that cause large numbers of injuries.

patterns.name: Medical use and eye injuries
patterns.context: Explains indications for eye-irrigation or drug-delivery devices, listing chemical burns, thermal burns, and irritants.

patterns.name: The in quantity and date phrases
patterns.context: The definite article occurs in noun phrases for historical events, agent phrases, or anaphoric expressions; its specific function and meaning vary.

patterns.name: Several sporadic historical-action expressions
patterns.context: Describes a person taking part in multiple actions in India; weakly related to the clear activation patterns in the other passages.

10_19.description: 激活常落在历史叙述中 by 引出的施事或致因，以及毁坏、受损、烧毁、死亡等结果附近；另覆盖 same wicked things、造成损害、伤亡场景和眼伤治疗等局部短语，未形成单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 被动毁坏或伤亡结果
patterns.trigger: “destroyed by” [3][6]；“damage from” [7]；“killed by being shot down” [10]；“burnt down by” [6]
patterns.context: 常出现在被动结构中，描述某事物遭某种力量、灾害或事件破坏、烧毁、致死；[1] 也有 “killed in” 与 “assassination”。
patterns.domain: 历史、人物传记、百科叙述

patterns.name: 原因或施事引出的 by
patterns.context: 介词后接施事、力量或致因；激活集中在因果/施事表达附近，但并非所有例子都是毁坏结果。

patterns.name: the same 与强调性宾语
patterns.context: 谈论读者做过与前文相同的事；激活覆盖限定词、强调词及宾语短语。

patterns.name: all the damage 的责任归属
patterns.context: 批评父母造成损害，后接脑洗及持续坚持等内容。

patterns.name: mass casualty 场景
patterns.context: 列举事故、自然灾害、敌对行动及爆炸等造成大量伤者的场景。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学/应急处置

patterns.name: 医疗用途及眼部伤害
patterns.trigger: “including cases of chemical eye burns, thermal burns, irritants”
patterns.context: 说明眼部冲洗或给药设备的适用情况，列举化学、热灼伤及刺激物。

patterns.name: 数量与年代短语中的 the
patterns.context: 定冠词处于历史事件名词短语、施事短语或回指表达中；具体功能和语义不完全一致。

patterns.name: 若干零散的历史动作表达
patterns.context: 描述人物参加在印度发生的多次行动；与其他段的明显激活模式联系较弱。

en.description: Activation appears primarily in accounts of major events such as war, violence, injury, and disasters, and also in medical descriptions of eye burns and conviction information in biographical entries. A common thread may be event severity or negative consequences, but evidence is insufficient to reduce it to a single lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Physical conflict or violent events
patterns.context: Describes specific assaults, fights, injuries, arrests, or assassinations; words may be distributed throughout the event description and do not always refer to the same kind of violence.
patterns.domain: Legal cases, biographies, or historical narratives

patterns.name: War and military operations
patterns.context: In accounts of military figures, wars, or naval history, describes combat, battles, operations, casualties, or atrocities.
patterns.domain: Military history, war history, encyclopedic accounts

patterns.name: Damage, injury, and disaster consequences
patterns.context: Mentions eye burns or severe damage caused by an earthquake; this pattern partly overlaps with military violence but also covers non-war injuries.

patterns.name: Follow-up proceedings after a case or disaster
patterns.context: Event accounts include subsequent actions such as conflict, arrest, prosecution, and expulsion; this may be a broad trigger for event-based narratives, but the boundaries are unclear.

patterns.name: Significant event-based experiences
patterns.context: Describes people or things experiencing a significant event, action, or consequence; beyond examples overlapping with war or disaster patterns, no shared trigger condition can be identified.

patterns.name: Eye-related medical procedures
patterns.context: In the context of using a Morgan Lens, mentions eye irrigation, medication administration, or burns.

patterns.name: Negative criminal information in a biographical entry
patterns.context: A list entry identifies a person's conviction after their name or occupation.

10_19.description: 激活主要出现在战争、暴力、伤害及灾害等重大事件叙述，也见眼部烧伤的医疗说明和人物条目的定罪信息。各段共同点可能是事件的严重性或负面后果，但证据不足以归结为单一词汇模式。

patterns.name: 身体冲突或暴力事件
patterns.context: 叙述具体袭击、斗殴、受伤、被捕或暗杀等事件；词语可分散在事件描述中，并不总是同一种暴力。
patterns.domain: 法律案件、人物传记或历史叙事

patterns.name: 战争与军事行动
patterns.context: 军事人物、战争或舰船战史中，描述参战、战斗、行动、伤亡或暴行。
patterns.domain: 军事史、战争史百科叙述

patterns.name: 损伤、伤害与灾害后果
patterns.context: 提及眼部烧伤或地震造成的严重损害；此模式与军事暴力有部分语义重叠，但也覆盖非战争伤害。

patterns.name: 涉案或灾难的后续处置
patterns.context: 事件叙述中出现冲突、拘捕、起诉、驱逐等后续行动；较可能是事件型叙述的宽泛触发，边界不清。

patterns.name: 强烈的事件性经历
patterns.context: 描述人物或事物经历了显著事件、行动或后果；除与战争、灾害等模式重叠的用例外，无法确定共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 眼部医疗操作
patterns.context: Morgan Lens 的使用场景中，提及眼部冲洗、给药或烧伤。

patterns.name: 人物条目中的负面罪行信息
patterns.context: 人物列表条目在姓名或职业介绍后附加定罪信息。

en.concept: Local vocabulary in event and injury narratives
en.description: Activation is distributed across conflict, injury, death, military action, and contextual words in historical and legal narratives; it also appears in chemical patent terminology, a chest-pain fact, and low-intensity timeline formatting. The common thread is loose.

patterns.name: Indefinite articles followed by bodily-harm or injury events
patterns.context: Activation lands on the indefinite article a/an, followed by a specific conflict, fatal event, or trauma noun; some describe events, others wounds.
patterns.domain: Legal narratives, historical biographies, and chronicles; passages [1][2][9][10]

patterns.name: Events or circumstances following in
patterns.context: In introduces the context of participating in, experiencing, or being in an event or period; in the strongest examples, it is immediately followed by a and an event noun.

patterns.name: Aviation exploration and military activity
patterns.context: Describes maritime exploration voyages or a pilot participating in multiple air battles; activation centers on the activity, an air-battle adjective, or a participation construction.

patterns.name: Material chemistry term fragment
patterns.context: In a patent-process description, tokens combine to form diepoxide, a raw material used to prepare fluorinated-alkyl multifunctional urethane acrylates.

patterns.name: Legal case procedural narrative
patterns.context: In a case’s facts and procedural history, mentions a deceased person’s chest pain and referral; high activation lands on the medical symptom noun.

patterns.name: Violence and disaster vocabulary
patterns.context: Historical narratives mention violent events such as plunder, torture, or massacres, or a person dying of illness; trigger words do not all occur in the same grammatical structure.

patterns.name: Historical chronicle format
patterns.context: A chronicle format arranged by dates, dashes, and event entries; dates and entry separators activate, but weakly.

10_19.concept: 事件与伤害叙述中的局部词汇
10_19.description: 激活分布于历史与法律叙事中的冲突、伤害、死亡、军事行动及其情境词，也见化学专利术语、胸痛事实和低强度年表格式；共同线索较松散。

patterns.name: 不定冠词后接身体/伤害事件
patterns.context: 激活落在不定冠词 a/an 上，后接具体冲突、致命事件或创伤名词；其中有的描述事件，有的描述伤口。
patterns.domain: 法律叙事、历史人物传记与编年史；段 [1][2][9][10]

patterns.name: 介词 in 后的事件或处境
patterns.trigger: «in»8«a»10«fist»7；«in»6 what some believed to have been an assassination；«in»6«June»；«in»8 a multitude of aerial battles
patterns.context: in 引出参与、发生或处于某事件/时期的情境；最强例子中 in 后紧接 a 和事件名词。

patterns.name: 航空探索与军事活动
patterns.trigger: «exploratory»9«exped»itions；«aerial»9 battles；«in»8 a multitude of aerial battles
patterns.context: 描述海上探索航行或飞行员参与多场空战，激活集中于活动方式、空战形容词或参与结构。

patterns.name: 材料化学术语片段
patterns.context: 专利工艺描述中，跨 token 拼成 diepoxide，指含氟烷基的多官能团氨基甲酸酯丙烯酸酯制备原料。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景、化学材料

patterns.name: 法律案件程序叙述
patterns.context: 案件事实与程序经过中，提及死者胸痛并转诊；高激活落在医疗症状名词上。

patterns.name: 暴力与灾难词汇
patterns.context: 历史叙述中出现掠夺、酷刑、屠杀等暴力事件，或人物因疾病死亡；触发词并不都处于同一语法结构。

patterns.name: 历史编年格式
patterns.context: 按日期、破折号和事件条目排列的编年史格式；日期与条目分隔符有激活，但强度低。

en.description: Covers causes of death, deaths from wartime violence, legal offenses, and medical head injuries; the shared theme is contexts involving death, injury, or serious adverse outcomes, but trigger phrases and styles vary.

patterns.name: Cause-of-death phrases
patterns.context: When describing a person's death in a biography or category, activation concentrates on “from” and may extend to the following article, cause-of-death term, and related words.

patterns.name: Violent deaths and wartime casualties
patterns.context: Narratives of deaths and injuries caused by war, persecution, or group violence.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia military history and historical narratives

patterns.name: Criminal convictions and offenses
patterns.context: Jury verdicts, convictions, or charges appear in legal texts; activation concentrates on offense lead-in terms and the crime names that follow.

patterns.name: Medical complications and head injuries
patterns.context: Perioperative complications following bleeding or head injuries are discussed in medical abstracts; activation is prominent on “head”.

10_19.description: 覆盖人物死因、战争暴力致死、法律罪名及医学头部损伤；共同点是死亡、伤害或严重不良后果相关语境，但触发短语与文体各异。

patterns.name: 死亡原因短语
patterns.trigger: “deaths from influenza”、“death from a heart attack”、“died from battle wounds”、“died of cancer”
patterns.context: 人物生平或分类中描述死亡时，激活集中在“from”，并可延伸到后接的冠词、死因词及相关词。

patterns.name: 暴力致死及战争伤亡
patterns.context: 叙述战争、迫害或群体暴力造成的死亡和伤害。

patterns.name: 刑事定罪与罪名
patterns.trigger: “guilty by a jury of the charge of aggravated assault”、“guilty of second degree murder, kidnapping, and felony false imprisonment”、“criminal offense of procuring a female for a house”
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现陪审团裁决、定罪或指控；激活集中于罪名引导词及其后的犯罪名称。

patterns.name: 医学并发症及头部损伤
patterns.trigger: “complications are common after subarachnoid haemorrhage or head injury”
patterns.context: 医学摘要中讨论出血或头部损伤后的围手术期并发症；激活显著落在“head”。

en.description: Activation clusters mainly in contexts of death, injury, atrocities, and military conflict; it also appears in legal allegations of sex crimes, accounts of atrocities during expulsions, and encyclopedia birth-and-death categories. The common thread is bodily harm or severe violence, but contexts and word forms vary.

patterns.name: Death, killing, or casualties
patterns.context: Narratives or classifications of a person’s death, killing, cause of death, or death event; no specific syntactic position is required.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies, historical entries, and category labels

patterns.name: Violent injury and experiences of harm
patterns.context: Mentions bodily injury, atrocities, or serious crimes in war, accounts of detention, or legal texts.

patterns.name: Military operations and combat
patterns.context: War or military narratives involving combat, military service, prisoners of war, or operations; “patrol” appears in a statement later challenged.

patterns.name: Sex-crime allegations in criminal justice
patterns.context: Legal opinions describe sex crimes for which a defendant was prosecuted or accused; this pattern depends on a legal-litigation context.
patterns.domain: US case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Expulsion and atrocities against civilians
patterns.context: Describes the Ottoman authorities expelling local civilians and the atrocities that followed.

patterns.name: Birth and death years in category labels
patterns.context: Wikipedia category entries use years to mark people’s birth and death; activation lands near a word such as “deaths”.

10_19.description: 激活主要聚集在死亡、致伤、暴行与军事冲突语境，也出现在性犯罪案件的法律指控、驱逐暴行记述及百科生卒类别中；共同点是涉及人身伤亡或严重暴力，但语境和词形并不一致。

patterns.name: 死亡、遇害或伤亡
patterns.context: 人物死亡、被杀、死因或死亡事件的叙述与分类；不要求特定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 百科传记、历史条目与类别标签

patterns.name: 暴力伤害与受伤经历
patterns.context: 战争、拘捕经历或法律文本中提及人身伤害、暴行及严重犯罪。

patterns.name: 军事行动与战斗
patterns.context: 战争或军旅叙述，涉及战斗、军事服役、战俘或作战行动；其中“patrol”出现在一段后来被质疑的供述中。

patterns.name: 刑事司法中的性犯罪指控
patterns.trigger: “engaging in prostitution”, “criminal offense of procuring a female for a house of”
patterns.context: 法律意见书描述被告遭起诉或被指控的性犯罪；本模式依赖法律诉讼语境。

patterns.name: 驱逐及针对平民的暴行
patterns.context: 描述奥斯曼当局驱逐当地平民，以及随之发生的暴行。

patterns.name: 类别标签中的出生与死亡年份
patterns.context: Wikipedia 类别条目中以年份标记人物生卒年代；激活落在“deaths”一类词附近。

en.description: Primarily responds to serious violent and lethal crimes and related criminal-justice narratives; also covers duels, wartime combat, and atrocities against civilians, and responds to procedural and boilerplate language in judgments.

patterns.name: Violent crime and criminal justice
patterns.context: In legal judgments, indictments, crime reporting, or crime narratives, often adjacent to crime categories, convictions, victims, or violent incidents; activation may also fall on subword fragments within crime terms.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, news, and historical/biographical narratives

patterns.name: Duels
patterns.context: A biographical narrative describes a duel in which an opponent is killed and the duelist flees to England; criminal-justice vocabulary does not appear directly.

patterns.name: War and military atrocities
patterns.context: Narratives of war, sieges, or military actions against civilians; involving combat casualties or atrocities.

patterns.name: Boilerplate and procedural language in legal texts
patterns.context: Standard formats and procedural narratives in court judgments or legal arguments; often co-occurs with crime-type terms, but also forms a salient context in its own right.

10_19.description: 主要响应严重暴力及致死犯罪、相关刑事司法叙述；也覆盖决斗、战争战斗与针对平民的暴行，并对判决书的程序和模板用语有反应。

patterns.name: 暴力犯罪与刑事司法
patterns.context: 在法律判决、起诉、犯罪报道或罪案叙述中，常与犯罪类别、定罪、受害者或暴力事件相邻；激活也可能落在犯罪词内部的分词片段。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、新闻及历史/人物叙述

patterns.name: 决斗
patterns.context: 人物叙述中出现杀死对手并逃往英国的决斗事件；犯罪司法词汇并未直接出现。

patterns.name: 战争与军事暴行
patterns.context: 战争、围城或针对平民的军事行动叙述；涉及战斗伤亡或暴行。

patterns.name: 法律文本的模板与程序用语
patterns.context: 法院判决或法律论证的固定格式和程序叙述；与犯罪类型词常同时出现，但本身也形成显著语境。

en.concept: Events related to death, disease, and criminal injury
en.description: Primarily responds in legal texts involving charges, convictions, and court proceedings; it also activates on medical infection names, encyclopedia categories, military casualty statistics, and a relative’s accidental death in a personal narrative.

patterns.name: Criminal offenses and convictions
patterns.context: In criminal-justice contexts, lists charges or degrees of crime, or recounts a defendant’s conviction, sentencing, or appeal; sometimes appears alongside the specific method of an offense or a victim.
patterns.domain: Court decisions, statutes, and crime narratives

patterns.name: Litigation proceedings and court rulings
patterns.context: Describes proceedings such as trials, jury verdicts, appeals, or protective orders; often appears alongside an offense or a ruling concerning a party.

patterns.name: Infections and disease names
patterns.context: Bacterial infections and the diseases or symptoms they cause are listed consecutively.

patterns.name: Encyclopedia category labels
patterns.context: Category labels at the end of Wikipedia entries list a person’s region, occupation, era, or cause of death.

patterns.name: War-unit casualty statistics
patterns.context: Service records for a regiment tally those killed in action, those who died of wounds, and deaths from disease.

patterns.name: Breakup of an intimate relationship and a relative’s death
patterns.context: A personal narrative says a boyfriend’s cousin died in a car accident, then mentions the boyfriend returning to Britain; the death is the emotional backdrop.

10_19.concept: 死亡、疾病与刑事伤害相关事件
10_19.description: 主要在罪名、定罪及法院程序的法律文本中响应；另对医学感染病名、百科分类、军队伤亡统计，以及个人叙述中的亲属意外死亡有激活。

patterns.name: 刑事犯罪与定罪判决
patterns.context: 刑事司法语境中列举罪名、犯罪等级，或叙述被告被定罪、判刑、上诉；有时与具体犯罪方式或受害者并列。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、法条及犯罪叙述

patterns.name: 诉讼程序与法院裁定
patterns.context: 描述法院审理、陪审团裁决、上诉或保护令等程序；常与犯罪或当事人判决并现。

patterns.name: 感染及疾病名称
patterns.context: 细菌感染及其引发的疾病或症状被连续列举。

patterns.name: 百科分类标签
patterns.context: 维基百科条目末尾以分类标签列出人物地域、职业、年代或死亡原因。

patterns.name: 战争部队伤亡统计
patterns.context: 军团服役记录中统计阵亡、伤重死亡及疾病死亡人数。

patterns.name: 亲密关系分手及亲属死亡
patterns.context: 个人叙述中，男友的表亲因车祸死亡，随后提及男友回到英国；死亡是情感叙事背景。

en.description: Activation covers death, fatal incidents, and criminal-justice narratives, and also appears in narratives about streptococcal infection, domestic-violence homicides, and plots involving extramarital affairs; the shared thread leans toward negative events, but content types differ markedly.

patterns.name: Narratives of death and fatal incidents
patterns.context: Involves a person's death, cause of death, or subsequent events; includes personal narratives, biographies, and chronicles.
patterns.domain: Personal narratives, encyclopedia biographies, historical chronicles

patterns.name: Criminal convictions and sentencing
patterns.context: Criminal charges, convictions, offenses, or the death penalty are mentioned in judicial or legal contexts; common in judgments and case summaries.

patterns.name: Infection and disease names
patterns.context: Describes pathogens and the infections or clinical diseases they cause.

patterns.name: Domestic violence and homicide investigations
patterns.context: Police or prosecutors describe a homicide case, explicitly placing it in a domestic-violence context.

patterns.name: Extramarital affairs
patterns.context: A character profile states that a married person has an affair with a colleague.

10_19.description: 激活覆盖死亡、致死事件与犯罪司法叙述，也见于链球菌感染及家庭暴力凶杀通报、婚外情剧情介绍；共同线索偏向负面事件，但内容类型差异明显。

patterns.name: 死亡及致死事件叙述
patterns.trigger: « died»、« dies»、« death»、« died» in an attempted prison break、« dies» of a wound
patterns.context: 涉及人物死亡、死亡原因或其后的事件；包括私人叙事、人物传记和编年史。
patterns.domain: 个人叙事、百科传记、历史编年

patterns.name: 刑事定罪与刑罚
patterns.trigger: « convicted»、« charge»、« aggravated» assault、« murder»、« rape»、« dangerous» crimes、« h»anged
patterns.context: 司法或法律语境中提到犯罪指控、定罪、罪名或死刑；常见于判决文本及案件介绍。

patterns.name: 感染及疾病名称
patterns.context: 描述病原体及其引起的感染或临床疾病。

patterns.name: 家庭暴力及凶杀调查
patterns.context: 警方或检方叙述凶杀案件，明确将事件置于家庭暴力背景中。

patterns.name: 婚外情
patterns.context: 人物简介中陈述已婚人物与同事有婚外情。

en.description: Activation appears on several local subword fragments: fragments of cellulitis, aviation and flight, casualty events, and contexts involving prison breaks and violent crime; it also appears near an unusual phrase in a medical abstract. Triggers are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Cell (string fragment)
patterns.context: In a list of infectious diseases, the marker lands on the initial segment and subsequent subword fragments of “cellulitis”; the surrounding text lists several streptococcal infections.

patterns.name: Air combat and aviation
patterns.context: Activation occurs in narratives mentioning flight, pilots, or aviation accidents, including combat experiences and fatal accidents.

patterns.name: Attempted prison break and death
patterns.context: Describes someone attempting a prison break and dying while incarcerated; activation clusters around “attempted prison break”.

patterns.name: Injury, trauma, and death events
patterns.context: Describes wounds, recovery from a shoulder injury, or a relative dying in a tragic car accident; the precise trigger location varies across passages.
patterns.domain: Historical timelines, sports biographies, personal narratives

patterns.name: Violent crimes and legal contexts
patterns.context: Involves murder, rape, domestic violence, or killing in a duel; includes lists of charges and case narratives in legal texts.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, crime news, historical biographies

patterns.name: Anomalous intensity near an infection list
patterns.context: The unusual phrase also activates near a list of diseases associated with streptococcal infection, but differs from the triggers on disease names.

10_19.description: 激活见于若干局部词片段：cellulitis 的分词片段、航空与飞行、伤亡事件，以及越狱和暴力犯罪语境；另有医学摘要中异常短语附近激活。触发并不统一。

patterns.name: 细胞（字符串片段）
patterns.context: 感染疾病列表中，标记落在“cellulitis”的首段及其后续子词片段；周围列举多种链球菌感染。

patterns.name: 空中战斗与航空
patterns.context: 提及飞行、飞行员或航空事故的叙述中激活，包括战斗经历和死亡事故。

patterns.name: 尝试越狱及死亡
patterns.context: 描述某人尝试越狱、服刑期间死亡；激活集中在“attempted prison break”一带。

patterns.name: 受伤、创伤与死亡事件
patterns.trigger: «wound»4« received»4« at»6« the»5；«shoulder»9« injury»；«died»5« in»8« a»8« tragic»7« car»7 accident
patterns.context: 叙述伤口、肩伤后康复，或亲属在悲剧性车祸中死亡；各段具体触发位置有所不同。
patterns.domain: 历史年表、体育传记、个人叙述

patterns.name: 暴力罪行及其法律语境
patterns.context: 涉及谋杀、强奸、家庭暴力或决斗杀人；包括法律文本中的罪名列举和案件叙述。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、犯罪新闻、历史传记

patterns.name: 感染疾病列表中的强度异常
patterns.context: 与链球菌感染相关的疾病清单中，该异常短语附近也有激活，但与疾病名称的触发不同。

en.description: Activation concentrates on disease names, deaths or serious injuries, criminal convictions and serious crimes, and keywords in narratives of war and disaster; it commonly appears in contexts describing serious health or physical harm.

patterns.name: Bacterial-infection terms
patterns.context: In lists of infectious diseases, the trigger occurs after disease names such as “impetigo”; the same list also includes “laryngitis”, “scarlet fever”, “septic”.

patterns.name: Death, injury, and fatal incidents
patterns.context: Describes a person's death, murder, or serious injury, especially causes of death or incidents.

patterns.name: Criminal convictions and sentencing
patterns.context: Legal texts describe a defendant being convicted, crime categories, or the application of a sentence; also includes lists of serious crimes such as “rape”, “murder”, “child mol…”.

patterns.name: Outbreak of war and historical disasters
patterns.context: Describes the outbreak of war or lists disasters such as war, plague, and earthquakes and their consequences.

10_19.description: 激活集中于疾病名称、死亡或重伤事件、刑事定罪与严重犯罪，以及战争和灾难叙述中的关键词；多见于描述重大健康或人身危害的语境。

patterns.name: 细菌感染相关词
patterns.context: 感染疾病的列举中，触发词位于“impetigo”等病名之后；同列还出现“laryngitis”“scarlet fever”“septic”。

patterns.name: 死亡、受伤及致命事件
patterns.trigger: «died»4« in»3« an»6« attempted»9« prison»6 break；«shoulder»9« injury»1；«killed»4；«assassination»4
patterns.context: 描述个人死亡、谋杀或严重受伤，尤其涉及死亡原因或事件。
patterns.domain: 人物传记、体育史、历史叙述

patterns.name: 刑事定罪与刑罚
patterns.trigger: «of»9« grand»3« lar»2cen«y»1；«of»8« criminal»4« possession»4；«convicted»1« of»5« dangerous»3 crimes
patterns.context: 法律文本中描述被告被判罪、犯罪类别或刑罚适用对象；另有“rape”“murder”“child mol…”等严重犯罪列举。

patterns.name: 战争爆发与历史灾难
patterns.trigger: «the»3 outbreak« of»7« World»9« War»2 I；«the»8« outbreak»1« of»8« the»8« World»8« War»1« I»4
patterns.context: 叙述战争爆发，或列举战争、瘟疫、地震等灾难及其后果。

en.description: Activation is distributed across accounts of disease and injury, historical disasters or violent events, and criminal judgments; court-decision formats are the most concentrated, alongside several independent event descriptions.

patterns.name: Streptococcal infections and disease names
patterns.context: Introduces a pathogen and the infections or diseases it causes; disease names often end in medical suffixes such as -itis

patterns.name: Shoulder injury and recovery
patterns.context: Mentions recovery from an injury in an athlete’s contract or career narrative

patterns.name: Historical account of the outbreak of World War I
patterns.context: A historical timeline links a period of persecution or disaster to the outbreak of the First World War

patterns.name: Criminal judgments and charges
patterns.context: A court-decision summary gives the judgment date, defendant, trial type, and conviction charges, often first/fourth degree

patterns.name: Fire damage to a building
patterns.context: A school or building history states that the building was destroyed in a particular fire

patterns.name: Killing in a duel
patterns.context: A historical biography recounts an officer killing a fellow officer and then fleeing abroad

10_19.description: 激活分布于疾病与伤病、历史灾难或暴力事件，以及刑事判决等叙述；法律判决格式最集中，另有多种独立的事件描述。

patterns.name: 链球菌感染及疾病名称
patterns.context: 介绍病原体及其导致的感染或疾病，疾病名常以 -itis 等医学后缀结尾

patterns.name: 肩伤及恢复
