patterns.context: 出现在参考文献链接之后、句子或段落开头；该局部片段本身不明显属于长度或基因编码描述。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 正文与引用标记格式

en.description: Primarily sensitive to numbers and their units, sequence lengths, and coordinates in biomedical text; also covers transcript/protein isoforms, gene-cloning coding information, miRNA length definitions, and common molecular biology descriptions of DNA regulatory sequences.

patterns.name: Numeric or alphanumeric identifiers
patterns.context: Numbers, sequence lengths, coordinates, identifiers, or incomplete identifiers in biomedical text; numbers themselves are often split into multiple tokens
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, gene and nucleic acid/protein descriptions

patterns.name: Transcript and protein isoform descriptions
patterns.context: Compares transcript variants and their exons, protein lengths, or functions

patterns.name: Gene cloning and sequence/coding information
patterns.context: Reports gene cloning, sequence analysis, reading frames, base lengths, and encoded products
patterns.domain: Molecular biology paper abstracts or main text

patterns.name: miRNA definition and length
patterns.context: Introduces miRNA in a definition sentence and gives its nucleotide length

patterns.name: DNA regulatory sequences and promoters
patterns.context: Describes transcription factor binding sites, consensus sequences, spacer lengths, or promoter regulatory elements

10_109.concept: 生物医学分子信息与数值
10_109.description: 主要对生物医学文本中的数字及其单位、序列长度和坐标敏感；也覆盖转录本/蛋白异构体、基因克隆编码信息、miRNA长度定义及DNA调控序列等常见分子生物学表述。

patterns.name: 数字或字母数字标识符
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中的数字、序列长度、坐标、编号或残缺标识符；数字本身常被拆成多个 token
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、基因与核酸/蛋白质描述

patterns.name: 转录本与蛋白质异构体描述
patterns.trigger: “longest transcript”“isoform”“Transcript variant”“skips an in-frame exon”“shorter protein”“amino acids”
patterns.context: 比较转录本变体及其外显子、蛋白质长度或功能

patterns.name: 基因克隆及序列/编码信息
patterns.trigger: “encoding genes”“cloned”“Nucleotide sequence analysis”“gene of ... bp”“open reading frame”“encoding ... protein”
patterns.context: 报告基因克隆、序列分析、阅读框、碱基长度和编码产物
patterns.domain: 分子生物学论文摘要或正文

patterns.name: miRNA定义与长度
patterns.trigger: “MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are small non-coding RNAs of 21 to 25 nucleotides”及“microRNAs are endogenous small non-coding RNAs consisting of 21–25 nucleotides”
patterns.context: 以定义句介绍 miRNA，并给出其核苷酸长度
patterns.domain: 生物医学综述或研究论文

patterns.name: DNA调控序列与启动子
patterns.trigger: “consensus TATA box”“consensus target sequence”“spacer of up to 13 bases”“androgen responsive element (ARE)”
patterns.context: 描述转录因子结合位点、共识序列、间隔长度或启动子调控元件
patterns.domain: 基因调控与分子生物学

en.concept: Molecular biology entities and their structural descriptions
en.description: Primarily responds to definitions or structural descriptions of genes, RNA, proteins, and nucleic acid sequences in biomedical literature, often accompanied by lengths, units, sequences, and genomic information; also covers related content such as transcriptional regulation, gene cloning, and protein-length comparisons.

patterns.name: microRNA definitions and nucleotide lengths
patterns.context: Introduces the definition, size, and function of miRNAs in paper introductions or background sections; recurs in similar definitional sentences

patterns.name: Length descriptions of genes and nucleic acid sequences
patterns.context: Describes gene structure, nucleotide sequences, or coding length; no specific biological entity is required

patterns.name: Protein complexes and promoter binding
patterns.context: Describes transcription-initiation-related protein complexes and their DNA-binding sequences

patterns.name: Gene expression regulation and promoter response elements
patterns.context: Describes hormone regulation of gene expression and response elements in promoters

patterns.name: Esterase gene cloning and sequence analysis
patterns.context: Introduces the cloning, sequence, and length of a bacterial esterase gene

patterns.name: Plant protein gene cloning and length
patterns.context: Reports the cloning and expression of a plant-derived gene, and the length of the gene or protein

patterns.name: Stop codons and protein-length comparisons
patterns.context: Compares stop codons and protein-length differences in neurohypophyseal hormone-related cDNAs

patterns.name: NPM gene genomic structure
patterns.context: Describes the genomic span, location, and expression context of the human NPM1 gene

10_109.concept: 分子生物学实体及其结构描述
10_109.description: 主要响应生物医学文献中对基因、RNA、蛋白及核酸序列的定义或结构描述，常伴随长度、单位、序列和基因组信息；也覆盖转录调控、基因克隆及蛋白长度比较等相关内容。

patterns.name: microRNA 定义与核苷酸长度
patterns.trigger: “MicroRNAs”/“microRNAs”或“miRNAs”，并出现“small non-coding RNAs”及“21”至“25 nucleotides”一类表述
patterns.context: 论文引言或背景中介绍 miRNA 的定义、大小和功能；反复出现在相似的定义句中

patterns.name: 基因与核酸序列的长度描述
patterns.context: 描述基因结构、核苷酸序列或编码长度；不要求特定生物实体
patterns.domain: 分子生物学摘要或论文

patterns.name: 蛋白质复合物与启动子结合
patterns.context: 描述转录起始相关蛋白复合物及其 DNA 结合序列

patterns.name: 基因表达调控与启动子应答元件
patterns.context: 描述激素对基因表达的调控以及启动子上的应答元件

patterns.name: 酯酶基因克隆与序列分析
patterns.context: 介绍细菌酯酶基因的克隆、序列及长度

patterns.name: 植物蛋白基因克隆与长度
patterns.context: 报告植物来源基因的克隆、表达及基因或蛋白长度

patterns.name: 终止密码子与蛋白质长度比较
patterns.context: 比较神经垂体素相关 cDNA 中止止密码子及蛋白长度差异

patterns.name: NPM 基因基因组结构
patterns.trigger: “Structure and Expression of NPM Genes”“gene spans”“genomic region”“kb”“chromosome”
patterns.context: 描述人类 NPM1 基因的基因组跨度、位置及表达背景

en.description: Activation concentrates on descriptions of molecular entities, their sequences, lengths, and encoded products in biomedical text; a few fragments highlight DNA consensus motifs, spacer regions, and transcription complexes.

patterns.name: Molecular entities and sequence-length descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces molecules, genes, or proteins in biomedical literature, describing their composition, length, encoded products, or function; common expressions include “consisting of”, “encoding”, and “of … nucleotides/bp”.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, biomedical abstracts and papers

patterns.name: Nucleic acid sequence motifs and transcription complexes
patterns.context: Describes DNA sequences, consensus motifs and their spacing, or complexes formed by transcription factors and DNA.

patterns.name: Unidentified sporadic biological wording
patterns.context: The fragments cover different biomedical topics; activation may fall on specific tokens in gene, nucleic acid, or protein descriptions rather than on a unified semantic theme.

10_109.concept: 生物分子序列与基因描述
10_109.description: 激活集中于生物医学文本中的分子实体及其序列、长度、编码产物等描述；少数片段突出 DNA 共识基序、间隔区和转录复合体。

patterns.name: 分子实体与序列长度描述
patterns.trigger: “RNAs”“gene”“sequence”“cDNA”“protein”及其邻近长度数值，如“21 to 25 nucleotides”“744 bp”“181 amino acids”
patterns.context: 生物医学文献中介绍分子、基因或蛋白的组成、长度、编码产物或功能；常出现“consisting of”“encoding”“of … nucleotides/bp”等表达。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、生物医学摘要与论文

patterns.name: 核酸序列基序与转录复合体
patterns.context: 描述 DNA 序列、共识基序及其间隔，或转录因子与 DNA 形成的复合体。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、基因转录研究

patterns.name: 未识别的零散生物学措辞
patterns.trigger: “microRNAs”“gene”“sequence”“stop codon”等局部 token 也与主要触发词重叠，但无法单独解释激活差异
patterns.context: 片段涉及不同生物医学主题；激活可能落在基因、核酸或蛋白表述中的具体 token 上，而非一个统一语义主题。

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly in descriptions of genes, RNA, and their structure or length in biomedical papers: these include microRNA definitions and naming or quantitative information about genes, transcripts, exons, regulatory sequences, and protein products.

patterns.name: microRNA definitions and characteristics
patterns.context: When introducing microRNAs, describes their length, coding properties, or biological functions immediately after the name or in the same sentence

patterns.name: Nucleotide lengths of genes or transcripts
patterns.context: Describes the length of a specific gene, cDNA, or transcript; common in abstracts on gene cloning and sequence analysis

patterns.name: Quantitative descriptions of gene structure or sequences
patterns.context: Includes structural descriptions such as gene-regulatory complexes, exon counts, or promoter coordinates; need not involve nucleotide length

patterns.name: unexplained: single gene names and protein product lengths
patterns.context: Describes plant proteins or gene products; locally resembles topics such as length, microRNA definitions, and gene structure, but lacks a clear shared trigger pattern

10_109.concept: 分子生物学序列描述
10_109.description: 激活主要集中于生物医学论文中基因、RNA及其结构或长度的描述：包括microRNA定义，以及基因、转录本、外显子、调控序列和蛋白产物的命名或定量信息。

patterns.name: microRNA 定义与特征
patterns.context: 介绍 microRNAs 时，紧接名称或在同一句中描述其长度、编码属性、生物功能

patterns.name: 基因或转录本的核苷酸长度
patterns.trigger: 数字与 «bp» 或 «nucleotides»，如 «7»«44»« bp»、«133»«5»« bp»、«620»« nucleotides»、«9»«54»« bp»
patterns.context: 描述特定基因、cDNA或转录本的长度；常见于基因克隆与序列分析摘要

patterns.name: 基因结构或序列的定量描述
patterns.context: 出现基因调控复合物、外显子数或启动子坐标等结构性描述；不要求涉及核苷酸长度
patterns.domain: 分子生物学及遗传学论文

patterns.name: unexplained：单个基因名称与蛋白产物长度
patterns.context: 植物蛋白或基因产物描述；与长度、microRNA定义及基因结构等主题有局部相似，但缺少清晰的共同触发形式

en.concept: Molecular biology sequence and length descriptions
en.description: Primarily responds to descriptions of gene, protein, or RNA sequences and structures in biomedical text, especially reading frames, nucleotide/amino acid lengths, and numeric units; also includes DNA-binding sequences, gene arrangements, and protein fragments. The common thread is molecular biology terminology and quantitative sequence information rather than a single topic.

patterns.name: Gene length and reading-frame numbers
patterns.context: In molecular biology abstracts or papers describing gene/cDNA structure, sequence length, or encoded protein length, numbers appear alongside units or reading-frame terminology
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, gene and protein sequence descriptions

patterns.name: Protein complexes and binding sequences
patterns.context: Describes transcription factor binding to DNA, target sequence composition, or spacing between repeat sequences

patterns.name: Gene families and chromosomal clusters
patterns.context: Describes clusters of related genes in the genome and the length of the region

patterns.name: Protein sequence fragments and molecular weight
patterns.context: Maps protein electrophoresis bands or terminal fragments to inferred amino acid sequences

patterns.name: Noncoding RNA length and function
patterns.context: Introduces RNA classes, nucleotide lengths, and regulatory functions
patterns.domain: RNA biology reviews or paper introductions

10_109.concept: 分子生物学序列与长度描述
10_109.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中基因、蛋白质或RNA的序列与结构描述，尤其是编码框、核苷酸/氨基酸长度及数值单位；也涉及DNA结合序列、基因排列和蛋白质片段。共同点是分子生物学术语与定量序列信息，而非单一主题。

patterns.name: 基因长度与编码框数字
patterns.trigger: "open reading frame"、"intron-less gene"、"exon"，以及紧邻的 bp、nucleotides、amino acids 数值，如 «7»«44»、«181»、«133»«5»
patterns.context: 分子生物学摘要或论文中描述基因/cDNA结构、序列长度、编码蛋白长度时，数字与单位或编码框术语相邻
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、基因与蛋白质序列描述

patterns.name: 蛋白质复合物与结合序列
patterns.trigger: "ternary complex"、"DNA sequence"、"consensus TATA box"；"consisting of 2 copies"、"spacer"
patterns.context: 描述转录因子与DNA结合、靶序列构成或重复序列间隔长度
patterns.domain: 分子生物学与转录调控

patterns.name: 基因家族与染色体聚集
patterns.context: 描述相关基因在基因组中的成簇排列及区域长度
patterns.domain: 基因组学与蛋白质家族研究

patterns.name: 蛋白质序列片段及分子量
patterns.context: 将蛋白质电泳条带或末端片段与推导出的氨基酸序列对应
patterns.domain: 蛋白质生物化学与序列分析

patterns.name: 非编码RNA长度与功能
patterns.context: 介绍RNA类别、核苷酸长度及其调控功能
patterns.domain: RNA生物学综述或论文引言

en.concept: Quantification and classification markers in scientific text
en.description: Most patterns involve numbers representing molecular lengths or quantities in biomedical text, especially numbers adjacent to units such as bp, nt, bases, nucleotides, or amino acids; there are also phoneme/vowel contrasts in phonetics and one unclear instance of 29.1.

patterns.name: Biomolecular lengths and quantities
patterns.context: Describes quantitative properties such as the length or copy number of genes, transcripts, RNA, or proteins in biomedical text; numbers are commonly followed by bp, nt, bases, nucleotides, or amino acids
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, genetics, and biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: Phoneme and vowel contrasts
patterns.context: Uses vowels in different words as contrasting examples when discussing phonetic representations or speech classification
patterns.domain: Phonetics and speech recognition patent background

patterns.name: Decimal values in technical text
patterns.context: A decimal value appears in a technical sentence about a protein complex and DNA sequence; the value's referent is unclear

10_109.concept: 科学文本中的定量与分类标记
10_109.description: 多数模式是生物医学文本中数字表示的分子长度或数量，尤其数字与 bp、nt、bases、nucleotides、amino acids 等单位相连；另有语音学中的 phoneme/元音对比，以及一处含义不明的 29.1。

patterns.name: 生物分子长度与数量
patterns.trigger: “954 bp”“1221 bp”“1335 bp”“744 bp”“∼22 nucleotides”“181 amino acids”“13 bases”“21nt”及数字与单位相连的表达
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中描述基因、转录本、RNA或蛋白质的长度、拷贝数等定量属性；常见数字后接 bp、nt、bases、nucleotides 或 amino acids
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、遗传学与生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 音位与元音对比
patterns.context: 讨论语音表征或语音分类时，以不同词中的元音作为对比例子
patterns.domain: 语音学、语音识别相关专利背景

patterns.name: 技术文本中的小数数值
patterns.context: 描述蛋白质复合物与 DNA 序列的技术性语句中出现小数数值；数值所指不清
patterns.domain: 生物分子研究计划摘要

en.description: Primarily responds to nucleic acid lengths and their numeric expressions in biomedical text, especially “number+nucleotides/bp/base pairs”; also occurs with gene upstream regions, chromosomal gene clusters, and occasional residue or sequence-position numbers.

patterns.name: Nucleic acid length and units
patterns.context: Numbers adjacent to nucleic acid length units, often describing RNA, gene, or fragment length; genomic terminology typically appears nearby.

patterns.name: Description of microRNAs at approximately 22 nt
patterns.context: Appears in definitions or overviews of miRNA/MicroRNAs, describing properties such as being short and noncoding.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, RNA and gene regulation

patterns.name: Specific nucleic acid length numbers
patterns.context: Specific values describe gene, transcript, or RNA length across different papers; not limited to a particular nucleic acid or fixed length.

patterns.name: Gene annotation and upstream regions
patterns.context: Length units occur alongside upstream distances in descriptions of gene definitions, SNP annotation, or promoter regions.

patterns.name: Base-pair scale of chromosomal gene clusters
patterns.context: Describes chromosomal gene cluster regions on the bp scale; not an RNA length definition.

patterns.name: Other specific genomic coordinates or sequence-length numbers
patterns.context: Numbers occur in descriptions of TATA box positions or protein residue fragments, without a clear length-unit pattern.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology papers; transcription complexes or protein sequence descriptions

10_109.concept: 生物序列长度及数字
10_109.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中核酸长度及其数字表达，尤其是“数字+nucleotides/bp/base pairs”；也见于基因上游区间、染色体基因簇，以及少数残基或序列位置数字。

patterns.name: 核酸长度与单位
patterns.context: 数字与核酸长度单位相邻，常用于描述 RNA 长度、基因长度或片段长度；附近通常出现基因组学术语。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、分子生物学论文

patterns.name: 约 22 nt 的 microRNA 描述
patterns.context: 出现在 miRNA/MicroRNAs 的定义或概述中，描述其短小、非编码等性质。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文，RNA 与基因调控

patterns.name: 特定核酸长度数字
patterns.context: 不同论文中用具体数值描述基因、转录本或 RNA 的长度；并不局限于某一种核酸或固定长度。

patterns.name: 基因注释与上游区间
patterns.context: 描述基因定义、SNP 注释或启动子区域时，长度单位与上游距离同现。
patterns.domain: 遗传学与基因组学方法

patterns.name: 染色体基因簇的碱基对规模
patterns.context: 以 bp 量级描述染色体上的基因簇区域；不是 RNA 长度定义。
patterns.domain: 基因组学、基因家族描述

patterns.name: 其他具体基因组坐标或序列长度数字
patterns.context: 数值出现在 TATA box 的位置描述或蛋白质残基片段描述中，长度单位模式不明显。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学论文；转录复合物或蛋白序列描述

en.concept: Definitions and length expressions in scientific text
en.description: Primarily responds to definitions of miRNA in biomedical text, especially small non-coding RNA and its approximately 22 nt length; also activates on phonetic vowel comparisons and numeric units describing gene, transcript, and protein lengths in molecular biology.

patterns.name: 22 nt in miRNA definitions
patterns.context: Introduces microRNA properties or functions in biomedical background sections; activation centers on definitional wording and nearby tokens

patterns.name: Phonetic vowel comparisons
patterns.context: Discusses how acoustic measurements distinguish speech or phonemes by comparing vowels in different words

patterns.name: Lengths of adjacent genes and transcripts
patterns.context: Describes criteria such as gene overlap, orientation, and transcript length; 21 nt is a transcript-length threshold here, not an explicit miRNA definition

patterns.name: Gene/protein sequence length numbers
patterns.context: Numbers and units recur when reporting cloned genes, coding regions, protein lengths, or molecular weights
patterns.domain: Molecular biology abstracts, NIH research plans

10_109.concept: 科学文本中的定义与长度表述
10_109.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中 miRNA 的定义，尤其 small non-coding RNA 与约22 nt长度；另对语音学元音比较，以及分子生物学中基因、转录本和蛋白长度的数字单位表述有激活。

patterns.name: miRNA定义中的22 nt
patterns.trigger: “MicroRNAs”/“microRNAs”或“miRNAs”，紧接着描述为“small non-coding RNAs”并出现“∼22 nucleotides”或“21 to 25 nucleotides”等长度
patterns.context: 生物医学背景段落中介绍 microRNA 的性质或功能；激活集中在定义性表述及其邻近 token
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 语音学元音比较
patterns.trigger: “the vowel in ‘pin’”和“the vowel in ‘pen’”中的“the”“vowel”及相关音标/词例
patterns.context: 讨论声学测量如何区分语音或音素，比较不同词中的元音
patterns.domain: 专利背景、语音识别/语音学

patterns.name: 相邻基因与转录本长度
patterns.context: 描述基因重叠、方向及转录本长度等判定参数；21 nt 在此是转录本长度阈值，而非明确的 miRNA 定义
patterns.domain: 生物学论文方法或结果

patterns.name: 基因/蛋白序列长度数字
patterns.trigger: “bp”“open reading frame”“amino acids”及其附近的数字，如“744 bp”“1335 bp”“181 amino acids”“317 amino acids”
patterns.context: 报告克隆基因、编码区、蛋白长度或分子量时，数字和单位反复出现
patterns.domain: 分子生物学摘要、NIH 研究计划

en.concept: Descriptions of technical objects and structures
en.description: Primarily responds to biomedical sequences and descriptions of their structure, labels, and genomic locations, often with specialized terminology, sequence lengths, and experimental language; also activates for speech-sound contrasts and explanations of electronic text typography.

patterns.name: Descriptions of biological gene and protein sequences
patterns.context: Describes genes, proteins, nucleic acid sequences, cloning, or expression; often includes length, structure, annotation, or experimental information.

patterns.name: N-terminal and molecular tags/domains
patterns.context: Describes protein termini, domains, or added tags in a molecular biology context.

patterns.name: Genomic locations and regional ranges
patterns.context: Describes upstream regions, clustering, or chromosomal locations of genes.

patterns.name: Speech phonemes and vowel contrasts
patterns.context: Discusses classifying speech by acoustic features and gives examples of words with similar pronunciations.

patterns.name: Gutenberg typography and font markers
patterns.context: Explains how font, ligatures, or capitalization are represented in electronic text.

10_109.concept: 技术性对象与结构描述
10_109.description: 主要响应生物医学序列及其结构、标签、基因组定位描述，常伴随专业名词、序列长度和实验语汇；另对语音音素对比与电子文本排版说明有激活。

patterns.name: 生物基因与蛋白质序列描述
patterns.context: 描述基因、蛋白质、核酸序列、克隆或表达；常出现长度、结构、注释或实验信息。

patterns.name: N-terminal与分子标签/结构域
patterns.context: 在分子生物学语境中说明蛋白质末端、结构域或附加标签。

patterns.name: 基因组位置与区域范围
patterns.context: 说明基因的上游区域、聚集方式或染色体位置。

patterns.name: 语音音素与元音对比
patterns.context: 讨论以声学特征对语音分类，并举发音相近词作例子。

patterns.name: Gutenberg排版与字体标记
patterns.context: 解释电子文本中的字体、连字或大小写格式表示。

en.description: Primarily responds to biological molecule terminology such as nucleotides, RNA, and their sequences or lengths; also covers transcripts, exons, protein variants, primers, and experimental annotations. It also responds sporadically to code character mappings and allowed-punctuation rules.

patterns.name: Small RNA terminology definitions
patterns.context: miRNA/MicroRNAs followed by a parenthetical abbreviation and a definitional description, especially terms such as small, non-coding, RNAs, and nucleotide lengths

patterns.name: Nucleotide sequences and lengths
patterns.context: Nucleotide(s) occurs alongside sequence, quantity, or length information; also includes local contexts discussing codons

patterns.name: Biomedical transcript and protein annotations
patterns.context: Descriptions annotating transcript variants, splice exons, protein isoforms, or cDNA/protein sequences

patterns.name: Primers, tags, and experimental constructs
patterns.context: Provides nucleic acid primer sequences or experimental details such as tags and sites in protein constructs

patterns.name: Gene variants and protein changes in lists
patterns.context: Lists variants using gene symbols, nucleotide substitutions, and protein positions/amino acid changes

patterns.name: Identifier-mapping code
patterns.context: Code uses character categories or character values as table entries mapping them to enums/constants

patterns.name: Allowed-character rules
patterns.context: Explicitly lists spaces and punctuation characters that are allowed or prohibited in input

patterns.name: Biomedical background regulatory descriptions
patterns.context: Uses molecules such as chemokines and NF-κB to describe regulatory relationships, followed by discussion of miRNA

10_109.concept: 生物序列与字符序列描述
10_109.description: 主要响应核苷酸、RNA及其序列/长度等生物分子术语，也覆盖转录本、外显子、蛋白变异、引物和实验注释；另对代码字符映射及允许标点规则有零散响应。

patterns.name: 小 RNA 术语定义

patterns.context: Describes the base length of cDNA, genes, or sequences, as well as open reading frames and coding products; numbers may be split into multiple tokens

patterns.name: Mutation and frameshift variant annotation
patterns.context: Reports genetic variants and deletions and their consequences for translation products or proteins; may also occur in case tables or variant lists
patterns.domain: Genetics, disease research, and variant annotation

patterns.name: Protein expression and construct terminology
patterns.context: Describes cloning protein fragments, bacterial expression vectors, and construct details, often alongside residue counts or tag information
patterns.domain: Molecular biology methods and protein engineering

patterns.name: Characterization of gene and protein products
patterns.context: Introduces enzymes encoded by genes and properties such as protein length and molecular weight, often alongside open reading frame descriptions

patterns.name: Splice sites and splicing regulation
patterns.context: Discusses alternative splicing, splice sites, or intronic cis-regulatory elements; the fifth passage describes a deletion and frameshift following a splice-site abnormality
patterns.domain: RNA splicing and gene regulation research

patterns.name: Transcriptional regulatory regions and effects
patterns.context: Describes positive or negative effects of DNA regions on transcription relative to the transcription start site or upstream sequence

patterns.name: RNA classes and length descriptions
patterns.context: Defines a noncoding RNA class and gives its nucleotide length; this passage is primarily background information

patterns.name: Genotype and case-table fields
patterns.context: Compressed table- or database-style text juxtaposes cases, cell lines, mutations, and negative/positive status in a discontinuous format

10_109.concept: 分子生物学中的基因与变异注释
10_109.description: 激活集中于生物医学遗传与分子生物学文本：序列长度和开放阅读框、蛋白编码/表达、突变缺失与移码、剪接调控、转录效应及RNA定义；也响应病例表格中的突变与状态字段。

patterns.name: 核酸序列长度与编码区描述
patterns.trigger: «bp»、«base pairs»、«open reading frame»、«encoding»；如“2 178 base pairs”“17 31 bp putative open reading frame”“12 21 bp”“9 54 bp”
patterns.context: 描述 cDNA、基因或序列的碱基长度，以及开放阅读框和编码产物；数字可能被拆分成多个 token

patterns.name: 突变与移码变异标注
patterns.trigger: «deletion»、«frameshift»、«del»及变异后的氨基酸标记；如“introduces a frameshift”“frameshift deletion”“p.Ala1304Valfs*3”“p.Arg177*”
patterns.context: 报告遗传变异、缺失及其对翻译产物或蛋白质的后果；也可出现在病例表格或变异列表中
patterns.domain: 遗传学、疾病研究与变异注释

patterns.name: 蛋白质表达与构建术语
patterns.context: 描述蛋白质片段的克隆、细菌表达载体及构建细节，常与残基数或标签信息相邻
patterns.domain: 分子生物学方法与蛋白质工程

patterns.name: 基因与蛋白质产物表征
patterns.context: 介绍基因编码的酶及蛋白质长度、分子量等性质，并常伴随开放阅读框描述
patterns.domain: 酶学与分子生物学摘要

patterns.name: 剪接位点与剪接调控
patterns.context: 讨论替代剪接、剪接位点或内含子顺式调控元件；第5段则是在剪接位点异常后出现缺失和移码

patterns.name: 转录调控区域及效应
patterns.context: 以转录起始位点或上游序列为参照，描述 DNA 区域对转录的正负调控效应
patterns.domain: 基因表达与启动子研究

patterns.name: RNA类别及长度说明
patterns.context: 定义非编码 RNA 类别并给出其核苷酸长度；此段主要是背景性说明

patterns.name: 基因型与病例表格字段
patterns.context: 压缩的表格或数据库式文本，将病例、细胞系、突变及阴性/阳性状态并列，格式不连续

en.concept: Biomedical molecular genetics text and a few anomalies
en.description: Primarily responds to biomedical genetics and molecular biology terminology, especially gene/transcript/protein structure, mutation and variant nomenclature, and microRNA length descriptions; also includes one instance of the uppercase blood-written “RUN” in a horror narrative.

patterns.name: Protein/gene structure and expression
patterns.context: Describes gene transcripts, exons, open reading frames, protein structure, or expression constructs in biomedical text; often accompanied by variant identifiers and molecular lengths.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, gene, and protein research papers

patterns.name: Mutation and variant nomenclature
patterns.context: Lists gene variants in genetics or disease research, often in c./p. coordinate, amino acid substitution, or nonsense mutation formats.
patterns.domain: Medical genetics and clinical research abstracts

patterns.name: microRNA definitions and lengths
patterns.context: Introduces microRNA as short noncoding RNA and gives its approximate length of 21–25 nucleotides and function.

patterns.name: Command words in a bloody scene
patterns.context: In a horror story, a word appears in capital letters written in blood, as a warning or command within the scene.

10_109.concept: 生物医学分子遗传文本及少量异常
10_109.description: 主要响应生物医学遗传与分子生物学术语，尤其基因/转录本/蛋白结构、突变变异命名及microRNA长度描述；另有一次恐怖叙事中血写的大写“RUN”。

patterns.name: 蛋白质/基因结构与表达
patterns.trigger: “protein tyrosine phosphatase”“ORF”“N-terminal His tag”“in frame AUG”“alternate promoters”“exons”“transcript variant”“isoform”“amino acids”
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中说明基因转录本、外显子、开放阅读框、蛋白结构或表达构建体；常伴随变体编号与分子长度。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、基因与蛋白研究论文

patterns.name: 突变与变异命名
patterns.context: 遗传学或疾病研究中列出基因变异，常以 c./p. 坐标、氨基酸替换或终止突变格式呈现。
patterns.domain: 医学遗传学、临床研究摘要

patterns.name: microRNA定义与长度
patterns.context: 引介 microRNA 时描述其为短的非编码 RNA，并说明约 21–25 个核苷酸的长度及功能。
patterns.domain: 生物医学综述或论文引言

patterns.name: 血腥场景中的命令词
patterns.context: 恐怖故事叙述中，词语以大写形式写在血迹上，作为场景内的警告或命令。

en.description: Activations appear across several common words and phrases: frameworks in multiple-domain contexts, the title words Episode and Enquiry, and local words in medical, technical, and email contexts. Aside from frameworks, there is no stable shared context.

patterns.name: Final-word activation on frameworks
patterns.context: Appears near the end of a phrase or sentence; marked in [1], [8], and [10].
patterns.domain: Academic text, technical Q&A, software documentation

patterns.name: Episode
patterns.context: Appears in the title information for the television show “I’ve Got a Secret”.

patterns.name: Enquiry
patterns.context: First word of a film entry title.

patterns.name: classification
patterns.context: Appears in a question about logistic regression.

patterns.name: combination
patterns.context: Appears in a review of combination treatment approaches for alcohol dependence.

patterns.name: protection
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of an abstract on T-cell line protection research.

patterns.name: energy production
patterns.context: Used with “production” to describe ketone bodies as fuel.

patterns.name: Departure/farewell wording
patterns.context: Appears in a farewell email stating the last day at Enron.

patterns.name: Unclear local activation
patterns.context: Appears in materials-science terminology for metal-organic frameworks; the specific trigger is difficult to determine from the fragment alone.

10_574.description: 激活散见于若干常见词及短语：多领域语境中的 frameworks，以及标题词 Episode、Enquiry 和医学、技术、邮件语境中的局部词语。除 frameworks 外，缺乏稳定共同上下文。

patterns.name: frameworks 的末词激活
patterns.context: 出现在短语或句子的结尾附近；在 [1]、[8]、[10] 均被标记。
patterns.domain: 学术文本、技术问答、软件文档

patterns.name: Episode
patterns.context: 出现在电视节目标题 “I’ve Got a Secret” 的标题信息中。

patterns.name: Enquiry
patterns.context: 作为电影条目标题的词首。

patterns.name: classification
patterns.context: 出现在有关逻辑回归的问句中。

patterns.name: combination
patterns.context: 出现在关于酒精依赖治疗方案组合的综述中。

patterns.name: protection
patterns.context: 出现在 T 细胞系保护研究的摘要开头。

patterns.name: energy production
patterns.context: 与 “production” 连用，描述酮体作为燃料。

patterns.name: departure/farewell wording
patterns.context: 出现在告别邮件中，说明离开 Enron 的最后一天。

patterns.name: 未明的局部激活
patterns.context: 出现在金属有机框架的材料术语中；仅凭片段难以判断具体触发因素。

en.concept: Technical text containing a set of frameworks/methods
en.description: Activation most consistently falls on the plural word “frameworks” across technical papers, NLP questions, and code explanations. Other examples include classification reports, treatment combinations, title words, and several isolated subword fragments, with dispersed semantics.

patterns.name: Plural noun for a set of frameworks or methods
patterns.context: Occurs when discussing frameworks available for selection, providing processing capabilities, or used in applications; also appears in noun phrases in technical papers.
patterns.domain: Machine learning, natural language processing, software/API, and materials science papers

patterns.name: Object of reporting or integration
patterns.context: In technical contexts, the trigger refers to a report of classification results or a combination of treatment plans.

patterns.name: Specific noun or title format in a title
patterns.context: A distinctive proper noun or title word appears in a title or entry name.
patterns.domain: Title of a quiz show, Wikipedia film entry

patterns.name: Local trigger on general vocabulary
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments of words; the surrounding sentences show no clear shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, NIH research descriptions, email

10_574.concept: 含框架/方法集合的技术文本
10_574.description: 激活最稳定地落在复数词“frameworks”上，跨技术论文、NLP 问题和代码说明；另有分类报告、治疗组合、标题词及若干孤立词片段，语义分散。

patterns.name: 框架或方法集合的复数名词
patterns.context: 出现在讨论可供选择、提供处理能力或用于应用的框架时；也可出现在技术论文的名词短语中。
patterns.domain: 机器学习、自然语言处理、软件/API，以及材料科学论文

patterns.name: 报告或集成的对象
patterns.context: 技术语境中，触发词指向分类结果报告或治疗方案的组合。

patterns.name: 标题中的特定名词或标题格式
patterns.context: 标题、条目名称中出现醒目的专名或标题词。
patterns.domain: 问答节目标题、维基百科电影条目

patterns.name: 一般词汇的局部触发
patterns.context: 激活分别落在词的子词片段上，所在句子并无明显共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、NIH 研究描述、邮件

en.description: The most consistent trigger is “frameworks” in technical text, especially discussions of frameworks, choices, or standards. Other examples include classification reports, energy production, code whitespace policies, and several title, formatting, and email-time triggers; the latter groups are difficult to unify.

patterns.name: “frameworks” in technical literature
patterns.context: The word form “frameworks” appears in contexts involving applications, choices, naming, or standards, usually with a preceding modifier.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, technical Q&A, software documentation, forum discussions

patterns.name: Software classification and evaluation terminology
patterns.context: Describes machine-learning tasks, framework selection, or software components in technical discussions.

patterns.name: Energy and production in specialized terminology
patterns.context: Discusses ketone bodies as fuel and their role in energy production in rat brains.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or formatting markers
patterns.context: Paragraph openings, Q&A labels, line breaks, or title information; no shared semantic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Paper metadata, Q&A, forum titles, historical show titles

patterns.name: Whitespace handling in code properties
patterns.context: The Java identifier Whites­pacePolicy, appearing near a PreserveAll setting.

patterns.name: Time in email sign-off context
patterns.context: An email sign-off states the time of the last day before leaving a job.

10_574.description: 最稳定的触发是技术文本中的 frameworks，尤其框架、选择或标准讨论；另有分类报告、能量生产、代码空白策略及若干标题、格式和邮件时间触发，后几类难以统一。

patterns.name: 技术文献中的 frameworks
patterns.context: 词形 frameworks 位于应用、选择、命名、标准等语境中；通常由前置修饰语限定。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、技术问答、软件文档、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 软件分类与评估术语
patterns.context: 技术讨论中描述机器学习任务、框架选择或软件组件。

patterns.name: 专业术语中的能量与生产
patterns.context: 讨论酮体作为燃料及其在大鼠脑中的能量生产作用。

patterns.name: 句首或格式性标记
patterns.context: 段落开头、问答标签、换行或标题信息；未见统一的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 论文元数据、问答、论坛标题、历史节目标题

patterns.name: 代码属性中的空白处理
patterns.context: Java代码中的标识符 Whites­pacePolicy，且出现在 PreserveAll 设置附近。

patterns.name: 邮件告别语境中的时间
patterns.context: 告别邮件中说明离职前最后一天的时间。

en.description: Activations span several types of contexts: energy-related words in academic text, proper nouns or technical compounds, document labels and formatting symbols, title tokens, and code identifiers. Aside from local token/formatting features, no unified semantic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Energy-related academic phrasing
patterns.context: In scientific abstracts or papers, energy co-occurs with words such as fuel, production, and activation; examples come from different research fields.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and technical terms in compounds
patterns.context: Activations fall on tokens that form parts of proper nouns, terms, or compound words; local contexts differ considerably, with no stable shared collocation.
patterns.domain: Materials science, biographical entries, programming Q&A, biomedicine, website Q&A

patterns.name: Section headings and formatting markers
patterns.context: Section markers, divider lines, and line breaks appear at the start of a document or near a heading, adjacent to following materials-science text.

patterns.name: Tokens in titles/show names
patterns.context: Multiple adjacent tokens activate in title-like phrases consisting of a person's name and a show title.

patterns.name: Abstract and question labels
patterns.context: Opening labels in abstracts or Q&A text, usually followed immediately by a line break.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and attribute assignments
patterns.context: Class names, attribute names, and assignment statements in code; identifiers often consist of multiple tokens.

10_574.description: 激活分布于多类场景：学术文本中的 energy 相关词、专名或技术复合词、文档标签与排版符号、标题词元及代码标识符。除局部词元/格式特征外，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: energy 相关学术表述
patterns.context: 科技摘要或论文语境中，energy 与 fuel、production、activation 等词搭配；出现于不同研究领域。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、机器学习、化学

patterns.name: 复合术语中的专名与技术词
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、术语或复合词的组成 token 上；各例局部上下文差异较大，未见稳定共同搭配。
patterns.domain: 材料科学、人物条目、编程问答、生物医学、网站问答

patterns.name: 分节标题及排版标记
patterns.context: 文档开头或标题附近，出现章节标记、分隔线和换行；与后续材料科学文字相邻。

patterns.name: 标题/节目名称中的词元
patterns.context: 人名与节目标题构成的标题式短语中，多个相邻词元有激活。

patterns.name: 摘要与问题标签
patterns.context: 摘要或问答正文的开头标签，通常紧接换行。

patterns.name: 代码标识符及属性赋值
patterns.context: 代码中类名、属性名及赋值语句，标识符常由多个 token 拼成。

en.description: The most consistent trigger is “energy” in academic text, especially scientific abstracts. Clear exceptions include PC-12, the code identifier “locations,” “metal-organic frameworks,” and “goTown” in game code.

patterns.name: “energy” and its scientific contexts
patterns.context: “energy” appears in the body text, often in scientific abstracts or research titles; topics include chemical oscillations, resonance energy transfer, gamma rays, graph energy, or nuclear energy.
patterns.domain: Academic texts in chemistry, physics, mathematics, and other fields

patterns.name: Specific entity or identifier PC-12
patterns.context: USS PC-12 appears in a Wikipedia entry title or name; there is no clear energy context.

patterns.name: “locations” identifier in code
patterns.context: “locations” is used as a variable or property in code, appearing in array assignment and map bounds update logic.

patterns.name: Metal-organic framework terminology
patterns.context: Discusses applications of metal-organic frameworks; this highly activated term is not part of an “energy” phrase.

patterns.name: Town navigation function in code
patterns.context: A town scene and navigation function in game or interactive-program code; it co-occurs with the “locations” variable but is not the same trigger.

10_574.description: 最稳定的触发是学术文本中的 energy，尤其科学摘要；另有明显例外：PC-12、代码标识符 locations、metal-organic frameworks，以及游戏代码中的 goTown。

patterns.name: “energy”及其科学语境
patterns.context: 正文中出现 energy，常见于科学摘要或研究标题；涉及化学振荡、共振能量转移、伽马射线、图能量或核能。
patterns.domain: 化学、物理、数学等学术文本

patterns.name: 特定实体或标识符 PC-12
patterns.context: 百科条目标题或名称中出现 USS PC-12；没有明显的 energy 语境。

patterns.name: 代码中的 locations 标识符
patterns.context: 代码中 locations 作为变量或属性名，分别出现在数组赋值及地图 bounds 更新逻辑中。

patterns.name: 金属有机框架术语
patterns.context: 谈及金属有机框架的应用；该高激活词不属于 energy 词组。

patterns.name: 代码中的城镇导航函数
patterns.trigger: «goTown»8；相关字符串«You are in the town square.»
patterns.context: 游戏或交互程序代码中的城镇场景及导航函数，与 locations 变量同现，但不是同一个触发词。

en.concept: new and various local word-form features
en.description: The most stable cross-segment signal is new (appearing in all 9 segments); in addition, Enquiry, scientific term fragments, sidelines, general prose phrases, and pathology markers each show local activation, with no shared semantics or unified context apparent.

patterns.name: Activation on new
patterns.context: new is marked across multiple domains and syntactic positions; the context does not require a particular sense or fixed collocation.

patterns.name: Enquiry title word
patterns.context: Enquiry is split into subwords and appears in a film entry title and its opening text; activation is concentrated on the initial subword and stem.

patterns.name: Specific scientific term fragments
patterns.context: These are subword fragments within scientific terms across different words and domains, with no unified semantics or stable syntactic context apparent.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, neuroscience, physics, and mass spectrometry

patterns.name: Repetition and compounds of sidelines
patterns.context: Appears in “on the sidelines” and the repeated emphasis “the sidelines of coal-fired generation,” including a word-final fragment and a repeated phrase.

patterns.name: General vocabulary and phrases in prose
patterns.context: Several ordinary words and phrases in the same passage are marked, spanning sentence openings, idioms, and proper nouns; no trigger condition consistently grouping these with other activations is apparent.

patterns.name: Disease markers and pathological expressions
patterns.context: In medical text describing metastatic patterns and immunohistochemical markers, multiple markers, disease-name fragments, and expression-related words are marked; new also appears in the same passage.

10_574.concept: new 与多种局部词形特征
10_574.description: 最稳定的跨段信号是 new（9段均出现）；此外，Enquiry、科学术语片段、sidelines、一般散文词组及病理标记各有局部激活，未显出共同语义或统一上下文。

patterns.name: new 的激活
patterns.context: 在多个领域和句法位置中，new 均被标记；上下文并不要求特定词义或固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：摘要、论文、网页、邮件

patterns.name: Enquiry 标题词
patterns.context: 词语 Enquiry 被拆分为子词，出现在电影条目标题及其开头正文；激活集中在词首子词和词干部分。

patterns.name: 特定科学词汇片段
patterns.context: 这些是跨词汇、跨领域的科学术语内部子词片段，未见统一语义或稳定的句法上下文。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、神经科学、物理学及质谱分析

patterns.name: sidelines 的重复及复合形式
patterns.context: 出现在“on the sidelines”及重复强调的“the sidelines of coal-fired generation”中，包含词尾片段和重复词组。

patterns.name: 散文中的一般词汇与短语
patterns.trigger: «could»4« be»7« made»6…；«Looking»5« at»7；«boom»4« and»5« bust»4；«Information»5« Age»8
patterns.context: 同一段中若干普通词和短语被标记，跨越句首、习语及专名；看不出能与其他激活一致归并的触发条件。

patterns.name: 疾病标志物及病理表达
patterns.context: 在描述转移模式及免疫组化标志物的医学文字中，多个标记、病名片段和表达相关词被标记；同段另有 new。

en.description: The most consistent signal is the occurrence of “of” in fixed phrases and compound structures; the patent trademark Track®, Hear in references, and the name Hearon also trigger strong activation, with the latter two possibly reflecting coincidental word forms or tokens.

patterns.name: “of” followed by a compound
patterns.context: Activation falls on the preposition of or its split token, often inside fixed phrases, compound structures, or noun phrases; it is sometimes accompanied by a hyphen, but this is not required.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; academic, Q&A, legal, patent, and technical texts

patterns.name: Patent trademark symbol
patterns.context: Strong activation appears near the registered mark at the end of a brand name.

patterns.name: Hear in a bibliography
patterns.context: Appears in the phrase “hear an online story” in a reference; activation is concentrated on Hear.
