patterns.name: Organization name in a list
patterns.context: The organization name Kenan-Flagler appears after a list of organizations or events recruiting minority and women students for business schools.

patterns.name: Aqueous solutions and electron-donor descriptions
patterns.context: Sentences in chemistry/biomedicine explain ionic bonds and electron-donor atoms such as oxygen in water molecules; activation falls on general function words and term fragments.

10_574.description: 激活分布于异质文本：网址片段、专名内部子串、行政字段、化学术语及科学叙述、商业与法律文书中的词语和数字；未见单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 网址及路径结构
patterns.context: URL、网址路径或文章链接中，激活落在协议、域名、路径片段及其内部子词上；常夹杂数字、斜线与连字符。

patterns.name: 专名与词内片段
patterns.context: 人名、机构名、公司名等专名内部的词片段或跨子词边界处激活，片段位置不固定。
patterns.domain: 法律、新闻、百科及 NIH 文本

patterns.name: 报告及行政字段
patterns.context: 格式化费用报告中，标题、字段标签和报告名附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语与化学式片段
patterns.context: 复杂化学名称、辅酶/甲基转移酶缩写与结构式中，激活覆盖术语内部子串、字母数字组合及连接符。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学文献

patterns.name: 技术/创业计划中的规模与专利申请词
patterns.trigger: « scale»2« production»3；« 4»2« liter»2；«50»2«L»2；« GL»2«P»3；« IND»2« application»1；« next»9« 12»2« months»3
patterns.context: 描述生产设施、产量、规范条件和申请计划的项目进展句中，多处实体与计划用语激活。
patterns.domain: NIH 资助申请/研究计划

patterns.name: 公司经营报道中的常用词和数字
patterns.trigger: « sales»3« and»3« its»4« CEO»5« stay»5« on»2« course»4；« mon»3«olithic»3；« $»9«11»4« billion»6
patterns.context: 新闻叙述公司领导、并购或经营状况时，句中常见词、公司名片段和金额都出现激活。

patterns.name: 法律争议与金额/税务条目
patterns.trigger: « filed»1« a»2« counterclaim»2；« Tin»neys« failed»1 to report« $»3«101»1«,»3963；« $»5«8»4«,»9»696；« deduction»1
patterns.context: 法律材料中涉及诉讼事实或税务争点时，激活落在程序词、当事人姓名、金额及扣除项目等不同位置。

patterns.name: 列表中的机构名
patterns.context: 机构名称 Kenan-Flagler 出现在商学院招募少数族裔和女性学生的组织/活动名单之后。

patterns.name: 水溶液与电子供体描述
patterns.trigger: « in»1 aqueous solution and« form»2 ionic bonds« with»1« an»1ions … electron« donor»1 atoms« such»2« as»1 oxygen
patterns.context: 化学/生物医学解释离子键及水分子中氧等电子供体原子的句子；激活的是一般语法词与术语片段。

en.concept: Salient subwords and formatting fragments in heterogeneous text
en.description: Activations span subwords in URLs and rare proper nouns, chemical terms, code identifiers, and numbers, spaces, and punctuation in tables/YAML; a few ordinary English content words also activate. The commonality appears to be sensitivity to salient, segmented, or formatted tokens in heterogeneous text, rather than a stable semantic feature.

patterns.name: Encoded and domain fragments in URLs
patterns.context: Domains, paths, or personal names in URLs are split into multiple subwords; activations are distributed across the URL and nearby characters.

patterns.name: Numbers and separators in structured data
patterns.context: Aligned spaces, numbers, punctuation, and boundary symbols in tables, range conditions, or serialized configurations; these do not depend on natural-language semantics.
patterns.domain: Q&A formatting, code output, and Unity YAML, [4][6][9]

patterns.name: Code identifiers and mixed-case strings
patterns.context: Class names, variable names, HTML/PHP fragments, and long identifiers composed of letters, numbers, and mixed case appear in code; activations fall on subword fragments of the identifiers.

patterns.name: In-word subword segmentation and technical terms
patterns.context: Complex chemical names, abbreviations, and their punctuation are split into multiple tokens; activation is concentrated on character fragments within terms.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of proper nouns or rare words
patterns.context: Names, brands, or rare proper nouns are split into irregular subwords; evidence here is limited and overlaps with the segmentation seen in URLs/code.

patterns.name: Semantic words in ordinary English narrative
patterns.context: Some content words activate in natural-language news or comment sentences, but there is no obvious unified meaning or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Business news, forum comments, and sports news, [1][7][10]

10_574.concept: 异质文本中的显著子词与格式片段
10_574.description: 激活遍布网址和罕见专名的子词、化学术语、代码标识符，以及表格/YAML中的数字、空格和标点；少数普通英文内容词也激活。共同点更像对异质文本中显著、分段或格式化的token敏感，而非稳定语义特征。

patterns.name: URL中的编码与域名片段
patterns.context: 网址中的域名、路径或个人姓名被拆分为多个子词；激活分散在URL及其附近字符。

patterns.name: 结构化数据中的数字与分隔符
patterns.context: 表格、范围条件或序列化配置中的对齐空格、数字、标点和边界符号；不依赖自然语言语义。
patterns.domain: 问答排版、代码输出与Unity YAML，[4][6][9]

patterns.name: 代码标识符和混合大小写字符串
patterns.context: 代码中的类名、变量名、HTML/PHP片段以及由字母、数字和大小写组成的长标识符；激活落在标识符的子词片段上。

patterns.name: 词内子词切分及技术术语
patterns.context: 复杂化学名称、缩写及其标点被切成多个token；激活集中于术语内部的字符片段。

patterns.name: 专名或罕见词的内部片段
patterns.context: 姓名、品牌或罕见专名被分成不规则子词；此处证据有限，且与网址/代码中的切分现象有交叠。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道及代码字符串，[1][3][5]

patterns.name: 普通英文叙述中的语义词
patterns.context: 自然语言新闻或评论句中若干内容词会激活，但没有明显统一的词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 商业新闻、论坛评论及体育新闻，[1][7][10]

en.description: Activation appears in several discrete formatted fragments: the business phrase “stay on course,” URLs and code identifiers, number/period strings, paper citation numbers, legal docket fields, and time expressions in research and development plans. There is no single stable word-meaning pattern across the examples.

patterns.name: “stay on course” phrase
patterns.context: In a news sentence about company sales and the CEO’s departure or leadership direction, the trigger falls mainly on the fixed phrase “stay on course”.

patterns.name: String fragments in mixed URLs
patterns.context: Short fragments in URLs, URL encoding, or domains/paths; no evident natural-language meaning trigger.

patterns.name: Code identifier and class-name fragments
patterns.context: Package names, class names, or identifiers in Java test code are segmented and matched; the fragments are within identifiers.

patterns.name: Numeric addresses and period-delimited formats
patterns.context: Period-separated number strings, IP-like addresses, or version/configuration data; activation falls on number and separator fragments.
patterns.domain: GitHub configuration or network address data

patterns.name: Fine-grained text in numbered citations
patterns.context: Bracketed citations and reference numbers in biomedical papers, with numbers mixed with words.

patterns.name: Literature citation markers and paper numbers
patterns.context: PLOS paper reference labels and period-delimited numbers appear near the body text; activation is concentrated on citation-marker fragments.

patterns.name: Tax amounts and table terminology
patterns.context: In tax case narratives, taxpayer names, amounts, deductions, and items such as Schedule C are interleaved; the precise strong-trigger locations cannot be reduced to a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Docket numbers and document fields
patterns.context: Case numbers, document numbers, page numbers, and date fields in court document headers; colons and number strings activate.

patterns.name: Time and quantity expressions in production plans
patterns.context: Specialized paragraphs about drug/formulation production scale, GLP conditions, and IND application plans; strong activation appears near time phrases.

10_574.description: 激活出现在多种离散格式片段：商业短语 stay on course、网址与代码标识符、数字/点号串、论文引用编号、法律案卷字段，以及研发计划中的时间表达。缺少跨段稳定的单一词义模式。

patterns.name: stay on course 短语
patterns.context: 新闻句中谈及公司销售及 CEO 的去留或领导方向，触发主要落在固定短语“stay on course”。

patterns.name: 混杂网址中的字符串片段
patterns.context: 网址、URL 编码或域名/路径中的短片段；并非明显的自然语言词义触发。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与类名片段
patterns.context: Java 测试代码中的包名、类名或标识符被分词后命中；片段处于标识符内部。

patterns.name: 数字地址及点号格式
patterns.context: 由点分隔的数字串、类似 IP 地址或版本/配置数据；激活落在数字与分隔符片段上。
patterns.domain: GitHub 配置或网络地址数据

patterns.name: 编号引用中的细分文本
patterns.context: 生物医学论文中方括号引用及文献编号，编号混有词语与数字。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 文献引用标记与论文编号
patterns.context: 正文附近出现 PLOS 论文参考文献标签和带点号的编号；激活集中在引用标记片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 税务金额与表格术语
patterns.context: 税务案件叙述中，纳税人姓名、金额、扣除额及 Schedule C 等内容交织；强触发具体落点未能归纳为单一语义。

patterns.name: 案卷编号及文档字段
patterns.context: 法院文件页眉中的案件号、文档号、页码和日期字段，冒号及数字串被激活。

patterns.name: 生产计划中的时间与数量表达
patterns.context: 药物/制剂生产规模、GLP 条件与 IND 申请计划的专业段落；时间短语附近有较强激活。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医药研发摘要

en.description: Activations are scattered across URLs, bibliographic citations, monetary amounts, years and segmented proper nouns, technical terms, and interface quotations. They occur mostly in structured or tokenized strings, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: URL and domain fragments
patterns.context: Punctuation, numbers, and word fragments are mixed and marked in long URLs, domains, or paths; local activations concentrate on URL character sequences rather than complete semantic sentences.
patterns.domain: Web links, news sites, and HackerNews text

patterns.name: Reference numbers and citation markers
patterns.context: Bracketed reference markers, citation numbers, and their alphanumeric fragments in biomedical papers; surrounding text concerns chemistry, biology, or medicine.

patterns.name: Number, amount, and identifier formats
patterns.context: Number strings are split into tokens, especially decimals, dollar amounts, and comma-separated amounts; their specific semantics vary.
patterns.domain: Code/data text, legal and tax text

patterns.name: Numeric years and subwords in company names
patterns.context: Years and segmented proper-name subwords activate locally when describing company history; most other narrative words are unmarked.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of car audio terminology
patterns.context: Compound names or technical terms are split and activated in hardware contexts discussing Mustang-style CVR, terminals, and connectors.

patterns.name: Quoted titles and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Interface quotations, titles, or proper names are segmented when introducing an academic search site; academic search terms such as Chemistry, papers, and cited also appear.

10_574.concept: 结构化字符串与分词边界
10_574.description: 激活分散于网址、文献引文、数字金额、年份与专名切分、技术名词及界面引文；多出现在结构化或被分词的字符串中，但没有单一稳定的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: URL与域名片段
patterns.context: 长 URL、域名或路径中的标点、数字与词片段被混合标记；局部激活集中在网址字符序列，而非完整语义句子。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、新闻网站与 HackerNews 文本

patterns.name: 参考文献编号与引文标识
patterns.context: 生物医学论文中的方括号参考文献标记、文献编号及其字母数字片段；周围正文涉及化学、生物或医学。

patterns.name: 数字、金额与编号格式
patterns.context: 数字串被切分成 token，尤其是带小数点的数字，或美元金额及逗号分隔的金额；具体语义不一致。
patterns.domain: 代码/数据文本、法律税务文本

patterns.name: 数字年份及公司名中的子词
patterns.context: 叙述公司历史时，年份和被切分的专名子词局部激活；其余叙事词大多未标记。

patterns.name: 汽车音响术语的分词片段
patterns.context: 在讨论 Mustang 风格 CVR、接线柱和连接器的硬件语境中，复合名称或技术词被拆分并激活。
patterns.domain: 产品讨论/技术论坛文本

patterns.name: 引用标题与专名片段
patterns.context: 介绍学术搜索网站时，界面引文、标题或专名被切分；同时出现 Chemistry、papers、cited 等学术检索词。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 产品/学术搜索讨论

en.description: Activation is scattered across URLs, numeric identifiers, citation tables, scanned image filenames, code, titles, and forum words. A possible commonality is fragments in formatted text, but trigger locations and content vary across examples.

patterns.name: Domains and path components in URLs
patterns.context: Appears in URLs, Markdown links, or URLs in code; activation is distributed across domains and paths rather than tied to a single fixed token.

patterns.name: Numbers and identifiers
patterns.context: Numbers appear in paper citations, dates, URL paths, or data tables; form and position vary.
patterns.domain: Academic literature, web pages, and data

patterns.name: Formatted citation markers and table structure
patterns.context: Activation falls near citation markers, table column headers, and reference numbers, mixing letters, numbers, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Document/page filenames and image markers
patterns.context: Repeated Markdown markers for scanned page images and numbered .tif filenames; activation also falls on path-like filename fragments.
patterns.domain: Scanned document transcriptions or page-image text

patterns.name: Code identifiers and syntax fragments
patterns.context: In code, activation is scattered across identifiers, method names, keywords, type names, and punctuation; it does not consistently point to a particular API.

patterns.name: Mixed-case rare strings
patterns.context: Character fragments appear in URL paths or proper nouns; the examples do not establish whether the response is to a specific word, a segmentation boundary, or an encoded form.

patterns.name: Common words and segmented word forms in English titles
patterns.context: Book titles recur, with activation covering title words, hyphens, and split word forms; no specific semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: General words in forum text
patterns.context: Activation appears in a passage of English forum commentary, including common words; there is no clear structural connection to the other examples.

10_574.description: 激活分散在 URL、数字编号、引文表格、扫描图像文件名、代码、标题及论坛词语中；共同点可能是格式化文本里的碎片，但各段触发位置与内容并不一致。

patterns.name: URL 中的域名与路径成分
patterns.context: 出现在网址、Markdown 链接或代码中的 URL；激活分布在域名和路径各部分，并非固定单一词元。

patterns.name: 数字与编号
patterns.context: 数字出现在论文引用、年代、网址路径或数据表格中；形式与位置不固定。

patterns.name: 带格式标记的引用与表格结构
patterns.context: 激活落在引用标记、表格列标题及参考文献编号附近，混合字母、数字和标点。

patterns.name: 文档/页面文件名与图像标记
patterns.context: 重复的扫描页面图像 Markdown 标记和带编号的 .tif 文件名；激活也落在路径样式的文件名片段。
patterns.domain: 扫描文档转录或页面图像文本

patterns.name: 代码标识符与语法碎片
patterns.context: 在代码中，激活散布于标识符、方法名、关键字、类型名及标点；没有稳定指向某个特定 API。

patterns.name: 混合大小写的罕见字符串
patterns.context: 字符片段出现在 URL 路径或专名中；无法从样本确认是对特定词、分词边界还是编码形式的响应。

patterns.name: 英文标题中的普通词及分段词形
patterns.context: 书名重复出现，激活覆盖标题词、连字符和被拆分的词形；看不出专属语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 书籍元数据 / 电商式书名

patterns.name: 论坛文本中的一般词语
patterns.context: 激活出现在一段英文论坛评论中，也包括普通词；与其他样本的结构特征没有明确联系。

en.description: Activations occur in various segmented structured strings: URLs, numeric ranges, paper citations, hexadecimal signatures, code constants, and content words in book titles. Weaker activations also appear on connective expressions in academic prose.

patterns.name: URL and path fragments
patterns.context: Domains, paths, and numeric IDs in URLs or links are split into subwords; «sp» in the path is especially prominent in the first segment.

patterns.name: Numeric binning tables
patterns.context: Rows and columns in tables express numeric ranges using inequality signs and sequences of values.

patterns.name: Bibliographic and biomedical citation markers
patterns.context: Bracketed citations, reference numbers, or figure/table citations in biomedical papers; often mixed with letters, numbers, hyphens, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Hexadecimal signature strings
patterns.context: Long strings of hexadecimal characters in JSON field values, split into multiple short fragments.

patterns.name: Uppercase constant identifiers in code
patterns.context: In Java calls, package or action names appear as uppercase constants separated by underscores.

patterns.name: Words in book titles
patterns.context: Multiple English content words appear in title case in titles or repeated book names, often split into within-word subfragments.

patterns.name: Connective expressions in academic prose
patterns.context: Connects purpose, comparisons, or supplementary examples in academic explanatory sentences; a reference marker also appears at the end of the same passage.

10_574.concept: 结构化文本片段与标识符
10_574.description: 激活见于多种被切分的结构化字符串：网址、数字区间、论文引用、十六进制签名、代码常量及书名实词；另在学术论述连接词上出现较弱激活。

patterns.name: 网址与路径片段
patterns.context: URL 或链接中，域名、路径和数字 ID 被切分成子词；第1段尤其突出路径中的 «sp»。

patterns.name: 数字分箱表格
patterns.context: 表格行列中，数字区间以不等号和连续数值表示。

patterns.name: 文献与生物医学引用标识
patterns.context: 生物医学论文正文中的方括号引用、文献编号或图表引用；常与字母、数字、连字符及标点混排。

patterns.name: 十六进制签名串
patterns.context: JSON 字段值中的长串十六进制字符，按多个短片段切分。

patterns.name: 代码中的大写常量标识符
patterns.context: Java 代码调用中，包名或动作名以大写、下划线分隔的常量形式出现。

patterns.name: 书名标题词
patterns.context: 标题或重复书名中，多个英文实词以标题式大小写排列，且常被拆成词内子片段。
patterns.domain: 书籍标题/家居装修指南

patterns.name: 论文论述连接表达
patterns.context: 学术说明句中连接目的、比较关系或举例补充；同段末尾还带有参考文献标识。

en.description: Activation is concentrated in URLs and their punctuation/character fragments, paper citation numbers, and structured strings in technical text: log timestamps and class names, product models, XML tags, and code identifiers. There are also sporadic activations on paper terminology and common words.

patterns.name: Character fragments in URLs and web addresses
patterns.context: Inside URLs or hyperlink targets; activation is scattered across domains, paths, subword fragments, and punctuation, with no single fixed meaning
patterns.domain: Web pages, news links, and crawled text

patterns.name: Paper citation identifiers and reference numbers
patterns.context: Bracketed references in biomedical paper text, including numbers, hyphens, and alphanumeric combinations

patterns.name: Virology abbreviations and transcript-related text
patterns.context: Paper contexts describing viral proteins, gene expression, and transcript levels; activation markers are sparse

patterns.name: Times and stack-trace formats in Android logs
patterns.context: Android crash or runtime logs containing timestamps, process labels, class names, and Java line numbers

patterns.name: Product models and technical specification codes
patterns.context: Product descriptions listing alphanumeric model numbers with hyphens; brand names and component descriptions appear nearby

patterns.name: XML/ASP.NET response structures and configuration strings
patterns.context: Code or API response examples mixing tags, URLs, attributes, and configuration/assembly names

patterns.name: VB-style conditions and date-variable code
patterns.context: Code uses weekday variables in conditional checks, sets a Boolean value, and exits a function

patterns.name: Sporadic common-word activations not fitting a stable pattern
patterns.context: These markers fall on common words or brand names in product descriptions and do not fully match the model-code pattern

10_574.description: 激活集中于网址及其标点/字符片段、论文引用编号和技术文本中的结构化串：日志时间与类名、产品型号、XML标签及代码标识；另有论文术语和普通词的零散激活。

patterns.name: URL 与网址中的字符片段
patterns.context: URL 或超链接目标内部；激活分散于域名、路径、分词片段及标点，未显示单一固定词义
patterns.domain: 网页、新闻链接与爬取文本

patterns.name: 论文引用标识与文献编号
patterns.context: 生物医学论文正文中的方括号文献引用，包含编号、连字符、字母数字混排

patterns.name: 病毒学缩写与转录本相关文本
patterns.context: 描述病毒蛋白及基因表达、转录本水平的论文语境；激活标记稀疏

patterns.name: Android 日志中的时间与堆栈格式
patterns.context: Android 崩溃或运行日志，包含时间戳、进程标签、类名与 Java 行号

patterns.name: 产品型号与技术规格代码
patterns.context: 产品说明中连续列举带字母、连字符和数字的型号；附近有品牌名与部件说明
patterns.domain: 摩托车滤清器产品文案

patterns.name: XML/ASP.NET 响应结构与配置字符串
patterns.context: 代码或接口响应样例，标签、URL、属性及配置/程序集名称混排

patterns.name: VB 风格条件与日期变量代码
patterns.context: 代码中按星期变量进行条件判断，并设置布尔值、退出函数
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答，类似 Visual Basic

patterns.name: 未能归入稳定模式的零散普通词激活
patterns.context: 这些标记落在产品说明的普通词或品牌词上，与型号代码模式并不完全相同

en.concept: Boundaries and code strings in structured text
en.description: Primarily responds to URLs, punctuation, and segmented alphanumeric strings; also appears in bibliographic citations, product models, XML tags, table missing values, and email headers. Activations on ordinary English word fragments lack a clear explanation.

patterns.name: URL and domain fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on URL protocols, punctuation, domains, and paths; sometimes only segmented word fragments are hit.
patterns.domain: Web links, HackerNews quotations, and URLs in code

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric strings
patterns.context: Numeric strings are often embedded in structures such as URLs, product models, reference numbers, tables, or email headers; marked numeric fragments also occur.
patterns.domain: Mixed text: links, product IDs, academic citations, tables, and email metadata

patterns.name: Citation markers and reference numbers
patterns.context: Bracketed citations or reference labels surrounded by paper text.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and their citation markers

patterns.name: Models and alphanumeric codes
patterns.context: Models or specification codes composed of letters and numbers appear in product descriptions and racing parts lists.

patterns.name: Structured markup and tags
patterns.context: XML-like tag boundaries and tag names appear next to fields such as filenames and image dimensions.
patterns.domain: Code, file metadata, or XML-formatted text

patterns.name: Missing values and comparison symbols in tables
patterns.context: Aligned table rows repeatedly contain NaN, month fields, and numeric range conditions.
patterns.domain: Tables or data output in StackExchange technical Q&A

patterns.name: Email headers and addresses
patterns.context: Fields such as software versions, SMTP, recipient/sender addresses, and message IDs appear together in mail transport headers.
patterns.domain: Enron email headers or archived email text

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on ordinary word fragments
patterns.context: Appears in ordinary English sentences and around signatures, with no clear semantic trigger shared with the other segments.

10_574.concept: 结构化文本中的边界与代码串
10_574.description: 主要响应 URL、标点和被切分的字母数字串；也常见于文献引用、产品型号、XML 标签、表格缺失值及邮件头。普通英文词片段的激活缺乏清晰解释。

patterns.name: URL 与域名片段
patterns.trigger: «http»、«://»、«www»、«.»、«/»，以及域名/路径中的 «sp»、«itz»、«de»、«blogs» 等子串
patterns.context: 激活落在 URL 的协议、标点、域名及路径各部分；有时仅命中被切分的词片段。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、HackerNews 引文及代码中的网址

patterns.name: 数字与数字化字符串
patterns.context: 数字串常嵌在 URL、产品型号、文献编号、表格或邮件头等结构中；也包括被标注的数字片段。
patterns.domain: 混合文本：链接、产品编号、学术引用、表格和邮件元数据

patterns.name: 引用标识与文献编号
patterns.context: 方括号内的文献引用或参考文献标签，周围是论文正文。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及其引文标记

patterns.name: 型号与字母数字代码
patterns.context: 字母与数字组成的型号或规格代码，出现在产品介绍和赛车部件清单中。

patterns.name: 结构化标记与标签
patterns.context: XML 类标签边界及标签名，邻接文件名和图像尺寸等字段。
patterns.domain: 代码、文件元数据或 XML 格式文本

patterns.name: 表格中的缺失值及比较符号
patterns.context: 对齐的表格行中反复出现 NaN、月份字段和数值范围条件。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答中的表格或数据输出

patterns.name: 邮件头与地址
patterns.context: 邮件传输头中，软件版本、SMTP、收件/发件地址及消息 ID 等字段相邻。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件头或邮件归档文本

patterns.name: 普通词片段的零散激活
patterns.context: 出现在普通英文句子和签名附近，未见与其他段一致的明确语义触发条件。

en.description: Activation appears in several types of formatted, structured text: URLs and their subwords, chemical names, code and fields, log timestamps, and email markers. The triggering content differs across examples and often includes punctuation, abbreviations, numbers, or segmented fragments.

patterns.name: Segmented fragments in URLs and paths
patterns.context: When URLs, domains, or paths are split into multiple subwords, activation falls on domain and path fragments
patterns.domain: Web links, forum posts, or HTML links in email

patterns.name: Chemical names and abbreviations
patterns.context: Subwords and abbreviations in long chemical names, molecular formulas, or enzyme names; no specific sentence context is required

patterns.name: Program code, identifiers, and configuration data
patterns.context: Code, exception stack traces, configuration, or key-value-like structures containing punctuation, identifiers, field names, and types
patterns.domain: Software development, debugging logs, structured data

patterns.name: Date/time and scheduling records
patterns.context: Timestamps, dates, or schedule intervals where numbers and time units appear together
patterns.domain: Error logs, time arrangements in email

patterns.name: HTML email markers and repeated resource links
patterns.context: HTML tags, indentation, and repeated image URLs appear consecutively

10_574.description: 激活见于多种格式化、结构化文本：URL及其子词、化学名称、代码与字段、日志时间和邮件标记。各处触发内容不同，常伴标点、缩写、数字或分词片段。

patterns.name: URL 与路径中的分词片段
patterns.context: URL、域名或路径被拆成多个子词时；高亮落在域名及路径片段上
patterns.domain: 网页链接、论坛帖子或邮件中的 HTML 链接

patterns.name: 化学名称与缩写
patterns.context: 长化学名称、分子式或酶名的子词与缩写；不要求特定句子语境

patterns.name: 程序代码、标识符与配置数据
patterns.context: 代码、异常堆栈、配置或类似键值结构中，混有标点、标识符、字段名和类型
patterns.domain: 软件开发、调试日志、结构化数据

patterns.name: 日期时间与排班记录
patterns.context: 时间戳、日期或排班区间中，数字及时间单位相邻出现
patterns.domain: 错误日志、邮件中的时间安排

patterns.name: HTML 邮件标记与重复资源链接
patterns.context: HTML 标签、缩进及重复的图片 URL 连续出现
patterns.domain: 邮件中的 HTML 片段

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple domains: sp in URLs, code identifiers and configuration, date-time tables, legal and patent terminology, UI code, and forum wording. Apart from local word strings in individual segments, no stable cross-segment trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: `.vendorCode` identifier
patterns.context: The compound identifier `vendorCode` appears twice in Java constructor parameters and `super(...)` calls; stronger activations fall on these two occurrences.

patterns.name: Weekend time-range text
patterns.context: An email lists consecutive time periods with dates, times, and CT/PT time zones; the same passage appears twice.

patterns.name: `sp` in a specific domain URL
patterns.context: Activations occur within the URL domain and path, especially `sp` in `spitz`; this does not establish a general URL pattern.

patterns.name: `Payment` in code and configuration
patterns.context: `Payment` and `SO` appear after a DLL name in a C#-style code/configuration string; `Payment` is strongly marked.

patterns.name: `approved` in gun-lock legal wording
patterns.context: When describing the purchase of a used gun and legal requirements, `approved` is strongly marked; nearby terms include `law`, `used guns`, and `lock`.

patterns.name: `pp` in the laser material name `sapphire`
patterns.context: A patent technical description refers to a type of laser; the strongest local activation falls on `pp` after tokenization.

patterns.name: Selection controls and option text
patterns.context: R-style UI code defines an experiment selection page and radio buttons; fragments such as `Want to` and `select` activate.

patterns.name: Video frame type `intra`
patterns.context: Patent text explains image reproduction components and encoded data, listing I/P-picture types.

patterns.name: Discussion of compensation and similar projects
patterns.context: A forum quotation discusses whether open-source project contributors are compensated; activations are scattered across comparison and compensation wording, without enough evidence to establish a unified trigger word.

10_574.description: 激活分散于多个领域：URL 中的 sp、代码标识符与配置、日期时间表、法律和专利术语、UI 代码及论坛措辞。除各段局部词串外，看不出跨段稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: `.vendorCode` 标识符
patterns.context: Java 构造函数参数及 `super(...)` 调用中，复合标识符 `vendorCode` 出现两次；较强激活落在这两处。

patterns.name: 周末时间区间文本
patterns.context: 邮件中列出带日期、时间及 CT/PT 时区的连续时间段；同一片段重复出现两次。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件 / 日程安排

patterns.name: 特定域名 URL 中的 `sp`
patterns.trigger: `http://www.zeit.de/datenschutz/malte-spitz-data-retention`，其中 `sp` 及相邻 URL 子串有标记
patterns.context: 激活出现在 URL 的域名和路径内部，尤其 `sp` 所在的 `spitz`；不能据此确认是一般 URL 模式。

patterns.name: 代码及配置中的 `Payment`
patterns.context: C# 风格代码/配置字符串中，`Payment` 与 `SO` 出现在 DLL 名称之后；`Payment` 标记较强。

patterns.name: 枪支锁法律措辞中的 `approved`
patterns.context: 叙述购买二手枪及法律要求时，`approved` 被强标记；周边还有 `law`、`used guns`、`lock`。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC / 枪支法律相关叙述

patterns.name: 激光材料名 `sapphire` 中的 `pp`
patterns.trigger: `Ti sapphire laser`，特别是被拆分标记的 `sa`、`pp`、`hire`
patterns.context: 专利技术描述中，短语指一种激光；最强局部激活落在分词后的 `pp`。

patterns.name: 选择控件及选项文本
patterns.context: R 风格 UI 代码定义实验选择页面和单选按钮；`Want to`、`select` 等片段激活。

patterns.name: 视频帧类型 `intra`
patterns.context: 专利文本解释图像再现部分及编码数据，列举 I/P-picture 类型。

patterns.name: 补偿与相似项目讨论
patterns.context: 论坛引文讨论开源项目贡献者是否获得补偿；激活分散在比较和补偿措辞中，缺少足以确立统一触发词的证据。

en.description: The strongest triggers cluster around “able to + verb,” expressing ability or feasibility across scientific, patent, Q&A, and everyday contexts. Another strong response occurs to “Unable to find” in an error message.

patterns.name: “able to” ability construction
patterns.context: States that an entity has the ability, capacity, or conditions to perform a following action; actions include substituting, controlling, printing, binding, inducing, providing predictions, initiating, or identifying.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; academic papers, patents, Q&A, forums, and general narrative

patterns.name: “Unable to” error message
patterns.context: An error message reports that a particular file cannot be found; the preceding context concerns an Android emulator userdata.img and ABI.

10_574.description: 最强触发集中于“able to + 动词”，用于表达能力或可行性，跨科学、专利、问答和日常语境；另在一段错误消息中强烈响应“Unable to find”。

patterns.name: “able to”能力结构
patterns.context: 说明某实体具备、能够或有条件执行后续动作；后续动作可为替代、控制、印刷、结合、诱导、提供预测、启动或识别等。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；学术论文、专利、问答、论坛及一般叙述

patterns.name: “Unable to”错误提示
patterns.trigger: «Unable»5；随后在错误文本中出现 «Unable»10« to»4
patterns.context: 错误信息报告无法找到特定文件；前文是 Android 模拟器 userdata.img 与 ABI 的问题。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、错误日志

en.description: Activations are scattered across formatted text such as database errors, legal case numbers, record discussions, news links, schedule times, and code fields; there is insufficient evidence for a single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Database error logs
patterns.context: Diagnostic messages repeatedly contain Alias, database identifiers, and Error/!!! prefixes; activations also cover function words in the error sentences.
patterns.domain: Database or software error logs in Enron emails

patterns.name: Case numbers and header formatting
patterns.context: Structured fields in court document headers, including case numbers, document numbers, page numbers, and filing dates.

patterns.name: Music album and CD discussions
patterns.context: First-person recollections of buying, collecting, or enjoying music albums, with several words around CD/album names activating.
patterns.domain: Music and record-collecting forums or comments

patterns.name: Fragmented text in links
patterns.context: Words in URLs or link titles are split into multiple tokens; the same passage also discusses trendspotter and phone-tracking.

patterns.name: Time ranges and date scheduling
patterns.context: Multiline schedules give time ranges with start/end times, weekdays, dates, and time zones.
patterns.domain: Shift schedules or calendar records in Enron emails

patterns.name: Return fields in XML/code
patterns.context: Code or configuration snippets contain XML-style tags, URL fields, and project/assembly names.

patterns.name: Split words in privacy policy links
patterns.context: Privacy- and data-retention-related words in German URL paths are split and marked; the link text and target URL are repeated.

10_574.description: 激活分散在数据库报错、法律案号、唱片讨论、新闻链接、日程时间、代码字段等格式化文本中；没有足够证据支持单一语义触发点。

patterns.name: 数据库错误日志
patterns.trigger: «Cannot» perform this operation on a closed database；«Unknown database»；«Insufficient disk space»
patterns.context: 反复出现 Alias、数据库标识及 Error/!!! 前缀的诊断信息；激活也覆盖错误句中的功能词。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的数据库或软件错误日志

patterns.name: 案卷编号与页眉格式
patterns.context: 法院文件页眉中案号、文件号、页码和提交日期等结构化字段。

patterns.name: 音乐专辑与CD讨论
patterns.context: 以第一人称回忆购买、收藏或喜爱音乐专辑，CD/专辑名周围多个词激活。
patterns.domain: 音乐、唱片收藏的论坛或评论

patterns.name: 链接中的碎片化文字
patterns.context: URL 或链接标题中的词被拆成多个 token；同段还有 trendspotter 和 phone-tracking 话题。

patterns.name: 时间区间与日期排程
patterns.context: 多行日程以起止时间、星期、日期及时区标注区间。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的排班或日程记录

patterns.name: XML/代码中的返回字段
patterns.context: 代码或配置片段包含 XML 风格标签、URL 字段及项目/程序集名称。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答中的代码

patterns.name: 隐私政策链接中的拆分词
patterns.context: 德语 URL 路径中的隐私与数据保留相关词被拆分标记，链接文本与目标 URL 重复。

en.description: Activations cover several text types: patent descriptions of gear shifting and locking, database error logs, and records containing technical terms, model numbers, IDs, digits, or specific objects. Other examples include forum comments, product complaints, and baseball reports, with no common semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Gear shifting and locking
patterns.context: Describes the mechanical action of moving a shifting component from neutral into an engaged position and locking it.

patterns.name: Database error logs
patterns.context: Database aliases and errors such as insufficient disk space, unknown databases, or closed databases, often formatted with exclamation marks and line breaks.

patterns.name: Nursing home beds and occupancy data
patterns.context: Quantifies occupancy and bed capacity at care facilities using numbers and percentages.

patterns.name: Motorcycle filters and product models
patterns.context: Mentions filter installation and lists racing-related product models.

patterns.name: Teacher certification comments
patterns.context: Comments on teacher certification programs, calling them counterproductive and consisting of extensive busywork.

patterns.name: Clinical study title and ID
patterns.context: A study project ID and the title of a pilot study of minocycline for retinal vein occlusion.

patterns.name: Display without shift functionality
patterns.context: Complains that a type of display device lacks a shift function, preventing precise position adjustment.

patterns.name: Baseball hits and foul balls
patterns.context: Recounts a night baseball game in which a hit became a foul ball and nearly struck a spectator.

10_574.description: 激活覆盖多类文本：专利换挡锁止、数据库错误日志，以及含技术术语、型号、编号、数字或具体对象的记录；另见论坛评论、产品抱怨和棒球报道，缺少统一语义触发点。

patterns.name: 齿轮换挡与锁止
patterns.context: 描述换挡部件从空挡移动到啮合位置并锁定的机械动作。

patterns.name: 数据库错误日志
patterns.trigger: «db»«C»«aps»«97»«Data»、«Unknown» database、«Cannot» perform this operation on a closed database、«Insufficient» disk space
patterns.context: 数据库别名及磁盘空间不足、数据库未知或已关闭等报错，常以感叹号和换行呈现。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的软件错误日志

patterns.name: 养老院床位与入住率数据
patterns.context: 以数字和百分比量化养老机构的入住及床位情况。
patterns.domain: 养老机构介绍/网页文本

patterns.name: 摩托车滤件与产品型号
patterns.context: 提及滤件安装，并列出赛车相关产品型号。

patterns.name: 教师资格认证评论
patterns.context: 评论教师资格认证项目，认为其适得其反且由大量繁琐工作构成。

patterns.name: 临床研究标题与编号
patterns.context: 研究项目编号及关于米诺环素治疗视网膜静脉阻塞的试点研究标题。

patterns.name: 显示器缺少移位功能
patterns.trigger: «no» «matter» my tastes、«can»’«t» make these units work、«lack» of «shift»
patterns.context: 抱怨某种显示设备缺少 shift 功能，导致无法精确调整位置。

patterns.name: 棒球击球与界外球
patterns.context: 叙述夜场棒球比赛中击球成界外球，差点打到观众。

en.description: Activations are distributed across different domains, often on proper nouns, segmented identifiers, and specific technical, medical, legal, or topical words; the segments lack a shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Word fragments in place or institution names
patterns.context: Appears in nursing center names or URL domains; activations are scattered across words and subword fragments in proper names.

patterns.name: Medical and nursing terminology
patterns.context: Medical research titles or descriptions of nursing institutions, especially drugs, treatments, facility beds, and resident information.

patterns.name: Patent citations and numbering formats
patterns.context: Patent numbers, patent document citations, or numeric citation formats; numbers are split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Repair work and invoice numbers in legal narratives
patterns.context: Legal factual narratives mention repair work, owner reference numbers, and invoice numbers.

patterns.name: Status, position, and movement in technical descriptions
patterns.context: Describes mechanical components of a device being secured, prevented from moving, or moved into a position.

patterns.name: Technical devices and user-count limits
patterns.context: Describes the purpose of a laser/pixel detection device and distinguishes single users from multiple simultaneous users.

patterns.name: Fishing- and trout-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Discusses stocking trout, fishing methods, and catches; strong activations also fall on words describing fish populations and catchability.

patterns.name: Political and economic ideology discussion
patterns.context: Compares the ability of capitalism and socialism to solve problems.

patterns.name: Persuading others to collaborate
patterns.context: Discusses the ability to get others to collaborate or participate in work; earlier text mentions an app launch and testing costs.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, project or product development

10_574.description: 激活分布在不同领域，常落于专名、切分后的编号及具体技术、医疗、法律或主题词；各段缺少统一的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 地点或机构专名中的词片段
patterns.trigger: « Health»、« And»、« Center»、« river»、« grand»、« rap»、« ids»、« com»
patterns.context: 出现在护理中心名称或网址域名中；激活分散在专名的词和子词片段上。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、机构资料、网址

patterns.name: 医疗与护理术语
patterns.trigger: « Min»、«ocy»、«cline»、«gl»、« Inhib»、« Treatment»；« nursing»、« home»、« residents»、« beds»
patterns.context: 医疗研究标题或护理机构描述中，尤其是药物、治疗、机构床位与住户信息。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、护理机构资料

patterns.name: 专利引文与编号格式
patterns.context: 专利号、专利文献引证或带数字的引用格式；编号被切分成多个 token。

patterns.name: 法律叙述中的修理工作与发票编号
patterns.trigger: « testimony»、« repair»、« work»、« pursuant»、« Invoice»、« No»、« 00»、« 174»
patterns.context: 法律事实叙述提及维修工作、业主参考号及发票编号。

patterns.name: 技术描述中的状态、位置和运动
patterns.trigger: « releasing»、« state»、« assigned»、« held»、« locked»、« moving»、« neutral»、« position»、« gear»
patterns.context: 描述装置的机械部件被固定、防止移动或进入某位置。

patterns.name: 技术装置与用户数量限制
patterns.trigger: « detector»、« on»、« screen»、« pixel»、« laser»、« invention»、« single»、« user»、« multiple»、« simultaneous»
patterns.context: 说明激光/像素检测装置的用途，并区分单用户与多个同时用户。

patterns.name: 钓鱼与鳟鱼相关词汇
patterns.trigger: « rainbow»、« trout»、« stock»、« Angl»、«ers»、« B»、«ait»、« fly»、« t»、«rolling»
patterns.context: 谈论放养鳟鱼、垂钓方式及鱼获情况；强激活也落在描述鱼类数量和可捕获性的词上。

patterns.name: 政治经济意识形态讨论
patterns.context: 比较资本主义与社会主义处理问题的能力。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、政治经济评论

patterns.name: 说服他人参与合作
patterns.trigger: « get»、« good»、« convincing»、« people»、« work»、« with»
patterns.context: 讨论让他人愿意合作或参与工作的能力；前文提到应用上线和测试费用。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、项目或产品开发

en.description: Activations occur across various local structures, including patent terminology, job news, nursing home information, legal docket numbers, paper citations, promotional URLs, and energy-trading tables. No stable cross-domain common trigger pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Patent-style technical description
patterns.context: Continuous descriptions of technical terms, functions, structures, or procedures in patent backgrounds or embodiments; activations often occur near technical terms and patent boilerplate.

patterns.name: Job and career news narrative
patterns.context: News passages describe a person potentially competing for a position; activations cluster near words related to the position or competition.

patterns.name: Nursing home description
patterns.context: Information about a care facility’s ownership, occupancy, beds, and residents.

patterns.name: Legal docket numbers and formatting
patterns.context: Court document headers or docket tables, with numbers, dates, and adjacent blank formatting.

patterns.name: Paper citations and genetics terminology
patterns.context: Crop genotype descriptions in biomedical papers accompanied by author–year citations.

patterns.name: Promotional product terms in URLs
patterns.context: URL paths contain promotional terms such as mobile carriers, offer, and daily deals; activations fall on split word fragments.

patterns.name: Daily energy-trading report tables
patterns.context: Email tables present daily trades and month-to-date figures in repeated fields and numeric columns.

10_574.description: 激活分布于专利技术术语、职位新闻、护理院资料、法律案卷编号、论文引文、促销网址及能源交易表格等多种局部结构；未见跨领域稳定的共同触发模式。

patterns.name: 专利式技术描述
patterns.context: 专利背景或实施方式中，技术名词与功能、结构或步骤的连续描述；激活常落在技术术语及专利套语附近。

patterns.name: 职位与职业新闻叙述
patterns.context: 新闻段落中描述人物可能竞逐职位，激活集中在职位或竞逐相关词附近。

patterns.name: 养老院机构描述
patterns.context: 介绍护理机构的所有权、入住率、床位及住户等信息。

patterns.name: 法律案卷编号与版式
patterns.context: 法院文书页眉或案卷表格，编号、日期和空白排版相邻。

patterns.name: 论文引文与遗传学术语
patterns.context: 生物医学论文中，作物基因型叙述伴随作者—年份式引文。

patterns.name: 网址中的促销商品词
patterns.context: URL 路径由移动运营商、offer、daily deals 等促销词组成，激活落在拆分后的词段。

patterns.name: 能源交易日报表格
patterns.context: 邮件中以重复字段和数值列呈现日交易及月累计数据。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件/能源交易报表

en.description: Activations occur in date-and-time schedules, email tables, IDs, institutional statistics, program identifiers, legal and credentialing discussions, deal URLs, and code terminology. No stable semantic trigger across passages is evident; the response appears to mix formatted fields, fragmented tokens, and list text.

patterns.name: Date, time, and weekly schedules
patterns.context: Tab-delimited email schedules or time ranges containing weekdays, dates, time zones, and specific times.

patterns.name: Enron email table fields
patterns.context: Dated tables or report rows in emails, with field names and abbreviations arranged in columns.

patterns.name: Digit segmentation in serial numbers/IDs
patterns.context: An ID-like string, code, or numbered title marker appears near a paper title; digits and letters are split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Nursing facility operating statistics
patterns.context: Institutional information describes nursing home addresses, beds, occupancy, and resident counts.

patterns.name: Program identifiers and status terms
patterns.context: Process/process-name identifiers, error codes, and descriptions of their validity status appear.

patterns.name: Legal and formal phrasing in technical discussions
patterns.context: Comments discuss the legal effects of platform bans or teacher certification and its burdensome requirements; no clear shared local topic.

patterns.name: Product deal paths in URLs
patterns.context: URL or link paths consist of hyphenated fragments such as carrier names, offer, and daily deals.

patterns.name: Code and type-signature discussions
patterns.context: Discusses debugging code, compilation failures, and whether code should have a type signature.

10_574.concept: 结构化文本与字段片段
10_574.description: 激活分布于日期时间排程、邮件表格、编号、机构统计、程序标识符、法律与资质讨论、优惠网址及代码术语；未见跨段稳定的语义触发词，较像格式化字段、碎片化 token 或列表文本的混合响应。

patterns.name: 日期时间与周次排程
patterns.context: 以制表符分隔的邮件日程或时间范围，包含星期、日期、时区和具体时刻。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的排程文本

patterns.name: Enron 邮件表格字段
patterns.context: 邮件中带日期的表格或报告行，字段名与缩写按列排列。

patterns.name: 序列号／编号中的数字分段
patterns.context: 论文标题附近出现类似编号、代码或编号式标题标记；数字与字母被拆成多个 token。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目记录／科研元数据

patterns.name: 护理机构经营统计
patterns.context: 描述护理院地址、床位、入住率和住户数的机构资料。
patterns.domain: 医疗机构目录或商业信息

patterns.name: 程序标识符与状态词
patterns.context: 出现过程／过程名标识符、错误代码及其有效状态说明。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答／代码调试

patterns.name: 技术讨论中的法律与形式化措辞
patterns.context: 评论中讨论平台封禁策略的法律效果，或教师资质认证及其繁琐性；没有明显共享的局部主题。

patterns.name: 网址中的商品优惠路径
patterns.context: 网址或链接路径由运营商名称、offer、daily deals 等连字符片段组成。

patterns.name: 代码与类型签名讨论
patterns.context: 讨论调试代码、编译失败，以及代码是否应有类型签名。

en.concept: Formatted proper names and identifier fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across numbers and identifiers in formatted fields, as well as several specific word fragments: date-time fields, report headers, deals in URLs, technically legal, car models, and HDAC subtypes. There is no unified semantic trigger across domains.

patterns.name: Timestamp and date fields
patterns.context: Regular date, time, and time-zone fields, often including weekdays, date ranges, and multiple time-zone abbreviations
patterns.domain: Shift or time-slot records in Enron emails

patterns.name: Table column headers and totals
patterns.context: Tab-separated headers or short report fields in emails

patterns.name: The deals string in URLs
patterns.context: Hyphen-separated names of promotional pages in URL paths; activations fall on subword fragments of deals

patterns.name: Legal and technical legality
patterns.context: In sentences discussing platform banning policies and their chilling effect, emphasizes that an action is technically legal

patterns.name: pharmaceutics in reference numbers
patterns.context: Repeated paper identifiers or citation numbers in square brackets

patterns.name: Car models and model-name fragments
patterns.context: Discusses car accessories, models, and user experience; activations concentrate on model identifiers or fragments of model names

patterns.name: or encoding in reference numbers
patterns.context: Repeated citation identifiers around a discussion of CRC prognosis; activations mainly fall on alphanumeric fragments of citation numbers

patterns.name: HDAC numbers and family names
patterns.context: Discussion of HDAC subtype numbers and their sequence and structure-function relationships

10_574.concept: 格式化专名与标识符片段
10_574.description: 激活散布于格式化字段中的数字与标识符，以及若干特定词片段：日期时间、报表表头、URL 的 deals、technically legal、汽车型号和 HDAC 亚型；跨领域缺少统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 时间戳与日期字段
patterns.context: 规律化的日期、时间、时区字段，常含星期、日期范围和多个时区缩写
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的排班或时段记录

patterns.name: 表格列标题与总量
patterns.context: 邮件中的制表符分隔表头或简短报表字段

patterns.name: 网址中的 deals 字符串
patterns.context: URL 路径中连字符分隔的促销页面名称；激活落在 deals 的子词片段上

patterns.name: 法律与技术性合法
patterns.context: 讨论平台封禁策略及其寒蝉效应的句子中，强调某行为在技术上合法

patterns.name: 文献编号中的 pharmaceutics
patterns.context: 方括号内重复出现的论文标识符或引文编号

patterns.name: 汽车型号及车型词片段
patterns.context: 讨论汽车配件、车型和使用体验；激活集中在型号或车型名称片段

patterns.name: 文献编号中的 or 编码
patterns.context: CRC 预后讨论周围的重复文献标识符；激活主要落在引文编号的字母数字片段

patterns.name: HDAC 编号与家族名称
patterns.context: HDAC 亚型编号及其序列、结构功能关系的讨论
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要/分子生物学

en.description: Activations span forums, code, patents, product descriptions, and sports text. They often fall on subwords within words, technical terms, quotation marks, or short phrase fragments. Topics vary widely, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Code, identifiers, and technical term fragments
patterns.context: Technical terms, proper names, program identifiers, or words composed of multiple subwords appear; activations often fall on the latter part of a term or an adjacent word, while specific topics vary widely across passages.
patterns.domain: Programming discussions, code, product descriptions, patent text, and general technical content

patterns.name: Quoted evaluations or mentions
patterns.context: Words are enclosed in quotation marks or appear as string literals in code; “embarrassment” and “ugly” are negative evaluations, while name in code is an identifier.

patterns.name: Review, audit, and troubleshooting contexts
patterns.context: Discusses code/API review or identifies recurring equipment seal problems; local activations fall on review, issue, and related words.
patterns.domain: Software engineering discussions, product failure experiences

patterns.name: Spelling fragments or within-word subword activations
patterns.context: Activations may fall on internal word segments rather than whole words; the words and meanings vary, so the fragments alone do not support a unified lexical pattern.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain natural-language text and proper names

patterns.name: Citations, forum reposts, and echo-chamber discussions
patterns.context: Posts with quotations or forum usernames discuss articles, the spread of views, or community phenomena.

patterns.name: Environmental signaling and neighborhood impressions
patterns.context: Comments sarcastically on an environmental image and displaying it to neighbors with inexpensive signs.

patterns.name: Common words and phrases in descriptive English
patterns.context: In ordinary explanatory or narrative sentences, activations are scattered across content words and adjacent function words; topics include sports statistics and e-book reading.

patterns.name: Names and entry methods in Java examples
patterns.context: Shows code that creates a list before retrieving a collection, or defines a class; activations cluster near string field names and the main method.

patterns.name: Layered LCD panel structure description
patterns.context: Patent-style sentence describes a color filter, common electrode, and multiple liquid crystal panels formed on a substrate surface.

patterns.name: Defensive performance and game results
patterns.context: Evaluates a team’s recent defensive statistics and ability to limit opponents’ scoring.

patterns.name: Project documentation comments and fallback rule class names
patterns.context: A code documentation comment explains creating a rule instance and its return type; the returned class is named SimpleFallbackRule.

patterns.name: Recurring failures and seal replacement
patterns.context: A user describes a damaged seal, notes that the issue may recur after replacement, and says the problem is common.

patterns.name: Kindle alternative-device reading instructions
patterns.context: Explains that readers without a Kindle can download a free app and read Kindle books on a PC or other device.
patterns.domain: Product description or e-book promotional copy

patterns.name: Automotive parts comparison
patterns.context: Compares a Mustang-style CVR’s threaded studs and snaps, discussing which is easier to use.

patterns.name: Conclusion wording indicating a solvable problem
patterns.context: After a code problem or review requirement is introduced, “solvable” indicates that it can be resolved.

patterns.name: Requests to address sustainability
patterns.context: Fragmentary context requests meeting needs in a sustainable way.

10_574.description: 激活横跨论坛、代码、专利、产品说明和体育文本；常落在词内子词、技术名词、引号或短语片段上。各段主题差异大，未见单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 代码、标识符及技术术语片段
patterns.context: 嵌入技术名词、专名、程序标识符或由多个子词构成的词；激活常落在术语后半部分或相邻词上，不同段落的具体主题差异很大。
patterns.domain: 编程讨论、代码、产品说明、专利文本及一般技术内容

patterns.name: 引号中的评价或提及表达
patterns.context: 词语被引号括起，或作为代码中的字符串字面量；其中“embarrassment”“ugly”是负面评价词，代码里的 name 则是标识符。

patterns.name: 审查、审核及问题排查语境
patterns.context: 讨论代码/API的审查审核，或识别反复出现的设备密封问题；局部激活落在审查、问题及相关词上。
patterns.domain: 软件工程讨论、产品故障经验

patterns.name: 拼写片段或词内子词激活
patterns.context: 激活可落在词的内部切分片段，而非完整词；所涉词及语义并不一致，片段本身不足以支持统一词义模式。
patterns.domain: 跨领域自然语言文本与专名

patterns.name: 引用、论坛转帖及回声室讨论
patterns.context: 带有引用或论坛用户名的帖子中，讨论文章、观点传播或社区现象。

patterns.name: 环保信号与邻里印象
patterns.context: 评论环保形象及通过低成本标志向邻居展示形象，语气带讽刺。

patterns.name: 描述性英语中的常见词与短语
patterns.context: 普通说明或叙述句中，激活散布在内容词和相邻功能词上；主题分别是体育数据与电子书阅读。

patterns.name: Java示例中的名称与入口方法
patterns.context: 展示先创建列表再获取集合的代码或类定义；激活集中在字符串字段名和 main 方法附近。

patterns.name: 层叠式液晶面板结构描述
patterns.context: 专利句式描述基板表面形成滤光片、公共电极及多个液晶面板。

patterns.name: 防守表现与比赛结果
patterns.context: 评价球队近期防守数据及限制对手得分的能力。

patterns.name: 项目文档注释及回退规则类名
patterns.context: 代码文档注释中说明创建规则实例及返回类型，返回名为 SimpleFallbackRule 的类。

patterns.name: 重复故障及密封件更换
patterns.context: 用户描述密封件损坏、更换后问题仍可能复发，并指出该问题常见。

patterns.name: Kindle替代设备阅读说明
patterns.context: 说明不拥有 Kindle 的读者可下载免费应用，在 PC 或其他设备阅读 Kindle 书籍。
patterns.domain: 产品说明或电子书推广文案

patterns.name: 汽车配件比较
patterns.context: 比较野马风格 CVR 的带螺纹螺柱与按扣，讨论哪种更容易使用。

patterns.name: 可解决问题的结论用语
patterns.context: 在前文提出代码问题或审查要求后，用“solvable”表示问题可以解决。

patterns.name: 讨论可持续性的要求
patterns.context: 残缺上下文中要求以可持续的方式满足需求。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论，具体话题不明

en.concept: Common English expressions and web text
en.description: Activations occur across multiple genres, often near quantifiers and degree expressions, make-result constructions, and news summaries. Other examples include forum arguments, sports evaluations, automotive and travel news, personal experiences, and biomedical paper terminology and citations, with no unified theme.

patterns.name: General quantifiers and degree expressions
patterns.context: Strong activations occur near quantifiers and degree words in noun phrases or comparative and evaluative expressions.
patterns.domain: Forum conversations, news, and sports commentary

patterns.name: Make in causative/result expressions
patterns.context: Make is followed by an object and a property, result, or evaluation.

patterns.name: Search-style “read more”
patterns.context: A read-more link at the end of a news summary or web snippet.

patterns.name: Stances or evaluative claims in arguments
patterns.context: A forum reply first responds to another person’s view, then provides an explanation involving judgment or skepticism.

patterns.name: Sports performance and game evaluations
patterns.context: Describes a team’s defense, a player’s key performance, or a season result.

patterns.name: Automotive partnerships and model news
patterns.context: A news summary introduces automakers jointly developing a platform and a new model.

patterns.name: Resort facilities and guest benefits
patterns.context: A web summary describes benefits for resort and theme park guests.

patterns.name: Clinical scales and literature citations
patterns.context: A clinical study lists validated scales and supports them with numbered citations.

patterns.name: Medical imaging mechanisms and citations
patterns.context: Describes an imaging method, electron excitation, and radiation comparison, with references.

patterns.name: Attempts in personal narratives
patterns.context: A first-person account recalls beginning to try an activity.

patterns.name: Evaluation of audience accessibility
patterns.context: Discusses whether a work would suit a general audience better if dialogue were removed.

patterns.name: Literal catching and hand-skill metaphor
patterns.context: Uses catching ability to describe a player and extends the idea to performance in key moments.

10_574.concept: 常见英语表达与网页文本
10_574.description: 激活分布于多种文体，常见于量词和程度表达、make结果结构及新闻摘要；另涉及论坛论辩、体育评价、汽车与旅游新闻、个人经历及医学论文术语和引文，缺少统一主题。

patterns.name: 一般量词与程度表达
patterns.context: 名词短语或比较、评价表达中，量词和程度词附近出现较强激活
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、新闻及体育评论

patterns.name: 使役/结果表达中的 make
patterns.trigger: «make»，如“make it more palatable”“make them the best team”
patterns.context: make 后接宾语及性质、结果或评价

patterns.name: 信息检索式的 read more
patterns.context: 新闻摘要或网页片段结尾的阅读更多链接

patterns.name: 争论中的立场或评价陈述
patterns.trigger: «That is exactly what the drug companies say»；«The real agenda has a lot more to do with»
patterns.context: 论坛回复中先回应对方观点，再给出带有判断或质疑的解释

patterns.name: 体育表现与比赛评价
patterns.context: 描述球队防守、球员关键表现或赛季结果

patterns.name: 汽车合作与车型新闻
patterns.context: 介绍车企联合开发平台及新车型的新闻摘要

patterns.name: 旅游度假设施与宾客福利
patterns.context: 介绍度假村和主题乐园住客待遇的网页摘要

patterns.name: 临床量表及文献引用
patterns.context: 临床研究中列举已验证量表并以编号引文支持

patterns.name: 医学影像机制及引文
patterns.context: 描述成像方式、电子激发及辐射对照，附参考文献

patterns.name: 个人经历叙述中的尝试
patterns.trigger: «I thought I might have a go at that»、«my kids got a bit older»
patterns.context: 第一人称回忆开始尝试某项活动的经历

patterns.name: 对受众易接受程度的评价
patterns.context: 讨论删去对话后作品是否更适合普通受众

patterns.name: 字面捕捉与手部灵巧的比喻
patterns.trigger: «sticky hands»、«Anything thrown close to him will be caught»
patterns.context: 以抓球能力形容球员，并延伸到关键时刻表现

en.description: Activation contexts are varied, covering time schedules with time zones, credit and patent text, fantasy commentary, mining news, sports scouting evaluations, pheromone chemistry, automotive news, and farm tree descriptions. No common lexical or semantic trigger pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Time and time-zone formats
patterns.context: Midnight times, AM/PM, and CT/PT time-zone abbreviations appear alongside dates, time ranges, and line-broken scheduling content.

patterns.name: Credit score disclaimer
patterns.context: Terms such as Equifax, FICO, credit repair, and federal or state laws form a consumer credit score explanation.

patterns.name: Magic and fantasy character expressions
patterns.context: Discusses magical abilities and compares them to elves and Harry Potter, in a conversational or commentary-like tone.

patterns.name: Sheet-material structure in a patent
patterns.context: “object of the invention” introduces an electronic component housing and its construction, materials, and coating.

patterns.name: South African mining area and labor conflict
patterns.context: Recounts a mine location, date, mining company, and police action against striking workers.

patterns.name: Scouting-style hockey player evaluation
patterns.context: Evaluates a player’s catching ability, consistency, and performance in key moments, in a fan-commentary tone.

patterns.name: Pheromone formulas and sensitivity
patterns.context: Compares pheromone components, proportions, and sensitivity in an experimental or research context.

patterns.name: Automotive partnerships and model news

en.description: Activations occur across varied and unrelated corpora: forum wording, patent quantities and identifiers, legal precedents, baseball narratives, fantasy jokes, e-book descriptions, and evaluations of papers. There is no stable cross-domain semantic or syntactic trigger pattern.

en.description: Activations include degree evaluations and colloquial judgments in forum quotations, as well as sports commentary, web links, email tables, code configuration, interface copy, and patent terminology. No single meaning spans all corpora.

patterns.name: so constructions expressing emphasis or difficulty

patterns.name: best and team performance
