patterns.name: Best album combination in a forum quotation
patterns.context: A music forum post expresses a desire to compile live performances onto one album; “best” occurs in a specific phrase.

10_574.description: 激活分布在多种领域：时间表中的日期、时间和时区最集中且有重复样本；另见表格金额、代码与 IP、专利部件编号，以及体育和论坛中的若干短语，彼此没有稳定共享的词法或语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 明确的时间区间记录
patterns.context: 多行记录中按起止时间列出日期、钟点和时区；内容常在换行处继续
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的时间表或时间记录

patterns.name: 时间字段格式中的数字片段
patterns.trigger: 时间戳里重复出现的«00»，以及«:»、«AM»、«PM»、«CT»、«PT»
patterns.context: 具体时间字段及其相邻标点、时区缩写；和模式1属同一段落格式
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的时间表或时间记录

patterns.name: 表格总计与交易记录
patterns.context: 以空格或制表符排列表格数字、总计，后接邮件或交易条目
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件/交易数据导出

patterns.name: 包含代码与网络地址的配置文本
patterns.context: 代码、配置字符串与支付 URL 混杂；激活覆盖代码标识符及地址中的数字和标点
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答或代码片段

patterns.name: 条码专利中的数值标号
patterns.context: 专利说明书用数字标记部件，并描述最小可解码条码片段及尺寸

patterns.name: 体育评论中的比较级与最佳表达
patterns.context: 讨论球队攻防表现、领先优势和比赛战绩；“best”重复出现

patterns.name: 口语中的 so easy 句式
patterns.context: 评论某事难以理解，后接“to understand the real agendas here”；相同表达在引文中重复

patterns.name: greater Toronto Area 缩写
patterns.context: 询问在大多伦多地区为汽车编程，缩写与括号内地名解释并列

patterns.name: 低技术方案的比较表达
patterns.context: 论坛回复以“to be honest”引出更有效的低技术捕捉方法，附近提到计数与捕捉数字

patterns.name: 论坛引文中最佳唱片组合
patterns.context: 音乐论坛帖子表达希望把现场演出合辑成一张唱片；“best”出现在特定短语中

en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of text: English word fragments, date-time fields, numbers and code identifiers, and email table labels. There is no stable semantic or syntactic theme across segments; some activations may relate to tokenization, numeric strings, and formatted text.

patterns.name: Specific subword fragments within or at the boundaries of English words
patterns.context: In ordinary English text, activations fall on words or word fragments; different semantic words may be covered within the same segment, with no stable syntactic position or lexical condition.
patterns.domain: Mixed text including news comments, sports discussions, papers, emails, and forums

patterns.name: Date and time format fields
patterns.context: Weekdays and numeric fields are marked in schedule-like time ranges consisting of dates, times, and time zones; the content of segments 3 and 4 is repeated.

patterns.name: Number, code, and identifier fragments
patterns.context: Alphanumeric configuration items, network addresses, code constants, or long identifiers; activations are scattered within fields, without consistent format boundaries.

patterns.name: Email tables and accounting labels
patterns.context: Near summary rows in email tables and email subject/field labels, accompanied by amount and date numbers.
patterns.domain: Enron emails, tables, or accounting text

10_574.concept: 格式化文本中的异质片段
10_574.description: 激活分布于多类文本：英文词片段、日期时间字段、数字与代码标识符，以及邮件表格标签。跨段没有稳定的语义或句法主题；部分激活可能与分词、数字串及格式化文本有关。

patterns.name: 英语词内部/边界的特定子词片段
patterns.context: 普通英文文本中，激活落在词语或词片段上；同一段内可能覆盖不同语义词，没有稳定的句法位置或词义条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、体育讨论、论文、邮件、论坛等混合文本

patterns.name: 日期与时间格式字段
patterns.context: 日期、时间与时区构成的排班式时间区间中，星期名及数字字段被标记；第3、4段内容重复。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的日程/时间表

patterns.name: 数字、代码与标识符片段
patterns.context: 数字与字母混合的配置项、网络地址、代码常量或长标识符；激活分散于字段内部，缺乏一致格式边界。
patterns.domain: 代码、技术问答、配置文本

patterns.name: 邮件表格与账目标签
patterns.context: 邮件中的表格汇总行及邮件标题/字段附近，伴随金额和日期数字。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、表格或账目文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across the technical use of may, C# generic list initialization and calls, specific institution/trial names and person-name fragments, values following an equals sign, and negative-pixel CSS offsets; no stable semantic pattern spans all segments.

patterns.name: may in English technical text
patterns.context: In technical descriptions or patent backgrounds, may appears in sentences describing a system’s/device’s capabilities or possibilities; both examples are accompanied by verbs such as include/be

patterns.name: List initialization terminator
patterns.context: At the end of a C# generic List initialization statement, immediately before a semicolon

patterns.name: Specific domain terms or fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall respectively on a word fragment in the name of a gynecologic oncology research institution, a clinical-trial term, and several subword fragments in a Japanese person’s name; there is no shared local semantic context
patterns.domain: NIH project descriptions and Wikipedia person entries

patterns.name: Numeric equals expression
patterns.context: An equals sign at the start of a line or in a standalone code/math expression is followed by the value 10000, then a line break

patterns.name: Assembly type call fragment
patterns.context: In C# reflection-scanning code, a call to the generic method AddAllTypesOf, with IP...ViolationHandler as the type parameter

patterns.name: CSS negative offset value
patterns.context: In a CSS background sprite image-positioning property, a hyphenated negative value and the px unit form a pixel offset

10_598.description: 激活分散在 may 的技术说明用法、C# 泛型列表初始化及调用、特定机构/试验名称和人名片段、等号后数值，以及 CSS 负像素偏移；未见贯穿所有片段的稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 英语技术文本中的 may
patterns.context: 在技术说明或专利背景中，may 位于描述某系统/设备能力或可能性的句子里；两例均伴随 include/be 等动词

patterns.name: 列表初始化结束符
patterns.context: C# 泛型 List 的 new 初始化语句末尾，紧邻分号

patterns.name: 特定领域名词或片段
patterns.context: 激活分别落在妇科肿瘤研究机构名称中的词片段、临床试验名词，以及日文人名的若干子词片段；没有共同的局部语义上下文
patterns.domain: NIH 项目描述与 Wikipedia 人名条目

patterns.name: 数字等号表达式
patterns.context: 行首或独立代码/数学表达式中的等号后接数值 10000，随后换行
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文本，具体语境不足

patterns.name: 程序集类型调用片段
patterns.context: C# 反射扫描代码中，调用 AddAllTypesOf 泛型方法，泛型参数为 IP...ViolationHandler

patterns.name: CSS 负偏移值
patterns.context: CSS background 的 sprite 图片定位属性中，连字符负值与 px 单位构成像素偏移

en.description: Activations occur in patents, medical research, names, papers, and code. Code samples commonly feature C# generic list construction or type registration; other examples include CSS background offsets, numeric assignments, clinical-trial terms, and name fragments, which are difficult to explain with a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Syntactic-unit boundaries and function words
patterns.context: In technical descriptions, function words connect noun phrases, relative clauses, or descriptions of possibility; these words often occur near highly activated noun phrases or code identifiers.

patterns.name: Clinical-trial-related terms
patterns.context: Research objectives mention participating in collaborative groups and conducting clinical trials, especially cancer research.

patterns.name: Name fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Japanese names are transliterated into Latin letters, followed by a line break and the beginning of a biographical profile.

patterns.name: C# generic lists and initialization
patterns.context: C# code declares or initializes a generic List, typically in code snippets from Q&A.

patterns.name: Type-registration calls in code
patterns.context: C# code registers a generic type using a scanner; this does not occur in list-initialization examples.

patterns.name: Numeric assignment and paper introduction
patterns.context: A numeric assignment is followed by a line break and the paper-introduction phrase «Recently there has been much interest».

patterns.name: CSS selectors and background-image offsets
patterns.context: A CSS rule sets a sprite background and pixel offsets for an arrow-related class selector.

10_598.concept: 异质文本中的标记片段
10_598.description: 激活分布于专利、医学研究、姓名、论文及代码文本。代码样本中常见 C# 泛型列表构造或类型注册；另有 CSS 背景偏移、数值赋值、临床试验词语与人名片段，难以由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 句法单元边界与功能词
patterns.context: 技术说明中用功能词连接名词短语、限定从句或描述可能性；这些词常位于高激活的名词短语或代码标识符附近。

patterns.name: 临床试验相关词语
patterns.context: 研究目标提及参与合作组并开展临床试验，尤其是肿瘤研究。

patterns.name: 专名中的姓名片段
patterns.context: 日文姓名以拉丁字母转写，姓名后接换行及人物简介开头。

patterns.name: C# 泛型列表及初始化
patterns.context: C# 代码中声明或初始化泛型 List，通常是问答里的代码片段。

patterns.name: 代码中的类型注册调用
patterns.context: C# 代码通过扫描器注册某个泛型类型；未见于列表初始化示例。

patterns.name: 数值赋值及论文引言
patterns.context: 数值赋值后换行，接论文引言式的 «Recently there has been much interest»。

patterns.name: CSS 选择器与背景图偏移
patterns.context: CSS 规则为箭头相关类选择器设置精灵图背景和像素偏移。

en.concept: Sentence endings/boundaries and common continuation structures
en.description: Patterns are distributed: may stands out in patents and financial explanations; code snippets often activate near the semicolon ending a List generic constructor initialization; there are also isolated examples such as trials, 10000 followed by a line break, and name fragments.

patterns.name: Possibility/modal verb may
patterns.context: may follows the subject or main clause and introduces a possible, capable, or permitted action; in [1] and [10] it appears in patent technical descriptions, and in [5] in a Q&A-style financial explanation.

patterns.name: Generic collection initialization in code
patterns.context: C#-style code declares a generic List and initializes it with new; activation falls on the semicolon ending the initialization expression; strongest in [3] and [6].
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A and code snippets

patterns.name: Numbers and paragraph boundaries in academic text
patterns.context: The number 10000 immediately follows an equals sign and occurs at a line break, after which an academic paper-style introduction begins; no other examples show the same numeric pattern.

patterns.name: Clinical-trial-related terms
patterns.context: In NIH research-summary contexts involving collaborative clinical research and solid tumors, activation falls on trials.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in names
patterns.context: The Japanese name Masayuki Matsubara is split into multiple subwords; the strongest activation falls on the internal name fragment uki. There are no other name examples.

patterns.name: Pronoun for stock ownership
patterns.context: In financial Q&A, its refers to company in a sentence about company executives selling its stock; the passage also contains may.
patterns.domain: Financial Q&A text in Enron emails

10_598.concept: 句末/边界及常见续接结构
10_598.description: 模式分散：may 在专利与金融解释中突出；代码片段多在 List 泛型构造器初始化的分号附近激活；另有 trials、10000 换行及人名片段等单例。

patterns.name: 可能性/助动词 may
patterns.context: may 位于主语或主句之后，引出可能、能力或允许的动作；[1]、[10]中为专利技术描述，[5]中为问答式金融解释。

patterns.name: 代码中的泛型集合初始化
patterns.context: C# 风格代码中声明 List 泛型并以 new 初始化，激活落在初始化表达式结束处的分号；[3]、[6]最强。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答及代码片段

patterns.name: 学术文本中的数值与段落边界
patterns.context: 数字 10000 紧接等号并位于换行处，之后开始学术论文式引言；未见相同数值模式的其他例子。

patterns.name: 临床试验相关词语
patterns.context: 临床合作研究、实体瘤等 NIH 研究摘要语境中，激活落在 trials。

patterns.name: 人名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 日文姓名 Masayuki Matsubara 被切分为多个子词，最强激活落在姓名内部的片段 uki；没有其他姓名例子。

patterns.name: 股票持有的代词
patterns.context: 金融问答中指代 company 的 its，出现在公司高管出售其股票的句子里；该段还出现 may。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的金融问答文本

en.description: Activations involve numbers or formulas following an equals sign at the start of a line, patent-style may include, academic introductory wording, and the repeated proper name Lejac Residential School; these triggers differ markedly from one another.

patterns.name: Leading equals sign and number/formula
patterns.context: The equals sign is at the start of the segment, often followed by a number, formula, or equation-like content; in math problems, a period is often followed by an instruction

patterns.name: may in patent style
patterns.context: Patent background descriptions of what a device or system may include

patterns.name: Academic introductory wording
patterns.context: Stating recent research interest in the introduction of an academic paper

patterns.name: Proper name Lejac Residential School
patterns.context: The proper name is repeated after the title

10_598.description: 激活涉及行首等号后接数字或算式、专利语体的 may include、学术引言措辞，以及重复专名 Lejac Residential School；这些触发条件彼此差异明显。

patterns.name: 行首等号与数字/公式
patterns.context: 等号位于片段开头，后面常跟数值、算式或类方程内容；数学题中常以句点结束后接题目指令

patterns.name: 专利语体中的 may
patterns.context: 专利背景描述设备或系统可能包含某些部件或功能

patterns.name: 学术引言措辞
patterns.context: 学术论文引言中陈述近期研究兴趣

patterns.name: 专名 Lejac Residential School
patterns.trigger: «Le»、«Res»等词片段，且重复出现«Lejac Residential School»
patterns.context: 专名在标题后再次重复

en.description: Primarily responds to First at the beginning of titles or entries, and to to connecting a topic and object in titles; there are also rare activations involving particle-physics terms, values after an equals sign, and blank lines.

patterns.name: Initial First
patterns.context: First appears at the beginning of a title or entry, followed by title content; activation occurs with different continuations.

patterns.name: to in titles
patterns.context: to occurs within a title phrase, connecting a topic to an object or goal.

patterns.name: Directional asymmetry terminology
patterns.context: Particle-physics terminology involving bottom quark and forward-backward asymmetry.

patterns.name: Values after an equals sign and paragraph starts
patterns.context: A value follows an equals sign, then a blank line, and the body begins with Recently; activation is concentrated on the symbol, number, and line break.

10_598.description: 主要响应标题或条目开头的 First，也响应标题中连接主题与对象的 to；另有粒子物理术语及等号后数值、空行等少见激活。

patterns.name: 词首 First
patterns.context: First 出现在标题或条目开头，后接标题内容；在不同续接内容中均有激活。
patterns.domain: 百科标题、学术标题及媒体标题

patterns.name: 标题中的 to
patterns.context: to 位于标题短语内部，连接主题与对象或目标。

patterns.name: 方向不对称性术语
patterns.context: 粒子物理术语片段，包含 bottom quark 与 forward-backward asymmetry。

patterns.name: 等号后的数值与段落起始
patterns.context: 等号后出现数值，随后空行并以 Recently 开始正文；激活集中在符号、数字及换行处。

en.description: Primarily activates on the modal may, in uses expressing possibility, capability, or potential function; there are also isolated activations on the proper-name fragment uki, like in a phrase, and Network at the start of a sentence.

patterns.name: Modal may
patterns.context: may is followed by a base-form verb or be, expressing possibility, potential function, or general capability; it is the primary activation point in multiple segments.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, medical abstracts, research texts, emails, and general expository writing

patterns.name: Specific fragment in a person’s name
patterns.context: Appears within the proper name «Masayuki Matsubara»; activation is concentrated on the name fragment rather than syntactic structure.

patterns.name: may look like construction
patterns.context: In “it may look like a red flag,” like also has strong activation in addition to may.

patterns.name: Word-initial network
patterns.context: Network security appears at the start of a sentence; increasingly in the same sentence also has moderate activation, but there is insufficient evidence for a stable collocation.
patterns.domain: Network security description in a patent background

10_598.concept: may 情态词及偶发词项
10_598.description: 主要对情态词 may 激活，涵盖可能性、能力或潜在作用等用法；另有专名片段 uki、短语中的 like，以及句首 Network 的孤立激活。

patterns.name: may 情态词
patterns.context: may 后接动词原形或 be，表达可能性、潜在功能或一般能力；在多段中是主要激活点。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学摘要、科研文本、邮件及一般说明文

patterns.name: 人名中的特定片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名「Masayuki Matsubara」内部，激活集中于人名片段而非句法结构。

patterns.name: may look like 搭配
patterns.context: “it may look like a red flag”中，除 may 外，对 like 也有较强激活。

patterns.name: network 词首
patterns.context: 句首出现 Network security；同句还有 increasingly 的中等激活，但未见足够证据认定为稳定搭配。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的网络安全说明

en.description: Activations do not form a single semantic theme: strong signals recur on comes and characterized, and occur sporadically on akin, lux within subluxation, and net within botnet; the first two categories appear across scientific, medical, and news texts.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in comes
patterns.context: The full word or substring comes appears in a sentence, often as a predicate verb; prefixes can attach before the word, as in becomes, and the word can also appear in overcomes and outcomes.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, project descriptions, and press releases

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in characterized
patterns.context: The past participle characterized functions as a predicate or modifier, often followed by by; in [4], cyclase immediately before it is also activated.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in akin
patterns.context: In the construction “a process akin to …,” describing a process as similar to another process.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in subluxation
patterns.context: Appears in the diagnostic name extensor carpi ulnaris subluxation as part of a medical term.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in botnet
patterns.context: Refers to a botnet consisting of controlled or infected hosts; activation is concentrated on the word-final net.

10_598.description: 激活并非单一语义主题：较强信号反复落在 comes 与 characterized，也零星落在 akin、subluxation 内的 lux、botnet 内的 net；前两类跨科学、医学和新闻文本出现。

patterns.name: comes 的词尾片段
patterns.context: 完整词形或子串 comes 出现在句中，常位于谓语动词位置；前缀可接在词前，如 becomes，词也可出现在 overcomes、outcomes 中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、项目说明及新闻稿

patterns.name: characterized 的词尾片段
patterns.context: 过去分词 characterized 作谓语或修饰语，常接 by；[4] 中紧邻前面的 cyclase 也有激活。

patterns.name: akin 的词尾片段
patterns.context: 在“a process akin to …”结构中，描述过程与另一过程相似。

patterns.name: sub luxation 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在诊断名称 extensor carpi ulnaris subluxation 中，是医学术语的一部分。

patterns.name: botnet 的词内片段
patterns.context: 指受控制或受感染主机组成的 botnet；激活集中在词尾 net。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术／网络安全

en.description: Strong activations often fall on words carrying research actions, uses, and findings in abstracts or technical descriptions; a few terms or title words are also involved: frequency, admissions, branching. The segments come from different fields and do not show a unified narrow theme.

patterns.name: Verbs in research abstracts
patterns.context: Predicates describing research content, system uses, experimental findings, or established results in research or technical introductions; the trigger is not always the same word form.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, NIH project abstracts, and biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: AC frequency phrase
patterns.context: Appears in the fixed term «Variable» «frequency» «alternating» «current».

patterns.name: admissions
patterns.context: «Ac»«ute admissions», meaning acute hospital admissions in a medical article title.

patterns.name: starch branching
patterns.context: «St»«arch» «branching» «enzymes», referring to starch-branching enzymes.

10_598.concept: 研究摘要中的信息承载词
10_598.description: 强激活多落在摘要或技术说明中承载研究动作、用途和发现的词，也包括少数术语或标题词：frequency、admissions、branching。各段领域不同，未显示统一的窄主题。

patterns.name: 研究摘要中的动词
patterns.context: 研究或技术介绍中描述研究内容、系统用途、实验发现或已确立结果的谓语；触发点不总在同一词形。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、NIH 项目摘要及生物医学摘要

patterns.name: AC 高频词组
patterns.context: 出现在固定术语 «Variable» «frequency» «alternating» «current» 中。

patterns.name: admissions
patterns.context: «Ac»«ute admissions»，即医学文章标题中的急性住院收治。

patterns.name: starch branching
patterns.context: «St»«arch» «branching» «enzymes»，涉及淀粉分支酶。

en.description: The clearest recurring clue is the substring “her” within English words, across multiple fields and with varied meanings. In the remaining segments, highlights are scattered across Japanese strings, statements of genetic harmfulness, and general research wording, making them difficult to group into a single stable pattern.

patterns.name: Substring her
patterns.context: The consecutive substring `her` occurs within an English word; no specific semantic or syntactic environment is required
patterns.domain: Cross-disciplinary English texts: condensed matter physics, medicine, genetics, theoretical physics

patterns.name: Medical variant and harmfulness descriptions involving her
patterns.context: Medical paper contexts concerning genetic variants, amino-acid properties, and predicted harmful effects

patterns.name: Local markers in Japanese interface text
patterns.context: Japanese interface copy or translated strings; their meaning does not jointly explain activations in the other segments

patterns.name: Sporadically highly activated words in general English research text
patterns.context: Narration in research abstracts describing effects or research methods; no stable, specific shared trigger condition is apparent

10_598.description: 最清楚的重复线索是英文单词内部出现子串“her”，涉及多种领域且语义各异。其余段的高亮分散在日文字符串、遗传学有害性表述及一般科研措辞中，难以归入同一稳定模式。

patterns.name: her 子串
patterns.context: 英文单词内部包含连续子串 `her`；不要求特定语义或句法环境
patterns.domain: 跨学科英文文本：凝聚态物理、医学、遗传学、理论物理

patterns.name: her 相关医学变异与有害性描述
patterns.trigger: `her`（段 [5] 中未出现；相关显著触发词为 “deleterious”）
patterns.context: 遗传变异、氨基酸性质及预测有害影响的医学论文语境

patterns.name: 日文界面文本中的局部标记
patterns.trigger: 日文字符串中的 `«»`、`»6` 等标记；可见例子包括 “許VDR訊息” 和 “御社”
patterns.context: 日语界面文案或翻译字符串；无法从词义与其他段的激活共同解释
patterns.domain: 软件翻译、日文技术问答

patterns.name: 一般英文科研文本中的零散高激活词
patterns.context: 科研摘要中描述作用或研究方法的叙述；没有显示出稳定且特异的共同触发条件

en.concept: Local technical fragments in heterogeneous text
en.description: Activations are scattered across fragments within technical terms, research methods and scale-validity terminology, medical treatment outcome statistics, biological sex determination, code variables, and paper citation markers; there is no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Word-final/in-word fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on local fragments of longer technical terms or identifiers; sentence meanings vary, and fragment positions are not fixed.

patterns.name: Citations and markers containing numbers
patterns.context: Activations occur near citation markers, iteration method names, or return-series labels in mathematics papers.

patterns.name: Research design and validity measurement terminology
patterns.context: Activations occur near methodological or evaluation terms in research abstracts describing interviews, clinical scales, study phases, and measurement properties.

patterns.name: Clinical outcomes and treatment statistics
patterns.context: Activations occur when medical texts report treatment, patient outcomes, or statistics listed by treatment group.

patterns.name: Biological sex determination and stages
patterns.context: Activations occur in sentences describing biological sex-determination mechanisms and the stages at which they occur.

patterns.name: Probability variable in code
patterns.context: A local fragment of the variable name stands out as C++-style code iterates over a probabilities member variable.

patterns.name: Technical suffix in application pricing discussion
patterns.context: In a HackerNews post discussing application market size and pricing models, activation is concentrated on a split word fragment; its specific meaning is difficult to relate to the other segments.

patterns.name: Cochlear stimulation and nerve fiber location
patterns.context: Activations occur in experimental descriptions comparing the locations of afferent and efferent fiber endings after mechanical or electrical stimulation of hair cells.

patterns.name: Citation/statistical fragments without a clear pattern
patterns.context: The segments may locally overlap with other patterns, but the context alone does not establish a stable trigger condition.

10_598.concept: 异质文本中的局部技术片段
10_598.description: 激活分散于技术词内部片段、研究方法与量表效度术语、医学治疗结局统计、生物性别决定，以及代码变量和论文引用标记；尚无统一语义触发点。

patterns.name: 技术词中的词尾/词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在较长技术词或标识符的局部片段上；所处句子语义各异，片段位置不固定。
patterns.domain: 跨领域技术文本与代码

patterns.name: 带数字的引用与标记
patterns.context: 数学论文中，引用标记、迭代方法名或 return 系列标签附近出现激活。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学/计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 研究设计与效度测量用语
patterns.context: 描述访谈、临床量表、研究阶段及测量属性的研究摘要中，方法学或评估术语附近激活。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划/临床研究

patterns.name: 临床结果与治疗统计
patterns.context: 医学文本报告治疗、患者结局或按治疗组列出的统计数据时激活。

patterns.name: 生物学性别决定与阶段
patterns.context: 描述生物体性别决定机制及其发生阶段的句子中激活。

patterns.name: 概率变量代码
patterns.context: C++ 风格代码遍历 probabilities 成员变量时，变量名局部片段突出。

patterns.name: 应用定价讨论中的技术尾缀
patterns.context: 讨论应用市场规模与定价模式的 HackerNews 帖子中，激活集中在被拆分的词片段；具体词义与其他片段难以对应。

patterns.name: 耳蜗刺激与神经纤维位置
patterns.context: 比较毛细胞机械或电刺激后传入、传出纤维末端位置的实验描述中激活。

patterns.name: 未形成明确模式的引文/统计片段
patterns.context: 片段中可能与其他模式有局部重合，但单凭上下文不能确定稳定触发条件。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 引文；医学统计摘要

en.description: Activations occur mainly in biomedical academic texts, especially clinical research methods, tissue/disease terminology, and test-performance metrics; they also respond to fragments within words, research titles, image-analysis citations, and code header-file paths, making them difficult to assign to a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Medical research terms and methods descriptions
patterns.context: Appears in results, methods, and background sentences of clinical research, pathology, or biomedical papers; involves patients, tissues, diseases, tests, or research processes.

patterns.name: Quantitative results and evaluation metrics
patterns.context: Reports performance metrics in testing or diagnostic studies, often in the same sentence as comparisons, limitations, or interpretation of results.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within medical words
patterns.context: Triggers fall within complete words or affixes and do not always align with biomedical subject matter; they may reflect word-form or fragment features.

patterns.name: Paths and filenames in code
patterns.context: Appears in C/C++ preprocessor directives and quoted header-file paths.

patterns.name: Title-case phrase in a title
patterns.context: Title case describing the translation of bench research into the clinical domain; activation is concentrated on words in the title.

patterns.name: References and paper terminology
patterns.context: A cell image-analysis paper discusses segmentation challenges and lists related work in author-year format.

10_598.description: 主要出现在生物医学学术文本，尤其是临床研究的方法、组织/疾病术语及检测性能指标；也响应词内片段、科研标题、图像分析引文，以及代码头文件路径，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 医学研究术语与方法描述
patterns.trigger: “post-”/“-partum”、“fetal”、“maternal”、“patients”、“tissue samples”等医学词汇，以及“defined”“recorded”“was performed”等方法描述
patterns.context: 出现在临床研究、病理学或生物医学论文的结果、方法和背景句中；涉及患者、组织、疾病、检测或研究流程。

patterns.name: 定量结果与评估指标
patterns.context: 检测或诊断研究中报告性能指标，常与比较、限制或结果解释同句出现。

patterns.name: 医学词语内部的子词片段
patterns.context: 触发落在完整词或词缀内部，并不总与生物医学主题一致；可能反映词形或片段特征。

patterns.name: 代码中的路径与文件名
patterns.context: 出现在 C/C++ 预处理指令和双引号包围的头文件路径中。

patterns.name: 标题中的大小写词组
patterns.trigger: “Multiple Perspectives On Bringing Bench top Research Into The Clinical Domain”
patterns.context: 标题式大小写，描述将台式研究转化到临床领域；激活集中于标题中的词语。

patterns.name: 参考文献引用与论文术语
patterns.context: 细胞图像分析论文讨论分割困难，并以作者年份格式列举相关工作。

en.description: Activations concentrate in biomedical text, covering diseases and abbreviations, clinical treatment and survival outcomes, pregnancy and placenta, imaging scores, statistical measures, tumor sites, and radiotherapy responses. They also mark terminology, numbers, citations, and ordinary narrative words, with no single stable word-form pattern.

patterns.name: Vocabulary and phrases in medical text
patterns.context: Occurs in medical research narratives, case reports, clinical trials, or pathology descriptions; activations span nouns, adjectives, verbs, and function words rather than a single part of speech or fixed phrase

patterns.name: Disease names and abbreviations
patterns.context: Occurs in disease classification, diagnosis, cases, or discussions of tumor biology, with abbreviations alongside their expansions or clinical descriptions

patterns.name: Quantitative scores and statistical measures
patterns.context: Numbers correspond to grades, ratios, or confidence intervals in imaging severity scores or medical research results

patterns.name: Treatment regimens, clinical trials, and efficacy
patterns.context: Discusses cancer treatment, treatment combinations, clinical trials, or transplant therapies received by patients

patterns.name: Pregnancy, placenta, and obstetric factors
patterns.context: Describes hormonal changes during pregnancy or placenta-related measures and their statistical associations

patterns.name: Cancer and skin reactions to radiation therapy
patterns.context: Studies acute or late skin reactions after radiotherapy in breast cancer patients and plans to establish cell lines

patterns.name: Anatomical sites and localization of metastases/lesions
patterns.context: Describes the organ, brain region, or lesion site where a tumor is located; paragraph 1 also concerns primary/subsequent lesion sites and survival

patterns.name: Months and survival-time expressions
patterns.context: Reports survival or duration of treatment efficacy in clinical results

patterns.name: Expansion or parenthetical definition of abbreviations
patterns.context: A parenthetical abbreviation follows a technical term, or an abbreviation appears alongside its expanded form

patterns.name: Citation, proper-noun, and publication-format fragments
patterns.context: Citation markers, institution names, or report-title fragments in medical papers; no stable semantic trigger

10_598.description: 激活集中于生物医学文本，涵盖疾病与缩写、临床治疗和生存结果、妊娠胎盘、影像评分、统计指标、肿瘤部位及放疗反应；也标记术语、数字、引文和普通叙述词，未见单一稳定词形模式。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的词汇与短语
patterns.trigger: 多个段落中被标记的医学术语和普通词，如 «patients»、«disease»、«months»、«segment»、«severe»、«growth»、«cancer»、«stage»
patterns.context: 出现在医学研究叙述、病例报告、临床试验或病理描述中；激活分布在名词、形容词、动词及功能词上，并非单一词类或固定短语

patterns.name: 疾病名称及缩写
patterns.context: 出现在疾病分类、诊断、病例或肿瘤生物学讨论中，缩写与其展开名称或临床描述并列

patterns.name: 量化评分与统计指标
patterns.context: 在影像严重程度评分或医学研究结果中，数字与等级、比值或置信区间对应

patterns.name: 治疗方案、临床试验与疗效
patterns.context: 讨论癌症治疗、治疗组合、临床试验或患者接受的移植治疗

patterns.name: 妊娠、胎盘及产科因素
patterns.context: 描述妊娠期激素变化或胎盘相关指标及其统计关联

patterns.name: 癌症及放射治疗皮肤反应
patterns.trigger: «breast cancer patients»、«skin reactions»、«radiation fractionation trial»、«fibroblast cell lines»
patterns.context: 研究乳腺癌患者放疗后的急性或晚期皮肤反应，并计划建立细胞系

patterns.name: 解剖部位与转移/病灶定位
patterns.context: 描述肿瘤所在的器官、脑区或病灶部位；第1段另涉及原发/后续病灶部位与生存期

patterns.name: 月数及生存时间表达
patterns.context: 临床结果中报告生存期或疗效持续时间

patterns.name: 术语缩写的展开或括注
patterns.context: 专业术语后紧接括号缩写，或缩写与展开术语共同出现

patterns.name: 引文、专名及出版格式残片
patterns.context: 医学论文中的引文标记、机构名或报告标题残片；缺乏稳定的语义触发条件

en.description: Primarily responds to dense clinical or histological descriptions in biomedical papers, especially numerical, stage, sample, classification, and outcome information; it also covers less common sequencing, transplantation, and placental staining descriptions. The commonality is a specialized medical research context, but the specific triggers vary.

patterns.name: Numbers and quantitative results in medical texts
patterns.context: Appears in research results, sample descriptions, grading scales, or measurement metrics; activation sometimes falls on words or punctuation near numbers.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and abstracts, quantitative reporting

patterns.name: Gestational stages and developmental timing
patterns.context: Descriptions of stage-based comparisons or locations involving fetuses, placentas, or gestational tissue.
patterns.domain: Reproductive, developmental, and placental biomedical research

patterns.name: Tissue, cell, and pathological morphology descriptions
patterns.context: Involves tissue samples, cell types, histological observations, lesions, or margin features; often accompanied by testing, localization, or comparison results.

patterns.name: Clinical cohorts and patient characteristics
patterns.context: Describes patient enrollment, disease subtypes, treatment conditions, or cohort design.

patterns.name: Medical classification, grading, and scoring
patterns.context: Classifies diseases, imaging abnormalities, or tissue features into categories or grades.

patterns.name: Imaging and anatomical measurements
patterns.context: Describes imaging assessment, ocular tissue observation, or anatomical units and ranges used for measurement.

patterns.name: Survival, risk, and outcome statistics
patterns.context: Reports hazard ratios, confidence intervals, survival times, or adverse event rates.

patterns.name: Molecular testing and sequencing
patterns.context: Cloning, sequencing, or molecular sequence analysis is performed on tumor-derived material.

patterns.name: Cell components and tissue staining localization
patterns.context: Describes the distribution and intensity differences of staining in placental cell layers.

patterns.name: Treatment and transplantation abbreviations
patterns.context: Research descriptions of patients receiving high-dose chemotherapy and peripheral blood stem cell transplantation.

10_598.description: 主要响应生物医学论文中密集的临床或组织学描述，尤其是数值、阶段、样本、分类和结局信息；也覆盖少见的测序、移植及胎盘染色表述。共同点是专业医学研究语境，但具体触发内容多样。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的数字与量化结果
patterns.context: 出现在研究结果、样本描述、分级量表或测量指标中；激活点有时落在数值附近的词或标点上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与摘要，定量报告

patterns.name: 孕期阶段与发育时间
patterns.context: 围绕胎儿、胎盘或妊娠组织的阶段性比较或定位描述。
patterns.domain: 生殖、发育与胎盘生物医学研究

patterns.name: 组织、细胞及病理形态描述
patterns.context: 涉及组织样本、细胞类型、组织学观察、病变或切缘特征；常伴随检测、定位或比较结果。
patterns.domain: 病理学、组织学与肿瘤医学

patterns.name: 临床队列与患者特征
patterns.trigger: «Thirty-three patients», «patients», «refractory or recurrent NHL», «matched for sex», «prospective, multicenter»
patterns.context: 交代患者入组、疾病亚型、治疗条件或队列设计。

patterns.name: 医学分类、分级与评分
patterns.context: 将疾病、影像异常或组织特征划分为类别或等级。

patterns.name: 影像检查与解剖测量
patterns.context: 描述影像评估、眼部组织观察或测量的解剖单位与范围。
patterns.domain: 影像学、眼科及手术病理

patterns.name: 生存、风险与结局统计
patterns.context: 报告风险比、置信区间、生存时间或不良事件发生率。
patterns.domain: 流行病学与临床结局研究

patterns.name: 分子检测与测序
patterns.context: 在肿瘤来源材料中进行克隆、测序或分子序列分析。

patterns.name: 细胞成分与组织染色定位
patterns.context: 描述胎盘细胞层中的染色分布及强弱差异。
patterns.domain: 胎盘组织学与免疫染色研究

patterns.name: 治疗与移植缩写
patterns.context: 患者接受高剂量化疗及外周血干细胞移植治疗的研究描述。

en.description: Activations mainly occur in biomedical contexts involving cells, cell types, and tumors, and also cover specific descriptions of differentiation stages, tissue localization, stem cells, cell-morphology analysis, and receptor binding. The passages share biomedical cell vocabulary, but their triggering subtopics are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Cell/histological terminology and cell types
patterns.context: Biomedical text mentions cells, cell types, or cellular structures, often alongside descriptions of growth, differentiation, staining, or tissue localization.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and NIH project summaries

patterns.name: Tumor and malignancy terminology
patterns.context: Descriptions of tumor types, malignant status, or tumor cells; some passages concern differentiation arrest or origin.

patterns.name: Differentiation arrest and developmental stages
patterns.context: Describes blocked cell differentiation, progenitor-cell states, or developmental stages.

patterns.name: Cell localization, boundaries, and membrane structures
patterns.context: Tissue localization of staining, proteins, or intercellular structures, especially references to boundaries, membranes, or surfaces.

patterns.name: Stem cells and hematopoietic factors/cell repair
patterns.context: Descriptions related to stem cells, the hematopoietic system, or repair after injury.
patterns.domain: Neuroscience, hematopoietic biology, and NIH project summaries

patterns.name: Cell morphology and image segmentation
patterns.context: Cell or image analysis based on morphological features of nuclei and cytoplasm.

patterns.name: Specific disease term: teratoid/rhabdoid tumor
patterns.context: Tumor-name abbreviations and their definitions or location descriptions.

patterns.name: Receptors and molecular binding
patterns.context: Narrative about a drug blocking a protein from binding to a cell-surface receptor.

patterns.name: Early immunoglobulin gene sequences and mutations
patterns.context: Analyzes immunoglobulin variable-region sequences of tumor origin and mutation patterns.

10_598.description: 激活主要出现在细胞、细胞类型与肿瘤相关生物医学语境，也覆盖分化阶段、组织定位、干细胞、细胞形态分析及受体结合等具体表述；各段共享细胞生物医学词汇，但触发子主题并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 细胞/组织学术语与细胞类型
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中出现细胞、细胞类型或细胞结构，常伴随生长、分化、染色或组织定位描述。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与 NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 肿瘤及恶性病变术语
patterns.context: 肿瘤类型、恶性状态或肿瘤细胞的描述；部分段落涉及分化停滞或起源。

patterns.name: 分化停滞及发育阶段
patterns.context: 描述细胞分化受阻、前体细胞状态或发育阶段。
patterns.domain: 发育生物学、血液学与肿瘤学

patterns.name: 细胞定位、边界与膜结构
patterns.trigger: “at the boundary between the two cell layers”, “at the cell membrane”, “luminal aspect”
patterns.context: 染色、蛋白或细胞间结构的组织定位，尤其提及边界、膜或表面。

patterns.name: 干细胞及造血因子/细胞修复
patterns.trigger: “stem cells”, “stem cell factor”, “hematopoietic growth factors”, “hematopoietic stem cell”
patterns.context: 干细胞、造血系统或损伤后修复相关描述。
patterns.domain: 神经科学、造血生物学与 NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 细胞形态与图像分割
patterns.trigger: “nucleus to cytoplasm ratio”, “nuclear size”, “nuclear shape”, “segmentation of cell”
patterns.context: 以细胞核、细胞质形态特征为依据的细胞或图像分析。

patterns.name: 特定疾病名词：畸胎样/横纹肌样肿瘤
patterns.context: 肿瘤名称缩写及其定义、部位说明。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤分类或词汇表式文本

patterns.name: 受体及分子结合
patterns.trigger: “prevented … from binding”, “surface cell receptor called CD47”
patterns.context: 药物阻断蛋白与细胞表面受体结合的叙述。

patterns.name: 早期免疫球蛋白基因序列与突变
patterns.context: 分析肿瘤来源的免疫球蛋白可变区序列及突变模式。

en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of biomedical text: terminology for factors, hormones, and cellular processes; segmentation of cell/brain-region compounds; and case-report and abbreviation-list formatting. Local trigger conditions are not entirely consistent across segments.

patterns.name: Factor names in biomedicine
patterns.context: Discusses the function or induction effect of cytokines, growth factors, or angiogenic factors, or their relationship to disease processes; factor terms and nearby names are often marked
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts and research plans

patterns.name: Trophoblast and cell-layer boundaries
patterns.context: Describes placental staining localization, especially cell types and boundaries between layers

patterns.name: Cell-cycle arrest and senescence
patterns.context: Describes post-treatment cell-cycle changes and senescent phenotypes

patterns.name: Split fragments in brain-region names
patterns.context: Lists brain regions involved in emotional stimulus tasks, especially when region names are split into subwords

patterns.name: Authorization statement at the end of a case report
patterns.context: A case report states that written informed consent is available for review by the journal editor

patterns.name: Abbreviations and definitions in an abbreviation list
patterns.context: Formatting of abbreviations, colons, line breaks, and term definitions in an abbreviation list at the end of a paper
patterns.domain: Medical paper appendices or supplementary sections

patterns.name: Follicle-stimulating hormone and its effects

Triggers are mostly localized to specialized terms.

patterns.context: Discusses cytokines or growth factors and their effects on hematopoiesis, stem cells, brain injury repair, or tumor cells; triggers often occur on related terms and nearby words.

patterns.name: Targeted anticancer drugs and receptor markers
patterns.context: Contexts involving targeted therapies, drugs, or molecular receptor markers for breast cancer and other tumors.

patterns.name: Cell adhesion- and migration-related molecules
patterns.context: Describes cell-cell adhesion, receptor-ligand relationships, or tumor cell migration; activation centers on adhesion molecule and receptor names.

patterns.name: Glial cells and developmental markers
patterns.context: Describes identification of oligodendrocytes at different developmental stages and expression of precursor cell markers.

patterns.name: Clinical research registration and data platforms
patterns.context: Introduces multicenter clinical studies, registration information, or data platforms supporting research.

patterns.name: Overview of hematopoietic stem cell transplantation

patterns.name: 细胞因子与造血生长因子

en.description: Primarily responds to cytokines, growth factors, and cell-related terminology in biomedical research text; also covers blood-cell differentiation, tumor treatment and angiogenesis, markers and tissue localization, and clinical study registration.

patterns.name: Cytokines and growth factors

patterns.name: Hematopoiesis and blood-cell differentiation

patterns.name: Cancer treatment and angiogenesis
patterns.context: Lists targeted anticancer drugs or describes angiogenesis and related factors.

patterns.name: Cell markers and tissue localization

patterns.name: Neural injury repair

patterns.name: Clinical research registration and databases

patterns.name: Glial cells and neural markers
patterns.context: Describes cell types, tissue localization, immunostaining markers, or antibody names, often using specialized terms and marker abbreviations.

patterns.name: Clinical research registration and collaboration platforms
patterns.context: Descriptions of research registration, database sources, and multicenter collaboration platforms.

patterns.name: Transplantation and age numbers

patterns.name: Erythroid differentiation and CFU-e
patterns.context: Discusses nucleoproteins, cell growth and differentiation, and the arrested differentiation state of erythroid precursor cells.

10_598.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中的专业细胞与分子术语，尤其细胞因子及IL编号；也响应胶质/组织标记、移植临床数据、研究平台和红系分化术语。

en.description: Primarily responds to cell, molecular, and marker terminology in biomedical text, especially cytokines/growth factors, receptor therapies, and molecular names; it also covers angiogenesis, signaling pathways, glia, and platelets across different topics.

patterns.name: IL numbers in cytokine names

patterns.name: Growth-factor and cytokine terminology
patterns.context: Discusses hematopoiesis, growth factors, or cytokines, often alongside treatment combinations, cell culture, platelet production, or lists of cytokines.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and NIH grant applications

patterns.name: Antibodies and targeted-therapy expressions
patterns.context: Describes blocking treatment targeting the IL-6 receptor and monoclonal antibodies; activation is concentrated around the antibody and its abbreviation.

patterns.name: Epithelial markers and cell-adhesion molecules
patterns.context: Discusses tumor-cell phenotypes and detection using epithelial-specific markers.

patterns.name: Platelet production and megakaryocytes

patterns.name: Angiogenesis and fibroblast growth factors
patterns.context: Describes angiogenesis, endothelial-cell tube formation, and related growth factors.

patterns.name: PI3K pathway and transcription factors

patterns.name: Glial-cell markers

patterns.name: Stem-cell phenotype and marker lists

patterns.name: Platelet adhesion and coagulation-related molecules

patterns.name: 临床研究注册与研究基础设施

en.description: Activations center on cytokines, growth factors, cell markers, and their functions in biomedical text; also covers adjacent topics such as targeted therapy, vascular mechanics, brain repair, and angiogenesis.

patterns.name: Cytokines and interleukins
patterns.context: Discusses the effects of cytokines, receptors, or growth factors on cellular function, disease, or treatment, often naming specific factors.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, immunology, and hematology papers or grant abstracts

patterns.name: Cell types and markers
patterns.context: Lists markers, antibodies, or cell surface molecules when describing cell identity, differentiation stage, or phenotype.

patterns.name: Targeted anticancer drugs and treatment classes
patterns.context: Introduces cancer treatment approaches, drug classes, or specific targeted drugs.

patterns.name: Blood-flow shear stress and endothelial transcriptional regulation
patterns.context: Discusses arterial hemodynamic forces acting on endothelial cells and inducing transcription factors.

patterns.name: Brain injury repair and hematopoietic growth factors

patterns.name: Angiogenesis and endothelial tube formation
patterns.context: Describes angiogenesis and endothelial cell proliferation and tube formation.
patterns.domain: Tumor or vascular biology patent background

10_598.concept: 生物医学细胞因子与细胞表型
10_598.description: 激活集中于生物医学文本中的细胞因子、生长因子、细胞标志物及其功能描述；也覆盖靶向治疗、血管力学、脑修复和血管生成等相邻专题。

patterns.name: 细胞因子与白细胞介素
patterns.context: 讨论细胞因子、受体或生长因子对细胞功能、疾病或治疗的影响，常出现具体因子名称。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、免疫学与血液学论文或基金摘要

patterns.name: 细胞类型与标志物
patterns.context: 描述细胞身份、分化阶段或表型时，列举标志物、抗体或细胞表面分子。

patterns.name: 靶向抗癌药物与治疗类别
patterns.context: 介绍癌症治疗方式、药物类别或具体靶向药。

patterns.name: 血流剪切力与内皮转录调控
patterns.context: 讨论动脉血流力学作用于内皮细胞并诱导转录因子。

patterns.name: 脑损伤修复与造血生长因子
patterns.trigger: “brain repair”“stroke-damaged brain”“hematopoietic growth factors”“stem cell factor”
patterns.context: 讨论慢性期脑损伤或卒中后的修复策略及生长因子组合。

patterns.name: 血管生成与内皮管形成
patterns.context: 描述血管生成过程及内皮细胞增殖、组织成管。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤或血管生物学专利背景

en.description: Activations concentrate in biomedical contexts, especially cell/immune markers, cytokines, and their effects on cells, differentiation, and disease; other topics include stem cells, glia, platelet production, and tumor angiogenesis.

patterns.name: Immune markers and cell markers
patterns.context: When describing cell type, differentiation stage, or immune recognition, marker(s) and marker names occur; sometimes the marker name itself is activated.

patterns.name: Cytokines and their names
patterns.context: Discusses cytokines, their functions, or combinations of cytokines; often adjacent to immunity, hematopoiesis, or disease mechanisms.

patterns.name: Stem cells and differentiation
patterns.context: Mentions stem-cell types, culture, or differentiation, often alongside markers or cytokines.

patterns.name: Immune cells and immune functions
patterns.context: Describes immune-cell subsets, immune functions, or immune memory; some examples occur alongside cytokines or lymphoma.

patterns.name: Cytokine therapy and disease associations
patterns.context: Links cytokine pathways and receptor-blocking treatment to disease manifestations or comorbidities.

patterns.name: Cytokine effects on platelet production
patterns.context: Describes the relationship between thrombocytosis, production factors, megakaryocytes, and cytokines.

patterns.name: Glial cells and neural markers
patterns.context: Discusses the development, identification, or tissue localization of nervous-system cells, often using markers.

patterns.name: Liver-related growth factors
patterns.context: Describes sequential addition of liver-related factors during in vitro differentiation to enhance differentiation.

patterns.name: Tumor angiogenic factors
patterns.context: Describes OSM promoting expression of pro-angiogenic factors in tumor cells.

patterns.name: CD markers in cell names
patterns.context: Occurs as part of cell-surface markers or immune-cell names.

10_598.concept: 生物医学细胞因子与标志物
10_598.description: 激活集中于生物医学语境，尤其是细胞/免疫标志物、细胞因子及其对细胞、分化和疾病的作用；另涉及干细胞、神经胶质、血小板生成与肿瘤血管生成。

patterns.name: 免疫标志物与细胞标志物
patterns.trigger: “marker”以及后接的标志物名称，如 “marker HLA-ABC”“precursor marker nestin”“marker glial fibrillary acidic protein”
patterns.context: 描述细胞类型、分化阶段或免疫识别时，出现 marker(s) 与其名称；有时标志物名称自身被激活。

patterns.name: 细胞因子及其名称
patterns.context: 讨论细胞因子、其作用或由细胞因子组成的组合；常与免疫、造血或疾病机制相邻。

patterns.name: 干细胞与分化
patterns.trigger: “embryonic stem cell”“mesenchymal stem cell”“hematopoietic stem cells”“differentiation efficacy”
patterns.context: 提及干细胞类型、培养或分化，并常伴随标志物或细胞因子。

patterns.name: 免疫细胞与免疫功能
patterns.trigger: “immune effector function”“Treg”“Follicular helper CD4 T cells”“Tfh”“immunological memory”
patterns.context: 描述免疫细胞亚群、免疫功能或免疫记忆；部分例子与细胞因子或淋巴瘤并列。

patterns.name: 细胞因子治疗与疾病关联
patterns.context: 将细胞因子通路、受体阻断治疗与疾病表现或合并症联系起来。

patterns.name: 细胞因子对血小板生成的作用
patterns.context: 描述血小板增多与生成因子、巨核细胞及细胞因子的关系。

patterns.name: 神经胶质细胞及神经标志物
patterns.context: 讨论神经系统细胞的发育、识别或组织定位，常借助标志物。

patterns.name: 肝脏相关生长因子
patterns.context: 描述体外分化中顺序加入肝脏相关因子以增强分化。
patterns.domain: 发育生物学与细胞培养

patterns.name: 肿瘤血管生成因子
patterns.trigger: “breast cancer cells”“proangiogenic factor VEGF”“OSM promotes expression”
patterns.context: 描述肿瘤细胞中 OSM 促进促血管生成因子表达。

patterns.name: 细胞名称中的 CD 标记
patterns.context: 作为细胞表面标志物或免疫细胞名称的一部分出现。

en.description: Primarily responds to specialized entities and terms in biomedical text, especially immune cells, cytokines, markers, and alphanumeric molecular names; also covers related expressions involving cancer treatment, angiogenesis, and clinical management.

patterns.name: Biomedical markers and molecular names
patterns.context: Appears in specialized descriptions of cell types, molecules, or biological processes, often adjacent to marker, transcription factor, or growth factor names.

patterns.name: Cytokines and immune-related terminology
patterns.context: Discussions of immune cells, cytokines, disease, or immune function, often accompanied by abbreviations, numbers, and receptor names.

patterns.name: Lists of drug and treatment names
patterns.context: Lists targeted anticancer drugs or chemotherapy regimens; drug names are often complex generic names.
patterns.domain: Cancer treatment-related patents or case reports

patterns.name: Numbered proper names and alphanumeric strings
patterns.context: Antibodies, cell-surface molecules, or factor names in biomedical text; letters and numbers are closely combined.

patterns.name: Angiogenesis-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Explains angiogenesis, endothelial cell proliferation, and formation of tubular structures in tumors or tissues.

patterns.name: Breast surgery and pathological management
patterns.context: Case descriptions of breast lesion diagnosis, surgery, and postoperative treatment.

patterns.name: Transplantation defects and cell culture
patterns.context: Discusses the effects of cytokines on hematopoietic stem cell culture or transplant outcomes.

patterns.name: Glial developmental markers
patterns.context: Discusses different developmental stages of oligodendrocytes and their marker expression.

patterns.name: Antitumor mechanisms and cell death
patterns.context: Describes the tumor microenvironment, apoptosis, or mechanisms of targeted therapy.

10_598.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中的专业实体与术语，尤其是免疫细胞、细胞因子、标记物及字母数字分子名；也覆盖肿瘤治疗、血管生成和临床处置等相关表述。

patterns.name: 生物医学标记与分子名称
patterns.context: 出现在细胞类型、分子或生物过程的专业描述中，常与标记物、转录因子或生长因子名称相邻。

patterns.name: 细胞因子及免疫相关术语
patterns.context: 免疫细胞、细胞因子、疾病或免疫功能的讨论，常伴随缩写、编号及受体名称。
patterns.domain: 免疫学、血液学及肿瘤学

patterns.name: 药物与治疗名称列表
patterns.context: 列举抗癌靶向药或化疗方案，药名常为复杂拼写的药物通用名。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤治疗相关专利或病例报告

patterns.name: 带编号的专名及字母数字串
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中的抗体、细胞表面分子或因子名称；字母与数字组合紧密相连。

patterns.name: 血管生成相关词汇
patterns.context: 解释肿瘤或组织中血管生成、内皮细胞增殖与管状结构形成。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤生物学、血管生物学

patterns.name: 乳腺手术与病理处置
patterns.context: 病例叙述乳腺病灶诊断、手术及术后治疗。

patterns.name: 移植缺陷与细胞培养
patterns.context: 讨论细胞因子对造血干细胞培养或移植结果的影响。

patterns.name: 神经胶质发育标记
patterns.context: 讨论少突胶质细胞不同发育阶段及其标记物表达。

patterns.name: 抗肿瘤机制与细胞死亡
patterns.trigger: “tumor cell apoptosis”、“cancer cells to die naturally”
patterns.context: 描述肿瘤微环境、细胞凋亡或靶向治疗作用机制。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤生物学及专利背景

en.concept: Biomedical cell and tumor immunology terminology
en.description: Activation occurs in biomedical texts dense with cell, immune, and tumor terminology, especially markers, cytokines, T-cell subsets, angiogenesis, and therapies; it also appears in research registration, experimental methods, and neurodevelopment descriptions.

patterns.name: Cell markers and immunophenotyping
patterns.context: Describes cell types, differentiation stages, or immunophenotypes, listing markers, antibodies, or surface molecules

patterns.name: Tumor angiogenesis and therapy
patterns.context: Discusses tumor-associated angiogenesis, mechanisms that promote or inhibit it, and targeted drugs

patterns.name: Cytokines and immune regulation
patterns.context: Mentions cytokines produced by immune or tumor cells and their effects on immune function or the tumor environment

patterns.name: T-cell subsets and immune function
patterns.context: Introduces T-cell subsets, their functions, or features related to immune memory, immunosuppression, and exhaustion

patterns.name: Inhibitory receptors and immune exhaustion
patterns.context: Describes reduced T-cell effector function, impaired cytokine production, and increased expression of inhibitory molecules

patterns.name: Research registration and database collaboration
patterns.context: Provides information on multicenter study registration, database sources, or research collaboration platforms

patterns.name: Cohort studies and experimental treatments
patterns.context: Describes research cohorts, collaborators, or in vitro treatments; the excerpt also mentions the German Cancer Research Center

patterns.name: Nitric oxide-mediated apoptosis
patterns.context: Explains that NO can induce tumor cell apoptosis in the tumor environment

patterns.name: Glial development and progenitor markers
patterns.context: Describes oligodendrocyte developmental stages and expression of neuroepithelial progenitor markers

patterns.name: Targeted drugs for tumor growth signaling
patterns.context: Lists cancer-targeted therapies in patent-background style and distinguishes them from antiangiogenic drugs

10_598.concept: 生物医学细胞与肿瘤免疫术语
10_598.description: 激活见于生物医学文本中密集的细胞、免疫与肿瘤术语，尤其标志物、细胞因子、T细胞亚群、血管生成及治疗；另见研究登记、实验方法和神经发育表述。

patterns.name: 细胞标志物与免疫表型
patterns.context: 描述细胞类型、分化阶段或免疫表型，并列举标志物、抗体或表面分子

patterns.name: 肿瘤血管生成与治疗
patterns.context: 讨论肿瘤相关血管生成、促进或抑制该过程的机制及靶向药物

patterns.name: 细胞因子及免疫调节
patterns.context: 提及免疫细胞或肿瘤细胞产生的细胞因子，以及其对免疫功能或肿瘤环境的影响

patterns.name: T细胞亚群与免疫功能
patterns.context: 介绍T细胞亚群、其功能或与免疫记忆、免疫抑制和耗竭相关的特征

patterns.name: 抑制性受体与免疫耗竭
patterns.context: 描述T细胞效应功能减弱、细胞因子产生受损及抑制分子表达升高

patterns.name: 研究注册与数据库协作
patterns.context: 交代多中心研究登记、数据库来源或科研协作平台

patterns.name: 队列研究与实验处理
patterns.trigger: “cohort of 110 individuals”“in vitro treatment with TCDD”
patterns.context: 描述研究队列、研究协作人员，或体外实验处理；片段中还提及德国癌症研究中心

patterns.name: 硝酸氧化物介导的凋亡
patterns.context: 说明肿瘤环境中NO可诱导肿瘤细胞凋亡

patterns.name: 神经胶质发育与前体标志
patterns.trigger: “oligodendroglia”“different stages of development”“neuroepithelial precursor marker nestin”
patterns.context: 描述少突胶质细胞发育阶段及神经上皮前体标志物表达

patterns.name: 肿瘤生长信号靶向药物
patterns.context: 以专利背景文体列举癌症靶向治疗药物，并与抗血管生成药物区分

en.description: Activations center on biomedical contexts involving VEGF and angiogenesis, stem cells and markers, cytokines, clinical trial registration, and collaborator information in papers; the patterns are not entirely unified thematically.

patterns.name: VEGF/pro-angiogenic terminology
patterns.context: VEGF, pro-angiogenic processes, or their regulatory mechanisms in tumor, growth factor, or treatment research contexts.

patterns.name: Stem cell markers and cell subsets
patterns.context: Describes stem cell phenotypes, markers, or cell subsets, including embryonic, mesenchymal, and cancer stem cells.
patterns.domain: Stem cell and tumor cell research

patterns.name: Stem cell recruitment and repair factors
patterns.context: Stem cell factors used to recruit or activate cells or repair damaged tissue.

patterns.name: Clinical trial and research platform registration information
patterns.context: Reports multicenter registration, trial registration, or clinical research platform information.

patterns.name: Author names and institutional collaborations
patterns.context: Collaborator names, institutions, and descriptions of collaboration appear in the research design background.

patterns.name: Cytokine families and immune sources
patterns.context: Introduces cytokine families and their production by immune or tumor cells.

10_598.description: 激活集中于生物医学语境，涉及VEGF与血管生成、干细胞及标志物、细胞因子、临床试验登记和论文中的合作机构信息；各模式并非完全同一主题。

patterns.name: VEGF/促血管生成相关术语
patterns.context: VEGF、促血管生成或其调控机制出现在肿瘤、生长因子或治疗研究语境中。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤生物学与临床研究

patterns.name: 干细胞标志物及细胞亚群
patterns.trigger: « cell»8« marker»9« S»5SEA；« CD»5«29»、« CD»6«44»；« stem»4« cell»6
patterns.context: 描述干细胞表型、标志物或细胞亚群；包括胚胎、间充质及癌症干细胞。
patterns.domain: 干细胞与肿瘤细胞研究

patterns.name: 干细胞募集及修复因子
patterns.trigger: « stem»2« cells»1；« stem»4« cell»4« recruitment»2« factor»6
patterns.context: 干细胞因子用于募集、激活细胞或修复损伤组织。

patterns.name: 临床试验及研究平台登记信息
patterns.context: 报告多中心登记、试验注册或临床研究平台信息。
patterns.domain: 临床研究与医学数据库

patterns.name: 人名与机构合作署名
patterns.trigger: « University»6« of»4« Main»2«z»3；« German»5« cancer»4« Research»3« center»9
patterns.context: 研究设计背景中出现合作者姓名、机构及协作描述。

patterns.name: 细胞因子家族与免疫来源
patterns.context: 介绍细胞因子家族及其由免疫细胞或肿瘤细胞产生。

en.description: Activates in biomedical texts, especially those concerning tumors and cancer therapy, cell markers, angiogenesis, and immune factors; it also responds to clinical study design and neuroinjury terminology. The excerpts share a biomedical research register, but trigger words span multiple topics.

patterns.name: Cancer biomarkers and cell-surface markers
patterns.context: Activates when describing marker expression, phenotype, or detection results for stem cells, tumor cells, or cell populations; no specific marker is required.
patterns.domain: Biomedical science, stem cell and tumor research

patterns.name: Tumor and cancer therapy terminology
patterns.context: Narratives of cancer biology, tumor treatment, or antitumor effects; often adjacent to molecular mechanisms, drugs, or therapy types.

patterns.name: Angiogenesis and related factors
patterns.context: Discusses angiogenesis, its regulation, or measurement of related factors; includes both promotion and inhibition of angiogenesis.
patterns.domain: Tumor biology, vascular biology, and clinical research

patterns.name: Immune factors, cytokines, and chemokines
patterns.context: Mentions immune signaling molecules or descriptions of their production, expression, or effects; may involve tumors, neuroinjury, or vascular endothelium.

patterns.name: Study design, cohorts, and institutional information
patterns.context: Activates when introducing study participants, registered studies, collaborators, research centers, or project records.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, clinical research, and research project materials

patterns.name: Neuroinjury or neurotoxicity
patterns.context: Contexts involving neuronal death, microglia, or radiation-related neurotoxicity; does not fully overlap with most tumor and angiogenesis excerpts.

10_598.description: 激活于生物医学文本，尤其关注肿瘤与癌症治疗、细胞标记、血管生成及免疫因子；也响应临床研究设计和神经损伤术语。各片段共同呈现医学科研语域，但触发词涉及多类主题。

patterns.name: 癌症生物标志物与细胞表面标记
patterns.context: 在描述干细胞、肿瘤细胞或细胞群的标记表达、表型或检测结果时激活；不要求某一种特定标记。
patterns.domain: 生物医学，干细胞与肿瘤研究

patterns.name: 肿瘤与癌症治疗术语
patterns.context: 癌症生物学、肿瘤治疗或抗肿瘤效应的叙述；常与分子机制、药物或治疗类型相邻。

patterns.name: 血管生成及其因子
patterns.context: 讨论血管生成、其调控或相关因子测量；既包括促进，也包括抑制血管生成。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤生物学、血管生物学及临床研究

patterns.name: 免疫因子、细胞因子与趋化因子
patterns.context: 出现免疫信号分子或其产生、表达、作用的叙述；可能涉及肿瘤、神经损伤或血管内皮。
patterns.domain: 免疫学、炎症及生物医学研究

patterns.name: 研究设计、队列与机构信息
patterns.context: 介绍研究对象、登记研究、合作人员、研究中心或项目记录时激活。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、临床研究与科研项目资料

patterns.name: 神经损伤或神经毒性
patterns.context: 涉及神经元死亡、微胶质细胞或辐射相关神经毒性的语境；与多数肿瘤及血管生成片段不完全重合。

en.concept: Biomedical terminology and cancer research contexts
en.description: Primarily activates on technical terms, abbreviations, and cancer research contexts in biomedical texts, especially stem cell markers, tumor mechanisms, angiogenesis, and clinical project descriptions; brain injury research also appears. One excerpt about a German political figure is not explained by the main pattern.

patterns.name: Biomedical technical terms and abbreviations
patterns.context: Genes, proteins, cell markers, drugs, or research abbreviations in biomedical texts; typically embedded in papers or grant project descriptions. This pattern spans multiple medical topics rather than a single entity class.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, NIH project descriptions, patents

patterns.name: Cancer therapy and tumor biology
patterns.context: Discusses tumor cells, cancer markers, angiogenesis, targeted drugs, or related mechanisms; sometimes associated with breast cancer, brain tumors, or stem cell markers.

patterns.name: Stem cells and cell markers
patterns.context: Describes embryonic or mesenchymal stem cells, cancer stem cell-related markers, and their expression; also includes stem cell factors.

patterns.name: Angiogenesis and its measurement or inhibition
patterns.context: Mentions proangiogenic factors, angiogenesis-related cytokines/proteins, or therapies that inhibit angiogenesis.
patterns.domain: Oncology, radiation injury research, vascular biology

patterns.name: Clinical research and project registration descriptions
patterns.context: Provides project background information, such as study participants, clinical centers, registries, collaboration platforms, or researchers.
patterns.domain: Clinical research and research project descriptions

patterns.name: Brain injury and neurotoxicity
patterns.context: Discusses radiation therapy-related neurotoxicity or repair of chronic brain injury, and may mention angiogenesis or hematopoietic growth factors.

patterns.name: German political figure and regulatory remarks
patterns.context: News or encyclopedic accounts mention a German Member of the European Parliament and quotations about technology, remittances, and regulation; this is unrelated to the medical topics.

10_598.concept: 生物医学术语与癌症研究语境
10_598.description: 主要激活于生物医学文本中的专业名词、缩写及癌症研究语境，尤见干细胞标志物、肿瘤机制、血管生成与临床项目描述；脑损伤研究也有涉及。另有一段德国政治人物文本，无法由主模式解释。

patterns.name: 生物医学专业名词与缩写
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中出现基因、蛋白、细胞标记、药物或研究缩写；通常嵌在论文或资助项目描述中。该模式跨越多种医学主题，并非单一实体类别。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、NIH 项目描述、专利

patterns.name: 癌症治疗与肿瘤生物学
patterns.context: 讨论肿瘤细胞、癌症标志物、血管生成、靶向药或相关机制；有时与乳腺癌、脑肿瘤或干细胞标志物相连。

patterns.name: 干细胞与细胞标志物
patterns.context: 描述胚胎或间充质干细胞、癌症干细胞相关标志物及其表达；也包括干细胞因子。
patterns.domain: 细胞生物学、再生医学、肿瘤学

patterns.name: 血管生成及其测量或抑制
patterns.context: 提及促血管生成因子、血管生成相关细胞因子/蛋白，或抑制血管生成的治疗。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤学、放射损伤研究、血管生物学

patterns.name: 临床研究与项目登记描述
patterns.context: 交代研究对象、临床中心、登记库、协作平台或研究人员等项目背景信息。
patterns.domain: 临床研究与科研项目说明

patterns.name: 脑损伤与神经毒性
patterns.context: 讨论放射治疗相关神经毒性或慢性期脑损伤修复，并可能提及血管生成或造血生长因子。

patterns.name: 德国政治人物与监管言论
patterns.context: 新闻或百科叙述中提到德国欧洲议会议员及其关于技术、汇款和监管的引述；与医学主题无明显联系。

en.description: Strong responses to entity-dense text in specialized biomedical contexts, especially alphanumeric abbreviations, cells/markers, immune and tumor mechanisms, drugs, and research proper names; surrounding general scientific narrative also activates.

patterns.name: Alphanumeric abbreviations and markers in specialized biomedical text
patterns.context: Appears in sentences containing many biomedical entities and proper names, often adjacent to numbers, hyphens, Greek letters, or mixed-case forms; activations may occur on ordinary words before or after entities
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, medical research funding abstracts, and patent background

patterns.name: Angiogenesis and cancer treatment terminology
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of tumor cells, angiogenesis, treatment mechanisms, or inhibition of angiogenesis

patterns.name: Immune cells, immune markers, and immune function
patterns.context: Describes immune cell types, immunophenotypes, markers, or immune function; also includes immune-related molecular names

patterns.name: Stem cells, cancer stem cells, and their markers
patterns.context: Involves stem cell or cancer stem cell phenotypes, markers, or culture/sphere formation
patterns.domain: Stem cell research and tumor biology

patterns.name: Inflammatory factors and signaling pathways
patterns.context: Cytokines, chemokines, and signaling pathways appear in descriptions of inflammation or mechanisms of endothelial adaptation to abnormal conditions

patterns.name: Drug, compound, and targeted therapy names
patterns.context: Proper names of drugs/compounds appearing in study treatment conditions or examples of targeted therapies
patterns.domain: Pharmacology, cancer treatment, and research methods

patterns.name: Proper names of research institutions, cohorts, and clinical registrations
patterns.context: Research sources, collaborators, cohorts, or clinical trial registration information; activations occur on proper names and surrounding administrative/research descriptions
patterns.domain: Research abstracts and clinical research reports

patterns.name: General connective language and scientific narrative
patterns.context: General descriptive or connective phrases in entity-dense specialized text that do not themselves constitute a unified semantic trigger
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, abstracts, and patent prose

10_598.concept: 生物医学实体密集文本
10_598.description: 对生物医学专业语境中的实体密集文本反应明显，尤其是字母数字缩写、细胞/标记物、免疫与肿瘤机制、药物及研究专名；周围普通科学叙述也会激活。

patterns.name: 生物医学专业文本中的字母数字缩写与标记
patterns.trigger: 基因、蛋白、细胞标志物、细胞因子等缩写及其带数字/连字符形式，如“CD29”“VEGF”“PD-1”“Tfh”“NF-κB”“TCDD”“NCT101561144”
patterns.context: 出现在包含大量生物医学实体和专名的句子中，常与数字、连字符、希腊字母或大小写混合形式相邻；激活可落在实体前后的普通词上
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、医学研究资助摘要及专利背景

patterns.name: 血管生成与肿瘤治疗相关术语
patterns.context: 讨论肿瘤细胞、血管生成、治疗机制或抑制血管生成时出现

patterns.name: 免疫细胞、免疫标记与免疫功能
patterns.trigger: “immune cells”“CD4+ T cell”“exhaustion phenotype”“inhibitor molecules”“immunological memory”“Tfh”“B cells”“HLA-ABC”
patterns.context: 描述免疫细胞类型、免疫表型、标记物或免疫功能；也包括免疫相关分子名

patterns.name: 干细胞、肿瘤干细胞及其标志物
patterns.trigger: “embryonic stem cell marker”“mesenchymal stem cell markers”“sphere formation”“CSC-related markers”“CD133”“EpCAM”
patterns.context: 涉及干细胞或肿瘤干细胞表型、标志物及培养/成球现象
patterns.domain: 干细胞研究与肿瘤生物学

patterns.name: 炎症因子与信号通路
patterns.context: 炎症或内皮细胞适应异常的机制叙述中出现细胞因子、趋化因子和信号通路

patterns.name: 药物、化合物与靶向治疗名称
patterns.context: 研究处理条件或靶向治疗举例中出现的药物/化合物专名
patterns.domain: 药理学、肿瘤治疗及研究方法

patterns.name: 研究机构、队列与临床登记专名
patterns.trigger: “University of Mainz”“German cancer Research center”“Spanish centres”“UMBRA study”“NCT101561144”
patterns.context: 研究来源、协作人员、队列或临床试验登记信息；激活落在专名及相关行政/研究描述周围
patterns.domain: 科研摘要与临床研究报告

patterns.name: 普通论述连接语及一般科学叙述
patterns.trigger: “strongly positive for”“correlated with”“Another type of targeted therapy includes”“This database is supported by”
patterns.context: 专业实体密集文本中的一般描述性或连接性短语，本身不构成统一的语义触发条件
patterns.domain: 科学论文、摘要与专利说明文体

en.description: Primarily responds to immune, tumor, and stem cell terminology and marker lists in biomedical papers; also covers related or localized topics such as T-cell function, angiogenesis, brain repair, and research cohorts.

patterns.name: Cell-surface markers and stemness
patterns.context: Describes tumor spheroid formation, stem cell-like properties, or lists embryonic/mesenchymal stem cell and immune markers; markers often appear as CD numbers or abbreviations.
patterns.domain: Tumor biology, stem cells, and cell phenotyping research

patterns.name: Cytokines and immune regulation
patterns.context: Discusses cytokines, their expression, or effects in immune cell, tumor, or hematopoietic stem cell contexts; also includes Treg-mediated suppression of immune effector function.
patterns.domain: Immunology, tumor immunity, and hematopoietic research

patterns.name: Angiogenesis and VEGF
patterns.context: Discusses expression of proangiogenic factors or mechanisms that inhibit HIF/VEGF-related angiogenesis; VEGF appears in narratives describing different directions of effect.

patterns.name: T-cell exhaustion and inhibitory receptors
patterns.context: Describes impaired T-cell function and lists inhibitory molecules or features of an exhaustion phenotype.

patterns.name: Tfh cells and immune memory
patterns.context: Describes Tfh help for B cells and its dependence on transcription factors.

patterns.name: Hematopoietic factors and brain injury repair
patterns.context: Mentions hematopoietic growth factors and stem cell factor in chronic brain injury or stroke repair contexts.
patterns.domain: Neural repair and stem cell research

patterns.name: Cohorts, institutions, and researcher entities
patterns.context: Descriptions of research sample sources, collaborating institutions, and researchers; no clear mechanistic theme shared with the other excerpts.
patterns.domain: Research project or cohort study descriptions

10_598.description: 主要响应生物医学论文中的免疫、肿瘤与干细胞术语及标志物列举；也覆盖 T 细胞功能、血管生成、脑修复和研究队列等相关或局部主题。

patterns.name: 细胞表面标志物与干性
patterns.context: 描述肿瘤细胞球形成、干细胞样特征，或列举胚胎/间充质干细胞及免疫标志物；标志物常以 CD 编号或缩写呈现。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤生物学、干细胞与细胞表型研究

patterns.name: 细胞因子及免疫调节
patterns.context: 免疫细胞、肿瘤或造血干细胞语境中讨论细胞因子、其表达或作用；也包括 Treg 对免疫效应功能的抑制。
patterns.domain: 免疫学、肿瘤免疫与造血研究

patterns.name: 血管生成及 VEGF
patterns.context: 谈论促血管生成因子表达，或抑制 HIF/VEGF 相关血管生成的机制；VEGF 出现在不同作用方向的叙述中。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤生物学、血管生成研究

patterns.name: T 细胞耗竭与抑制受体
patterns.context: 描述 T 细胞功能受损，并列举抑制性分子或耗竭表型特征。

patterns.name: Tfh 细胞与免疫记忆
patterns.context: 介绍 Tfh 对 B 细胞的帮助及其转录因子依赖性。

patterns.name: 造血因子与脑损伤修复
patterns.context: 慢性脑损伤或卒中修复语境中，提及造血生长因子和干细胞因子。
patterns.domain: 神经修复与干细胞研究

patterns.name: 队列、机构与研究人员实体
patterns.trigger: «cohort»；«University of Mainz»；«cancer Research center»；人名«Detlev Jung»、«Johannes Konietzko»
patterns.context: 研究样本来源、合作机构和研究人员的叙述；未见与其他片段共享的明确机制主题。
patterns.domain: 科研项目或队列研究叙述

en.description: Primarily responds to tumor biomedical texts, especially VEGF and angiogenesis; it also covers tumor/stem cell markers, immunosuppression, and clinical trial descriptions. It responds more weakly to research cohort and TCDD experimental descriptions.

patterns.name: VEGF and proangiogenic factors
patterns.context: Discusses tumors, angiogenesis, and related factors, mechanisms, or inhibitory effects; also includes the balance between proangiogenic and antiangiogenic factors.
patterns.domain: Tumor biology, angiogenesis research, and patent background

patterns.name: Tumor stem cells and cell markers
patterns.context: Lists tumor- or stem cell-related markers, or describes their association with expression, cell phenotype, or sphere-forming capacity.
patterns.domain: Cancer stem cell and cell phenotyping research

patterns.name: Immunosuppression and cytokines
patterns.context: Discusses Tregs, the lymphoma microenvironment, and effects of cytokines on immune function.

patterns.name: Clinical trial efficacy figures
patterns.context: Describes clinical benefits of bevacizumab combined with chemotherapy for advanced colorectal cancer.

patterns.name: Cohorts, researchers, and experimental treatments
patterns.context: Introduces cohort sources, collaborators, and experimental treatments; no clear angiogenesis or cell-marker trigger terms are present.
patterns.domain: Research project or epidemiological/experimental study descriptions

10_598.description: 主要响应肿瘤生物医学文本，尤其是VEGF及血管生成；也覆盖肿瘤/干细胞标志物、免疫抑制和临床试验表述。另对研究队列与TCDD实验叙述有较弱响应。

patterns.name: VEGF与促血管生成因子
patterns.trigger: “proangiogenic factor VEGF”“angiogenic factors”“vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF)”
patterns.context: 讨论肿瘤、血管生成及其相关因子、机制或抑制作用；也包括促血管生成与抗血管生成因子的平衡。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤生物学、血管生成研究与专利背景

patterns.name: 肿瘤干细胞与细胞标志物
patterns.trigger: “embryonic stem cell marker”“mesenchymal stem cell markers”“CSC-related markers”“CD133”“CD44”
patterns.context: 列举肿瘤或干细胞相关标志物，或描述其表达与细胞表型、成球能力的关联。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤干细胞与细胞表型研究

patterns.name: 免疫抑制与细胞因子
patterns.trigger: “immune effector function”“Treg biology”“cytokines such as IL10, IL13, and TGF”
patterns.context: 讨论Treg、淋巴瘤微环境及细胞因子对免疫功能的影响。

patterns.name: 临床试验疗效数字
patterns.trigger: “a survival benefit of 4.7 months”“phase III clinical trial”
patterns.context: 描述贝伐珠单抗与化疗联合治疗晚期结直肠癌的临床获益。

patterns.name: 队列、研究人员与实验处理
patterns.trigger: “cohort of 110 individuals”“University of Mainz”“German cancer Research center”“In vitro treatment with TCDD”
patterns.context: 队列研究的来源、合作人员及实验处理介绍；未见明确的血管生成或细胞标志物触发词。
patterns.domain: 研究项目或流行病学/实验研究叙述

en.description: Primarily responds to cytokine, interleukin, cell marker, and growth factor terminology in biomedical texts; it also covers related research on stem cells, tumors, and tissue repair, as well as some clinical statistical expressions.

patterns.name: Cytokines and interleukins
patterns.context: Biomedical contexts related to immunity, tumors, or neuroinflammation; often appears in descriptions of cytokine names, functions, or production.

patterns.name: Cell markers and surface antigens
patterns.context: Describes cell types, phenotypes, or marker expression involving immune cells, stem cells, or tumor cells.

patterns.name: Growth factors and angiogenesis
patterns.context: Describes the effects of factors related to tissue repair, angiogenesis, or tumors; includes factor names and their biological functions.

patterns.name: Biomedical technical terms and molecular abbreviations
patterns.context: Cell, disease, compound, or molecular abbreviations in scientific texts; not necessarily accompanied by a cytokine or marker context.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research plans, papers, and patents

patterns.name: Medical statistics and clinical outcomes
patterns.context: Clinical or epidemiological descriptions involving research cohorts, disease risk, or prognosis.

10_598.concept: 生物医学分子与细胞术语
10_598.description: 主要响应生物医学文本中的细胞因子、白细胞介素、细胞标志物及生长因子术语；也覆盖干细胞、肿瘤、组织修复等相关研究内容，以及少量临床统计表达。

patterns.name: 细胞因子及白细胞介素
patterns.context: 免疫、肿瘤或神经炎症相关生物医学语境；常出现在细胞因子名称、功能或产生的描述中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与研究计划

patterns.name: 细胞标志物与表面抗原
patterns.context: 描述细胞类型、表型或标志物表达，涉及免疫细胞、干细胞或肿瘤细胞。

patterns.name: 生长因子与血管生成
patterns.context: 描述组织修复、血管生成或肿瘤相关因子的作用；包含因子名称及其生物学功能。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究与专利背景

patterns.name: 生物医学专业名词与分子缩写
patterns.context: 科学文本中的细胞、疾病、化合物或分子缩写；不一定伴随细胞因子或标志物语境。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究计划、论文与专利

patterns.name: 医学统计与临床结局
patterns.context: 临床或流行病学描述，涉及研究队列、疾病风险或预后。

en.description: Activations occur mainly in biomedical text: angiogenic factors, cytokines and immune regulation, and stem cell/tumor cell markers and immunophenotypes; immune subtopics such as Treg and Tfh also appear. Some cohort and in vitro treatment contexts are difficult to classify.

patterns.name: Angiogenesis and VEGF factors
patterns.context: Discussions of angiogenesis, endothelial cell proliferation, or related factors; factor names may be split into tokens.
patterns.domain: Tumor biology, angiogenesis research, and related patent background

patterns.name: Cytokines and immune regulation
patterns.context: Cytokines involved in immune effects, lymphoma pathology, or hematopoietic cell culture; often accompanied by specific interleukin names.

patterns.name: Cell surface markers and immunophenotypes
patterns.context: Describes surface markers, marker expression, and immunophenotypes of stem cells or tumor cells; CD markers appear in varying separated forms.
patterns.domain: Stem cell and cell biology research

patterns.name: Stem cell-related phenotypes
patterns.context: Involves stem cell types, culture, or phenotypes; sometimes listed alongside marker detection.

patterns.name: Experimental research and researcher background
patterns.context: Describes research cohorts, collaborators, or in vitro treatments, rather than an explicit cytokine/marker theme.
patterns.domain: Research project abstracts or methods background

patterns.name: Treg and lymphoma
patterns.context: Discusses regulatory T-cell suppression of immune effects and the lymphoma-related immune environment.

patterns.name: Follicular helper T cells
patterns.context: Describes Tfh cell help for B cells and its dependence on transcription factors.

patterns.name: Unclearly classified hematopoietic transplant defects
patterns.context: Aims to identify cytokines that cause engraftment defects; its specific wording has limited connection to other fragments.

10_598.concept: 生物医学细胞与免疫研究
10_598.description: 激活主要见于生物医学文本：血管生成因子、细胞因子与免疫调节，以及干细胞/肿瘤细胞标志物和免疫表型；另见Treg、Tfh等免疫亚主题。个别队列与体外处理背景难以归类。

patterns.name: 血管生成与 VEGF 因子
patterns.context: 血管生成、内皮细胞增殖或相关因子的讨论；因子名可分词出现。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤生物学、血管生成研究及相关专利背景

patterns.name: 细胞因子与免疫调节
patterns.context: 细胞因子参与免疫效应、淋巴瘤病理或造血细胞培养；常伴具体白介素名称。
patterns.domain: 免疫学、淋巴瘤及造血研究

patterns.name: 细胞表面标志物与免疫表型
patterns.context: 描述干细胞或肿瘤细胞的表面标志、标志物表达及免疫表型；CD标志的分隔形式不一。
patterns.domain: 干细胞与细胞生物学研究

patterns.name: 干细胞相关表型
patterns.context: 涉及干细胞类别、培养或其表型；有时与标志物检测并列。

patterns.name: 实验研究与研究人员背景
patterns.context: 描述研究队列、合作人员或体外处理，而非明确的细胞因子/标志物主题。
patterns.domain: 科研项目摘要或方法背景

patterns.name: Treg 与淋巴瘤
patterns.context: 讨论调节性T细胞抑制免疫效应及淋巴瘤相关免疫环境。

patterns.name: 滤泡辅助性T细胞
patterns.context: 说明Tfh细胞对B细胞的帮助及其转录因子依赖。

patterns.name: 未清楚归类的造血移植缺陷
patterns.context: 以识别导致植入缺陷的细胞因子为研究目标；与其他片段的具体表述联系有限。

en.concept: Growth factors and cell markers in biomedicine
en.description: Primarily activates on angiogenesis/VEGF, cytokines and immune signaling, stem cell markers, and growth factors in biomedical texts; brain injury repair and TCDD cohort study background also appear.

patterns.name: Angiogenesis and VEGF-related expression
patterns.context: Descriptions of angiogenesis, tumor vasculature, or expression/measurement of related growth factors; sometimes listed alongside cytokines.
patterns.domain: Tumor biology, angiogenesis research, and patent background

patterns.name: Stem cell markers and phenotypes
patterns.context: Introduces embryonic/mesenchymal/cancer stem cell markers or stem cell-related phenotypes and their changes.
patterns.domain: Cancer stem cell and cell biology research

patterns.name: Cytokines and immune signaling
patterns.context: Lists or discusses cytokines and their effects on immune cells, tumors, or cell function; some excerpts also concern hematopoietic stem cell culture.

patterns.name: Stem cell factor and brain injury repair
patterns.context: Describes combined use of hematopoietic growth factors and stem cell factor in chronic-stage brain injury repair.
patterns.domain: Brain injury repair and regenerative medicine

patterns.name: TCDD treatment and cohort study background
patterns.context: Introduces cohort sources, collaborators, and institutions before shifting to in vitro TCDD treatment; the connection to the biological themes of other excerpts is unclear.

10_598.concept: 生物医学中的生长因子与细胞标志物
10_598.description: 主要激活于生物医学文本中的血管生成/VEGF、细胞因子与免疫信号、干细胞标志物及生长因子；另见脑损伤修复和 TCDD 队列研究背景。

patterns.name: 血管生成及 VEGF 相关表达
patterns.context: 血管生成、肿瘤血管或相关生长因子表达/测量的描述；有时与细胞因子并列。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤生物学、血管生成研究及专利背景

patterns.name: 干细胞标志物与表型
patterns.context: 介绍胚胎/间充质/癌症干细胞标志物，或干细胞相关表型及其变化。
patterns.domain: 肿瘤干细胞与细胞生物学研究

patterns.name: 细胞因子与免疫信号
patterns.context: 列举或讨论细胞因子及其对免疫细胞、肿瘤或细胞功能的作用；部分片段也涉及造血干细胞培养。
patterns.domain: 免疫学、肿瘤学及细胞因子研究

patterns.name: 干细胞因子与脑损伤修复

patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, grant text, and patent background

patterns.name: Immune cells and immune regulation

patterns.name: Stem cells and cell markers

patterns.name: 免疫检查点联合治疗

en.description: Primarily responds to dense lists of immune markers, cytokines, and growth factors in biomedical texts, especially VEGF/FGF-related angiogenesis and tumor mechanisms; it also covers targeted therapy, radiation assessment, and comparisons of clinical measures.

patterns.name: Immune and inflammatory factor markers
patterns.context: Discusses immune cell phenotypes, T-cell exhaustion, cytokines, or inflammatory markers; includes lists of immune markers and factor names

patterns.name: Angiogenesis and related factors

patterns.name: Growth factors and targeted therapy

10_598.concept: 生物医学分子标记与因子

patterns.name: 生长因子与靶向治疗

patterns.name: 医学缩写、标记与枚举

patterns.name: 放射治疗相关神经毒性评估
