patterns.context: 提问者说明操作后得到错误、响应或输出，常用 following/this 引出

patterns.name: 程序输出与请求响应序列
patterns.context: 描述程序运行后的多行输出或请求/响应顺序；不一定包含错误
patterns.domain: StackExchange 并发或网络编程问答

patterns.name: 代码控制流及命令处理
patterns.context: Python 命令分支中处理未知命令并抛出异常

patterns.name: 法律案件当事人与事故事实
patterns.context: 法律意见书列出代理律师、法官，并叙述案件起因与伤情

patterns.name: 代码与日志混排
patterns.context: 代码后接 Android 风格带时间戳、进程号和异常内容的日志
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答及 Android 日志

en.description: Across languages, libraries, and tasks, the neuron primarily responds to phrases reporting execution results or failures in technical contexts, especially “get/receive/getting the error/response/message”; it also responds to the exception name Error.

patterns.name: Error-position markers in error/exception messages
patterns.context: Phrases in technical questions or code snippets describing receiving, seeing, or encountering an error, response, or message after execution; activation often falls on the modifier before the error and on the error name.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, Github code and logs

patterns.name: Error marker in error text
patterns.context: Error appears in exception class names, logs, or error descriptions; segments 1, 2, and 10 contain the word directly, while most others are in error-reporting contexts.
patterns.domain: Programming errors, logs, and Q&A titles/body

patterns.name: MongoDB operation failure reports
patterns.context: Reporting errors after MongoDB/Mongo Atlas connection, upload, or insert operations; activation remains concentrated on reporting phrases such as “getting the following error,” rather than database terminology itself.

patterns.name: Phrases introducing error results in programming Q&A
patterns.context: Code, commands, or operations are described first, followed by the actual error, response, or returned data; includes exceptions, deployment failures, Buffer output, and Selenium errors.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A and Github debugging code

10_979.description: 跨语言、库与任务，神经元主要响应技术上下文中报告执行结果或故障的句式，尤其是“get/receive/getting the error/response/message”；也对异常名 Error 有反应。

patterns.name: 错误/异常消息中的错误位置标记
patterns.context: 技术问题或代码片段中，描述执行后收到、看到或遇到错误、响应、消息的句式；激活常落在错误前的限定词和错误名上。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、Github 代码与日志

patterns.name: 错误文本中的 Error 标记
patterns.context: 异常类名、日志或错误描述中出现 Error；段1、2、10直接包含该词，其他段多是错误报告语境。
patterns.domain: 编程错误、日志及问答标题/正文

patterns.name: MongoDB 操作失败报告
patterns.context: MongoDB/Mongo Atlas 连接、上传或插入操作后报告错误；激活仍集中于“getting the following error”等报告句式，而非数据库术语本身。

patterns.name: 编程问答中的错误结果引出语
patterns.context: 先陈述代码、命令或操作，再引出实际错误、响应或返回数据；包括异常、部署失败、Buffer 输出和 Selenium 报错。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答及 Github 调试代码

en.description: Sensitive to failures and their feedback contexts: technical Q&A often introduces an error, message, or response after an operation fails; code also contains exception throwing, catching, and error/warning response handling.

patterns.name: Reporting errors in questions
patterns.context: Describes an operation or code execution failing, then introduces an error, message, or exception.

patterns.name: Deployment failure feedback
patterns.context: Reports a failure response after running an Azure CLI deployment.

patterns.name: Error-handling code
patterns.context: Code throws or catches an exception, or reads exception information.

patterns.name: Login flow stuck
patterns.context: Describes a problem encountered when redirecting based on user type, without directly providing exception text.

patterns.name: Frontend warning/error dispatch
patterns.context: Frontend code dispatches an error response of warning type.

10_979.description: 对失败及其反馈语境敏感：技术问答常在操作失败后引出 error、message 或 response；代码中也会出现异常抛出、捕获和错误/警告响应处理。

patterns.name: 提问中报告错误
patterns.trigger: “getting the following error”“receive the following message”“receiving the error”“get the error”
patterns.context: 描述操作或代码执行失败，随后引出错误、消息或异常内容

patterns.name: 部署失败反馈
patterns.context: 执行 Azure CLI 部署后报告失败响应

patterns.name: 错误处理代码
patterns.context: 代码中抛出异常、捕获异常或读取异常信息

patterns.name: 登录流程卡住
patterns.context: 描述按用户类型重定向时遇到问题，未直接给出异常文本

patterns.name: 前端警告错误分发
patterns.context: 前端代码分发警告类型的错误响应

en.description: Primarily responds to software-error-related terms, exception types, error messages, and throw code; also covers error counts, SSL error constants, failure-state descriptions, and help-seeking language in technical Q&A. Several segments also activate on ordinary code or contextual words.

patterns.name: Error/exception identifiers and messages
patterns.context: Error-related terms are marked in error types, error text, or exception-handling code; includes both logs/user-reported errors and exception classes and throw statements in code

patterns.name: Descriptions of error consequences or failure states
patterns.context: Describes failure, an unexpected state, or an unsuccessful operation near an error; the trigger seems associated with co-occurrence in error narratives, while these words alone are not a consistent semantic marker
patterns.domain: Software troubleshooting Q&A and error messages

patterns.name: Program control flow and command handling
patterns.context: Fallback path in a command branch: calls usage and then throws an unknown-command error

patterns.name: Exception class declarations and inheritance
patterns.context: Consecutively defines exception classes, some inheriting from PipelineException

patterns.name: Error-count label
patterns.context: Field representing the number of errors in a JSON/configuration-style key-value table

patterns.name: SSL error constants
patterns.context: TLS/SSL error-code strings quoted in Q&A titles or body

patterns.name: Error-related help-seeking language in Q&A
patterns.context: The asker describes encountering an error, a feature failing, or requests diagnosis; sometimes occurs alongside specific error terms

patterns.name: Generalized request/transport failure text
patterns.context: Complete natural-language error messages in an error field, describing a failed request or connection

10_979.description: 主要响应软件错误相关词及异常类型、错误消息和抛出代码；也覆盖错误计数、SSL错误常量、失败状态描述与技术问答中的求助措辞。多个片段兼有普通代码或上下文词激活。

patterns.name: 错误/异常标识与消息
patterns.trigger: “Error”“error”“Exception”“ERROR”，以及 “IOError”“RuntimeError”“NotFound”；常与“getting/receiving the error”“raise”或异常消息相邻
patterns.context: 错误类型、报错文本或异常处理代码中的错误相关词被标记；既包括日志/用户报错，也包括代码中的异常类与抛出语句
patterns.domain: 软件开发问答、日志、代码

patterns.name: 错误后果或失败状态的描述
patterns.context: 报错附近描述失败、意外状态或操作未成功；触发更像与错误叙述共现，单独这些词并非统一语义标记
patterns.domain: 软件故障排查问答与错误消息

patterns.name: 程序控制流与命令处理
patterns.context: 命令分支中的兜底路径：调用 usage 后抛出未知命令错误

patterns.name: 异常类声明与继承
patterns.context: 连续定义异常类，部分异常类继承自 PipelineException

patterns.name: 错误计数标签
patterns.context: JSON/配置式键值表中表示错误数量的字段

patterns.name: SSL 错误常量
patterns.context: 问答标题或正文中引用 TLS/SSL 错误代码字符串

patterns.name: 问答中的错误求助措辞
patterns.trigger: “I’m getting”“Could you please tell me what mistake”“not able to”
patterns.context: 提问者描述遇到错误、功能失败或请求诊断；有时与具体错误词共同出现

patterns.name: 一般化的请求/传输故障文本
patterns.trigger: “An error occurred while sending the request”“underlying connection was closed”
patterns.context: 错误字段中的完整自然语言错误消息，说明请求发送或连接失败

en.description: Responds to errors, exceptions, and failure information: including error reports and logs, exception catching/throwing and wrapping, error fields or handler names, and specific messages about import, upload, or SMTP connection failures.

patterns.name: Error and exception phrasing
patterns.context: Triggered in error reports, logs, exception-handling code, or Q&A when describing failure, catching an exception, or constructing an exception message.

patterns.name: Exception throwing and message wrapping
patterns.context: Code converts, wraps, and rethrows an existing exception or assertion failure; also includes throwing a runtime error for an unknown command.
patterns.domain: Java, Python, Kotlin, and other code

patterns.name: Logging or console-recorded errors
patterns.context: An error is output as a log or console message, often with an explanation of an operation, request, or connection failure.
patterns.domain: Application logs, command-line output, and email error messages

patterns.name: Error-related identifiers and fields
patterns.context: The word error appears in a configuration key, UI label, or handler name, rather than directly indicating a thrown exception.
patterns.domain: Configuration, metric labels, and code identifiers

patterns.name: Q&A about import or upload errors
patterns.context: The asker describes an actual import or upload problem and quotes failure information or requests help.

patterns.name: SMTP connection failure messages
patterns.context: An SMTP command or connection fails during email sending; the error message is repeated in diagnostic text.

10_979.description: 对错误、异常及失败信息有反应：包括错误报告和日志、异常捕获/抛出与包装、错误字段或处理器名称，以及导入、上传、SMTP 连接故障等具体消息。

patterns.name: 错误与异常表述
patterns.context: 错误报告、日志、异常处理代码或问答中，描述失败、捕获异常或构造异常消息时触发。

patterns.name: 异常抛出及消息包装
patterns.context: 代码把已有异常或断言失败转换、包装并重新抛出；也包括根据未知命令抛出运行时错误。

patterns.name: 日志或控制台记录错误
patterns.trigger: “console.error(error)”“LOG.error('Exception in HTTP request handler: …')”“ERROR”“Error: Could not connect”
patterns.context: 错误作为日志或控制台输出，常附带操作、请求或连接失败的说明。
patterns.domain: 应用日志、命令行输出及邮件错误信息

patterns.name: 错误相关标识符与字段
patterns.context: 错误一词出现在配置键、界面标签或处理器名称中，而非直接抛出异常。
patterns.domain: 配置、指标标签与代码标识符

patterns.name: 错误导入或上传故障问答
patterns.trigger: “Could not import views.ganttapp. Error was: No module named json”“Not able to upload JSON”“getting the following error”
patterns.context: 提问者描述实际遇到的导入或上传问题，并引用失败信息或请求帮助。

patterns.name: SMTP 连接失败消息
patterns.trigger: “SMTP ERROR: QUIT command failed”“Could not connect to SMTP host”“Mailer Error”
patterns.context: 邮件发送时 SMTP 命令或连接失败，错误信息重复出现在诊断文本中。

en.description: Primarily responds to software-error and exception-related text: the word error, error reports, exception types, and throw statements; also covers error-count labels, missing resources, network send failures, invalid lengths, and expressions introducing errors in questions.

patterns.name: Error and exception reports
patterns.context: Reports program failure in a question, log, or code; often adjacent to getting, raise, throwing, unexpected, or Invalid.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, software logs, and error-handling code

patterns.name: Exception types and throwing
patterns.context: Code explicitly throws an exception, or the context gives a framework/language exception class name; activation also covers Error within exception names.
patterns.domain: Python, Django, and other code and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Error counts and status fields
patterns.context: Metric or label fields in configuration or serialized data; may not describe a specific failure.
patterns.domain: JSON/configuration mappings or monitoring fields in code

patterns.name: Missing files or paths
patterns.context: Error-handling logic checks whether a file, path, or resource exists and reports an error if expectations are not met.

patterns.name: Connection and send failures in error messages
patterns.context: Log/response strings describe a connection interruption or send failure while sending a request.

patterns.name: Invalid length in error messages
patterns.context: A decryption operation fails after page navigation, and the error is quoted as a problem encountered by the user.

patterns.name: Lead-in to an error question
patterns.context: First-person problem descriptions introduce a subsequent exception or error message.

10_979.description: 主要响应软件错误及异常相关文本：错误一词、错误报告、异常类型与抛出语句；也覆盖错误计数标签、资源不存在、网络发送失败、无效长度等具体消息，以及提问中引出错误的表达。

patterns.name: 错误与异常报告
patterns.trigger: “error”/“Error”及其附近的错误描述，如 “The error I'm getting is this”, “getting ... error”, “throwing Error like”
patterns.context: 在提问、日志或代码中报告程序失败；常与 getting、raise、throwing、unexpected、Invalid 等词相邻。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答及软件日志、错误处理代码

patterns.name: 异常类型与抛出
patterns.context: 代码中显式抛出异常，或上下文给出框架/语言的异常类名；激活也覆盖异常名内部的 Error。
patterns.domain: Python、Django 等代码及技术问答

patterns.name: 错误计数与状态字段
patterns.context: 配置或序列化数据中的指标、标签字段，不一定是在描述一次具体故障。
patterns.domain: 代码中的 JSON/配置映射或监控字段

patterns.name: 文件或路径不存在
patterns.trigger: “does not exist”, “does not exist” error, “expected does not exist error”
patterns.context: 错误处理逻辑检查文件、路径或资源是否存在，并在不符合预期时报告错误。
patterns.domain: Go 测试或文件系统相关代码

patterns.name: 错误消息中的连接、发送故障
patterns.trigger: “An error occurred while sending the request”, “connection was closed”, “unexpected error occurred”
patterns.context: 日志/响应字符串描述请求发送期间连接中断或发送失败。

patterns.name: 错误消息中的无效长度
patterns.context: 页面跳转后解密操作失败，错误被作为用户遇到的问题引用。

patterns.name: 错误提问引导语
patterns.context: 第一人称问题描述中引出后续异常或错误信息。

en.description: Primarily responds to error/exception terms such as error, Error, and Exception in software development contexts and their reporting contexts; also responds to Error in exception class names and error-count fields. The specific problem domains vary, and another segment contains an exception class name used only as an identifier in an import.

patterns.name: Error and exception reports
patterns.context: Descriptions involving an error occurring, an exception being thrown, or an error message being reported; often followed by the cause, exception type, or error details.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, code, and runtime logs

patterns.name: Error in exception type names
patterns.context: Exception class names in code imports, exception construction, or stack traces; activates even outside natural-language error reports.

patterns.name: Error-count label
patterns.context: A label in a structured key-value pair or metric field indicating the number of errors.
patterns.domain: JSON/configuration in code or monitoring metrics

patterns.name: Local terminology in error reports
patterns.context: Errors may concern JSON uploads, encryption/decryption redirects, schema inference, Android startup, or database queries; the specific technical causes differ.
patterns.domain: Various software development Q&A and runtime logs

patterns.name: Exception class import outside an error context
patterns.context: Appears as an identifier in an import statement, not as a description of a failure.

10_979.description: 主要响应软件开发语境中 error、Error、Exception 等错误/异常词及其报错上下文；也响应异常类名中的 Error 和错误计数字段。具体问题领域多样，另有代码导入中仅作为标识符出现的异常类名。

patterns.name: 错误及异常报告
patterns.context: 围绕出现错误、抛出异常或报告错误消息的描述；常紧接错误原因、异常类型或报错内容。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、代码与运行日志

patterns.name: 异常类型名称中的 Error
patterns.context: 代码导入、构造异常或堆栈中的异常类名；即使不在自然语言报错叙述中也会激活。

patterns.name: 错误计数标签
patterns.context: 结构化键值或指标字段中，表示错误数量的标签。
patterns.domain: 代码中的 JSON/配置或监控指标

patterns.name: 错误报告中的局部术语
patterns.context: 错误可能与上传 JSON、加解密重定向、schema 推断、Android 启动或数据库查询有关；具体技术原因彼此不同。
patterns.domain: 多种软件开发问答与运行时日志

patterns.name: 非错误语境的异常类导入
patterns.context: 作为导入语句中的标识符出现，并非正在描述一次故障。

en.description: Primarily responds to Python exceptions and error reports: exception classes, raise statements, error messages, tracebacks, and askers’ error narratives; it can also respond to an Error Count field in configuration. Triggers occur in both code and natural language.

patterns.name: Python exceptions and errors
patterns.context: Exceptions raised in Python code, or error messages and traceback text; especially Error in exception class names and its prefixes.
patterns.domain: Python programming, debugging, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Exception names and error-prompt text
patterns.context: An exception class name followed by a parenthesized message, or natural-language descriptions of encountering an error; no specific error type is required.
patterns.domain: Code error handling and StackExchange question descriptions

patterns.name: Error-count and logging fields
patterns.context: Error in a configuration or data structure denotes an error-related metric and combines with Count to form a field name or label.
patterns.domain: Github code, configuration, or metric naming

patterns.name: Exception traceback format
patterns.context: Fixed-format text, file paths, and line numbers in a Python traceback, usually followed by an exception and error message.

patterns.name: Natural-language narratives related to errors
patterns.context: The asker uses first person to say they encountered an error, or introduces subsequent error content; activation falls on narrative words and the word error.

10_979.description: 主要响应 Python 异常及错误报告：异常类、raise 语句、错误消息、traceback 和提问者的报错叙述；也可响应配置中的 Error Count 字段。触发形式跨代码与自然语言。

patterns.name: Python 异常与报错
patterns.context: Python 代码中抛出异常，或错误信息、回溯文本；尤其是异常类名中的 Error 及其前缀。
patterns.domain: Python 编程、调试与技术问答

patterns.name: 异常名与错误提示文本
patterns.context: 异常类名后跟括号中的消息，或自然语言中描述遇到的 error；不要求特定错误种类。
patterns.domain: 代码错误处理与 StackExchange 问题描述

patterns.name: 错误计数与日志字段
patterns.context: 配置或数据结构中以 Error 表示错误相关指标、并与 Count 组合成字段名或标签。
patterns.domain: Github 代码、配置或指标命名

patterns.name: 异常回溯格式
patterns.context: Python traceback 中的固定格式、文件路径与行号，通常随后出现异常及报错消息。

patterns.name: 错误相关的自然语言叙述
patterns.trigger: «The» « error»7 « I»7«'m»9« getting»6、«getting»9« the»7« following»9« error»6
patterns.context: 提问者用第一人称说明遇到错误，或引出后续错误内容；激活落在叙述词及错误一词上。

en.description: Primarily responds to programming errors and exception text, especially ValueError, RuntimeError, and code that raises them; also responds to failed requests, error reports, and help-seeking language. The language and error types vary across segments.

patterns.name: Python ValueError exceptions
patterns.context: ValueError appears in a traceback or error output; causes include failed int conversion, mismatched key-value lengths, and import problems.
patterns.domain: Python programming Q&A, code, and tracebacks

patterns.name: RuntimeError exceptions
patterns.context: Code raises RuntimeError, followed by an explanation of an unknown command or out-of-range error.

patterns.name: error and getting in error reports
patterns.context: The asker describes an error they are encountering or requests troubleshooting; no fixed exception name is required.

patterns.name: Network request connection exception text
patterns.context: An HTTP request fails to send; exception or serialized error messages repeatedly describe the underlying connection being closed.
patterns.domain: .NET/HTTP technical Q&A and JSON error fields

patterns.name: Explicitly raised exceptions in code
patterns.context: The program constructs and raises an exception under an error condition, possibly in a command-handling branch or parameter validation.

patterns.name: Help-seeking language in error questions
patterns.context: After describing an error or exception, the asker asks for the problem in the code to be identified.

patterns.name: Exception classes or error identifiers
patterns.context: An exception class name appears in error text; the instances are not all from the same language or exception type.

10_979.description: 主要响应编程错误与异常文本，尤其是 ValueError、RuntimeError 及其抛出代码；也响应请求失败、错误报告和求助措辞。各段语言、错误类型并不完全一致。

patterns.name: Python ValueError 异常
patterns.context: 异常回溯或错误输出中出现 ValueError；包括 int 转换失败、键值长度不匹配、导入问题等不同成因。
patterns.domain: Python 编程问答、代码与 traceback

patterns.name: RuntimeError 异常
patterns.context: 代码中抛出 RuntimeError，后面跟未知命令或越界等错误说明。

patterns.name: 错误报告中的 error 与 getting
patterns.context: 提问者描述正在遇到的错误或请求排查；不要求异常名称固定。

patterns.name: 网络请求连接异常文本
patterns.context: HTTP 请求发送失败，异常或序列化错误信息重复描述底层连接关闭。
patterns.domain: .NET/HTTP 技术问答及 JSON 错误字段

patterns.name: 代码主动抛出异常
patterns.context: 程序在错误条件下主动构造并抛出异常；可能位于命令处理分支或参数校验中。

patterns.name: 报错提问中的请求帮助措辞
patterns.context: 错误或异常背景之后，提问者请求指出代码中的问题。

patterns.name: 异常类或错误标识符
patterns.context: 异常类名出现在报错文本中；不都属于同一种语言或异常。

en.description: All snippets contain error/Error/Exception-related terms, covering error descriptions, exception text and handling code, error counts, and callback parameters; JSON, MongoDB, and network errors are specific contexts.

patterns.name: error/error object in error contexts
patterns.context: The word error appears in Q&A error descriptions, exception types, or code comments; sometimes accompanied by specific error text.

patterns.name: Connection/send failure error text
patterns.context: An exception message for a failed request send, appearing in explanations of reproducing an error or exception types.

patterns.name: JSON-related errors and exception handling
patterns.context: Discusses errors when uploading, parsing, or writing JSON, or catches and logs JSON exceptions in code.
patterns.domain: StackExchange/Github, software development Q&A and code

patterns.name: MongoDB query or upload errors
patterns.context: An error occurs during a MongoDB upload or query operation; segment 9 gives a specific query selector error.

patterns.name: Error-count field
patterns.context: An error count appears as a statistics field in JSON-style key-value data.

patterns.name: Placeholder parameter in a program error callback
patterns.context: An asynchronous JavaScript callback parameter is named error and mentioned in a comment in the function body; no specific error message is given.

10_979.description: 所有片段都含 error/Error/Exception 相关词，涵盖报错描述、异常文本与处理代码、错误计数及回调参数；JSON、MongoDB和网络错误是具体语境。

patterns.name: 错误上下文中的 error/error 错误对象
patterns.trigger: «error»、«Error»、«Exception»；包括 «getting the following error»、«receive the following message»、«error» 注释
patterns.context: 错误词出现在问答中的报错描述、异常类型或代码注释里；有时伴随具体错误文本。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、Github 代码

patterns.name: 连接发送失败错误文本
patterns.trigger: «The underlying connection was closed: An unexpected error occurred on a send»
patterns.context: 作为请求发送失败的异常消息，出现在对错误复现或异常类型的说明中。

patterns.name: JSON 相关错误与异常处理
patterns.context: 讨论 JSON 上传、解析或写入时的报错，或在代码中捕获并记录 JSON 异常。

patterns.name: MongoDB 查询或上传报错
patterns.context: MongoDB 上传或查询操作导致错误；第9段给出具体查询选择器错误。

patterns.name: 错误计数字段
patterns.context: JSON 风格的键值数据中，错误计数作为统计字段出现。

patterns.name: 程序错误回调中的占位参数
patterns.context: 异步 JavaScript 回调参数命名为 error，并在函数体中以注释提及；没有具体报错信息。

en.description: Primarily responds to error, Exception, and error descriptions in software contexts, especially failures involving network requests, JSON, unfitted models, scope, and file uploads; also responds to error-code handling and exception-catching code. The names of parties in legal case titles cannot be explained by this.

patterns.name: Exception and error information
patterns.context: In error reports, logs, exception-handling code, or debugging Q&A; error terms and nearby content show the strongest activation.
patterns.domain: Software development Q&A, code, and logs

patterns.name: Connection request failure descriptions
patterns.context: In exception text describing failed HTTP requests or connections, activation is concentrated around error and the error description.

patterns.name: Account operation and service response error codes
patterns.context: Comments and constant names describe account-operation requirements and server-side error codes.

patterns.name: Instruction scope access errors
patterns.context: AngularJS directive link functions fail to access a parent-scope variable, as described in Q&A titles and explanations.

patterns.name: JSON write exception logs
patterns.context: Exception-catching and logging code for writing to a JSON object.

patterns.name: Names of parties in legal cases
patterns.context: Case-title sections in court memorandum opinions; no clear error or exception context.

patterns.name: Unfitted model exception
patterns.context: A machine-learning Q&A describes an error caused by an unfitted OneHotEncoder.

patterns.name: File-upload error-code handling
patterns.context: PHP code returns corresponding error messages based on upload error codes.

patterns.name: Input/output exception handling
patterns.context: Java code catches IOException and prints the error to standard output.

10_979.description: 主要响应软件语境中的 error、Exception 及错误描述，尤其是网络请求、JSON、模型未拟合、作用域和文件上传故障；也响应错误码处理与异常捕获代码。法律案件标题中的人名激活无法由此解释。

patterns.name: 异常与错误信息
patterns.context: 错误报告、日志、异常处理代码或调试问答中；错误词及其附近内容激活最明显。
patterns.domain: 软件开发问答、代码与日志

patterns.name: 连接请求失败描述
patterns.trigger: “The underlying connection was closed” “An unexpected error occurred” “error occurred while sending the request”
patterns.context: HTTP 请求或连接发送失败的异常文本中，激活集中在 error 及错误描述附近。

patterns.name: 账户操作与服务响应错误码
patterns.trigger: “Account Action is required” “ErrCode” “Bad Request Exception” “service response error code”
patterns.context: 以注释和常量名说明账户操作要求及服务端错误码。

patterns.name: 指令作用域访问错误
patterns.context: AngularJS 指令 link 函数访问父作用域变量失败的问答标题和说明。

patterns.name: JSON 写入异常日志
patterns.trigger: “catch (JSON Exception e)” “LOG.error” “Exception while put to json”
patterns.context: JSON 对象写入操作的异常捕获与日志记录代码。

patterns.name: 法律案件当事人姓名
patterns.context: 法院备忘录意见的案件标题部分；无明显错误或异常语境。

patterns.name: 模型未拟合异常
patterns.context: 机器学习问答中描述 OneHotEncoder 未拟合而报错。

patterns.name: 文件上传错误码处理
patterns.context: PHP 代码按上传错误码返回对应错误消息。

patterns.name: 输入输出异常处理
patterns.context: Java 代码捕获 IOException 并将错误打印到标准输出。

en.concept: Errors/exceptions and problem narratives (also legal documents)
en.description: Most segments concern programming errors, exceptions, or data reading/writing, often alongside help-seeking questions; others contain legal decision titles, criminal charges, and accounts of accident facts, with no clear common trigger word.

patterns.name: Exceptions, errors, and exception handling
patterns.context: Mentions runtime exceptions, error messages, or requests help diagnosing errors; includes code that catches and logs exceptions, as well as exception class names and error codes.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, code, and technical documentation

patterns.name: JSON and data reading/writing
patterns.context: Data serialization, import, copying, or writing; some segments also contain error descriptions.

patterns.name: Help-seeking problem descriptions
patterns.context: The asker describes an operation and the problem encountered, often followed by an error or exception.

patterns.name: Legal decisions, litigation, and court-document format
patterns.context: Procedures and legal facts in judicial documents, such as court titles, appeals, or criminal charges.

patterns.name: Injury incidents in accounts of legal facts
patterns.context: Describes how an accident occurred and related expenses, liability, or insurance matters.

patterns.name: Anomalous technical segment: empty-list cache
patterns.context: After code, describes a service returning an empty cache list and asks why; contains no clear exception or error message.

10_979.concept: 错误/异常及问题叙述（另有法律文书）
10_979.description: 多数片段谈编程错误、异常或数据读写，常伴随求助式问题；另有法律判决标题、刑事指控及事故事实叙述，未见共同的明显触发词。

patterns.name: 异常、错误及异常处理
patterns.context: 提及运行时异常、错误信息或请求帮助诊断错误；包括代码中捕获并记录异常，以及异常类名、错误码。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、代码与技术文档

patterns.name: JSON 与数据读写
patterns.trigger: “json.put(key, value)”, “No module named json”, “upload JSON file”, “Copy mdf file and use it in run time”, “Insert data”
patterns.context: 数据序列化、导入、复制或写入场景；其中部分片段同时含错误描述。

patterns.name: 求助式问题描述
patterns.trigger: “I am getting … Could you please tell me what mistake I am doing here”, “I’m trying to … but getting …”
patterns.context: 提问者描述操作及遇到的问题，常以错误或异常作后续说明。

patterns.name: 法律判决、诉讼与裁判文书格式
patterns.trigger: “STATE”, “FROM THE 396TH DISTRICT COURT”, “MEMORANDUM OPINION”, “conviction”, “indictment”, “in violation of”
patterns.context: 法院标题、上诉或刑事指控等司法文书中的程序与法律事实叙述。

patterns.name: 法律事实叙述中的受伤事件
patterns.context: 叙述事故发生经过及相关费用、责任或保险事项。

patterns.name: 异常的技术片段：空列表缓存
patterns.context: 代码之后描述服务返回空缓存列表并询问原因；没有明确异常或错误消息。

en.description: The neuron primarily responds to errors and their reporting, exception diagnosis, and handling contexts: including user-reported errors, exception information in logs, error-handling code, and explicit error types.

patterns.name: Error reports and help requests
patterns.context: Describes encountering an error, often with error text, installation logs, or a user question; no specific error type is required.

patterns.name: Exception and error diagnostic text
patterns.context: Describes runtime failures using an exception class name or natural language, especially network connection and request-send failures.
patterns.domain: Code logs, API/network failure descriptions, JSON error data

patterns.name: Error-handling code or error callbacks
patterns.context: Code declares an error-display method or registers a failure callback and logs an error; successful callback code may also be nearby.
patterns.domain: Java, JavaScript application code, and file operations

patterns.name: Explicit ERROR/MethodError diagnostics
patterns.context: Uses an uppercase ERROR marker and gives a specific method-matching failure diagnosis.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, program error output

10_979.description: 神经元主要响应错误及其报告、异常诊断和处理语境：包括用户描述错误、日志中的异常信息、错误处理代码和明确的错误类型。

patterns.name: 错误报告与求助
patterns.trigger: “The error I'm getting is this”, “ERROR: Error running”, “getting the following error”, “This is the error I am getting”
patterns.context: 描述遇到的错误，常附错误文本、安装日志或用户问题；不要求特定错误类型。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问答、软件安装问题

patterns.name: 异常及错误诊断文本
patterns.trigger: “Exception while”, “throws the same exceptions”, “WebException”, “IOException”, “An error occurred”
patterns.context: 以异常类名或自然语言描述运行时故障，尤其是网络连接和请求发送失败。
patterns.domain: 代码日志、API/网络故障说明、JSON 错误数据

patterns.name: 代码中的错误处理或错误回调
patterns.context: 代码声明错误展示方法，或注册失败回调并记录错误；其中也可能邻近成功回调代码。
patterns.domain: Java、JavaScript 应用代码与文件操作

patterns.name: 显式 ERROR/MethodError 诊断
patterns.context: 以大写 ERROR 标记并给出具体方法匹配失败诊断。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、程序错误输出

en.description: Strongly responds to errors, exceptions, and failure reports in programming contexts, especially error text and help-seeking phrases such as “getting/doing wrong”; also covers specific JSON, MongoDB, network, Python/Spark errors, plus some error-handling code and error-localization prompts.

patterns.name: Error and exception reports
patterns.context: Error-related terms appear in exception class names, error messages, or user descriptions, often with phrases such as getting, throws, following.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, debugging logs, and code

patterns.name: Requesting help and describing failures
patterns.context: The questioner describes a problem or requests help locating an error, usually next to error information or a code snippet.

patterns.name: JSON operations and their errors
patterns.context: JSON is written, uploaded, or imported as a module; includes Java logs, MongoDB issues, and Django import errors.

patterns.name: MongoDB query or upload errors
patterns.context: Concerns uploading JSON to MongoDB or running queries, with errors reported.

patterns.name: Specific runtime exception stack trace
patterns.context: A TypeError traceback follows Python/Spark data-transformation code.

patterns.name: Network connection exception
patterns.context: Describes a connection closing and a send error during an HTTP request or response-stream read.

patterns.name: Application UI error-handling code
patterns.context: A Java/Android class defines a method to display an error message, with a nearby ToastUtils call.

patterns.name: Database field and error-domain information
patterns.context: Code involves a place_type field, followed by a user update and error-domain text; distinct from the specific problems in other error-report passages.

patterns.name: Code example and error-localization prompt
patterns.context: Asks someone to inspect code or a program; the snippet contains garbled and hash-like text but presents no clear error type.

10_979.description: 强烈响应编程语境中的错误、异常及故障报告，尤其是报错文本与“getting/doing wrong”等求助表述；也覆盖 JSON、MongoDB、网络、Python/Spark 等具体错误，以及少量错误处理代码和错误定位提示。

patterns.name: 错误与异常报告
patterns.context: 错误相关词出现在异常类名、报错消息或用户说明中，常伴随 getting、throws、following 等表述。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、调试日志与代码

patterns.name: 求助与描述故障
patterns.trigger: «I» am «getting»、«I»'m «getting»、«Could» you please tell me、«Can» you spot
patterns.context: 提问者说明遇到的问题或请求定位错误，通常紧邻错误信息或代码片段。

patterns.name: JSON 操作及其错误
patterns.context: JSON 被写入、上传或作为模块导入时出现；包括 Java 日志、MongoDB 问题及 Django 导入错误。

patterns.name: MongoDB 查询或上传错误
patterns.context: 围绕 MongoDB 上传 JSON 或执行查询，并报告错误。

patterns.name: 特定运行时异常堆栈
patterns.context: Python/Spark 数据转换代码后接 TypeError traceback。

patterns.name: 网络连接异常
patterns.context: HTTP 请求或读取响应流时，描述连接关闭及发送错误。

patterns.name: 应用界面错误处理代码
patterns.context: Java/Android 类中定义显示错误消息的方法，附近有 ToastUtils 调用。

patterns.name: 数据库字段与错误域信息
patterns.context: 代码涉及 place_type 字段，后接用户更新说明和错误域文本；与其他报错段的具体问题不同。

patterns.name: 代码示例与错误定位提示
patterns.context: 请求检查代码或程序，片段中含乱码及哈希状文本，但未呈现明确错误类型。

en.description: Primarily responds to program errors and exception contexts: error prompts, Tracebacks, exception catching/logging, and askers describing errors or unexpected results; also covers local contexts involving JSON, syntax errors, empty caches, and specific Python operations.

patterns.name: Error or exception information
patterns.context: In error descriptions such as “the error I’m getting” and “getting the following error,” or in logs/exception text

patterns.name: Traceback opening
patterns.context: Before the body of a traceback in Python interactive output

patterns.name: getting introducing a problem
patterns.context: The asker describes an error, exceptional result, or unexpected state they encountered

patterns.name: JSON-related operations
patterns.context: Involves uploading JSON, writing key-value pairs to JSON, or failed JSON import
patterns.domain: Databases, Java programs, and Django errors

patterns.name: exception in exception-handling code
patterns.context: Code catches an exception and logs or describes the operation during which it occurred

patterns.name: Colon and quoted content in error prompts
patterns.context: A colon connects an error label to a specific explanation or error details

patterns.name: SyntaxError report
patterns.context: A JavaScript syntax error occurs after a webpage button triggers a data operation

patterns.name: Question about an empty cache
patterns.context: The asker asks about an unexpected empty list returned by a service

patterns.name: Traceback after IMAP authentication
patterns.context: An exception traceback is output after Gmail IMAP authentication in Python
patterns.domain: Email protocols and Python technical Q&A

patterns.name: Traceback after repeat call
patterns.context: A traceback appears after calling repeat in a Python interactive environment

10_979.description: 主要响应程序错误及异常语境：error 提示、Traceback、异常捕获/日志，以及提问者描述遇错或意外结果；也覆盖 JSON、语法错误、空缓存和具体 Python 操作等局部语境。

patterns.name: 错误或异常信息
patterns.context: 在“the error I’m getting”“getting the following error”等报错说明中，或出现在日志/异常文本里

patterns.name: 异常回溯开头
patterns.context: Python 交互式输出中，错误回溯正文之前

patterns.name: getting 引出问题
patterns.context: 提问者描述自己遇到的错误、异常结果或意外状态

patterns.name: JSON 相关操作
patterns.context: 涉及上传 JSON、将键值写入 JSON，或 JSON 导入失败
patterns.domain: 数据库、Java 程序及 Django 报错

patterns.name: 异常处理代码中的 exception
patterns.context: 代码捕获异常，并记录或描述异常发生时的操作

patterns.name: 错误提示中的冒号及引述内容
patterns.trigger: error: input module is broken；Error Domain=；Could not import views: Error was
patterns.context: 冒号连接错误标签与具体说明或错误详情

patterns.name: SyntaxError 报告
patterns.trigger: Uncaught SyntaxError: missing ) after argument list
patterns.context: 网页按钮触发数据操作后出现 JavaScript 语法错误

patterns.name: 缓存为空的提问
patterns.context: 提问者询问服务中得到意外的空列表

patterns.name: IMAP 认证后的回溯
patterns.context: Python 中进行 Gmail IMAP 认证后输出异常回溯
patterns.domain: 邮件协议与 Python 技术问答

patterns.name: repeat 调用后的回溯
patterns.context: Python 交互式环境中调用 repeat 后出现回溯

en.concept: Errors and debugging in technical Q&A
en.description: Primarily responds to error, exception, or unexpected-result explanations following code in technical Q&A; also responds to Traceback, JSON code, and help-seeking openings. One passage of legal charges does not fit these patterns.

patterns.name: Narrative requesting help with an error
patterns.context: The problem description gives code or an operation, then explains the current error, exception, or unexpected result; activation covers question and error-introducing sentences, not only specific error text.

patterns.name: Traceback error output
patterns.context: A Python interactive output starts displaying an exception traceback after a failed call; activation concentrates on Traceback and nearby content.

patterns.name: JSON-related code or question
patterns.context: JSON is the subject of a code operation, data communication, or parsing problem; JSON alone can also activate, but is usually adjacent to a failure description.

patterns.name: Java exception logs
patterns.context: Java-style exception catching and logging, emphasizing exception information from a failed JSON write.

patterns.name: List of charges in a legal indictment
patterns.context: Criminal charges and statutory bases are listed with numbers; unlike programming error contexts.

patterns.name: Technical Q&A title/problem opening
patterns.context: Briefly raises unexpected program behavior or a problem category, followed by code or error output; does not require “I am getting.”

patterns.name: Help request following code
patterns.context: Code is posted first, then the text shifts to an error, empty result, or request for help; activation occurs where code meets the natural-language question.

10_979.concept: 技术问答中的错误与调试
10_979.description: 主要响应技术问答中代码之后的报错、异常或错误结果说明，也响应 Traceback、JSON 代码与求助开场；另有一段法律指控文本无法归入这些模式。

patterns.name: 报错求助叙述
patterns.trigger: “I am getting” / “I'm getting”后接“the following error”或具体错误；以及“I am getting … Could you please tell me what mistake…”
patterns.context: 问题描述先给出代码或操作，再说明当前错误、异常或不符合预期的结果；激活覆盖提问句和错误引入句，不只限于特定错误文本。

patterns.name: Traceback 错误输出
patterns.context: Python 交互式输出中，调用失败后开始展示异常回溯；激活集中在 Traceback 及其邻近内容。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答／Python 调试

patterns.name: JSON 相关代码或问题
patterns.context: JSON 是代码操作、数据通信或解析问题的主题；单独出现 JSON 时也有激活，但通常与故障描述相邻。

patterns.name: Java 异常日志
patterns.trigger: “catch (JSON Exception e)”及“LOG.error("Exception while put to json: …”)
patterns.context: Java 风格的异常捕获和日志记录，强调写入 JSON 失败的异常信息。

patterns.name: 法律起诉书中的罪名列举
patterns.context: 以编号列举刑事指控及法条依据；和编程错误语境不同。

patterns.name: 技术问答标题／问题开场
patterns.context: 简短提出程序行为异常或问题分类，随后接代码或错误输出；不要求出现“I am getting”。

patterns.name: 代码尾部接求助说明
patterns.trigger: 代码片段结束后接“UPDATE: This is the error I am getting”或“I am getting cache as empty list”
patterns.context: 先贴代码，再转入错误、空结果或求助说明；激活出现在代码与自然语言问题衔接处。

en.description: The most prominent pattern repeated across passages is herpes/herpesvirus-related vocabulary, found in virology project materials and abstracts; there are also sporadic medical subword fragments, customer video descriptions in patents, and a blue heron nesting account, with no clear shared conditions.

patterns.name: Herpesvirus-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Directly features herpes/herpesvirus and virus types or research uses; sometimes these are longer terms in biomedical text.
patterns.domain: Virology, NIH project materials, and PubMed abstracts

patterns.name: Suffix fragments split within words
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments spanning tokenized words, but the fragments are scattered across terms for traumatic dystonia, titles, place names, and treatment-related words; no consistent lexical meaning or contextual condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Verb collocations about customer video communication
patterns.context: Patent background text describes follow-up visits or expert consultation and contrasts these with one-way video communication; activation concentrates on words such as customer and sees.

patterns.name: Blue herons and nesting sites
patterns.context: A natural-history account describes blue herons returning to their current nesting site.

10_1110.description: 最突出且跨段重复的模式是 herpes/herpesvirus 相关词汇，见于病毒学项目材料和摘要；此外还有零散的医学词片段、专利中的客户视频描述，以及蓝鹭筑巢叙述，彼此缺乏明确共同条件。

patterns.name: 疱疹病毒相关词汇
patterns.trigger: “herpes simplex viruses”“Human herpesvirus-6”“herpesviruses”“herpes simplex virus (HSV)-based vectors”
patterns.context: 直接出现 herpes/herpesvirus 及其病毒种类或研究用途；有时是生物医学文本中的较长术语。
patterns.domain: 病毒学、NIH 项目材料及 PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: 单词内部切分的后缀片段
patterns.context: 激活落在跨子词切分的词片段上，但片段分散于创伤性肌张力障碍、标题、地名和治疗相关词中；看不出一致的词义或语境条件。

patterns.name: 涉客视频通信的动词搭配
patterns.context: 专利背景中描述回访或专家咨询，并对比单向视频通信；激活集中在 customer、sees 等词。

patterns.name: 蓝鹭及筑巢地点
patterns.context: 自然史叙述中描写蓝鹭返回当前巢址。

en.description: The most prominent and repeated pattern is herpes virus names in medical or virology texts. Other activations are sporadic, appearing in disease terminology, heron names, customer-service video descriptions, proper names, and tumor-treatment vocabulary, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: herpes virus texts
patterns.context: Names such as herpes simplex, human herpesvirus, herpesvirus, or HSV-based vectors appear; activation falls on “herpes,” usually in virological or medical contexts.
patterns.domain: Virology, NIH-funded texts, PubMed medical abstracts

patterns.name: Trauma-induced dystonia terminology
patterns.context: A term for trauma-induced dystonia in a medical abstract; activation is concentrated on multiple subword fragments of the disease name.

patterns.name: Heron names
patterns.context: In the species name Pacific great blue herons, activation falls on a subword fragment of herons; no repeated examples in the same ecological context are found.

patterns.name: Customers seeing video
patterns.context: Describes one-way video communication during a customer-service callback, where the customer can see the representative on video; activation is concentrated on “the customer sees.”

patterns.name: Scott in a personal name
patterns.context: In the name F. Scott Fitzgerald, activation falls on the surname Scott; the surrounding text is about short-story entries.

patterns.name: Chillicothe in a place name
patterns.context: Chillicothe appears in a description of an Ohio mound site; activation is concentrated on the initial fragment of the place name.

patterns.name: Description of metastatic breast cancer treatment
patterns.context: Describes treatment outcomes after surgical resection, recurrence, and metastatic disease; aside from this term, no trigger clearly connected to the main pattern is found.

10_1110.description: 最显著且重复的模式是医学或病毒学文本中的 herpes 病毒名称；其余激活零散落在疾病术语、苍鹭名称、客服视频表述、专名及肿瘤治疗词汇上，未形成统一语义模式。

patterns.name: herpes 病毒文本
patterns.context: 出现 herpes simplex、human herpesvirus、herpesvirus 或以 HSV 为基础的载体等名称；激活落在“herpes”上，常见于病毒学或医学语境。
patterns.domain: 病毒学、NIH 资助文本、PubMed 医学摘要

patterns.name: 诱发性肌张力障碍术语
patterns.context: 医学摘要中的创伤诱发型肌张力障碍术语，激活集中于该疾病名称的多个子词片段。

patterns.name: 苍鹭名称
patterns.context: Pacific great blue herons 的物种名称中，激活落在 herons 的词片段；未见相同生态语境的重复例子。

patterns.name: 顾客看到视频
patterns.context: 描述客服回拨中单向视频通信，顾客能看到客服人员的视频；激活集中在“顾客看到”。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、通信系统

patterns.name: 人名中的 Scott
patterns.context: F. Scott Fitzgerald 的姓名中，激活落在姓氏 Scott；周围是短篇小说条目。

patterns.name: 地名中的 Chillicothe
patterns.context: 俄亥俄州 mound 地点描述中的 Chillicothe，激活集中于地名的开头片段。

patterns.name: 乳腺癌转移治疗描述
patterns.context: 描述手术切除后复发及转移性疾病的治疗效果；除该词外未见与主要模式明显相连的触发。

en.description: Activations occur mainly in herpes/herpesvirus virological expressions. They also appear on the -ons fragment in mesons, Sponsored, and Coupons, as well as in dystonia, herons, and Policy in a conference topic; these span domains and lack a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: herpesvirus spelling
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the English medical name herpes and adjacent words or virus numbers, including hyphenated numbers and plural forms.
patterns.domain: Virology, medical abstracts, and NIH project texts

patterns.name: Word-final -ons
patterns.context: The continuous letter sequence ons is segmented and marked as highly activated inside different words: mesons, Sponsored, and Coupons.
patterns.domain: Physics papers, legal-affairs titles, and code

patterns.name: Trauma-induced dystonia terminology
patterns.context: The phrase trauma-induced dystonia in a medical abstract; strong activation falls on induced and several subword fragments of dystonia.

patterns.name: Blue heron names
patterns.context: In Pacific great blue herons, activation falls on the final fragment of herons; it is not clearly connected to other activation patterns.

patterns.name: Neurotoxicology conference topic
patterns.context: In a conference name and its topic text, strong activation falls on Policy; the same topic also mentions environmental causes of neurological disorders.
patterns.domain: Neurotoxicology conference announcements or project texts

10_1110.description: 激活主要见于 herpes/herpesvirus 病毒学表述；另在 mesons、Sponsored、Coupons 的 -ons 片段，以及 dystonia、herons 和会议主题中的 Policy 出现，跨领域且没有统一语义。

patterns.name: herpesvirus 拼写
patterns.trigger: « herpes»10«virus»3«-»4«6»4；« herpes»10« simplex»3« viruses»4；« herpes»9viruses；« herpes»9« simplex»3« virus
patterns.context: 激活集中在英文医学名称 herpes 及其相邻词或病毒编号；包括连字符编号和复数形式。
patterns.domain: 病毒学、医学摘要与 NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 词尾 -ons
patterns.context: 在不同词内部，ons 这一连续字母片段被拆分标记为高激活；分别出现在 mesons、Sponsored、Coupons。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文、法律事务标题及代码

patterns.name: 诱发性肌张力障碍术语
patterns.context: 医学摘要中 trauma-induced dystonia 一词组；强激活落在 induced 及 dystonia 的若干子词片段。

patterns.name: 蓝鹭名称
patterns.context: 在 Pacific great blue herons 中，激活落在 herons 的词尾片段；与其他激活模式不明显相连。
patterns.domain: 自然观察或生态类文本

patterns.name: 神经毒理学会议主题
patterns.context: 会议名称及其主题文本中，强激活落在 Policy；同一主题还提到 neurological disorders 的环境病因。
patterns.domain: 神经毒理学会议公告或项目文本

en.description: Strong activation primarily occurs on herpes/herpesvirus and variants, including virological forms such as HSV/HHV; other high activations are scattered across bird-name endings, medical terms, competition names, tumor phrases, place names and years, and NIH titles, with no shared semantics.

patterns.name: Herpesvirus word forms
patterns.context: Herpesvirus appears as a word or medical entity; in several passages it also appears with a hyphen or abbreviation, such as “herpesvirus-6,” “HHV-6,” and “HSV.”
patterns.domain: Biomedical text, virology, and NIH application text

patterns.name: Specific word-final fragments
patterns.context: In the bird name “great blue herons,” activation falls on a word-final fragment after tokenization; this differs from the virus context.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in medical compounds
patterns.context: “induced” is strongly activated in a medical description of trauma-induced movement disorders; the passage is not about herpesviruses.

patterns.name: speedway word form
patterns.context: Appears in the competition name “British Speedway Championship” and is repeated on the next line.

patterns.name: Oncology phrase
patterns.context: An abstract background introduces metastatic cutaneous melanoma and compares it with other solid tumors.

patterns.name: Place names and years
patterns.context: A historical account of Philippine place names and administrative divisions; high-activation markers fall on final fragments of place names and on years.

patterns.name: Budget word forms in titles
patterns.context: Budget recommendations and a Special Emphasis Panel title in NIH application text, with abbreviations and uppercase title formatting.

10_1110.description: 主要对 herpes/herpesvirus 及其变体、HSV/HHV 等病毒学词形强激活；其余高激活分散在鸟名词尾、医学术语、赛事名、肿瘤短语、地名年份和 NIH 标题，缺乏共同语义。

patterns.name: 疱疹病毒词形
patterns.context: 疱疹病毒作为词语或医学实体出现；在若干段落中也带有连字符或缩写，如“herpesvirus-6”“HHV-6”“HSV”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、病毒学及 NIH 申请文本

patterns.name: 特定词尾片段
patterns.context: 鸟类名称“great blue herons”中，激活落在分词后的词尾片段；与病毒语境不同。

patterns.name: 医学复合词内部片段
patterns.context: 创伤诱发的运动障碍这一医学术语描述中，“induced”强激活；该段没有疱疹病毒主题。

patterns.name: speedway 词形
patterns.context: 出现在赛事名称“British Speedway Championship”中，且在下一行重复。

patterns.name: 肿瘤学短语
patterns.context: 摘要背景中介绍转移性皮肤黑色素瘤及其与其他实体瘤的比较。

patterns.name: 地名及年份
patterns.context: 菲律宾地名与行政区划历史叙述；高激活标记落在地名末尾片段和年份。
patterns.domain: 维基百科历史／地理条目

patterns.name: 标题预算词形
patterns.context: NIH 申请文本中的预算建议及特别重点评审小组标题，夹杂缩写和大写标题格式。

en.concept: English fixed phrases and word-form fragments
en.description: Activations span webpage Follow subscription prompts, medical terminology and paper titles, the name or place Barry, and sentence openings such as Every year/day. These fragments differ considerably in domain and semantics.

patterns.name: Subscription prompts beginning with Follow
patterns.context: A sentence begins with Follow as an action prompt, followed by an object or method such as Us, via email, or via RSS; common in website navigation or subscription copy.
patterns.domain: Webpages, newsletters, or RSS navigation copy

patterns.name: Herpesviruses and numbering
patterns.context: herpesvirus appears in medical names, especially Human herpesvirus-6 or its abbreviation HHV-6.

patterns.name: Title wording for construction and validation
patterns.context: A title or paper title uses coordinated gerunds to describe constructing and validating an object.

patterns.name: Trauma-induced dystonia
patterns.context: A medical title pairs trauma-induced with dystonia to describe an etiology or clinical phenomenon.

patterns.name: Barry followed by an evaluation
patterns.context: Barry is a personal name followed by an evaluation of performance or suitability; this example is a recommendation in an email.

patterns.name: Place name Barry Islands
patterns.context: Barry combines with Islands to form a place name, followed by an introduction to the islands.

patterns.name: Annual overview beginning with Every year
patterns.context: A sentence begins with Every year to introduce something that happens annually; this example discusses important parts of the world.

patterns.name: Promotional expression Every day heroes
patterns.context: Everyday heroes refers to ordinary heroes, followed by around us at Enron, in an approving or promotional tone.

10_1110.concept: 英语固定短语与词形片段
10_1110.description: 激活跨网页 Follow 订阅提示、医学术语与论文标题、Barry 人名或地名，以及 Every year/day 开头的句式；这些片段的领域和语义差异较大。

patterns.name: Follow 开头的订阅提示
patterns.context: 句首以 Follow 发出行动提示，后接对象或方式，如 Us、via email、via RSS；常见于网页导航或订阅文案。
patterns.domain: 网页、新闻通讯或 RSS 导航文案

patterns.name: 疱疹病毒及编号
patterns.context: 医学名称中出现 herpesvirus，尤其是 Human herpesvirus-6 或其缩写 HHV-6。

patterns.name: 构建与验证的标题措辞
patterns.context: 标题或论文题名中，以动名词并列描述构建和验证某种对象。

patterns.name: 创伤诱发的肌张力障碍
patterns.context: 医学标题中将 trauma-induced 与 dystonia 连用，描述病因或临床现象。

patterns.name: Barry 及其后的评价
patterns.context: Barry 作人名，后接对其表现或适任性的评价；此例为邮件中的建议。

patterns.name: Barry Islands 地名
patterns.context: Barry 与 Islands 连用构成地名，后文转入岛屿介绍。

patterns.name: Every year 引出的年度概述
patterns.context: 句首以 Every year 引出每年发生的情况；本例谈世界各地的重要部分。

patterns.name: Every day heroes 的宣传式表达
patterns.context: Everyday heroes 指日常英雄，后接 around us at Enron，语气带赞扬或宣传色彩。

en.concept: Subwords and formatting fragments in structured text
en.description: Activations are scattered across split uppercase titles, subwords within words, label fragments, webpage subscription copy, table numbers and whitespace, numbered dates, and Spanish chat; this looks more like varied responses to formatting boundaries and local subwords than a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Local spelling fragments in HTML/XML tags
patterns.context: Activation occurs at tag boundaries and on letter fragments split within them; this appears in different structures, including HTML tables and IRC pseudo-tags.
patterns.domain: Web tables, chat logs, and marked-up text

patterns.name: Uppercase titles or section labels
patterns.context: Uppercase words or phrases are split into consecutive subword fragments; these occur in titles, comment headings, and legal document section names.

patterns.name: Internal word fragments in proper nouns and technical terms
patterns.context: Longer words or names are split into subwords, with activation concentrated on internal fragments; contexts include paper titles and abstracts.

patterns.name: Webpage follow and subscription copy
patterns.context: Short webpage footer or navigation copy containing language about following, email subscriptions, or RSS subscriptions.

patterns.name: Tabular numbers and indentation whitespace
patterns.context: Numbers, field names, and values appear in whitespace-separated, row-and-column records; passage 6 also contains dates, amounts, and names in an HTML table.
patterns.domain: Energy trading data tables, web tables

patterns.name: Number and date formats
patterns.context: Years, dates, or identifiers are split and placed in formal records or table cells.

patterns.name: Spanish chat and encoding-corrupted characters
patterns.context: An IRC conversation contains Spanish greetings and chat, interspersed with corrupted accented characters and punctuation.

patterns.name: Disease and medical entity names
patterns.context: Disease, patient, or microorganism names in medical text; activation falls on partial subwords within the names.

10_1110.concept: 结构化文本中的子词与格式片段
10_1110.description: 激活分散于拆分的大写标题、词内子词、标签片段、网页订阅文案、表格数字与空白、编号日期及西语聊天；更像对格式边界和局部子词的多种响应，而非单一语义主题。

patterns.name: HTML/XML标签中的局部拼写片段
patterns.context: 标签边界及其内部被拆分的字母片段激活；出现在表格 HTML、IRC 聊天伪标签等不同结构中。
patterns.domain: 网页表格、聊天记录及标记文本

patterns.name: 大写标题或分节标签
patterns.context: 大写词或短语被拆成连续子词片段；分别出现在标题、评论标题和法律文件分节名中。

patterns.name: 专名、术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 较长词或名称按子词切分，激活集中在词内片段；所处语境包括论文标题及摘要。

patterns.name: 网页关注与订阅文案
patterns.context: 网页页脚或导航式短文案，包含关注、邮件订阅或 RSS 订阅表达。

patterns.name: 表格化数字与缩进空白
patterns.context: 数字、字段名与数值在空白分隔的行列式记录中出现；段 6 也有 HTML 表格日期、金额和人名。
patterns.domain: 能源交易数据表、网页表格

patterns.name: 编号与日期类格式
patterns.context: 年份、日期或编号被拆分并置于正式记录或表格单元格中。

patterns.name: 西班牙语聊天及编码异常字符
patterns.context: IRC 对话中出现西班牙语问候和聊天内容，夹杂损坏的重音字符及标点。

patterns.name: 疾病与医学实体名称
patterns.context: 医学文本中的疾病、患者或微生物名称；激活落在名称的部分子词上。

en.concept: “based” and local word forms in academic text
en.description: The most consistent trigger is based (upon/on, or after a comma), across grant text, medical and academic papers; other local patterns include virus names, personal-name titles, medical title word forms, and mathematical models.

patterns.name: Expressions meaning based on / according to
patterns.context: Appears in formal sentences stating methods, arguments, or goals; common forms are “based upon/on,” as well as “based,” after a comma.
patterns.domain: NIH grant text, medical abstracts, genetics and mathematics papers

patterns.name: HHV-6 hyphenated name
patterns.context: The beginning of the virus name and its parenthesized abbreviation; activation covers tokenized fragments such as “herpes,” “virus,” “-,” and “6.”

patterns.name: Personal names and entry titles
patterns.context: A name appears as a standalone title, followed by a line break and “may refer to” introducing disambiguation entries.

patterns.name: Periodicity and impact in a title
patterns.context: A medical-paper-title-style phrase: first describing the periodicity of susceptibility, then introducing the effects of factors such as light.

patterns.name: mistletoe word form in abstracts
patterns.context: Abstract text about plant extracts and their antitumor activity; activation concentrates on internal word segments and does not clearly fall on “based.”

patterns.name: Cardinals and models in mathematics
patterns.context: An existence statement discusses limit models and their cardinalities; it shares a form of “based” with other passages, but activation on “based” is weaker here.

10_1110.concept: 学术文本中的“based”及局部词形
10_1110.description: 最一致的触发是 based（upon/on，或逗号后），横跨资助文本、医学与学术论文；另有病毒名、人名标题、医学标题词形及数学模型等局部模式。

patterns.name: 基于／依据表达
patterns.context: 出现在陈述方法、论据或目标的正式句子中；常见形式为“based upon/on”，也有逗号后的“based,”
patterns.domain: NIH 资助文本、医学摘要、遗传学和数学论文

patterns.name: HHV-6 连字符名称
patterns.context: 病毒名称及括号内缩写的开头；激活覆盖分词后的“herpes”“virus”“-”“6”等片段

patterns.name: 人名与词条标题
patterns.context: 姓名作为独立标题，随后换行并以“may refer to”引出消歧义条目

patterns.name: 标题中的周期性与影响
patterns.context: 医学论文标题式短语：先描述易感性的周期性，再引出光照等因素的影响

patterns.name: 摘要中的 mistletoe 词形
patterns.context: 植物提取物及其抗肿瘤活性的摘要文本；激活集中在词内分段，未明显落在“based”上

patterns.name: 数学中的基数与模型
patterns.context: 存在性命题中讨论极限模型及其基数；与其他段共享“based”形式，但该处的“based”激活较弱

en.concept: Vertical-related words and several isolated words
en.description: The most prominent recognizable pattern is Vertical/vertical and vertical devices, directions, or interface elements, in texts about ventilation, patents, software, and mining. Other high activations are scattered across words for conflict, click reaction, dependent, time dependence, and species classification, without a shared context.

patterns.name: Vertical and vertical-direction words
patterns.context: Features Vertical/vertical, or directions, devices, or interface elements modified by it; capitalization is not significant, but strong activation falls mainly on Vertical itself.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: ventilation equipment, patents/computer graphics, software interfaces, mining equipment, ergonomic devices; also scientific texts

patterns.name: Words related to conflict and cognitive control
patterns.context: Describes a situation in which the ventrolateral prefrontal cortex faces a conflict between immediate and delayed value during a task.

patterns.name: Click reaction-related words
patterns.context: Mentions click reactions and their formation of covalent bonds in chemical reaction and biological-system contexts.

patterns.name: Data-sharing dependence
patterns.context: Describes users’ willingness to share health data as depending on the data’s potential uses.
patterns.domain: Health data and privacy research paper

patterns.name: Time-dependent expression
patterns.context: Modifies time in a theoretical discussion of a tachyon field and its solutions.

patterns.name: Insect species and microbiomes
patterns.context: Appears in a parenthetical list summarizing endemic Hawaiian insects and their bacterial diversity.

10_1110.concept: 垂直相关词与若干孤立词
10_1110.description: 最突出的可辨模式是 Vertical/vertical 及垂直设备、方向或界面元素，见通风、专利、软件和矿业等文本。其余高激活分散在冲突、click reaction、dependent、时间依赖及物种分类等词上，缺乏共同语境。

patterns.name: Vertical 及垂直方向相关词
patterns.context: 出现 Vertical/vertical，或其修饰的方向、设备、界面元素；大小写不敏感，但强激活主要落在 Vertical 一词上
patterns.domain: 跨领域：通风设备、专利/计算机图形、软件界面、矿业设备、人体工学设备；也有科学文本

patterns.name: 冲突与认知控制相关词

patterns.domain: 神经科学/认知心理学论文

patterns.name: Click reaction 相关词

patterns.name: 数据分享依赖关系

patterns.name: 时间依赖表述

patterns.name: insect 物种与微生物组
patterns.context: 在概述夏威夷特有昆虫及其细菌多样性的括号列举中
patterns.domain: 昆虫学/微生物生态学论文

en.description: Primarily activates on the string piece or its subword piece: this includes the noun phrase “a piece of” and the mathematical term piecewise; other sporadic triggers include click in clickbait, head in technical contexts, and dasher in refrigeration equipment terminology.

patterns.name: Literal collocation “a piece of”
patterns.context: In ordinary noun phrases, piece is followed by different objects such as a meal, material, code, or card; activation falls mainly on piece (sometimes also on piece in the subword piecewise).
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: news commentary, patents, scientific papers, programming Q&A, personal narratives

patterns.name: piece in the compound piecewise
patterns.context: piecewise appears as part of a compound in mathematical text; after piece and wise are tokenized, piece is strongly activated.

patterns.name: click subword in clickbait
patterns.context: A news headline is criticized as clickbait; high activation falls on the click subword.

patterns.name: head in patent text
patterns.context: In mechanical or logical technical contexts, refers respectively to the head slider of a disk drive and a head-cycle in a logic program; neither has an evident semantic connection to piece.

patterns.name: dasher in refrigeration equipment terminology
patterns.context: Lists available dasher types in industrial continuous freezing equipment; activation is weaker than for the main trigger.

10_1110.description: 主要对 piece 字符串或其子词 piece 激活：涵盖“a piece of”名词短语及数学术语 piecewise；另有 clickbait 中 click、技术语境中的 head 和冷冻设备术语 dasher 等零散触发。

patterns.name: “a piece of”字面搭配
patterns.context: 普通名词短语中，piece 后接 meal、材料、代码、卡片等不同宾语；激活主要落在 piece（有时也落在子词 piecewise 的 piece）。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：新闻评论、专利、科学论文、编程问答、个人叙述

patterns.name: piecewise 复合词中的 piece
patterns.context: 数学文本中 piecewise 作为复合词的一部分；piece 与 wise 分词标记后，piece 激活较强。

patterns.name: clickbait 子词 click
patterns.context: 新闻标题被批评为吸引点击的 clickbait；高激活落在 click 子词。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的 head
patterns.context: 机械或逻辑技术语境中，分别指磁盘驱动器的 head slider，以及逻辑程序中的 head-cycle；与 piece 的出现没有明显语义联系。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书、计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 冷冻设备术语 dasher
patterns.context: 工业连续冷冻设备中列举可用的 dasher types；强度低于主要触发词。

en.description: Primarily responds to “point” denoting a specific location or key position and its contexts, including physical points, event locations, geometric points, and image positions; it also activates on the name “Jackson” in one passage.

patterns.name: “point” related to location/position [9]
patterns.context: Describes a specific location, where an event occurs, a position on a geometric object, or a coordinate in an image; sometimes preceded by “the,” and sometimes embedded in a proper noun or technical description.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: scientific papers, patents, law, mathematics, and image technology; covers [1][2][4][5][6][7][8][9][10]

patterns.name: Surname in a person’s name
patterns.context: Appears in the birth name “born Suzanne Jackson.”

10_1110.description: 主要对表示具体位置或关键位置的“point”及其语境反应，涵盖物理点、事件地点、几何点和图像位置；另在一处对人名“Jackson”有激活。

patterns.name: “point”相关位置/位置9
patterns.context: 描述某个具体位置、事件发生处、几何对象上的位置，或图像中的坐标位置；有时前接“the”，有时嵌在专名或技术描述中。

patterns.name: 人物姓名中的姓氏
patterns.context: 出现在人物出生姓名“born Suzanne Jackson”中。

en.concept: General vocabulary describing activities and processes
en.description: Activation is distributed across scientific, legal, sports, and technical texts; common triggers are activities/tasks, as well as continuity, direction, length, or range in technical descriptions. There are also nouns related to phenomenon, composition, and numbers, in unrelated contexts.

patterns.name: Activities and their duration
patterns.context: Mentions activities, tasks, or activities of daily life; [10] also explicitly specifies duration or exercise intensity.
patterns.domain: Research projects, legal documents, sports nutrition

patterns.name: Continuous motion, extension, or length in technical processes
patterns.context: Describes the direction, continuity, size, or range of an object, material, system, or process.

patterns.name: Broad concepts or composition descriptions in scientific and technical terms
patterns.context: A noun refers to a phenomenon or describes the composition of a material; the trigger itself is broad, with no shared local collocation apparent.

patterns.name: Unspecified numeric or counting expressions
patterns.context: Number-related nouns appear in project statistics or descriptions of structural positions, with differing meanings and contexts.

10_1110.concept: 活动与过程描述中的泛化词汇
10_1110.description: 激活分布于科研、法律、运动与技术文本；常见触发是活动/任务，以及技术描述中的连续过程、方向、长度或范围。另有 phenomenon、composition 和数字相关名词，彼此语境不一。

patterns.name: 活动及其持续时间
patterns.context: 出现活动、任务或日常生活活动的表述；[10]还明确说明持续时间或运动强度。
patterns.domain: 科研项目、法律文件、运动营养

patterns.name: 技术过程中的连续运动、延伸或长度
patterns.context: 描述物体、材料、系统或过程的方向、连续性、尺寸或范围。
patterns.domain: 专利、工程技术、通信技术

patterns.name: 科学技术名词中的宽泛概念或组成描述
patterns.context: 名词指称某种现象，或说明材料的组成；触发词本身较泛，未见共同的局部搭配。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文、专利材料说明

patterns.name: 未明确的数字或计数表达
patterns.context: 数字相关名词出现在项目统计或结构位置说明中，语义及上下文不同。

en.description: Most fragments activate on point and its positional collocations, covering technical structures, route locations, intersections, and points of state change. A few activations fall on location or position terms and end parts; one commercial-purpose phrase remains unexplained.

patterns.name: Positional marker “point”
patterns.context: Describes a specific location in a structure, route, diagram, or process, often followed by “of,” “where,” or “at,” or modified by distance, direction, or similar information.

patterns.name: Positional prepositional phrases
patterns.context: The preposition “at” precedes a location word to introduce a place, connection point, intersection, or location where a change occurs; activation is concentrated on point and its local collocations.

patterns.name: Drawing and numbered locations
patterns.context: A point or connection location in a technical system is specified using figure numbers, numerals, distances, or directions.

patterns.name: Abstract stage or functional location
patterns.context: point refers to a mechanical hinge location or where a process or state change occurs, rather than simply a geographic location.

patterns.name: Proper names and route locations
patterns.context: In legal or route narratives, point denotes a location identified along a road or relative to a landmark.

patterns.name: Geometric intersection
patterns.context: Describes the location where arcs at the tip of a key intersect and their angular relationship.

patterns.name: Local boundary or end location
patterns.context: The text contains positional expressions such as ends or boundaries, but no point collocation; a connection to positional focus is possible, but evidence is weak.

patterns.name: Weak association with range and position nouns
patterns.context: Plural position words describe locations that a component passes through or stops at, without point.

patterns.name: Non-positional purpose phrase
patterns.context: purpose denotes a commercial objective, not a spatial location; it has no clear connection to the point pattern.

10_1110.description: 多数片段激活于 point 及其位置搭配，涵盖技术结构、路线地点、交点和状态变化处；少数激活落在 locations、positions 或端部等位置词，另有商业用途短语无法解释。

patterns.name: 位置标记“point”
patterns.context: 描述结构、路线、图示或过程中的特定位置，常接“of”“where”“at”，或被距离、方向等信息修饰。
patterns.domain: 专利、法律叙述、技术说明

patterns.name: 位置介词短语
patterns.context: 位置词前出现“at”，引出某个地点、连接点、交点或发生变化的位置；激活集中在 point 及其局部搭配。

patterns.name: 图纸及编号位置
patterns.context: 用图号、数字、距离或方位限定技术系统中的点或连接位置。

patterns.name: 抽象阶段或用途位置
patterns.trigger: “at the point of the principal hinge”；“at the point where the light image intensity and bias voltage”
patterns.context: point 指向机械铰链处或过程/状态变化发生处，而非单纯地理位置。

patterns.name: 专名与路线位置
patterns.trigger: “at a point 1.29 miles west of the City”；“to a point east of White Plains”
patterns.context: 法律或路线叙述中，以 point 表示沿道路或相对地标确定的地点。
patterns.domain: 法律叙述、交通路线描述

patterns.name: 几何交点
patterns.trigger: “point of intersection”；“at the point of intersection”
patterns.context: 描述钥匙尖端弧线相交的位置及其角度关系。

patterns.name: 局部边界或端部位置
patterns.context: 文本中出现端部、边界等位置表达，但没有 point 搭配；可能与位置关注有关，证据较弱。

patterns.name: 范围与位置名词的弱关联
patterns.trigger: “locations where the drive plates pass through”；“positions near the opposite ends”
patterns.context: 以复数位置词描述部件经过或停止的地点，不出现 point。

patterns.name: 非位置性用途短语
patterns.context: purpose 表示商业化目的，不是空间位置；与 point 模式无明确联系。

en.concept: Statements of purpose and behavioral relationships
en.description: Primarily responds to expressions of purpose and activity, such as “purposes of” and “activities that”; it also activates on class action, conduct, and liability language in legal texts, and descriptions of mechanical positions and technical ranges in patents. Other contexts include regulation of women’s clothing, research projects, and partnership disputes.

patterns.name: Purpose/use phrases
patterns.context: The noun “purposes” is followed by “of” to explain the purpose of an action, regulation, or project; occurs across several fields.
patterns.domain: Law, sports commentary, public policy, research project descriptions

patterns.name: Activities and their constraints or effects
patterns.context: “activities” introduces a subsequent result or restrictive clause, describing participants’ activities and their effects.

patterns.name: Legal conduct and procedural language
patterns.context: Legal text concerning a category of lawsuit, attributable conduct, or ongoing business operations.

patterns.name: Positions/connections of mechanical components
patterns.context: Patent text describes the connections and relative positions of components such as screws, nuts, and stops.

patterns.name: Technical parameters and range width
patterns.context: A patent technical description defines the range width corresponding to a programming level.

patterns.name: Exposure and women’s clothing choices
patterns.context: Discusses women’s sportswear, sexualization, or regulation of public nudity.

patterns.name: Oversight and termination of a partnership
patterns.context: Describes the liquidation of a partnership and whether continuing operations are feasible.

patterns.name: Research project participants and further education
patterns.context: Reports the proportion of project participants who advance to graduate or professional programs, and their activities.

patterns.name: Joint criminal conduct and attribution of liability
patterns.context: Discusses the scope of defendants’ liability for others’ acts when a crime is committed jointly.

patterns.name: Disrupted business plans
patterns.context: Recounts a company requiring someone to participate in an activity, preventing them from completing a business plan.

patterns.name: Project coordination and client contact
patterns.context: Describes the administrative purpose of project staffing.

10_1110.description: 主要响应“purposes of”及“activities that”等目的、活动表述；另对法律中的class action、conduct和责任措辞，以及专利机械位置、技术区间描述有激活。还覆盖女性服装规制、研究项目、合伙纠纷等语境。

patterns.name: 目的/用途短语
patterns.context: 名词“purposes”后接“of”，说明行动、规定或项目的目的；在多个领域均出现

patterns.name: 活动及其限制或效果
patterns.context: “activities”引出后续结果或限制性从句，描述参与者从事的活动及影响
patterns.domain: 研究资助说明、法律陈述

patterns.name: 法律行为与程序性措辞
patterns.context: 法律文本中围绕诉讼类别、可归责行为或持续经营的陈述

patterns.name: 机械部件的位置/连接描述
patterns.context: 专利文本描述螺杆、螺母、止挡件等部件的连接关系和相对位置

patterns.name: 技术参数与区间宽度
patterns.context: 专利技术说明中定义编程等级对应的区间宽度

patterns.name: 裸露与女性服装选择
patterns.context: 讨论女性运动服装、性化或公共场所裸露规制
patterns.domain: 哲学/体育评论、地方条例报道

patterns.name: 监督与合伙关系终止
patterns.context: 描述合伙企业清算及继续经营是否可行

patterns.name: 研究项目参与者与升学
patterns.context: 报告项目参与者升入研究生或专业项目的比例及活动

patterns.name: 犯罪共同行为及责任归属
patterns.context: 讨论共同实施犯罪时被告对他人行为的责任范围

patterns.name: 商业计划受阻
patterns.context: 叙述公司要求某人参与活动，导致其无法完成商业计划

patterns.name: 项目协调与客户接触
patterns.context: 说明项目人员配置的行政用途
patterns.domain: 公共卫生/社会工作项目说明

en.description: Activations are scattered across technical, scientific, and legal texts: they may fall on systems, locations or distances, geometry, or component words, and also appear on conduct in legal contexts. The passages lack a unified, clearly defined semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Coupled systems
patterns.context: Describes a system of coupled nonlinear Schrödinger equations involving multi-pulses, solitons, and bifurcations.

patterns.name: Routes and geographic orientation
patterns.context: A route description specifies places, directions, and road layout; activations are distributed across several directional or positional terms.

patterns.name: Distance and centerline
patterns.context: A patent technical description specifies component positions, spacing, and a centerline.

patterns.name: Quantum systems
patterns.context: Discusses quantum dots, interference effects, and system symmetry; activations are especially evident on systems and are.

patterns.name: Geometric trajectory and radius
patterns.context: Describes a jet extending along a particular line, using radius and tangent to explain geometric relationships.

patterns.name: Conduct and legal evaluation
patterns.context: A complaint alleges that certain conduct made the partnership difficult to continue.

patterns.name: Screw position
patterns.context: Specifies the mounting position of a stop on a screw shaft, especially near the shaft end.

patterns.name: Electron-hole systems
patterns.context: Discusses a system composed of electrons and holes and its energy-spectrum properties.

patterns.name: Container components
patterns.context: A patent describes a bottle body, dropper, and their integral structure; high activation falls near reference numbers and component words.

patterns.name: Findings of fact in legal cases
patterns.context: A court record or judgment states findings of fact about a party’s conduct.

10_1110.description: 激活分散于技术、科学和法律文本：可落在系统、位置/距离、几何或部件词上，也出现在法律行为 conduct；各段缺乏统一的明确语义触发词。

patterns.name: 耦合系统
patterns.trigger: « systems»10« of»6« coupled»1« nonlinear»2« Sch»3«rod»1«inger»1« equations»4
patterns.context: 描述多脉冲、孤立波及分岔的耦合非线性薛定谔方程系统。

patterns.name: 路线与地理方位

patterns.name: 距离及中心线

patterns.name: 量子系统

patterns.domain: 理论物理 / ArXiv 摘要

patterns.name: 几何轨迹与半径
patterns.trigger: « lines»10 which« are»5 between« a»2 radius»7 and« a»2 tangent»4
patterns.context: 描述喷射流沿特定线延伸，并以半径和切线说明几何关系。

patterns.name: 行为及法律评价
patterns.context: 诉状指称某种行为导致合伙关系难以继续。

patterns.name: 螺杆位置

patterns.name: 电子与空穴系统
patterns.trigger: « systems»9 formed« by»1 both« electrons»2 and« holes»2
patterns.context: 讨论由电子和空穴组成的系统及其能谱性质。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理 / ArXiv 摘要

patterns.name: 容器部件
patterns.context: 专利描述瓶体、滴管及其一体成型结构；高激活落在编号和部件词附近。

patterns.name: 法律事实认定
patterns.context: 法院审理记录或裁判文书中，陈述对当事人行为的事实认定。

en.concept: Systems and processes in scientific text
en.description: Primarily responds to “systems” in scientific text, especially near in/of/by and descriptions of composition or properties; it also responds to explanations of process mechanisms and activates sporadically on various physics, nanoscience, and patent terms.

patterns.name: The word “systems”
patterns.context: Describes research subjects consisting of a type of particle, structure, or equation in scientific papers; activation concentrates on systems itself and nearby collocations such as in/of/by.

patterns.name: “process” and process explanations
patterns.context: process is followed by an explanation introduced by that or a past-participle phrase, describing a mechanism, step, or phenomenon.

patterns.name: “terminal” and terminal labels
patterns.context: In a circuit-diagram description of a floating-gate memory cell, source/drain terminal is followed by letter labels.

patterns.name: “confined” describing a constrained state
patterns.context: A system or substance is constrained to a state or region; one passage refers to an intermediate state that is permanently confined, another to chromospheric material in a confined region.

patterns.name: Mirror symmetry and chaotic systems
patterns.context: Describes geometric or dynamical properties of a system and is related to interference effects.

patterns.name: Nanostructure names
patterns.context: Discusses plasmonic nanospheres and modeling with their non-Hermitian Hamiltonian.

patterns.name: Surface species removal with a scanning tunneling microscope
patterns.context: Describes experimental steps for removing covalently bonded species from a surface using STM.

patterns.name: Solitons in nonlinear equations
patterns.context: Discusses coupled nonlinear Schrödinger equations and the generation of multi-peak solitons.

patterns.name: Quantum dots and multimode leads
patterns.context: Compares the magnitude of interference effects when quantum dots are coupled to multimode leads.

patterns.name: Electron and hole carriers
patterns.context: Discusses systems composed of a single carrier type or of both electrons and holes.

10_1110.concept: 科学文本中的系统与过程
10_1110.description: 主要响应科学文本中的 systems，尤其邻近 in/of/by 及组成、性质描述；另响应 process 的机制说明，并对多种物理、纳米科学和专利术语有零散激活。

patterns.name: “systems”一词
patterns.context: 在科学论文中描述由某类粒子、结构或方程构成的研究对象；激活集中在 systems 本身及邻近的 in/of/by 等搭配。

patterns.name: “process”及过程说明
patterns.context: process 后接 that 引导的解释或过去分词短语，说明某种机制、步骤或现象。

patterns.name: “terminal”及端子标注
patterns.context: 浮栅存储器单元的电路图说明中，source/drain terminal 后附带字母标记。

patterns.name: “confined”描述受限状态
patterns.context: 系统或物质被限制在某状态或区域；一处指中间态永久受限，另一处指色球物质处在受限区域。

patterns.name: 镜面对称与混沌系统
patterns.context: 描述系统几何或动力学性质，且与干涉效应相关。

patterns.name: 纳米结构名称
patterns.context: 讨论等离激元纳米球及其非厄米哈密顿量建模。

patterns.name: 超导隧道显微镜处理表面物种
patterns.context: 描述用 STM 从表面移除共价结合物种的实验步骤。

patterns.name: 非线性方程中的孤波
patterns.context: 讨论耦合非线性薛定谔方程及多峰孤立波的生成。

patterns.name: 量子点与多模引线
patterns.context: 比较量子点耦合多模引线时干涉效应的大小。

patterns.name: 电子与空穴载流子
patterns.context: 讨论单类及电子、空穴双类载流子构成的系统。

en.concept: Local terminology and structure in diverse scientific and technical texts
en.description: Activations are scattered across texts from various disciplines, with triggers including specific nouns, conditional clauses, and structural references. There is no single stable semantic theme; some fragments show local syntactic or terminological co-occurrence.

patterns.name: Program-level width
patterns.context: In a patent technical description, these words occur together near a definition of program-level width.

patterns.name: Low-momentum condition
patterns.context: In discussing a model’s applicability, the text states the condition that system-particle momentum is low.

patterns.name: Team history and identity
patterns.context: A team description states its current name, former name, and affiliation.

patterns.name: Mirror-symmetric system
patterns.context: Describes a quantum-dot system that is mirror-symmetric but otherwise chaotic.

patterns.name: Plasmonic nanosphere system
patterns.context: A paper introduces its subject of study and discusses a plasmonic nanosphere system.

patterns.name: Process naming
patterns.context: A physical process is first described, followed by its technical name, “chromospheric evaporation.”

patterns.name: Process reference
patterns.context: After explaining a material-collection mechanism, “a process” refers back to it and adds that it had not previously been considered.

patterns.name: Strongly interacting critical case
patterns.context: Discusses a case in which interactions become significantly stronger near the critical line.

patterns.name: Distance definition
patterns.context: In a patent geometric description, the distance between centerlines is given first, followed by a statement that this distance corresponds to approximately 30 to...

patterns.name: Band-region properties
patterns.context: Describes a region in a phase diagram where each Landau-level-like band has a Chern number of one.

10_1110.concept: 多样化科学与技术文本中的局部术语及结构
10_1110.description: 激活分散在多种学科文本中，触发点包括特定名词、条件从句及结构性回指；没有单一稳定语义主题，部分片段呈现局部句法或术语共现。

patterns.name: 程序等级宽度
patterns.context: 专利技术说明中，这些词共同出现在对编程等级宽度的定义附近。

patterns.name: 低动量条件
patterns.context: 讨论模型适用性时，指出系统粒子动量低这一条件。

patterns.name: 球队历史与身份
patterns.context: 球队介绍中，说明其现名、旧称及隶属关系。

patterns.name: 镜面对称系统
patterns.context: 描述具有镜面对称、但其他方面混沌的量子点系统。

patterns.name: 等离激元纳米球系统
patterns.context: 论文转入研究对象的介绍，讨论等离激元纳米球系统。

patterns.name: 过程命名
patterns.context: 先描述物理过程，再给出其专门名称“chromospheric evaporation”。

patterns.name: 过程回指
patterns.context: 在解释某种材料收集机制后，用“a process”回指并补充其先前未被考虑。

patterns.name: 强相互作用临界情形
patterns.context: 讨论接近临界线时、相互作用显著增强的情况。

patterns.name: 距离定义
patterns.context: 专利几何描述中，前文给出中心线间距，随后说明该距离对应约30至……。

patterns.name: 能带区域特征
patterns.context: 相图中描述一类区域，其中每条类似朗道能级的能带具有单位陈数。

en.description: Activations are scattered across scientific, legal, political, and patent texts, involving processes, speed values, geographic points, systems, and descriptions of charts and geometry; no reliable unified meaning or stable syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: The word process
patterns.context: “process” describes a mechanism or process, followed by an explanatory clause or name.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers: nanowire growth mechanisms and solar physics

patterns.name: Speed and numerical values
patterns.context: Speed terms are associated with statutory speed limits or experimental motion speeds.
patterns.domain: Legal provisions and exercise physiology abstracts

patterns.name: Points in geographic descriptions
