patterns.context: “point” refers to a geographic location in route or boundary descriptions, near directions, distances, or place names.
patterns.domain: Legal boundary descriptions and highway route descriptions

patterns.name: The word system
patterns.context: “system” refers to a system in physical theory or a political system; the two uses differ in meaning and style.
patterns.domain: Theoretical physics papers and political commentary emails

patterns.name: Chart data and labels
patterns.context: Figure captions describe experimental data, curves, and axis scales; the strongest marker falls on a comma.

patterns.name: Geometric distances and regions
patterns.context: Describes key-shaped regions, arcs, centerlines, and the distances between them.

10_1110.description: 激活分散在科学、法律、政治及专利文本中，涉及过程、速度数值、地理点位、系统，以及图表和几何描述；未见可靠的统一词义或稳定句法条件。

patterns.name: process 一词
patterns.context: “process”用于描述某种机制或过程，后接解释性从句或名称。
patterns.domain: 科学论文：纳米线生长机制与太阳物理

patterns.name: 速度及数值
patterns.context: 速度词与法规中的限速数值或实验中的运动速度相连。
patterns.domain: 法律条文与运动生理学摘要

patterns.name: 地理描述中的点位
patterns.context: “point”指路线或边界描述中的地理位置，周围出现方向、距离或地名。
patterns.domain: 法律地界描述与公路路线说明

patterns.name: system 一词
patterns.context: “system”指物理理论中的系统或政治制度；两处语义和文体不同。
patterns.domain: 理论物理论文与政治评论邮件

patterns.name: 图表数据与标注
patterns.context: 图注中描述实验数据、曲线及坐标轴刻度；最强标记落在逗号上。

patterns.name: 几何距离与区域
patterns.context: 描述钥匙形状的区域、圆弧、中心线及其间距。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple genres: segmentation of proper names, legal relation words, patent components and explanatory wording, experimental parameters, disclaimers, and time and dispute expressions in emails. Apart from clusters in patent technical texts, no unified semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Name, title, or proper-name boundaries
patterns.context: Proper names or compounds are split at token boundaries, with some components marked; examples include call signs, mathematical symbols, company names, and media names.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, academic papers, medical papers, website texts

patterns.name: Relational words in legal narratives
patterns.context: A criminal judgment summary describes the legal fact of attempting to reenter after prior deportation; activation falls on short function words and segmented word fragments.

patterns.name: Patent technical terms and explanatory structures
patterns.context: A patent specification uses component nouns to describe memories, vehicle transmissions, or communication beams, interspersed with figure explanations, definitions, or frequency adverbs.

patterns.name: Experimental dosage and duration expressions
patterns.context: Activations appear near parameters such as dosage, body-weight units, and duration in drug or animal-experiment methods.

patterns.name: Comment disclaimers and moderation
patterns.context: A news website disclaimer states that user comments do not represent the administration’s views and mentions removing inappropriate comments.

patterns.name: Time points and fee disputes
patterns.context: A business email discusses the date of retroactive charges, debt, and a regulator’s determination, and mentions that an interest group may object.

10_1110.description: 激活分散于多种文体：专名拆分、法律关系词、专利部件与说明用语、实验参数、免责声明及邮件中的时间与争议表达。除专利技术文本成组外，未见统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 名称、标题或专名边界
patterns.context: 专名或复合词在 token 边界处被拆分，部分成分被标记；见于呼号、数学符号、公司名和媒体名。
patterns.domain: 百科、学术论文、医学论文、网站文本

patterns.name: 法律叙述中的关系词
patterns.context: 刑事判决摘要中，描述因先前驱逐而试图再次入境的法律事实；激活落在短功能词及拆分词片段上。

patterns.name: 专利技术名词及说明性结构
patterns.context: 专利说明书以部件名词描述存储器、车辆传动或通信波束，并穿插图示说明、定义或频率副词。

patterns.name: 实验剂量与周期表达
patterns.context: 药物或动物实验方法中，剂量、体重单位与持续时间等参数附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 评论免责声明与评论管理
patterns.context: 新闻网站免责声明说明用户评论不代表管理方观点，并提及排除不合适评论。

patterns.name: 时间点与费用争议
patterns.context: 商业邮件讨论追溯收费、债务及监管机构认定的时间点，且提及利益团体可能反对。

en.description: Activations are scattered across texts from multiple domains, often landing on terms, common words, proper names, or token fragments; sports, legal, technical, and encyclopedic content are all represented, with no reliable single semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Term or compound boundaries
patterns.context: Activations land on tokens in common words, technical terms, or compounds, especially near token boundaries, numbers, or punctuation; contextual conditions are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain texts: legal, sports, patents, biomedicine, encyclopedias, mathematics

patterns.name: Tokenization fragments and markers
patterns.context: There are also activations on token fragments adjacent to capitalization, punctuation, or numbers; these may relate to subword segmentation or special formatting, but the samples do not establish a unified condition.
patterns.domain: Web text, code licenses, patents, papers, and encyclopedic texts

patterns.name: Event or entity names
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions related to sporting events, venues, leagues, or teams; activations land on different types of words.

patterns.name: Legal and licensing language
patterns.context: Describes comment moderation, software distribution, or source code in website disclaimers or open-source licenses.

patterns.name: Structural tokens in proper names
patterns.context: Appears in an alphanumeric cell-line name; this is insufficient to determine whether the trigger is biological semantics or a subword segmentation effect.

patterns.name: Radio station format descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces a station's license coverage area and broadcast format; activations are scattered across different tokens in the sentence.

patterns.name: Quantum-state terminology
patterns.context: Introduces the vector representation of a pure quantum state in quantum information texts; high activations also occur near punctuation and mathematical symbols.

patterns.name: Building descriptions
patterns.context: Historical building entries describe architectural form and dimensions.

patterns.name: RNA interference terminology
patterns.context: Explains the mechanism by which siRNA inhibits gene expression.

patterns.name: Patent geometry descriptions
patterns.context: Describes key geometry, arcs, and distances between centerlines.

10_1110.concept: 跨领域词元/术语片段响应
10_1110.description: 激活散布于多领域文本，常落在术语、普通词、专名或词元碎片上；体育、法律、科技和百科内容均有，未见可靠的单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 术语或复合词边界
patterns.context: 激活落在普通词、专业术语或复合词中的词元，尤其是在词元边界、数字或标点附近；上下文条件不统一。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本：法律、体育、专利、生物医学、百科、数学

patterns.name: 词元化碎片与标记
patterns.context: 对大小写、标点、数字相邻的词元片段也有激活；可能与子词切分或特殊格式有关，但无法从样本确定统一条件。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、代码许可证、专利、论文及百科文本

patterns.name: 事件或实体名称
patterns.context: 出现在体育报道的赛事、场馆、联盟或球队相关描述中；激活分别落在不同类型的词上。

patterns.name: 法律及许可措辞
patterns.context: 网站免责声明或开源许可文本中，描述评论管理、软件分发或作品源代码。
patterns.domain: 网站免责声明、软件许可证

patterns.name: 专名中的结构词元
patterns.context: 出现在细胞系名称的字母数字组合中，不能据此判断是生物学语义触发还是子词切分效应。

patterns.name: 无线电台格式描述
patterns.context: 介绍电台执照覆盖区域及广播格式；激活分散在句中不同词元。

patterns.name: 量子态术语
patterns.context: 量子信息文本中介绍纯量子态的向量表示；高激活还落在标点与数学符号附近。

patterns.name: 建筑物描述
patterns.context: 历史建筑条目描述建筑形制及尺寸。

patterns.name: RNA干扰术语
patterns.context: 解释siRNA抑制基因表达的机制。

patterns.name: 专利几何描述
patterns.context: 描述钥匙几何结构、圆弧与中心线间距。

en.concept: Explanatory introduction of terms, processes, or quantities
en.description: Activations are broadly distributed: patent and legal texts often introduce, define, and name terms; other passages cover process explanations, physical-event modeling, quantitative changes, or component names. The commonality is weak.

patterns.name: Proper-name definitions in legal texts
patterns.context: License text such as GPL defines terms, often using quotation marks, definitional phrasing, and line breaks

patterns.name: Parenthetical introduction of procedural terms
patterns.context: A technical quantity is described first, followed by a parenthetical note specifying what it will be called later

patterns.name: Parenthetical naming of equipment
patterns.context: After describing equipment or a technical solution, a name used later is introduced in parentheses

patterns.name: Parenthetical definition of an abbreviation or term
patterns.context: A technical name is given first, followed by the introduction of an abbreviation using “hereafter referred to as”

patterns.name: Naming or shortening a process name
patterns.context: When explaining a biological mechanism, “process known as” introduces the name of the process

patterns.name: Descriptive introduction of a process
patterns.context: In a causal or mechanistic account, “a process that...” introduces an explanation of a process; there is no parenthetical definition

patterns.name: Model-based description of a process or event
patterns.context: A physical model describes particles moving between events and quantifies events using a rate

patterns.name: Expressions for magnitude of change and factors
patterns.context: Compares the magnitude of parameter changes and expresses the result in orders of magnitude or factors

patterns.name: Naming and explaining a process
patterns.context: A clinical narrative first describes withdrawal from mechanical ventilation and then names the process

patterns.name: Object features and generic names
patterns.context: After describing an eyeglass-frame structure, the text states what a component is commonly called

10_1110.concept: 术语、过程或量的说明性引入
10_1110.description: 激活分布广泛：专利与法律文本中常见术语引入、定义和命名；其他段涉及过程说明、物理事件建模、定量变化或部件称谓。共同点较弱。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的专名定义
patterns.context: GPL 等许可证正文中对术语作定义，常见引号、定义句式及换行

patterns.name: 程序化术语的括号引入
patterns.context: 先描述技术量，再用括号说明该量在后文中的名称

patterns.name: 设备名称的括号式命名
patterns.trigger: «hereinafter»9« occasionally»9 referred« to»4« as»4« the»2« shuttle»4« head»5« system»7
patterns.context: 描述设备或技术方案后，在括号中引入后文使用的名称

patterns.name: 缩写或术语的括号定义
patterns.context: 先给出技术名称，再以“hereafter referred to as”引入缩写

patterns.name: 过程的名称或简称
patterns.context: 解释生物机制时，以“process known as”引出该过程名称

patterns.name: 过程的描述性引入
patterns.context: 因果或机制叙述中，用“a process that...”引出过程说明；没有括号式定义

patterns.name: 过程或事件的模型化描述
patterns.trigger: «trajectory»8 between« scatter»2« events»5 ... at a« rate»9
patterns.context: 物理模型中描述粒子在事件之间运动，并以速率量化事件

patterns.name: 变化幅度与因子表达
patterns.context: 比较参数变化幅度，并用数量级或因子表达结果

patterns.name: 过程命名及解释
patterns.context: 临床叙述中先描述撤离机械通气，再给该过程命名

patterns.name: 物件特征与通用称谓
patterns.context: 描述眼镜框结构后，说明某部件通常被称作什么

en.concept: Word forms and common narrative fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across words such as process/practice and their subword fragments, as well as technical terms, system, numerical changes, and patent structural descriptions; aside from some repeated word forms, there is no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Literal and morphological segmentation of process
patterns.context: Appears in sentences that introduce, name, or explain a process; strong activations cluster on different subword fragments of process, often followed by a process name or mechanism explanation.
patterns.domain: Interdisciplinary papers, medical abstracts, biology articles, and online discussions

patterns.name: The word forms practise/practice
patterns.context: Used at the beginning or within a sentence to introduce actual circumstances or implementation methods; activations land on segmented fragments of practice/practise.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: Activations occur within terms or near intraword subword boundaries, with no unified semantic or contextual condition apparent.

patterns.name: The word system
patterns.context: Refers to a research subject or model system in a physics passage; activation occurs on system.

patterns.name: Expressions comparing changes and quantities
patterns.context: Discusses changes in parameters and the numerical changes they cause, including comparisons of orders of magnitude or multiples.

patterns.name: Patent component and structural descriptions
patterns.context: Continuously describes lenses, frames, and their structural components; strong activations include descriptive phrases such as commonly referred to.

patterns.name: Patent circuit symbols and numerical relationships
patterns.context: Explains the relationship between a threshold voltage and a reference value, and the range of their difference.

10_1110.description: 激活分散于 process/practice 等词及其子词片段，也见技术术语、system、数值变化和专利结构描述；除部分词形重复外，尚无统一语义模式。

patterns.name: process 的字面及词法分段
patterns.trigger: “process”及分段形式“process”“proces”“cess”，包括 “a process”“a process called”“a process termed”“through a process”
patterns.context: 出现在介绍、命名或解释某种过程的句子中；强激活集中于 process 的不同子词片段，常接过程名称或机制说明。
patterns.domain: 跨学科论文、医学摘要、生物学文章及网络讨论

patterns.name: practise/practice 词形
patterns.context: 句首或句中用于引出实际情况、实施方式；激活落在 practice/practise 的分词片段上。

patterns.name: 技术名词的词内片段
patterns.trigger: “resetting”中的“reset”“stochastically”中的“stoch”“printing”中的“print”、以及“weaning”所在的“ventilator”语境
patterns.context: 激活出现在术语或词内子词边界附近，未见统一的语义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文、专利、医学摘要

patterns.name: system 一词
patterns.context: 物理学段落中指研究对象或模型系统；激活在 system 词上。

patterns.name: 变化与数量比较表达
patterns.context: 讨论参数变化及其导致的数值变化，含量级或倍数比较。

patterns.name: 专利技术部件与结构描述
patterns.context: 连续描述镜片、镜框及其结构部件；强激活包含 commonly referred to 等描述性短语。

patterns.name: 专利电路符号与数值关系
patterns.context: 说明阈值电压与参考值的关系及其差值范围。

en.concept: Relations and process descriptions in technical texts
en.description: Activation primarily targets “factor of” and surrounding quantity-ratio expressions, and also the phrase “process known as” introducing a mechanism name. Other occurrences include work in a license, particle-trajectory figure captions, and theoretical descriptions of physical systems, spanning multiple scientific and technical contexts.

patterns.name: “factor of” quantity expressions
patterns.context: Statements about magnitude of change, ratios, or orders of magnitude; the phrase is often preceded by by a and followed by a value or formula
patterns.domain: Scientific papers and patent technical texts

patterns.name: Introducing a process and its name
patterns.context: First a mechanism or process is described, then a term is introduced with known as

patterns.name: Copyright-license context for work
patterns.context: Refers to a program or derivative work subject to a copyright license

patterns.name: Trajectory and particle-diffusion descriptions
patterns.context: A caption describes particle motion in a sample cell and its random reset

patterns.name: Theoretical description of systems and coupling constants
patterns.context: Discusses a limiting system and a case with a negative coupling constant

10_1110.concept: 技术文本中的关系与过程表述
10_1110.description: 主要对“factor of”及其前后数量比例表达激活，也响应“process known as”引出机制名称；另见许可证中的work、粒子轨迹图注和理论物理系统描述，覆盖多个科研与技术语境。

patterns.name: “factor of”数量表达式
patterns.trigger: “factor”后接“of”，常见于“by a factor of [数值]”；包括“factor of two”“factor of 10”“factor of 1/Ns”
patterns.context: 涉及变化幅度、比例或数量级的陈述；该短语周围常有 by a，后接数值或公式
patterns.domain: 科研论文及专利技术文本

patterns.name: 过程及其名称的引入
patterns.trigger: “a process known as”；有时名称被拆开，如“degranulation”
patterns.context: 先描述某种机制或过程，再以 known as 引出术语
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、专利背景文本

patterns.name: work 的版权许可语境
patterns.context: 谈及受版权许可约束的程序或衍生作品

patterns.name: 轨迹及粒子扩散描述
patterns.trigger: “A sample trajectory of a silica particle diffusing”
patterns.context: 图注描述粒子在样品池中的运动及其随机重置

patterns.name: 系统与耦合常数的理论描述
patterns.context: 讨论极限系统及负耦合常数下的情形

en.concept: Quantitative relationships and process descriptions in technical texts
en.description: Primarily responds to expressions of quantitative scaling or multiplicative relationships (especially factor and its numerical value); it also activates on systems, particle motion, and scattering in physics papers, and on professional process descriptions introduced by process in medical and biological texts.

patterns.name: Multiples and scaling factors
patterns.context: Describes a quantity scaling, changing, or being compared by a number, multiple, or ratio; the trigger often falls on factor itself or the number that follows.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, patents, mathematics, and engineering texts

patterns.name: Physical systems and particle dynamics
patterns.context: Discusses system composition, particle motion, or interactions; some examples also involve classical trajectories, scattering events, or coupling parameters.

patterns.name: Medical processes and term definitions
patterns.context: Uses process to introduce or explain a technical process name, concerning mechanical ventilation weaning and RNA interference, respectively.

10_1110.concept: 技术文本中的定量关系与过程描述
10_1110.description: 主要对定量缩放或倍数关系的表达（尤其 factor 及其数值）响应；另对物理论文中的系统、粒子运动与散射，以及医学和生物学中以 process 引出的专业过程描述有激活。

patterns.name: 倍数与比例因子
patterns.trigger: “factor”及紧邻的数值或比例，如 “factor 10”、“factor of 1/Ns”、“factor of 10”、“factor of two”
patterns.context: 描述某量按一个数值、倍数或比例缩放、变化或比较；触发常落在 factor 本身或其后的数值上。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、专利、数学与工程技术文本

patterns.name: 物理系统与粒子动力学
patterns.context: 讨论系统构成、粒子运动或相互作用；部分例子同时涉及经典轨迹、散射事件或耦合参数。

patterns.name: 医学过程与术语定义
patterns.trigger: “process called ‘weaning’”以及“process known as RNA interference”
patterns.context: 以 process 引出或解释一个专业过程名称，分别涉及机械通气撤机和 RNA 干扰。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、生物医学研究

en.concept: Quantification and process descriptions in scientific texts
en.description: Strong activation occurs on rate parameters, factor-of expressions, and phrases naming processes; it is also sensitive to descriptions of particle motion in physical contexts, including particle, trajectory, and scattering. The pattern spans scientific, patent, and medical texts.

patterns.name: Statistical/physical parameter use of “rate”
patterns.context: rate is followed by a value or a parameter describing frequency of occurrence, magnitude of change, or scattering frequency; examples include random resets, population changes, and scattering events.

patterns.name: “a factor of” multiplier expressions
patterns.context: Describes by what factor a quantity increases, decreases, or changes, followed by a value, radical, or approximation; sometimes emphasizes the ratio relative to a baseline.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, patent background, medical abstracts

patterns.name: “process” as a noun for a process
patterns.context: process is followed by naming, definition, or explanation, referring to a physical or clinical process described earlier.

patterns.name: Physical descriptions of particle motion and scattering
patterns.context: Particles are described as moving along trajectories, diffusing, or scattering in events, in a physical modeling context.

10_1110.concept: 科学文本中的量化与过程表述
10_1110.description: 对 rate 参数、factor of 倍数表达及 process 命名短语有强激活；另对物理语境中 particle、trajectory、scattering 等粒子运动描述敏感。模式跨科学、专利和医学文本。

patterns.name: “rate”的统计/物理参数用法
patterns.context: rate 后接数值或描述发生频率、变化幅度、散射频率等的参数；包括随机重置、人口变化和散射事件。

patterns.name: “a factor of”倍数表达
patterns.context: 描述某量增加、减少或变化的倍数，后接数值、根式或近似量；有时强调相比基准的倍率。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、专利背景、医学摘要

patterns.name: “process”过程名词
patterns.context: process 后接命名、定义或说明，指代前文描述的物理过程或临床过程。

patterns.name: 粒子运动与散射的物理描述
patterns.context: 粒子被描述为沿轨迹运动、扩散或在事件中散射，且处于物理建模语境。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to “a process” and nearby expressions in scientific explanations that introduce or name a mechanism, including “known as,” “called,” and “termed,” and covers examples from different fields. There are also word-final fragments in random-reset contexts and activations near “factor of two.”

patterns.name: Naming or defining a process
patterns.context: A process phrase is followed by a name, term, or explanatory clause describing the mechanism just mentioned; it may include the indefinite article “a” or omit it ([10] “through a process that…”).
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, medical abstracts, patent backgrounds, and technical discussions

patterns.name: The word process itself
patterns.context: When describing a preceding mechanism, step, or phenomenon, markers cluster near process; in [2]–[8], the word directly activates. [10] also contains “a process that…”.
patterns.domain: Scientific and technical explanatory writing across domains, also seen in online discussions

patterns.name: Word forms or related forms of process
patterns.context: No clear “a process” naming structure is apparent; in [1], the marker falls on a word-final fragment, and the same passage also marks a number and “rate.” In [9], markers cluster around “factor of two.”
patterns.domain: [1] random process paper; [9] communication complexity paper

10_1110.concept: 过程命名表达及邻近词
10_1110.description: 主要对科学说明中引入或命名机制的“a process”及其邻近表述强烈响应，包括“known as”“called”“termed”等，也覆盖不同领域的实例。另有随机重置语境的词尾片段和“factor of two”附近激活。

patterns.name: 过程的命名或定义
patterns.trigger: “a process”后接“known as”“called”“referred to as”“termed”，或直接接描述性从句；如 [2] “a process known as ‘chromospheric evaporation’”、[4] “a process that is referred to as…”
patterns.context: 过程短语之后用名称、术语或解释性从句说明刚提到的机制；可带不定冠词“a”，也可不带冠词（[10] “through a process that…”）。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、医学摘要、专利背景及技术讨论

patterns.name: 过程一词本身
patterns.trigger: “process”，尤其是“a process”；[2]–[8]附近均标记 process
patterns.context: 描述先前机制、步骤或现象时，标记集中在 process 附近；[2]–[8]中该词直接激活。[10]亦出现“a process that…”。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的科学与技术说明文字，也见网络讨论

patterns.name: 过程词的词形或相关形式
patterns.context: 未见清楚的“a process”命名结构；[1]标记落在词尾片段，且同段还标记数值与“rate”。[9]标记集中于“factor of two”一带。
patterns.domain: [1]随机过程论文；[9]通信复杂度论文

en.description: Activations often occur on terms for processes, phenomena, and structures in scientific texts, especially mechanism names and explanations. Sporadic patterns also include license wording, proper-name titles, and source-code formatting symbols, with no single consistent trigger condition.

patterns.name: Modifiers before process nouns
patterns.context: Abstract or technical nouns summarize or refer to a mechanism, phenomenon, property, or structure; often appear in explanatory sentences
patterns.domain: Research papers, medical abstracts, and technical explanations

patterns.name: Process labels and mechanism terminology
patterns.context: Specialized terms name biological, genetic, medical, or physical processes, often introduced or explained by descriptive phrases

patterns.name: Technical terms for relations or structures
patterns.context: Nouns describing spatial, geometric, organizational, or physical relations, near prepositions, directions, or structural descriptions
patterns.domain: Scientific papers and popular science texts

patterns.name: Legal wording in licenses
patterns.context: License terms describe incorporating software, creating derivative works, and applicable conditions; activation is especially concentrated on “collectively”

patterns.name: Words in proper names and titles
patterns.context: Words in film entries or paper titles, with no clear semantic trigger shared with other passages

patterns.name: Formatting symbols and markers
patterns.context: Line breaks, lists, quotations, or LaTeX document source; activation may relate to special formatting tokens
patterns.domain: Code, forum quotations, academic document source

10_1110.description: 激活多见于科学文本中的过程、现象及结构术语，尤其是机制命名和说明；另有许可证措辞、专名标题及源码排版符号等零散模式，触发条件并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 过程名词前的定语
patterns.context: 抽象或技术性名词用于概括、指称某种机制、现象、性质或结构；常出现在解释性句子中
patterns.domain: 科研论文、医学摘要及技术说明

patterns.name: 过程标签及机制术语
patterns.context: 专业术语命名生物、遗传、医学或物理过程，常由说明性短语引出或解释
patterns.domain: 生物医学、物理与科学文本

patterns.name: 关系或结构类技术词
patterns.context: 描述空间、几何、组织或物理关系的名词，邻近介词、方位或结构说明

patterns.name: 许可证法律措辞
patterns.context: 许可条款中说明整合软件、制作衍生作品及其条件；激活特别集中于“collectively”

patterns.name: 专名与标题中的词语
patterns.context: 电影条目或论文标题中的词语，未见与其他段落相同的明确语义触发条件
patterns.domain: 维基百科条目、论文标题

patterns.name: 排版符号与标记
patterns.context: 换行、列表、引用或 LaTeX 文档源码；激活可能与特殊格式 token 相关
patterns.domain: 代码、论坛引用、学术文档源码

en.description: Primarily responds to explanatory naming constructions, especially “a process” followed by known as, termed, or called; it also responds to local expressions such as phenomenon called, degree, formerly, and also called in parentheses.

patterns.name: “a process” definition construction
patterns.context: “a process” is followed by an explanatory phrase such as “known as,” “termed,” or “called,” often naming or explaining a process or mechanism; the strongest activations occur in passages 1–3, and it also appears in passages 5, 6, and 9.
patterns.domain: Scientific, medical, and patent explanatory texts

patterns.name: Naming a phenomenon or effect
patterns.context: “phenomenon” is followed by “called” and a specific name, introducing a physical phenomenon; “a process” does not appear.

patterns.name: Degree or threshold expression
patterns.context: “to a degree” introduces a degree or threshold beyond which subsequent manufacturing cannot continue; it does not fit the definition construction.

patterns.name: Retrospective note after a team name
patterns.context: A team description uses “formerly” to explain a former name or status; there is no process-definition expression.

patterns.name: Flash Cookie naming explanation
patterns.context: Parentheses explain the type of cookie collected by Flash media player and its alternate name, Local Shared Object; “called” occurs, but not “a process.”

10_1110.concept: 说明性命名与定义表达
10_1110.description: 主要响应说明性命名句式，尤其“a process”后接 known as、termed、called；也响应 phenomenon called、degree、formerly及括号中的 also called 等局部表达。

patterns.name: “a process”定义句式
patterns.context: “a process”后接说明性短语，如“known as”“termed”“called”，常在解释某种过程的名称或机制；第1–3段强度最高，第5、6、9段也出现。

patterns.name: 现象或效应的命名
patterns.context: “phenomenon”后接“called”及具体名称，介绍物理现象；未出现“a process”。

patterns.name: 程度或阈值表达
patterns.context: “to a degree”引出使后续制造无法继续的程度或阈值，不符合定义句式。

patterns.name: 球队名称之后的回顾性说明
patterns.trigger: team⁹, formerly⁸ the Southern League version⁵
patterns.context: 球队介绍中以“formerly”说明旧称或旧身份；无定义过程表达。

patterns.name: Flash Cookie称谓说明
patterns.context: 括号内解释 Flash media player 收集的 cookie 类型及其别名 Local Shared Object；虽有“called”，但没有“a process”。

en.concept: Mechanism and terminology explanations in specialized texts
en.description: Activations commonly occur in specialized explanations describing regions, systems, or biomedical entities, and especially highlight “process” and the process-naming structure that follows it. Other activations appear in classification terms, formula symbols, climate word forms, and film entries, which cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Introducing a process/mechanism name
patterns.context: Describes how a phenomenon or result occurs through a process, or names the process; found across technical expository texts

patterns.name: Scientific descriptions of mechanisms, systems, or materials
patterns.context: Describes the properties and behavior of physical regions, theoretical systems, probability distributions, or biological materials in specialized explanations
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, theoretical physics, condensed matter physics, biomedicine

patterns.name: Regional climate and geographic divisions
patterns.context: Introduces a place, climate, or land region and describes its extent, characteristics, or classification

patterns.name: Explanations of classifications, labels, or terminology
patterns.context: Explains specialized classifications, abbreviations, names, or concepts
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, climatology, medicine, and scientific expository texts

patterns.name: Biomedical entities and their effects
patterns.context: Mentions diseases, immune responses, molecules, or gene expression, often describing causal effects or functions
patterns.domain: Patent background, online discussions, biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: Regional or compound-name boundaries in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation falls on geographic phrases containing spaces or compound proper nouns split into subword fragments; no clear semantic pattern

patterns.name: Word-form fragment in a climate-season term
patterns.context: Activation spans the tokenized “winters” in descriptions of seasonal climate

patterns.name: Year and punctuation in film entries
patterns.context: Film encyclopedia entries describing works, release years, and cast; no clear relation to the scientific mechanism pattern in other passages

patterns.name: Quantum-state symbols and mathematical notation
patterns.context: Activation occurs near formulas and state-vector notation; the text describes states, wave functions, and energy

patterns.name: Specialized abbreviations and compound terms
patterns.context: Medical or biological texts use abbreviations and explain their meaning or function in nearby text

10_1110.concept: 专业文本中的机制与术语说明
10_1110.description: 激活常见于专业说明中描述区域、系统或生物医学实体，并尤其突出“process”及其后的过程命名结构；也散见于分类术语、公式符号、气候词形和电影条目，不能由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 过程/机制名称引入
patterns.context: 描述某种现象或结果如何通过一个过程发生，或给过程命名；跨学科技术说明文

patterns.name: 机制、系统或材料的科学描述
patterns.context: 在专业说明中描述物理区域、理论系统、概率分布或生物材料的性质及行为
patterns.domain: 天体物理、理论物理、凝聚态物理、生物医学

patterns.name: 区域气候与地理分区
patterns.context: 介绍地点、气候或地表区域，并说明其范围、特征或分类

patterns.name: 分类、标签或术语说明
patterns.context: 解释专业分类、缩写、名称或概念
patterns.domain: 百科、气候学、医学与科学说明文

patterns.name: 生物医学实体及其效应
patterns.context: 提及疾病、免疫反应、分子或基因表达，常描述因果作用或功能
patterns.domain: 专利背景、网络讨论、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 专名中的区域或复合词边界
patterns.context: 激活落在带空格的地理短语或被子词切分的复合专名上；具体语义模式不明显

patterns.name: 气候季节词中的词形片段
patterns.context: 激活跨越被切分的“winters”，出现在季节气候描述中

patterns.name: 电影条目中的年份及标点
patterns.context: 电影百科条目，叙述作品、发行年份和演员；与其他段的科学机制模式不明显

patterns.name: 量子态符号及数学记号
patterns.context: 激活位于公式及态矢记号附近，正文描述状态、波函数和能量
patterns.domain: 理论物理、数学排版文本

patterns.name: 专业缩写及复合术语
patterns.context: 医学或生物学文本使用缩写，并在邻近文字中说明其含义或功能
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、生物医学文本

en.description: Activations span domains without a single stable theme: they often involve terminology introductions and regime classifications, and also occur with stochastic model parameters, spatial structures, game in soccer match accounts, and collectively in licenses.

patterns.name: Defining or introducing a term
patterns.context: First describes an object or process, then introduces its name with referred to as, known as, or called; activation concentrates on words near the name introduction.
patterns.domain: Patents, astrophysics, planetary geology, immunology expository texts

patterns.name: Descriptions of regimes and their classifications
patterns.context: Discusses states, parameter ranges, or classifications of physical or mathematical systems, often alongside regime(s) and their qualifiers or divisions.

patterns.name: Random distributions and model parameters
patterns.context: Describes randomly sampled state energies or parameters in a theoretical model; occurs in a single passage.

patterns.name: Regions or divisions of spatial structures
patterns.context: Discusses regions, branches, or structures in space; may overlap with other patterns, but is not itself a stable trigger condition.

patterns.name: A decisive goal in a match
patterns.context: Sports narratives describe a match and the goal that decides its outcome; activation concentrates on game.

patterns.name: Collective designation in license terms
patterns.context: A software license uses collectively to introduce a collective term for previously mentioned objects; activation concentrates on collectively.

10_1110.description: 激活跨领域且无单一稳定主题：多见术语命名引介、regime分类，也涉及随机模型参数、空间结构、足球比赛中的game及许可证中的collectively。

patterns.name: 术语界定或命名引介
patterns.trigger: “commonly referred to as a cushion”（3）；“a process known as ‘chromospheric evaporation’”（4）；“a region called the Martian dichotomy”（6）；“a process known as degranulation”（8）
patterns.context: 先描述对象或过程，随后用 referred to as、known as、called 引出名称；激活集中在名称引介附近的词。
patterns.domain: 专利、天体物理、行星地质、免疫学说明文

patterns.name: regime及其分类描述
patterns.trigger: “coexistence regime”（2）；“regimes where”；“Two regimes can be distinguished”；“the regime of”（7）
patterns.context: 讨论物理或数学系统的状态、参数范围或分类，常伴随 regime(s) 及其限定、划分。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理、数学/理论研究

patterns.name: 随机分布及模型参数
patterns.context: 描述理论模型中随机取样的状态能量或参数；单段出现。

patterns.name: 空间结构的区域或分区
patterns.trigger: “a manifold of linear branches in momentum space”（9）；“region”（6）；“zones”（6）
patterns.context: 讨论空间中的区域、分支或结构；与其他模式可能交叠，但本身并非稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: 比赛中的关键进球
patterns.trigger: “a crucial winning goal”；邻近“game”激活最强（1）
patterns.context: 体育叙事中描述某场比赛及决定胜负的进球；激活集中在 game。

patterns.name: 许可证条款中的集合称谓
patterns.context: 软件许可证以 collectively 引出对前述对象的统称；激活集中在 collectively。

en.description: Activations cover relational and explanatory wording across diverse texts: spatial regions/ranges, component structure, team sports, event coverage, physical states and mechanisms, theoretical parameters, biomedical definitions, and product comparisons; there is no single narrow topic.

patterns.name: Regions, ranges, and subdivisions
patterns.context: Describes an object's location, extent, distribution, or division into regions in space; sometimes adjacent to geographic proper names.

patterns.name: Structural components and their relationships
patterns.context: Specific components connect, extend, or fit together spatially, with dense noun phrases.

patterns.name: Teams, events, and sports results
patterns.context: Describes teams, leagues, or games; may include season performance, home venues, and team histories.

patterns.name: Date and event coverage
patterns.context: Introduces an event, talk, and its topic with a specific date.

patterns.name: States, wavefunctions, and random distributions
patterns.context: Describes a physical system and its energy distribution using mathematical symbols and state variables.

patterns.name: Naming a process or mechanism
patterns.context: Explains a physical process occurring in a particular region or names a mechanism with a technical term.

patterns.name: Roles, parameters, and nonlinear terms in theory
patterns.context: Explains the role, constant, or model term of a theoretical object, accompanied by formulas.

patterns.name: Product batches and attribute comparisons
patterns.context: Introduces a new product and differences in its attributes compared with earlier versions.

patterns.name: Biomedical definitions and functions
patterns.context: First defines a biomolecule, then describes its target and inhibitory mechanism.

10_1110.description: 激活覆盖多种文本中的关系与说明性措辞：空间区域/范围、部件结构、团队赛事、活动报道、物理状态与机制、理论参数、生物医学定义及产品对比；未见单一狭窄主题。

patterns.name: 区域、范围与分区
patterns.context: 描述某物在空间中的位置、范围、分布或区域划分；有时与地理专名相邻。

patterns.name: 结构部件及其相互关系
patterns.context: 具体部件按空间关系连接、延伸或适配，包含密集的名词短语。

patterns.name: 团队、赛事与体育结果
patterns.context: 叙述球队、联盟或比赛；可包括赛季表现、主场及球队沿革。

patterns.name: 日期与活动报道
patterns.context: 以具体日期介绍一场活动、演讲及其主题。
patterns.domain: 机构网站新闻/活动公告

patterns.name: 状态、波函数与随机分布
patterns.context: 以数学符号和状态变量描述物理系统及其能量分布。

patterns.name: 过程或机制的命名
patterns.context: 说明发生在特定区域的物理过程，或用术语命名机制。

patterns.name: 理论中的作用、参数与非线性项
patterns.context: 解释理论对象的作用、常数或模型项，并伴有公式。

patterns.name: 产品批次与属性对比
patterns.context: 介绍新产品及其与先前版本的属性差异。

patterns.name: 生物医学定义与功能
patterns.trigger: «Short» interfering RNAs、«designed» to suppress the «expression» of homologous «genes»
patterns.context: 先定义生物分子，再说明其靶向对象和抑制机制。

en.description: Activations often occur in “a process” and its mechanism explanations, and also in descriptions of regions/parts, sports teams and matches. Other activations cover distribution parameters and nonlinear terms in physics texts, making it difficult to assign a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: “process” and its explanatory collocations
patterns.context: Refers to a mechanism, process, or effect, often after preceding text describes its steps or outcome; this pattern occurs in scientific explanations, forum discussions, and patent text.

patterns.name: Nouns for regions or parts
patterns.context: Refers to a region or part of a geographic, spatial, or structural entity; sometimes appears in comparisons or descriptions of spatial relations.

patterns.name: Sports teams and match accounts
patterns.context: Accounts of professional or minor-league teams, matches, and team histories.

patterns.name: Distribution/parameter in academic noun phrases
patterns.context: Describes states, energy, and random distributions in quantum or theoretical physics contexts.

patterns.name: Arbitrary nonlinear terms in theory
patterns.context: Mathematical physics descriptions of field theory or Lagrangians.

10_1110.description: 激活常见于“a process”及其机制说明，也见于区域/部分、体育队伍与比赛叙述；另覆盖物理文本中的分布参数和非线性项，难以归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: “process”及其说明性搭配
patterns.trigger: “a process”及后续“that”“known as”等说明性结构
patterns.context: 表示某种机制、过程或效应，常由前文描述其步骤或结果；该模式出现在科学说明、论坛讨论和专利文字中。

patterns.name: 区域或部分的名词
patterns.context: 指地理、空间或结构中的区域/部分；有时位于对比或空间关系的描述中。

patterns.name: 体育队伍与比赛叙述
patterns.context: 职业或小联盟球队、比赛及队伍沿革的叙述。

patterns.name: 学术名词短语中的分布/参数
patterns.context: 量子或理论物理语境中，描述状态、能量及随机分布。

patterns.name: 理论中的任意非线性项
patterns.context: 场论或拉格朗日量的数学物理描述。

en.description: Strong activations are distributed across scientific and medical mechanism descriptions, spatial regions and structural descriptions, and sports match accounts. In several scientific passages, process activates when steps or causal mechanisms are introduced; there are also isolated highly activated words such as game and region, which do not fit a single lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Naming a process or process mechanism
patterns.context: After describing multiple steps, a causal chain, or a specific phenomenon, the noun process follows; often near structures such as that or known as. The region in [1] likewise appears in a sentence naming a region, but is not process.

patterns.name: Match event or game scenario
patterns.context: Sports narratives introduce a match and its opponents, outcome, or key events; weaker evidence includes «winning» and «goal».
patterns.domain: Basketball, soccer, and other sports news or biographies

patterns.name: Spatial region or local structure
patterns.context: Describes spatial extent, an object's location, or a structure in an experimental apparatus; sometimes embedded in scientific explanations.

patterns.name: Local activations in specialized terms or mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Technical texts contain domain terminology, formulas, or specific entities; there is no single shared lexical trigger, and these may accompany concept or mechanism explanations.

10_1110.description: 强激活分散于科学与医学机制描述、空间区域和结构描写，以及体育比赛叙述。多个科学段落在介绍步骤或因果机制时激活 process；另有 game、region 等孤立高激活词，难归为同一词面模式。

patterns.name: 过程或过程机制的命名
patterns.context: 在描述多个步骤、因果链或特定现象后，接名词 process；常与 that、known as 等结构相邻。[1] 的 region 同样处于对某区域命名的句式中，但并非 process。
patterns.domain: 跨领域说明性、学术性文本

patterns.name: 比赛事件或比赛场景
patterns.context: 体育叙述中介绍一场比赛及其对手、结果或关键事件；较弱证据包括 «winning» 和 «goal»。
patterns.domain: 篮球、足球等体育新闻或传记

patterns.name: 空间区域或局部结构
patterns.context: 描述空间范围、物体所在位置或实验装置中的实体结构；有时嵌入科学说明。
patterns.domain: 行星科学、物理学、实验方法

patterns.name: 专业术语或数学表达中的局部激活
patterns.context: 技术文本中出现领域术语、公式或特定实体；没有共同的单一词面触发条件，可能与概念解释或机制说明相伴。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、物理学、天体物理学

en.concept: Category and mechanism descriptions in expository texts
en.description: Activations occur across several kinds of nominalized expository text: mechanisms and processes, regional classifications, product or game feature introductions, formal names and aliases, and mathematical structures and material layers. There is no single stable lexical trigger; clearer local cues include process, regional nouns, and also known as.

patterns.name: process in process or mechanism explanations
patterns.context: process itself activates when explaining an effect, causal chain, or biological mechanism; surrounding text describes the mechanism's steps or outcome.
patterns.domain: Life sciences, medicine, and popular science discussions

patterns.name: Lowland topographic regions and regional divisions
patterns.context: Geographic categories and regional nouns activate when describing two types of Martian terrain belts and the region between them.

patterns.name: Naming and describing a French fries product
patterns.context: Activates in news accounts of a fast-food brand launching a new kind of fries and describing its name and nutritional features.

patterns.name: Multiplayer game mode
patterns.context: Activates when describing a game adding a new online multiplayer mode and the number of players.

patterns.name: Introducing legal names or formal abbreviations
patterns.context: First gives the name of a law or competition, then introduces its abbreviation or alias with also known as.
patterns.domain: Patent background, encyclopedias, and formal expository texts

patterns.name: Grid structures in discrete mathematics
patterns.context: Introduces a two-dimensional lattice and node indices in a mathematical problem statement.

patterns.name: Thin-film materials and their properties
patterns.context: Patent technical descriptions discuss silicon oxide films, dielectric properties, or aliases for material layers.

10_1110.concept: 说明性文本中的类别与机制描述
10_1110.description: 激活分布于多类名词化说明文本：机制与过程、区域分类、产品或游戏功能介绍、正式名称别称，以及数学结构和材料层描述。没有单一稳定的词面触发；较明显的局部线索包括 process、区域名词与 also known as。

patterns.name: 过程或机制说明中的 process
patterns.context: 在说明某种作用、因果链或生物机制时，process 本身被激活；其前后描述机制的步骤或结果。
patterns.domain: 生命科学、医学及科普讨论

patterns.name: 低地形区及区域划分
patterns.context: 描述火星表面两种地形带及其间区域时，地理空间类别和区域名词附近激活。

patterns.name: 薯条产品命名及描述
patterns.context: 在快餐品牌推出新款薯条、介绍名称及营养特点的新闻叙述中激活。

patterns.name: 多人游戏模式
patterns.context: 介绍游戏新增在线多人模式及玩家规模时激活。

patterns.name: 法律名称或正式缩写介绍
patterns.context: 先写法律或赛事名称，再以 also known as 引出其缩写或别名。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、百科及正式说明文

patterns.name: 离散数学中的网格结构
patterns.context: 数学问题表述中介绍二维格点及节点索引。

patterns.name: 薄膜材料及其性质
patterns.context: 专利技术说明中讨论硅氧化物薄膜、介电性质或材料层的别称。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to process and sentence constructions explaining processes or mechanisms. It also appears in unrelated contexts such as geographic subdivisions, legal abbreviation explanations, new product naming, the REM model, game content, and quantum-state distributions; these secondary patterns cannot be fully explained by a single semantic rule.

patterns.name: Process as a process marker
patterns.context: The trigger is the noun process, especially when followed by that or known as; it introduces a mechanism or step.
patterns.domain: Scientific, medical, and general explanatory texts

patterns.name: Near process and mechanism terms
patterns.context: Occurs in contexts describing how an entity changes, produces a result, or performs a function; related to process-explanation constructions, but the activation does not necessarily fall on process.

patterns.name: Geographic regions and boundaries
patterns.context: Describes regions on a planetary surface and their relative positions, extents, or subdivisions; the strongest trigger is “region.”

patterns.name: Legal names and abbreviation explanations
patterns.context: Appears when introducing a law and its abbreviation; activations cluster on “also.”

patterns.name: New product launches and naming
patterns.context: Describes a fast-food chain launching a new product, its attributes, and its name; activations cluster on “batch,” “fries,” and a comma.

patterns.name: REM model and state energies
patterns.context: Introduces model components and state energies in theoretical or mathematical physics texts; activations land near state counts and punctuation.

patterns.name: Game content and multiplayer modes
patterns.context: Introduces in-game decorations and a newly added multiplayer mode; activations cluster on “mode” and the punctuation around it.

patterns.name: Quantum states, wavefunctions, and random distributions
patterns.context: Describes states, their spatial positions, energy, and random distributions in mathematical physics; activations cluster on wavefunction, site, and distribution.

10_1110.description: 主要对“process”及过程机制说明句式强烈响应，也出现在地理分区、法律简称说明、新品命名、REM 模型、游戏内容和量子态分布等彼此不同的上下文；这些旁支模式无法由单一语义规则完全解释。

patterns.name: 过程标记词 process
patterns.context: 触发点是名词 process，尤其在其后接 that 或 known as 时；用于引出某种机制或步骤。
patterns.domain: 科学、医学及一般说明文

patterns.name: 过程及机制术语附近
patterns.trigger: “process”前后对机制、步骤或因果链的描述，如 “cleavage”“refold”“fusion”“damages gut microbes”“chromospheric evaporation”“RNA interference”
patterns.context: 在描述实体如何发生变化、产生结果或实现功能的上下文中；与过程说明句式相关，但激活不一定落在 process 上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、天体物理及技术说明

patterns.name: 地理区域与边界
patterns.context: 描述行星表面区域及其相对位置、范围或分区；最强触发为 “region”。

patterns.name: 法律名称和缩写说明
patterns.context: 在介绍法律及其简称时出现；激活集中在 “also”。

patterns.name: 新产品推出及命名
patterns.context: 描述快餐连锁推出新品、产品属性及命名；激活集中在 “batch”“fries”及逗号。

patterns.name: REM 模型与状态能量
patterns.context: 理论或数学物理文本中介绍模型组成及状态能量；激活落在状态数与标点附近。

patterns.name: 游戏内容与多人模式
patterns.context: 介绍游戏内装饰物及新增多人游戏模式；激活集中在 “mode”及其前后的标点。

patterns.name: 量子态、波函数与随机分布
patterns.context: 数学物理中描述态及其空间位置、能量和随机分布；激活集中在 wavefunction、site 与 distribution。

en.description: The most stable cue is “process” in explanations of mechanisms or changes, commonly in scientific texts. Activations also respond to regions, spatial extent, and “also known as” naming structures, as well as series works and sports contexts.

patterns.name: “process” and its explanatory collocations
patterns.context: Describes how a mechanism, change, or phenomenon occurs, especially in scientific process explanations; the strongest and recurring pattern across different fields.

patterns.name: Region or spatial area
patterns.context: Refers to a geographic or physical region, extent, or part; sometimes connected to descriptions of spatial location.

patterns.name: “also known as” naming structure
patterns.context: Adds an alias or formal name, followed by the name of an organization, law, or competition.

patterns.name: Series works and media
patterns.context: Introduces a series of works and their medium or release platform.

patterns.name: Competition and team background
patterns.context: Information about youth competitions and participating teams in accounts of an athlete's career.

10_1110.description: 最稳定的线索是说明机制或变化的“process”，常见于科学文本；另对区域、空间范围及“also known as”命名结构有反应，也涉及系列作品和体育赛事语境。

patterns.name: “process”及其解释性搭配
patterns.context: 描述某种机制、变化或现象如何发生，尤其是科学文本中的过程说明；最强且重复出现于不同领域。
patterns.domain: 科学、生物医学与技术说明

patterns.name: 区域或空间区域
patterns.context: 指地理或物理空间中的区域、范围或部分；有时与空间位置描述相连。

patterns.name: “also known as”命名结构
patterns.context: 补充别名或正式名称，后接机构、法律或赛事名称。

patterns.name: 系列作品与媒介
patterns.context: 介绍某一系列作品及其媒介或发布平台。

patterns.name: 赛事及球队背景
patterns.context: 运动员生涯叙述中的青年赛事和参赛队伍信息。

en.concept: Introducing explanations of processes and names
en.description: Activations commonly occur with “process” followed by an explanation of its function or a process name, and also with alias or terminology introductions such as “also known as/termed.” Other examples involving regional descriptions and product naming are sporadic.

patterns.name: “process” followed by a relative clause
patterns.context: Describes how a process functions or gives the process a name; also includes similar expressions where “termed” introduces a name.
patterns.domain: Scientific abstracts, medicine/biology, and online discussions; covers [1][2][6][8]

patterns.name: “also known as” naming expression
patterns.context: Adds an alias for an entity; common at the beginning of encyclopedia entries and also found in legal texts introducing a law's name.

patterns.name: “also termed” terminology clarification
patterns.context: After first giving a disease or medical entity, names it with another term.

patterns.name: “areas/zones/region” in noun phrases and their spatial relations
patterns.context: Describes regions on geographic or planetary surfaces and their spatial distribution.

patterns.name: Tokenization of “fries” and naming structure
patterns.context: In a fast-food product report, the food name is split across tokens, and the new product name is introduced later.

10_1110.concept: 过程与名称的说明引介
10_1110.description: 激活常见于“process”后说明作用机制或命名过程，也常见于“also known as/termed”这类别名、术语引介；另有区域描述和产品命名的零散例子。

patterns.name: “process”及其后接关系从句
patterns.trigger: “process”后接“that”或“known as”，如“in a process that”“by a process known as”
patterns.context: 描述某种过程如何发挥作用，或说明过程名称；也包括“termed”引出名称的近似表达。
patterns.domain: 科学摘要、医学/生物学与网络讨论；覆盖[1][2][6][8]

patterns.name: “also known as”命名表达
patterns.trigger: “also known as”，并伴随名称、缩写或别名
patterns.context: 补充实体的别称；多见于百科条目开头，也见于法律文本介绍法案名称。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、专利背景；覆盖[3][4][5]

patterns.name: “also termed”术语释义
patterns.context: 在先给出疾病或医学对象后，以另一术语命名。

patterns.name: 名词短语中的“areas/zones/region”及其空间关系
patterns.trigger: “areas”“zones”“region”，以及“Between these two zones is a region”
patterns.context: 描述地理或行星表面的区域及其空间分布。
patterns.domain: 行星科学百科文本；覆盖[10]

patterns.name: “fries”拼写切分及命名结构
patterns.context: 快餐产品报道中，食物名称被跨 token 切分，后文介绍新品名称。

en.description: The clearest shared trigger is “process” in scientific mechanism descriptions, especially followed by that, termed, or called. “also” also repeatedly activates in terminology and alias definitions. Other activations involve geographic zones and mathematical physics terminology, with weaker regularity.

patterns.name: process in process phrases
patterns.context: Describes a mechanism, step, or change; common structures include “a process that …”, “a process termed …”, or “a process called …”.

patterns.name: Wording for naming or defining
patterns.context: Adds an alias, formal name, or explanation after a term, abbreviation, or name; does not require process.
patterns.domain: Legal, medical, sports, and product descriptions

patterns.name: zones for geographic regions
patterns.context: Describes two types of regions on the Martian surface and the transition region between them.

patterns.name: Mathematical physics spaces and variable terminology
patterns.context: Discusses a projection operator acting on a function space and introduces a subset of slow variables; the main pattern's process or also known is absent.

10_1110.description: 最明显的共同触发是科学机制描述中的“process”，尤其接 that、termed 或 called；另在术语别名定义处反复激活“also”。其余激活涉及地理 zones 与数学物理术语，规律较弱。

patterns.name: process 短语中的 process
patterns.context: 描述某种机制、步骤或变化过程；常见结构为“a process that …”“a process termed …”或“a process called …”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、科学说明及讨论

patterns.name: 命名或定义用语
patterns.context: 在术语、缩写或名称后补充别名、正式名称或解释；本身不要求出现 process。
patterns.domain: 法律、医学、体育及产品介绍

patterns.name: 地理区域的 zones
patterns.context: 描述火星表面两类区域及其之间的过渡区域。

patterns.name: 数学物理空间与变量术语
patterns.context: 讲述投影算子作用于函数空间，并介绍慢变量子集；未见主模式中的 process 或 also known。

en.description: Activations tend toward structural words that introduce mechanisms, aliases, regions, sets, categories, or properties in explanatory texts; “process” and “also known as” are especially prominent, but the examples span multiple fields and syntactic contexts.

patterns.name: Process/mechanism expressions
patterns.context: Uses “a process” to introduce a biological or causal mechanism, followed by “that” and its function or result; activation clusters on process.

patterns.name: “also known as” alias explanation
patterns.context: Adds an alias, abbreviation, or trade name after a term or name; activation falls on also or nearby in the phrase.

patterns.name: Regional divisions and naming with “region”
patterns.context: Describes neighboring geographic regions and introduces a region name; this example concerns Martian landform divisions.

patterns.name: Article before an organization name
patterns.context: The article in “a new organization” activates, followed by an organization type and name.

patterns.name: Sets and variables in technical noun phrases
patterns.context: A special subset of a function appears in a mathematical physics text and is called a countable set; activation occurs on “set.”

patterns.name: Material product categories
patterns.context: Introduces a company's product types, followed by product names or uses.

patterns.name: Property description of a junction structure
patterns.context: First names Holliday junction, then introduces a property of the structure.

10_1110.concept: 说明性文本中的结构引介词
10_1110.description: 激活偏向说明性文本中引入机制、别名、区域、集合、类别或性质的结构词；尤其突出“process”和“also known as”，但涵盖多个领域与不同句法环境。

patterns.name: 过程/机制表述
patterns.context: 以“a process”引出某种生物或因果机制，后接“that”及其作用或结果；激活集中在 process。

patterns.name: “also known as”别名说明
patterns.context: 在术语或名称后补充别称、缩写或商品名；激活落在 also 或该短语附近。

patterns.name: 区域划分及“region”命名
patterns.context: 描述相邻地理区域，并引入一个区域名称；本例为火星地貌分区。

patterns.name: 组织名称前的冠词
patterns.context: “a new organization”中冠词处激活，后接组织类别及名称。

patterns.name: 专业名词短语中的集合与变量
patterns.context: 数学物理文本中出现函数的特殊子集，并称其为可数集合；激活在“set”。

patterns.name: 材料产品类别
patterns.context: 介绍某公司的产品种类，后接产品名称或用途。

patterns.name: 交界结构的性质描述
patterns.context: 先命名 Holliday junction，再引出该结构具有的性质。

en.concept: Structural words in relation or process descriptions
en.description: Primarily responds to process introducing a process and its subsequent effects in mechanism explanations. It also responds to specific narrative terms involving regional divisions, mathematical sets, former names, patent components, legal aliases, and organizational founding.

patterns.name: Introducing a process or mechanism
patterns.context: Uses process to introduce its function or subsequent result when explaining a causal chain, mechanism, or operational steps; especially «process» followed by «that» or a past participle/mechanism description.
patterns.domain: Scientific, biomedical, and public-facing mechanism explanations

patterns.name: Locating a region or category
patterns.context: Describes relations between spatial regions, components, or classifications; the strongest activation falls on region, with weaker activations on other location words.
patterns.domain: Geography, astronomy, or geomorphology encyclopedia explanations

patterns.name: Sets of variables in mathematical physics
patterns.context: Introduces a subset or collection of objects in a formal discussion of a function space; strong activation falls on set, with mathematical terminology nearby.
patterns.domain: Statistical physics, mathematics, or theoretical science encyclopedia texts

patterns.name: Former-name descriptions in team names
patterns.context: Describes a team's previous name, identity, or incarnation when introducing its history or identity.

patterns.name: Shape or category of patent components
patterns.context: A patent description uses a general noun for a device component, then gives a synonymous or more specific component name.

patterns.name: Introducing aliases for legal names
patterns.context: Gives the full name of a law, then introduces its abbreviation or common name.
patterns.domain: Legal, policy, or patent background explanations

patterns.name: Founding a new organization
patterns.context: Describes a group founding a new organization in the history of a political group or organization.

10_1110.concept: 关系或过程说明中的结构性词语
10_1110.description: 主要响应机制说明中引出过程及其后续作用的 process；另对地域分区、数学集合、旧称、专利部件、法律别称和组织成立等特定叙述词有响应。

patterns.name: 过程或机理的引入
patterns.trigger: «process»，常与后续的 «that» 或过程名称相连
patterns.context: 在说明因果链、机制或操作步骤时，用 process 引出其作用或后续结果；尤其是 «process» 后接 «that» 或过去分词/机制描述。
patterns.domain: 科学、生物医学及面向大众的机制解释

patterns.name: 区域或类别的定位
patterns.context: 描述空间区域、组成部分或分类之间的关系；核心高激活落在 region，其他位置词也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: 地理、天文学或地貌类百科说明

patterns.name: 数学物理中的变量集合
patterns.context: 在形式化论述中介绍函数空间中的子集或一组对象；高激活落在 set，周边是数学术语。
patterns.domain: 统计物理、数学或理论科学百科文本

patterns.name: 球队名称中的旧称说明
patterns.context: 在介绍球队沿革或身份时，说明其先前名称、身份或所属版本。

patterns.name: 专利部件的形状或类别
patterns.context: 专利说明以一般性名词描述装置组成部件，再给出同义或更具体的部件名称。

patterns.name: 法律名称的别称引出
patterns.context: 先给出法案全名，再引出缩写或常用名称。
patterns.domain: 法律、政策或专利背景说明

patterns.name: 新组织的成立
patterns.context: 叙述政治团体或组织的历史时，说明某群体创立了新组织。

en.description: The most prominent common thread is process and mechanism explanations, but activations also occur across disparate content such as diseases and biomolecules, geographic regions, physics terms, event titles, religious broadcasts, and film entries; some patterns appear in only one passage and are difficult to reduce to a single semantic category.

patterns.name: “process” and process descriptions
patterns.context: Appears in sentences explaining a mechanism, pathway, regional formation, or biological process; [1], [2], [4], and [10] are followed by that/known as/termed and similar modifiers, while [3] is «region».
patterns.domain: Primarily scientific explanatory texts, also geographic encyclopedias

patterns.name: Biomedical mechanisms and diseases
patterns.context: Life science texts describe diseases, molecular entities, and their mechanisms; especially when appearing in the same sentence or mechanism explanation as process.

patterns.name: Spatial regions and geographic subdivisions
patterns.context: Describes the distribution, extent, and regional divisions of Martian surface features.

patterns.name: “known as” naming expression
patterns.context: Uses known as to introduce a name or term; [4] introduces RNA interference, while [5] introduces an event alias.
patterns.domain: Scientific explanatory texts and encyclopedic entries

patterns.name: Year and event name
patterns.context: A year appears next to an NFL event name, formatted with a line break as an entry title and alias.

patterns.name: Projection operators and phase-space terminology
patterns.context: Technical physics passage discussing the Zwanzig projection operator and a set of slow variables.

patterns.name: Spin and graphene physics
patterns.context: Describes spin-orbit interaction, band gaps and edge states in graphene, and related physical phenomena.

patterns.name: Religious broadcasting experience
patterns.context: A biographical entry introduces a person's church activities and weekly broadcast program.

patterns.name: Film entries and production information
patterns.context: Introduces a Kannada-language film by its title, genre, director, production company, and release year.

10_1110.description: 最显著的共同线索是“process”及机制说明，但激活也分布在疾病与生物分子、地理区域、物理术语、赛事标题、宗教广播和电影条目等不同内容；部分模式仅见于单段，难以归结为单一语义。

patterns.name: “process”及其过程描述
patterns.context: 出现在说明某种机制、路径、区域形成或生物学过程的句子中；[1]、[2]、[4]、[10] 后接 that/known as/termed 等限定，[3] 则是 «region»。
patterns.domain: 科学说明文为主，也包括地理百科

patterns.name: 生物医学机制与疾病
patterns.context: 生命科学文本中描述疾病、分子实体及其作用机制；尤其与 process 同句或同一机制说明中。

patterns.name: 空间区域与地理分区
patterns.context: 描述火星表面地貌的分布、覆盖范围及区域划分。

patterns.name: “known as”命名表述
patterns.context: 以 known as 引入名称或术语；[4]介绍 RNA interference，[5]介绍赛事别名。
patterns.domain: 科学说明文与百科条目

patterns.name: 年份与赛事名称
patterns.context: 年份紧邻 NFL 赛事名称，并以换行呈现条目标题及别名。

patterns.name: 投影算子与相空间术语
patterns.context: 技术性物理学段落，讨论 Zwanzig 投影算子及慢变量集合。
patterns.domain: 统计物理／数学物理百科

patterns.name: 自旋与石墨烯物理
patterns.context: 描述自旋轨道相互作用、石墨烯中的能隙和边缘态，以及相关物理现象。

patterns.name: 宗教广播经历
patterns.context: 人物传记中介绍其教会活动及每周广播节目。

patterns.name: 电影条目与制作信息
patterns.context: 以片名、类型、导演、制作方和上映年份介绍一部卡纳达语电影。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple text types: FYI email openings and bodies, disease terms and definitions in medical abstracts, time and sleep expressions, job responsibilities, biographies, and bibliographic titles; some time expressions, as phrases, and formatting markers are also activated, making it difficult to identify a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: FYI email opening
patterns.context: Activates when an email begins with FYI; sometimes extends to a blank line, separator, or the first sentence of the body.

patterns.name: Time-span expressions
patterns.context: Activates when describing duration, time ranges, or specific dates; several tokens in related time phrases receive strong activations.

patterns.name: As / identity or role
patterns.context: Activates when as introduces a work standard or a role or position held by a person.

patterns.name: Medical terms or disease-name fragments
patterns.context: Subword fragments within disease names in medical abstracts are activated; the examples involve terms related to two skin diseases.

patterns.name: Definitions and time units
patterns.context: A medical definition sentence explains how a condition is defined and gives the timescale over which change occurs.

patterns.name: Research objective and sleep duration
patterns.context: A research abstract labels its aim OBJECTIVE and discusses sleep deprivation and changes in sleep duration.

patterns.name: Work completion and performance standards
patterns.context: A responsibility or project-management statement describes completing work and relates it to time, budget, and quality standards.

patterns.name: Time expression in a Spanish book title or heading
patterns.context: A Spanish bibliographic title or related text contains a word meaning “time.”

patterns.name: Tone and contact information in email body
patterns.context: A short business email body describes a difficult situation or invites the recipient to get in touch.

patterns.name: Self-assessment and media criticism in email
patterns.context: An email reflects on the sender’s statements in the media, describing them as potentially too forceful or critical.

patterns.name: Location and convenience in email
patterns.context: An email mentions that something will be more convenient for the London side.

patterns.name: Person’s name and soccer position
patterns.context: A biography includes a name, date of birth, and position on the soccer field.

patterns.name: Document line breaks and email separators
patterns.context: Activates near blank lines, line breaks, or horizontal separators in emails.

10_1365.description: 激活分散于多类文本：邮件FYI开头及正文、医学摘要中的疾病词与定义、时间和睡眠表达、工作职责、人物简介、书目标题；部分时间、as短语和格式标记也被激活，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: FYI 邮件开头
patterns.context: 邮件以 FYI 开头时激活；有时继续延伸到空行、分隔线或正文首句。

patterns.name: 时间跨度表达
patterns.trigger: «over»« the»« last»« century»、«hours»« to»« days»、«15»« August»« 1983»
patterns.context: 描述持续时长、时间范围或具体日期时激活；相关时间短语中若干 token 得到较强激活。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、百科人物简介

patterns.name: 作为 / 身份角色
patterns.context: as 引出工作标准或人物担任的角色、位置时激活。
patterns.domain: 工作职责描述、百科人物简介

patterns.name: 医学术语或疾病名称片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要中疾病名称的词内片段被激活；此处涉及两种皮肤病相关术语。

patterns.name: 定义与时间单位
patterns.context: 医学定义句中说明某状况如何界定，并给出变化发生的时间尺度。

patterns.name: 研究目的与睡眠时长
patterns.context: 研究摘要以 OBJECTIVE 标注目的，并讨论睡眠不足及睡眠时间变化。

patterns.name: 工作完成与绩效标准
patterns.context: 职责或项目管理语句中描述完成工作，并关联时间、预算和质量标准。

patterns.name: 西班牙语书名或标题中的时间表达
patterns.context: 西班牙语书目标题或相关文本中，出现意为“时间”的词。

patterns.name: 邮箱正文中的语气与联系方式
patterns.context: 简短商务邮件正文中表达处境艰难，或邀请对方联系。

patterns.name: 邮件中的自我评价与媒体批评
patterns.context: 邮件中回顾自己在媒体上的表达，称其可能过于强硬或带有批评性。

patterns.name: 邮件中的地点与便利性
patterns.context: 邮件提到某事项将使伦敦方面更方便。

patterns.name: 人物姓名与足球位置
patterns.context: 人物简介中出现姓名、出生日期及其足球场上位置。

patterns.name: 文档换行与邮件分隔
patterns.context: 邮件中的空行、换行或横线分隔符附近激活。

en.description: Activates on diseases, definitions, and time expressions in medical abstracts; repeated “FYI” and its short body in Enron emails; also project responsibilities, Spanish time words in bibliographies, and footballer profiles. Triggers are not consistent across corpora.

patterns.name: Diseases and medical terminology
patterns.context: Disease names, definitions, health conditions, and time scales appear in medical abstracts or research backgrounds; activation in some passages concentrates on medical terms and descriptive text

patterns.name: FYI email openings
patterns.context: An email begins with “FYI”, followed by a brief explanation, forwarded content, or blank space; “FYI” itself activates in all three email passages

patterns.name: Emphatic expressions in emails
patterns.context: Brief statements or personal evaluations in the bodies of FYI emails; trigger words are scattered and may relate to email tone or common body-text expressions

patterns.name: Project execution and completion
patterns.context: Describes responsibility for overseeing work to ensure completion on time, within budget, and to quality standards
patterns.domain: Job responsibilities or project management text

patterns.name: Time expressions in Spanish bibliographies
patterns.context: In a Spanish-language bibliography or paper title, a word appears in the phrase “vivir en nuestro tiempo”

patterns.name: Dates and identity information in profiles
patterns.context: An encyclopedia-style biography gives a birth date, nationality, and football position; “as” appears in the position description

10_1365.description: 激活覆盖医学摘要中的疾病、定义与时间表达；Enron 邮件中反复出现的“FYI”及其短正文；另见项目职责、书目中的西语时间词和足球人物资料。跨语料触发特征不统一。

patterns.name: 疾病与医学术语
patterns.context: 医学摘要或研究背景中，出现疾病名称、定义、健康状况及时间尺度；部分段落的激活集中在医学词语和描述性文本

patterns.name: FYI 邮件开头
patterns.trigger: “FYI”以及其后的换行、连续点号或破折号
patterns.context: 邮件以“FYI”开头，后接简短说明、转发式内容或留白；“FYI”本身在三个邮件段落中均激活

patterns.name: 邮件中的强调表达
patterns.context: FYI 邮件正文中的简短陈述或个人评价；触发词分散，可能与邮件语气或常见正文表达有关

patterns.name: 项目执行与达成
patterns.trigger: “successful completion of work as per the time, budget and quality standards”
patterns.context: 描述负责监督工作按时间、预算和质量标准完成的职责
patterns.domain: 职业职责或项目管理文本

patterns.name: 西班牙语书目中的时间表达
patterns.context: 西班牙语书目或论文题名中，词语出现在“vivir en nuestro tiempo”这一短语内

patterns.name: 人物资料中的日期与身份信息
patterns.context: 百科式人物简介，提供出生日期、国籍及足球场上位置；其中“as”在位置描述中出现

en.description: Activations are scattered across word forms and contexts: Ac-initial words and hours in medical text, FYI email openings and email separator formatting, as well as work completion, expressions of difficulty, English first-person reflection, and Spanish tiempo; there is no single stable trigger.

patterns.name: FYI email openings
patterns.context: At the beginning of an email body or reply, often followed by a space, dash, or line break; activation falls on FYI and nearby punctuation/formatting tokens.

patterns.name: English compound-word segmentation
patterns.context: In medical titles or abstracts, a word is split into multiple subwords by the tokenizer; activation concentrates on Ac and subsequent subword fragments.

patterns.name: Time spans and hours
patterns.context: Sentences about changes over time, duration, or definitions; “hours” receives strong activation, sometimes along with a numeral.

patterns.name: Work completion and standards
patterns.context: Management-style statements describing work completed on time and to budget and quality requirements; strongest activation falls on “as”.

patterns.name: “tough” and surrounding degree expressions
patterns.context: A brief email summarizes general difficulty, with a period at the end of the sentence and a line break.

patterns.name: Quoted or forwarded email layout
patterns.context: Emails use ellipses or em dashes as separators, often adjacent to FYI, message bodies, or signature-like content.

patterns.name: Time expressions in Spanish titles
patterns.context: Spanish-language philosophy/aesthetics bibliographies or discussions contain “nuestro tiempo” (our time); activation concentrates on tiempo.

patterns.name: First-person reflection in English email
patterns.context: The sender reflects on their performance in media criticism; activation covers “I was” and the split token assertive.

10_1365.description: 激活分散于多类词形与语境：医学文本的 Ac- 开头词及 hours、FYI 邮件开头和邮件分隔格式，另见工作完成、困难表述、英文自我回顾及西语 tiempo；没有单一稳定触发特征。

patterns.name: FYI 邮件开头
patterns.context: 邮件正文或回复开头，常紧接空格、破折号或换行；激活落在 FYI 及附近标点/格式 token。

patterns.name: 英文复合词切分
patterns.context: 医学标题或摘要中，词被分词器拆成多个子词；激活集中在 Ac 及后续词片段。

patterns.name: 时间跨度及小时数
patterns.context: 关于时间变化、持续时长或定义的句子；“hours”获得强激活，偶尔连带数量词。

patterns.name: 完成工作与标准
patterns.context: 描述按时间、预算、质量要求完成工作的管理式表述，最强落在“as”。
patterns.domain: 工作职责/项目管理文本

patterns.name: “tough”及周围程度表达
patterns.context: 简短邮件中概述普遍困难，伴有句末句号与换行。

patterns.name: 引用或转发邮件版式
patterns.context: 邮件中以省略点或长横线作分隔符，常与 FYI、消息正文或签名式内容相邻。

patterns.name: 西班牙语标题中的时间表达
patterns.context: 西班牙语哲学/美学书目或论述中出现“nuestro tiempo”（我们的时代），激活集中在 tiempo。
patterns.domain: PhilPapers 西班牙语学术文本

patterns.name: 英语邮件中的第一人称回顾
patterns.context: 发件人反思自己在媒体批评中的表现；激活覆盖“I was”及拆分的 assertive。

en.description: Activations are scattered across medical titles and abstracts, webpage labels, all-caps headings, business emails, and narrative text; they include subword segmentation, line breaks, fixed phrases, and time expressions with “hours,” with no single stable semantic or syntactic pattern evident.

patterns.name: Boundary/disease phrase in a title
patterns.context: A medical paper title uses “Border disease virus” as the disease name, followed by a colon and subtitle.

patterns.name: Subword segmentation of a rare disease name
patterns.context: The medical term “Acne fulminans” is split into multiple subword fragments; it is followed by “coexisting with pyoderma”.

patterns.name: Form-like labels and line breaks
patterns.context: The short label “Payment method” is followed by consecutive line breaks, then fields or link text such as “Contact”.

patterns.name: Movie word and subword segmentation
patterns.context: “Movies” is split into multiple subword fragments, followed by a line break and another occurrence of “Movies”.

patterns.name: Request for comments in email
patterns.context: “Your comments are needed” requests feedback, followed by a person’s name or related information.

patterns.name: All-caps, segmented headline-style phrase
patterns.context: The all-caps phrase “MORE TROUBLES FOR COMESA” appears as a heading, with words also split into subword fragments.

patterns.name: Email prompt and place name
patterns.context: An email sentence begins with “FYI -”, says something will make things easier, and mentions London.

patterns.name: Medical-service evaluation phrase
patterns.context: A medical or health-services study discusses the relationship between patient assessment and a healthcare delivery approach.

patterns.name: Time unit in a medical title
patterns.context: A definition of acute kidney injury describes a decline in glomerular filtration rate over the period “hours to days”.

patterns.name: Narrative turn after a time unit
patterns.context: In a narrative sentence, “for a few hours” is followed by a shift to a character having started planning an escape.

10_1365.description: 激活分散于医学标题与摘要、网页标签、全大写标题、商务邮件和叙事文本；包括词内切分、换行、固定短语，以及“hours”时间表达，未见单一稳定语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 标题中的边界/疾病词组
patterns.context: 医学论文标题中，以“Border disease virus”作为病名，后接冒号和标题副标题。

patterns.name: 罕见病名的词内分段
patterns.context: “Acne fulminans”这一医学术语被拆成多个子词片段；后接“coexisting with pyoderma”。

patterns.name: 表单式标签与换行
patterns.context: 短标签“Payment method”后连续换行，再出现“Contact”等字段或链接文本。

patterns.name: 电影词及词内分段
patterns.context: “Movies”被拆成多个子词片段，之后换行并再次出现“Movies”一词。

patterns.name: 邮件中的评论请求
patterns.context: 以“Your comments are needed”请求反馈，后面跟随人物姓名或相关说明。

patterns.name: 全大写、分段的标题式短语
patterns.context: 全大写短语“MORE TROUBLES FOR COMESA”以标题形式呈现，词语还被拆成子词片段。

patterns.name: 邮件提示语及地名
patterns.trigger: «FY»3«I»5« -»5« This»9« should»3 make« things»1« easier»3 in»2« London»3« as»7
patterns.context: 以“FYI -”开头的邮件语句，说明某事会让事情更容易，并提及 London。

patterns.name: 医疗服务评估短语
patterns.trigger: «Patient»4« assessment»9« within»8 the« context»1 of« healthcare»5« delivery»3 packages
patterns.context: 医学或卫生服务研究中，讨论患者评估与医疗服务交付方案的关系。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的时间单位
patterns.context: 急性肾损伤定义句中，描述肾小球滤过率在“hours to days”这一时间范围内下降。

patterns.name: 时间单位后的叙事转折
patterns.context: 叙事句中“for a few hours”之后转入人物已经开始计划逃跑的情节。

en.description: Activations span several short-text formats: blank lines after entry titles and repeated titles are the most consistent; other examples include names and line breaks in emails, title-case phrases, line breaks in math problems, and webpage navigation items. There is insufficient evidence that they share a single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Line break and repeated title after an entry heading
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry title is followed by a blank line, then a repeated title or definition; activation mainly falls on the title fragment and line break.

patterns.name: Names or forms of address and line breaks in emails
patterns.context: A person's name or name-like form of address appears in the email body, near a line break, blank line, or brief reply; the marked name fragment and line break are prominent.

patterns.name: Title-case phrases and in-word fragments
patterns.context: Uppercase or title-case text appears in a short title or proper noun; activation falls near word-initial or in-word fragments or punctuation, with no stable syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Philosophy bibliography phrases, medical paper titles

patterns.name: Line breaks and expressions in math problems
patterns.context: A line break follows a mathematical expression and introduces an instruction; numbers, symbols, and the line break all activate.

patterns.name: Footer-style navigation text on webpages
patterns.context: Navigation/footer items such as payment methods and contact information are separated by line breaks in short webpage snippets.

10_1365.concept: 短文本边界与标题格式
10_1365.description: 激活分布于多种短文本格式：词条标题后的空行与标题复现最稳定；另见邮件中的姓名及换行、标题式大写片段、数学题换行和网页导航项。没有足够证据证明它们共享单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 词条标题后的换行与重复标题
patterns.trigger: 标题或短语后出现 «↵»8/9，随后再次出现相同或近似标题；如 «Fa»izabad Junction railway station、«C»remation、«Sam»ut Prakan radiation accident、«C»helomey
patterns.context: 百科条目标题后接空行，再以重复标题或释义句开头；激活主要落在标题片段和换行上。

patterns.name: 邮件中的姓名或称呼及换行
patterns.trigger: «Your» comments are needed for Joyce James…；«C»heryl: «↵»«↵»Thanks.
patterns.context: 邮件正文出现人名或姓名式称呼，附近有换行、空行或邮件简短回复；被标记的姓名片段及换行较突出。

patterns.name: 标题式大写短语与词内片段
patterns.trigger: «MORE» TR«OU»BL«ES» FOR COM«ES»；«Border» disease virus: delineation
patterns.context: 短标题或专名中出现大写/标题式文本，激活落在词首、词内片段或标点附近；未见稳定的句法条件。
patterns.domain: 哲学书目短语、医学论文标题

patterns.name: 数学题中的换行及表达式
patterns.context: 数学表达式后换行进入题目指令；表达式数字、符号和换行均有激活。

patterns.name: 网页页脚式导航文本
patterns.context: 短网页片段中，支付方式、联系信息等导航/页脚项目以换行分隔。

en.concept: First-person statements and miscellaneous text features
en.description: Primarily responds to first-person “I” at the beginning of a sentence or clause, especially in personal email statements; also occurs in “I can’t” negative sentences, as well as in a few distinct patterns involving cryptocurrency terms, form-field formatting, and medical-academic phrases.

patterns.name: First-person subject I
patterns.context: First-person statements or personal expressions in emails; the verbs vary and do not form a fixed collocation.
patterns.domain: Emails, web text, and conversational narrative

patterns.name: Negative contraction can’t
patterns.context: First-person negation followed by an action or perception expression: “play”, “see”; it is unclear whether the response is specific to the contraction structure.

patterns.name: Cryptocurrency-related terms
patterns.context: Introductory material for beginners; activation is concentrated on the term following “You may be new to”.

patterns.name: Form fields and line breaks
patterns.context: Short field labels are separated by line breaks, resembling the formatting of a form or webpage.

patterns.name: Medical-academic phrase
patterns.context: A formal, nominalized phrase related to healthcare services; activation mainly falls on “assessment within”.

10_1365.concept: 第一人称陈述及杂项文本特征
10_1365.description: 主要响应句首或分句中的第一人称“I”，尤见邮件式个人陈述；另有“I can’t”否定句，以及加密货币术语、表单字段格式和医疗学术短语等少数不同模式。

patterns.name: 第一人称主语 I
patterns.trigger: “I”在 [1]–[6]、[9] 中激活，尤以“I”后接谓语的句式明显；[4] 另有“Actually I think”
patterns.context: 第一人称陈述或邮件中的个人表达；动词内容多样，并非固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 邮件、网络文本及口语化叙述

patterns.name: 否定缩写 can’t
patterns.context: 第一人称否定后接动作或感知表达：“play”“see”；不确定是否只响应缩写结构。

patterns.name: 加密货币相关词
patterns.context: 面向新手的介绍性表述；激活集中在“You may be new to”之后的术语。

patterns.name: 表单字段与断行
patterns.context: 短字段标签以换行分隔，呈现类似表单或页面文本的格式。

patterns.name: 医疗学术短语
patterns.trigger: “Patient assessment within the context of healthcare delivery”
patterns.context: 名词化、正式的医疗服务相关短语；激活主要落在“assessment within”。

en.description: All segments strongly activate on let, including let someone do/know/walk, let's, let you get back to work, and let alone; the pattern spans emails, forums, and everyday text, with no stable domain restriction.

patterns.name: Permissive/causative use of let
patterns.context: let is followed by an object and a verb or complement; the object may be a pronoun or omitted at the token boundary, as in «let»10« you»2 or «let»10« alone»
patterns.domain: Cross-domain conversational, email, and forum text

10_1365.description: 所有段都在 let 上强激活：包括 let someone do/know/walk、let's、let you get back to work，以及 let alone；跨邮件、论坛和日常文本，未见稳定领域限定。

patterns.name: let 的许可／使役用法
patterns.context: let 后接宾语及动词或补语；宾语可为代词，也可省略在 token 边界中，如 «let»10« you»2 或 «let»10« alone»
patterns.domain: 跨领域的对话、邮件与论坛文本

en.concept: Common function words and sentence fragments
en.description: Strong activations occur across a variety of conjunctions and sentence patterns: because, but, pronouns after let, as well as when, as, if, whatever, and Now; a few unrelated predicates also occur, with no consistent style or topic.

patterns.name: Word after because
patterns.context: Markers are concentrated after because, followed by it, S, I, and so on; no fixed domain is required.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, personal narratives, and technical commentary

patterns.name: Pronoun after let
patterns.context: let is immediately followed by object pronouns or names such as her, you, Tom, and him.
patterns.domain: Personal narratives, emails, commentary about people

patterns.name: Concessive or contrastive conjunction but
patterns.context: Connects preceding and following content in a sentence, often introducing contrast or elaboration; these passages also commonly have a colloquial or conversational tone.

patterns.name: Temporal clause introduced by when
patterns.context: when is followed by I first started up, narrating the temporal background of an event.

patterns.name: As in a causal explanation
patterns.context: Appears in the structure let Tom know ... as soon as ..., expressing a temporal relationship.

patterns.name: Adverb whatever
patterns.context: Introduces a concessive or general situation at the beginning of a sentence, followed by an imperative.
patterns.domain: Commentary or advice about a person

patterns.name: Conditional clause with if
patterns.context: Introduces a conditional clause about someone’s opinion, followed by you think.

patterns.name: Now in quoted narration
patterns.context: Shifts at the start of a sentence to commentary or summary of a story.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on action or attitude predicates
patterns.context: Activation falls on predicates with different semantic and syntactic roles; no stable shared collocation is evident.

10_1365.concept: 常见功能词与句式片段
10_1365.description: 强激活散见于多种连接词和句式：because、but、let 后代词，以及 when、as、if、whatever、Now 等；另有少数不同谓词，文体和主题不统一。

patterns.name: because 后的词
patterns.context: 标记集中出现在 because 之后，后续接 it、S、I 等；不要求固定领域。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、个人叙述及技术评论

patterns.name: let 后的代词
patterns.context: let 后紧接 her、you、Tom、him 等宾语代词或人名。
patterns.domain: 个人叙述、邮件、人物评论

patterns.name: 让步或转折连接词 but
patterns.context: 在句中连接前后内容，常用于转折或补充；这些段落里还常见口语或对话语气。

patterns.name: when 引出的时间从句
patterns.context: when 后接 I first started up，叙述发生某事的时间背景。
patterns.domain: 论坛中的产品使用经历

patterns.name: 因果解释中的 as
patterns.context: 出现在 let Tom know ... as soon as ... 结构中，表示时间关系。

patterns.name: 副词 whatever
patterns.context: 句首引出让步或泛指情形，后接祈使句。

patterns.name: 条件从句 if
patterns.context: 引出对他人看法的条件从句，后接 you think。

patterns.name: 引述中的 Now
patterns.context: 句首转入对故事的评论或总结。

patterns.name: 动作或态度谓词的零散激活
patterns.context: 激活落在语义和句法角色各异的谓词上，未见稳定共同搭配。

en.description: Activations are scattered: many fall on possessive pronouns such as their/your and descriptions of interpersonal relationships, and also occur in health records, job searching, parenting and food, restaurant experiences, and astrophysics papers; forum separators, usernames, and sporadic word fragments are also activated, making it difficult to identify a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Their / your in possessive constructions
