patterns.context: The pronouns refer to previously mentioned people, groups, or their belongings; they often occur before nouns and also appear in constructions such as “their former coach”.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, sports reporting, medical titles, job-search forums

patterns.name: Accounts of pregnant women and family circumstances
patterns.context: Personal narratives involving pregnancy, parenting, family relationships, and treatment of pregnant women; pronouns introduce possession or relative clauses.

patterns.name: Associations involving food and parenting
patterns.context: When discussing feeding, parenting, or food, personal thoughts and recollections of related details occur.

patterns.name: Date and health-status records
patterns.context: Symptoms are recorded by date, along with a description of recovery to normal.

patterns.name: Job-search experience and timing
patterns.context: Asks about gaps on a résumé and the time needed to find a new position.

patterns.name: Errand, compensation, and food
patterns.context: A conversational account of helping someone at their request and receiving a meal in return.

patterns.name: Estimated value in academic research
patterns.context: A paper reports an estimate of magnetic-field strength.

patterns.name: Forum post separators and garbled usernames
patterns.context: HackerNews posts are joined by separators and usernames; activation falls on numbers, separators, or fragments related to usernames.

patterns.name: Unexplained local triggers
patterns.context: The examples lack a clear shared semantic condition; local word forms or tokenization may be responsible.

10_1365.description: 激活分散：多处落在 their/your 等领属代词及人物关系叙述，也出现在健康记录、求职、育儿饮食、餐馆经历和天体物理论文中；论坛分隔符、用户名及零散词片段也有激活，整体难归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 领属结构中的 their / your
patterns.context: 代词指向前文提及的人、群体或其所属物；常出现在名词前，也见于“their former coach”等结构。
patterns.domain: 研究摘要、体育报道、医学标题、求职论坛

patterns.name: 孕妇与家庭处境叙述
patterns.context: 涉及孕期、育儿、家庭关系及对待孕妇的个人叙述；代词引出所属或关系从句。
patterns.domain: 个人经历、社会议题叙述

patterns.name: 关于食物与育儿的联想
patterns.context: 谈论喂食、育儿或食物时，出现个人想法及对相关细节的回忆。

patterns.name: 日期与健康状况记录
patterns.trigger: «everything»10；邻近日期、蚊虫叮咬、夜间盗汗、食欲变化
patterns.context: 按日期记录症状变化，并描述恢复正常。

patterns.name: 求职经历与时间安排
patterns.context: 询问简历空档及寻找新职位所需时间。

patterns.name: 委托、报酬与食物
patterns.trigger: «wet burritos»；邻近“client promised me a meal”“a MEAL”
patterns.context: 口语化叙述一次受托帮忙及获得餐食的经历。

patterns.name: 学术研究中的估算数值
patterns.context: 论文中报告对磁场强度的估算。

patterns.name: 论坛发帖分隔符与乱码用户名
patterns.context: HackerNews 帖子间以分隔线和用户名串接；激活落在编号、分隔符或用户名相关片段上。

patterns.name: 未解释的局部触发
patterns.context: 各处缺乏共同且明确的语义条件，可能是局部词形或分词触发。

en.concept: Boundaries and fragments in structured text
en.description: Activations often occur on names, addresses, and field formatting in email headers, as well as short fragments after forum separators; Japanese characters and ordinary words in legal commentary also occur. The trigger near the byte string and line break in segment 1 is unclear.

patterns.name: Short strings after separators
patterns.context: After a horizontal separator in forum- or email-like fragments, short strings split into several subword fragments appear; activation falls mainly on these fragments.

patterns.name: Email recipient lists and names
patterns.context: In email headers or contact lists, names, recipients, and their email/organizational paths are interspersed; strong activations often fall on names, spaces, and field separators.
patterns.domain: Enron emails and email address books

patterns.name: Email header fields and punctuation
patterns.context: Sender, date, recipient, cc, and subject fields in email headers, along with punctuation and formatting characters in addresses and dates.

patterns.name: Document separators and formatting fragments
patterns.context: Line breaks, equals-sign or horizontal-line separators, and nearby short text fragments in webpages or post excerpts; these fragments do not form a stable semantic topic.

patterns.name: Japanese hiragana and katakana text
patterns.context: In Japanese sentences and subsequent technical explanations, activation is scattered across subword fragments of kana, kanji, and katakana.

patterns.name: Ordinary words in legal discussion
patterns.context: Commentary in a legal opinion discusses the Department of Justice, prosecutors, and the boundaries of legal theory; activation falls on ordinary English words, unlike the formatting cues in other patterns.

10_1365.concept: 结构化文本中的边界与碎片
10_1365.description: 激活多见于邮件头中的姓名、地址与字段格式，以及论坛分隔符后的短碎片；另见日文字符和法律评论普通词。第1段的字节串与换行附近触发原因不明。

patterns.name: 分隔符后的短字符串
patterns.context: 在类似帖子或邮件片段的横线分隔符后，出现被切分成若干子词片段的短字符串；激活主要落在这些片段上。

patterns.name: 邮件收件人名单与姓名
patterns.context: 邮件头或联系人列表中，姓名、收件人及其邮箱/组织路径交错出现；高激活常落在姓名、空格及字段分隔处。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及邮件地址簿

patterns.name: 邮件头字段与标点
patterns.context: 邮件头中的发件人、日期、收件人、抄送和主题字段，以及地址、日期中的标点和格式字符。

patterns.name: 文档分隔符与格式化残片
patterns.context: 网页或帖子片段中换行、等号/横线分隔符及其邻近的短文本残片；这些残片不构成稳定的语义主题。

patterns.name: 日文假名与片假名文字
patterns.context: 日文句子及其后续技术说明中，激活分散在假名、汉字和片假名的子词片段上。

patterns.name: 法律论述中的普通词语
patterns.context: 法律意见讨论中，对司法部、检察官及法律理论边界的评论；激活落在普通英文词上，与其他模式的格式线索不同。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to academic document structure: paper metadata, section headings, separators, and line breaks; also responds to forwarded-email header formatting. Mathematical papers contain scattered symbols, terms, and name fragments, but their shared trigger is unclear.

patterns.name: ArXiv document structure markers
patterns.context: Near academic paper metadata and section headings, especially the title, author list, and Markdown/text separator structure before and after Introduction; activation falls on markers, line breaks, and some formatting tokens.

patterns.name: Section structure in mathematical papers
patterns.context: Papers in which headings are marked by titles, underlines, or explicit sec labels; no specific field is required.

patterns.name: Local words in mathematical discussion
patterns.context: Terms such as matrix coefficients and subdiagonal in mathematical text, or near combinatorics lemmas and names; activation is scattered across symbols and word fragments.

patterns.name: Short word fragments in paper titles/topics
patterns.context: These words occur in titles or academic text, but the topics vary widely, making it difficult to confirm a unified lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Email quotation and forwarding format
patterns.context: Original-message separators and email headers in forwarded or replied-to emails; ordinary business-email body text, thanks, or signatures also occur.

10_1365.description: 主要对学术文档的结构格式敏感：论文元数据、章节标题、分隔线和换行；另对邮件转发头格式有反应。数学论文中也出现分散的符号、术语和人名片段，但其共同触发条件不明确。

patterns.name: ArXiv 文档结构标记
patterns.context: 学术论文元数据及章节标题附近，尤其是标题、作者列表和 Introduction 前后的 Markdown/文本分隔结构；激活落在标记、换行和部分格式 token 上。

patterns.name: 数学论文中的章节结构
patterns.context: 论文以标题、下划线或显式 sec 标签标示章节的场景；不要求特定学科。

patterns.name: 数学论述中的局部词语
patterns.context: 数学正文中矩阵系数、下对角线等术语，或组合数学引理、人名附近；激活分散在符号和词语片段上。
patterns.domain: 数学论文（算子理论、组合数学）

patterns.name: 论文标题/主题中的短词片段
patterns.context: 这些词出现在标题或学术正文中，但上下文主题差异很大，难以确认存在统一词义触发条件。

patterns.name: 邮件引用与转发格式
patterns.context: 转发或回复邮件中的原始邮件分隔线和邮件头；同时出现普通商务邮件正文、致谢或签名。

en.description: Primarily responds to academic document structure and citation markers: section headings, anchors, separators, authors, and references; also covers mathematical formulas, Objective-C test code, and local patterns such as biomedical experiments and author declarations.

patterns.name: Paper titles, section structure, or navigation markers
patterns.context: Activation falls on paper section headings, structural descriptions, and their Markdown/LaTeX markers; often accompanied by line breaks and heading separators.
patterns.domain: ArXiv papers and PubMed Central articles, including Markdown/academic document formats

patterns.name: Citation and reference strings in academic papers
patterns.context: Citation markers, reference links, or author/paper citations in the main text; commonly occur in academic discussion alongside paragraph-structure markers.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, computer science, and other academic texts; also StackExchange

patterns.name: Names, authors, and researcher attribution
patterns.context: Researcher names, collaborators, or statements about author contributions; activation often falls on author labels or plural forms of author.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, archaeology survey abstracts, and French paper statements

patterns.name: Formulas and mathematical notation in academic sections or results
patterns.context: Near mathematical formulas, including LaTeX symbols, variables, or results-section headings following formulas; activation may also fall on markers such as parentheses and backslashes.

patterns.name: Objective-C test code and testing-framework markers
patterns.context: Objective-C unit-test methods containing failure assertions and test-class end markers.

patterns.name: Specific experimental material and microcell technology terms
patterns.context: Describes donor cell lines suitable for generating microcells and improving the efficiency of related experiments.

patterns.name: French author declarations and conflict-of-interest sections
patterns.context: Conflict-of-interest statements and author-contribution sections at the end of a paper, with headings containing section anchors and separators.

patterns.name: The technical term uniton number and harmonic maps
patterns.context: Discusses harmonic maps from the two-sphere to compact Lie groups and their finite uniton number property, and mentions related researchers.

10_1365.concept: 学术文档结构与元数据
10_1365.description: 主要响应学术文献的结构与引用标记：章节标题、锚点、分隔线、作者和参考文献；也覆盖数学公式、Objective-C 测试代码及生物医学实验和作者声明等局部模式。

patterns.name: 论文标题、章节结构或导航标记
patterns.trigger: “Plan of the paper”、 “Problem setup”、 “Main result”、 “Proof of the main result”、 “Numerical experiments”、 “Results”、以及标题下的 {#sec...} 和 =/--- 分隔线
patterns.context: 激活落在论文的章节标题、结构说明及其 Markdown/LaTeX 标记上；常伴随换行和标题分隔符。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文及 PubMed Central 文章，含 Markdown/学术文档格式

patterns.name: 学术论文中的引用与参考文献串
patterns.trigger: “[@hardy-ramanujan1918]”、“[@Uspensky1920]”、“[@CG00]”、“[@Uh1]”、“[@BG]”、 ACM URL 以及人名与“paper quoted”
patterns.context: 引用标记、参考文献链接或正文中的作者/论文引用；常出现在学术论述中，且与段落结构标记并存。
patterns.domain: 数学、计算机科学及其他学术文本；另见 StackExchange

patterns.name: 人名、作者与研究者归属表述
patterns.trigger: “Nagaoka and colleagues found”、 “Drumm’s results”、 “Dr. Mitsuo Oshimura and co-authors”、 “Les auteurs”、 “Tous les auteurs”
patterns.context: 研究者姓名、合作者或作者贡献相关表述；激活常落在作者称谓或复数作者词上。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、考古学调查摘要及法语论文声明

patterns.name: 学术章节或结果中的公式和数学记号
patterns.context: 数学公式附近，包含 LaTeX 符号、变量或公式后的结果章节标题；激活也可能落在括号、反斜线等标记上。

patterns.name: Objective-C 测试代码及测试框架标记
patterns.context: Objective-C 单元测试方法中，包含失败断言和测试类结束标记。

patterns.name: 特定实验材料与微细胞技术术语
patterns.trigger: “hamster CHO and mouse A9 cells”、“microcell generation”
patterns.context: 描述适合生成微细胞的供体细胞系及改进相关实验效率。

patterns.name: 法语作者声明与利益冲突栏目
patterns.trigger: “Les auteurs ne déclarent aucun conflit d’intérêt.”、“Contributions des auteurs”
patterns.context: 论文末尾的利益冲突声明和作者贡献栏目，标题带有章节锚点及分隔线。

patterns.name: 专业术语 uniton number 与调和映射
patterns.context: 讨论从二球面到紧李群的调和映射及其有限 uniton number 性质，并提及相关研究者。

en.concept: Paper structure markers and local formatting fragments
en.description: Strong activations often fall on paper structure markers, especially equals-sign heading separators; other occurrences include constants at the ends of mathematical general terms, French author declarations, text adjacent to formulas, and descriptions of people’s scientific achievements, with no single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Markdown heading underline
patterns.context: An equals-sign underline in Markdown style appears after a heading or subsection heading in the paper body; activation is concentrated on the equals-sign string.

patterns.name: Answer expression in a math problem
patterns.context: After a sequence problem asks for the nth term, a candidate general term expressed with variables and exponents follows; the strongest activation falls on the final constant «1» or «-1» in the expression.

patterns.name: Paper acknowledgment heading
patterns.context: Acknowledgments appear as an unnumbered heading at the end of the paper body or at a section transition; the heading and adjacent formatting markers are activated.

patterns.name: French paper author declaration and contribution heading
patterns.context: The declarations or author-contributions section of a French academic paper, accompanied by numbered subsection markers, equals-sign separators, and line breaks.

patterns.name: Combinatorial asymptotic constants in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: A paper cites results by Hardy–Ramanujan and Uspensky and introduces a subsequent improvement; activation occurs on English connective text near the formula.

patterns.name: Physics section heading
patterns.context: Discusses anomalous light refraction in low-pressure hydrogen gas, followed by a descriptive heading introducing the anomaly and its explanation.

patterns.name: Renormalization section heading
patterns.context: A particle-physics paper opens a section on renormalization methods with a heading, followed by the paper body.

patterns.name: Electroweak field section heading
patterns.context: After discussing physical forces such as electroweak, gluon, and gravitational forces, a section heading introduces electroweak fields.

patterns.name: Microbiologist narrative in a biography
patterns.context: A biographical account describes a scientist’s research achievements and contributions to agriculture and animal husbandry; no clear heading-separator trigger is evident.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central biographical or institutional history

patterns.name: Paper abstract heading
patterns.context: At the beginning of a paper, an unnumbered abstract heading and equals-sign underline serve as structural markers.

patterns.name: General-term question in a sequence problem
patterns.context: A natural-language question asks for a particular term of a sequence, followed by an algebraic expression; activation is weaker and does not fully match the strong activation on the final constant in the expression.

10_1365.concept: 论文结构标记与局部格式片段
10_1365.description: 强激活多落在论文结构标记上，尤其等号标题分隔线；另见数学通项式末尾常数、法语作者声明、公式邻接语及人物科研成就叙述，无法归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: Markdown 标题分隔线
patterns.context: 论文正文中的标题或小节标题后，出现 Markdown 风格的等号下划线；激活集中在等号串。

patterns.name: 数学题中的答案表达式
patterns.context: 数列题询问第 n 项后，紧接以变量和幂次表示的候选通项；最强激活落在表达式末尾的常数项「1」或「-1」。

patterns.name: 论文致谢标题
patterns.context: 论文正文末尾或章节转换处，致谢作为无编号标题出现；标题及紧邻格式标记激活。

patterns.name: 法语论文作者声明与贡献标题
patterns.trigger: 「Les auteurs ne déclarent aucun conflit d’intérêt.」「Contributions des auteurs」「{#S0006}」
patterns.context: 法语学术论文的声明或作者贡献部分，伴随编号小节标记、等号分隔线及换行。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的组合渐近常数
patterns.context: 论文引用 Hardy–Ramanujan 与 Uspensky 的结果，介绍后续改进；激活出现在公式附近的英文连接语。

patterns.name: 物理章节标题
patterns.trigger: 「Description of the anomalies and their explanations.」「{#description}」「Anomalies of the speeds」
patterns.context: 讨论低压含氢气体中的光折射异常，随后以描述性标题引出异常及解释。

patterns.name: 重整化章节标题
patterns.context: 粒子物理论文中以标题开启重整化方法章节，标题后接论文正文。

patterns.name: 电弱场章节标题
patterns.context: 讨论电弱、胶子和引力等物理力后，以章节标题引出电弱场内容。

patterns.name: 人物传记中的微生物学家叙述
patterns.trigger: 「a distinguished microbiologist」「developed new applications of microorganisms」「greatly benefited agriculture and livestock husbandry」
patterns.context: 人物经历叙述中介绍一位科学家的研究成就及农业、畜牧业贡献；未见明确标题分隔线触发。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 人物或机构史料

patterns.name: 论文摘要标题
patterns.context: 论文开头以无编号摘要标题及等号下划线作为结构标记。

patterns.name: 数列题中的通项询问
patterns.trigger: 「What is the f’th term」「What is the x’th term」及相邻数列
patterns.context: 以自然语言询问数列第几项，随后给出代数式；激活较弱，且与表达式末尾常数项的强激活不完全相同。

en.description: Activations are scattered across paper text and document metadata, including section separators, vertical bars in author addresses, quotation marks in PO date fields, and academic prose, titles, and mathematical formulas. Aside from formatting markers, there is no stable semantic or lexical trigger shared across all passages.

patterns.name: LaTeX section-heading separators
patterns.context: Appears after a paper title or subsection heading, typically with blank lines before and after and heading text

patterns.name: Quotation marks at the end of metadata fields
patterns.context: POT- or PO- date metadata in GitHub file headers, with an escaped newline after the date
patterns.domain: Translation templates or PO file metadata

patterns.name: Vertical bars in author address blocks
patterns.context: In an author address block, a vertical bar appears alongside hyphens, backslash line breaks, and indented address information

patterns.name: Punctuation/subword fragments in English citations and author names
patterns.context: Ordinary English paper text containing citations, author names, or prose; no obvious shared local trigger structure

patterns.name: Near mathematical symbols or formulas
patterns.context: Mathematical formulas, variables, or nearby prose; formula topics and neighboring activated tokens vary across passages

patterns.name: Front-matter titles and title-style text
patterns.context: Near paper titles, prefaces, or section headings, often with line breaks and separators

10_1365.description: 激活分散在论文文本与文档元数据中：包括章节分隔线、作者地址竖线、PO 日期字段引号，以及学术正文、标题和数学公式。除格式标记外，未见覆盖所有片段的稳定语义或词面触发模式。

patterns.name: LaTeX 分节标题分隔线
patterns.context: 出现在论文标题或小节标题之后，通常伴随前后空行及标题文本
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文的 Markdown/文本转储

patterns.name: 元数据字段末尾的引号
patterns.context: GitHub 文件头中的 POT- 或 PO- 日期元数据，日期后含转义换行
patterns.domain: 翻译模板或 PO 文件元数据

patterns.name: 作者地址栏中的竖线
patterns.context: 作者地址块中，竖线与连字符、反斜杠换行及缩进地址信息相邻
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文作者联系信息

patterns.name: 英文引文与作者姓名中的标点/词片
patterns.context: 普通英文论文正文，包含引文、作者姓名或书面叙述；没有明显共同的局部触发结构

patterns.name: 数学符号或公式附近
patterns.context: 数学公式、变量或公式附近的正文；各段公式主题和邻近激活 token 不一致

patterns.name: 论文前置标题及标题式文本
patterns.context: 论文题名、前言或章节标题附近，常有换行和分隔线

en.concept: Opening layout of ArXiv paper introductions
en.description: Activations are concentrated on the opening layout of ArXiv papers: title and equals-sign or hyphen separators, prefatory metadata or keywords, followed by the introduction body; some fragments also contain section anchors, authors, or address fragments.

patterns.name: Underline beneath paper introduction heading
patterns.context: After front matter in an ArXiv paper, an Introduction heading and equals-sign heading separator appear, followed by the body; this structure occurs in all segments.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, especially ArXiv LaTeX/text-converted formats

patterns.name: Section heading formatting markers
patterns.context: The heading is accompanied by an explicit anchor or section identifier in braces, unlike an ordinary heading separator; clearly appears only in segments 8 and 10.
patterns.domain: Academic document conversion text with Markdown/HTML anchors

patterns.name: Paper metadata and keywords
patterns.context: Title, authors, keywords, classification codes, or subject tags appear as front matter before or after the introduction; the subject matter varies across papers.
patterns.domain: Academic paper abstract pages, title pages, and keyword/classification information

patterns.name: Hyphen-style separator
patterns.context: Located after the paper title or front matter and before the introduction body; equals-sign separators are especially consistent, while hyphens occur in only some segments.
patterns.domain: Typesetting structure in ArXiv text dumps

patterns.name: Opening language of the introduction body
patterns.context: The first sentence of the paper body immediately follows the Introduction heading, often opening with a statement introducing the research subject or paper; vocabulary and topic vary.

patterns.name: Authors, addresses, and other front-matter fragments
patterns.context: Addresses or author information occur near paper metadata; the address in segment 1 has no clear connection to the topic, while other names belong to paper front matter.
patterns.domain: Paper front-page metadata or document-extraction fragments

10_1365.description: 激活集中于ArXiv论文的引言起始版式：标题与等号/短横线分隔、前置元数据或关键词，随后进入引言正文；个别片段还含章节锚点、作者或地址残片。

patterns.name: 论文引言标题下划线
patterns.context: ArXiv论文前置信息之后，出现 Introduction 标题及等号式标题分隔线，随后进入正文；该结构在所有片段中出现。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其是 ArXiv LaTeX/文本转换格式

patterns.name: 章节标题格式标记
patterns.context: 标题伴随花括号中的显式锚点或章节标识，区别于普通标题分隔线；仅在片段8和10清楚出现。
patterns.domain: 带有 Markdown/HTML 锚点的学术文档转换文本

patterns.name: 论文元数据及关键词
patterns.context: 引言前后列出题名、作者、关键词、分类号或主题标签等论文前置信息；各篇内容领域不同。
patterns.domain: 学术论文摘要页、标题页及关键词/分类信息

patterns.name: 横线式分隔符
patterns.context: 位于论文题名或前置信息之后、引言正文之前；等号分隔符尤其稳定，短横线仅出现在部分片段。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文本转储中的排版结构

patterns.name: 引言正文起始语
patterns.trigger: «We»3« are»3 interested« in»1 the effect；«In»2 the« paper»2« we»3 deal with；«The»1 time»1 evolution；«The»1 point»1 at infinity
patterns.context: 引言标题后紧接论文正文首句，常以介绍研究对象或论文内容的陈述句开篇；具体词汇和主题并不一致。

patterns.name: 作者姓名与地址等前置杂项
patterns.trigger: «619 Red Cedar RD, East Lansing, MI 48824, USA»；«K. Smolentsev»；«F. Fauvet»
patterns.context: 论文元数据附近出现地址或作者信息；片段1的地址与主题内容联系不明，其他姓名属于论文前置信息。
patterns.domain: 论文首页元数据或文档抽取残片

en.description: Activations primarily concentrate on paper-layout structure: section headings, heading anchors, and repeated-character separator lines; scattered patterns also include formula markers, author and reference metadata, reader guidance, and acknowledgment wording.

patterns.name: Underlines beneath section headings
patterns.context: A separator line directly follows a paper title or subsection heading to mark heading hierarchy; activation concentrates on the separator itself or its end.
patterns.domain: Markdown or converted typeset text in ArXiv/PubMed papers

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematics and formula markers
patterns.context: Near mathematical formulas and their LaTeX typesetting markers; activations in these examples fall on formula delimiters, formula content, or labels.

patterns.name: Author, affiliation, and bibliographic metadata fields
patterns.context: Near author, institution, or reference fields in paper templates or document metadata; hyphens and field names activate clearly in the examples.

patterns.name: Acknowledgments and institutional acknowledgment wording
patterns.context: Acknowledgment passages describing institutional permission, support, or assistance with research and publication; “greatly” is also marked here.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg historical book prefaces or acknowledgments

patterns.name: Academic section structure and headings in the main text
patterns.context: Paper structure consisting of headings, heading anchors, and adjacent body text; besides separators, some heading text or section anchors also activate.

patterns.name: Modifiers in mathematical paper prose
patterns.context: A literature review sentence describing previous results as having been substantially improved; activation falls on “greatly”, which also appears in passage 10.

patterns.name: Reader-guidance wording
patterns.context: Phrases in the main text recommending references or further reading to the reader; “reader” activates most strongly.

patterns.name: Section headings and proof structure of theoretical results
patterns.context: A paper lists consecutive results, proofs, and experimental section headings, with Markdown anchors and separators.

10_1365.description: 激活主要集中在论文排版结构：章节标题、标题锚点及其重复字符分隔线；另有公式标记、作者与参考文献元数据、读者引导语和致谢措辞等零散模式。

patterns.name: 章节标题下划线
patterns.context: 分隔线紧跟论文标题或小节标题，用于标记标题层级；激活集中在分隔符本身或其末尾。
patterns.domain: ArXiv/PubMed 论文的 Markdown 或转换后排版文本

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学与公式标记
patterns.context: 数学公式及其 LaTeX 排版标记附近；这些样例中激活落在公式分隔符、公式内容或标签附近。

patterns.name: 作者、单位与文献元数据字段
patterns.context: 论文模板或文档元数据的作者、机构、参考文献字段附近；样例中的连字符和字段名有明显激活。

patterns.name: 致谢与机构致谢措辞
patterns.trigger: “with the knowledge of the War Department of the United States”、“has greatly helped me”
patterns.context: 叙述机构许可、支持或协助研究与出版的致谢段落；“greatly”在此处也被标记。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 历史书籍前言或致谢

patterns.name: 正文中的学术章节结构与标题
patterns.trigger: “Main Results”、“Scaling Limits and Other Modes of Convergence”、“Preface”、“Related literature”
patterns.context: 标题、标题锚点及相邻正文构成的论文结构文本；除分隔线外，部分标题文字或章节锚点也有激活。

patterns.name: 数学论文叙述中的修饰语
patterns.context: 文献回顾中描述先前结果被显著改进的句子；激活落在“greatly”，而该词在第10段也出现。
patterns.domain: 数学论文相关工作叙述

patterns.name: 读者引导措辞
patterns.context: 正文向读者推荐参考文献或补充阅读的句式；“reader”激活最强。

patterns.name: 理论结果的章节标题及证明结构
patterns.trigger: “Main result”、“Proof of the main result”、“Numerical experiments”
patterns.context: 论文中连续列出结果、证明与实验章节标题，并含 Markdown 锚点和分隔线。

en.concept: Salience and formatting cues in academic texts
en.description: Activations occur across paper metadata and typographic boundaries, reader address and requests for help, email formatting, and degree expressions such as greatly in academic texts. Some transitional words and formatting markers also respond, with no single stable semantic trigger evident.

patterns.name: greatly and subsequent degree/result expressions
patterns.context: Used as a degree adverb before a verb or participle to express significant help, improvement, or expansion; often occurs in academic prose.
patterns.domain: Book prefaces, mathematics papers, research texts

patterns.name: Author and affiliation metadata templates
patterns.context: Author, address, email, and reference fields in paper layouts or exported text, often accompanied by line breaks, LaTeX markers, and placeholder-like hyphens.

patterns.name: Reader/requester address
patterns.context: Explanations directed at readers or direct questions; trigger words occur when inviting readers to consult references or asking for help.

patterns.name: Email exchanges and interpersonal negotiation
patterns.context: Quoted email headers, or informal exchanges discussing colleagues, plans, and opinions.

patterns.name: Conjunctions and referential words in general coherent text
patterns.context: Relational words and demonstratives that connect to preceding text within or at the beginning of a sentence; there is insufficient evidence that they form an independent, stable pattern.

patterns.name: Local markers without a clear correspondence
patterns.context: Adjacent to metadata fields or text boundaries, possibly influenced by formatting and tokenization; no consistent semantic condition can be inferred on its own.
patterns.domain: ArXiv formatted text and Q&A text

10_1365.concept: 学术文本中的显著性与格式线索
10_1365.description: 激活分布在论文元数据与排版边界、读者称呼和求助表达、邮件格式，以及学术文本中 greatly 等程度表达；也响应若干承接词和格式标记，未显示单一稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: greatly及其后续程度/结果表达
patterns.context: 在动词或分词前作程度副词，表达显著帮助、改进或扩展；常处于学术叙述中。
patterns.domain: 书籍前言、数学论文、科研文本

patterns.name: 作者与机构元数据模板
patterns.context: 论文排版或导出文本中的作者、地址、邮箱及参考文献字段，常伴随换行、LaTeX 标记和占位式连字符。

patterns.name: 读者/求助者称呼
patterns.context: 面向读者的说明或直接提问；触发词出现在邀请查阅参考文献或请求帮助的语境。
patterns.domain: 学术论文说明、StackExchange 问答

patterns.name: 邮件往来与人际协商
patterns.trigger: «Original Message»、«From»:；以及“I had to plan”“Any thoughts?”
patterns.context: 邮件引用头部，或讨论同事、计划与意见的非正式交流。

patterns.name: 一般连贯文本中的转折/指代词
patterns.context: 句内或句首承接前文的关系词、指示词；没有足够证据表明它们构成独立稳定模式。

patterns.name: 无明确对应的局部标记
patterns.trigger: 高激活还落在空格、换行、标点、破折号及 LaTeX/引用标记上
patterns.context: 与元数据字段或文本边界相邻，可能受格式和分词影响；无法单独归纳出一致语义条件。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 排版文本及问答文本

en.concept: Heterogeneous word forms and formatting fragments
en.description: Activations occur mainly on the period in the math-problem phrase “for variable.”, the adverb greatly, the in-word fragment cha, and the Co fragment in the cited surname Cooper; one passage about an electroweak-field paper remains unexplained.

patterns.name: Adverbial use of greatly
patterns.context: Greatly modifies a following verb or participle; occurs in “has greatly helped” and “greatly refined”.

patterns.name: In-word fragment cha-
patterns.context: The fragment occurs within words rather than as a standalone word: passage 4 has “chaunted”, and passage 10 has “Chauncey”.

patterns.name: Variable answer followed by a period in math problems
patterns.context: In the equation-solving instruction “for c/p.”, the variable name is immediately followed by a period; the surrounding text consists of consecutive generated algebra problems.

patterns.name: Cooper fragment in a cited reference identifier
patterns.context: Appears in the bracketed author-surname citation identifier “Cooper2011PRL”.

10_1365.description: 激活主要出现在数学题“for 变量.”的句点、greatly 修饰动词、词内 cha 片段及引用姓氏 Cooper 的 Co 片段；另有一段电弱场论文内容无法解释。

patterns.name: greatly 的副词用法
patterns.context: greatly 修饰后续动词或分词；分别出现在“has greatly helped”和“greatly refined”中。

patterns.name: cha- 开头的词内片段
patterns.context: 片段出现在词语内部而非独立词：段4为“chaunted”，段10为“Chauncey”。
patterns.domain: 历史叙述、法律判决文本

patterns.name: 数学题中句点前的变量答案
patterns.context: 解方程指令“for c/p.”中，变量名后紧接句点；周围是连续生成的代数题。

patterns.name: 引用文献标识中的 Cooper 片段
patterns.context: 出现在方括号内的作者姓氏引用标识“Cooper2011PRL”中。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文及参考文献

en.description: Primarily responds to paper structure and front matter metadata: authors, attribution, delimiters, institutional addresses, titles, and research statements in abstracts. It also responds strongly to formal institutional permission and expressions of thanks in book acknowledgments.

patterns.name: Author/statement metadata fields in paper abstracts or body text
patterns.context: An academic paper excerpt transitions after the abstract or body to metadata such as authors, affiliations, classifications, or references; these boundaries/fields activate strongly across multiple passages.

patterns.name: Author names and attribution lines
patterns.context: Names, footnotes, or affiliation markers listed in a paper's author field, often followed by a line break, delimiter, or affiliation.

patterns.name: Contributions or results in abstracts
patterns.context: A paper abstract or body summarizes a research question, proof, contribution, design, or physical result; activations are distributed across narrative and result words.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, computer science, engineering, physics, and economics papers

patterns.name: Paper titles and title formatting
patterns.context: Near a title, including title capitalization, formatting markers, and the following author information.

patterns.name: Address and affiliation layout lines
patterns.context: Standalone lines for affiliations, addresses, postal codes, and similar fields following author attribution, often separated by backslashes or line breaks.

patterns.name: Official institutional wording in acknowledgments/permissions
patterns.context: First-person statements that a work was created with an institution's knowledge or permission, thanking it for materials, images, or research assistance.

10_1365.description: 主要响应论文结构与前置元数据：作者、署名、分隔符、机构地址、标题及摘要中的研究陈述；另对书籍致谢中正式机构许可和感谢语有明显响应。

patterns.name: 论文摘要或正文中的作者/声明元数据字段
patterns.context: 学术论文片段在摘要或正文后转入作者、单位、分类或参考文献等元数据；多段中这些边界/字段标记激活强

patterns.name: 作者姓名与署名行
patterns.context: 论文作者字段中列出姓名、脚注或机构标记，常接换行、分隔符或单位

patterns.name: 摘要中的贡献或结果表述
patterns.context: 论文摘要或正文概述研究问题、证明、贡献、设计方案或物理结果；激活散布在叙述词和结果词上
patterns.domain: 数学、计算机、工程、物理及经济学论文

patterns.name: 论文标题及标题格式
patterns.context: 标题或题名附近，含标题大小写、格式标记及紧随的作者信息

patterns.name: 地址与机构排版行
patterns.trigger: «Department of Statistics»、«5734 S. University Ave»、«Chicago, IL 60637»、«Institute for Theoretical Physics»
patterns.context: 作者署名后的机构、地址、邮编等独立换行字段，常以反斜杠或换行分隔

patterns.name: 致谢/许可中的官方机构措辞
patterns.trigger: «with» the «knowledge» of the «War» Department…«kindly» allowed…«greatly» helped
patterns.context: 第一人称说明作品经某机构知情或许可，并感谢其提供材料、图片或研究帮助

en.concept: ArXiv paper structure and academic register
en.description: Activations most consistently fall on ArXiv author metadata labels, signatures, and name fragments; other scattered examples include argumentative language in academic prose, physics terminology, mathematical proofs, statistical results, corollaries, and special formatting, and are difficult to group under a single meaning.

patterns.name: Author metadata labels
patterns.context: In ArXiv paper excerpts, author information and affiliation metadata follow the title or body; labels and separators are directly marked, often alongside author names, footnote numbers, or institutions.

patterns.name: Name fragments in author names
patterns.context: A name appears in an author field or author line, with activation on some of its tokens; sometimes adjacent to superscript footnotes, institutions, or line breaks.

patterns.name: Academic discourse connectives and assertions
patterns.context: The paper body uses first-person plural to state a proof, argument, or result, or to describe a corollary or possibility; not every passage has the same set of words.

patterns.name: Theoretical physics terminology
patterns.context: Physics paper titles or body text contain terms related to theory, particles, cosmology, scattering, or detectors; these terms span different areas and may share only the source genre.

patterns.name: Mathematical proofs and combinatorial objects
patterns.context: The body text states that a conjecture is proved and gives conditions on a set or subset.

patterns.name: Statistical significance and observational results
patterns.context: Reports results or observations and explains statistical significance and dependencies at different scales.

patterns.name: Deriving conclusions from a framework
patterns.context: Derives conclusions from a theoretical framework, then discusses typicality or whether a principle is credible.

patterns.name: Proofs, definitions, and Bayesian statements
patterns.context: Presents an argument about whether a definition or scheme satisfies a Bayesian statement; includes citations.

patterns.name: Institution fields and markers
patterns.context: An institution name appears after the author byline, often introduced by a footnote or special formatting.

patterns.name: Title formatting and special typography
patterns.context: Paper titles use bold or bracket markers, followed by an author line; line breaks and layout symbols may also contribute to activation.

10_1365.description: 激活最一致地落在ArXiv作者元数据标签、署名及姓名片段；另散见学术正文中的论证用语、物理术语、数学证明、统计结果、推论与特殊排版，难以归为单一词义。

patterns.name: 作者元数据标签
patterns.context: ArXiv 论文片段中，标题或正文之后出现作者信息及机构元数据；标签和分隔符被直接标记，常伴随作者姓名、脚注编号或机构。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文排版与元数据

patterns.name: 作者名中的人名片段
patterns.context: 姓名位于作者字段或作者行中，激活落在姓名的部分 token；有时紧邻上标脚注、机构或换行。

patterns.name: 学术论述连接与断言
patterns.trigger: « In»、« we»、« prove»、« argue»、« show»、« can»、« that»
patterns.context: 论文正文以第一人称复数陈述证明、论证或展示结果，或说明推论与可能性；并非每段都有同一组词。

patterns.name: 理论物理领域术语
patterns.trigger: « quantum potential approach to quantum theory»、«field-theoretical»、«neutral mesons»、«turbulence»、«EWSBS»、«DFI detector»
patterns.context: 物理论文标题或正文出现理论、粒子、宇宙学、散射或探测器相关术语；这些术语彼此领域各异，可能只是来源文体共同性。
patterns.domain: 理论物理及相关物理研究

patterns.name: 数学证明与组合对象
patterns.context: 正文陈述证明某猜想，并给出集合或子集上的条件。

patterns.name: 统计显著性与观测结果
patterns.context: 报告结果或观测，并对统计显著性、不同尺度上的依赖关系作解释。
patterns.domain: 天体物理或经验研究论文

patterns.name: 从框架推出结论
patterns.context: 从某理论框架推导出结论，进而讨论典型性或某原则是否可信。
patterns.domain: 宇宙学、科学哲学类论文正文

patterns.name: 证明、定义与贝叶斯表述
patterns.context: 围绕定义或方案是否满足贝叶斯表述展开论证；含文献引用。

patterns.name: 机构字段及其标记
patterns.trigger: «Institute for Theoretical Physics»、«ISCAP and Physics Department»、«Stern»
patterns.context: 作者署名之后出现机构名称，常由脚注或特殊格式引出。

patterns.name: 标题格式与特殊排版
patterns.trigger: «**About neutral mesons and particle oscillations in the light of field-theoretical prescriptions of Weinberg**»、«↵»
patterns.context: 论文标题使用粗体或方括号等标记，后接作者行；换行和版面符号也可能贡献激活。

en.description: Primarily responds to labels, delimiters, citation markers, and formatting boundaries in ArXiv paper author sections. Sporadic activations also occur in theoretical physics terminology, academic abstract phrasing, and evaluative narration in a children's literature review.

patterns.name: ArXiv author metadata and formatting
patterns.context: An author section appears after the body or abstract; activations concentrate on labels, delimiters, citation markers, and formatting boundaries, with occasional activations within names.

patterns.name: Proper nouns or terminology in mathematical physics papers
patterns.context: The body or title concerns quantum theory, dynamics, particle physics, spectral correspondence, or classification; word activations are sporadic, usually near the end of the body and the author section.
patterns.domain: Theoretical physics and mathematical physics papers

patterns.name: Academic abstract phrasing and closing punctuation
patterns.context: An academic abstract/body passage stating a proof or research result, followed by author metadata after the final punctuation.

patterns.name: Praise and audience in children's literature reviews
patterns.context: A review discusses a story and its popularity, mentioning readers, admirers, and children; activations are distributed across descriptions of evaluation and expected effects.

10_1365.concept: 学术论文元数据与边界
10_1365.description: 主要响应 ArXiv 论文作者栏的标签、分隔符、引用标记和排版边界；同时在理论物理术语、学术摘要句式及一段儿童文学评论的评价叙述中有零散激活。

patterns.name: ArXiv 作者元数据与排版
patterns.trigger: «author»:、«-» |、作者名单中的 «[^…]»、«\» 和机构行前的缩进
patterns.context: 论文正文后或摘要片段后出现作者栏；激活集中在标签、分隔符、引用标记及格式边界，姓名内部也有零星激活。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文模板与元数据

patterns.name: 数学物理论文中的专名或术语
patterns.context: 论文正文或标题涉及量子理论、动力学、粒子物理、谱对应或分类；词语激活零散，通常紧邻正文结束及作者栏。
patterns.domain: 理论物理及数学物理论文

patterns.name: 论文摘要句式与结尾标点
patterns.trigger: «In» this «note», we prove、«and» we provide、句末 «.'»
patterns.context: 陈述证明或研究结果的学术摘要/正文片段，句末标点后紧接作者元数据。

patterns.name: 儿童文学评论中的赞誉与受众
patterns.context: 评论故事及其受欢迎程度，提及读者、仰慕者和儿童；激活分布于评价和预期效果的叙述中。
patterns.domain: 维多利亚时期文学评论

en.description: The strongest repeated pattern is the author field, author/affiliation lists, and their line-break-separated formatting in ArXiv paper headers; also covers paper titles and abstracts, classification numbers, and acknowledgment/publication notes and animal-specimen narratives in two Gutenberg passages.

patterns.name: author field in ArXiv metadata
patterns.context: Author metadata appears after the paper abstract or title; activation often falls on the author label, colon, author list, and formatting markers.

patterns.name: ArXiv author and affiliation formatting
patterns.context: Author names, footnote markers, and institution names are arranged in the format of a paper's first page; often adjacent to the author field or a similar author block.

patterns.name: Academic text in paper titles and abstracts
patterns.context: The title or abstract body of a physics, control, or graph theory paper; sometimes followed by author metadata.

patterns.name: Reference classification numbers and paper header information
patterns.context: Discipline classification numbers, preprint identifiers, or institutional report numbers in the front matter of a paper, usually alongside title, author, or institution information.

patterns.name: Book acknowledgments and publisher's notes
patterns.context: The narrator thanks editors or indexers at the end of a book, then relays the publisher's desire to locate someone.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg old-style book front or back matter

patterns.name: Animal specimens in natural-history narratives
patterns.context: The narrator discusses searching for or failing to catch certain animals, specimens, and their habits.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg natural history or travel narrative

10_1365.concept: 论文元数据与文档结构
10_1365.description: 最强而重复的模式是 ArXiv 论文头部的 author 字段、作者/机构列表及其换行分隔格式；另覆盖论文标题摘要、分类编号，以及两段 Gutenberg 的致谢出版说明和动物标本叙述。

patterns.name: ArXiv 元数据中的 author 字段
patterns.trigger: «author»、«:»，以及其后的作者名、机构、换行和分隔符
patterns.context: 论文摘要或标题后出现 author 元数据；激活常落在 author 标签、冒号、作者列表和排版标记上。

patterns.name: ArXiv 作者与机构排版
patterns.trigger: «De»«hua» «Cheng»、«USC»、«Institute for Theoretical Physics» 等作者或机构条目及其相邻 «\»、«↵»
patterns.context: 作者名、脚注标记和机构名按论文首页格式排列；常与 author 字段或类似作者区块相邻。

patterns.name: 论文标题与摘要中的学术文本
patterns.trigger: «quantum potential approach to quantum theory»、«neutral mesons»、«particle oscillations»、«optimal affine sensor outputs»、«ell_1$ minimization problem»
patterns.context: 物理、控制或图论论文的标题或摘要正文；有时后接 author 元数据。

patterns.name: 参考文献分类号与论文头部信息
patterns.context: 论文前部的学科分类号、预印本编号或机构报告编号，通常与标题、作者或机构信息同现。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文头部/书目信息

patterns.name: 书籍致谢与出版者说明
patterns.trigger: «Miss Windeatt Roberts»、«Index»、«The publisher wishes me to say»
patterns.context: 叙述者在书末致谢编辑或索引编制者，随后转述出版者寻人的愿望。

patterns.name: 自然史叙述中的动物标本
patterns.context: 叙述者谈及搜寻或未能捕获某些动物、标本及其习性。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 自然史或旅行叙述

en.concept: Academic document structure and formatting markers
en.description: Activations occur mainly in academic documents, especially ArXiv paper author/affiliation metadata and LaTeX/Markdown formatting structures. Citations, section headings, course entries, and encyclopedia-style cultural narratives also trigger activations; no single thematic word explains all passages.

patterns.name: ArXiv paper author information block
patterns.context: An author heading, names, email, footnote markers, or institutional addresses appear after an abstract or body; LaTeX/Markdown formatting remnants sometimes occur.
patterns.domain: ArXiv papers and their converted text

patterns.name: Paper title and affiliation formatting
patterns.context: The metadata region on a paper's first page, comprising the title, author footnotes, and institutional addresses, with LaTeX formatting markers.

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and LaTeX structure
patterns.context: Mathematical expressions followed by LaTeX labels or citations, sometimes adjacent to prose; activations are not limited to the formulas themselves.

patterns.name: Graph algorithm course entries and roster formatting
patterns.context: Entries listed on separate lines by person name, course year, and topic in a project or course report.

patterns.name: Document section headings
patterns.context: Section headings in the body formed by Markdown markers and underscore separator lines.

patterns.name: Philosophers and cultural narratives
patterns.context: Narratives about people encountering, imitating, or being influenced by philosophical works and French culture.

patterns.name: Paper citations and body-text connections
patterns.context: References marked in the body using square brackets and author-year format, followed or preceded by mathematical discussion.

10_1365.concept: 学术文档结构与排版标记
10_1365.description: 主要激活于学术文档，尤其 ArXiv 论文的作者/机构元数据、LaTeX与Markdown排版结构；也响应引文、章节标题、课程条目及百科式文化叙述，未见单一主题词能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: ArXiv 论文作者信息块
patterns.trigger: «author»、«-»、«|»、缩进作者名，以及«\»后的换行和机构信息
patterns.context: 论文摘要或正文之后出现作者标题、作者姓名、邮箱、脚注标记或机构地址；有时包含 LaTeX/Markdown 排版残留
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文及其转换后的文本

patterns.name: 论文标题与机构排版
patterns.context: 论文首页标题、作者脚注和机构地址组成的元数据区域，混有 LaTeX 格式标记

patterns.name: 数学公式及 LaTeX 结构
patterns.context: 数学表达式后接 LaTeX 标签或引文，也可能与正文叙述相邻；激活不只落在公式本身

patterns.name: 图算法课程条目与名单排版
patterns.context: 项目或课程报告中按人名、课程年份和主题分行列出的条目
patterns.domain: GitHub 文档，课程/项目报告

patterns.name: 文档章节标题
patterns.context: 正文中由 Markdown 标记与下划线分隔线构成的章节标题
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文档的 Markdown/转换文本

patterns.name: 哲学家与文化叙述
patterns.context: 叙述人物接触、模仿或受到哲学著作及法国文化影响
patterns.domain: 百科全书式历史/人物传记

patterns.name: 论文文献引注与正文连接
patterns.context: 正文中以方括号和作者年份形式标注文献，前后接数学论述

en.description: Primarily responds to fragments of paper headers and metadata formatting (authors, institutions, titles, keywords, footnote markers), and also to questions about sequence terms and negative-number lists; another example is a GitHub course-topic roster. Function words, punctuation, and mathematical symbols are local triggers across passages and are difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Academic paper header metadata and author information
patterns.context: Line breaks, author fields, institution/footnote markers appear after an abstract or title; often contains LaTeX/LaTeX-like formatting fragments
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper metadata; similar academic roster formats

patterns.name: Questions about sequence terms in math problems
patterns.context: A natural-language question asks for a term in a sequence, followed by comma-separated negative integers; both passages activate near the end of the question

patterns.name: Keywords and classification information in mathematics papers
patterns.context: Keywords and subject classification fields before a paper abstract or body; some keyword lines end with a period

patterns.name: Paper titles and title fields
patterns.context: A paper header labels the title or abstract with a field name, followed by a proper noun or technical topic

patterns.name: Course roster for algorithm topics
patterns.context: Names, class years, and topics they are responsible for or involved with are listed line by line

patterns.name: Function words and punctuation in English phrases
patterns.context: Appears in ordinary English/LaTeX fragments such as paper abstracts, titles, or keywords; triggers are scattered, so a unified semantic condition cannot be determined from this alone

patterns.name: Local symbols in mathematical snippets
patterns.context: Number sequences in sequence problems; hyphens or dashes also occur in paper excerpts, so this may overlap with the formatting pattern above

10_1365.concept: 学术与结构化文本格式
10_1365.description: 主要响应论文头部与元数据排版残片（作者、机构、标题、关键词、脚注标记），也响应数列题的提问及负数列表；另见GitHub课程主题名录。函数词、标点和数学符号是跨段的局部触发，难归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 学术论文头部元数据与作者信息
patterns.context: 摘要或标题之后出现换行、作者字段、机构/脚注标记；常有 LaTeX/类 LaTeX 排版残片
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据；相似的学术名录格式

patterns.name: 数学题中的数列项提问
patterns.trigger: “What is the y'th term of”与“What is the h'th term of”，以及紧随其后的负数列表
patterns.context: 以自然语言询问数列的某一项，后接逗号分隔的负整数；两段均在问题末尾附近激活

patterns.name: 数学论文关键词及分类信息
patterns.trigger: «[**»…«Key words»…«**]»{}:»，关键词“Darboux transformation”“fractional Laplacian”等，以及“«PACS numbers»”
patterns.context: 论文摘要或正文前的关键词、学科分类字段；部分关键词行以句点收尾

patterns.name: 论文题名及标题字段
patterns.trigger: «title»与其后的“Finite Temperature Reduction”；另有摘要起始字段“«abstract»”
patterns.context: 论文头部以字段名标出题名或摘要，后接专名/专业主题

patterns.name: 算法主题的课程成员列表
patterns.context: 人名、班级年份及其负责或涉及的主题按行列出

patterns.name: 英文短语中的函数词与标点
patterns.trigger: « of»、« to»、« the»、« in»及逗号、句点、冒号等标点
patterns.context: 出现在论文摘要、标题或关键词等普通英文/LaTeX 片段中；触发分散，无法据此单独确定统一语义条件

patterns.name: 数学片段中的局部符号
patterns.context: 数列题中的数字序列；也有论文片段里的连字符或破折号，因此此处可能与前述格式模式重叠

en.description: Activations appear across line breaks, punctuation, and structural boundaries: paper metadata and citations, roster entries, sequence puzzles, literary narratives, and legal headings. Aside from a tendency toward formatting segmentation, the content and triggers are not consistent.

patterns.name: Paper metadata and formatting markers
patterns.context: Near structured metadata such as academic paper titles, authors, footnotes, classification codes, or references; activations often fall on line breaks, punctuation, and markers.
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic documents and their LaTeX/BibTeX formatting

patterns.name: Structured lists with numbers
patterns.context: A year in parentheses follows a name, then items such as courses, algorithms, or responsibilities are listed by line.
patterns.domain: GitHub project descriptions or acknowledgment lists

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in mathematical sequence puzzles
patterns.context: A number sequence is followed by a question such as “What comes next:” or “What is next in” and then candidate terms or another sequence to extend.

patterns.name: Ordinary punctuation in literary narrative
patterns.context: Activations occur on punctuation and common short words in English prose or dialogue; the two passages have no clear shared theme.

patterns.name: Paragraph headings in legal decisions
patterns.context: The body of a judicial decision transitions to findings or ruling sections separated by uppercase headings.
patterns.domain: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs legal documents

10_1365.description: 激活散见于换行、标点及结构边界：论文元数据和引用、名单条目、数列题、文学叙事、法律标题。除格式分段倾向外，各类内容和触发词不统一。

patterns.name: 论文元数据与格式标记
patterns.context: 学术论文标题、作者、脚注、分类号或参考文献等结构化元数据附近；激活常落在换行及标点、标记上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术文档及其 LaTeX/BibTeX 格式

patterns.name: 带数字的结构化列表
patterns.context: 姓名后附括号年份，随后按行列出课程、算法或职责等项目。
patterns.domain: GitHub 项目说明或致谢名单

patterns.name: 数学数列题中的数字与标点
patterns.context: 数字序列后出现“What comes next:”或“What is next in”等提问，并继续给出候选或待推数列。

patterns.name: 文学叙事中的普通标点
patterns.context: 英文散文或对话叙述中，标点及常见短词处出现激活；两段内容并无明显共同主题。

patterns.name: 法律裁决中的段落标题
patterns.context: 司法决定正文转入大写标题分隔的事实认定或判决部分。
patterns.domain: 美国退伍军人事务法律文书

en.description: The strongest activations occur on authors, citations, and formatting markers in academic papers, as well as academic prose in mathematical papers; activations also appear on commas and some numbers in sequence problems, and on words such as “comfort” in a memorial song text. Triggers are distributed across categories, with no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: HTML/TeX author information and markers
patterns.context: Near author lists, author markers, or reference cross-references in academic documents; activations fall on formatting tags, punctuation, and name fragments
patterns.domain: HTML- or TeX-converted text from ArXiv/PubMed Central papers

patterns.name: Academic prose in mathematical papers
patterns.context: In the body of mathematical papers stating theorem conditions, theoretical progress, proofs, or results; activations are distributed across ordinary academic phrasing rather than concentrated on a single term
patterns.domain: ArXiv papers on mathematics, probability, and analysis

patterns.name: Commas and numerical separators in sequence problems
patterns.context: Commas separating consecutive terms in sequence or pattern-finding problems; activations fall mainly on separators and some number tokens
patterns.domain: Math exercises / automatically generated sequence Q&A

patterns.name: Emotional words in memorial-song narratives
patterns.context: First-person accounts of writing a song after the death of a son, expressing the hope that others will find comfort in the lyrics
patterns.domain: Personal stories, music introductions, or memorial texts

10_1365.description: 激活最突出的是学术论文中的作者、引用与格式标记，以及数学论文正文的学术叙述；另在数列题的逗号和部分数字、悼念歌曲文本中的“comfort”等词上也激活。各类触发分散，未见单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: HTML/TeX 作者信息与标记
patterns.trigger: «caps»、«span»、«author»、«ref-type»、«\»及作者姓名中被拆分标记的片段
patterns.context: 学术文档的作者列表、作者标记或参考文献交叉引用附近；激活落在格式标签、标点和姓名片段上
patterns.domain: ArXiv/PubMed Central 论文的 HTML 或 TeX 转换文本

patterns.name: 数学论文中的学术叙述
patterns.context: 数学论文正文中陈述定理条件、理论进展、证明或结果；激活分布于普通学术表达，不集中在单一术语
patterns.domain: 数学、概率与分析类 ArXiv 论文

patterns.name: 数列题中的逗号及数值分隔
patterns.context: 数列或找规律题中，逗号分隔连续数项；激活主要落在分隔符及部分数字 token 上
patterns.domain: 数学练习题/自动生成的数列问答

patterns.name: 悼念歌曲叙述中的情感词
patterns.context: 第一人称描述儿子去世后写歌，并表达希望他人从歌词中获得安慰
patterns.domain: 个人故事、音乐介绍或悼念性文本

en.description: Activations commonly occur on LaTeX equation commands, equation boundaries, and academic discussion in ArXiv, and also cover mathematical terminology, cited names, and author metadata. There are also ordinary words in literary narratives and negative-number fragments in sequence puzzles. Overall, this appears to be a mixture of responses to multiple formatting types and local subword fragments.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical formulas and structural markers
patterns.context: Near commands, equation punctuation, and structural markers in mathematical formulas, alignment environments, or piecewise definitions; present in multiple independent formula passages.

patterns.name: English connective language in mathematical paper prose
patterns.context: Paper body text following formulas, or academic discussion introducing theorems, results, and subsequent arguments.

patterns.name: Author-name fragments in citations
patterns.context: Names split by tokenization, appearing in references or body text introducing existing results.

patterns.name: H-space and fibration terminology
patterns.context: Topology passages discussing H-spaces, fibers, and contractibility conditions.

patterns.name: Paper metadata and author sections
patterns.context: Addresses, authors, and other metadata follow the end of the paper body; author names are split into subwords.

patterns.name: Degree or contrast words in English narrative
patterns.context: Literary narration describing a character occasionally leaving social life and nevertheless enjoying something; activations fall on scattered ordinary words.

patterns.name: Number fragments in negative-number sequence puzzles
patterns.context: In integer sequences asking for the next term, the minus sign and number are split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: H^p and L^p space notation and theoretical discussion
patterns.context: States that function spaces coincide over a specified parameter range and introduces related theoretical developments.

10_1365.description: 激活常见于 ArXiv 的 LaTeX 公式命令、公式边界及学术论述，也覆盖数学术语、引文人名和作者元数据；另有文学叙述中的普通词及负数数列数字片段。整体更像多类格式与局部词片段的混合响应。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学公式与结构标记
patterns.context: 数学公式、对齐环境或分段定义中，尤其是命令、公式标点和结构标记附近；多个独立公式片段中均出现

patterns.name: 数学论文叙述中的英文衔接语
patterns.context: 公式之后的论文正文，或介绍定理、结果与后续论证的学术叙述

patterns.name: 引用文献中的作者名片段
patterns.context: 人名被分词切开，出现在文献引用或介绍既有结果的正文中

patterns.name: H空间与纤维化术语
patterns.context: 讨论 H-space、纤维及可缩性条件的拓扑学段落

patterns.name: 论文元数据与作者栏
patterns.context: 论文正文结束后转入地址、作者等元数据，作者名被拆分为子词

patterns.name: 英文叙事中程度或转折词
patterns.context: 描写人物偶尔离开社交生活、又很享受某事的文学叙述；激活落在分散的普通词上

patterns.name: 负数数列题中的数字片段
patterns.context: 要求求下一项的整数数列中，负号与数字被拆成多个 token

patterns.name: H^p 与 L^p 空间记号及其理论叙述
patterns.context: 陈述函数空间在特定参数范围内相合，并引出相关理论发展

en.concept: Local subword fragments and common collocations
en.description: Activations are distributed across greatly for significant change, to-infinitives, enjoyment, an internal French word fragment, the lo substring, negative-number fragments, Anyone, and a fragment of the surname Sugawara; triggers are not consistent beyond a few local collocations.

patterns.name: greatly followed by change or result
patterns.context: The adverb greatly is followed by a verb describing a significant change, improvement, or difference

patterns.name: High activation on to in to-infinitives
patterns.context: To is followed by a verb or mathematical expression; the highest activation in this group occurs in Sugawara goes on to obtain

patterns.name: Enjoying something
patterns.context: The degree adverb so much modifies enjoyed, with a person and social activity mentioned earlier

patterns.name: Internal segmentation of commencer
patterns.context: The French first-person future-tense verb commencerai is split into tokens, and the initial subword fragment comm activates strongly

patterns.name: The lo substring
patterns.context: Lo occurs within an English word or fragment: in segment 7, it appears in a phrase before behold, while in segment 9 it is embedded in a variant spelling fragment of like; no stable semantic condition is evident

patterns.name: Number fragments in mathematical sequences
patterns.context: Negative-number sequence problems are tokenized into minus signs and numbers; activation falls on token fragments within numbers

patterns.name: Number fragments in negative sequences
patterns.context: In a problem asking for the hth term of a sequence, activation falls on number fragments in negative numbers

patterns.name: Strong activation on Anyone
patterns.context: In technical discussions, Anyone's interested introduces interest or follow-up information

patterns.name: Name fragment Sugawara
patterns.context: The name Sugawara appears in a mathematical paper in a sentence stating a subsequent result

10_1365.concept: 局部词片段与常见搭配
10_1365.description: 激活分散在 greatly 表示显著变化、to 不定式、享受、法语词内片段、lo 子串、数学负数数字片段、Anyone，以及 Sugawara 姓名片段；除少数局部搭配外，触发条件不统一。

patterns.name: greatly 与后续变化或结果
patterns.context: 副词 greatly 后接描述程度显著变化、改进或差异的动词

patterns.name: to 不定式中 to 的高激活
patterns.context: to 后接动词或数学表达式；本组中最高激活出现在 Sugawara goes on to obtain

patterns.name: 享受某事
patterns.context: 程度副词 so much 修饰 enjoyed，前文提到人物与社交活动

patterns.name: commencer 的词内分段
patterns.context: 法语第一人称将来时动词 commencerai，被切分的词首子串 comm 获得强激活

patterns.name: lo 子串
patterns.context: lo 出现在英文词或词片段中：段7为 behold 前的短语位置，段9则嵌在 like 的变体拼写片段中；未见稳定语义条件

patterns.name: 数学序列中的数字片段
patterns.context: 负数数列题中，负号及数字被分词；激活落在数字内部的 token 片段

patterns.name: 负数序列中的数字片段
patterns.context: 询问数列第 h 项的题目中，激活落在负数的数字片段

patterns.name: Anyone 的强激活
patterns.context: 技术讨论中以 Anyone's interested 引出兴趣或后续信息

patterns.name: Sugawara 姓名片段
patterns.context: 数学论文中人名 Sugawara 出现在陈述其后续结果的句子里

en.description: Activations occur mainly in academic literature reviews, research progress, and statements of results, especially authors/citations, paper contributions, and degree emphasis with “greatly”; they also occur in email requests, a French parliamentary opening, and two paragraph-initial instances of “There are.” The relation of segment 8 to the overall pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: Author surnames and literature citations
patterns.context: Academic passages listing earlier researchers or authors, often accompanied by citations; activations fall on name fragments or following narrative words

patterns.name: Emphasis of degree with greatly
patterns.context: Greatly modifies research results, method effectiveness, or differences; the word itself activates strongly in all three segments
patterns.domain: Academic paper abstracts or body text

patterns.name: Research progress in literature reviews
patterns.context: States prior work, recent progress, or research results in a field, often at the beginning of a paragraph or in a literature review

patterns.name: Overview of paper structure and contributions
patterns.context: Authors summarize the methods proposed, results presented, or contributions of the paper

patterns.name: Formal academic terminology and statements of results
patterns.context: Mathematical or theoretical papers state properties of objects, theoretical results, or existence and uniqueness; activations occur near terminology and statements of results
patterns.domain: Mathematics, physics, and theoretical academic papers

patterns.name: Requests and names in emails
patterns.context: An email with a confidentiality agreement as its subject discusses someone’s desired task and asks who should handle it

patterns.name: Polite opening in French parliamentary speech
patterns.context: A speaker addresses the chair and those present, then begins speaking in the first person

patterns.name: There are at paragraph openings
patterns.context: A new paragraph or line begins with “There are” to introduce a situation or existing research; only this fixed opening is directly observable

10_1365.concept: 学术论述与文献综述线索
10_1365.description: 主要激活于学术文献综述、研究进展与结果表述，尤其是作者/引文、论文贡献和“greatly”程度强调；另见邮件请求、法语议会开场，以及两处段首“There are”。第8段与整体模式关系不明。

patterns.name: 作者姓氏与文献引用
patterns.trigger: 作者名或姓氏的子词，如 «hard«y»3«-»1«ram»4«an»3«uj»1«an»3«1918»3«»,»6«、«Uspens«ky»2、«authors»9«、«Hof»2«mann»4«、«Mit»3«rea»5« and»2« Yan»5« further»9« developed»3«；常紧邻 [@…] 引文
patterns.context: 学术段落中列举先前研究者或作者，常伴随文献引用；激活落在姓名片段或后续叙述词上

patterns.name: greatly 强调程度
patterns.trigger: « greatly»10« refined»5«、« greatly»9« simplify»2«，以及 «greatly»9« differs»
patterns.context: greatly 修饰研究结果、方法效果或差异；该词本身在三段中均有强激活

patterns.name: 文献综述中的研究进展
patterns.trigger: « Recently»4« … « drawn»4« wide»4« interest»2« and»5« many»5« results»9«；« further»9« developed»3« the»1« theory»2；« There»9« are»2« already»3« a»3« lot»4« of»4« works»5« which»7« provide»4
patterns.context: 陈述某领域已有工作、近期进展或研究结果，常出现在段落开头或文献综述处

patterns.name: 论文结构与贡献概述
patterns.trigger: « In»4« this»2« note»5« we»7« introduce»4« a»4« perturbative»3« framework»1« and»6« show»5« how»1«；以及 « contributions»4« are»4« a»4« comparison»
patterns.context: 作者概述本文提出的方法、展示的结果或贡献

patterns.name: 形式化学术术语及结果陈述
patterns.trigger: « Hausdorff dimension»、« evid»3«ences»5«、« stronger»1« version»2«；« action»2« admits»1« a»3« natural»3« supers»1«ym»1«metrization»；« existence»1« and»1« uniqueness»
patterns.context: 数学或理论论文中陈述对象性质、理论结果或存在唯一性；激活分布在术语与结果表述附近
patterns.domain: 数学、物理及理论学术论文

patterns.name: 邮件中的请求与人名
patterns.trigger: «Christi»,»2« Kevin»1 would« lo»9«ke»4« to»3« do»2 this«.»2« «Who»3« should»1
patterns.context: 邮件主题为保密协议，正文讨论某人想办理事项并询问应由谁处理

patterns.name: 法语议会发言中的礼貌开场
patterns.trigger: «Günter» Ver«he»1«ugen»3«↵»«M»3«onsieur»1 le Président»,»1« Mesdames et Messieurs«,»1« je»2« comm»9«encer»3ai
patterns.context: 议会发言者称呼主席及在场人士，随后以第一人称开始发言

patterns.name: 段落开头的 There are
patterns.context: 新段落或换行后以“There are”引出某种情况或已有研究；仅能直接观察到该固定开头

en.concept: ArXiv paper structure and attribution boundaries
en.description: Activations cluster mainly around the abstract-to-author-metadata boundary in ArXiv papers, line-break delimiters, and author names. There are also sporadic triggers from equation citation formatting, HTML small-caps author formatting, and words in economics and various physics abstracts, with no stable single-discipline semantics evident.

patterns.name: Author information boundary at the end of an ArXiv title
patterns.context: The title or abstract transitions to an author/attribution section, often with line breaks, delimiters, author names, or institution names; paragraphs 1 and 2 also show strong activation at the transition from title to author information.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper metadata and abstract formatting

patterns.name: Formatting structure near mathematical formulas and citations
patterns.context: Near formulas, citations, or marked LaTeX structures, activations fall on formatting symbols, connectives, and subsequent formula content; no stable mathematical-theme trigger is evident.
patterns.domain: LaTeX formatting in mathematics/physics paper bodies

patterns.name: Fragmented word forms in high-energy physics titles
patterns.context: A paper title is split by special markers or tokenization, with activations around title text and its boundaries.

patterns.name: Mixed title and author metadata markers
patterns.context: An ArXiv identifier, title emphasis markers, author names, and departmental information occur together in the same passage.

patterns.name: Common connectives and punctuation at abstract endings
patterns.context: At the end of sentences in abstract-style English statements or in the transition from abstract to author fields; these words recur in abstracts on different topics, but do not activate equally everywhere.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in author names
patterns.context: Names in the author field or attribution section after an abstract are often split into subwords and occur next to line breaks and delimiters.

patterns.name: HTML small-caps name formatting
patterns.context: Author lists use HTML span tags for small-caps styling, with names interspersed among tags and superscript markers.
patterns.domain: Paper author lists with HTML formatting

patterns.name: Semantic emphasis words in abstracts
patterns.context: A mathematics history or number theory statement says that a cited result was further improved; here, intensity is concentrated on the adverb.

patterns.name: Market-model keywords
patterns.context: Abstract body text discussing the market as an aggregate opponent and the paradox of monetary preference; the topic differs from the other physics/metadata samples.

patterns.name: Quantum and physics terminology
patterns.context: Physics abstracts contain terms such as quantum algorithms, quantum gravity, plasma, stellar oscillations, or magnetic states; activations do not consistently correspond to any particular term.

10_1365.description: 激活主要聚集在 ArXiv 论文的摘要—作者元数据边界、换行分隔符及作者姓名附近；另有公式引用排版、HTML small-caps 作者格式，以及经济学和多类物理摘要中的零散词语触发，未显示稳定的单一学科语义。

patterns.name: ArXiv 标题末尾的作者信息边界
patterns.trigger: «author»:«9»、«↵»、«-»、«|»及后续作者名或机构信息；另见「L.M. Slad」「Riccardo Rattazzi」
patterns.context: 论文标题或摘要结束后进入作者/署名区域，常伴随换行、分隔符、作者名或机构名；第1、2段在标题与作者信息过渡处也有强激活
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据与摘要格式

patterns.name: 数学公式与文献引用附近的排版结构
patterns.context: 公式、引用或标记性 LaTeX 结构附近，激活落在格式符号、连接词及公式后续内容上；未见稳定的数学主题词触发条件
patterns.domain: 数学/物理论文正文的 LaTeX 排版

patterns.name: 高能物理标题中的破碎词形
patterns.context: 论文标题被特殊标记或分词切分，激活出现在标题文字及其边界附近

patterns.name: 论文题名与作者元数据的混合标记
patterns.context: ArXiv 编号、标题强调标记、作者姓名和院系信息在同一片段中相邻出现

patterns.name: 摘要结尾的常见连接词与标点
patterns.context: 摘要式英文陈述的句子结尾或摘要到作者字段的过渡处；这些词在不同主题摘要中重复出现，但并非每处都同样激活

patterns.name: 作者姓名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 摘要后作者字段或署名区域内，姓名常被切成子词并与换行、分隔符相邻

patterns.name: HTML 小型大写姓名格式
patterns.context: 作者列表以 HTML span 标签设置 small-caps 样式，姓名穿插在标签与上标标记之间
patterns.domain: 带 HTML 格式的论文作者列表

patterns.name: 摘要中的语义强调词
patterns.context: 数学史或数论陈述中，引用后说明结果被进一步改进；此处强度集中在副词

patterns.name: 市场模型主题词
patterns.context: 讨论市场作为整体对手及货币偏好悖论的摘要正文；与其余物理/元数据样本主题不同
patterns.domain: 经济学或市场建模摘要

patterns.name: 量子与物理术语
patterns.context: 物理学摘要中出现量子算法、量子引力、等离子体、天体振荡或磁态等领域术语；激活并不固定对应某个术语

en.description: Activations are distributed across formulas, citations, title metadata, group theory, and physics discourse in papers and bibliographic formatting; they also appear in experimental results, legal evidentiary language, and software Q&A requests for help with upgrades. Commonality is weak, and activations often fall near transitions, citations, or formatted text.

patterns.name: Relational symbols and expression transitions in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Near mathematical symbols, formulas, or transitions between formulas and body text; activations fall on nearby punctuation, relational symbols, or short words, with no single fixed symbol

patterns.name: Transitional and emphatic wording in academic prose
patterns.context: Academic prose introduces subsequent developments, differences in results, or conclusions drawn from preceding text; triggers may include adverbs, connectives, and nearby words

patterns.name: Citations, author names, and bibliography markers
patterns.context: Bracketed citations, author names, and references or title markers in papers; activations are distributed across tokens near citations
patterns.domain: Academic papers and their formatted text

patterns.name: Academic titles and author-affiliation metadata
patterns.context: Paper titles, author bylines, affiliation information, and their line breaks or formatting markers

patterns.name: Group theory and physics symmetry terminology
patterns.context: Mathematical physics contexts discussing groups, subgroups, symmetries, or group order
patterns.domain: Mathematical physics and group theory papers

patterns.name: Evidentiary and ruling language in legal documents
patterns.context: Discussion of parties’ claims, supporting evidence, and statements by an administrative law judge about evidence

patterns.name: Software-upgrade help requests in online Q&A
patterns.context: A questioner describes being unable to find a feature after an upgrade and asks whether anyone knows about compatibility changes

patterns.name: Process notation and figure references in particle physics
patterns.context: Collision processes are described using particle or boson symbols, with references to diagrams

patterns.name: Comparison of experimental measurements in a paper
patterns.context: Reports experimental observations as a function of pseudorapidity and compares them with prior experimental results

patterns.name: Bibliographic records mixing titles and numbers
patterns.context: Numbers, preprint identifiers, and titles appear next to each other in bibliography entries or paper fragments

10_1365.concept: 异质文档中的结构化叙述
10_1365.description: 激活分布在论文与文献排版中的公式、引文、标题元数据、群论和物理叙述，也见实验结果、法律证据措辞及软件问答升级求助；共同点较弱，常落在承接词、引用或格式化文本附近。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的关系符号与表达式衔接
patterns.context: 数学符号、公式或公式与正文衔接处；激活落在公式附近的标点、关系符号或短词上，未见单一固定符号

patterns.name: 学术正文中的承接与强调措辞
patterns.trigger: “greatly refined”“greatly differs”“Later on”“From this one can follow”
patterns.context: 论文叙述中介绍后续发展、结果差异或由前文推出结论；触发可能包括副词、连接词和邻近词

patterns.name: 引文、作者名与参考文献标记
patterns.context: 论文中的方括号引用、作者姓名及参考文献或标题标记；激活分布在引文邻近 token
patterns.domain: 学术论文及其排版文本

patterns.name: 学术标题与作者机构元数据
patterns.trigger: “[**About neutral mesons and particle oscillations...” “Disoriented Sleptons” “Department of Physics and Astronomy”
patterns.context: 论文标题、作者署名、机构信息及其换行或格式标记

patterns.name: 群论与物理对称性术语
patterns.context: 讨论群、子群、对称性或群阶的数学物理语境

patterns.name: 法律文书中的证据与裁决措辞
patterns.trigger: “substantiating his otherwise conclusive statements” “ALJ misstated the evidence”
patterns.context: 论述当事人主张、证据支持及行政法官对证据的陈述

patterns.name: 在线问答中的软件升级求助
patterns.trigger: “new version” “not able to find the same” “breaking changes”
patterns.context: 提问者描述升级后找不到功能，并询问是否有人了解兼容性变化

patterns.name: 粒子物理中的过程记号与图表引用
patterns.context: 以粒子或玻色子符号描述碰撞过程，并引用示意图

patterns.name: 论文中实验测量结果的比较
patterns.trigger: “the signal rises” “measurement greatly differs from the NA49 results”
patterns.context: 报告实验观测随赝快度变化，并与既有实验结果比较

patterns.name: 题名与编号混杂的文献记录
patterns.context: 文献条目或论文片段中，编号、预印本标识与标题相邻

en.concept: Structural and discourse markers in formal writing
en.description: Activations are distributed across connective prose, citations and names, theorem proofs, background references, and theoretical applications in academic papers; they also occur in polite French parliamentary openings, legal evidentiary discussion, and formatting markers on paper title pages. There is no single clear trigger word.

patterns.name: Paper citations and author-name markers
patterns.context: References to prior work, authors, and years in mathematical paper body text; high activations fall on words connecting citations to the narrative and fragments within citations.

patterns.name: Narrative connectives in academic prose
patterns.context: Common English function and discourse words activate as papers explain derivations, state results, or guide readers; specific triggers vary across passages.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, physics, and theoretical papers

patterns.name: Physics diagrams and literature citations
patterns.context: A particle physics paper mentions a diagram and immediately follows it with a citation; strong activations occur in tokenized fragments of cited names.

patterns.name: Polite expressions in French parliamentary speech
patterns.context: A French parliamentary speech opens with a formal address and uses “I first thank…” to introduce the speech.

patterns.name: Evidence and judicial statements in legal documents
patterns.context: A legal opinion discusses parties’ failure to provide supporting examples and states their objection to the administrative law judge’s evidentiary finding.

patterns.name: Numbering and layout markers on paper title pages
patterns.context: On a physics paper’s title page or in its metadata area, numbers, line breaks, titles, and affiliation fields alternate; activations concentrate on formatting fragments and backslash markers.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper title pages / formatted text

patterns.name: Theorem, lemma, and proof structure
patterns.context: A mathematical paper states results and introduces a lemma, or explains that the paper will complete a proof; theorem- and proof-related words and organizational prose activate.

patterns.name: Background to mathematical theory and reader guidance
patterns.context: A paper reviews the origins or background of a theory and directs readers to books or references.

patterns.name: Narrative of group representations and quantum-theory applications
patterns.context: Discusses the role of a particular group or symmetry in theoretical construction, including mathematical objects, prior research, and applications.

10_1365.concept: 正式文体中的结构与叙述标记
10_1365.description: 激活分布于学术论文的行文连接、引文与姓名、定理证明、背景指引和理论应用，也出现在法语议会礼貌开场、法律证据论述及论文首页版式标记；没有单一明确触发词。

patterns.name: 论文引文与作者姓名标记
patterns.context: 数学论文正文中引用前人工作、作者和年份；高激活落在连接引用与叙述的词，以及引文内部碎片。

patterns.name: 学术正文中的叙述连接词
patterns.trigger: « greatly»10« refined»5« later»4« to»6«；« From»3« this»2« one»5« can»9« follow»6« that；« the»7« reader»6« to»9
patterns.context: 论文解释推导、陈述结果或引导读者时，若干常见英语功能词和叙述词获得激活；不同段落中具体触发词不完全相同。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、物理及理论论文

patterns.name: 物理图示与文献引用
patterns.context: 粒子物理论文提到图示并紧接文献引用；引用人名的分词片段中有强激活。

patterns.name: 法语议会发言中的礼貌表达
patterns.trigger: «Günter Ver«he»2«ugen»3；«M»2onsieur le Président, Mesdames et Messieurs,« je»2« comm»9«encer»2ai« par»2« rem»8ercier
patterns.context: 法语议会发言以正式称呼开场，并用“我先感谢……”引入发言。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的证据与裁判表述

en.description: Activations are distributed across academic papers and literary narratives, involving common connectives, relative clauses, summaries of research, citation-author fragments, and LaTeX/title-page metadata; there is no stable single meaning or topic, and the feature appears to be jointly driven by various local formatting and syntactic cues.

patterns.name: Connectives and phrases in academic text
patterns.context: Occurs in English sentences or passages, often introducing a following clause, adding clarification, or summarizing prior work; the trigger is not fixed to a single part of speech.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical typesetting commands
patterns.context: Occurs near equation environments, equation numbers, or paper typesetting source.

patterns.name: Reference author-name fragments
patterns.context: A tokenized author surname fragment immediately follows the citation marker [@…].

patterns.name: Paper title and author/affiliation layout
patterns.context: Titles, author names, and affiliation information are laid out among line breaks and markers.

patterns.name: Dates and preprint identifiers
patterns.context: Dates, laboratories, and archive identifiers in the margins or footers of paper title pages.

patterns.name: Subject introducing a following predicate or complement
patterns.context: A relative pronoun introduces a clause modifying students, followed by learnt from him.

patterns.name: Section references and introduction of research
patterns.context: Explains that a preceding theorem does not apply and introduces an extension of the result in a section of the paper.

patterns.name: Author reference in literary narrative
patterns.context: Written narrative states the author’s intention in writing.

patterns.name: Evaluation and commentary contexts
patterns.context: Comments on a person’s attire and a sentence about no one daring to make a certain judgment.

patterns.name: Summary sentence about quantum-theory applications
patterns.context: Many authors is the subject of a sentence summarizing how authors use high symmetry to construct theories.

10_1365.description: 激活分散于学术论文和文学叙述中，涉及常见连接词、关系从句、研究工作概述、引文作者片段及 LaTeX/首页元数据；没有稳定的单一词义或主题，较像受多种局部格式与句法线索共同驱动。

patterns.name: 学术文本中的连接词与短语
patterns.context: 出现在英文句子或句段中，常位于引出后续从句、补充说明或概括既有工作的语境；触发点不固定为单一词类。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学排版命令

patterns.name: 参考文献作者名片段

patterns.name: 论文标题与作者/机构版式

patterns.name: 日期及预印本编号

patterns.name: 主语引出后续谓语或补语

patterns.name: 章节引用及研究工作介绍

patterns.name: 量子理论应用的概括句

en.description: Primarily responds to academic discussion, researcher actions, and technical terminology in ArXiv papers, and also activates on author/classification metadata, citations, section numbers, and names. These cues span mathematical physics and do not form a single theme.

patterns.name: Narrating research actions by paper authors
patterns.context: Academic text states what researchers will, have, or have tried to do, often followed by a result, definition, or criterion.

patterns.name: Paper metadata and author attribution
patterns.context: Bibliographic metadata such as classifications, authors, and institutions outside the abstract or body.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper headers and author information

patterns.name: Citation and cross-reference markers
patterns.context: The body cites references, theorems, or sections, or a title contains bolded citation links.

patterns.name: Structural numbering and formatting boundaries
patterns.context: Near structural paper markers such as sections, classification codes, archive identifiers, and line breaks.

patterns.name: Academic vocabulary and technical content
patterns.context: Technical terms, research objects, or property descriptions occur in mathematics or physics papers; no clear single theme is evident.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, physics, and astronomy paper body text

patterns.name: Listing or citing researcher names
patterns.context: Names occur as previous researchers, theorem originators, or cited authors.

10_1365.description: 主要响应ArXiv论文的学术叙述、研究者动作与专业术语，也对作者/分类等元数据、引文、章节编号和人名有激活；这些线索跨数学物理领域，未形成单一主题。

patterns.name: 论文元数据与作者署名

patterns.name: 引文与交叉引用标记

patterns.name: 结构编号及格式边界

patterns.name: 学术词汇与技术内容

patterns.name: 列举或引述研究者姓名
patterns.context: 姓名作为前人研究者、定理提出者或被引作者出现

en.description: Activations are distributed across paper titles and metadata, LaTeX/citation formatting, academic prose, book prose, and email headers. Commonality is weak; some peaks may come from boundary markers, formatting symbols, or common discourse transitions rather than a single topic.

patterns.name: Punctuation boundaries in paper titles and metadata
patterns.context: Activations concentrate at the boundary between titles, authors, or affiliation information and line breaks or LaTeX/Markdown markers; they do not consistently respond to vocabulary from a particular discipline.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper headers and formatting markers

patterns.name: Phrasing that introduces theorems or sections in mathematical papers
patterns.context: Local connectives and section-introduction phrases activate when describing research steps, noting that a theorem does not apply, and explaining how results will be extended or organized.

patterns.name: Historical account of fractional calculus
patterns.context: Narrative context in which historical figures raise questions and later scholars attempt to define fractional derivatives.
patterns.domain: History of mathematics and academic papers

patterns.name: LaTeX structural markers in formula environments
patterns.context: Equation numbers, labels, or the end of formula environments; activations occur next to formula source markers.

patterns.name: Literature citations and strings of scholar names
patterns.context: Occurs when citing related work, listing authors, and summarizing theoretical development; formatting factors such as citation brackets and tokenized names may also be involved.
patterns.domain: Mathematical analysis papers and citation discourse

patterns.name: Understanding and reader exhortation in book prose
patterns.context: First-person or exhortative prose discusses how to understand something, begin learning, and then turns to the reader’s interests.

patterns.name: Email headers and business correspondence formatting
patterns.context: A recipient and subject follow email header fields; the body also contains a brief question.

10_1365.description: 激活分布于论文标题与元数据、LaTeX/引用格式、学术叙述，以及书籍散文和邮件头。共同点较弱，部分峰值可能来自边界标记、格式符号或常见叙述衔接语，而非单一主题。

patterns.name: 论文标题与元数据中的标点边界
patterns.context: 激活集中在标题、作者或机构信息与换行、LaTeX/Markdown 标记交界处；并非对某个特定学科词汇的稳定响应。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文头部与格式标记

patterns.name: 数学论文中引入定理或章节的措辞
patterns.context: 叙述研究步骤、指出定理不适用并说明将如何扩展或组织结果时，局部连接词和章节引介语激活。

patterns.name: 分数阶微积分的历史叙述
patterns.trigger: «He»、«asked»、«Later on»、«many researchers»、«tried to give a definition»
patterns.context: 围绕历史人物提出问题、后续学者尝试定义分数阶导数的叙述性语境。

patterns.name: 公式环境中的 LaTeX 结构标记
patterns.context: 方程编号、标签或公式环境结束处；激活与公式源码标记相邻。

patterns.name: 文献引用及学者姓名串
patterns.context: 引用相关工作、列举作者并概述理论发展时出现；也可能包含引用括号和姓名分词的格式因素。
patterns.domain: 数学分析论文及参考文献叙述

patterns.name: 书籍散文中的理解与读者劝导
