patterns.context: 第一人称或劝导性散文中，讨论如何理解对象、开始学习，并转向读者兴趣。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 文学或宗教性散文

patterns.name: 邮件头与商务通信格式
patterns.context: 邮件头字段之后接收件人及主题；正文另有简短询问。

en.concept: Continuation and structural cues in academic text
en.description: Activations often occur in academic text describing continuation, attempts, extension, or inquiry, and also in physics-paper author affiliations, titles, and formatting markers; they additionally cover an evaluation of a historical literary figure, making it difficult to assign a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Weak continuation and extension phrasing in papers
patterns.context: Narrates research history, identifies shortcomings in prior results, and proposes to continue, extend, or explain them; activations occur on words such as “we shall,” “slightly,” “researchers,” “tried,” and “to”
patterns.domain: Academic papers, especially mathematical, philosophical, and history-of-science writing

patterns.name: Inquiry phrasing in mathematical-paper questions
patterns.context: A mathematical proposition or condition is stated first, followed by a question asking for a proof or source

patterns.name: Physics-paper metadata and author information
patterns.context: Authors, affiliations, markers, and line-break layout in a paper’s title page or header; activations often fall on author names, affiliations, and backslashes
patterns.domain: High-energy physics paper title pages and author information

patterns.name: Topic words in particle physics titles
patterns.context: Particle-physics paper titles or abstract fragments concerning mesons, decay, colliders, and theoretical prescriptions; activations are scattered across topic words and title formatting

patterns.name: Title and structural markers in documents
patterns.context: Document structure formatting at the boundary between paper titles, section/author fields, line breaks, and body text

patterns.name: Characters and evaluation in literary narratives
patterns.context: Biographical or historical literary narrative focused on a person, with evaluative descriptions and narrator commentary

10_1365.concept: 学术文本中的延续与结构线索
10_1365.description: 激活多见于学术文本中延续、尝试、扩展或求证的叙述，也出现在物理论文作者机构、标题及排版标记；另覆盖一段历史文学人物评价，难以归为统一词义模式。

patterns.context: 正文叙述研究史、指出既有结果不足，并提出将继续扩展或阐释；激活集中于“we shall”“slightly”“researchers”“tried”“to”等词
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤见数学、哲学与科学史叙述

patterns.name: 数学论文问句中的求证表达

patterns.context: 论文首页或页眉中的作者、机构、标记和换行排版；激活常落在作者名、机构及反斜线附近

patterns.name: 文档中的标题及结构标记
patterns.context: 论文标题、分节/作者栏及换行等文档结构格式与正文交界处

patterns.name: 文学叙述中的人物与评价
patterns.trigger: “the chaplain of Oliver Cromwell”“a strange mixture of money-grasping, enthusiasm, and humour”“the author”

en.concept: Expressions of discourse and research progress
en.description: Activations occur in academic argumentation expressing research progress, understanding, and problem-solving, as well as in paper metadata and physics formulas; they also cover reader exhortation and historical evaluation in older prose, and introductions to poetic traditions. Common cues are weak.

patterns.name: First-person research progress in academic discourse
patterns.context: A first-person plural or singular subject is followed by a research action, plan, or argumentative step; typically occurs in a paper’s body text
patterns.domain: Academic papers in mathematics, physics, or philosophy

patterns.name: First-person plural expressions of knowledge and analysis
patterns.context: We co-occurs with wish, understand, must, studying, and other words expressing understanding or research processes

patterns.name: Question-and-answer and subsequent research in historical narratives
patterns.context: First recounts a person asking a question, then describes later attempts to answer it

patterns.name: Paper title, author, affiliation, and other bibliographic metadata
patterns.context: Title-page or header information such as titles, authors, footnote markers, affiliations, or preprint identifiers

patterns.name: Physical processes and figure references
patterns.context: Physical symbols, collision processes, and figure references appear in technical discussion

patterns.name: Exhortation, requests, and moral evaluation in older prose
patterns.context: A first-person author addresses readers directly with reading advice, or expresses concerns and evaluations

patterns.name: Character evaluation and narrative in older historical prose
patterns.context: Narrates or evaluates historical figures and explains the author’s writing choices
patterns.domain: Gutenberg historical biography or historical writing

patterns.name: Poetic tradition, teaching, and continuation
patterns.context: Introduces a poet, folk narrative, or work, and mentions students carrying on the poet’s poetry

10_1365.description: 激活见于学术论证中的研究推进、理解与求解表达，也见于论文元数据和物理公式；另覆盖旧式散文的读者劝告与历史评价，以及诗歌传承介绍。共同线索较弱。

patterns.name: 学术论述中的第一人称研究推进
patterns.trigger: we shall slightly extend his result；I will here try to develop further

patterns.domain: 学术论文，数学、物理或哲学

patterns.name: 第一人称复数的认识与分析表达
patterns.trigger: if we wish to understand them, we must begin by studying it
patterns.context: we 与 wish、understand、must、studying 等表达理解或研究过程的词共现

patterns.name: 历史叙述中的人物问答与后续研究
patterns.trigger: He asked what does it mean；many researchers tried to give a definition
patterns.context: 先叙述人物提出问题，再讲述后人尝试解答

patterns.name: 论文标题、作者与机构等文献元数据
patterns.trigger: About neutral mesons；L. M. Slad；Department of Physics and Astronomy
patterns.context: 标题、作者、脚注标记、机构或预印本编号等论文首页/页眉信息

patterns.name: 物理过程及图表引用
patterns.trigger: W_L\to W_L；gamma gamma colliders；shown in Fig.

en.description: Activations span academic papers, philosophical discussion, and older book prose: they commonly occur when explaining subsequent extensions or research progress, in paper metadata formatting, and when authors explain their writing purpose or urge readers to read. Proper nouns and ordinary function words also activate sporadically.

patterns.name: Extending or continuing discussion
patterns.context: An author or researcher says they will next extend, develop, derive, or present a result/definition, often accompanied by narrative verbs and subsequent research progress.

patterns.name: Paper title and bibliographic formatting
patterns.context: Paper titles, authors, footnotes, citations, preprint identifiers, or institutional information appear; activations may fall near the end of a title, footnote markers, and formatting symbols.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper headers and LaTeX/bibliographic markers

patterns.name: Book narration and exhortations to read
patterns.context: Addressing readers about the author's purpose, encouraging them to read, or explaining the intended audience; often features first person, references to readers, and an exhortative tone.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and anomalous fragments in titles
patterns.context: Activations occur near proper nouns, personal names, or title words, but these words belong to different topics and show no consistent semantic condition.

patterns.name: Common function words and local phrasing
patterns.context: Ordinary function words or common adverbs activate in different syntactic positions across passages; the most prominent word is “slightly” in paragraph 1, while other instances are difficult to group under a shared semantic trigger.

10_1365.concept: 篇章推进与文本元话语
10_1365.description: 激活跨学术论文、哲学论述和旧式书籍散文：常见于说明后续扩展或研究进展、论文元数据排版，以及作者面向读者解释写作目的或劝读；另有专名和普通功能词的零散激活。

patterns.name: 延展、继续论述
patterns.trigger: “we shall slightly extend his result”；“I will here try to develop further”；“goes on to obtain”；“Later on, many researchers tried to give”
patterns.context: 作者或研究者说明接下来要扩展、发展、推导或给出某结果/定义时，常伴随叙述性动词及后续研究进展。

patterns.name: 论文标题与书目信息格式
patterns.context: 论文标题、作者、脚注、引用、预印本编号或机构信息等排版元数据出现时，激活可落在标题尾部、脚注标记和格式符号附近。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文头部及 LaTeX/文献标记

patterns.name: 书籍叙述与劝读语气
patterns.trigger: “the author, not to retell the lives”；“I command the serious perusal”；“who wishes to become well informed”；“I fear I may not interest those who aim”
patterns.context: 面向读者谈论作者写作目的、劝读或解释作品适用读者时；常见第一人称、读者称谓和劝告语气。

patterns.name: 专名与标题中的异常片段
patterns.context: 专名、人名或标题词附近有激活，但这些词分属不同内容，未见一致的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 物理学、哲学及历史文本

patterns.name: 常见功能词及局部措辞
patterns.context: 若干片段中普通功能词或常见副词在不同句法位置激活；最突出的单词是第1段的“slightly”，其他实例难以归为同一语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文与学术文本

en.description: Activations are distributed across academic and literary texts: common expressions of subsequent development, attempts, or purpose are frequent, as are mathematical physics content, citation formatting, biographies, and poetic traditions; several sporadic words do not fit a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Narratives of subsequent research and extension
patterns.context: Discusses subsequent developments, attempts, or transmission related to prior work or people; common in introductory accounts and includes expressions such as will/try/further, later, and still

patterns.name: To-infinitives and expressions of purpose or attempts
patterns.context: An action or purpose structure introduced by to appears near the trigger; it can co-occur with verbs of attempting, understanding, or narrating

patterns.name: Mathematical statements involving quantities or fractions
patterns.context: Fractions, symbols, definitions, or results occur in mathematical or physics contexts; specific topics vary across passages

patterns.name: Biographical introductions to people and works
patterns.context: Mentions an author, a person’s life, students, or the transmission of works, often in third-person narration

patterns.name: Citation and bibliography formats in papers
patterns.context: Bracketed citations, footnotes, or bibliography markers occur in academic text, usually next to an author name or a theorem/lemma

patterns.name: Special spellings in titles and proper names
patterns.context: Paper titles, author bylines, or institutional names; no clear semantic trigger shared with the other passages

patterns.name: Punjabi folk poetry and lineage
patterns.context: Introduces a poet and their works, students, and the transmission of poetry

patterns.name: Poorly interpretable local activations
patterns.context: Sporadic words or phrases activate but are difficult to associate with a stable topic or syntactic pattern

10_1365.concept: 后续发展与叙述性动作
10_1365.description: 激活分布于多种学术与文学文本：常见后续发展、尝试或目的表达，也涉及数学物理内容、引文格式、人物传记与诗歌传承；若干零散词无法归入统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 后续研究与扩展的叙述
patterns.trigger: “we shall slightly extend his result”“Later on, many researchers tried to give a definition”“I will here try to develop further”“who learnt from him and still sings his poetry”
patterns.context: 围绕前人工作或人物的后续发展、尝试、传承；常见于介绍性叙述，包含 will/try/further、later、still 等表达
patterns.domain: 学术论文、哲学评论、人物传记

patterns.name: to 不定式及目的/尝试表达
patterns.trigger: “to obtain”“to give”“to retell”“to understand”“to studying”“to have”“to develop”
patterns.context: 触发点附近出现 to 引出的动作或目的结构；可与尝试、理解、叙述等动词共现

patterns.name: 数量或分数相关的数学表述
patterns.context: 数学或物理语境中出现分数、符号、定义或结果等内容；段间具体主题不一致
patterns.domain: 数学、理论物理学术文本

patterns.name: 人物与作品的传记性介绍
patterns.trigger: “the author”“the lives”“He had many students”“his poetry”
patterns.context: 提及作者、人物生平、学生或作品传承，常以第三人称叙述

patterns.name: 论文引文与文献条目格式
patterns.context: 学术文本中出现方括号引用、脚注或参考文献标记，通常紧邻作者名或定理/引理

patterns.name: 标题及专名中的特殊拼写
patterns.context: 论文标题、作者署名或机构名称；没有明显与其余段落共享的语义触发条件

patterns.name: Punjabi民间诗歌与师承
patterns.context: 介绍诗人及其作品、学生和诗歌传承

patterns.name: 未充分可解释的局部激活
patterns.trigger: “Sugawara goes on”“Peter”“ugh”“I fear I may not interest”
patterns.context: 零散词或短语激活，难以与一个稳定主题或句法模式对应

en.concept: Transitions and extensions in academic texts
en.description: Activations often occur when academic discussion builds on, extends, or compares prior work, and also around citations, attribution, and technical terminology. Sporadic examples also occur in classical narrative, exhortations to read, and poetic transmission. Paragraph 3 is mainly fragments of numbering and a title page and is difficult to interpret.

patterns.name: Extension or follow-up work in academic writing
patterns.context: After citing an existing result, researcher, or viewpoint, the text says that the paper will extend it, develop it further, or proceed to subsequent discussion; related discourse words and references to authors also activate.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, especially theoretical or conceptual discussion

patterns.name: Reporting comparisons and differences in academic texts
patterns.context: After stating measurements, compares them with earlier experimental results using “differs from”.

patterns.name: References, authors, and affiliation information in academic papers
patterns.context: Near paper citations, title pages, author attribution, institutional information, or bibliographic identifiers.

patterns.name: Technical terms or mathematical expressions in academic texts
patterns.context: Specialized concepts or formulas embedded in sentences; the examples have no shared topic.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, physics, and history of science texts

patterns.name: Character evaluation and plot description in narrative
patterns.context: Commentary on a character's personality, an author's intent, or a biographical account.

patterns.name: Formal exhortations or requests for readers to read
patterns.context: Formal, old-fashioned wording urges readers to carefully read an appendix or article.
patterns.domain: Prefaces or exhortatory text in classical books

patterns.name: Poetic transmission and teacher-student lineage
patterns.context: Describes a poet's students, their study of the poet's works, and the continued recitation of those works.

patterns.name: Discussion of conceptual classification difficult to group with the main pattern
patterns.context: Philosophical discussion of classification relations among abstract concepts, stating that the viewpoint will be further developed; partly resembles academic extension but focuses on defining concepts.
patterns.domain: Philosophy or philosophy of science papers

10_1365.concept: 学术文本中的承接与延展
10_1365.description: 激活多见于学术论述中承接、扩展或比较既有工作，也见于引用署名、技术术语；另有古典叙事、劝读和诗歌传承等零散文体。第3段主要是编号及标题页碎片，难以解释。

patterns.name: 学术写作中的延展或后续工作
patterns.trigger: “we shall slightly extend his result”“It is likely that”“I will here try to develop further”
patterns.context: 先引述既有结果、研究者或观点，再说明本文将扩展、继续发展或转入后续讨论；相关语气词和作者指称也有激活。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其理论或概念讨论

patterns.name: 学术文本中的比较与差异报告
patterns.trigger: “our measurement greatly differs from the NA49 results”
patterns.context: 陈述测量结果后，以“differs from”对照既有实验结果。

patterns.name: 学术论文的参考文献、作者与机构信息
patterns.trigger: “[@Ingham Thm. 2]”“[@brodsky]”“Riccardo Rattazzi”“Department of Physics and Astronomy”“L.M. Slad”
patterns.context: 论文引用、标题页、作者署名、机构或文献编号等书目信息附近。

patterns.name: 学术文本中的技术术语或数学表达
patterns.context: 专门概念或公式嵌入句子中；各例的主题并不相同。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理及科学史类学术文本

patterns.name: 叙事中的人物评价与情节性描述
patterns.trigger: “a strange mixture”“Oliver Cromwell”“the author”“retell the lives”
patterns.context: 对人物性格、作者意图或生平叙述作评论。

patterns.name: 正式劝读或恳请读者阅读
patterns.trigger: “I command the serious perusal”“who wishes to become well informed”
patterns.context: 以较正式、旧式措辞敦促读者认真阅读附录或文章。
patterns.domain: 古典书籍的序言或劝读文字

patterns.name: 诗歌传承及师承描述
patterns.trigger: “He had many students who learnt from him”“still sings his poetry”
patterns.context: 描述诗人的学生、学习其作品以及延续传唱。
patterns.domain: 维基百科人物传记，旁遮普诗歌文化

patterns.name: 与主模式难以归并的概念分类论述
patterns.trigger: “systems make up some special species of the genus pattern”“patterns and systems”
patterns.context: 哲学性地讨论抽象概念间的分类关系，并表示将进一步发展观点；与学术延展模式部分相近，但内容侧重概念界定。

en.description: Activations are distributed across numbers and their punctuation, line breaks and heading formats, fragments within proper names, and a few biomedical terms; no semantic or syntactic pattern explains all passages.

patterns.name: Numbers and numerical expressions
patterns.context: Numbers adjacent to punctuation in numbers, percentages, years, or equations; some activations fall on split number tokens.
patterns.domain: Statistical narratives, math problems, report titles

patterns.name: Specific fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Letter fragments within multi-token proper names or words; trigger positions vary and show no clear, consistent semantic category.
patterns.domain: Biomedical texts, place names, personal or organization names, and common words

patterns.name: Passage and heading boundaries
patterns.context: Appears at line breaks, short headings, or uppercase report titles; some activations occur next to formatting boundaries.
patterns.domain: Math exercises, encyclopedia entries, email subject lines

patterns.name: Biomedical term fragments
patterns.context: Terms or their subword fragments in biomedical texts; activations do not consistently fall on a particular term or syntactic position.

patterns.name: Function words in percentage sentences
patterns.context: In short phrases following percentage values that introduce a year or period.

10_1619.description: 激活分散在数字及其标点、换行和标题格式、专名内部片段及少量生物医学词汇上；没有一个语义或句法模式能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 数字与数值表达
patterns.context: 数字、百分比、年份或算式中的数字与标点相邻；有些激活落在被拆分的数字 token 上。
patterns.domain: 统计叙述、数学题、报告标题

patterns.name: 专名中的特定片段
patterns.context: 多 token 专名或词语内部的字母片段；触发位置并不固定，也没有明显一致的语义类别。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、地名、人名或组织名，以及普通词语

patterns.name: 文段与标题边界
patterns.context: 换行、短标题或大写报告标题中出现；部分激活紧邻格式边界。
patterns.domain: 数学练习、百科条目、邮件标题

patterns.name: 生物医学术语片段
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中的术语或其子词片段；激活未稳定落在某一术语或句法位置。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 资助项目描述

patterns.name: 百分比句中的功能词
patterns.context: 跟在百分比数值之后、引出年份或时期的短语中。
patterns.domain: 智能手机市场份额叙述

en.description: Activations span diverse domains and are scattered, often landing on within-word letter fragments, proper nouns, and subword boundaries in technical terms. They also occur on numbers, percentages, formula symbols, and all-caps title fragments; there is no stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activations land on letter fragments within words, often in proper nouns, technical terms, or compounds; fragment positions and boundaries vary across words.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; scientific text, proper nouns, and general text

patterns.name: Digit fragments in numbers and percentages
patterns.context: Activations occur near digits and punctuation in values, years, or percentages; they sometimes cover the number and sometimes extend to the percent sign or adjacent text.
patterns.domain: Market-share reports and other text containing numbers

patterns.name: Operators and values in math problems
patterns.context: In algebra problems, activations cluster on minus signs, values, and formula fragments; the passage also contains activations on ordinary text tokens.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in all-caps titles or abbreviations
patterns.context: All-caps title strings are split into multiple letter fragments, with activations on several fragments; hyphens and dates are also present.
patterns.domain: Energy market report titles, email or report titles

10_1619.description: 激活跨领域且分散，常落在词内字母片段、专名和技术词的子词边界，也见于数字、百分数、公式符号及全大写标题片段；没有稳定的语义主题。

patterns.name: 英文单词内部的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部的字母片段上，常见于专名、技术词或复合词；不同词中片段位置和边界不一。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；科学文本、专名和一般文本

patterns.name: 数字与百分数中的数字片段
patterns.context: 数值、年份或百分数中的数字及标点附近出现激活；激活有时覆盖数字，有时延伸到百分号或相邻文本。
patterns.domain: 市场份额报道及其他含数字文本

patterns.name: 数学题中的运算符号和数值
patterns.context: 代数题目中，激活集中在负号、数值及公式片段；该段也含普通文字 token 激活。

patterns.name: 全大写标题或缩写中的字母片段
patterns.context: 大写标题字符串被切分为多个字母片段，并在多个片段上激活；包含连字符及日期。
patterns.domain: 能源市场报告标题、邮件或报告标题

en.description: Activations are scattered across fine-grained fragments of numbers and punctuation, question-and-answer math prompts, proper-name word-form fragments, and title formatting; a few content words also activate. Cross-domain repetition is limited, making it difficult to identify a single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Formatted questions and prompt boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur near questions, instructions, and line breaks in math problems or question-and-answer text; several values and mathematical symbols are also marked.

patterns.name: Signed large integers and digit fragments
patterns.context: Numbers are split into multiple tokens, often adjacent to minus signs, operators, or commas; this occurs in both math problems and code data.

patterns.name: Percentages and decimal digits
patterns.context: Activations occur on percentages in statistical descriptions such as market shares, as well as on decimal points and digit token fragments.

patterns.name: Word-form fragments within proper nouns
patterns.context: Multi-token proper nouns or words are split into fragments; activations land on specific fragments across different texts.

patterns.name: All-caps titles and date strings
patterns.context: Letter fragments and month names activate in all-caps titles or report names.

patterns.name: Parenthesized chemical names and abbreviations
patterns.context: Activations occur near parenthesized units or drug brand names; the same passage also contains chemical names and colons.

patterns.name: Symbolic list entries
patterns.context: Punctuation and digit fragments activate in comma-separated arrays in square brackets or lists of paired values.

patterns.name: Unmerged fragments of specialized content words
patterns.context: These words activate in their respective contexts, but the triggers are scattered and difficult to link to the formal patterns above or to one another through a clear shared condition.

10_1619.description: 激活分散在数字与标点的细分片段、问答式数学提示、专名词形片段及标题格式；另有少数内容词激活。跨领域重复有限，无法确定单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 格式化问题与提示词边界
patterns.context: 数学题或问答式文本中，问题、指令及换行边界附近出现激活；若干数值和数学符号也同时被标记。

patterns.name: 带符号的大整数及数字片段
patterns.context: 数字被拆分成多个 token，常与负号、运算符或逗号相邻；数学题与代码数据中均出现。

patterns.name: 百分比与小数数字
patterns.context: 市场份额等统计叙述中的百分比，小数点及数字的分词片段有激活。

patterns.name: 专名内部的词形片段
patterns.context: 多词元专名或词语被切分成片段；激活落在特定片段上，不同文本中出现。

patterns.name: 大写标题与日期字样
patterns.context: 全大写标题或报告名称中，字母片段及月份字样激活。

patterns.name: 带括号的化学名称与缩写
patterns.context: 括号括起的单位或药品商品名附近激活；同段还出现化学名及冒号。

patterns.name: 符号化列表条目
patterns.context: 逗号分隔的方括号数组或成对数值列表中，标点及数字片段出现激活。

patterns.name: 未能归并的专业内容词片段
patterns.context: 这些词在各自语境中有激活，但触发点分散，难以与上述形式模式或彼此建立明确共同条件。

en.description: Activations occur across various texts, with more prominent patterns involving hyphens, formula operators, and tokenization boundaries; chemical terms, plant-related biomedical words, and encyclopedia proper names also appear. The shared trigger conditions vary across passages, making it difficult to reduce them to a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Hyphens and adjacent fragments in tokens
patterns.context: In mathematical expressions, hyphens appear between formula terms; they also occur in the date « - MAY 30» and the email-address fragment «owner-ucb_police».

patterns.name: Tokenization boundaries or subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on words or proper-name fragments split across multiple tokens, often next to internal segmentation, spaces, or line breaks; the precise positions vary across passages.

patterns.name: Chemical/biomedical terms
patterns.context: Appears in texts about chemical substances or plant signaling pathways, including both internal subword fragments and complete scientific words.

patterns.name: Proper names and encyclopedia-entry formatting
patterns.context: Encyclopedia-style entries, parenthetical explanations, or consecutive line breaks appear around proper names or taxonomic names; the specific highlighted character fragments vary.

patterns.name: Algebraic/polynomial formula fragments
patterns.context: In formulas made up of variables, numbers, and operators, activations occur on multiple operators and terms; formula structures vary.

10_1619.description: 激活分布在多种文本中，较明显地涉及连字符、公式运算符和分词边界；另见化学术语、植物生物医学词及百科专名。各段的共同触发条件并不一致，难以归结为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: token 中的连字符及邻近片段
patterns.context: 数学表达式中，连字符出现在公式项之间；也出现在日期« - MAY 30»及邮件地址片段«owner-ucb_police»中。

patterns.name: 分词边界或子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分成多个 token 的词或专名片段上，常与词内分段、空格或换行邻接；不同段中具体位置不一致。

patterns.name: 化学／生物医学术语
patterns.context: 出现在化学物质或植物信号通路相关文本中，既包括术语内部子词，也包括完整科学词。

patterns.name: 专名及百科条目格式
patterns.context: 专名或分类学名称周围出现百科式条目内容、括号说明或连续换行；被激活的具体字符片段各异。

patterns.name: 代数／多项式公式片段
patterns.context: 变量、数字、运算符构成的公式中，多个运算符和项间隔出现激活；不同公式的结构并不完全相同。

en.description: Activations are scattered across different texts, often appearing on titles or sentence-final punctuation (colons, periods, line breaks); other examples include a fixed Enron report-link format, biomedical terminology in titles, split plant proper nouns, and a passage of disjointed erotic webpage text.

patterns.name: Sentence-final or title-final punctuation
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of a complete title or declarative sentence; a line break often follows the period.
patterns.domain: Paper titles, PubMed abstracts, email report titles, and encyclopedia text

patterns.name: Enron report-link format
patterns.context: A fixed report email format; the domain and slash in the link also activate strongly.

patterns.name: Terms and compounds in biomedical titles
patterns.context: Titles consist of technical terms, modifiers, or hyphenated compounds, often followed by a period and the abstract body.
patterns.domain: Medical, biological, and chemical paper abstracts

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of proper nouns
patterns.context: Proper nouns or taxonomic names are split into multiple subword tokens; a line break and definitional body text follow the title.

patterns.name: Ungrammatical erotic phrases and names
patterns.context: Grammatically and semantically disjointed sentences, followed by names of people apparently from pornographic text.

10_1619.description: 激活分散在多种文本中，常见于标题或句末标点（冒号、句号、换行）；另有 Enron 固定报告链接格式、生物医学术语标题、拆分的植物专名，以及一段不连贯的情色网页文本。

patterns.name: 句末或标题末尾标点
patterns.trigger: 「:」「.」「↵」，尤其是标题中的「:」和摘要句末的「.」
patterns.context: 出现在完整标题或陈述句的末尾；句号后常紧接换行。
patterns.domain: 论文标题、PubMed 摘要、邮件报告标题及百科文本

patterns.name: Enron 报告链接格式
patterns.context: 固定的报告邮件格式；链接中的域名和斜杠也有较强激活。

patterns.name: 生物医学标题中的术语与复合词
patterns.trigger: 如「globe injuries」「formaldehyde-mediated」「covalent binding」「T-shaped facial amphiphiles」「cardiothoracic ratio」「Toxoplasma gondii」「wound healing」
patterns.context: 标题由专业名词、修饰语或连字符复合词构成，随后常以句号结束并进入摘要正文。
patterns.domain: 医学、生物学及化学论文摘要

patterns.name: 专名的分词片段
patterns.context: 专名或分类学名称被拆成多个子词 token；标题后还出现换行及定义性正文。

patterns.name: 不自然的情色短语及姓名
patterns.context: 语法和语义不连贯的句子，后接疑似色情文本中的人物姓名。

en.description: Activations occur in mathematical formulas, specialized biomedical terms and research narratives, engineering equipment descriptions, and business emails. The shared signal is weak; several passages contain domain-specific terms, abbreviations, or structured professional text, but these do not explain all the variation.

patterns.name: Formulas and symbols in math problems
patterns.context: Trigger symbols occur in math-problem passages composed of formulas, variables, or numbers, often accompanied by line breaks and problem-style phrasing.

patterns.name: Specialized biomedical terms and abbreviations
patterns.context: Appears in research abstracts, patent backgrounds, or grant texts; often includes terms for diseases, proteins, genes, cells, or experiments, including split technical words and abbreviations.
patterns.domain: Biomedical texts, patent backgrounds, research abstracts

patterns.name: Experimental and research descriptions in abstracts
patterns.context: Research goals, experimental design, measurements, or results provide the context, with full academic-abstract sentence structure.

patterns.name: Engineering equipment and performance descriptions
patterns.context: Focuses on system design, parameter optimization, and equipment performance, accompanied by engineering terminology and technical units.

patterns.name: Meetings and personal names in business emails
patterns.context: Email narratives describe meetings with members of an energy-related committee and include times, organizations, and several personal names.

patterns.name: Title about DNA chemical binding
patterns.context: A noun phrase summarizing research on formaldehyde-mediated chemical binding.

10_1619.description: 激活分布在数学公式、专业生物医学术语和科研叙述、工程设备描述及商务邮件中。共同线索较弱；多个片段出现领域专词、缩写或结构化专业文本，但无法解释全部差异。

patterns.name: 数学题目中的公式与符号
patterns.context: 触发符号处于公式、变量或数字构成的数学题目片段中，常伴随换行和题目式表述。

patterns.name: 专业生物医学术语与缩写
patterns.context: 出现在科研摘要、专利背景或资助项目文本中；常有疾病、蛋白、基因、细胞或实验术语，包含被拆分的专业词和缩写。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、专利背景、科研摘要

patterns.name: 科研摘要中的实验与研究描述
patterns.context: 以研究目标、实验设计、测量或结果叙述为上下文，出现完整的学术摘要句式。

patterns.name: 工程设备与性能描述
patterns.context: 围绕系统设计、参数优化和设备性能展开，伴随工程术语及技术单位。
patterns.domain: 工程技术、科研项目描述

patterns.name: 商务邮件中的会议及人名
patterns.context: 邮件叙述与能源相关委员会人员会面，包含时间、机构和多个人名。

patterns.name: DNA 化学结合标题
patterns.context: 以名词短语形式概括甲醛介导的化学结合研究主题。

en.description: Activations are scattered across intra-word subword fragments in multiple languages, numbers, and text-initial fragments; a few highlights fall on stems such as consc and lov and on personal names. The passages lack a unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Subword fragments across word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal subword fragments of words or proper names in multiple languages; the triggering fragments show no stable meaning or part of speech.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; biomedical, legal, sports, parliamentary texts, etc.

patterns.name: Numbers and identifiers
patterns.context: Numbers appear at the end of paper titles, in legal citation identifiers, or in other numerical expressions; numbers are not shared by all passages.
patterns.domain: Paper titles, legal documents, and general text

patterns.name: Sentence-initial capitalized fragments
patterns.context: Appears at the start of passages or titles, citation openings, and similar positions, possibly related to text-cropping boundaries; no consistent capitalization or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Abstracts, titles, legal citations, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: consc in Spanish rights statements
patterns.context: In a Spanish sentence about EU passenger rights, stating that passengers should know these rights.

patterns.name: Romanian lov stem
patterns.context: In a Romanian sentence describing a blow or setback that occurs after ten days.

patterns.name: Portuguese consc stem
patterns.context: The word meaning “conscious” appears in Portuguese discussion of historical actions and institutions.

patterns.name: Personal names in wrestling commentary
patterns.context: Appears as a personal name in informal commentary about wrestling match results and performer performance.

10_1619.description: 激活分散于多语种词内子词片段、数字和文本开头片段；少数高亮落在 consc、lov 等词干及人名上。各段缺乏统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 跨词边界的子词片段
patterns.trigger: 词内被切分并标记的片段，如 «otrop»（ad«otrop»in）、«ros»/«clerosis»、«spin»/«ous»、«Ana»（Anaheim）、«Influ»（Influenced）
patterns.context: 激活落在多种语言词汇或专名的内部子词片段上；触发片段本身并未显示稳定的词义或词性。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；生物医学、法律、体育、议会文本等

patterns.name: 数字及编号
patterns.context: 数字出现在论文题名末尾、法律引文编号或其他文本的数字表达中；数字并非所有片段共有。
patterns.domain: 论文标题、法律文书及一般文本

patterns.name: 句首大写片段
patterns.context: 出现在片段开头或标题、引文开头等位置，可能与文本截取边界有关；没有一致的大小写或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 摘要、标题、法律引文、百科条目

patterns.name: 西班牙语权利表述中的 consc
patterns.context: 欧盟乘客权利的西班牙语句子中，提到乘客应知晓这些权利。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 西班牙语议会文本

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语 lov 词干
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语句子中描述十天后发生的一次打击或挫折。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语 consc 词干
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语论述历史行动及制度时，出现“有意识的”一词。
patterns.domain: PhilPapers 葡萄牙语哲学文本

patterns.name: 摔角评论中的人名
patterns.context: 谈及摔角比赛结果及选手表现的非正式评论中，作为人名出现。

en.concept: Multilingual proper names and subword fragments
en.description: Activations mainly fall on subword fragments of multilingual personal names, place names, occupational titles, and Italian words; they commonly occur in encyclopedia lists, titles, and credits, and also involve lists of alternative names. This is not a single semantic class; unexplained cases are sporadic intra-word fragments.

patterns.name: Italian word forms and morpheme fragments
patterns.context: Multiple intra-word tokens are marked in continuous Italian text, including longer words, word endings, and internal joins; not limited to a particular part of speech

patterns.name: Transliterated fragments in Punjabi and South Asian names
patterns.context: Romanized forms of Indian personal names, place names, poet titles, and the like; activations occur on syllables or submorphemes within names and also in sentences describing Punjabi poetic traditions
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, South Asian culture and figures

patterns.name: Italian title fragments in work catalogs
patterns.context: Italian painting titles and their catalog entries; internal fragments of several title words are activated

patterns.name: Occupation and name fragments in biographical lists
patterns.context: Names, titles, or occupations in lists of people are marked across tokens; the people need not belong to the same field
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia lists of people and biographies

patterns.name: Name fragments in film cast lists
patterns.context: A “Cast” heading and actor–role format appear after a plot summary; activations fall within actor or character names

patterns.name: Multilingual names and film credits
patterns.context: Credits for directors, cinematographers, editors, actors, and others in film descriptions; names consist of multiple subword fragments

patterns.name: Lists of multilingual names and variants
patterns.context: Encyclopedia text lists multiple transliterations or alternative names for the same language or ethnic group in succession

patterns.name: Mixed-entry fragments with insufficient explanation
patterns.context: Activations occur sporadically in Italian work lists, English biographies, and the name of a Jewish ritual in a film plot; insufficient basis to group them with the preceding name or word-form patterns

10_1619.concept: 多语种专名与子词片段
10_1619.description: 激活主要落在多语种人名、地名、职业名及意大利语词语的子词片段；常见于百科名单、标题和署名，也涉及异名罗列。不是单一语义类，未覆盖部分为零散词内片段。

patterns.name: 意大利语词形与词素片段
patterns.context: 意大利语连续文本中，词内多个分词 token 被标记；包括较长词、词尾以及词内拼接处，并非只限某一词类
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会发言、哲学文本

patterns.name: 旁遮普语及南亚人名的转写片段
patterns.context: 印度人名、地名、诗人称号等罗马字转写；激活分布在名字内部的音节或子词素，也出现在说明旁遮普诗歌传统的句子中
patterns.domain: 百科条目、南亚文化与人物

patterns.name: 作品目录中的意大利语标题片段
patterns.trigger: “Prima confessione”“Ave Maria”“Un sentiero delle Alpi”中的“«Prim»«a»”“«confession»«e»”“« sent»…«iero»”
patterns.context: 意大利语绘画作品标题及其目录条目；若干标题词的内部片段激活

patterns.name: 履历名单中的职业与姓名片段
patterns.context: 人物名单中姓名、职称或职业名称被分词标记；不要求这些人物同属一领域

patterns.name: 影视演职员表中的姓名片段
patterns.context: 剧情简介后出现“Cast”及演员—角色格式，激活落在演员或角色姓名内部

patterns.name: 跨语言姓名与电影制作署名
patterns.context: 电影介绍中的导演、摄影、剪辑和演员等署名；姓名由多个子词片段组成

patterns.name: 跨语言异名与变体罗列
patterns.trigger: “Bagvalal (also called Bagulal, Kwantl Hekwa, Bagolal, Kwanadi…)”中的多个“Bag…”和“K…”形式
patterns.context: 百科正文把同一语言或族群名称的多种转写、别称连续列举

patterns.name: 未充分解释的混合条目片段
patterns.context: 激活散见于意大利语作品清单、英语履历以及影视剧情中的犹太仪式名称；不足以归入前述姓名或词形模式

en.description: Most prominent responses are to syllables or substrings within segmented proper names, especially personal names, place names, and South Asian and Eastern European names; lists, line breaks, and delimiters often co-occur. Also includes musician names, academic terms, and a few place-name spellings, making it difficult to assign a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Suffix-like syllable fragments in proper names
patterns.context: When personal or place names are split into multiple subword tokens, especially non-English names such as South Asian and Eastern European ones, many strong activations fall on internal syllable fragments rather than whole words.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia lists of people, biographies, cast lists, and political-figure entries

patterns.name: List and itemized formats
patterns.context: Names appear consecutively, organized by line breaks, commas, «as», or year markers; activations often cover name fragments and delimiters.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia cast lists, alumni lists, election results, and other structured encyclopedia text

patterns.name: Specific character sequences in proper names
patterns.context: Multi-token spellings in place names, surnames, or organization names; responds to internal syllables or substrings in proper names, but does not correspond to a particular language or meaning.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia geography, airline profiles, and historical biographies

patterns.name: Line-break boundaries in lists of names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Line breaks occur alongside consecutive proper names in list layouts; the line break itself may contribute to triggering, but may also co-occur with name fragments.
patterns.domain: Cast lists, rosters, and tabular content in encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Syllable fragments in terms
patterns.context: An ordinary academic word is split into subword tokens; this is not a list of names, and its relationship to the main pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: Classical music conductors’ names
patterns.context: A conductor’s name appears in continuous narrative and lists; activations cover internal name fragments.

10_1619.description: 对拆分后的专名内部音节/子串反应最明显，尤其是人名、地名及南亚和东欧姓名；名单、换行和分隔符常伴随出现。也覆盖音乐家姓名、学术术语及少数地名拼写，难以归为单一语义类别。

patterns.name: 专名中的后缀式音节片段
patterns.trigger: «av»、«ari»、«an»、«i»、«ić»、«a» 等嵌在姓名中的片段；例如 «Fl»«av»«io»、«Barb»«ari»«ć»、«Dr»«agi»«š»«a»
patterns.context: 人名或地名被拆分为多个子词 token 时，尤其是南亚、东欧等非英语姓名；不少高激活落在姓名内部的音节片段，而非完整词。
patterns.domain: 百科全书人物名单、传记、演员表及政治人物条目

patterns.name: 名单与逐项列举格式
patterns.trigger: 换行分列的人名及其角色，如 «as George…»；以及年份后重复的候选人—政党条目
patterns.context: 姓名连续出现并以换行、逗号、«as» 或年份标记组织；激活常覆盖姓名片段及分隔符。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 演员表、校友名单、选举结果等结构化百科文本

patterns.name: 专名中的特定字符序列
patterns.context: 地名、姓氏或机构名中的多 token 拼写；对专名内部的音节/子串有响应，但并非只对应某一语言或一种词义。
patterns.domain: 百科地理、航空公司资料及历史传记

patterns.name: 人名及专名列表中的换行边界
patterns.trigger: «↵»，常紧邻分行的人名或姓名条目
patterns.context: 列表式排版中换行与专名连续出现；换行本身可能参与触发，但也可能与姓名片段共同出现。
patterns.domain: 百科条目中的演员表、名单和表格化内容

patterns.name: 术语中的音节片段
patterns.context: 普通学术词被拆成子词 token；此处并非姓名列表，和主模式的关系不明确。

patterns.name: 古典音乐指挥家姓名
patterns.context: 指挥家姓名嵌在连续叙述和列举中；激活覆盖姓名内部片段。

en.concept: Local patterns in word fragments and proper names
en.description: Activations span many domains and often fall on segmented proper names or intra-word fragments; other local patterns include Italian parliamentary stock phrases, list and catalog formatting, and descriptions of medical symptoms, making it difficult to assign a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Intra-word subword/tokenization boundaries in personal names
patterns.context: Activations often fall on internal fragments of proper names, foreign words, or compound words; sometimes on fragments of split names or words. This describes activation locations but does not explain why these particular fragments are selected.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including legal, parliamentary, encyclopedia, medical abstract, and bibliographic texts

patterns.name: Italian parliamentary report stock phrases
patterns.context: Fixed formal phrasing in Italian parliamentary texts concerning reports, committees, someone’s name, and topics; activations are distributed across segmented Italian words and intra-word fragments.

patterns.name: Proper names and entry formatting in lists or catalogs
patterns.context: Names, titles, identifiers, and formatting markers occur together in lists, catalogs, or entry-style text; unclear whether activations are triggered by formatting or proper names.
patterns.domain: Sports rosters, poetry catalogs, diplomatic figure entries

patterns.name: Name fragments in biographical accounts
patterns.context: Personal names appear in biographies or plot summaries, split into multiple tokens, with strong activations on some fragments; no clearer shared condition across names and fields.
patterns.domain: Historical encyclopedia entries, film plot summaries, organized-crime history entries

patterns.name: Disease descriptions in medical abstracts
patterns.context: Clinical abstracts describing infants with illness or sequelae following perinatal injury; activation here is concentrated on suffering.

10_1619.concept: 词片段与专名中的局部模式
10_1619.description: 激活跨多领域且常落在被拆分的专名或词内片段；另有意大利语议会套语、名单目录排版及医学症状描述等局部模式，难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 人名的词内子词/分词边界
patterns.context: 激活常落在专名、外语词或复合词的内部片段；有时位于被拆分的姓名或词语片段上。此模式可描述激活位置，但不能统一解释为何选中这些具体片段。
patterns.domain: 法律、议会记录、百科、医疗摘要、书目等多种文体

patterns.name: 意大利语议会报告套语
patterns.context: 意大利语议会文本中，围绕报告、委员会、某人名义及议题的固定正式表述；激活分布在拆分的意大利语词及词内片段。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，意大利语正式议会记录

patterns.name: 名单或目录中的专名与条目排版
patterns.context: 名单、目录或条目式文字中，人物姓名、头衔、编号及排版标记相邻出现；不能确定激活由格式还是专名触发。
patterns.domain: 体育赛事名单、诗歌目录、外交人物条目

patterns.name: 人物传记中的姓名片段
patterns.context: 传记或剧情简介中出现人物姓名，姓名被拆成多个 token，强激活落在其中片段；不同姓名和领域间缺少更明确的共同条件。
patterns.domain: 历史百科、电影剧情简介、黑帮历史条目

patterns.name: 医学摘要中的疾病描述
patterns.context: 描述婴儿患病或围产期损伤后遗症的临床摘要；该处激活集中于 suffering。

en.description: Activations often fall on intra-word fragments split across subwords, especially multilingual proper names, place names, terms, and muscle names; other cases include Roman numerals in poetry and several sporadic ordinary-word fragments. The passages lack a unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Spelling fragments such as “par/ma/av” across word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations fall on intra-word fragments split across subwords, often in proper names, place names, and terms; no unified semantic or syntactic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, proper names, and technical vocabulary

patterns.name: The “sam/asm” letter sequence
patterns.context: Appears in the Sanskrit philosophical term samskaras and the Italian place name San Erasmo; the overlap may be orthographic rather than semantic.

patterns.name: Multilingual intra-word subword segmentation
patterns.context: Activations cover word forms split into multiple subwords, including Swedish and German words and Italian proper names; no clear contextual semantic restriction.

patterns.name: Line-initial Roman numerals in poetry
patterns.context: Roman numerals number sections or lines in poetry, accompanied by line breaks and poetic formatting.

patterns.name: Segmented fragments in muscle names
patterns.context: Anatomical muscle names in medical abstracts, embedded in descriptions of pain-study results.

patterns.name: River and alluvial-plain vocabulary
patterns.context: Geographic encyclopedia descriptions of rivers, plains, and regional locations; triggers include common geographic words and internal fragments of proper names.

patterns.name: Proper names of historical dynasties and places
patterns.context: Historical passages describing South Indian dynasties, rulers, and architectural sites; activations concentrate within proper names.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments that resist grouping
patterns.context: These activations occur in philosophical/psychological explanations, poetry, and geographic texts, with no clear shared semantic or syntactic condition.

10_1619.description: 激活多落在跨子词切分的词内片段，尤其是多语种专名、地名、术语与肌肉名称；另有诗歌罗马数字及若干零散普通词片段。各处缺少统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 跨词界的“par/ma/av”等拼写片段
patterns.trigger: « par»10«asp»；« Ch»4«olas»；« K»2«anch»；« all»3«uv»；« Alt»10«us»；« Bh»3«ag»5«ir»8«athi»
patterns.context: 激活落在跨子词切分的词内片段上，常见于专名、地名、术语；未见统一的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 多语种文本、专名与技术词汇

patterns.name: “sam/asm”字母序列
patterns.context: 出现在梵语哲学术语 samskaras 和意大利地名 San Erasmo 中；可能是拼写片段重合，而非共同语义。
patterns.domain: 宗教哲学说明；历史地理条目

patterns.name: 多语种词内子词切分
patterns.context: 激活覆盖被拆成多个子词的词形，包含瑞典语、德语、意大利语专名；没有清楚的上下文语义限制。

patterns.name: 诗歌中的行首罗马数字
patterns.context: 诗歌分节或分行处出现罗马数字编号，伴随换行与诗体排版。

patterns.name: 肌肉名称中的切分片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要中的肌肉解剖名称，夹在疼痛研究结果描述中。

patterns.name: 河流及冲积平原词汇
patterns.context: 地理百科对河流、平原和区域位置的描述；触发包含常见地理词与专名内部片段。

patterns.name: 历史王朝与地名专名
patterns.context: 描述南印度王朝、统治者及建筑地点的历史段落，激活集中于专名内部。

patterns.name: 难以归并的词内片段
patterns.context: 这些激活分别出现在哲学／心理说明、诗歌及地理文本中，缺乏明显共同语义或句法条件。

en.concept: Local word forms and proper-name fragments
en.description: Activations often land on split proper nouns and within-word fragments; they also appear on interface commands, program arguments, psychological exercise terms, foreign loanwords, and patent mechanical terminology, making it difficult to group them into a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Letter/syllable segmentation in proper nouns
patterns.context: Strong activations land on segmented fragments of proper nouns, including personal names, place names, and works; some punctuation and ordinary words also activate.

patterns.name: Interface command identifiers
patterns.context: Menu/command items are listed as code key names alongside their human-readable labels; activations cluster on words in the command identifiers.

patterns.name: Emotion and cognition words in guided exercises
patterns.context: Activations occur near emotion, cognition, and related words in imperative instructions for psychological exercises or mindfulness activities.

patterns.name: Foreign word forms in classical prose
patterns.context: Italicized French loanwords and inflected English words appear in English prose; activations cluster on within-word fragments.

patterns.name: Program argument interfaces
patterns.context: A Python argparse example defines command-line arguments; activations occur locally on interface names such as parser and add_argument.

patterns.name: Patent mechanical components and positional descriptions
patterns.context: Technical sentences describe clamping or extending components, resistance adjustment, and knee position; activations are distributed across mechanical terms and positional descriptions.

patterns.name: Within-word subfragment activations
patterns.context: Activations may land within words rather than at complete word boundaries; the available examples are insufficient to determine whether they are triggered by word meaning, spelling fragments, or tokenization.

10_1619.description: 激活常落在被拆分的专名及词内片段；另见界面命令、程序参数、心理练习词、异语借词和专利机械术语，难以归为单一语义类别。

patterns.name: 专名中的字母／音节切分
patterns.trigger: 专名被拆分为多个子词片段，如«Dec»3«amer»7«on»9、«Mur»4«sh»2«id»3abad、«T»6«urt»10«i»5«Par»6、«S»6«adas»6«iv»6«ud»5«u»3
patterns.context: 强激活落在被分段书写的专名片段上；包括人名、地名及作品名，部分标点和普通词也有激活。
patterns.domain: 跨文体；文学、新闻、百科等

patterns.name: 界面命令标识符
patterns.context: 菜单／命令项以代码键名和对应的人类可读标签列出，激活集中于命令标识符中的词。

patterns.name: 指导性练习中的情绪与认知词
patterns.context: 以祈使句引导心理练习或觉察活动时，情绪、认知及相关词语附近出现激活。
patterns.domain: 自助、身心练习类指导文本

patterns.name: 古典语文中的异语词形
patterns.context: 英语散文中出现斜体标示的法语借词，以及带词尾的英语词；激活集中于词内片段。

patterns.name: 程序参数接口
patterns.context: Python argparse 示例中定义命令行参数，激活出现在 parser、add_argument 等接口名称的局部。

patterns.name: 专利机械部件与位置描述
patterns.context: 描述夹持或伸展部件、阻力调节及膝部位置的技术句子；激活分布在机械术语和位置描述上。
patterns.domain: 专利／机械与医疗器械技术文本

patterns.name: 词内子片段激活
patterns.context: 激活可能落在词语内部而非完整词边界；现有例子不足以判断是否由词义、拼写片段或分词方式触发。

en.description: Activations occur in segmented proper names or foreign-word fragments, including place names, personal names, work titles, religious terms, and names of people; there is no clear, stable semantic or syntactic commonality.

patterns.name: Internal «San» fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Appears in proper names such as place names, administrative divisions, team names, or religious terms; activations often fall on segmented fragments within names

patterns.name: Segmented fragments in names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Proper names or foreign words are split into multiple tokens, with activations on some of the fragments; no stable semantic or syntactic condition
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, literary texts, and lists

patterns.name: Name fragments in South Asian film coverage
patterns.context: Mentions a director, actor, or potential actor in a film-news context

10_1619.description: 激活分布在被拆分的专名或外语词片段中，包括地名、姓名、作品名、宗教术语及人名；没有明确稳定的语义或句法共性。

patterns.name: 专名内部的「San」片段
patterns.context: 出现在地名、行政区名、球队名或宗教术语等专名中；激活常落在名称内部的分词片段

patterns.name: 姓名与名称中的分词片段
patterns.trigger: 人名、作品名或地点名中的多 token 片段，如“G. Sadasivudu”“N. T. Rama Rao”“ipse dixit”“Huangpu”“Kashimpur”“Jadav Tarafder”“Hori Naohiro”
patterns.context: 专名或外语词被拆成多个 token，激活落在其中若干片段；没有稳定的词义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 百科条目、文学文本及名单

patterns.name: 南亚电影报道中的姓名片段
patterns.context: 电影新闻语境中提及导演、演员或潜在演员

en.concept: Encyclopedic proper nouns and entry formats
en.description: Activations occur in encyclopedic text dense with proper nouns: geography and routes, South Asian history and culture, bridges and transportation, sports biographies, commercial theaters, Thai films, and constituency lists. They often co-occur with place names, personal names, organizations, numbers, and list formatting; the fragment “San” also recurs in two types of proper nouns.

patterns.name: Place names and administrative divisions
patterns.context: Place names appear in encyclopedic geographic descriptions, administrative divisions, or route lists; some names are split into subwords across languages.
patterns.domain: Geography, local administration, and route entries

patterns.name: South Asian historical and cultural proper nouns
patterns.context: Introductions to Indian and South Asian history, architecture and art, or etymology; proper nouns are often split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Historical, artistic, and etymological encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Transportation engineering and infrastructure
patterns.context: Describes bridge height, construction date, routes, and terrain crossed.

patterns.name: Team names and years in sports careers
patterns.context: Chronologically recounts the teams an athlete played for, transfers, or signings.

patterns.name: The fragment “San” in proper nouns
patterns.context: Occurs only within different proper nouns, in contexts respectively describing a local attraction and a player’s career; it may be a shared string cue, but evidence is limited.
patterns.domain: Place names and sports proper nouns

patterns.name: Theater and commercial venue names
patterns.context: Describes a business operator shifting to theater construction and lists venue names.

patterns.name: Thai films and personal names
patterns.context: Genre, year, director, and cast information in film entries; names are split into subwords.

patterns.name: Constituency lists and politicians' names
patterns.context: Lists candidates or legislators and party abbreviations by numbered constituency.

10_1619.description: 激活出现于百科式专名密集文本：地理与路线、南亚历史文化、桥梁交通、体育履历、商业剧院、泰国电影及选区名录；常伴随地名、人名、机构名、数字和列表格式，另有“San”在两类专名中重现。

patterns.name: 地名与行政区划条目
patterns.context: 地名嵌在百科式地理介绍、行政区划或路线列表中；部分名称跨语言切分为子词。
patterns.domain: 地理、地方行政与路线条目

patterns.name: 南亚历史文化专名
patterns.context: 印度及南亚历史、建筑艺术或词源介绍，专名常被拆成多个 token。

patterns.name: 交通工程与基础设施
patterns.context: 描述桥梁高度、建成时间、线路及跨越的地形。

patterns.name: 体育人物生涯中的队名与年份
patterns.context: 按时间顺序叙述运动员效力球队、转会或签约。

patterns.name: 专名中的片段“San”
patterns.context: 仅在不同专名内部出现，周围语境分别是地方景点介绍和球员效力经历；可能是同一字串线索，但证据有限。

patterns.name: 剧院及商业场所名称
patterns.context: 叙述商业经营者转向建造剧院，并列举场馆名称。

patterns.name: 泰国电影及人名
patterns.trigger: “2005 Thai horror film”“Long khong”以及导演、演员姓名，如“Kongkiat”“Putipong”
patterns.context: 电影条目的类型、年份、导演和演员介绍；姓名被拆分成子词。

patterns.name: 选区列表与政治人物姓名
patterns.context: 以编号选区逐项列出候选人或议员姓名及党派缩写。

en.description: Primarily responds to specific subword fragments in proper names, especially Put/Puth and South Indian personal and place names; other sporadic patterns include Japanese names, Latin maxims, Indian film proper names, and names of ancient dynastic coins.

patterns.name: Put / Puth syllables in names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations concentrate within proper names, especially personal names beginning with Put-/Puth-; also appears in Thai film-industry names and place names. This is not a response to whole-word boundaries and often falls on segmented subword fragments.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries on people, films, and places

patterns.name: Name fragments in Thai film entries
patterns.context: The strongest activation is near Putipong Saisikaew in a list of people in a Thai horror-film entry; the same passage also includes Thai names such as Kongkiat and Thamthrakul.

patterns.name: Indian film-industry names and place names
patterns.context: Appears in a list of Kerala place names, Kannada film-director names, and Malayalam film-writer names; biased toward South Indian proper names.
patterns.domain: Indian film and geography encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Japanese names and feudal titles
patterns.context: In the disambiguation page for the name Hori Naohiro, especially near historical explanations of Muromatsu and daimyo.

patterns.name: amicus in a Latin maxim
patterns.context: When the maxim “Amicus Plato, amicus Socrates, magis …” is quoted at the end of English prose, activations concentrate on the Latin amicus and adjacent proper names.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on Indian film-related proper names
patterns.context: Some proper-name subword fragments activate when Indian actors, studios, or football clubs are mentioned in film entries; these do not fully match the Put-/Puth- cluster.
patterns.domain: Indian film and sports figure encyclopedias

patterns.name: Ancient coins and dynasty names
patterns.context: In historical passages about the Indo-Greek Kingdom, Kushan Empire, and their coin imagery, activations fall on dynasty, ethnic-group, or proper-name fragments.
patterns.domain: Ancient history and numismatics encyclopedia entries

10_1619.description: 主要响应专名中的特定子词片段，尤见 Put/Puth 及印度南部人名地名；另有日文姓名、拉丁格言、印度影视专名和古代王朝钱币名称等零散模式。

patterns.name: 名称与专名中的 Put / Puth 音节
patterns.context: 激活集中在专名内部，尤其是以 Put-/Puth- 开头的人名；也见于泰语电影人名和地名。并非完整词边界反应，常落在被切分的子词片段上。
patterns.domain: 百科人物、电影与地名条目

patterns.name: 泰国电影条目中的人名片段
patterns.context: 泰语恐怖片条目的人名列表中，Putipong Saisikaew 附近激活最强；同段还有 Kongkiat、Thamthrakul 等泰语姓名。

patterns.name: 印度电影人名与地名
patterns.context: 出现在喀拉拉邦地名列表、卡纳达电影导演姓名，以及马拉雅拉姆电影编剧姓名中；偏向印度南部专名。
patterns.domain: 印度电影与地理百科条目

patterns.name: 日文姓名及封建官职条目
patterns.context: 姓名 Hori Naohiro 的词条消歧页面中，尤其在 Muromatsu 和 daimyo 的历史说明附近激活。
patterns.domain: 日本历史人物消歧百科条目

patterns.name: 拉丁格言中的 amicus
patterns.context: 英语散文末尾引述“Amicus Plato, amicus Socrates, magis …”格言时，激活集中于拉丁语 amicus 及相邻专名。
patterns.domain: 古典格言引文／书籍散文

patterns.name: 印度影视相关专名的零星激活
patterns.context: 影视条目中出现印度演员、工作室或足球俱乐部名称时，若干专名子词片段激活；与 Put-/Puth- 主簇不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 印度影视及体育人物百科

patterns.name: 古代钱币与王朝名称
patterns.context: 关于印希王国、贵霜帝国及其钱币图像的历史段落中，激活落在王朝、族群或专名片段上。
patterns.domain: 古代史与钱币学百科条目

en.description: Activations are distributed across multilingual personal names, place names, film titles, and their subword fragments; they also occur in bibliographies, political lists, geography, film plots, and architectural descriptions. Fragments such as Put recur, but there is no unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Put in proper nouns
patterns.context: Put is followed by different endings in multilingual proper nouns; no fixed syntactic position is required
patterns.domain: Wikipedia biographies, film, and place entries

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of Japanese place names or personal names
patterns.context: Subword fragments of Japanese names, teams, or places; no shared syntactic function is apparent
patterns.domain: Wikipedia lists, sports biographies, and Q&A text

patterns.name: Indian local administrative geography
patterns.context: Describes villages, towns, administrative locations, or surrounding areas

patterns.name: South Indian film plots and characters
patterns.context: Introduces characters, families, and story background in film plot passages

patterns.name: Indian film-related proper nouns
patterns.context: Introduces the film industry, releases, directors, or works

patterns.name: Descriptions of European church architecture
patterns.context: Describes church interiors, features, reliefs, style, or location

patterns.name: Japanese constituency member lists
patterns.context: Lists candidates or representatives by constituency number

patterns.name: References and bibliography formats
patterns.context: Bibliography entries at the end of a text, including authors, years, titles, or publication information

patterns.name: Thai film titles and creators
patterns.context: Opening of a film entry, giving the title, year, country, genre, and creators

patterns.name: Other proper-noun fragments
patterns.context: Tokenized fragments within proper nouns, occurring in varied semantic and syntactic environments

10_1619.description: 激活分布在多语种人名、地名、片名及其分词片段中，也见于书目、政治名单、地理、电影剧情和建筑描述；Put 等片段有重复，但无统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Put
patterns.context: 跨语言专名中，Put 后接不同词尾；不要求固定句法位置
patterns.domain: 维基百科人物、电影与地点条目

patterns.name: 日本地名或姓名的切分片段
patterns.context: 日语姓名、球队或地点的分词子片段；未见共同句法功能
patterns.domain: 维基百科名单、体育人物条目及问答文本

patterns.name: 印度地方行政地理
patterns.context: 描述村镇、行政区方位或周边地区

patterns.name: 南印度电影情节与人物
patterns.trigger: «Ray»an«am»、«Mad»hav、«Ar»una 等人物名及电影情节词
patterns.context: 电影剧情段落中介绍人物、家庭与故事背景

patterns.name: 印度电影相关专名
patterns.trigger: «Kann»ada、«Bell»i «Mod»a、«Put»tanna 等电影或电影业相关名称
patterns.context: 介绍影业、发行、导演或作品

patterns.name: 欧洲教堂建筑描述
patterns.context: 描述教堂内部构件、浮雕、风格或地点
patterns.domain: 维基百科建筑艺术条目

patterns.name: 日本选区议员名单
patterns.trigger: «13th district»、«14th district»及姓名与党派缩写 «(JRP)»
patterns.context: 按选区编号逐项列出候选人或代表

patterns.name: 参考文献与书目格式
patterns.trigger: «Ogawa»,»10« M.»及年份、出版地和出版社信息
patterns.context: 文末书目条目，包含作者、年份、书名或出版信息

patterns.name: 泰语电影名及创作者
patterns.context: 电影条目开头，说明片名、年份、国别、类型和创作者

patterns.name: 其他专名片段
patterns.context: 专名内部的分词片段，所处语义与句法环境各异

en.concept: Subword fragments in proper names and quotations
en.description: Activations often fall on local subwords in proper names: especially Put/Puthen name or place fragments, proper names beginning with U, and Japanese name segmentation. Patent citation numbers, Antiquities, and two instances of awa also appear.

patterns.name: Put／Puthen surnames
patterns.context: Names or surnames beginning with Put appear in personal names; strong activations fall on the Put substring.

patterns.name: Names or proper nouns beginning with U
patterns.context: Personal names or proper nouns starting with U; the trigger is the initial U substring.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia lists, patent citations, and film entries

patterns.name: Fragments of Japanese names
patterns.context: In lists of Japanese politicians or accounts of Japanese football careers, names are segmented into multiple adjacent subwords.

patterns.name: Patent numbers and citations
patterns.context: Patent numbers, identifiers, or patent-publication citations in patent background text.

patterns.name: Cast and crew listings in film entries
patterns.context: Film summaries or entries conventionally list directors, actors, and songwriters. Activations cluster on name fragments, especially those beginning with Put.

patterns.name: Put substring in place names
patterns.context: Put is the initial substring of a place name in lists of places or towns; other place names also appear in the same passage.

patterns.name: Ant substring in a common term or name
patterns.context: The initial substring of Antiquities, a work by Josephus; context discusses the Jewish War and Rome.

patterns.name: awa substring in a Spanish word
patterns.context: An isolated fragment at the start of a list line, near a list of districts and names; the excerpt does not reveal which complete word it belongs to.

patterns.name: awa substring in a Spanish word
patterns.context: Appears at the end of the author surname Ogawa in a reference; surrounded by bibliographic formatting and publication information.

10_1619.concept: 专名及引文中的子词片段
10_1619.description: 激活多落在专名的局部子词：尤以 Put/Puthen 姓名或地名片段、U 开头专名、日本姓名分词为显著模式；另见专利引文编号、Antiquities 与两处 awa。

patterns.name: Put／Puthen 姓氏
patterns.trigger: « Put»10，另有« Put»9；完整形式包括“Putipong”和“Puthenchery”
patterns.context: 人名中包含以 Put 开头的名字或姓氏；强激活落在姓名的 Put 子串上。

patterns.name: U 开头的人名或专名
patterns.context: 以 U 起始的人名或专名；触发位置在词首的 U 子串。
patterns.domain: 百科名单、专利引文及电影条目

patterns.name: 日本姓名的片段
patterns.trigger: « Kō»5«ichi»6、« N»5«ish»5«ino»5、« Tak»7«ashi»6、« Tan»5«ih»6«ata»2、« Yas»5«uto»4；另有« San»9«f»4«rec»2«ce»3« Hiro»4«sh»6«ima»3
patterns.context: 日本政治人物名单或日本足球经历中，姓名被分词切成多个相邻子词。
patterns.domain: 百科名单及体育人物传记

patterns.name: 专利编号与引文
patterns.context: 专利背景文本中的专利号、编号或专利出版物引文。

patterns.name: 电影条目中的演职人员罗列
patterns.trigger: “directed by”后的人名子词，以及“starring”“Songs are written by”后的姓名；另见“directed by S. R. Puttanna Kanagal”
patterns.context: 电影简介或影片条目按惯例罗列导演、演员、歌曲作者，激活集中在这些姓名片段，尤其 Put 开头片段。

patterns.name: 地名中的 Put 子串
patterns.context: 地名或城镇列表中，Put 是地点名的起始子串；同段也出现其他地名。

patterns.name: 一般词项或人名中的 Ant 子串
patterns.context: Josephus 著作名 Antiquities 的词首；上下文讨论犹太战争与罗马。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内的 awa 子串
patterns.context: 孤立片段位于名单行开头，附近为选区与姓名列表；无法从截取内容确定它属于哪个完整词。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内的 awa 子串
patterns.context: 出现在参考文献作者 Ogawa 的姓氏末尾，周围是书目格式与出版信息。

en.concept: Variant fragments in proper nouns and bibliographic identifiers
en.description: Activations are concentrated on Japanese and U.S. patent identifiers and numbers in patent citations, and often land on transliterated fragments of multilingual personal names and religious terms. There are also sporadic activations on bibliographic punctuation and ordinary words, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Japanese patent document numbers
patterns.context: Citations to Japanese patents or published patent applications and their numbers occur in patent background or prior-art sections, especially years, hyphens, and digit strings in the numbers.

patterns.name: U.S. patent number citations
patterns.context: A U.S. patent number is cited in technical descriptions as an example of an existing device or technology; the citation format includes U.S. Pat. No. and a numeric identifier.

patterns.name: Transliterated fragments of Japanese personal names
patterns.context: Names in Japanese constituency lists are transliterated into Roman characters; activations land on syllable or letter fragments within the names. Constituency numbers also appear in the same passage.

patterns.name: Tibetan Buddhist terms and personal names
patterns.context: When discussing a tradition distinguished from Tibetan Buddhism and the origins of its scriptures and visions, activations occur on transliterated Tibetan religious titles and personal names.

patterns.name: Bibliographic name punctuation and word fragments
patterns.context: In Spanish bibliography/reference fragments, activations land locally on author names, punctuation, or truncated words; there is no clear, consistent semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Sanskrit epic forms of address and proper nouns
patterns.context: In religious poetry quotations, people are addressed by vocative forms; activations cluster on transliterated fragments of proper nouns, while several ordinary words are also marked.

patterns.name: Personal names in Punjabi folktales
patterns.context: In introductions to Punjabi folktales, activations land on internal fragments of transliterated personal names; the same passage also contains other names and folk descriptions.

patterns.name: Transliterated Tamil personal names
patterns.context: In descriptions of historical figures in the Chennai region, activations occur on multiple Romanized fragments of Tamil poets' names.

10_1619.concept: 专名与文献标识的异形片段
10_1619.description: 激活最集中于专利引用中的日美专利标识及编号，也常落在多语种人名、宗教术语的罗马字转写片段；另有书目标点和普通词等零散激活，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 日本专利文献编号
patterns.context: 专利背景技术或现有技术段落中，出现日本专利/专利申请公开的引用及其编号，尤其编号中的年代、连字符和数字串。

patterns.name: 美国专利号引用
patterns.context: 技术描述中以美国专利号为例说明已有装置或技术，引用格式包含 U.S. Pat. No. 与数字编号。

patterns.name: 日文人名音译片段
patterns.context: 日本选区名单中的姓名以罗马字转写，激活落在人名内部的音节或字母片段；同段还包含选区编号。

patterns.name: 藏传佛教术语与人名
patterns.context: 讨论与藏传佛教相区别的传统及其经典、异象来源时，激活藏语宗教称谓和人名的转写片段。

patterns.name: 书目姓名标点与词片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语书目/参考文献片段，激活落在作者姓名、标点或截断词的局部；没有清晰一致的语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 学术书目与西班牙语文本

patterns.name: 梵文史诗称谓与专名
patterns.context: 宗教诗文引文中，以呼格称谓称呼人物；激活集中于专名音译片段，另有若干普通词也被标记。
patterns.domain: 宗教诗歌/《薄伽梵歌》译文

patterns.name: 旁遮普民间故事人名
patterns.context: 介绍旁遮普民间故事时，激活落在人名音译的内部片段；同段也出现其他人名和民俗叙述。

patterns.name: 泰米尔人名转写
patterns.context: 介绍钦奈地区历史人物时，激活泰米尔诗人姓名的多个罗马字转写片段。

en.description: Activations mainly cluster on local spelling fragments in proper names, especially Par, San, and South Asian, Japanese romanized, and Sanskrit names. They span multiple domains, with no stable semantic or syntactic condition evident.

patterns.name: Specific word fragment Par
patterns.context: Triggered by initial Par- or its segmented fragment, with subsequent spelling varying by word; occurs in proper nouns.
patterns.domain: Sanskrit classics, Indian place names, Italian place names, general encyclopedia

patterns.name: San proper-name fragment
patterns.context: Triggered by San in proper names, followed by varying names; examples include Sanfrece Hiroshima, San Luca, and San Pancrazio.
patterns.domain: Sports biographies, art history, architectural encyclopedias

patterns.name: South Asian place-name spelling fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in Indian place names or names used in the Bhagavad Gita; activations are distributed across segmented name fragments.

patterns.name: Japanese romanized proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on romanized spelling fragments of Japanese personal names, place names, or patent names; they have no consistent meaning.

patterns.name: Tibetan Buddhist Sanskrit-term fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in transliterated names of Buddhist doctrinal terms, such as those for buddha-bodies and buddha-fields.

patterns.name: Fragments of Japanese author surnames
patterns.context: In statistical papers, names of institutions, authors, or locations are segmented, and adjacent fragments activate.

patterns.name: Spanish reference fragments
patterns.context: Occurs near author surnames and punctuation in Spanish-language bibliography entries.

10_1619.description: 激活主要集中于专名的局部拼写片段，尤其是 Par、San，以及南亚、日文罗马字和梵语名字；跨多种领域，未见稳定的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 特定词片段 Par
patterns.context: 触发于词首 Par- 或其分词片段，后续拼写因词而异；出现于专名中
patterns.domain: 梵文经典、印度地名、意大利地名、一般百科

patterns.name: San 专名片段
patterns.context: 触发于专名中的 San，后续名称各异；可见于 Sanfrece Hiroshima、San Luca、San Pancrazio
patterns.domain: 体育人物、艺术史、建筑百科

patterns.name: 南亚地名拼写片段
patterns.context: 出现在印度地名或《薄伽梵歌》称呼中，激活分布在被拆分的名字片段上
patterns.domain: 印度宗教文本、印度地理

patterns.name: 日文罗马字专名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在日文人名、地名或专利名称的罗马字拼写片段上；没有统一词义
patterns.domain: 专利文献、日本足球人物百科

patterns.name: 藏传佛教梵语术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在佛身、佛土等佛教教义术语的转写名称中

patterns.name: 日文作者姓氏片段
patterns.context: 统计论文的机构、作者或所在地名称中，名字被分词后相邻片段激活

patterns.name: 西班牙语参考文献片段
patterns.context: 出现在西班牙语书目条目中的作者姓氏及标点附近

en.concept: South Asian proper nouns and text fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across Buddhist terms, South Asian place names and personal names, religious scriptures, Punjabi folklore, Thai film proper nouns, and book-review expressions; many strong activations land on subword fragments of proper nouns, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Tibetan Buddhist terms and traditions
patterns.context: Introductions to Buddhist doctrines, schools, scriptures, or sacred figures; activations land on Sanskrit and Tibetan terms, proper nouns, and related words.
patterns.domain: Religious and Buddhist discussions and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Indian and South Asian place names
patterns.context: Indian place and regional names appear in Indian geography, administrative divisions, cities, or news reports.

patterns.name: South Asian personal names and forms of address
patterns.context: Personal names, epic figures' forms of address, or honorifics occur in narrative, quotations, or religious texts; activations often land on subword fragments of names.
patterns.domain: News, Punjabi folklore, Indian religious texts

patterns.name: Place-name fragments beginning with Put in lists
patterns.context: A place name or proper noun beginning with Put occurs in a geographic list or film cast list; the following words and domains differ between the two cases.

patterns.name: Thai film proper nouns
patterns.context: Descriptions of Thai horror films and lists of proper nouns such as cast and director names.

patterns.name: Punjabi folk story titles
patterns.context: Introductions to Punjabi folk stories or poetry; activations land on language/genre names and story characters' names.

patterns.name: Devotional faith and scriptural exhortations
patterns.context: Scripture-like direct quotations emphasizing believers, refuge, salvation, or immortality.

patterns.name: Scholarly authority and reader evaluations
patterns.context: First-person book reviews assessing whether an author is an expert on a particular topic.

patterns.name: Unmerged sporadic proper nouns and narrative
patterns.context: The provided passages respectively contain sentence endings in administrative descriptions and railway station descriptions; although they include Indian place names, the marked words themselves show no stable shared trigger.

10_1619.concept: 南亚相关专名与文本片段
10_1619.description: 激活分散于佛教术语、南亚地名与人名、宗教经文、旁遮普民间文学、泰国电影专名及书评表达；许多强激活落在专名的子词片段，未见单一稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: 藏传佛教术语与传承
patterns.context: 佛教教义、宗派、经典或神圣人物的介绍；激活落在梵藏术语、专名及相关词上。
patterns.domain: 宗教、佛教论述及百科条目

patterns.name: 印度与南亚地名
patterns.context: 印度地理、行政区划、城市或新闻报道中出现印度地名与区域名称。

patterns.name: 南亚人名及称谓
patterns.context: 人名、史诗人物称谓或敬称处于叙述、引语或宗教文本中；激活常落在姓名的子词片段。
patterns.domain: 新闻、旁遮普民间文学、印度宗教文本

patterns.name: 地点名录中的地名片段 Put
patterns.context: 地名或专名以 Put 开头，出现在地理区域清单或电影演职员表中；两处后续词义和领域不同。

patterns.name: 泰国电影专名
patterns.context: 泰国恐怖电影简介及演员、导演等专名列表。

patterns.name: 旁遮普语民间故事名称
patterns.context: 介绍旁遮普民间故事或诗歌，激活落在语言／文类名称和故事人物名上。

patterns.name: 虔诚信仰与经文劝诫
patterns.trigger: «Pro»4«claim»1 it« bold»1ly；« devote»2«e»5« never»6« per»2«ishes»2；« refuge»2« in»4« Me»3
patterns.context: 经文式直接引语，强调信徒、皈依、救赎或不灭。
patterns.domain: 印度教经文译文、宗教问答

patterns.name: 学术权威与读者评价
patterns.context: 第一人称读书评论，对作者是否具备某主题专家身份作评价。

patterns.name: 未能归并的零散专名与叙述
patterns.context: 所给片段中分别是行政描述的句尾、铁路站点说明；虽含印度地名，但这些被标记词本身未显示稳定的共同触发条件。

en.description: Activations cluster on local subwords in several proper names and long words: the Par- series, Buddhist-term fragments, India-related words, and scattered personal and place names. Isolated cases such as Turin and pilgrims also appear. The domains vary widely, with no unified semantic or syntactic condition evident.

patterns.name: Partha／Parthian strings
patterns.context: Activations fall on word fragments beginning with Par-; meanings and syntactic contexts vary.
patterns.domain: Religious scripture, place names, historical narrative

patterns.name: Sanskrit Buddhist-term/name fragments
patterns.context: Terms and names in Tibetan Buddhist or Buddhist philosophical contexts; stronger activations fall on specific fragments of terms.

patterns.name: India-related word fragments
patterns.context: Indian economic news or accounts of Indian places; activations are distributed across fragments of country names, offices, and place names.

patterns.name: Rare word fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activations occur on local subwords in personal, place, or historical names, with no consistent semantics or context across examples.
patterns.domain: Religious texts, ancient history, European history, and architectural history

patterns.name: Italian place/travel fragments
patterns.context: Biographical narrative describing an artist traveling between and settling in Italian cities.

patterns.name: Pilgrimage word fragment
patterns.context: Discusses pilgrims’ motivations for undertaking a pilgrimage and related books, outside an academic-review context.

10_1619.description: 激活集中于若干专名和长词的局部子词：Par- 系列、佛教术语片段、印度相关词，以及分散的人名地名；也出现 Turin、朝圣者等孤例。领域跨度大，未见统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: Partha／Parthian 字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在 Par- 开头的词片段；词义和句法背景各异。
patterns.domain: 宗教经文、地名、历史叙述

patterns.name: 梵语佛教术语／人名片段
patterns.context: 藏传佛教或佛教哲学语境中的术语、人名；较强激活落在术语的特定词片段。

patterns.name: 印度相关词片段
patterns.context: 印度经济新闻或印度地名叙述；激活分布在国家、官职及地名的若干片段。

patterns.name: 专名中的罕见词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在人物、地点或历史专名的局部子词上，彼此语义和语境不统一。
patterns.domain: 宗教文本、古代史、欧洲史与建筑史

patterns.name: 意大利地名／行程词片段
patterns.context: 描述艺术家在意大利城市间旅行、定居的传记叙述。

patterns.name: 朝圣词片段
patterns.context: 谈论朝圣者进行朝圣的动机及相关书籍，非学术评论语境。

en.concept: South Asian proper nouns and religious word fragments
en.description: Activations often land on within-word fragments of proper nouns, place names, personal names, and religious terms in Indian and Buddhist contexts, especially Par, South Asian transliterations, and Buddha. A few ordinary English words are also highlighted, which cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Par in South Asian religious proper nouns
patterns.context: Strong activations cluster on the Par substring, appearing with different following spellings in Hindu scriptural forms of address, Indian place names, and film narratives. The triggering boundaries are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Indian religious texts, Indian place names, and South Asian film narratives

patterns.name: South Asian proper nouns and religious vocabulary
patterns.context: Strong activations appear within proper nouns for Indian people, places, rivers, religious figures, or Buddhist terms; token segmentation varies and does not necessarily share a uniform word form.
patterns.domain: Indian news, encyclopedia entries, religious and Buddhist texts

patterns.name: Religious rituals and doctrinal terms
patterns.context: Occurs in contexts involving ritual obligations, explanations of Buddhist symbols, concepts of the Buddha's body, and Hindu devotion; activations land on religious terms or local spelling fragments.
patterns.domain: Religious encyclopedias, Buddhist philosophy, religious scriptures

patterns.name: Lists or entry-style enumeration of proper nouns
patterns.context: When place names and personal names are densely enumerated, multiple subword fragments within proper nouns activate; commas, line breaks, or encyclopedia entry formatting often accompany them.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia place-name, personal-name, and historical figure lists

patterns.name: Buddhist vajra and symbolic objects
patterns.context: When describing Buddhist symbols and their religious meaning, activations cover the object name, local transliterations, and related doctrinal terms.
patterns.domain: Buddhist iconography and symbolic-object encyclopedia descriptions

patterns.name: Indian personal names in historical narratives
patterns.context: Names of historical figures, rulers, and religious leaders occur in short entry-style narratives.

patterns.name: Names in Indian film plots
patterns.context: Character names and narrative transitions activate in plot summaries, surrounded by events involving land rental, relationships, and deities.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on ordinary English word fragments
patterns.context: A few non-proper-noun English words also activate strongly; they belong to news, railway descriptions, plots, and religious terms, with no consistent local context.
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedias, plots, and religious texts

10_1619.concept: 南亚专名与宗教词片段
10_1619.description: 激活多落在印度及佛教语境中的专名、地名、人名和宗教术语内部片段，尤其是 Par、南亚音译拼写及 Buddha 等；少数普通英语词也高亮，无法由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 南亚宗教专名中的 Par
patterns.context: 强激活集中在 Par 子串；出现在印度教经文称谓、印度地名和影视叙述中的不同后续拼写。具体触发边界并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 印度宗教文本、印度地名及南亚影视叙述

patterns.name: 南亚专名与宗教词汇
patterns.context: 印度人物、地名、河流、宗教人物或佛教术语的专名内部可见较强激活；token 分段方式多样，未必有统一词形。
patterns.domain: 印度新闻、百科条目、宗教与佛教文本

patterns.name: 宗教仪式与教义词
patterns.context: 出现在仪式义务、佛教象征说明、佛身概念及印度教虔信语境中；激活落在宗教术语或其局部拼写片段。
patterns.domain: 宗教百科、佛教哲学、宗教经文

patterns.name: 列表或条目式专名罗列
patterns.context: 地名、人名密集列举时，专名内部多个子词片段被激活；常伴随逗号、换行或百科条目格式。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 地名、人名与历史人物列表

patterns.name: 佛教金刚杵与象征物
patterns.context: 描述佛教象征物及其宗教含义时，激活覆盖物名、局部转写和相关教义词。
patterns.domain: 佛教图像与象征物百科说明

patterns.name: 历史叙事中的印度人名
patterns.context: 历史人物、统治者及宗教领袖姓名出现在短条目式叙述中。

patterns.name: 印度电影剧情中的姓名
patterns.context: 剧情梗概中人物姓名及叙述衔接词出现激活，周围是租地、人物关系与神祇等情节内容。

patterns.name: 普通英语词片段的零星激活
patterns.context: 少数非专名英语词也出现高激活，分属新闻、铁路描述、剧情和宗教词，缺少一致的局部语境。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、剧情及宗教文本

en.description: Mainly responds to internal fragments of segmented proper names, especially Par-, personal names, and place names. Strong activations also occur on fragments of religious buildings and monastery names, and on patent-number digit strings. The An Expert in segment 9 cannot be clearly linked to these patterns.

patterns.name: Par-initial subwords in proper names
patterns.context: Activations cluster on internal fragments of personal or place names beginning with Par; the corresponding complete words are Partha, Parma, Parthiban, and Paramakudi.

patterns.name: Fragments within other proper names
patterns.context: When proper names are segmented into subwords, activations fall on non-initial or internal fragments; examples include Pranab, Saryu, and Srinagar.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments in religious buildings and place names
patterns.context: Multi-part proper names of churches or monasteries, especially adjacent fragments forming a place or institution name.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias: religious architecture and Tibetan Bon

patterns.name: Patent-number digit strings
patterns.context: A digit string following “Japanese Patent No.” as part of a patent identifier.

10_1619.description: 主要响应被分词拆开的专名内部片段，尤其 Par-、人名及地名；另对宗教建筑、寺院名片段和专利编号数字串有高激活。第9段的 An Expert 无法与这些模式明确对应。

patterns.name: 专名中 Par 起始子词
patterns.context: 激活集中在 Par 开头的人名或地名的词内片段；对应完整词分别为 Partha、Parma、Parthiban、Paramakudi。
patterns.domain: 宗教文本、传记、地名列表

patterns.name: 其他专名内部的词片段
patterns.context: 专名被切成子词时，激活落在非词首或词内片段；分别构成 Pranab、Saryu、Srinagar。
patterns.domain: 新闻、地理条目、影视剧情

patterns.name: 宗教建筑与地名专名片段
patterns.context: 教堂名或寺院名中的多段式专名，尤其相邻片段构成地名、机构名。
patterns.domain: 百科全书，宗教建筑与藏传苯教

patterns.name: 专利号数字串
patterns.context: 数字串位于“Japanese Patent No.”之后，作为专利编号的一部分。

en.description: Activations mainly land on within-word subword fragments of proper nouns, religious terms, and personal and place names, especially fragments beginning with Par. Multiple contexts and spellings occur, with no stable syntactic or single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Par string fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations cluster on within-word segments of proper nouns or terms; their common feature is the spelling Par/Par…, but subsequent words and semantic uses vary.

patterns.name: South Asian religious and proper-noun fragments
patterns.context: In religious discussions or personal names, activations land on fragments of Indian religious terms, deity names, and personal names; they do not all share the same word form.

patterns.name: Other place-name fragments
patterns.context: Activations land on within-word fragments of European place names, with no clear shared context or semantic relation.

patterns.name: Personal-name and surname fragments
patterns.context: Activations land on tokenized fragments of biomedical coauthors' or local officials' names; these names are not part of the Par fragments mentioned above.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, introductions to people and organizations

patterns.name: Other name fragments
patterns.context: Names in ArXiv author lists are split into multiple subword fragments, with activations across several of them.

patterns.name: Names of princely figures
patterns.context: Activations cluster on name fragments in continuous lists of princes, Rajput figures, and titles.

10_1619.description: 激活主要落在专名、宗教术语及人名地名的词内子词片段上，尤其是 Par 开头片段；多种语境与拼写并存，未显示稳定句法或单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 专名中 Par 字符串的词片
patterns.context: 激活集中出现在专名或术语的词内分段上；共同点是拼写中出现 Par/Par…，但后续词及语义用途各异。
