patterns.domain: 宗教文本、人物传记、论文作者信息

patterns.name: 南亚宗教与专名词片
patterns.context: 在宗教论述或人物名称中，激活落在印度宗教相关术语、神名、人名的部分词片；不都共享同一词形。

patterns.name: 其他地名词片
patterns.context: 激活落在欧洲地名的词内片段，未见明确的共同上下文或语义关系。

patterns.name: 人名及姓氏词片
patterns.context: 激活落在科研合作者或地方官员姓名的分词片段；这些姓名不属于前述 Par 词片。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、人物与机构介绍

patterns.name: 其他姓名词片
patterns.context: ArXiv 作者列表中的姓名被分成多个子词片段，激活遍及其中若干片段。

patterns.name: 王公人物姓名词片
patterns.context: 在王侯、拉杰普特人物及头衔的连续名单中，激活集中于姓名词片段。

en.description: The most stable signal is activation on Par strings across various proper names and common words. Other scattered activations occur on proper-name fragments such as Mar and Srin, as well as list punctuation and line breaks. Corpus types and contexts vary widely, with no unified theme.

patterns.name: Fragments beginning with Par
patterns.context: Spelling fragments beginning with Par occur in place names, personal names, religious terms, and common words; capitalization and following characters vary.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: artwork lists, place and personal names, religious texts, narrative texts, patent documents

patterns.name: Mar in place names and proper names
patterns.context: Embedded in full personal or place names, appearing in directories, lists, or travel narratives.

patterns.name: Srin in proper names
patterns.context: The initial part of the Indian place name Srinagar, appearing in a location name in plant-experiment results.

patterns.name: Punctuation and structural boundaries
patterns.context: Punctuation and line breaks in lists, entries, or paragraph structure; activations cluster near entry boundaries or separators.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia lists, sequences of place names

patterns.name: Internal fragments of non-Par proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall within cross-token spellings of city names, river names, work titles, or religious terms; outside the Par pattern, there is no consistent spelling.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on common words
patterns.context: Appears in varied contexts, with no stable semantic or syntactic condition; activation strength and position are sporadic.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, narrative, patents, and other texts

10_1619.description: 最稳定的迹象是 Par 字串在多类专名和普通词中被激活；另有 Mar、Srin 等专名片段及列表标点、换行的零散激活。语料类型和上下文差异较大，未呈现统一主题。

patterns.name: Par 开头的片段
patterns.context: 在地名、人名、宗教术语或普通词中，均出现以 Par 开头的拼写片段；大小写和后续字符不同。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：艺术作品列表、地名与姓名、宗教文本、叙事文本、专利文献

patterns.name: 地名及专名中的 Mar
patterns.context: 嵌在完整人名或地名中，且出现在目录、名单或行程叙述里。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Srin
patterns.context: 作为印度地名 Srinagar 的开头部分，处在植物实验结果中的地点名里。

patterns.name: 标点及结构边界
patterns.context: 名单、条目或段落结构中的标点和换行；激活集中在条目边界或分隔符附近。

patterns.name: 非 Par 的专名内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在跨 token 拼写的城市名、河名、作品名或宗教术语内部；除 Par 模式外无一致字形。

patterns.name: 一般词语的零散激活
patterns.context: 出现在各自语境中，未见稳定的词义或句法条件；激活强度和位置零散。
patterns.domain: 百科、叙事、专利及其他文本

en.description: Activations occur broadly on multi-token word-internal fragments across languages and styles, especially proper names, place names, and names in lists; sporadic fragments also appear in bibliographies, Swedish morphology, reagent names, and scriptural quotations, without a stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments and continuation across word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations often occur in multi-token spellings, word interiors, or word endings rather than complete words; adjacent fragments sometimes activate too, with no single fixed root or semantic pattern.
patterns.domain: Cross-lingual, cross-style tokenization and word-form spelling phenomena

patterns.name: Proper names and place names
patterns.context: Personal names, place names, and other proper names are split into multiple subword fragments; not all proper-name fragments activate equally.
patterns.domain: Bibliographies, parliamentary texts, encyclopedias, religious texts

patterns.name: Scandinavian morphological fragments
patterns.context: In Swedish sentences, activations concentrate on fragments inside split words; the available examples are insufficient to identify specific word meanings.

patterns.name: Lists and entry-style formatting
patterns.context: Encyclopedia lists, tables of contents, or entries combine labels, punctuation, and entry content; activations mainly fall on proper-name fragments within entries.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia lists and tables of contents

patterns.name: Bibliographic publication format
patterns.context: Long bibliographic strings contain publication locations, years, editor initials, and German words; multiple word-internal fragments activate, with «ver» especially strong.

patterns.name: Method/reagent names and brands
patterns.context: Specialist names in parentheses, including chemical reagents, abbreviations, brands, and locations; activating fragments are sparse and weak.

patterns.name: Religious scriptural passages
patterns.context: In scripture-like English quotations, titles and proper names are split; ordinary word fragments also activate.

patterns.name: Lists of place names
patterns.context: When multiple place names are listed consecutively, activations are distributed across different internal fragments of the names.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia geography entries or place-name lists

10_1619.description: 激活广泛落在跨语言、跨文体的多词元词内片段，尤其专名、地名及列表中的名称；另见书目、瑞典语形态、试剂名和经文引文中的零散片段，未形成稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 词内片段与词界续接
patterns.trigger: 多段中激活落在被拆分的词片段上，如 «ver»10«änder»3«ter»4、«Mar»10«se»1«illes»1、«S»6«ary»10«u»5、«Har»7«an»8«agar»3
patterns.context: 激活常出现在多词元拼写、词中部或词尾，而非完整词；相邻片段有时也激活，未见单一固定词根或语义
patterns.domain: 跨语言、跨文体的分词/词形拼写现象

patterns.name: 专名与地名
patterns.context: 人名、地名及其他专名在文本中被切分成多个子词片段；并非所有专名片段都同样激活
patterns.domain: 书目、议会文本、百科、宗教文本

patterns.name: 斯堪的纳维亚语形态片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语句子中，激活集中于被拆分的词内部片段；现有例子不足以确定特定词义

patterns.name: 列表与条目式排版
patterns.trigger: «See also↵»、«17th district:»、«18th district:»及逗号分隔的姓名和地名串
patterns.context: 百科列表、目录或条目中，标签、标点及条目内容并存；激活主要落在条目中的专名片段

patterns.name: 出版物书目格式
patterns.trigger: «nach» den Handschriften der Kgl. Bib liothek in Berlin, hrs g. v. H. Nohl, Tübing en 1907, unveränderter Nachdruck
patterns.context: 书目式长串含出版地、年份、编者缩写及德语词；多个词内片段激活，«ver»尤强

patterns.name: 方法/试剂名称与品牌
patterns.context: 括号中的化学试剂、缩写、品牌与地点等专业名称；激活片段稀疏且较弱
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法或材料描述

patterns.name: 宗教经文语句
patterns.trigger: «Pro»claim it boldly, O son of Kunt i, that My devotee never perishes；«Par»tha
patterns.context: 经文式英语引文中，称谓和专名被切分；并伴有普通词片段激活

patterns.name: 地名名录
patterns.context: 连续列举多个地名时，激活分散在名称的不同内部片段
patterns.domain: 百科地理条目或地名列表

en.description: Most fragments cluster on segmented rare proper names and contexts introducing or enumerating them. Narrow-domain triggers also occur in maritime narratives, scriptural invocations, and legal judgment boilerplate, while ordinary neighboring words sometimes activate as well.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within proper names
patterns.context: For proper names segmented into multiple tokens, especially uncommon or non-English personal, place, and institution names, activations often occur at and near fragment boundaries; not all proper names activate equally.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies, geography, institutional and historical entries

patterns.name: Lists and entry-style fields
patterns.context: Labels and proper-name fragments activate in numbered electoral districts, candidate lists, or administrative divisions.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia lists, political and geographical entries

patterns.name: Proper names and lists of work creators
patterns.context: Activations occur when multiple companies, creators, and other proper names appear in sequence in product or work descriptions.

patterns.name: Religious scriptural forms of address and formulae
patterns.context: Proper-name forms of address and religious terms activate in direct scriptural address, religious doctrine, or exhortations.

patterns.name: Legal judgment boilerplate
patterns.context: Formal wording in court opinions describing applicable law, reversal of a judgment, and remedies.

patterns.name: General markers near proper names
patterns.context: Occasional activations in introductory accounts of proper names, historical figures, or dynasties; these common words are not stable triggers on their own.

patterns.name: Shipping and salvage narratives
patterns.context: Action words and place-name fragments appear together in accounts of clearing harbor wreckage, tugboats, and voyages between Mediterranean ports.

patterns.name: Judgment-status words outside proper names
patterns.context: Function words in the fixed phrase “judgment is reversed” in court rulings also strongly activate, so the pattern cannot be attributed entirely to proper-name fragments.

10_1619.description: 多数片段集中在拆分的罕见专名及其介绍、枚举语境；另有航运叙述、经文呼告和法律判决套语等窄域触发，普通邻接词也偶有激活。

patterns.name: 专名内部子词片段
patterns.trigger: 如 «Riv»«iera»、«Mar»«se»«illes»、«B»«izer»«te»；人名、地名、组织名中的词片段
patterns.context: 对被拆分为多个 token 的专名，尤其是非英语或不常见的人名、地名、机构名，片段边界处及其附近常有激活；并非所有专名都同样激活
patterns.domain: 百科传记、地理、机构及历史条目

patterns.name: 名单与条目式字段
patterns.context: 编号选区、候选人列表或行政区划枚举中，标签和专名片段激活
patterns.domain: 百科名单、政治及地理条目

patterns.name: 专名及作品创作者串列
patterns.context: 产品或作品介绍中，多个公司、创作者及其他专名连续出现时激活
patterns.domain: 专利背景、动漫作品介绍

patterns.name: 宗教经文称谓与套语
patterns.context: 经文式直接呼告、宗教教义或劝诫语句中，专名称谓及信仰用语激活

patterns.name: 法律裁判套语
patterns.context: 法院意见中描述适用法律、判决撤销及救济结果的正式表述

patterns.name: 一般专名邻近标记
patterns.trigger: «is»« known»、«first»、«royal» 等邻接专名或专名描述的词
patterns.context: 专名或历史人物、王朝的介绍性叙述中偶有激活；这些普通词本身并非稳定触发条件

patterns.name: 航运与修复叙述
patterns.context: 描述清理港口残骸、拖船及地中海港口间航行时，动作词与地名片段同时出现

patterns.name: 专名之外的判决状态词
patterns.context: 判决书中固定结构“judgment is reversed”里的功能词也有强激活，不能完全归结为专名片段

en.concept: Tokenized proper names and surrounding text
en.description: Primarily responds to proper names split into multiple subwords, especially place names, personal names, and institution names; also appears in addresses, company names, abbreviations, and transport/geography entries. A few function words and punctuation marks activate without an independent stable pattern.

patterns.name: Tokenization of place names in proper names
patterns.context: Place names are split into multiple subword tokens, especially in proper names, addresses, or locations in body text; punctuation, numbers, or spaces often occur nearby.

patterns.name: Tokenization of South Asian place names and personal names
patterns.context: India-related place names, personal names, or titles are split into multiple tokens, often embedded in encyclopedia-style geographical or biographical prose.

patterns.name: Tokenization of institution and company names
patterns.context: When an institution or company proper name appears, activations fall on tokens within the name; address or company-list contexts accompany them.

patterns.name: Letter abbreviations and degree markers
patterns.context: Degree abbreviations and institution abbreviations consisting of letters and periods occur after biographical education details.

patterns.name: Segmented tokens within proper names
patterns.context: Japanese names or work-character names are split into multiple subword tokens; they occur in text introducing characters, artists, or creators.

patterns.name: Function words and punctuation in ordinary text
patterns.context: A few common words or punctuation marks activate in some passages, but their distribution is unstable and they usually occur alongside tokenized proper names.

patterns.name: Railway stations and river place names
patterns.context: When describing urban railway junctions, locations relative to neighboring cities, and riverside directions, place names and transport/geography terms activate strongly.

10_1619.concept: 分词专名及其周边文本
10_1619.description: 主要响应被切分成多个子词的专名，尤其地名、人名、机构名；也见于地址、企业名、缩写及交通地理条目，少量功能词和标点激活缺乏独立稳定规律。

patterns.name: 专名中的地名分词
patterns.context: 地名被分成多个子词 token，尤见于专名、地址或正文中的地点名称；常有标点、数字或空格相邻。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、学术论文地址

patterns.name: 南亚地名及人名分词
patterns.context: 印度相关的地名、人名或头衔被切分成多个 token，常嵌在百科式地理或传记叙述中。

patterns.name: 机构与公司名称分词
patterns.context: 机构或企业专名出现时，激活落在名称内部的分词 token；伴随地址或公司列表语境。

patterns.name: 字母缩写与学历标记
patterns.context: 学位缩写及由字母、句点构成的机构缩写，出现在人物教育经历之后。

patterns.name: 专名内部的分段 token
patterns.context: 日本姓名或作品角色名被拆为多个子词 token；在介绍角色、艺术家或创作者的文字中出现。

patterns.name: 普通文本中的功能词与标点
patterns.context: 少量常见词或标点在若干片段中激活，但分布不稳定，且通常与专名分词同时出现。

patterns.name: 铁路站点及河流地名
patterns.context: 描述城市铁路交汇点、相邻城市位置及河岸方位时，地名和交通地理词获得较强激活。

en.description: Activations concentrate on proper-name subwords split in English text, especially Japanese institution names such as “Saitama”; they also appear in various personal names, place names, dynasties, and work titles. Line breaks in lists and punctuation may contribute to triggering, but the evidence is insufficient to confirm this.

patterns.name: “Saitama” subword fragments in Japanese place/institution names
patterns.context: Proper names appear as subword-tokenized forms in English text, especially Japanese place names, universities, medical centers, or research institutions; the most prominent shared trigger is “Saitama”
patterns.domain: Medical papers and academic methods, institutional affiliations; [1] also includes a place-name proper noun

patterns.name: Tokenized proper names and rare personal/place names
patterns.context: Foreign personal names, place names, dynastic names, and work/character names occur in English prose or lists; subword tokenization and rare spellings may be triggers. The pattern is not limited to one language or entity category.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, history, art, geography, lists of people

patterns.name: List and punctuation formatting
patterns.context: Activations also occur when names are arranged as line-by-line entries or in quoted attribution formats, but these formats co-occur with proper-name fragments, so an independent trigger cannot be confirmed.
patterns.domain: Paper author lists, election or seat lists

10_1619.description: 激活集中于英文文本中被拆分的专名子词，尤见“Saitama”等日本机构名；也出现在各类人名、地名、王朝与作品名中。名单换行和标点可能辅助触发，但证据不足以确认。

patterns.name: 日本地名／机构名中的「Saitama」子词片段
patterns.trigger: «S»、«ait»、«ama»，组成“Saitama”；并见«J»等后续机构名片段
patterns.context: 专名在英文文本中以子词切分出现，尤其是日本地名、大学、医学中心或研究机构名称；最突出的共同触发是“Saitama”
patterns.domain: 医学论文与学术方法、机构署名；[1]另有地名专名

patterns.name: 被切分的专名与罕见人名／地名
patterns.context: 英文叙述或列表中出现外国人名、地名、王朝名、作品／角色名等，子词切分和罕见拼写可能是触发条件；不局限于单一语言或实体类别
patterns.domain: 百科全书、历史、艺术、地理、人物名单

patterns.name: 列表及标点格式
patterns.context: 名字以逐行条目或带引号的署名格式排列时也有激活，但这些格式与专名片段同时出现，无法确认是独立触发
patterns.domain: 论文作者列表、选举或议席名单

en.description: Activations often fall on segmented proper-name fragments, especially place names, as well as institutions, companies, work titles, and forms of address for people in scripture. They span multiple genres, with no stable syntactic or semantic trigger condition evident.

patterns.name: Place/name fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations fall within segmented proper names, especially place names; names may denote cities, regions, or route origins.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, route descriptions, medical abstracts, etc.

patterns.name: Organization or company names in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations fall within proper names of institutions, companies, or manufacturers, usually at the beginning or within the name.

patterns.name: Word fragments in work titles
patterns.context: Activations occur on word fragments in classical music titles, including German titles and work names.

patterns.name: Forms of address in Bhagavad Gita religious passages
patterns.context: Occurs in direct quotations as a form of address to Arjuna, alongside religious contexts involving devotion, refuge, and eternal peace.

patterns.name: Final syllable of a place name
patterns.context: Activations cluster on an initial fragment of Srinagar; the place name appears in descriptions of a film plot and of a plant-growth study location.

10_1619.description: 激活多落在拆分标记的专名片段，尤以地名为主，也涉及机构、公司、作品标题及经文中的人名称谓；跨越多种文体，未见稳定的句法或语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 专名中的地名/名称片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标记的专名内部，尤其是地名；名称可能是城市、地区或路线起点。
patterns.domain: 百科、路线说明、医学摘要等

patterns.name: 专名中的组织或公司名称
patterns.context: 激活落在机构、公司或制造商专名内部，通常是名称的开头或内部词段。
patterns.domain: 百科、企业介绍、专利背景

patterns.name: 作品标题中的词段
patterns.context: 激活出现在古典音乐作品标题中的词段，包含德语标题及作品名。

patterns.name: 《薄伽梵歌》宗教语句中的称谓
patterns.context: 出现在直接引语中，作为对阿周那的称呼，与虔信、避难、永恒平安等宗教语境并列。

patterns.name: 地名的末尾音节
patterns.context: 激活集中于 Srinagar 的词首片段；该地名分别用于影视剧情和植物生长研究的地点描述。

en.concept: Proper-name internal fragments and legal boilerplate
en.description: Most passages activate on internal fragments of multisyllabic proper names or place names, often in name lists; a distinct pattern also appears in legal judgment boilerplate. A few personal names, religious words, and ordinary word fragments do not fit a unified explanation; evidence from 6 passages is insufficient.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of place names and proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on word-internal fragments of proper names or place names, especially multisyllabic, non-English spellings or names split by tokenization; some triggering fragments also occur in ordinary words.
patterns.domain: Locations, personal names, and institution names in encyclopedias, news, academic, and other texts

patterns.name: Lists of place names and administrative descriptions
patterns.context: Multiple place names are listed consecutively, often alongside subdivision, ports, ships, voyages, and other geography or transport descriptions; highlighted name stems can also occur in the same passage.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia geography entries, historical or travel narratives

patterns.name: Syllabic fragments of Indian names or South Asian place names
patterns.context: Highlights often cover internal syllables of South Asian personal names and place names; however, similar fragments also occur in non-South Asian names, so they cannot be geographically restricted.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies and place-name entries, academic author information

patterns.name: Partha in Romanized Sanskrit or religious quotations
patterns.context: Appears as a form of address in quotations of religious teachings; the same highlighted stem also occurs in words such as Parallel and Parma in other contexts.

patterns.name: Legal quotations and judgment wording
patterns.context: Highlights cluster in legal boilerplate about judgments, rulings, and their reversal; the same passage also contains many case citations.

patterns.name: Infrequent proper names/personal names outside place names
patterns.context: Highlights occur in proper names such as author names, personal names, churches, or titles, without a unified meaning for the triggering fragments; they may reflect subword patterns within proper names.
patterns.domain: Paper author lists, encyclopedia biographies and architecture entries, religious texts

10_1619.concept: 专名内部片段与法律程式语
10_1619.description: 多数段落在多音节专名或地名的内部片段上激活，常见于名称罗列；另有法律判决程式语句的明显模式。少数姓名、宗教词及普通词片段无法统一解释，6段证据不足。

patterns.name: 地名及专名内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或地名的词内片段，尤其是多音节、非英语拼写或被分词切开的名称；有些触发片段也出现在普通词中。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、学术及其他文本中的地点、人名、机构名

patterns.name: 地名罗列及行政区描述
patterns.context: 多个地名连续列举，常与 subdivision、ports、ships、voyages 等地理或交通描述同现；在同一段内亦可出现高亮的名称词干。
patterns.domain: 百科地理条目、历史或旅行叙述

patterns.name: 印度姓名或南亚地名的音节片段
patterns.context: 高亮常覆盖南亚姓名、地名的内部音节；但相似片段也出现在非南亚名称中，不能据此限定地域。
patterns.domain: 百科人物与地名条目、学术作者信息

patterns.name: 罗马化梵文或宗教引文中的 Partha
patterns.context: 在宗教教义引文中作为称呼出现；同一高亮词干也出现在其他语境的 Parallel、Parma 等词中。

patterns.name: 法律引文与判决措辞
patterns.context: 高亮集中于判决、裁决及其撤销的法律程式化措辞；同段还含大量判例引用。
patterns.domain: 美国法律意见或判决文本

patterns.name: 地名之外的低频专名/姓名
patterns.context: 高亮出现在作者姓名、人物名、教堂或称谓等专名中，触发片段不构成统一词义；可能反映专名内部的子词模式。
patterns.domain: 论文作者列表、百科人物与建筑条目、宗教文本

en.description: Strong responses occur mainly to subword fragments within proper names, including «rin», «Mar», «Par», «ant», and several place-name fragments; there are also activations on judgment and judgment-disposition phrasing in legal contexts. Proper-name triggers occur across domains, with no unified theme.

patterns.name: Srinagar place name
patterns.context: When the place name Srinagar is split by tokenization, activations concentrate on internal subword fragments, especially «rin».
patterns.domain: Wikipedia narrative; Srinagar Garhwal also occurs in an agricultural research abstract

patterns.name: Marseille place name
patterns.context: The city name Marseille is split into multiple subwords, with «Mar» activating most strongly.

patterns.name: Parma place name
patterns.context: The initial subword of the place name Parma triggers; the context is a list of travel destinations for a person.

patterns.name: Judgment in court opinions
patterns.context: In court opinions or judgment narratives, especially phrasing explaining that a judgment was reversed, modified, or affirmed; the same passage also contains conclusive legal wording.

patterns.name: Srinagar Garhwal place name
patterns.context: The full place name Srinagar Garhwal is split into subwords; «rin» activates prominently.

patterns.name: Srinivasan personal name
patterns.context: When the personal name Srinivasan is split, «rin» activates; nearby text describes roles and volunteer service.

patterns.name: Santos football team name
patterns.context: The football team name Santos appears in a list of teams a player played for and years; «ant» activates.

patterns.name: Mitani mountain-trail place name
patterns.context: Appears in route descriptions as the starting point or name of a hiking route.

patterns.name: Ichikawa mountain-trail place name
patterns.context: Appears alongside Seka in a route description as a hiking-route location name.

patterns.name: Iwazashin mountain-trail place name
patterns.context: A route or place name appearing alongside Mitani route, split into multiple subwords.

10_1619.description: 主要对专名中包含的子词片段 «rin»、«Mar»、«Par»、«ant» 及若干地名片段强烈响应；另对法律判决语境中 judgment 及判决处置句式有激活。专名触发跨领域出现，未见统一主题。

patterns.name: Srinagar 地名
patterns.context: 地名 Srinagar 被分词切开时，激活集中在其内部子词片段，尤以 «rin» 最强。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 叙事；另见农业研究摘要中的 Srinagar Garhwal

patterns.name: Marseille 地名
patterns.context: 城市名 Marseille 被切分为多个子词，«Mar» 激活最强。

patterns.name: Parma 地名
patterns.context: 地名 Parma 的开头子词触发；上下文是人物旅行地点列表。

patterns.name: 判决书中的 judgment

en.concept: Proper-name fragments and miscellaneous text features
en.description: Activations often fall on split fragments of proper names such as place names, personal names, and institutions, especially Srinagar, Parma, and Italian-related names; there are also whole-sentence activations in scripture-like religious passages and a few ordinary-word activations, with several examples remaining difficult to explain.

patterns.name: Srinagar place-name fragments
patterns.context: The place name Srinagar is split into multiple subword fragments; it appears in character narratives and descriptions of research locations.

patterns.name: Parma place-name fragments
patterns.context: Parma is split into a Par-initial fragment followed by fragments forming a place name or football club name.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia narratives, institutional addresses, football categories

patterns.name: Italian/European place and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Proper names are split into subword fragments, often in place names, personal names, and addresses.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, academic addresses, institutional copyright lines

patterns.name: Indian place, institution, and personal-name fragments
patterns.context: India-related proper names are split into fragments in descriptions of locations, educational institutions, and film/television figures.

patterns.name: Religious scripture-style exhortation
patterns.context: Consecutive activations of complete words in a sentence composed of invocation, admonition, and a profession of faith.

patterns.name: Historical personal-name and dynastic place-name fragments
patterns.context: Historical figures, rulers, and ethnic group proper names are split into fragments; the surrounding narrative concerns imprisonment and historical sources.

patterns.name: Italian football category entries
patterns.context: Category directories contain many proper names, including club names and player and manager categories.

patterns.name: High-frequency function words and ordinary-word activations
patterns.context: Occasional ordinary words interspersed among proper names or sentences also activate, but no unified semantic condition explains them.

en.concept: Proper names and internal word fragments
en.description: The strongest and most recurrent trigger is the Par fragment inside names or words, with varied capitalization and continuations. Activations also occur on fragments of proper names such as Mar, Srinagar, Peruvian, Star, and Macerata. These commonly occur in place names, personal names, institution names, and terminology, but span multiple genres with no single semantic condition evident.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments beginning with Par
patterns.context: Par begins a name or word, and subsequent letters are not necessarily in the same token; occurs in place names, personal names, proper nouns, and within common words. Diverse continuations suggest that the trigger is more likely the Par fragment than any complete entity.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; encyclopedia entries, travel writing, religious texts

patterns.name: Parma/Parma-related strings
patterns.context: Par is followed by ma to form Parma; respectively, the name of an Italian football club and an Italian city, with surrounding place names or historical narrative.

patterns.name: Par fragments in common words
patterns.context: Capitalization varies; embedded in the names of the adventure activity paragliding and the religious terms Parameṣṭhi and Partha. These are not the same complete word or entity.

patterns.name: Par-initial place name in an Italian address
patterns.context: The Par-initial place name Parco Aquilone appears in a copyright address, surrounded by Italian institutional and address information.

patterns.name: Name fragments beginning with Mar
patterns.context: Mar is followed by different letters to form Marinos and Marziani; both occur near personal or family names in historical narratives.

patterns.name: Srinagar place-name fragment
patterns.context: Activations cluster on an internal fragment of the proper name Srinagar, in a plot narrative about a character going there for work.

patterns.name: Peru-related name fragments
patterns.context: The name fragment in Peruvian / Peruvian Airlines occurs in a route description about flying to Lima and then transferring to a domestic flight.

patterns.name: Star-initial name fragment
patterns.context: Star occurs in the airline name Star Peru, next to a flight-route description.

patterns.name: Mac-initial name fragment
patterns.context: Forms the place name Macerata in a travel entry in a chapter heading.

10_1619.description: 最强且反复的触发是名称或词语内部的 Par 片段，大小写与续接形式多变；此外还对 Mar、Srinagar、Peruvian、Star、Macerata 等专名片段激活。整体常见于地名、人名、机构名和术语，但跨多种文体，未见单一语义条件。

en.description: Activations often fall on tokenized proper-name fragments, especially Par- and Mar-initial forms, as well as personal names, place names, institution names, and addresses; abbreviations, list fragments, and ordinary words in a religious passage also occur, so the pattern cannot be reduced to a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: “Par” initial fragment
patterns.context: Triggers at the beginning of proper names or place names, followed by varying spellings: Parma, Parthians, Parma, Parthibanur, and others; no specific complete word is required.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia place names, personal names, historical narratives, and category lists; also religious texts

patterns.name: Mar-initial fragment

patterns.name: Indian place names and administrative-name strings

patterns.domain: Geographical proper names and address lists

patterns.name: Latin-letter tokenization and subword boundaries
patterns.context: Letters or syllabic fragments split by the tokenizer in abbreviations and names activate; surrounding text includes list punctuation, line breaks, or quotation marks.

patterns.name: Word fragments in Sanskrit religious sentences
patterns.context: Multiple ordinary words and token fragments activate in scripture-like English sentences; this pattern does not fully match the proper-name fragments in other passages.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments in football entries
patterns.context: Some proper-name fragments activate in team, city, and club category names; Parma overlaps with the “Par”-initial pattern.

patterns.name: Fragments of Indian institution names
patterns.context: Institution names and fragments activate in entries about Indian educational collaborations; includes the especially prominent «Mar» fragment in passage 9.

10_1619.description: 激活常落在被分词的专名片段，尤其 Par、Mar 开头，以及人名、地名、机构名和地址；也见缩写、列表碎片及一段宗教经文中的普通词，无法归为单一语义主题。

en.concept: Proper names and their tokenized fragments
en.description: Activations mainly fall on proper names and their tokenized fragments: Srinagar/Srinivasan, Parma/Partha, and Mar-initial names; there are also scattered fragments in football categories, opera names, religious verses, and a few other words, with no unified trigger.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in names such as Srinagar/Srinivasan
patterns.context: When personal or place names are split into multiple subwords, especially Srinagar (the Kashmir city), Srinagar Garhwal, or Srinivasan, activations concentrate on the subword «rin».

patterns.name: Subwords in Parma-related words

patterns.name: Mar-initial place and personal names

patterns.name: Italian football category terms
patterns.context: Multiple subwords activate in football club and player/coach category names.

patterns.name: Opera character and composer fragments

patterns.name: Subwords in religious prayer
patterns.context: Internal subwords of multiple words activate in Bhagavad Gita-style verses; they have no obvious shared meaning with adjacent words.

patterns.name: Scattered word subwords
patterns.context: Occurs in a narrative about ships clearing wreckage and tugboats; no relationship to the other patterns is apparent so far.

patterns.name: Scattered word-final fragments
patterns.context: Occur separately in category text and the word steered; there is insufficient context to support a more specific explanation.

patterns.context: The complete place name Srinagar appears in descriptions of locations, personal narratives, or academic abstracts; activation concentrates on an internal subword fragment.

patterns.name: Parma initial fragment
patterns.context: Parma or a Par-initial word appears in Italian itineraries, football categories, or adventure activity lists; only the initial fragment is marked.

patterns.name: Jainism religious term
patterns.context: A Jainism passage describes the duties of Jains and includes transliterated Sanskrit terms.

patterns.name: Italian football terms
patterns.context: Italian club names and calcio appear in team and player category entries.

patterns.name: Marwar historical proper name
patterns.context: Marwar recurs in a narrative about Indian princes, generals, and their relations with Mughal rule.

patterns.name: Santa Casa pilgrimage heading
patterns.context: A chapter heading mentions Santa Casa and pilgrims together.

patterns.name: Srinivasan in a name
patterns.context: Srinivasan appears in the name of a staff member at an Indian social-service camp.

10_1619.description: 激活反复落在专名或词首子词片段上：Srinagar、Parma/Par-最突出；另见 Srinivasan、Jainism、意大利球队词、Marwar、Santa Casa 与 pilgrims。语境横跨地理、历史、宗教、足球、旅行，未见统一语义或文体。

patterns.name: Srinagar 地名
patterns.context: 完整地名 Srinagar 出现在地点介绍、人物叙述或学术摘要中；激活集中在词内子词片段

patterns.name: Parma 词首片段
patterns.context: Parma 或以 Par 开头的词出现在意大利行程、足球分类或冒险活动列表中；只标记词首片段

patterns.name: Jainism 宗教术语
patterns.context: Jainism 段落介绍耆那教徒的职责，并伴随梵语转写术语

patterns.name: 意大利语足球名词
patterns.context: 球队和球员分类条目中出现意大利俱乐部名称及 calcio

patterns.name: Marwar 历史专名
patterns.context: 叙述印度王公、将领与莫卧儿统治关系，Marwar 反复出现

patterns.name: Santa Casa 朝圣标题
patterns.context: 章节标题并列提及 Santa Casa 与朝圣者

patterns.name: 名字中的 Srinivasan
patterns.context: 印度社会服务营的工作人员姓名中出现 Srinivasan
patterns.domain: 百科人物或社会服务叙述

en.description: Activations often occur on segmented fragments of Wikipedia proper names, especially Indian history and geography, religious terms, and Italian place names. They also appear in European personal names, ports, and other scattered proper names, with no stable unified semantic or orthographic condition evident.

patterns.name: Indian historical/geographical name Parma
patterns.context: In Italian city/football-club names or Indian historical place names, names are segmented, with initial fragments such as Par/Mar prominent; the exact activation position varies.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia: Italian artist biographies, football categories, Indian history

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments such as Mahabharata
patterns.context: Fragments such as Mah and Mar occur in proper names, including epic titles, personal names/titles, or opera characters; activations often fall on a non-initial token in the name.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia: Indian epics, opera, and biography entries

patterns.name: Shravana and religious terms
patterns.context: In Hindu or Jain religious texts, Sh-initial terms are segmented into multiple subwords; the surrounding text describes epics, duties, or rituals.

patterns.name: European place and port names
patterns.context: Segmented fragments of European personal names, place names, or port names; apart from Mar- fragments, trigger forms are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia: opera characters, harbors, and ship activities

patterns.name: Scattered segmented proper names
patterns.context: Local fragments activate when historical figures, cities, or institutions are segmented into multiple subwords; these examples lack a stable shared spelling or context.
patterns.domain: HackerNews historical quotations, film plots, Indian place names, and education entries

10_1619.description: 激活多见于 Wikipedia 专名的分词片段，尤其印度史地、宗教词与意大利地名；也出现在欧洲人名、港口及其他零散专名中，未见稳定统一的语义或词形条件。

patterns.name: 印度史地名 Parma
patterns.context: 在意大利城市/足球俱乐部名称或印度历史地名中，名称被分词拆开，突出词首 Par/Mar 一类片段；具体激活位置不完全一致。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia：意大利艺术家传记、足球分类、印度历史

patterns.name: Mahabharata 等专名片段
patterns.context: 在专名中出现 Mah、Mar 等分词片段；包括史诗名称、人物/头衔或歌剧角色，激活常落在名称的非首个 token。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia：印度史诗、歌剧与人物条目

patterns.name: Shravana 及宗教术语
patterns.context: 印度教或耆那教宗教文本中，Sh- 开头术语被拆分成多个子词；周围有史诗、义务或仪式描述。

patterns.name: 欧洲地名与港口名
patterns.context: 欧洲人名、地名或港口专名的分词片段；除 Mar- 片段外，触发形式并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia：歌剧人物、海港与舰船活动

patterns.name: 零散专名分词
patterns.context: 历史人物、城市或机构名称被拆分成多个子词时，局部片段激活；这些例子之间缺少稳定的共同词形或语境。
patterns.domain: HackerNews历史引文、影视剧情、印度地名与教育条目

en.description: Activation cues are scattered: prominent occurrences of the strings Cor/cor and newline markers, alongside various numbers, subword fragments, and formatting symbols. These triggers are interleaved across corpora, with no reliable unified semantics.

patterns.name: Cor/cor strings
patterns.context: Case-insensitive Cor prefix appearing inside words or in field names; subsequent characters vary.
patterns.domain: PubMed author affiliations, corporate email signatures, StackExchange configuration text

patterns.name: ↵ newline marker
patterns.context: The newline marker itself repeatedly activates, often between questions, list items, or paragraphs.
patterns.domain: Math problems, email, HackerNews text, and formatted content

patterns.name: Numbers or numeric fragments
patterns.context: Number strings or numeric substrings, with no stable numerical semantics; especially dense in math problems.
patterns.domain: Math problems and other mixed text

patterns.name: Sporadic word fragments and delimiters
patterns.context: Word fragments at token boundaries, along with punctuation or formatting fragments; no consistent semantics across passages.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, web, patent, and other corpora

10_1661.description: 激活线索分散：突出出现 Cor/cor 字符串及换行标记，另有多种数字、词片段和格式符号；这些触发在不同语料中交错，尚无可靠统一语义。

patterns.name: Cor／cor 字符串
patterns.context: 大小写不敏感的 Cor 前缀，出现在单词内部或字段名中；后续字符各异。
patterns.domain: PubMed署名、企业邮件签名、StackExchange配置文本

patterns.name: ↵ 换行标记
patterns.context: 换行标记本身反复激活，常处于题目、列表或段落之间。
patterns.domain: 数学题、邮件、HackerNews文本及格式化内容

patterns.name: 数字或数字片段
patterns.context: 数字串或数字子串，未见稳定的数值语义；数学题中尤为密集。
patterns.domain: 数学题及其他混合文本

patterns.name: 零散词片段及分隔符
patterns.trigger: «LR»、« receptor»、« complex»、«ded»、«u»、« overlay»、« AGE»、« nec»、« Field»、« anthrop»
patterns.context: 分词边界上的词片段，以及标点或格式片段；跨段缺乏一致语义。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、网页文本、专利及其他语料

en.description: Activations are distributed across different corpora. The more stable surface cue is the «Cor» fragment within words; newline and number fragments also activate in math problems. Other trigger words are scattered across web, biomedical, patent, and configuration text, with no shared context.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments beginning with Cor-
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs at the beginning of English words that respectively refer to a corresponding author, an institution name, a surname, and a technical field; there is no unified semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Biomedical author affiliations, business email, ergonomics citations, software configuration

patterns.name: Number and math-problem formatting
patterns.context: Occurs near line breaks in arithmetic exercises, problems, and answers; activations fall on line breaks, number fragments, or numeric formats, with no consistent operator or number category evident.

patterns.name: Specific word fragments and technical terms
patterns.context: Falls within words or fragments such as zded, PBMCs, necrotic, polishing, and anthropometries; no shared local syntactic or semantic condition is evident across occurrences.
patterns.domain: Web headlines, biomedical abstracts and papers, patents, ergonomics text

patterns.name: Other sporadic markers
patterns.context: Occurs in number problems, problem instructions, and JSON/configuration fields; these sporadic trigger points do not establish a shared condition.

10_1661.description: 激活分散于不同语料。较稳定的表面线索是词内 «Cor» 片段；数学题中也出现换行与数字片段激活。其余触发词分散在网页、生医、专利及配置文本，缺乏共同上下文。

patterns.name: Cor- 开头的词内部片段
patterns.context: 触发片段处于英文单词开头；词分别表示通讯作者、机构名称、姓氏和技术字段，没有统一语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学署名、商务邮件、人体工程学引文、软件配置

patterns.name: 数字及数学题排版
patterns.trigger: 换行标记 «↵»3，以及数字或算术文本中的 «778»、«119»、«40» 等
patterns.context: 出现在分行的算术练习、题目和答案附近；其中激活落在换行、数字片段或数值格式内部，未显现统一的运算符或数值类别。

patterns.name: 特定词片段与技术术语
patterns.context: 分别落在 zded、PBMCs、necrotic、polishing、anthropometries 等词或词片段中；各处未显示共同的局部句法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、生物医学摘要与论文、专利、人体工程学文本

patterns.name: 其他零散标记
patterns.context: 分别出现在数字题目、题目指令和 JSON/配置字段中；无法从这些零散触发点确立共享条件。

en.description: Activations are distributed across newline markers, numbers and equation fragments in math problems, and terms and citation markers in biomedical text; forum headline fragments also occur. There is no single stable semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Newline markers
patterns.context: Indicates a text line break and appears in places such as headlines, math problems, or the start of abstract paragraphs; it does not depend on specific semantic content.

patterns.name: Numbers and equations in math problems
patterns.context: Numbers, punctuation, and equation fragments occur densely, often in math questions and answers or calculation steps listed one by one; activations fall on several number fragments.

patterns.name: Number fragments in numeric sequences
patterns.context: Short numbers or alphanumeric fragments after tokenization; some occur near headlines or links without obvious arithmetic semantics, while others are embedded in numbers in math problems.
patterns.domain: Forum headlines, math text, and general text

patterns.name: Biomedical term fragments
patterns.context: In medical or biological abstracts, activations occur on terms, abbreviations, or substrings within words; meanings and topics differ across paragraphs.

patterns.name: Citation numbers and reference markers
patterns.context: Embedded reference numbers, citation labels, or reference locators in paper text.

patterns.name: Short function words and symbol fragments
patterns.context: Occasionally activates in medical abstracts or math text, without a stable lexical meaning or unified syntactic condition.

patterns.name: HackerNews headline and link fragments
patterns.context: In short headlines and the following link strings, activations fall on headline words, alphanumeric fragments, and newline markers; a more specific trigger condition cannot be determined from a single passage.

patterns.name: Protein receptor-related terms
patterns.context: In abstracts discussing receptor domains, ligand sensing, and complex formation, activations sporadically fall on terms and fragments of author names.

patterns.name: Phospholipid and nuclear magnetic resonance terms
patterns.context: In sentences describing phospholipid vesicles, choline headgroups, and nuclear magnetic resonance spectra, activations occur on substrings of chemical terms.

10_1661.concept: 文本片段边界与局部模式
10_1661.description: 激活分布在换行标记、数学题的数字与算式片段，以及生物医学文本中的术语和引用标记；另见论坛标题碎片。没有单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 换行标记
patterns.context: 表示文本换行，在标题、数学题目或摘要段落开头等位置出现；不依赖特定语义内容。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与算式
patterns.context: 数字、标点和算式片段密集出现，常处于逐题列出的数学问答或计算过程；激活落在若干数字片段上。

patterns.name: 数值序列中的数字片段
patterns.context: token 切分后的短数字或字母数字片段；部分位于无明显算术语义的标题、链接附近，部分嵌在数学题的数字中。
patterns.domain: 论坛标题、数学文本及一般文本

patterns.name: 生物医学术语片段
patterns.context: 医学或生物学摘要中，激活出现在术语、缩写或词内子串上；不同段落中的词义和主题不完全相同。

patterns.name: 引用编号与参考文献标记
patterns.context: 论文正文中嵌入的文献编号、引用标签或参考文献定位符。

patterns.name: 短促功能词和符号片段
patterns.context: 在医学摘要或数学文字中偶发激活，未呈现稳定的词义或统一句法条件。

patterns.name: HackerNews 标题与链接碎片
patterns.context: 短标题及其后续链接字符串中，激活落在标题词、字母数字碎片和换行标记上；无法从单段确定更具体的触发条件。

patterns.name: 蛋白受体相关术语
patterns.context: 讨论受体结构域、配体感知和复合物形成的摘要文字中，激活零散落在术语及作者姓名片段上。

patterns.name: 磷脂与核磁共振术语
patterns.context: 描述磷脂囊泡、胆碱头基和核磁共振谱的句子中，激活出现在化学术语的子串上。

en.description: Activation is scattered across medical terminology, concern, mathematical symbols, heading typography, and several intra-word fragments. Newlines and formatting markers also occur repeatedly, but the triggering conditions are unstable and cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Local fragments at word endings or in markers
patterns.context: Highlights appear within words or at word boundaries, possibly related to subword segmentation or spelling fragments; these examples are insufficient to establish a unified lexical condition

patterns.name: Medical terminology and specialist abbreviations
patterns.context: Occurs in medical papers or case descriptions involving diseases, blood vessels, treatments, or medical abbreviations; the specific marked fragments vary

patterns.name: concern and its discourse context
patterns.context: Occurs in formal discussion, expressing concern about research or public health issues; “major” appears nearby in both instances, but several words apart

patterns.name: Numerical values and operation structures in math problems
patterns.context: Occurs in algebra problems asking for a ones digit and in subsequent problems; no stable, distinctive mathematical trigger substring is evident

patterns.name: Patient story heading layout
patterns.context: Webpage headings and section text are separated by newlines, with descriptions of patients and family members; activation also falls on headings or layout fragments

patterns.name: Word fragments in anti-Islamophobia discourse
patterns.context: Occurs in quotations or comments on the claim that “fearing Islam is reasonable”; there is no evidence that the topic itself is a stable trigger condition

patterns.name: Paragraph and section formatting markers
patterns.context: Appears at paragraph starts, blank lines, or section separators; may co-occur with medical introductions or math Q&A content, so it does not establish an independent pattern

10_1661.description: 激活分散在医学术语、concern、数学符号、标题排版及若干词内片段；换行和格式标记也多次出现，但触发条件不稳定，无法用单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 词尾或标记中的局部片段
patterns.context: 高亮呈现在词内或词边界，可能与子词切分、拼写片段有关；这些实例不足以确认统一词法条件
patterns.domain: 网页文本、姓名、一般英文

patterns.name: 医学术语与专业缩写
patterns.context: 出现在医学论文或病例描述中，涉及疾病、血管、治疗或医学缩写；其中被标记的具体片段并不一致

patterns.name: concern 及其论述语境
patterns.context: 位于正式论述中，表达研究或公共卫生议题的关注；两处附近都出现「major」，但中间相隔多词

patterns.name: 数学题中的数值与运算结构
patterns.context: 出现在要求求个位数的代数题及其后续题目中；未见稳定、专属的数学触发子串

patterns.name: 患者故事标题排版
patterns.context: 网页标题与栏目文字由换行分隔，夹杂患者、家属相关介绍；激活也落在标题或排版片段上

patterns.name: 反伊斯兰恐惧论述中的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在对“害怕伊斯兰是合理的”这一主张的引述或评论中；暂无证据表明该主题本身是稳定触发条件

patterns.name: 段落与章节格式标记
patterns.context: 作为段落开头、空行或章节分隔符出现；可与医学引言或数学问答内容同时出现，不能据此确认独立模式

en.description: Activations are scattered across word-initial and word-internal fragments, alphanumeric abbreviations and adjacent tokens; they also commonly occur in hyphenated compounds and at newline layout boundaries. The examples lack a stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Word-initial or word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on the beginning or first few subword fragments of complete words, which then continue into multisyllabic words; meanings and syntax are not fixed.

patterns.name: Abbreviations and alphanumeric strings
patterns.context: Letters, numbers, punctuation, and subword fragments occur adjacent to one another in code identifiers, legal citations, or technical abbreviations.

patterns.name: Common token continuations in phrases
patterns.context: Common words or phrases are split into multiple tokens, with activations distributed across within-word fragments and nearby tokens; there is no fixed semantic meaning or sentence structure.
patterns.domain: News-style copy, email, and general text

patterns.name: Newlines and layout boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur at line breaks between paragraphs, headlines, or page sections; sometimes they are adjacent to proper nouns or section content.

patterns.name: Hyphens within compounds
patterns.context: When a hyphen joins words or forms a term, fragments on either side of the hyphen may activate.
patterns.domain: Marketing copy, medical and immunology text

10_1661.description: 激活分散在词首/词内片段、字母数字缩写及其相邻 token，也常见于连字符复合词和换行版面边界；各例缺乏稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 词首或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整单词的开头或前几个子词片段，随后继续拼成多音节词；词义和句法并不固定。

patterns.name: 缩写与字母数字串
patterns.context: 代码标识符、法律引证或专业缩写中，字母、数字、标点及子词片段相邻。

patterns.name: 短语中的常见分词延续
patterns.context: 常见词或短语被拆成多个 token，激活分布在词内片段及其附近；并非固定语义或固定句式。
patterns.domain: 新闻式文案、邮件及一般文本

patterns.name: 换行与版面边界
patterns.context: 段落、标题或页面模块之间的换行处激活；有时紧邻专名或栏目内容。

patterns.name: 复合词内部的连字符
patterns.context: 连字符连接词语或构成术语时，连字符两侧的片段均可能激活。
patterns.domain: 营销文案、医学及免疫学文本

en.description: Activation is scattered across mathematical symbols and numbers, medical and notification text, code and JSON fields, character configurations, and commentary on social issues. Apart from local word forms or formatting, there is no stable cross-passage trigger condition.

patterns.name: Logical symbols after “neg”
patterns.context: In formal logic or set-theory expressions, symbols occur within LaTeX mathematical notation or its transcription; they are sometimes adjacent to variables and parentheses.

patterns.name: Numbers and radicals in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Activation falls on expression tokens containing numbers, radical signs, and operators; no common specific formula structure is apparent.

patterns.name: Otorhinological terminology fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in the phrase “ear surgery,” in a sentence about ear surgery and Ménière’s disease; the trigger is limited to one word fragment.

patterns.name: Email subject or course notification field
patterns.context: Occurs in the “Harassment Avoidance” heading after a newline; the preceding text is a course registration notice.

patterns.name: JSON keys, values, and identifiers
patterns.context: In JSON-style objects, activation is distributed across keys, string values, and numbers; JSON record fields also trigger.

patterns.name: Go code import statement
patterns.context: Package declaration and import block in Go source code, containing a MongoDB driver path.

patterns.name: Game character configuration fields
patterns.context: JSON-style character data containing character descriptions, name suffixes, and category fields.

patterns.name: Controversial social issue vocabulary
patterns.context: In a comment on whether fear of Islam is reasonable, activation is distributed across issue-related and evaluative words.

10_1661.description: 激活分散在数学符号与数字、医学和通知文本、代码及JSON字段、角色配置和社会议题评论中；除局部词形或格式外，看不出跨段稳定的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: “neg”后的逻辑符号
patterns.context: 形式逻辑或集合论表达式中，符号处于 LaTeX 数学记号或其转写形式内；有时邻接变量和括号。

patterns.name: 数学式中的数字与根式
patterns.context: 激活落在含数字、根号和运算符的算式 token 上；没有明显共同的具体公式结构。

patterns.name: 耳科术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在“ear surgery”短语中，句子谈及耳科手术与梅尼埃病；触发仅限一个词片段。

patterns.name: 邮件标题或课程通知字段
patterns.context: 出现在换行后的“Harassment Avoidance”标题中，前文是课程注册通知。

patterns.name: JSON 键值与标识符
patterns.context: JSON 风格对象中，激活分布于键名、字符串值和数字；另有 JSON 记录字段触发。
patterns.domain: Github 数据文件/结构化文本

patterns.name: Go 代码导入语句
patterns.context: Go 源码的包声明与 import 块，含 MongoDB 驱动路径。

patterns.name: 游戏角色配置字段
patterns.context: JSON 风格角色数据中，包含角色说明、名称后缀和类别字段。
patterns.domain: Github 游戏/角色配置数据

patterns.name: 争议性社会议题词汇
patterns.context: 在表达对伊斯兰恐惧是否合理的评论句中，激活分布于议题词与评价性词语。

en.concept: Text structure boundaries, with a preference for newlines
en.description: The most prominent common feature across passages is newlines and layout boundaries. Activation occurs in mathematical text, code, legal documents, and email; formula structures, code statements, and document fields show weaker activation as well.

patterns.name: Newline after line endings or formula environments
patterns.context: Strong activation falls on newline tokens, often after mathematical typesetting, code, or document paragraph boundaries; the first passage also contains formatting cues such as «/»5.

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and LaTeX structures
patterns.context: Mathematical symbols, formula markers, LaTeX environments, and surrounding newlines; activation is also distributed across variables, punctuation, and structural tokens.

patterns.name: Code lines and statement boundaries
patterns.context: Near statements, indentation, and closing parentheses in code snippets, especially where code ends and ordinary text begins.

patterns.name: Legal document formatting and headers
patterns.context: Layout regions such as headings, dates, disclaimers, and signatures in court opinions.

patterns.name: Email headers and body layout
patterns.context: Email header fields, recipient information, or signature areas at the end of the body; strong activation is primarily on newlines.

10_1661.concept: 文本结构边界，偏好换行
10_1661.description: 各段最突出的共同点是换行及版式边界；数学文本、代码、法律文书和邮件中均有激活，公式结构、代码语句与文档字段也出现较弱激活。

patterns.name: 行尾或公式环境后的换行
patterns.context: 显著激活落在换行 token 上，常出现在数学排版、代码或文档段落边界之后；第1段还有「«/»5」等格式线索。

patterns.name: 数学公式与 LaTeX 结构
patterns.context: 数学符号、公式标记、LaTeX 环境及其周边换行；激活也分布在变量、标点和结构 token 上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文、数学问答

patterns.name: 代码行与语句边界
patterns.context: 代码片段中的语句、缩进和闭合括号附近，尤其是代码结束后转入普通文字处。

patterns.name: 法律文档格式与页眉
patterns.context: 法院意见文本的标题、日期、免责声明和署名等版式区域。

patterns.name: 邮件头与邮件正文版式
patterns.context: 邮件头字段、收件人信息或正文末尾的签名区域，显著激活主要在换行。

en.description: All passages are code or code-adjacent text from technical Q&A. Activation is distributed around newlines and indentation, punctuation boundaries, identifiers, and property names. It spans frontend development, file handling, configuration, and multiple languages, with no single topic word or language dominating.

patterns.name: Code syntax and structural symbols
patterns.context: Activation occurs at newlines or indentation and punctuation boundaries in code snippets; it is not limited to one language, and some activation is adjacent to code tokens
patterns.domain: Multilingual code, configuration, and markup languages

patterns.name: Names and property boundaries in code
patterns.context: Near code identifiers, property names, or member-access expressions; often involving camelCase or compound names, but not a consistent specific name
patterns.domain: Source code in software development Q&A

patterns.name: JavaScript/React code and browser operations
patterns.context: Imports, UI components, browser detection, or scrolling code in frontend examples
patterns.domain: JavaScript, React, jQuery, and browser development

patterns.name: File, data, and serialization operations
patterns.context: Contexts where code reads, writes, iterates over, or processes files and data fields
patterns.domain: Node.js, PHP, Python, and data-processing code

patterns.name: Property, layout, and namespace configuration in code
patterns.context: Attributes or configuration key-value pairs describing component bindings, layout resources, or autoloading rules
patterns.domain: XAML/XML, Android, and PHP Composer configuration

patterns.name: Conditional logic and callback expressions
patterns.context: Near conditional branches, callbacks, or anonymous functions inside function bodies; reflects program control flow
patterns.domain: Example code in multiple programming languages

patterns.name: Natural-language comments/explanations in code examples
patterns.context: Comments or introductory explanations near code; specific content varies

patterns.name: Scattered HTML/template text
patterns.context: HTML fragments or template-rendering calls embedded in source code, including ordinary text fields

patterns.name: Python line-by-line file processing
patterns.context: Code that reads a text file and counts or compares values line by line

patterns.name: Idiomatic browser-detection expression
patterns.context: A JavaScript technique for browser identification using a function-string form

10_1661.description: 所有片段均为技术问答中的代码或代码邻近文本，激活分布在换行缩进、标点边界、标识符及属性名附近；涵盖前端、文件处理、配置和多种语言，未见单一主题词或语言主导。

patterns.name: 代码语法与结构符号
patterns.context: 在代码片段中，换行或缩进以及标点边界处激活；不局限于某一种语言，部分激活紧邻代码 token
patterns.domain: 多语言编程代码、配置与标记语言

patterns.name: 代码中的名称与属性边界
patterns.context: 代码标识符、属性名或成员访问表达式附近；常见于驼峰式或复合名称，但并非统一的具体名称
patterns.domain: 软件开发问答中的源代码

patterns.name: JavaScript/React 代码与浏览器操作
patterns.context: 前端示例中的导入、UI 组件、浏览器检测或滚动处理代码

patterns.name: 文件、数据与序列化操作
patterns.context: 代码读写、遍历或处理文件、数据字段的上下文

patterns.name: 代码中的属性、布局与命名空间配置
patterns.context: 以属性或配置键值描述组件绑定、布局资源或自动加载规则
patterns.domain: XAML/XML、Android 与 PHP Composer 配置

patterns.name: 条件判断与回调表达式
patterns.context: 函数体内条件分支、回调或匿名函数附近；呈现程序控制流程
patterns.domain: 多种编程语言的示例代码

patterns.name: 代码示例中的自然语言注释/说明
patterns.trigger: «//»、«now it is serial foreach loop»、«we are using latest version with closure on most recent data»、«Quick and easy browser sniff»
patterns.context: 代码附近的注释或引导说明；具体内容不相同

patterns.name: 散落的 HTML/模板文本
patterns.context: 源代码中嵌入的 HTML 片段或模板渲染调用，包含普通文本字段

patterns.name: Python 文件逐行处理
patterns.context: 读取文本文件并逐行统计、比较数值的代码

patterns.name: 特定浏览器检测惯用表达式
patterns.context: 通过函数字符串形式进行浏览器识别的 JavaScript 小技巧

en.description: Activation occurs primarily around indentation, newlines, and structural boundaries in code and markup languages, spanning JSX, HTML, Ruby, and PHP snippets. It also responds to medical table formatting, blank paragraphs in legal documents, and LaTeX mathematical definitions; no single specific word runs through all samples.

patterns.name: Structural markers in indented code
patterns.context: Located in code snippets, especially indented blocks, tags, or statement boundaries in JSX/HTML/Ruby and C-like syntax; activation is distributed across multiple tokens and is not limited to a particular identifier.

patterns.name: Table rows, columns, and numeric formatting
patterns.context: In medical statistical tables, column headings, categories, numbers, and percentages in parentheses are arranged in rows and columns.

patterns.name: Blank paragraphs in legal text
patterns.context: The legal document excerpt contains almost no visible body text, primarily paragraph spacing, newlines, and indentation; the excerpt does not establish whether more specific legal vocabulary triggers activation.

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and their formatting
patterns.context: Formula symbols, commands, and nearby text co-occur in a LaTeX mathematical explanation defining distance or a statistic in a paper.

10_1661.concept: 结构化文本排版与边界
10_1661.description: 主要激活于代码和标记语言中的缩进、换行及结构边界，覆盖 JSX、HTML、Ruby 与 PHP 等片段；另对医学表格排版、法律文书空白段落和 LaTeX 数学定义有响应，未见单一具体词汇贯穿全部样本。

patterns.name: 缩进代码中的结构标记
patterns.trigger: 换行、缩进空格以及代码结构边界，如 «↵»、«<»、«/>»、«}»、«case»、«return»、«</»
patterns.context: 位于代码片段中，尤其是 JSX/HTML/Ruby 等标记语言或类 C 语法的缩进块、标签或语句边界；激活分布于多种 token，并不局限于某一具体标识符。

patterns.name: 表格行列与数值排版
patterns.trigger: «Primary» «tumor» «sites» «(%)»、«Oral» «cavity» «53» «(» «36» «)»，以及对齐空白与百分比数值
patterns.context: 在医学统计表格中，列标题、分类项、数字和括号百分比呈现行列式排版。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的空白段落
patterns.trigger: «UST»以及反复出现的 «↵»、制表符和缩进空白
patterns.context: 法律文档片段几乎没有可见正文，主要是段落间距、换行和缩进；无法从截取内容判定是否有更具体的法律词汇触发。

patterns.name: 数学公式及其排版
patterns.context: 在论文对距离或统计量作定义的 LaTeX 数学说明中，公式符号、命令与其附近文本共同出现。

en.description: Activation samples are scattered across HTML, scientific prose, formulas, and code. Visible triggers include temporal or stage indicators, comparison operators, Boolean assignments, and field and error-handling syntax, with no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: HTML column layout markers
patterns.context: An HTML snippet defines a column container, nested div elements, and an icon span.

patterns.name: Temporal reference in academic text
patterns.context: Describes changes in tubal function at a point in time after surgery.

patterns.name: Evidence reference in a storm account
patterns.context: Explains a storm category adjustment based on observed wind speed and air pressure.

patterns.name: Patent step indicator
patterns.context: Describes a rivet structure and the process stage involving further application of tensile force.

patterns.name: Arbitrary time in mathematics
patterns.context: Defines the relationship between platelet uptake rates at two time points.

patterns.name: Greater-than comparison in code
patterns.context: Checks whether the number of request attachments is greater than zero; activation falls on and near the comparison operator.

patterns.name: Object Boolean property assignment
patterns.context: Sets the tree-node state properties of an object in succession.

patterns.name: Card metadata fields
patterns.context: Lists card information using field names and identifiers.

patterns.name: SQL query error handling
patterns.context: Outputs a database error and terminates the program when a query fails.

10_1661.description: 激活样本分散于HTML、科学叙述、公式与代码；可见触发点包括时间或阶段指示语、比较符、布尔赋值及字段和错误处理语法，未见统一的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: HTML 列布局标记
patterns.context: HTML 片段中定义列容器、嵌套 div 和图标 span。

patterns.name: 学术文本中的时间指示
patterns.context: 描述手术后某时间点的输卵管功能变化。

patterns.name: 风暴叙述中的依据指示
patterns.context: 根据观测到的风速和气压，说明风暴等级调整。

patterns.name: 专利步骤指示
patterns.context: 说明铆钉结构及进一步施加拉力时的过程阶段。

patterns.name: 数学中的任意时刻
patterns.context: 定义血小板摄取率在两个时间点上的关系。

patterns.name: 代码中的大于比较
patterns.context: 比较请求附件数量是否大于零；激活落在比较符及其附近。

patterns.name: 对象布尔属性赋值
patterns.context: 连续设置对象的树节点状态属性。

patterns.name: 卡片元数据字段
patterns.context: 以字段名和标识符列出卡片信息。

patterns.name: SQL 查询错误处理
patterns.context: 查询失败时输出数据库错误并终止程序。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on sentence-initial prepositional introductions: “On” in formal narratives and “To that end” in statements of purpose. Email time fields and mathematical numbered conditional statements also appear, all exhibiting formatted sentence-initial or field-introductory structures.

patterns.name: On in formal dates
patterns.context: A time/topic introduction at the beginning of a sentence or clause, followed by a date, referential phrase, or subject of discussion; often followed by a comma
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, court documents, and news biographies

patterns.name: Purpose introduction To that end
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or within one, states that an action, test, or study aims to achieve a previously mentioned goal
patterns.domain: Regulatory explanations and medical research text

patterns.name: Email date/time field
patterns.context: In the Sent field of an email header, weekday, date, year, and time are arranged in a formatted sequence

patterns.name: Numbered condition in formal logic
patterns.context: A numbered item states a mathematical proposition as a conditional, with symbols and variables
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers or formal mathematical text

10_1661.description: 激活主要落在句首介词引介语：正式叙事中的“On”及目的表述“To that end”；另见邮件时间字段和数学编号条件句，均呈现带格式的句首/字段引导结构。

patterns.name: 正式日期中的 On
patterns.trigger: «On» 后接月份、日期和年份，如 “On June 7, 2018” “On June 3 and June 12, 1968” “On this last date” “On this occasion” “On this point”
patterns.context: 句首或分句开头的时间/话题引介语，后接日期、指代性短语或论述对象；常与逗号相连
patterns.domain: 法律判决、法院文件及新闻传记

patterns.name: 目的引介语 To that end
patterns.context: 句首或句中说明某项行动、测试或研究旨在达成前文目标
patterns.domain: 法规说明与医学研究文本

patterns.name: 邮件日期时间字段
patterns.context: 邮件头的 Sent 字段中，星期、日期、年份与时间按格式排列

patterns.name: 形式逻辑中的编号条件
patterns.context: 编号条目以条件句陈述数学命题，含符号与变量
patterns.domain: 数学论文或形式化数学文本

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: triggers include date and numeric formats, English function words, technical error messages, patent filter vocabulary, medical timelines, table numbers, dental vocabulary, mathematical symbols, and fragments of proper nouns. No single content theme covers all fragments.

patterns.name: English date, time, and number markers
patterns.context: In date, time, or numeric expressions, numbers occur adjacent to months, units, or punctuation; also includes timestamps and measurements.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, medical papers, error logs

patterns.name: Articles and English function words
patterns.context: Articles, prepositions, conjunctions, and other high-frequency function words in ordinary English sentences; the contexts of trigger words vary widely.
patterns.domain: Patents, medical, dental, and technical text

patterns.name: Abnormality and connection in error messages
patterns.context: An error sentence reporting a failed request and closed underlying connection follows a structured timestamp.

patterns.name: Patent filter structure and contamination description
patterns.context: Conditional sentences describing a filter being removed from its housing and stored, as well as contamination caused by material adhering to an upstream surface.

patterns.name: Time intervals and clinical narratives in medicine
patterns.context: Minutes after allergy testing, or a medical history describing a patient whose symptoms began months earlier and who then sought care.
patterns.domain: PubMed clinical cases and medical papers

patterns.name: Numbers and psychological scale labels in tables
patterns.context: Highly formatted table rows dominated by numbers, decimals, and blank columns, interspersed with scale category labels.

patterns.name: Recurring vocabulary about crowns and cracked teeth
patterns.context: Discusses whether a cracked tooth can be repaired, whether to place a crown first, and issues arising after a crown covers a cracked tooth.

patterns.name: Variables and ordering relations in mathematical logic
patterns.context: Formal propositions express implications using set membership, logical OR, and inequalities.

patterns.name: String fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: A word-ending fragment in a band’s work title, with no shared semantic or grammatical condition evident across other passages.

10_1661.description: 激活模式分散：日期和数值格式、英文功能词、技术报错、专利滤器词汇、医学时间叙述、表格数字、牙科词汇、数学符号及专名片段均有触发；没有单一内容主题能覆盖全部片段。

patterns.name: 英文日期、时间和数字标记
patterns.context: 日期、时间或数值表达中，数字与月份、单位、标点相邻；也包括时间戳和测量值。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、医学论文、错误日志

patterns.name: 冠词与英语功能词
patterns.trigger: « a»、« the»、« and»、« but»、« to»、« for»
patterns.context: 普通英文句子中冠词、介词、连词等高频功能词；触发词所在语境差异很大。
patterns.domain: 专利、医学、牙科、技术文本

patterns.name: 错误信息中的异常与连接
patterns.context: 结构化时间戳之后出现请求失败、底层连接关闭的报错句。

patterns.name: 专利过滤器结构及污染描述
patterns.context: 描述滤器从壳体中取出、收纳，以及上游表面附着物造成污染的条件句。

patterns.name: 医学中的时间间隔与临床叙述
patterns.trigger: « 50»« minutes»、« after»、« patient»；« Six»« months»« ago»
patterns.context: 过敏测试后的分钟数，或患者数月前起病并就诊的病史叙述。
patterns.domain: PubMed 临床病例与医学论文

patterns.name: 表格中的数字与心理量表标签
patterns.context: 高度格式化的表格行，数字、小数和空白列占主导，夹有量表类别标签。

patterns.name: 牙冠与裂牙的重复词汇
patterns.context: 讨论裂牙是否能修复、是否应先做牙冠以及牙冠覆盖裂牙后的问题。

patterns.name: 数学逻辑中的变量与序关系
patterns.context: 形式化命题中以集合成员关系、逻辑或和不等式表达推论。

patterns.name: 专名中的字符串片段
patterns.context: 乐队作品名中的词尾片段，未见与其他段落共享的语义或语法条件。

en.description: Activation is scattered across domains: connective structures such as and, numbers and units, medical lesions and surgery, code identifiers, error/exception text, imaging and astronomical terminology, XML tags, and CORS fields. No single semantic pattern explains all samples.

patterns.name: English connective and
patterns.context: Activation falls on and itself or on adjacent phrases and punctuation; includes coordinated nouns, clauses, and connections in technical fields
patterns.domain: Patents, medical papers, code Q&A, error logs, astronomy

patterns.name: Word form of single
patterns.context: Occurs in “a single reference burst” and “a single carrier frequency,” with repeated single and a nearby

patterns.name: Numbers, percentages, and measurements
patterns.context: Quantified statements made up of values, parentheses, units, or percentages; activation also falls near several numbers

patterns.name: Medical surgery and lesion descriptions
patterns.context: Case or study results report fractures, masses, surgery, and pathological findings; activation is distributed across disease names, anatomical terms, and narrative connectives
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts and medical case reports

patterns.name: Program identifiers and code structure
patterns.context: Code snippets composed of classes, method names, calls, and braces; activation concentrates on identifiers and some syntax tokens

patterns.name: Error and exception text
patterns.context: Error messages describing request, connection, authorization, or loading failures; activation falls on error words and their context
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A and technical logs

patterns.name: Medical imaging and tumor status
patterns.context: Reports imaging results, lesion status, and subsequent treatment

patterns.name: Astronomical observation bands
patterns.context: Describes infrared observation resolution in conjunction with optical or CO images

patterns.name: XML/HTML style markers
patterns.context: Error messages are serialized in a tagged structure, with activation spanning the vicinity of closing tags

patterns.name: HTTP cross-origin request fields
patterns.context: Explains CORS response-header restrictions on localhost upload requests

10_1661.description: 激活分散于多领域：and 等连接结构、数值与单位、医学病灶及手术、代码标识符、错误/异常文本、影像和天文术语、XML 标签及 CORS 字段；未见能解释全部样本的单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 英语连接词 and
patterns.context: 激活落在 and 本身，或与 and 相邻的短语、标点上；包括并列名词、从句和技术字段中的连接
patterns.domain: 专利、医学论文、代码问答、错误日志、天文学

patterns.name: single 的词形
patterns.context: 出现在“a single reference burst”和“a single carrier frequency”中，附近有重复的 single 及 a

patterns.name: 数字、百分数与测量值
patterns.context: 数值、括号、单位或百分比组成的量化陈述；激活也落在若干数值附近
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、天文学、医学病例

patterns.name: 医学手术与病灶叙述
patterns.context: 病例或研究结果中报告骨折、肿块、手术及病理发现；激活分布于病名、解剖词和叙述连接词
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要与医学病例报告

patterns.name: 程序标识符及代码结构
patterns.context: 类、方法名、调用和花括号组成的代码片段；激活集中在标识符及部分语法 token

patterns.name: 错误与异常文本
patterns.context: 描述请求、连接、授权或加载失败的错误消息；激活落在错误词及其上下文中
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答与技术日志

patterns.name: 医学影像与肿瘤状态
patterns.context: 报告影像检查结果、病灶状态及后续治疗

patterns.name: 天文观测波段
patterns.context: 描述红外观测分辨率，并结合光学或 CO 图像

patterns.name: XML/HTML 样式标记
patterns.context: 错误信息被序列化在带标签的结构中，激活覆盖闭合标签附近

patterns.name: HTTP 跨域请求字段
patterns.context: 解释 localhost 上传请求的 CORS 响应头限制

en.concept: Medical lesion size and clinical narratives
en.description: Primarily responds to medical expressions where numbers are adjacent to cm, especially the size of masses or lesions; it also covers space-occupying lesions, imaging, surgery, and several medical specialty terms. “the same day” also appears across legal and public health text, indicating a minor temporal narrative pattern alongside domain-specific miscellany.

patterns.name: Mass size with units
patterns.context: In imaging or pathology descriptions, a size is adjacent to cm, often specifying the size of a mass, lesion, cystic lesion, or vascular mass.

patterns.name: Mass lesion terminology
patterns.context: Describes a space-occupying lesion or abnormal structure found in the body; often adjacent to a location, size, examination, or pathology result.

patterns.name: Lesion discovery and imaging narratives
patterns.context: Clinical narratives use examination results to report an internal injury or lesion, often introducing its location, nature, or size.

patterns.name: Same-day temporal expression
patterns.context: Uses “the same day” to connect a subsequent event when narrating event order or procedural progress.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, public health event narratives

patterns.name: Medical course and surgery/treatment terminology
patterns.context: Records a surgery, procedure, or treatment received by a patient; does not always co-occur with mass size.
patterns.domain: Medical cases, treatment outcomes, medical device patents

patterns.name: Criteria for in-stent thrombosis
patterns.context: Discusses the definition or angiographic diagnostic criteria for stent thrombosis; measurements in millimeters describe the positional relationship between the thrombus and stent.

patterns.name: Medical mass complication terminology
patterns.context: Reports postoperative complications, recurrence, and their management.

patterns.name: Legal proceedings and contract disputes
patterns.context: Describes litigation and arbitration proceedings in a contract dispute; has no clear semantic connection to the medical pattern.

patterns.name: Hotel incident investigation narrative
patterns.context: Describes post-event inquiries, a patient disclosing a previous hotel visit, and subsequent public health department actions.

patterns.name: Medication and clinical signs
patterns.context: Lists medications used to treat prior conditions in a case, or describes a pulsatile mass found on examination.

patterns.name: Spinal devices and puncture techniques
patterns.context: Introduces an intervertebral disc treatment device, surgical approach, or image-guided puncture procedure.

10_1661.concept: 医学病灶尺寸与临床叙述
10_1661.description: 主要响应医学文本中数字与cm相邻的尺寸表达，尤其是肿块或病灶大小；也覆盖占位、影像检查、手术治疗及若干医学专科术语。另有“the same day”跨法律和公共卫生文本出现，显示少量时间叙述模式及领域杂项。

patterns.name: 带单位的肿块尺寸
patterns.context: 影像或病理描述中，尺寸紧邻 cm，常用于说明肿块、病灶、囊性病变或血管包块的大小。
patterns.domain: 医学病例与影像、病理报告

patterns.name: 质量占位词
patterns.context: 描述身体内发现的占位或异常结构；常与部位、尺寸、检查或病理结果相邻。

patterns.name: 病灶发现与影像检查叙述
patterns.context: 临床叙述用检查结果报告体内损伤或病灶，常引出位置、性质或尺寸。

patterns.name: 同日时间表达
patterns.context: 在叙述事件先后或程序进展时，用“同一天”连接后续事件。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、公共卫生事件叙述

patterns.name: 医学病程与手术/治疗用语
patterns.context: 记录患者接受的手术、处置或治疗；并非总与肿块尺寸同时出现。
patterns.domain: 医学病例、治疗结果及医疗器械专利

patterns.name: 血管内支架血栓判据
patterns.context: 讨论支架血栓的定义或造影诊断条件，毫米数描述血栓与支架的位置关系。
patterns.domain: 心血管医学指南或病例讨论

patterns.name: 医学质量并发症术语
patterns.context: 报告术后并发症、复发及其处置。

patterns.name: 法律程序与合同争议
patterns.context: 合同纠纷中叙述诉讼与仲裁程序；与医学模式无明显语义联系。

patterns.name: 酒店事件调查叙述
patterns.context: 描述事后询问、患者透露曾到访酒店及公共卫生部门后续行动。

patterns.name: 药物与临床体征
patterns.context: 病例中列出既往疾病治疗药物，或描述体检发现的搏动性肿块。

patterns.name: 脊柱器械与穿刺技术
patterns.context: 介绍椎间盘治疗装置、手术途径或影像引导下的穿刺操作。

en.description: Activation is distributed across quantities and time expressions, body parts and injuries or medical procedures, legal proceedings and event sequences; it also includes football calls, galaxy accretion heating, and a breast cancer case. No single stable trigger word is evident.

patterns.name: Explicit quantities or timescales
patterns.context: Near numbers or quantity words, especially in descriptions of time intervals, case counts, scale, or size; trigger locations vary.
patterns.domain: News accounts, astrophysics, law, medicine, social science

patterns.name: Body parts and injury/medical procedures
patterns.context: When describing body parts, trauma, surgery, or medical examinations, often alongside specific actions, anatomical locations, or clinical outcomes.
patterns.domain: Legal findings, medical technology patents, medical abstracts and case reports

patterns.name: Legal proceedings and adjudication records
patterns.context: When legal documents describe litigation procedures, appellate review, or case records; activation sometimes falls on procedural terms or general legal language.

patterns.name: Football calls and scoring events
patterns.context: In football match reports, a referee’s decision, a disallowed goal, and a subsequent substitution form a sequence of events.

patterns.name: Matter accretion and heating during galaxy mergers
patterns.context: Describes gas entering a system during galaxy mergers and subsequent reheating.

patterns.name: Temporal sequence and dates in legal documents
patterns.context: Uses dates and intervals to establish the sequence of petitions, service, or other legal events.

patterns.name: Procedural actions and process verbs
patterns.context: Describes actions affecting an object, such as penetrating, invading, grabbing, or throwing; semantics and domains are not consistent.

patterns.name: Quantitative statistics and proportions
patterns.context: Reports case counts, proportions, or group sizes; numbers are often adjacent to statistical nouns or units.

patterns.name: Breast tumor case description
patterns.context: Describes breast cancer, refusal of biopsy, mastectomy, and characteristics of a mass in the specimen.

10_1661.description: 激活分布于数量和时间表达、身体部位及损伤或医疗操作、法律程序与事件顺序，也包括足球判罚、星系吸积加热和乳腺病例；未见单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 明确数量或时间尺度
patterns.context: 数字或数量词附近，尤其是时间间隔、病例数、规模或尺寸的叙述中；触发位置并不一致。
patterns.domain: 新闻叙述、天体物理、法律、医学、社会科学

patterns.name: 身体部位与损伤／医疗操作
patterns.context: 描述身体部位、创伤、手术或医学检查时，常伴随具体动作、解剖位置或临床结果。
patterns.domain: 法律事实陈述、专利医疗技术、医学摘要与病例报告

patterns.name: 法律程序与裁判记录
patterns.context: 法律文书叙述诉讼程序、上诉审查或案卷记录时；有时激活落在程序词或一般法律措辞上。

patterns.name: 足球比赛判罚与进球事件
patterns.context: 足球比赛报道中，裁判判罚、进球被判无效及后续换人构成连续事件。

patterns.name: 星系并合中的物质吸积与加热
patterns.context: 描述星系并合期间气体进入系统及随后的再加热过程。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的时间顺序与日期
patterns.context: 按日期和间隔交代请愿、送达或其他法律事件的先后顺序。

patterns.name: 程序动作与过程性动词
patterns.context: 描述穿透、侵犯、抓取或投掷等对对象产生影响的动作；语义和领域不统一。
patterns.domain: 医学／专利文本及法律事实叙述

patterns.name: 数量统计与比例报告
patterns.context: 报告病例数、比例或群体数量，数字常与统计性名词或单位相邻。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、社会科学研究

patterns.name: 乳腺肿瘤病例描述
patterns.context: 描述乳腺癌、拒绝活检、接受乳房切除及标本中的肿块特征。

en.description: Activations are distributed across temporal expressions (same day, later, short timescales, every six months), specific clinical measurements, and event details. Multiple passages emphasize intervals or event order, but isolated patterns also include size, limb restraint, and violent narratives.

patterns.name: On the same day
patterns.context: The temporal adverbial phrase “on the same day,” especially when recounting event timing at the beginning of a sentence; activation is strong near “same/day,” with variable capitalization.

patterns.name: Subsequent events after a time interval
patterns.context: Marks an immediately following event by a time interval; strong responses fall on time units or interval words.

patterns.name: Short timescales
patterns.context: Describes a process occurring on a short timescale, with strong responses to short-duration phrases.

patterns.name: Size unit cm
patterns.context: Reports mass size in centimeters during medical examination; the unit cm activates most strongly.

patterns.name: Head impaled on a pike
patterns.context: Describes the specific detail of a head being impaled on a pike after a violent event; the response is concentrated near on a pike.

patterns.name: Arm restraint
patterns.context: Describes one of a victim’s arms being raised and the other being held, preventing them from breaking a fall; “arm” activates most strongly.

patterns.name: Every six months
patterns.context: Specifies an interval for routine follow-up or treatment, emphasizing once every six months.

patterns.name: Postoperative excision description
patterns.context: After surgical excision, describes tumor-bed markers and tissue sampling; local activations fall on sentence-initial/determiner words such as After and A, without a stable shared trigger word.

10_1661.description: 激活分布于时间表达（同日、稍后、短时程、每六个月）、具体临床测量及事件细节；多个段落突出时间间隔或事件先后，但也有尺寸、肢体受制和暴力叙述等孤立模式。

patterns.name: On the same day
patterns.context: 时间状语短语“在同一天”，尤其句首转述事件时间；“same/day”附近激活强，大小写不一。

patterns.name: 时间间隔后续事件
patterns.context: 以一段时间间隔标记紧接发生的后续事件；强响应落在时间单位或间隔词上。

patterns.name: 短时间尺度
patterns.context: 描述过程在短时间尺度内发生，短时程词组受到突出响应。

patterns.name: 尺寸单位 cm
patterns.context: 医学检查中以厘米报告肿块尺寸，单位 cm 激活最强。

patterns.name: 头部插在尖桩上
patterns.context: 叙述暴力事件后将头颅插在尖桩上的具体情节，响应集中在 on a pike 附近。

patterns.name: 手臂受制
patterns.context: 描述受害者一只手臂被抬起、另一只被抓住，因而无法支撑跌倒；“arm”最强。

patterns.name: 每六个月
patterns.context: 规定定期复诊或治疗的时间间隔，强调每六个月一次。

patterns.name: 术后切除描述
patterns.context: 手术切除后描述肿瘤床标记及取材；局部激活落在 After、A 等句首／名词引导词，未见稳定共同触发词。

en.description: Activations appear around medical measurements and masses, surgery, orthopedics, and cardiac lesions, as well as dentistry, bytes or numeric checks in code, and legal descriptions of injuries; no clear common trigger.

patterns.name: Measurement unit cm
patterns.context: Appears after a number or range to describe size, boundaries, or distance
patterns.domain: Measurements in medical papers, such as masses and radiotherapy margins

patterns.name: Numeric and decimal measurements
patterns.context: Numbers, decimal points, multiplication signs, or ranges appear alongside medical measurements

patterns.name: Medical masses and lesions
patterns.context: Refers to masses, metastases, or lesions in body tissue, often near information on location, size, examination, or treatment

patterns.name: Surgery and tissue handling
patterns.context: Describes surgery, excision, or intraoperative findings

patterns.name: Orthopedic complications and implants
patterns.context: Follow-up statistics on surgery-related fractures, prosthetic stem perforation, and bone ingrowth

patterns.name: Cardiac thrombus and embolism
patterns.context: Links renal infarction to a left ventricular thrombus source

patterns.name: Dental caries events
patterns.context: Defines caries, filling, or extraction on a tooth surface that was healthy at baseline

patterns.name: Buffer bytes and code
patterns.context: Discusses the state of the fifth byte in a buffer when too few bytes are read

patterns.name: Limb injury narrative
patterns.context: Describes being grabbed, falling, and sustaining bruises
patterns.domain: Legal statements of fact or testimony

patterns.name: JavaScript validation prompt
patterns.context: A code branch displays a prompt that the input must be numeric and returns

10_1661.description: 激活分布于医学尺寸与肿块、手术、骨科及心脏病灶，也见牙科、代码中的字节或数字校验，以及法律伤情叙述；共同触发因素不明确。

patterns.name: 计量单位 cm
patterns.context: 数字或范围后出现，描述尺寸、边界或距离
patterns.domain: 医学论文中的肿块、放疗边界等测量

patterns.name: 数值与小数尺寸
patterns.context: 数字、小数点、乘号或范围与医学测量并列

patterns.name: 医学肿块与病灶
patterns.context: 指人体组织中的肿块、转移灶或病变，常与位置、大小、检查或治疗相邻
