patterns.domain: 专利背景、维修说明、网络讨论；涉及汽车安全气囊、滑板、植绒纸修补、沥青、牙冠和车轮等，覆盖[1,2,4,6,7,8,9]

patterns.name: 变化或结果的程度、阈值和作用关系
patterns.trigger: “to 10 open”“to 10 be”“affects tensile strength”“increases surface texture”“will not be able to hold it”“keep it from leaking”
patterns.context: 以过程或条件引出结果，尤其强调达到某种状态、程度、效果或阻止某种结果；与材料性能、强度或功能相关。
patterns.domain: 技术性说明和因果描述，覆盖[1,2,3,7,8,9]

patterns.name: 质地、触感或柔韧性的描述
patterns.context: 直接描述材料的表面质感或可塑性；有时与加热、压实或护理过程相关。
patterns.domain: 材料与修复说明、道路工程、个人护理，覆盖[3,6,7,10]

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤及等待冷却
patterns.context: 家常烘焙语境，描述烘烤后的冷却等待以及避免烫伤。
patterns.domain: 轻松、口语化的烹饪博客，覆盖[5]

patterns.name: 人体或物体内部的松脱、分解风险
patterns.trigger: “loosen or even disassemble within the body”
patterns.context: 讨论植入人体的医疗器械可能发生的结构问题。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的医疗器械说明，覆盖[4]

patterns.name: 滋润、营养与护理需求
patterns.trigger: “kept hydrated”“needs nutrients and oils”“skin underneath needs to be taken care of”
patterns.context: 列举保持头发可塑、易于造型及护理底层皮肤的需求。
patterns.domain: 个人护理或美容说明，覆盖[10]

en.description: Strong activations often occur on descriptions of changes such as deformation, opening, rotation, and failure, and also cover material properties such as stiffness and strength; other topics include heating and cooling, manufacturing and forming, medical components, pH, baking, and refrigerator doors. Several high activations occur on to, and the overall theme is not unified.

patterns.name: Deformation and failure of materials, structures, or components
patterns.context: Describes materials or components deforming, failing, or being unable to retain their structure under heat, pressure, load, crack propagation, or loose connections; also includes discussion of how to prevent these outcomes.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds and technical descriptions; also dental explanatory prose

patterns.name: Material properties and mechanical strength
patterns.context: Focuses on properties such as stiffness, strength, heat resistance, elongation, and texture in materials or components, typically relating them to design, forming, or performance in use.
patterns.domain: Materials, mechanical, and manufacturing patents; also latex glove descriptions

patterns.name: Cooling or curing after heating
patterns.context: Mentions heating, baking, or cooling; cooling may be a step in a repair or baking process.

patterns.name: Opening or cracking of a covering
patterns.context: Describes a covering or door designed to open, or an opening action; one example is a cover tearing open when an airbag inflates, while another is a refrigerator door opening.
patterns.domain: Automotive safety and appliance patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Forming or changing shape
patterns.context: Describes forming processes or changes in a part's shape or position under load.

patterns.name: Direction, distance, or extent of movement
patterns.context: Discusses increases in, or magnitude of, travel distance or rotation angle; appears only in golf ball and drive nut examples.

patterns.name: Medical or body-related components
patterns.context: Involves implants, bones, or crowns; the excerpts discuss both implant loosening and a crown failing to удержать a cracked tooth.
patterns.domain: Medical device patents and dental explanatory prose

patterns.name: High activation on the function word to
patterns.context: Strong activations occur on the infinitive marker to in several places, followed by verbs of change or action; sometimes this overlaps with structural-change semantics, but not in every instance.

patterns.name: Kitchen baking and waiting
patterns.context: In a baking context, mentions a kitchen scale, cookies cooling, and avoiding burns; unrelated to the technical patent theme.

patterns.name: Loss of support after crack propagation in a dental crown
patterns.context: When a crown covers a cracked tooth, the crack continues to propagate until complete failure, and the crown ultimately cannot support the tooth.

patterns.name: Latex formulation and pH adjustment
patterns.context: Describes pH adjustment in a latex dip-molding formulation and the effect of pH on glove properties.

patterns.name: Refrigerator door opening behavior
patterns.context: Discusses avoiding opening the refrigerator door to check its contents, thereby reducing door opening or closing; distinct from the material deformation theme.

10_1745.concept: 结构变化与材料性能
10_1745.description: 强激活多落在变形、开启、旋转及失效等变化描述，也覆盖刚度和强度等材料性能；另有加热冷却、制造成型、医疗部件、pH、烘焙和冰箱门等主题。若干高激活落在 to 上，整体主题并不统一。

patterns.name: 材料、结构或部件的变形与失效
patterns.context: 描述受热、压力、载荷、裂纹扩展或连接松动时，材料或部件发生变形、失效或无法保持结构；也包括讨论如何防止这些情况。
patterns.domain: 专利背景与技术说明；另见牙科说明文

patterns.name: 材料性能与机械强度
patterns.context: 围绕材料或构件的刚度、强度、耐热性、伸长率、纹理等性能展开，通常将性能与设计、成型或使用效果联系起来。
patterns.domain: 材料、机械及制造类专利；另见乳胶手套说明

patterns.name: 受热后冷却或固化
patterns.context: 提及加热、烘烤或冷却；冷却可能是修补或烘焙流程中的步骤。

patterns.name: 覆盖物开启或开裂
patterns.context: 描述覆盖物或门被设计为开启、或发生开启动作；一处是安全气囊膨胀时撕裂开启，另一处是冰箱门开启。
patterns.domain: 汽车安全与家电专利背景

patterns.name: 形成或改变形状
patterns.context: 描述成型工艺或零件在载荷作用下形状、位置发生变化。

patterns.name: 方向、距离或延伸程度
patterns.context: 讨论运动距离或旋转角度的增加、大小；只在高尔夫球和驱动螺母实例中出现。
patterns.domain: 高尔夫器材与机械专利

patterns.name: 医疗或人体相关部件
patterns.context: 涉及植入物、骨骼或牙冠；片段同时谈到植入物松脱及牙冠无法 удерж住裂牙。
patterns.domain: 医疗器械专利与牙科说明文

patterns.name: 连接词 to 的高激活
patterns.context: 多处强激活落在不定式 to 上，后接变化或动作动词；有时与结构变化语义重合，但并非所有实例都如此。

patterns.name: 厨房烘焙与等待
patterns.context: 烘焙语境中提及厨房秤、饼干冷却及避免烫伤；独立于专利技术主题。

patterns.name: 牙冠裂纹扩展后失去支撑
patterns.context: 牙冠覆盖裂牙时，裂纹继续扩展至完全失效，牙冠最终无法支撑牙齿。

patterns.name: 乳胶配方与 pH 调节
patterns.context: 描述乳胶浸渍成型配方的 pH 调节，以及 pH 对手套性能的影响。

patterns.name: 冰箱门开启行为
patterns.context: 讨论无需开门查看冰箱内部，以减少开门或关门操作；与材料变形主题不同。

en.concept: Structural changes and failure of objects
en.description: Responses concentrate on structural changes and failure after objects are loaded, worn, or processed; also involves thickness and layered structures, as well as heat-induced changes, cooking states, and predefined opening of airbag covers.

patterns.name: Damage or failure caused by mechanical or external forces
patterns.context: Describes objects deforming, wearing, loosening, breaking, or failing after exposure to external pressure, repeated friction, loads, or compaction; strong activations often occur near the failure outcome.
patterns.domain: Patent background, product maintenance instructions, web discussions, engineering construction

patterns.name: Thickness, strength, and structural layers
patterns.context: Discusses the thickness, layered structure, or compression of materials or products and their effects on strength, insulation, or shape; damage need not be explicitly described.

patterns.name: Heat-induced material changes or cooking processes
patterns.context: Describes materials curing or changing properties when heated, or state changes during heating and cooking.

patterns.name: Openable cover layers or weakened areas
patterns.context: The cover opens along a tear line or weakened section when the airbag inflates.

10_1745.concept: 物体的结构变化与失效
10_1745.description: 响应集中在物体受力、磨损或加工后的结构变化与失效，也涉及厚度和层状结构；另有热致变化、烹饪状态，以及安全气囊盖板的预设开启。

patterns.name: 机械或外力造成的损坏、失效
patterns.context: 描述承受外压、反复摩擦、载荷或压实作用后，物体变形、磨损、松脱、破坏或失效；失效结果附近常有强激活。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、产品维护说明、网页讨论、工程施工

patterns.name: 厚度、强度与结构层
patterns.trigger: “thick molded products”、“rim section thicker”、“overall strength”、“insulated duct”、“wall thickness”、“mat”
patterns.context: 讨论材料或产品的厚度、层状结构、压缩及其对强度、保温或形状的影响；不一定显式描述损坏。

patterns.name: 加热导致的材料变化或烹饪过程
patterns.trigger: “heated”、“Heat causes … to turn into”、“heat transfer”、“butter … deep golden brown”、“foam”
patterns.context: 热量施加后引起材料固化、性质改变，或描述加热烹饪时的状态变化。
patterns.domain: 维修说明、工程说明、食谱

patterns.name: 可开启的盖层或薄弱部位
patterns.trigger: “tear lines”、“weakened portions”、“allow the cover to open”
patterns.context: 安全气囊充气时，盖板沿撕裂线或薄弱部分打开。

en.concept: Physical properties and failure of materials and structures
en.description: Repeated responses occur in engineering and product texts describing walls, surfaces, compression/compressive strength, deformation, and durability; a few specific topics are also covered, including airbag covers, touchscreen devices, implants, and breast care.

patterns.name: Wall layers and thickness
patterns.context: Describes walls, thickness, or spaces, including insulated piping, dock seals, or molded components

patterns.name: Material compression, strength, and compaction
patterns.context: Materials are compressed or compacted during manufacturing, load-bearing, or construction, or are quantified by compressive strength
patterns.domain: Materials, construction, and road engineering patents

patterns.name: Deformation, bending, and failure
patterns.context: Describes components deforming, losing performance, or disintegrating under pressure, repeated bending, or aging
patterns.domain: Materials, product durability, and biological tissue descriptions

patterns.name: Surface and texture
patterns.context: Mentions the outer surface of a material or body and its properties; appears alongside other structural/material descriptions
patterns.domain: Tool patents, road engineering, and body-care copy

patterns.name: Tear-open airbag cover
patterns.context: A vehicle airbag cover opens along a predefined weak point when the airbag inflates

patterns.name: Touchscreen replacing a mechanical keyboard
patterns.context: Compares the effects of touch input and mechanical keyboards on device enclosure size

patterns.name: Breast care and bra sizing
patterns.context: Promotional copy about changes in women's bodies with age, pregnancy, or breastfeeding

patterns.name: Loosening or disintegration of an implant
patterns.context: Describes implant components loosening or coming apart inside the body

10_1745.concept: 材料与结构的物理性质及失效
10_1745.description: 反复响应工程与产品文本中对壁、表面、压缩/抗压、变形和耐久性的描述；也覆盖安全气囊盖板、触屏设备、植入物及胸部护理等少数具体主题。

patterns.name: wall/结构壁层与厚度
patterns.context: 描述壁、厚度或空间，并涉及绝缘管道、码头密封或模制构件

patterns.name: 材料受压、强度与压实
patterns.context: 材料在制造、承载或施工中被压缩、压实，或以抗压强度量化
patterns.domain: 材料、建筑与道路工程专利文本

patterns.name: 变形、弯折与失效
patterns.context: 描述构件在压力、反复弯曲或老化下发生形变、性能衰退或解体
patterns.domain: 材料、产品耐久性与生物组织描述

patterns.name: 表面与纹理
patterns.context: 提及材料或身体外表面及其性质；与其他结构/材料描述相邻
patterns.domain: 工具专利、道路工程与身体护理文案

patterns.name: 空气囊盖板撕裂开启
patterns.context: 车辆安全气囊充气时，盖板沿预设薄弱处开启

patterns.name: 触屏取代机械键盘
patterns.context: 比较触摸输入与机械键盘对设备外壳尺寸的影响

patterns.name: 胸部护理与文胸尺码
patterns.context: 女性身体随年龄、怀孕或哺乳变化的护理宣传语境

patterns.name: 假体松脱或解体
patterns.context: 描述植入体组件在体内松动或散开

en.description: Primarily responds to material or component properties such as thickness, stiffness, and strength, and changes to these properties. Also covers care for loss or thinning of body tissue/fibers, fastening and fit, expressions of degree, and fragments of product specifications; the second segment is difficult to relate to the main pattern.

patterns.name: Thickness, strength, and loading changes in materials or components
patterns.context: Describes thickness, stiffness, or strength and how these change during manufacturing, use, or under loading; also includes degree or threshold expressions such as “too thick” and “too hard.”
patterns.domain: Engineering patents, materials and product descriptions; also everyday product discussions and craft descriptions

patterns.name: Loss, thinning, and care of body or fiber materials
patterns.context: Describes the properties, thinning, loss, or care of body tissues such as skin and hair, or of fiber materials; some triggers may involve material composition.
patterns.domain: Beauty and personal care, consumer product copy, and materials descriptions

patterns.name: Fastening, fitting, or holding components in place
patterns.context: Components or objects are held, connected, or fitted, or the performance of fastening structures under pulling is discussed.

patterns.name: Strength, degree, or pressure in idiomatic expressions
patterns.context: Expresses that something is about to happen, requires effort, or involves applying excessive force; the meaning is not always a literal physical property.

patterns.name: Alphanumeric and product-specification fragments
patterns.context: Numbers, percentages, package quantities, and product names appear in product listings or formatted specifications, without an obvious shared semantic condition.

patterns.name: Hair cleansing and protein content
patterns.context: Links cleansing performance with the thickness and protein content of fine hair.

10_1745.concept: 厚度、强度及其变化
10_1745.description: 主要响应厚度、刚度、强度等材料或部件性质及其变化，也覆盖身体组织/纤维的损耗护理、固定贴合、程度表达和商品规格碎片；第2段难以与主模式对应。

patterns.name: 材料或部件的厚度、强度与受力变化
patterns.trigger: “wall thickness”“stiffness”“deformations”“quite thick glass”“too thick”“give it strength”
patterns.context: 描述厚度、刚度或强度，以及它们在制造、使用或受力条件下的变化；也包括“too thick”“too hard”等程度或阈值表达。
patterns.domain: 工程专利、材料与产品说明；亦见日常产品讨论和手工品描述

patterns.name: 身体或纤维材料的损耗、变薄与护理
patterns.trigger: “skin loses its elasticity”“fine hair”“thinner”“less protein”“weakening it”“rubber”
patterns.context: 描述皮肤、头发等身体组织或纤维材料的性质、变薄、损耗或护理；部分触发可能涉及材料成分。
patterns.domain: 美容护理、消费品文案及材料说明

patterns.name: 固定、贴合或保持部件就位
patterns.trigger: “stay on little feet”“straps are pulled”“outer layer”“match with other parts”
patterns.context: 部件或物品被保持、连接或贴合，或讨论固定结构在拉扯下的表现。
patterns.domain: 商品描述、工程产品说明

patterns.name: 惯用表达中的强度、程度或压力
patterns.trigger: “the other shoe to drop”“work so hard”“too hard”
patterns.context: 表达事情即将发生、费力或施加过大力量；语义并不总是字面物理属性。

patterns.name: 字母数字与商品规格碎片
patterns.context: 商品清单或格式化规格中出现数字、百分比、包装数量和商品名称，缺少明显的共同语义条件。

patterns.name: 头发清洁与蛋白质含量
patterns.trigger: “frees your hair from everyday grime”“50% less protein”
patterns.context: 将清洁效果与细发的厚度、蛋白质含量联系起来。

en.concept: Performance attributes of objects and materials
en.description: Activations are scattered across descriptions of material thickness and strength, properties of body tissues, surface durability, product functions, golf club deformation, and degradation from repeated bending; the broad commonality is attributes, performance, or words describing changes of state, with no single clear trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Material strength and dimensional parameters
patterns.context: In technical material descriptions, values and units occur alongside material properties or dimensions; activations cluster around terms related to thickness and compressive strength.
patterns.domain: Pipe insulation, construction materials, patent technical texts

patterns.name: Elasticity and changes in body tissue
patterns.context: Describes the properties, changes, and physiological characteristics of body parts or hair; includes attributes such as loss, elasticity, thickness, or protein.
patterns.domain: Beauty, health, or consumer product copy

patterns.name: Surface performance and durability
patterns.context: Lists coating properties, including surface hardness, wear resistance, or damage resistance.
patterns.domain: Patent coatings and materials technology texts

patterns.name: Product function and wearing experience in product descriptions
patterns.context: Consumer product copy describing materials, functions, comfort, or adjustable ways of wearing a product.

patterns.name: Golf club stiffness and deformation
patterns.context: Relates clubhead face stiffness and metal deformation to hitting distance when discussing club performance.

patterns.name: Material degradation from repeated bending
patterns.context: After repeated bending or loading, local fillers, springs, or other components in an object fatigue, break, or disintegrate.
patterns.domain: Mattress or furniture structure patent background

10_1745.concept: 物品与材料的性能属性
10_1745.description: 激活散布于材料厚度与强度、身体组织性质、表面耐久、商品功能、高尔夫杆变形及反复弯折劣化等描述；共同点偏向属性、性能或状态变化词，未见单一明确触发模式。

patterns.name: 材料强度与尺寸参数
patterns.trigger: «30»4« mm»5« loose»6« insulation»5« layer»3« by»3« 20»5« mm»5«…«wall»10 thickness；«comp»3«ressive»9/10 strength；«10»3 to« 100»4« M»3«Pa
patterns.context: 技术材料描述中，数值、计量单位与材料性质或尺寸相邻；激活集中于厚度及压缩强度相关词。
patterns.domain: 管道保温、建筑材料、专利技术文本

patterns.name: 身体组织的弹性与变化
patterns.context: 描述身体部位或毛发的性质、变化与生理特征；包含损失、弹性、厚度或蛋白质等属性。
patterns.domain: 美容、健康或消费品文案

patterns.name: 表面性能与耐久性
patterns.context: 涂层性能并列罗列，涉及表面硬度、耐磨或抗损伤特性。
patterns.domain: 专利涂料与材料技术文本

patterns.name: 商品描述中的功能与穿着体验
patterns.context: 消费品文案，描述商品材质、功能、舒适性或使用者可调节的穿着方式。
patterns.domain: 电商商品介绍、用户评价

patterns.name: 高尔夫球杆的刚度与变形
patterns.context: 讨论球杆击球性能时，将杆头面刚度、金属变形与击球距离联系起来。

patterns.name: 反复弯折导致材料劣化
patterns.context: 物件反复弯折或受力后，局部填充物、弹簧等发生疲劳、损坏或解体。
patterns.domain: 床垫或家具结构专利背景

en.concept: Physical properties of materials and products
en.description: Responds to vocabulary related to the physical properties and structural state of materials, tissues, and products: including performance degradation or damage, dimensions and space, fit and support, and properties such as wear resistance, strength, softness, and absorbency.

patterns.name: Degradation of material or tissue properties
patterns.context: Describes materials or body tissues becoming damaged, or losing elasticity, stiffness, tension, or other properties after use, loading, aging, or stretching
patterns.domain: Product descriptions, patent background, health and beauty, material properties

patterns.name: Dimensions, thickness, and space occupied
patterns.context: Describes the thickness of a finished product after compression or the amount of space occupied by a structure

patterns.name: Fit, support, and keeping in position
patterns.context: Describes a product’s fit to, support for, or function of keeping a body part in position

patterns.name: Wear resistance, strength, and other material properties
patterns.context: Lists the physical properties of materials or products that enable them to perform a task, with emphasis on durability, strength, softness, or absorbency
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic descriptions, patent background, paper product material descriptions

10_1745.concept: 材料与产品的物理性能
10_1745.description: 对材料、组织及产品的物理性能与结构状态相关词汇反应：包括性能衰退或损坏、尺寸空间、贴合支撑，以及耐磨、强度、柔软和吸收等属性。

patterns.name: 材料或组织性能衰退
patterns.context: 描述材料或身体组织在使用、受力、老化或拉伸后发生损坏，或失去弹性、刚度、张力等性能
patterns.domain: 产品说明、专利背景、健康美容、材料性能

patterns.name: 尺寸、厚度与空间占用
patterns.context: 描述压缩后成品的厚度，或结构占用的空间大小
patterns.domain: 工业产品说明、专利背景

patterns.name: 贴合、支撑与保持位置
patterns.context: 描述产品与身体部位的贴合、支撑或保持位置的功能
patterns.domain: 商品文案、医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 耐磨、强度及其他材料属性
patterns.context: 列举材料或产品用于满足任务的物理属性，侧重耐用、强度、柔软或吸收能力
patterns.domain: 百科说明、专利背景、纸品材料描述

en.concept: Mechanical properties and deformation of materials
en.description: Sensitive to descriptions of the thickness, mechanical properties, elasticity, and stiffness of materials or structures, as well as deformation or failure after bending under load; also includes changes in skin elasticity and comparisons of fine hair properties.

patterns.name: Wall thickness
patterns.context: Mentions the wall thickness or available wall space of components, pipes, or sealing structures, with emphasis on thickness or space occupied.

patterns.name: Material strength and physical properties
patterns.context: Lists or measures mechanical properties, strength, toughness, softness, and other material properties.
patterns.domain: Patent material descriptions, materials science papers

patterns.name: Bending fatigue and failure
patterns.context: Flexible or supporting structures are damaged, destabilized, or lose stiffness after repeated bending, loading, or material degradation.

patterns.name: Thinness and dimensional proportions
patterns.context: Uses comparatives and percentages to describe thickness or fiber fineness and related properties.

patterns.name: Materials retaining shape or providing support
patterns.context: Explains how material stiffness helps an object retain its shape and prevents collapse without internal support.

patterns.name: Loss of elasticity
patterns.context: Describes how body tissue changes shape after the skin loses elasticity.

patterns.name: Fine hair and protein content
patterns.context: Compares the fineness and protein content of fine hair with ordinary strands; apart from its relation to dimensional comparison, this is a distinct hair-care context.

10_1745.concept: 材料的机械性质与形变
10_1745.description: 对材料或结构的厚薄、力学性质、弹性与刚度，以及受力弯折后的形变或失效描述敏感；也出现皮肤弹性变化和细发属性比较。

patterns.name: 壁厚
patterns.context: 提及部件、管道或密封结构的壁厚／可用壁空间，尤其强调厚薄或空间占用。
patterns.domain: 专利工程、产品结构描述

patterns.name: 材料强度与物理性质
patterns.trigger: “physical characteristics”“strength, softness, and absorbency” [4]；“flexural strength”“flexural modulus”“toughness” [5]
patterns.context: 列举或测量材料的力学性能、强度、韧性、柔软性等性质。
patterns.domain: 专利材料说明、材料科学论文

patterns.name: 弯折疲劳与失效
patterns.trigger: “bends”“repeated flexure and disintegration” [6]；“buckle if the straps are pulled too hard”“lose its stiffness” [9]
patterns.context: 柔性或支撑结构在反复弯折、受力或材料退化后发生损坏、失稳或失去刚度。

patterns.name: 薄细及尺寸比例
patterns.context: 以比较级、百分比描述厚度或纤维粗细及其相关属性。
patterns.domain: 工程专利、个人护理文案

patterns.name: 材料维持形状／支撑
patterns.context: 说明材料刚度如何使物体保持形状，并在缺少内部支撑时避免塌陷。
patterns.domain: 百科说明、产品结构描述

patterns.name: 弹性丧失
patterns.context: 描述皮肤失去弹性后，身体组织形态随之改变。

patterns.name: 头发纤细与蛋白质含量
patterns.context: 比较细发与普通发丝的粗细和蛋白质含量；除与尺寸比较相关外，属于独立的护理语境。

en.description: Activations often occur when materials, components, or tissues bend, weaken, deform, loosen, or disintegrate under load; fiber materials and their strength are also involved. Other sporadic patterns include garment adjustment, making, and quantitative comparisons; the recipe segments have no clear shared trigger feature.

patterns.name: Damage or degradation of materials, components, or structures
patterns.context: Describes materials, body tissues, or devices weakening, deforming, loosening, or disintegrating during use, under load, or as their structure changes; commonly associated words include force, strength, flexural, and stiffening.
patterns.domain: Patent background, materials/engineering abstracts, product descriptions, and descriptions of body tissues

patterns.name: Fibers, fabrics, and their material properties
patterns.context: Mentions the composition, treatment, performance, or loading of fibers or fibrous materials; sometimes co-occurs with strength, bending, or degradation.

patterns.name: Bending, folding, and flexible movement
patterns.context: Objects or materials bend, fold, or undergo adjustable deformation because of their design, use, or loading.

patterns.name: Words containing dis- and expressions of separation/failure
patterns.context: The initial dis- substring in each word is strongly activated; the words refer respectively to material disintegration, components coming apart, and wire displacement, and their contexts do not fully match.

patterns.name: Processing steps in making or cooking
patterns.context: Describes specific operations and completion states in material production (felting) or recipes.

patterns.name: Adjustable garments and movement
patterns.context: Garments are adjusted for fit or weather by changing tightness or length.

patterns.name: Numerical proportions and comparative performance descriptions
patterns.context: Uses percentages to compare the thickness and protein content of fine hair with average hair strands.

10_1745.concept: 材料受力与结构变化
10_1745.description: 激活多见于材料、部件或组织受力后的弯曲、变弱、变形、松脱或解体；也涉及纤维材料及其强度。另有服饰调节、制作和量化比较等零散模式，食谱段无明确共同触发特征。

patterns.name: 材料、部件或结构的损坏/性能劣化
patterns.trigger: “deterioration”, “disintegration”, “loses its elasticity”, “weakening”, “loosen or even disassemble”, “buckle”, “too hard”, “less side forces to displace”
patterns.context: 描述材料、身体组织或器件在使用、受力或结构变化下变弱、变形、松脱或解体；常见相关词为 force、strength、flexural、stiffening。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、材料/工程摘要、产品说明及身体组织描述

patterns.name: 纤维、织物及其材料属性
patterns.trigger: “felted”, “wool”, “woven glass fibers”, “hair fibers”, “woven wire screen”, “padding material”
patterns.context: 提及纤维或纤维状材料的构成、处理、性能或受力；有时与强度、弯曲或劣化同现。
patterns.domain: 手工制品、化妆品、材料科学、专利

patterns.name: 弯曲、折叠及柔性动作
patterns.context: 物体或材料因结构设计、使用或受力发生弯曲、折叠或可调节形变。
patterns.domain: 专利、材料摘要、商品评论

patterns.name: 包含 dis- 的词及分离/失效表达
patterns.context: 该词首现的 dis- 子串均有较强激活；分别指材料解体、部件散开、线材移位，语境并不完全相同。

patterns.name: 制作或烹调中的处理步骤
patterns.trigger: “felted”, “Toast … until the skins begin to blacken”
patterns.context: 叙述材料制作（毡化）或食谱中的具体操作与完成状态。

patterns.name: 可调节服饰及动作
patterns.trigger: “adjustability”, “loosen the bow”, “let down the length”, “cinch it up”
patterns.context: 服饰通过松紧、长度调节以适应穿着或天气。

patterns.name: 数字比例和比较级性能描述
patterns.context: 以百分比量化比较细发与平均发丝的厚度、蛋白质含量。
patterns.domain: 产品宣传/头发护理说明

en.concept: Deformation, degradation, and properties of materials and tissue
en.description: Activations occur across descriptions of materials or tissue losing elasticity, strength, shape, or other properties, as well as bending, loading, and mechanical testing contexts; there are also responses to local references to skin/outer layers, fine-hair properties, thin-wall design, and bone screws with insufficient engagement.

patterns.name: Degradation or loss of properties in materials or structures
patterns.context: Describes materials, tissue, or structures weakening, deforming, or losing their original properties due to time, use, loading, or environmental effects.
patterns.domain: Beauty and health, patent background, materials engineering

patterns.name: Bending, loading, and mechanical performance testing
patterns.context: An object is subjected to bending, a load, or tension, or its bending resistance or durability is discussed.

patterns.name: Skin and outer layers beginning to darken
patterns.context: Skin- or outer-layer-related terms appear; in cooking contexts, this specifically refers to garlic skins beginning to darken when heated.

patterns.name: Fine hair and hair-care properties
patterns.context: Discusses shampoo products, hair type, and the thickness or protein content of fine hair.

patterns.name: Dental resin cycling and loading conditions
patterns.context: Dental resin materials undergo thermal cycling and mechanical loading tests.

patterns.name: Thin-wall structural design
patterns.context: Describes thin walls used in gas turbine components to reduce weight.

patterns.name: Screws not fully engaged and overlong
patterns.context: A screw is not fully inserted into a vertebra, and possible causes are discussed.

10_1745.concept: 材料与组织的形变、退化及性能
10_1745.description: 激活分布在材料或组织失去弹性、强度、形状等性能，以及弯折、受力和机械测试语境；另对皮肤/外皮、细发特性、薄壁设计和骨螺钉未充分啮合等局部表述有反应。

patterns.name: 材料或结构退化、失去性能
patterns.trigger: “loses its elasticity”“deterioration”“disintegration”“degrade and lose its stiffness”“lose their shape”
patterns.context: 描述材料、组织或结构因时间、使用、受力或环境影响而变弱、变形或失去原有性质。
patterns.domain: 美容健康、专利背景、材料工程

patterns.name: 弯折、受力与机械性能测试
patterns.trigger: “bend or fold”“repeated flexure”“mechanical loading”“flexural strength”“buck­le if the straps are pulled too hard”
patterns.context: 物体受弯曲、负载或拉力，或讨论其抗弯、耐久表现。

patterns.name: 皮肤及外层开始变黑
patterns.context: 出现皮肤或外皮相关词；烹饪语境中尤指加热后蒜皮开始变黑。

patterns.name: 细发与头发护理特性
patterns.context: 讨论洗发产品、发质以及细发的厚度或蛋白含量。

patterns.name: 牙科树脂循环与加载条件
patterns.context: 牙科树脂材料经过温度循环及机械加载测试。

patterns.name: 薄壁结构设计
patterns.context: 描述燃气轮机部件为轻量化而采用较薄壁厚。

patterns.name: 螺钉未完全啮合及过长
patterns.context: 椎骨中的螺钉未充分旋入，讨论可能原因。

en.description: Primarily responds to vocabulary for mechanical/physical properties of materials and tissues, especially strength, hardness, elasticity, toughness, and their measurement or changes; also activates on descriptions of skin darkening and excessive browning in cooking contexts.

patterns.name: Strength, toughness, and other material properties
patterns.context: Lists, measures, or compares physical/mechanical properties in materials or biomechanics texts; often appears alongside experimental subjects, test conditions, or other properties.
patterns.domain: Materials science, dental materials, biomedical engineering, and patent background

patterns.name: Loss of support properties in tissue or body structures
patterns.context: Describes properties or changes in elasticity, strength, thickness, or protein content of body tissues/fibers such as skin, breasts, or hair.

patterns.name: Preventing excessive browning in baking
patterns.context: A baking recipe instructs covering the edge of a pie crust with foil to prevent it from browning too much.

patterns.name: Food skin darkening during cooking
patterns.context: A recipe step describes garlic skin beginning to darken after heating, as a cooking-process or doneness cue.

10_1745.concept: 材料与组织性质
10_1745.description: 主要响应材料及组织的力学/物理性质词汇，尤其 strength、硬度、弹性、韧性及其测量或变化；另对烹饪语境中表皮变黑、过度褐变的描述有激活。

patterns.name: 强度、韧性等材料性能
patterns.context: 在材料或生物力学文本中列举、测量、比较物理/机械性能；常与实验对象、测试条件或其他性能并列出现。
patterns.domain: 材料科学、牙科材料、生物医学工程及专利背景

patterns.name: 组织或身体结构失去支撑特性
patterns.context: 描述皮肤、乳房或头发等身体组织/纤维的弹性、强度、厚度或蛋白质等特性及其变化。
patterns.domain: 健康、美容与身体护理文案

patterns.name: 烘焙中的防止过度变褐
patterns.context: 烘焙食谱中说明用锡箔遮盖饼皮边缘，以免烘烤过度上色。

patterns.name: 烹饪时食材表皮变黑
patterns.context: 食谱步骤中描述加热蒜瓣后表皮开始变黑，作为烹饪过程或熟度提示。

en.description: Activations often occur on physical property terms and their measurements related to materials, products, or the body. They also appear in descriptions of fit, food-processing quality, and specification values. The common thread is describing properties, performance, or outcomes, but not a single domain.

patterns.name: Physical Performance of Materials, Products, or Tissues
patterns.context: Activates near performance terms and related measurements when describing or comparing materials, products, and their performance; may appear in research abstracts, patent backgrounds, or product copy.
patterns.domain: Materials science, engineering patents, product descriptions

patterns.name: Body Tissue and Personal Care Properties
patterns.context: Activates when discussing the form, elasticity, strength, or care effects of body tissues or hair.

patterns.name: Wear and Fit Performance
patterns.context: Describes how well socks fit and stay on the feet in product copy.

patterns.name: Food Processing and Finished-Product Quality
patterns.context: Explains how dough resting time affects quality after pressing and baking.

patterns.name: Quantities, Dimensions, and Test Conditions
patterns.context: Numbers appear alongside units, ratios, or experimental conditions; often related to material or product specifications and testing, but may also simply occur in lists.

patterns.name: Fragmentary or Unclear Context
patterns.context: Activations occur in truncated sentences, specification lists, or snippets with insufficient context, making it difficult to assign them reliably to a more specific semantic pattern.

10_1745.concept: 物理属性与性能描述
10_1745.description: 激活常落在材料、产品或身体相关的物理性能词及其度量上，也见于贴合表现、食品加工质量和规格数字；共同点是描述性质、性能或结果，但并非单一领域。

patterns.name: 材料、产品或组织的物理性能
patterns.context: 在描述或比较材料、产品及其性能时，性能词及相关度量附近激活；可出现于论文摘要、专利背景或商品文案。
patterns.domain: 材料科学、工程专利、产品描述

patterns.name: 身体组织与个人护理属性
patterns.context: 谈论身体组织或头发的形态、弹性、强度及护理效果时激活。
patterns.domain: 个人护理与身体相关文案

patterns.name: 穿着与贴合表现
patterns.context: 商品文案中描述袜子贴合、留在脚上的表现。

patterns.name: 食物加工与成品质量
patterns.context: 说明面团静置时间对压制和烘烤后质量的影响。

patterns.name: 数量、尺寸与测试条件
patterns.trigger: “2.5 and 5 mm”, “1% rubber”, “20%”, “50% less”, “5000 cycles”, “5 degrees C/55 degrees”
patterns.context: 数字与单位、比例或实验条件相邻；多与材料或产品规格、测试相关，但也可能只是清单内容。

patterns.name: 残缺或不明确的上下文
patterns.trigger: “club head”, “sealing element”; 另有“Imported”“Machine washable”等标签片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在截断句子、规格清单或上下文不足的片段中，无法可靠归入更具体的语义模式。

en.concept: Physical properties and failure of materials and products
en.description: Responds to dimensions and thickness, wear and degradation, bending, and mechanical durability of materials or products; also involves shape retention, predefined weakening for opening, product specifications, and the effects of processing conditions on finished products.

patterns.name: Thickness and dimensions of functional materials
patterns.context: Describes the dimensions or thickness of a product, component, or structure and changes to them; thickness is sometimes given with numbers and units

patterns.name: Material aging, wear, and degradation
patterns.context: Materials or products lose performance, wear, or disintegrate over time, through use, or under repeated loading

patterns.name: Bending and mechanical properties of materials
patterns.context: Discusses the mechanical properties and durability of materials or components under bending or repeated loads
patterns.domain: Patents, dental materials, and biomechanical research

patterns.name: Objects retaining shape or structure
patterns.context: Emphasizes material rigidity or support to prevent an object from deforming or collapsing

patterns.name: Opening or breaking at a weakened point
patterns.context: A predefined weakened area allows a covering to open under a specific pressure or trigger condition

patterns.name: Product specification and product-description fragments
patterns.context: Sporadic product specifications, sizes, or selling points; not clearly related to technical material degradation

patterns.name: Processing conditions affect finished-product quality
patterns.context: The resting time of food dough affects the subsequent pressing and baking results

10_1745.concept: 材料与产品的物理性能及失效
10_1745.description: 响应材料或产品的尺寸厚度、磨损劣化、弯折及力学耐久性，也涉及形状保持、预设弱化开启、商品规格和加工条件对成品的影响。

patterns.name: 功能材料的厚度与尺寸
patterns.context: 描述产品、部件或结构的尺寸、厚度及其变化；有时以数字和单位给出厚度
patterns.domain: 商品描述、专利技术文献

patterns.name: 材料老化、磨损与劣化
patterns.context: 材料或产品经时间、使用或反复受力而失去性能、发生磨耗或解体
patterns.domain: 消费品说明、专利背景技术

patterns.name: 材料的弯折与机械性能
patterns.context: 讨论材料、构件受弯或反复载荷时的力学性质与耐久性
patterns.domain: 专利、牙科材料与生物力学研究

patterns.name: 物体保持形状或结构
patterns.context: 强调材料刚性或支撑性，以免物体变形或塌陷

patterns.name: 薄弱处开启或破裂
patterns.trigger: “tear lines”“weakened portions”“open during air bag inflation”
patterns.context: 通过预设弱化部位，使覆盖件在特定压力或触发条件下开启

patterns.name: 产品规格与商品描述片段
patterns.trigger: “1% rubber”“Machine washable”“3-Pack Print Socks”“The socks stay on”
patterns.context: 零散商品规格、尺码或产品卖点；不明显涉及技术性材料劣化

patterns.name: 加工条件影响成品质量
patterns.context: 食品面团的静置时间影响后续压制与烘烤成品

en.description: Primarily responds to mechanical properties, deformation, weakening, or loss exhibited by materials or tissues during bending, loading, compression, and use. It also responds to weakened tear lines in airbags, paper properties, and descriptions of baking and setting in recipes, as well as sporadic terms.

patterns.name: Changes in Performance and Loss in Materials or Body Parts
patterns.context: Describes declines in the performance of materials, tissues, or components after use, aging, or loading, including loss of elasticity, stiffness, or integrity.

patterns.name: Bending, Flexure, and Bending-Performance Testing
patterns.context: Describes bending behavior and mechanical properties in contexts involving repeated flexing, mechanical loads, or material testing.

patterns.name: Strength, Load-Bearing, and Applied Loads
patterns.context: Mentions material strength, mechanical loading, or different types of loads borne by a component; not limited to bending tests.

patterns.name: Weak Points Enabling Tearing or Opening
patterns.context: A component has a preset tear line or weak area so it can open under a specific loading event.

patterns.name: Compression Deformation of Elastomers or Ring-Shaped Components
patterns.context: A mechanism applies compressive force, deforming a ring-shaped component inward and changing its aperture.

patterns.name: Physical Properties of Tissue Paper Webs
patterns.context: Lists the physical properties required of a paper web product.

patterns.name: Baked-Product Condition and Edge Setting
patterns.context: A recipe uses color and edge condition to determine whether cookies are done.

patterns.name: Sporadic Strongly Activating Terms with Insufficient Explanation
patterns.context: Occurs in localized contexts involving product size/text fragments, a dental-material title, possible failure when a strap is pulled taut, or cycle counts; the snippets do not confirm a specific trigger shared with other patterns.
patterns.domain: Web text, medical abstracts, engineering patents, and experimental descriptions

10_1745.concept: 材料力学性质与变形
10_1745.description: 主要响应材料或组织在弯曲、载荷、压缩及使用中表现出的力学性质、变形、弱化或损耗；另响应安全气囊弱化撕裂线、纸品属性和食谱的烘焙定型描述，也有零散词项激活。

patterns.name: 材料或身体部位的性能变化、损耗
patterns.trigger: “skin loses its elasticity”“breasts often lose their…”；“degrade and lose its stiffness”“deterioration”“lose”
patterns.context: 描述材料、组织或部件在使用、老化或受力后性能下降，包括失去弹性、刚度或完整性。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学/健康说明

patterns.name: 弯曲、挠曲与弯曲性能测试
patterns.context: 在反复弯折、机械载荷或材料测试语境中，描述弯曲行为及其力学性质。

patterns.name: 强度、承载与受力载荷
patterns.context: 提及材料强度、机械加载或部件承受的不同类型载荷；不限于弯曲测试。

patterns.name: 弱化部位促成撕裂或开启
patterns.trigger: “tear lines”“weakened portions”“allow the cover to open”
patterns.context: 部件预设撕裂线或薄弱区域，以便在特定受力事件中打开。

patterns.name: 弹性体或环形部件受压变形
patterns.trigger: “pressing against the ring and annulus”“expand inwardly”“compressive force”“reduce the size”
patterns.context: 机构施加压缩力，使环形部件向内变形并改变孔径。

patterns.name: 纸巾纸幅的物理属性
patterns.context: 列举纸幅产品所需的物理性质。

patterns.name: 烘焙成品状态与边缘定型
patterns.context: 食谱中以颜色和边缘状态判断饼干是否烤好。

patterns.name: 未充分解释的零散强激活词

en.concept: ards character fragments and sporadic subword features
en.description: The clearest recurring feature is activation on the ards fragment in multiple words; other sporadic patterns include word-internal fragments, numbers and punctuation, and the code constant FILTER. Activation occurs across multiple domains and cannot be explained by a single semantic topic.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments containing ards
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ards letter fragment inside complete words or phrases; the preceding word and capitalization vary, and may be a complete word or a compound identifier.
patterns.domain: Web text, paper metadata, code, email

patterns.name: Specific letter fragments within words
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across several discontinuous letter fragments within words; apart from Tow/ards, there is no clear semantic or lexical condition consistently associated with the ards pattern.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, research papers, and medical abstracts

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation
patterns.context: Activation appears near local numbers, periods, hyphens, or operators; there is insufficient evidence for a shared contextual condition.

patterns.name: FILTER in code
patterns.context: In an OpenGL constant identifier, activation is concentrated on the final part of FILTER.

patterns.name: Unexplained sporadic fragments
patterns.context: Appears in license addresses and email body text, difficult to form a stable pattern with other activation locations.

patterns.context: 激活落在完整单词或词组内部的 ards 字母片段；片段前的词及大小写不同，可能是完整单词，也可能是复合标识符。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、论文元数据、代码、邮件

patterns.name: 单词内部的特定字母片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在词内的若干不连续字母片段；除 Tow/ards 外，与 ards 模式没有明显一致的语义或词法条件。
patterns.domain: 百科、科研论文及医学摘要

patterns.name: 序号与标点字符
patterns.context: 局部数字、句点、连字符或运算符附近出现激活；没有足够证据说明共同上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 许可证文本、数学表达式

patterns.name: 代码中的 FILTER
patterns.context: OpenGL 常量标识符中，激活集中在 FILTER 末尾部分。

patterns.name: 解释不明的零散片段
patterns.context: 在许可证地址和邮件正文中出现，难以与其他激活位置构成稳定模式。
patterns.domain: 代码许可证文本、电子邮件

en.description: Activation is scattered across beard/ards fragments, several long-word substrings, license numbers, numbers and operators in mathematical expressions, and the OpenGL constant FILTER; no stable, unified semantic or stylistic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: ards／ard spelling fragments
patterns.context: Appears in words such as beards, Major Beard, deckCards, and Regards; trigger positions span word beginnings, middles, and ends, with no clear shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Web promotional copy, code identifiers, email sign-offs

patterns.name: Fragments within specific words
patterns.context: Activation falls on different subword fragments of several longer words involving transportation agencies, academic discussion, medical terminology, and paper titles; these are difficult to group into one semantic class.

patterns.name: Document version numbers and punctuation
patterns.context: Activation appears near version numbers and copyright years in open-source license text; words such as Linux in the same passage also activate, possibly due to document templates or fragment boundaries.

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in nested radicals and algebraic expressions; adjacent markers span numbers, minus signs, and parentheses, with no clear specificity to mathematical meaning.

patterns.name: FILTER in OpenGL constant names
patterns.context: Triggered in OpenGL texture parameter constants GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER and GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER; adjacent markers involve identifier fragments such as RECTANGLE and NEAREST.

10_1774.description: 激活分散在 beard/ards 片段、若干长词子串、许可证数字、数学表达式数字与运算符，以及 OpenGL 常量 FILTER；未见稳定统一的语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: ards／ard 拼写片段
patterns.context: 出现在 beards、Major Beard、deckCards、Regards 等词中；触发位置横跨词首、词中与词尾，没有明显统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 网页宣传文案、代码标识符、邮件结尾

patterns.name: 特定词内的碎片
patterns.context: 激活落在若干较长词的不同子词片段，涉及交通机构、学术论述、医学术语与论文标题；难以归为同一语义类。

patterns.name: 文档版本数字与标点
patterns.context: 在开源许可证文本中，版本号和版权年份附近出现激活；同时该段的 Linux 等词也有激活，可能是文档模板或片段边界相关。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字与运算符
patterns.context: 出现在嵌套根式和代数表达式中；相邻标记跨数字、负号及括号结构，未见明确数学语义特异性。

patterns.name: OpenGL 常量名中的 FILTER
patterns.context: 在 OpenGL 纹理参数常量 GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER、GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER 中触发，且相邻标记涉及 RECTANGLE、NEAREST 等标识符片段。

en.description: Activation is distributed across transportation terms, beard-related words, life-science and medical terminology, PHP code identifiers, and number strings; local trigger conditions are clear within each passage, but these meanings and domains have no stable commonality.

patterns.name: Transportation-related terms
patterns.context: When names of transportation agencies appear, or when describing routes for transporting substances

patterns.name: Beard-related terms
patterns.context: Content about beards, including trimming and shaving

patterns.name: Biomedical and life-science terminology
patterns.context: Specialized terms, experimental descriptions, or biological environment descriptions in research or medical contexts

patterns.name: Test class names in PHP code
patterns.context: PHP code, including class names and namespace declarations

patterns.name: Number strings and punctuation
patterns.context: Fragments made up of numbers, commas, question marks, and asterisks
patterns.domain: Mathematics or structurally unclear numeric text

10_1774.description: 激活分布于交通与运输词、胡须词、生命科学和医学术语、PHP代码标识符及数字串；各段局部触发条件明确，但这些词义和领域之间缺少稳定共同点。

patterns.name: 运输相关词语
patterns.context: 出现交通机构名称或描述物质运输路径时

patterns.name: 胡须主题词
patterns.context: 围绕胡须及其修剪、剃须等内容

patterns.name: 生物医学与生命科学术语
patterns.context: 科研或医学语境中出现专业术语、实验描述或生物环境描述
patterns.domain: 生物医学、生命科学论文

patterns.name: PHP代码中的测试类名
patterns.context: PHP代码及类名、命名空间声明

patterns.name: 数字串与标点
patterns.context: 数字、逗号、问号及星号构成的片段
patterns.domain: 数学或结构不明的数字文本

en.concept: Word-initial Under, Sex, and reproductive vocabulary
en.description: Activation is concentrated on two distinct word beginnings: Under (including the complete word Understanding, and also Under natural) and Sex (including Sex work, Sex and gender, Sex pheromone); there is also one instance of sperm. Overall, the examples concern biomedical and biological texts.

patterns.name: Under-initial words and internal segmentation
patterns.context: “Under/Understanding” at the start of a sentence or title. [2]–[5] contain the complete word Understanding; in [1], Under is followed by natural and cannot be interpreted as Understanding.
patterns.domain: Botany, immunology, and biomedical project descriptions

patterns.name: Sex-initial words
patterns.context: Sex begins a title or phrase and is followed by different nouns or conjunctions; in [10], it combines with phe to form pheromone.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia titles, biomedical abstracts, and gender/sexual health texts

patterns.name: sperm in biology
patterns.context: Appears in “Preserved sperm in a shrimp,” describing sperm preserved inside a shrimp.

10_1774.concept: 词首 Under、Sex 及生殖词汇
10_1774.description: 激活集中于两个不同的词首：Under（含完整词 Understanding，也见 Under natural）和 Sex（含 Sex work、Sex and gender、Sex pheromone）；另有一例 sperm。整体涉及生物医学与生物学文本。

patterns.name: Under 开头及词内切分
patterns.trigger: «Under»10；[2]–[5] 中紧接 «standing»4，组成 “Understanding”；[1] 中后接 “natural fluctuations in light environments”
patterns.context: 句首或标题开头的 “Under/Understanding”。[2]–[5] 是完整单词 Understanding，[1] 中 Under 后接 natural，不能按 Understanding 解释。
patterns.domain: 植物学、免疫学及生物医学项目描述

patterns.name: Sex 词首
patterns.trigger: «Sex»8；[7] 中重复出现 “Sex and Breakfast”，[8] “Sex work”，[9] “Sex and gender”，[10] “Sex pheromone”
patterns.context: Sex 作为标题或短语开头，后接不同名词或连接词；[10] 中与 phe 合成 pheromone。
patterns.domain: 维基百科标题、生物医学摘要及性别/性健康文本

patterns.name: 生物学中的 sperm
patterns.context: 出现在 “Preserved sperm in a shrimp” 中，描述虾体内保存的精子。
patterns.domain: 古生物学或生殖生物学

en.description: Activation concentrates on the beginnings of two words at the start of passages: Under (including Under/Understanding) and Sex (including continuations such as Sexual); the two groups differ in style and topic.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Under
patterns.context: Occurs at the start of a passage, followed by varied content; appears both as the common preposition and at the beginning of “Understanding.”
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts, grant project descriptions

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Sex
patterns.context: Occurs at the start of a passage, followed by the standalone word “and” or forming words beginning with Sex-, such as “Sexual” and “Sex pheromone.”
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, biomedical paper titles or abstracts

10_1774.description: 激活集中于片段开头的两个词首：Under（含 Under/Understanding）与 Sex（含 Sexual 等延续形式）；两组文体和主题各异。

patterns.name: 句首 Under
patterns.context: 位于片段开头，后接不同内容；既有普通介词用法，也出现在“Understanding”一词的词首。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要、资助项目描述

patterns.name: 句首 Sex
patterns.context: 位于片段开头，后接独立词“and”或构成以 Sex- 开头的词，如“Sexual”“Sex pheromone”。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、生物医学论文标题或摘要

en.concept: Mathematical formulas and structured text fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to dense numbers, operators, variable powers, function definitions, evaluation, and differentiation instructions in DM Mathematics problems; there are also two isolated activations: a Sudakov fragment in a paper title and an uppercase transaction-record marker.

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Inside or adjacent to symbolic mathematical expressions, especially polynomials, powers, and arithmetic expressions.

patterns.name: Function definitions and substitution-style problems
patterns.context: A function or variable definition is introduced with Let, followed by an expression, often with a request to Give or Calculate a function value or expression.

patterns.name: Instruction words in math problems
patterns.context: Appears after a formula to introduce an evaluation, calculation, or differentiation request.

patterns.name: Negative-coefficient polynomials and powers
patterns.context: A minus sign alternates with coefficients and variable powers in polynomial definitions or expressions.

patterns.name: Complex fractions and positive-value conditions
patterns.context: An assumption that variables are positive follows nested fractions and exponential expressions.

patterns.name: Differentiation instructions
patterns.context: Explicitly requests differentiation with respect to a specified variable, immediately following the expression to be differentiated.

patterns.name: Formulas continued across lines in math problems
patterns.context: Definitions, hints, or answer formulas in math problems continue across lines.

patterns.name: Scholar name in a paper title
patterns.context: After a backslash and line break, a paper title fragment beginning with On and containing the name Sudakov appears.

patterns.name: Transaction-record marker
patterns.context: A transaction-start marker or transaction-type fragment composed of uppercase fields.
patterns.domain: Structured financial text in Enron email

10_1774.concept: 数学公式与结构化文本片段
10_1774.description: 主要对 DM 数学题中密集的数字、运算符、变量幂及函数定义、求值和求导指令响应；另有论文标题中的 Sudakov 片段和大写交易记录标记两种孤立激活。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字与运算符
patterns.context: 符号数学表达式内部或其相邻位置；尤其是多项式、幂和算术表达式。

patterns.name: 函数定义与代入题式
patterns.context: 以 Let 引入函数或变量定义，随后给出表达式，并常要求 Give 或 Calculate 某个函数值或表达式。

patterns.name: 数学题目指令词
patterns.context: 出现在公式之后，引出求值、计算或求导要求。

patterns.name: 负系数多项式与幂
patterns.context: 多项式定义或运算式中，负号和系数、变量幂交替出现。

patterns.name: 复杂分式与正值条件
patterns.context: 嵌套分数和指数表达式后，附带变量为正的假设。

patterns.name: 求导指令
patterns.context: 明确要求对指定变量求导，前面紧接待求导表达式。

patterns.name: 数学题中跨行公式续接
patterns.context: 数学题的定义、提示或答案公式跨行延续。

patterns.name: 论文标题中的学者姓名
patterns.context: 反斜线与换行之后，出现以 On 开始、包含 Sudakov 姓名的论文标题片段。

patterns.name: 交易记录标记
patterns.context: 大写字段构成的交易开始标记或交易类型片段。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的结构化金融文本

en.description: The strongest shared trigger is “She” at the beginning of a sentence or paragraph, often opening a narrative with a female subject; a few activations occur inside the names “Sheri” and the string “Sheeda,” where the spelling is the same but the fragment is not a pronoun.

patterns.name: “She” at the beginning of a paragraph or sentence
patterns.context: The pronoun “She” appears at the beginning of a sentence or new paragraph, followed by a predicate; it is sometimes preceded by a line start, paragraph break, or list item. In most examples it is immediately followed by “She is/was/has/played/posed…”, but examples also include a code string and a poem.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: encyclopedia biographies, legal narratives, medical case reports, email, code, and poetry

patterns.name: “She” string in a name or word
patterns.context: “She” is not an independent pronoun, but a character fragment within a proper name; it appears in an email recipient name and a string value in code.

10_1774.description: 最强共同触发是句首或段首的“She”，常作为女性主语开启叙述；少数激活落在姓名“Sheri”和字符串“Sheeda”的内部，表面拼写相同但并非代词。

patterns.name: 段首或句首的“She”
patterns.context: 代词“She”位于句首或新段落开头，后接谓语；有时前面是行首、段落换行或列表项。多数例子中紧接“She is/was/has/played/posed…”，但也包括代码字符串及诗句中的“She”。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：百科人物简介、法律叙述、医学病例、邮件、代码及诗句

patterns.name: 姓名或词内的“She”字符串
patterns.context: “She”并非独立代词，而是专名内部的字符片段；出现在邮件收件人姓名和代码中的字符串值。
patterns.domain: 邮件元数据；StackExchange 编程文本

en.concept: Prominent word fragments at text beginnings
en.description: Activation is concentrated on words or name fragments at the beginnings of several texts (Mil, Elizabeth, Edouard, Nanoscale), with another instance on numbers and operators in a mathematical expression; the shared feature is weak.

patterns.name: Mil-initial word or name
patterns.context: A word or proper name beginning with Mil, followed by a comma, a person’s name, or a phrase; the subsequent content in [1] is fragmentary, making the complete sentence meaning difficult to determine
patterns.domain: Web text, biographical entries, or proper-name fragments

patterns.name: Elizabeth name
patterns.context: The name appears at the beginning of the text; some entries repeat the name after a line break; [6] is followed by a fragment of email body text

patterns.name: Edouard name
patterns.context: A complete personal name appears as a split token, followed by a line break and a repetition of the name’s beginning

patterns.name: Nanoscale term
patterns.context: The term appears at the beginning of a paper title, followed by a scientific topic description

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: A dense sequence of algebraic expressions, powers, and fractions, near instructions such as “assuming d is positive” and “Simplify”
patterns.domain: Math problems or symbolic computation text

10_1774.concept: 文本开头的显著词片段
10_1774.description: 激活集中在若干文本开头的词或姓名片段（Mil、Elizabeth、Edouard、Nanoscale），另有一段数学式中的数字与运算符；共同点较弱。

patterns.name: Mil-开头的词或姓名
patterns.context: 以 Mil 开头的词或专名，后接逗号、人物名或短语；[1] 中后续内容较零碎，难以判断完整句意
patterns.domain: 网页文本、人物条目或专名片段

patterns.name: Elizabeth 姓名
patterns.context: 姓名位于文本开头，部分条目在换行后重复姓名；[6] 后接邮件正文片段
patterns.domain: 维基百科人物条目、邮件

patterns.name: Edouard 姓名
patterns.context: 以分词形式出现的完整人名，后有换行并重复名字开头

patterns.name: Nanoscale 术语
patterns.context: 术语出现在论文标题开头，后接科学主题描述

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数值与运算符
patterns.context: 代数式、幂和分数的密集串联，附近有“assuming d is positive”和“Simplify”等指令
patterns.domain: 数学题或符号计算文本

en.description: Activation often occurs on proper names, especially personal names and split surnames, and also on institution, publication, and historical-event names; there are also isolated activations on official titles, spending news, and a few common words, with no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Surname fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Appears on a first name, surname, or title and surname in personal names; names are sometimes split into multiple tokens and may appear on a standalone title line or in a table.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies, email, legal court records, sports results tables

patterns.name: Name fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Appears in multiword proper nouns such as place, institution, or publication names; it may also occur in a proper name formed by combining words or in a punning name.

patterns.name: Word-final part of a historical event name
patterns.context: A historical event name is split into multiple subword tokens; the highest activation falls on the final part of the name, «lav».

patterns.name: Officials and official titles
patterns.context: Description of a government official’s role in a news quotation; activation is concentrated on «official».

patterns.name: spending and neighboring words
patterns.context: A news description of someone’s spending habits; there are also activations related to a person’s form of address or a compound word, but it is unclear whether they share the same trigger as spending.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on words with weak contextual links
patterns.context: Pronouns, common words, and ordinary verbs also activate in narrative or legal contexts, but there is no evidence of repetition across passages from which to derive stable trigger conditions.

patterns.name: Names in sports and results tables
patterns.context: An event name, match stage, and competitors’ names appear together in a tennis results list; names contain split tokens.

10_1774.description: 激活多见于专名，尤其人名及被拆分的姓氏，也出现于机构、刊物和历史事件名称；另有官方身份称谓、spending 新闻与少量普通词的孤立激活，未见统一稳定的语义模式。

patterns.name: 人名姓氏片段
patterns.context: 在人名的首名、姓氏或称谓与姓氏上出现；人名有时被拆成多个 token，也可能位于独立标题行或表格中。
patterns.domain: 百科人物条目、邮件、法律庭审记录、体育结果表

patterns.name: 专名中的名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在地名、机构名或刊物名等多词专名中；也可能是词语拼接形成的专名或双关人名。

patterns.name: 历史事件名称的词尾
patterns.context: 历史事件名称被拆分为多个子词 token；最高激活落在名称末尾的 «lav»。

patterns.name: 官员与官方身份称谓
patterns.context: 新闻引语中的政府官员身份描述；激活集中在 «official»。

patterns.name: spending 及其邻近词
patterns.trigger: « spending»4；« spending»5；« $»1«100»1 bills；« master»4« boxing»4« crafts»2«man»5
patterns.context: 关于某人花钱习惯的新闻描述；同时出现了与人物称呼或组合词相关的激活，但不能确定它们和 spending 是同一触发模式。

patterns.name: 弱上下文词的零散激活
patterns.trigger: « the»3« media»4« he»7；« thief»2« either»5« had»5；« it»6« he»8；« court»1« overruled»3« the»3
patterns.context: 叙述或法律语境中的代词、常见词和普通动词也有激活，但缺少跨段重复证据，难以提炼为稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: 比赛项目及结果表中的姓名
patterns.context: 网球赛事结果列表中，项目名称、比赛阶段和参赛者姓名相邻；姓名内部有拆分 token。

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions in email that introduce information with “Here is/This is,” as well as names, institutions, and occupational or business terms; a few activations occur in product copy, literary descriptions of food, and academic editorial information, possibly triggered by proper names or local word forms.

patterns.name: Email introductions with “Here is”
patterns.context: At the beginning of an email body or paragraph, “Here is/This is” introduces an attachment, résumé, list, chart, results, or self-introduction; activation is concentrated on is and nearby words.

patterns.name: Personal and institutional names
patterns.context: Proper names occur in the body text or in email addresses, recipient lists, signatures, and other locations; names are often split into multiple subword tokens. Activation is not limited to a single language or format.

patterns.name: Occupational and business terms
patterns.context: Concerns work experience, responsibilities, accounting, or business records; sometimes appears in job résumés or company operations email.

patterns.name: Product descriptions and address fragments
patterns.context: Web-style descriptions of goods or services are followed by prices, specifications, or contact addresses; activation falls on descriptive text and address fragments.

patterns.name: Descriptions of food in narrative
patterns.context: Food and people eating are described in vivid, literary language; these words do not obviously match the business-email pattern in other passages.

patterns.name: Name-dense academic editorial information
patterns.context: Latin American scholars’ names, institutional abbreviations, and editorial information are listed consecutively, with proper names and institutional terms split into subwords.

patterns.name: Fragments that cannot be grouped
patterns.context: A pattern term in a home-goods description; it has no clear shared trigger with product specifications in the same passage, email in other passages, or proper-name patterns.

10_1774.description: 主要响应邮件中以“Here is/This is”引出信息的表达，也响应姓名、机构和职业业务词；少数激活出现在商品文案、文学饮食描写及学术编辑信息中，可能由专名或局部词形触发。

patterns.name: “Here is”邮件引介
patterns.context: 邮件正文开头或段落起始，用“Here is/This is”引出附件、简历、名单、图表、结果或自我介绍；激活集中在 is 及附近词。

patterns.name: 人名与机构名
patterns.context: 专名在正文或邮件地址、收件人列表、署名等位置出现；姓名常被拆成多个子词 token。激活并不只限于单一语言或格式。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、邮件、学术书目

patterns.name: 职业与业务术语
patterns.context: 涉及工作经历、职责、会计或业务记录等职业信息；有时出现在招聘简历或公司运营邮件中。

patterns.name: 商品描述与地址片段
patterns.trigger: «Available» in white, black or brown；«Ranch»«o» Vista« Dr».
patterns.context: 商品或服务的网页式描述后接价格、规格或联系地址；激活落在描述文字、地址词片段上。

patterns.name: 叙事中的饮食描写
patterns.context: 以生动、文学化措辞描述食物及人物进食动作；这些词与其他段落的商务邮件模式不明显相同。

patterns.name: 姓名密集的学术编辑信息
patterns.context: 拉丁美洲学者姓名、机构缩写与编辑信息连续列出，专名和机构词被切分成子词。

patterns.name: 无法归并的片段
patterns.trigger: « in» a dramatic lot«us» flower« pattern»
patterns.context: 家居商品描述中的花纹用语；与同段的商品规格、其他段的邮件和专名模式缺乏明确共同触发点。

en.description: Activation is distributed across time records, proper and project names, genealogy, tent narratives, health promotion, trading ads, group oscillation, and programming identifiers; the fragments lack a stable shared semantic or syntactic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Time or continuation of a process
patterns.context: Near dates, years, or time ranges; also includes expressions describing research follow-up as ongoing with a planned end.

patterns.name: Spelling fragments in proper names and titles
patterns.context: Activation falls on words and internal fragments in proper names, organization names, or project names, often in titles, lists, or project descriptions.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, research project descriptions, web citations

patterns.name: Genealogy and historical record searches
patterns.context: Context of tracing one’s roots, finding ancestors, or searching family census records.

patterns.name: Tent-building narrative
patterns.context: Narrative in which a character owns, sets up, or uses a tent, accompanied by an outdoor activity.

patterns.name: Therapy and improvement effects
patterns.context: Discusses improvements in a child’s physical condition and possible effects of therapy; the passage also cites an organization name.
patterns.domain: Health-related web text or promotional quotation

patterns.name: Trading promotion and urgency
patterns.context: In a trading or income promotion, “now is the time” urges readers to take action.

patterns.name: JavaScript properties and event objects
patterns.context: Discusses how to determine an event’s source based on an object property; source and className appear near the code.

patterns.name: A group shifting between positions
patterns.context: Describes a group moving back and forth between two other identities, positions, or orientations.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, organizational change and group identity

patterns.name: all in a C function name
patterns.context: A function declaration in C code, where all is part of the identifier sendall rather than a standalone word in a sentence.
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A, C/POSIX thread code

patterns.name: Parliamentary successors and names
patterns.context: A timeline-style record of who replaced a parliamentarian or other person after their death.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies or parliamentary history entries

patterns.name: Research projects and grant numbers
patterns.context: Introduces funded projects, existing projects, and their numbers.

patterns.name: Research follow-up and recruitment data
patterns.context: Reports recruitment for an intervention study, the number of mutation carriers, and plans for subsequent follow-up.

10_1774.description: 激活分布于时间记录、专名与项目名、家谱、帐篷叙事、健康宣传、交易广告、群体摇摆及编程标识符等多类语境；片段间缺少稳定的共同语义或句法触发模式。

patterns.name: 时间或进程延续
patterns.context: 日期、年份或时间范围附近；也包括描述研究随访仍在持续、计划结束的表达。
patterns.domain: 百科年表、医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 专名与名称中的拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、组织名或项目名的词及词内片段上，常见于标题、名单或项目介绍。
patterns.domain: 百科、科研项目说明、网页引文

patterns.name: 家谱与历史资料检索
patterns.context: 个人寻根、查找祖先或家族人口普查记录的语境。

patterns.name: 帐篷搭建叙事
patterns.context: 叙述人物拥有、搭建或使用帐篷，伴随户外活动情节。

patterns.name: 疗法与改善效果
patterns.context: 谈论儿童身体状况改善及疗法可能产生的效果；片段还引用了一个组织名。
patterns.domain: 健康相关网页或宣传引文

patterns.name: 交易宣传与时机催促
patterns.context: 交易或收入宣传中，用“现在是时候”催促读者采取行动。

patterns.name: JavaScript 属性与事件对象
patterns.context: 讨论如何依据对象属性判断事件来源，代码附近出现 source 和 className。

patterns.name: 群体在立场间摇摆
patterns.context: 描述一个群体在另外两种身份、立场或取向之间来回变化。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要，组织变革与群体身份

patterns.name: C 函数名中的 all
patterns.context: C 代码中的函数声明，all 是 sendall 标识符的一部分，而非普通句子中的独立词。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答，C/POSIX 线程代码

patterns.name: 议会替补及人物名单
patterns.context: 年表式记录议员或人物去世后由谁接替。
patterns.domain: 百科人物或议会历史条目

patterns.name: 科研项目与资助编号
patterns.context: 介绍资助项目、既有项目及其编号。

patterns.name: 研究随访与招募数据
patterns.context: 报告干预研究的招募、突变携带者人数及后续随访安排。

en.description: Activation is distributed across dates and times, event planning, and family and child contexts, and occurs sporadically near legal rulings, organizational roles, and obstetric terminology; the common trigger feature is unclear.

patterns.name: Calendar dates and numeric times
patterns.context: Near dates, weekdays, times, or event timing information, often with numbers, punctuation, and temporal judgments; the date itself is not always marked, and activation may fall on a subsequent word.
patterns.domain: Everyday narrative, event planning, legal documents

patterns.name: Event and travel arrangements
patterns.context: When mentioning plans for ticket purchases, cycling, transportation, or family activities, especially in event names, itineraries, or planning contexts.

patterns.name: Family, children, and caregiving
patterns.context: Contexts involving children, infants, childcare, or family life; sometimes connected to dates or legal child custody issues.

patterns.name: Legal proceedings and rulings
patterns.context: Activation appears near legal terms and procedural facts involving emergency court custody orders, child removal, or federal case transfers.

patterns.name: Positions, leadership, and organizational roles
patterns.context: Activation appears near role titles when a charitable organization introduces its leadership or lists members’ positions.

patterns.name: Delivery methods and medical terminology
patterns.context: Strong activation appears near cesarean terminology in discussions of difficult labor, obstetric intervention, or delivery methods.

patterns.name: Ambiguous copulas or statement structures
patterns.context: In several passages, activation falls on common words in copular or declarative sentences, but the contexts vary widely, making it difficult to establish a distinct, stable trigger pattern.

10_1774.description: 激活分布于日期时间、活动安排、家庭儿童语境，并零星出现在法律裁定、组织职务和产科术语附近；共同触发特征不明确。

patterns.name: 日历日期与数字时间
patterns.context: 日期、星期、时刻或事件时间信息附近，常出现数字、标点及时间判断；日期本身未必总是被标记，激活位置可能落在后续词上。
patterns.domain: 日常叙述、活动安排、法律文书

patterns.name: 活动与出行安排
patterns.context: 提到购票、骑行、接送或家庭活动的安排时，尤其处于活动名称、行程说明或计划语境。
patterns.domain: 网页宣传、邮件、个人叙述

patterns.name: 家庭、儿童与照护
patterns.context: 儿童、婴儿、子女照护或家庭生活语境；有时与日期或法律上的儿童监护问题相连。

patterns.name: 法律程序与裁定
patterns.context: 法院紧急监护令、儿童移除或联邦案件移送时，法律术语和程序事实附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 职位、领导与组织职务
patterns.context: 慈善组织介绍其领导层或列举成员职务时，职务名称附近激活。

patterns.name: 分娩方式与医疗术语
patterns.context: 讨论难产、产科处置或分娩方式时，剖宫产术语附近出现强激活。

patterns.name: 模糊的系词或陈述结构
patterns.context: 若干段落中激活落在系词或陈述句中的常见词上，但这些词所在语境差异很大，难以确认为独立、稳定的触发模式。

en.concept: Structural and temporal words across diverse contexts
en.description: Activation is distributed across multiple corpora: it often falls on copulas and function words, date/time and scheduling text, and also concerns legal removal, medicine, company activities, distance learning, and code collision checks. No single specific topic explains all examples.

patterns.name: Copulas or function-word phrases
patterns.context: Several adjacent words in a sentence are highlighted, often in copular constructions, determiners, and prepositional phrases; there is no stable single lexical item
patterns.domain: Multiple styles, including email, legal documents, and encyclopedia narratives

patterns.name: Dates and scheduling
patterns.context: Date, weekday, or time phrases used to schedule meetings and events, or to narrate case and medical appointment timing

patterns.name: Removal and its consequences
patterns.context: In a legal context, describes emergency removal of a child, whether a legal removal was timely, or its necessity

patterns.name: Medical and medical-procedure terms
patterns.context: Terms for cesarean delivery, illness, or consultation appear in medical narratives

patterns.name: Event and organization names
patterns.context: Email lists company events or event arrangements; activation also falls on nearby «ride», «Auction», and scheduling text

patterns.name: Study category and benefit eligibility
patterns.context: Discusses whether distance learning qualifies for GI Bill tuition payments

patterns.name: Game objects and collision checks in code
patterns.context: A Java-style loop iterates over objects and compares bullet and object coordinates

patterns.name: Email sign-offs and scheduling language
patterns.context: Email states meeting arrangements or that a date will be the last available date

10_1774.concept: 多样语境中的结构与时间词
10_1774.description: 激活分布于多类语料：常落在系词和功能词、日期时间与日程文字，也涉及法律移除、医疗、公司活动、远程学习及代码碰撞检查。没有一个具体主题能解释全部例子。

patterns.name: 系词或功能词短语
patterns.trigger: «is»、«was»、«this»、«the»、«for»，以及相邻短语中的普通功能词
patterns.context: 句中多个相邻词被标记，常见于系词结构、限定词和介词短语；没有稳定的单一词项
patterns.domain: 邮件、法律文书、百科叙述等多种文体

patterns.name: 日期与时间安排
patterns.context: 日期、星期或时间短语，用于安排会议、活动，或叙述案件与就医时间

patterns.name: 移除及其后果
patterns.context: 法律语境中描述儿童紧急移送、法律上的移除是否及时，或其必要性

patterns.name: 医疗和医疗程序术语
patterns.context: 医疗叙述中出现分娩手术、疾病或会诊等词

patterns.name: 活动与组织名称
patterns.context: 邮件中列举公司活动或活动安排；激活也落在邻近的«ride»、«Auction»及时间安排文字

patterns.name: 学习类别与福利资格
patterns.context: 讨论远程学习是否符合 GI Bill 学费支付资格
patterns.domain: 退伍军人福利法律文书

patterns.name: 代码中的游戏对象和碰撞检查
patterns.context: Java 风格循环中遍历对象，并比较子弹与对象的坐标

patterns.name: 邮件收尾及日程措辞
patterns.context: 邮件中说明会议安排或某日期将是最后可用日期

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: they often fall on copular verbs such as is/was and in judgment sentences, especially legal documents assessing necessity, timeliness, age, or termination of rights; they also appear in medical procedure terms, emphatic email sentences, uppercase advertising, prose expressions of death, and visa descriptions.

patterns.name: State/judgment word “was” in legal rulings
patterns.context: The past-tense copula was is followed by predicates or complements concerning necessity, timeliness, age, death status, or termination of rights; the strongest cases are findings of fact in legal documents.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings, litigation facts; also one passage of lyrical prose

patterns.name: Medical procedure noun phrase
patterns.context: The post-modifier caesarean section refers to a delivery procedure in a sentence discussing medical treatment options.

patterns.name: Timeliness predicate at the end of a legal sentence
patterns.context: In a legal document, removal is the subject and was timely relates to a statutory deadline dispute; like [2]’s was necessary, it has a judgmental complement after was.

patterns.name: Emphatic/deictic is in email
patterns.context: In emails, is introduces the final date or an emphatic judgment in event promotion; in [1], is is followed by the last… and is surrounded by schedule dates.

patterns.name: Advertisement-style uppercase THIS IS
patterns.context: In an all-uppercase product advertisement, THIS IS introduces the tire’s only drawback; the context includes replacement and tire specifications.

patterns.name: Judgment on termination of rights in a legal document
patterns.context: The court finds that termination of parental rights is in the child’s best interests; was and the preceding gerund phrase form a judgment sentence.

patterns.name: Past-tense was in a legal statement of facts
patterns.context: Describes the age of an alleged victim at the time; was is a past-tense copula followed by an age complement.

patterns.name: Judgment of death in prose
patterns.context: In first-person lyrical writing, is upon me expresses the imminence of death; this is not a legal context.

patterns.name: Immigration status and visa entry
patterns.context: Describes an applicant’s nationality, entry, and visitor visa information; no shared trigger with other passages is prominent.

10_1774.description: 激活模式较分散：常落在 is/was 等系动词和判定句中，尤其是法律文书对必要性、及时性、年龄或权利终止的认定；也出现在医疗手术名词、邮件强调句、广告大写句、散文死亡表达及签证描述中。

patterns.name: 法律判决中状态/判定词“was”
patterns.context: 过去时系动词 was 后接必要性、及时性、年龄、死亡状态或权利终止等谓语/补语；最强案例为法律文书中的事实认定。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、诉讼事实；另见一段抒情散文

patterns.name: 医疗手术名词短语
patterns.context: 分词后的 caesarean section 指分娩手术，处于讨论医疗处置方案的句子中。

patterns.name: 法律句末及时性谓语
patterns.context: 法律文书中 removal 一词作主语，was timely 对应法定期限争议；与 [2] 的 was necessary 同为 was 后接判定性补语。

patterns.name: 邮件中的强调/指示词 is
patterns.context: 邮件里以 is 引出最后日期或活动宣传中的强调判断；[1] 的 is 后接 the last…，且前后有日程日期。
patterns.domain: Enron 商务邮件、活动通知

patterns.name: 广告式大写 THIS IS
patterns.context: 全大写产品广告句中，THIS IS 引出轮胎的唯一缺点；上下文含替换、轮胎规格等内容。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的权利终止判定
patterns.trigger: termin«ating»2« Mother»1«’»2«s»3 and« Father»3«’»3«s»2« rights»2« was»8（[8]）
patterns.context: 法院认定终止父母权利符合儿童最佳利益，was 与前置动名词短语构成判定句。

patterns.name: 法律事实叙述中的过去时 was
patterns.context: 描述被指控受害者当时年龄；was 是过去时系动词，后接年龄补语。

patterns.name: 散文中的死亡状态判断
patterns.context: 第一人称抒情文字中，is upon me 表达死亡临近；并非法律语境。

patterns.name: 入境身份与签证条目
patterns.context: 描述申请人国籍、入境及访客签证信息；未见突出于其他段的共享触发词。

en.description: The strongest signal is was followed by a state judgment in legal narratives, especially statements about whether an action or procedure was necessary; there are also scheduling emails, fee tables, obstetric narratives, and several internal word fragments that do not form a single clear mechanism.

patterns.name: Judgments of necessity/non-necessity
patterns.context: In legal or formal narratives, states whether an action or procedure was necessary, often in the structure subject + was + (not) necessary; may also first state the court’s or a party’s judgment.

patterns.name: was in an action or legal state
patterns.context: The past-tense copula was is followed by an adjective, participle, or state description, often in legal reasoning or findings of fact; activation may also be near the state word.

patterns.name: was in perfect-tense constructions
patterns.context: Describes a person’s previous or ongoing residence status; activation falls on was, immediately followed by a past-perfect expression.

patterns.name: Past or future arrangements in dates/schedules
patterns.context: Email explains the sequence of meetings, leave, and available dates; there is no obvious was trigger, so this may be a weak association or incidental match.

patterns.name: Unit prices and annual billing entries
patterns.context: A fee list in legal materials itemizes years, work performed, and hourly amounts; activation falls on the internal fragment “per” in performed.

patterns.name: Surgical choices in obstetrics
patterns.context: Narrates labor, medical treatment, and the counterfactual consequences of not having a cesarean; activation falls on the internal fragment “are” in caesarean.

patterns.name: Other highlighted words outside the main pattern
patterns.context: Highlights fall on subword boundaries in words for a partner, ministerial conduct, a trial period, and performed in legal text; they show no stable shared lexical or grammatical trigger.

10_1774.description: 最突出的信号是法律叙述中 was 后接状态判断，尤其说明行动或程序是否 necessary；另有日程邮件、费用表、产科叙事及若干词内片段，未能归为同一明确机制。

patterns.name: 必要性／非必要性判断
patterns.context: 法律或正式叙述中说明某行动、程序是否必要，常见结构为主语 + was +（not）necessary；也可能先陈述法院或当事人的判断。

patterns.name: 动作或法律状态中的 was
patterns.trigger: «was»（如 “removal was untimely”“sale was appropriate”“he was deportable”）
patterns.context: 过去时系词 was 后接形容词、分词或状态描述，常见于法律论证、事实认定；激活位置也可能在状态词附近。

patterns.name: 完成时态中的 was
patterns.context: 描述某人先前或持续存在的居住状态；激活落在 was，紧接过去完成时表达。

patterns.name: 日期／日程中的过去或将来安排
patterns.trigger: “meeting is … scheduled”；“plan to be on vacation”；“this is the lastest date”
patterns.context: 邮件交代会议、休假与可用日期的先后关系；没有明显的 was 触发，可能是弱相关或偶然命中。

patterns.name: 单价与按年计费条目
patterns.trigger: “$317 per hour for 2018”“$233.00 per hour for work performed in 2018”
patterns.context: 法律材料中的费用清单，以年份、工作内容和每小时金额逐项列示；激活在 performed 的词内部分片“per”。

patterns.name: 产科中的手术选择
patterns.context: 叙述分娩过程、医疗处置及未采取剖宫产的反事实后果；激活在 caesarean 的词内部分片“are”。

patterns.name: 其他非主模式的高亮词
patterns.context: 高亮分别落在法律文本中的合伙人、部长行为、试用期及 performed 等词的子词边界，未显示稳定一致的词义或语法触发。

en.concept: Judgments and temporal sequence in legal contexts
en.description: Activation patterns include findings in various legal documents, procedural timeliness, final judgments, immigration, and military justice terminology, as well as date scheduling in an email and cesarean delivery in medical history. Common local trigger words include was, final, removal, untimely, and the cross-boundary subword fragment caesarean section; no single stable semantic or syntactic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: was/was necessary
patterns.context: A legal document states that the emergency removal of a child was necessary; activation concentrates on “was” and nearby text

patterns.name: removal and procedural timeliness
patterns.context: Describes a case transfer or removal proceeding and notes delay, procedural defects, and related matters

patterns.name: Date and time arrangements
patterns.context: An email schedules a meeting and vacation, and determines that a particular date is the last available date

patterns.name: Criminal appeal and final judgment
patterns.context: Discusses a criminal defendant’s appeal from a final conviction judgment or a motion for a new trial

patterns.name: Cesarean section
patterns.context: Describes a history of transverse lie delivery and the medical circumstances behind choosing a cesarean section at the time

patterns.name: Impending layoffs
patterns.context: A court considers whether a party reasonably believed layoffs were imminent upon retirement

patterns.name: Immigration status and absence
patterns.context: An immigration appeal finds that a person is deportable, involving facts about not attending school (or a related proceeding)

patterns.name: Untimely application
patterns.context: Determines whether an asylum application was untimely and whether extraordinary circumstances warrant an exception

patterns.name: Military justice institutions
patterns.context: Recounts the mailing of military trial records and related Air Force legal institutions

patterns.name: Finality of conviction and statute of limitations
patterns.context: The dispute concerns when a conviction became final for purposes of starting the petition limitations period

10_1774.concept: 法律语境中的判定与时序
10_1774.description: 激活模式包括多种法律文书中的判决认定、程序时效、终局判决、移民及军事司法术语，也包括一封邮件的日期安排和医学史中的剖宫产。常见局部触发词有 was、final、removal、untimely，以及分词跨边界的 caesarean section；未见单一稳定语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: was/was necessary
patterns.context: 法律文书中陈述法院认定紧急移除儿童有必要，激活集中在“was”及其附近

patterns.name: removal 及程序时效
patterns.context: 描述移送案件或移除程序，并说明迟延、程序瑕疵等

patterns.name: 日期与时间安排
patterns.context: 邮件中安排会议、休假，并判断某日期是可用的最后日期

patterns.name: 刑事上诉及终局判决
patterns.context: 讨论刑事被告对终局定罪判决或新审判动议提出上诉

patterns.name: 剖宫产
patterns.context: 描述横位分娩史及当时选择剖宫产的医学背景

patterns.name: 裁员迫近
patterns.context: 法院审理当事人退休时是否合理相信裁员即将发生

patterns.name: 移民身份及缺席
patterns.context: 移民上诉案件中认定某人可被驱逐，涉及未参加学校（或相关程序）的事实

patterns.name: 逾期申请
patterns.context: 判断庇护申请是否逾期，以及是否有特殊情形可予宽宥

patterns.name: 军事司法法律机构
patterns.context: 叙述军事审判记录寄送及相关空军法律机构

patterns.name: 定罪终局与诉讼时效
patterns.context: 争议请愿时效从定罪何时成为终局起算

en.description: Activations are scattered across legal procedures and factual narratives, medical records, date scheduling, event promotions, Bulgarian adjectives, and code identifiers; there is no clear shared semantic or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: Procedural and ruling language in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in sentences describing litigation procedures, court orders, whether a hearing is required, or whether removal was timely; no fixed legal terminology is required.

patterns.name: Medical diagnoses and hospitalization narratives
patterns.context: Medical records or litigation evidence describing illnesses, hospitalization periods, and specialist consultations.
patterns.domain: Medical facts in FreeLaw legal materials

patterns.name: Residence and service statements in legal documents
patterns.context: Continuous-tense statements of where someone lived or currently lives, their address, and whether they received mail.

patterns.name: Scheduling and date calculation
patterns.context: Infers that a date is the last available option based on meeting and vacation dates.

patterns.name: Event tickets and purchase promotions
patterns.context: Promotes or explains online availability, ordering methods, and guarantees for event tickets.

patterns.name: Online event registration notices
patterns.context: Tells readers how to attend or register for an online event and encourages early registration.

patterns.name: Bulgarian descriptive words
patterns.context: Words in Bulgarian describing sustainability, effectiveness, and ecological or energy-related properties; activation falls on subword fragments within words.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and property access
patterns.context: JavaScript functions extracting properties from parameter objects and combining underscore-separated identifiers.

10_1774.description: 激活分散于法律程序与事实叙述、医疗记录、日期安排、活动宣传、保加利亚语形容词及代码标识符中；没有明显统一的语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的程序与裁定措辞
patterns.context: 出现在描述诉讼程序、法院命令、是否需要听证或移除是否及时的句子中；不要求固定法律术语。

patterns.name: 医疗诊断及住院叙述
patterns.context: 病历或诉讼证据中描述疾病、住院时间及专科会诊。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法律材料中的医疗事实

patterns.name: 法律文件中的居住与送达陈述
patterns.context: 以连续时态陈述某人过去或目前的居住地点、地址及收信情况。

patterns.name: 日程安排与日期推算
patterns.context: 根据会议和休假日期推断某日期是最后可选时间。

patterns.name: 活动门票与购买宣传
patterns.context: 宣传或说明活动门票的线上可用性、订购方式和保障。

patterns.name: 线上活动报名通知
patterns.context: 告知读者线上活动的观看或报名方式，并鼓励提前注册。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语描述性词语
patterns.context: 保加利亚语中描述可持续、有效及生态或能源方面特征的词语；激活落在词内子词片段。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 保加利亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 代码标识符与属性访问
patterns.context: JavaScript 函数中从参数对象取出属性，并组合下划线命名的标识符。
