en.description: Activation spans legal procedural language, fragments within Bulgarian words, a hotel search error message, and a court system heading; overall, it appears to respond diffusely to certain word-internal substrings and formatting fragments, with no single semantic pattern explaining all cases.

patterns.name: Hearings and rulings in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Procedural terms such as hearings, rulings, court decisions, or motions appear in legal litigation narratives; activation also falls on subword fragments within some related words.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal rulings and litigation documents

patterns.name: Fragments within Bulgarian words
patterns.context: In Bulgarian parliamentary speeches, activation concentrates on split subword fragments; different passages trigger on different specific words.

patterns.name: Hotel search unavailable message
patterns.context: A brief user-facing service status message stating that hotel search is temporarily unavailable.

patterns.name: Blank layout and court system heading
patterns.context: Almost entirely blank lines and indentation, ending with a court system heading; strong activation falls on the “ellate” substring.
patterns.domain: Court website or system page text

10_1774.description: 激活跨法律程序用语、保加利亚语词内片段、酒店搜索错误提示及法院系统标题；整体更像对若干词内子串和格式片段的分散响应，尚无单一语义模式能解释全部。

patterns.name: 法律程序中的听证与裁决
patterns.context: 法律诉讼叙述中出现听证、裁决、法院决定或申请等程序性用语；激活也落在部分相关词语内部子词上。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决与诉讼文书

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 保加利亚语议会发言中，激活集中在被拆分的词内子串；不同段落触发的具体词并不相同。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 保加利亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 酒店搜索不可用提示
patterns.context: 面向用户的简短服务状态提示，说明酒店搜索暂时不可用。

patterns.name: 空白排版与法院系统标题
patterns.trigger: 大量“↵”和空格，以及“App«ellate»9 Courts”“App«ellate» Case Management System”
patterns.context: 几乎全为空白行与缩进，末尾出现法院系统标题；高激活落在“ellate”子串。
patterns.domain: 法院网页或系统页面文本

en.concept: Procedural and filing information in documents
en.description: Primarily responds to litigation procedures, court captions, parties, and judgment vocabulary in legal documents; other distinct patterns include German word fragments, community event notices, business schedules, and code fields.

patterns.name: Factual and procedural vocabulary in English legal documents
patterns.context: In legal opinions or litigation records, describes court procedures, party identities, rulings, or legal motions; activation is distributed across multiple legal words and related passages.

patterns.name: Section headings and layout whitespace
patterns.context: Legal document captions, headers, section headings, or layout indentation; whitespace and heading text themselves also activate.

patterns.name: Fragments within German words
patterns.context: In German philosophical discussion, activation falls on word-internal fragments in passages contrasting reason, finitude, and dogmatism.

patterns.name: Health insurance enrollment event notice
patterns.context: Notifies community members about a free event and explains preregistration requirements.

patterns.name: Emergency child custody and safety
patterns.context: A court orders emergency removal or custody due to risks to a child's health or safety.

patterns.name: Partner consent and asset sale
patterns.context: Discusses partners' consent to a public sale of real estate and related motions.

patterns.name: Sanctions and appeals in legal judgments
patterns.context: Narratives of criminal conviction, sentencing, and appellate proceedings.

patterns.name: Business event schedules and hospitality
patterns.context: Emails list times and arrangements for lunch, games, and receptions.

patterns.name: Structured code fields
patterns.context: Code or data structures create a temporary registration-period object and pass meeting and date fields.

10_1774.concept: 文书中的程序与登记信息
10_1774.description: 主要响应法律文书中的诉讼程序、法院标题、当事人及判决词汇；另见德语词内片段、社区活动通知、商务日程和代码字段等独立模式。

patterns.name: 英语法律文书中的事实与程序词汇
patterns.context: 法律判决或诉讼记录中，描述法院程序、当事人身份、裁决或法律动议；激活分布在多个法律词及相关句段中

patterns.name: 段落标题与版式空白
patterns.trigger: “FACTUAL BACKGROUND”、全大写法院标题，以及“       ”等缩进空白
patterns.context: 法律文书标题、页眉、分节标题或排版缩进处；空白和标题字样本身也有激活

patterns.name: 德语词内部片段
patterns.context: 德语哲学论述中，激活落在词内片段，句意涉及理性、有限性与教条主义的对照

patterns.name: 医疗保险登记活动通知
patterns.context: 通知社区成员参加免费活动，并说明预登记要求

patterns.name: 紧急儿童监护与安全
patterns.trigger: “emergency custody”, “ex parte order”, “immediate removal”, “children”, “health and safety”
patterns.context: 法院因儿童健康或安全风险决定紧急移除或监护

patterns.name: 合伙人同意与资产出售
patterns.context: 讨论合伙人对房地产公开出售的同意及相关动议

patterns.name: 法律判决的制裁与上诉
patterns.trigger: “found appellant guilty”, “punishment”, “60 years’ imprisonment”, “notice of appeal”
patterns.context: 刑事案件判罪、量刑及上诉程序叙述

patterns.name: 商务活动日程与招待
patterns.context: 邮件列出午餐、比赛和招待会的时间与安排

patterns.name: 结构化代码字段
patterns.context: 代码或数据结构中创建临时注册期对象，并传入会议及日期字段

en.description: Activation covers specific times, dates, clock times, and deadlines; legal rulings and party identities; and also preregistration, holiday notices, and an isolated Bulgarian “ефективно.” Multiple contexts coexist, making it difficult to attribute activation to a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Clock times, dates, and deadline expressions
patterns.context: Specific times, dates, or time intervals appear in narratives, arrangements, or business information; strong activation often falls on numeric time values, clock times, and temporal prepositions.

patterns.name: Personal names and identity information
patterns.context: In legal factual narratives, proper names occur alongside identity descriptions or party names; activation may fall on name fragments and copulas.

patterns.name: Administrative and legal procedural status
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across procedural terms, ruling status, and related sentences when a court issues a ruling, confirms a judgment, or describes appellate proceedings and deadlines.

patterns.name: Preregistration
patterns.context: An event notice states whether advance registration is required; activation concentrates on “preregistration” and the copula.

patterns.name: Holiday arrangements
patterns.context: An email informs the team of a holiday date and that it is a holiday; activation concentrates on the holiday name, copula, and holiday judgment.

patterns.name: Adverb of degree/manner in Bulgarian
patterns.context: In continuous Bulgarian speech, an internal subword fragment of this word activates; this example lacks sufficient context to establish a connection to the English time, legal, or notice patterns.

10_1774.description: 激活涵盖具体时间、日期、时刻与期限；法律裁定、当事人身份；另见预登记、节日通知，以及保加利亚语“ефективно”的孤例。多种语境并存，难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 钟点、日期与截止时间表达
patterns.context: 在叙述、安排或营业信息中，出现具体时刻、日期或时间区间；强激活常落在时间数值、时刻以及时间介词上。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、邮件、商业/旅游介绍

patterns.name: 人物姓名及身份信息
patterns.trigger: « Mohammed»3« Benn»1«ani»6« is»10« a»3« Moroc»can»2« citizen»3« and»4« national»2；« Mir»na»2 Let»icia»1 Alc»ant»1«ar»3«,»9
patterns.context: 法律事实叙述中，专名与身份描述或当事人姓名相邻；激活可落在姓名片段及系词上。

patterns.name: 行政及法律程序状态
patterns.trigger: « motion»5« to»4« extend»2…« deadline»1；« motion»3« is»5« GRANT»1«ED»2；« AFFIRM»；« judgment»…« AFFIRMED»
patterns.context: 法院裁定、确认判决或说明上诉程序及期限时，激活分布在程序词、裁定状态和相关句子中。

patterns.name: 预先登记事项
patterns.context: 活动通知中说明是否需要提前登记，激活集中在“预先登记”及系词。

patterns.name: 节日与假日安排
patterns.context: 邮件告知团队节日日期及其为假日；激活集中于节日名、系词和假日判断。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语中的程度/方式词
patterns.context: 保加利亚语连续语流中，该词内部子词片段获得激活；此例没有足够上下文证明与英语时间、法律或通知模式相关。

en.description: Activations commonly occur on explicit numeric times, dates, and schedules, and also appear in legal procedures, hospital/care contexts, and event notices; Polish and Bulgarian parliamentary fragments may be independent word-form or number triggers that are difficult to explain through English patterns.

patterns.name: Numeric times or dates in formal text
patterns.context: Times, clock times, durations, or dates are expressed with numbers and units, often in narrative or explanatory sentences; activation is distributed across numbers, punctuation, and nearby words.
patterns.domain: Legal factual narratives, email scheduling, and schedule descriptions

patterns.name: Procedures and legal terminology in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in formal accounts of court rulings or legal disputes involving procedures, property, and party actions; accompanied by conspicuous time-related activation, which may not be an independent trigger.

patterns.name: Hospital, health, and care contexts
patterns.context: Involves hospitalization, hospital staff, or Medicare enrollees; paragraph 2 also contains “about a week,” which may overlap with time expressions.
patterns.domain: Legal testimony narratives, community event notices

patterns.name: Appointments, event schedules, and service information
patterns.context: Explains reservations, delivery, event schedules, or registration methods, often in concise, practical notice or email style.

patterns.name: Numbered agenda items in Polish agenda text
patterns.context: Polish parliamentary text with numbers near agenda headings or items; activation falls on token fragments and numbers, with no clear shared cross-language trigger word.

patterns.name: Fragments of Bulgarian word forms
patterns.context: Bulgarian text; activation falls on subword fragments of Cyrillic words, and the available fragments are insufficient to determine specific semantic conditions.

10_1774.description: 激活常见于明确的数字时间、日期与日程安排，也见于法律程序、医院／照护和活动通知；波兰语、保加利亚语议会片段可能是独立的词形或数字触发，难以由英语模式解释。

patterns.name: 正式文本中的数字时间或日期
patterns.trigger: “at about 5:18 p.m.”、“between 3 and 7 business days”、“11:30 a.m.”、“12:00 p.m.”、“Feb 28th”、“12 hours”
patterns.context: 时间、时刻、时长或日期以数字和单位表示，常出现在叙述或说明句中；激活分布在数字、标点及邻近词上。
patterns.domain: 法律事实叙述、电子邮件安排与日程说明

patterns.name: 法律文书中的程序与法律术语
patterns.trigger: “removal was untimely”、“procedurally defective”、“public sale was appropriate”、“real estate”
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决或法律争议的正式叙述中，涉及程序、财产及当事人行动；同时伴随明显的时间激活，未必是独立触发因素。

patterns.name: 医院、健康及照护情境
patterns.trigger: “come out of the hospital”、“River Hospital”、“Medicare enrollees”
patterns.context: 涉及住院、医院工作人员或 Medicare 参保者；第 2 段还包含“about a week”，可能与时间表达重叠。
patterns.domain: 法律证词叙述、社区活动通知

patterns.name: 预约、活动安排与服务信息
patterns.trigger: “Reservations … to arrange the delivery”、“lunch at 11:30 a.m.”、“tournament”、“cocktail reception”、“Pre-registration is not required”
patterns.context: 说明预订、配送、活动日程或报名方式，常用简短实用的通知／邮件文体。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、社区活动公告

patterns.name: 波兰语议程文本中的数字化议程条目
patterns.context: 波兰语议会文本，议程标题或条目附近出现数字；激活落在分词碎片和数字上，未见明确的跨语言共同触发词。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词形碎片
patterns.context: 保加利亚语文本；激活落在西里尔字母词的子词片段上，现有片段不足以确定具体语义条件。

en.concept: Legal document formatting and proper-name markers
en.description: Primarily responds to the court, docket number, citation, date, and party formatting on the first page of U.S. rulings; it also covers names and family relationships, filing deadlines, and other material in ruling bodies, as well as a separate sailing word and time in a ship narrative.

patterns.name: U.S. federal appellate case titles and citations
patterns.context: A case-page header consisting of a volume number, case parties, docket number, circuit court, and ruling date; activation concentrates on markers in legal citations and title formatting.

patterns.name: State court ruling headers and party names
patterns.context: The court name, docket number, date, case parties, or ruling title on the first page of a state court ruling; names and titles are often formatted with uppercase letters, abbreviations, commas, and periods.

patterns.name: Names and family or identity descriptions in case names
patterns.context: Names identify litigation parties, with information about relatives, guardians, parental rights, or other identities and relationships appearing nearby.
patterns.domain: U.S. court case titles or family law documents, FreeLaw

patterns.name: Discussion of dismissal procedure and deadlines
patterns.context: The court discusses whether dismissal papers were timely, whether the service date was established, and procedural defects or remand.
patterns.domain: U.S. civil procedure ruling body, FreeLaw

patterns.name: Ship voyage narrative and time
patterns.context: Recounts sailors’ voyage, a ship setting sail after receiving a report, and engine trouble, with events marked by times.

10_1774.concept: 法律文书格式与专名标记
10_1774.description: 主要响应美国判决首页的法院、案号、引证、日期和当事人排版；也覆盖姓名及亲属身份、撤案时限等判决正文，并单独响应船舶叙事中的航行词和时间。

patterns.name: 美国联邦上诉判例标题与引证
patterns.trigger: «F»13d、«v»、«NO.»、«United States Court of Appeals»、«Circuit»、日期及«Appeal From»
patterns.context: 以卷号、判例双方、案号、法院巡回区和判决日期组成的判例页首；激活集中在法律引证和标题格式中的标记。

patterns.name: 州法院判决抬头与当事人姓名
patterns.trigger: «THE COURT OF APPEALS OF IOWA»、«IN THE INTEREST OF»、«Filed»、«JUDGMENT»，以及姓名后的标点和缩写
patterns.context: 州法院判决首页的法院名称、案号、日期、案件当事人或判决标题；姓名和标题常以大写、缩写、逗号及句点排版。

patterns.name: 案名中的姓名及亲属、身份说明
patterns.context: 以人名识别诉讼当事人，并在姓名附近出现亲属、监护人或父母权利等身份与关系信息。
patterns.domain: 美国法院案件标题或家庭法文书，FreeLaw

patterns.name: 撤案程序及时限论述
patterns.context: 法院讨论撤案文件是否及时、送达日期是否确定，以及程序瑕疵或发回处理。
patterns.domain: 美国民事诉讼判决正文，FreeLaw

patterns.name: 船舶航行叙述与时间
patterns.context: 叙述船员航行经历、船舶收到报告后出航以及遭遇引擎问题，并以时刻标记事件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across numbers and ordinal suffixes, clock times, fragments within Russian words, and a few proper names or legal terms; work schedules, travel and ticketing, and promotional content in emails, along with several other fragments, cannot be explained by a stable shared trigger.

patterns.name: Numbers and ordinal suffixes
patterns.context: In numbers, ordinal endings, or clock times, activation concentrates on digits and immediately adjacent characters such as nd/th and colons; no specific semantic context is required.

patterns.name: Fragments within Russian words
patterns.context: In Russian text, activation falls on fragmented portions within words rather than stable complete words or semantic categories.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a ship name
patterns.context: The character fragment “ista” in the proper name Carista Express and the following name activate.

patterns.name: Time in a voyage narrative
patterns.context: When a specific time appears in a ship voyage narrative, activation occurs near the digits, colon, minutes, and am.

patterns.name: Name fragments in legal documents
patterns.context: Activation occurs near people’s names and following copulas in factual backgrounds of legal opinions; it is unclear whether this is a general name pattern.

patterns.name: Exchange-related words in legal narratives
patterns.context: In case fact narratives, exchange activates when referring to arrangements or an incomplete transaction.

patterns.name: Code markers in regular-expression examples
patterns.context: Activation occurs near example labels and numbers in Russian regular-expression explanations; its relationship to other patterns is unclear.

10_1774.description: 激活分散于数字和序数后缀、时刻、俄语词内片段及少数专名或法律词语；邮件中的工作安排、行程票务和促销内容，以及若干其他片段，无法由稳定共同触发条件解释。

patterns.name: 数字与序数后缀
patterns.context: 数字、序数词尾或时刻中，激活集中在数字及其紧邻的 nd/th、冒号等字符；不要求特定语义。

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段
patterns.context: 俄语文本中，激活落在被拆分的词语内部片段，而非稳定的完整词或语义类别。

patterns.name: 船名中的内部片段
patterns.context: 专名 Carista Express 中间的字符片段“ista”及后续名称获得激活。

patterns.name: 航行叙述中的时间
patterns.context: 船只航行叙述中出现具体时刻时，数字、冒号、分钟和 am 附近激活。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的姓名片段
patterns.context: 法律判决事实背景中的人名及其后的系词附近出现激活；是否为普遍姓名模式无法确认。

patterns.name: 法律叙述中的交换词
patterns.context: 案件事实叙述中，exchange 在提及安排或未完成交易时激活。

patterns.name: 正则表达式示例中的代码标记
patterns.context: 俄语正则表达式说明中的示例标签与编号附近激活；与其他模式的关系不明。

en.description: Activation is distributed across the Russian word “Пример,” legal case titles and ruling bodies, hotel promotional terms, and email schedule times; apart from the Russian word and several local lexical triggers, no unified semantic or syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Russian example word “Пример”
patterns.context: An internal fragment of the Russian word “Пример” (example); in both passages, the word appears near code or data examples.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, Russian explanations and examples

patterns.name: Scattered strong activation in legal case titles
patterns.context: Local tokens appear in legal material case titles, court information, dates, or bodies; apart from filed in [1] and [7], the trigger positions have no obvious consistent lexical or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: RESORT in hotel promotional copy
patterns.context: The word RESORT is split into multiple tokens in uppercase hotel offers; both occurrences are in promotional language about resort fees or previews.

patterns.name: Email time and schedule expressions
patterns.context: Specific times and meeting or event arrangements in emails. Activation is scattered across time digits, colons, AM/PM, or noon fragments, with no stable, consistent single trigger word.

patterns.name: Unmerged local activations
patterns.context: These triggers occur in hotel terms, legal institution names, immigration litigation bodies, or case titles; the available passages do not establish a condition more unified than local lexical associations.

10_1774.description: 激活分布在俄语“Пример”、法律判例标题及正文、酒店促销词和邮件日程时间等不同语境；除俄语词例及若干局部词汇外，看不出统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 俄语示例词“Пример”
patterns.context: 俄语文本中“Пример”（例子）一词的词内片段；该词在两段中都位于代码或数据示例附近。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答，俄语说明与示例

patterns.name: 法律案件标题中的散落强激活
patterns.context: 法律材料的案件标题、法院信息、日期或正文中出现的局部 token；除 [1]、[7] 的 filed 外，其余触发位置并无明显一致的词汇或句法模式。

patterns.name: 酒店促销文案中的 RESORT
patterns.context: 大写酒店优惠条款中，词语 RESORT 被切分成多个 token；两处均处在关于度假村费用或预览的宣传语里。

patterns.name: 邮件时间与日程表达
patterns.context: 邮件中的具体时间和会议、活动安排。激活分散在时刻数字、冒号、AM/PM 或 noon 等片段，未见稳定一致的单一触发词。
patterns.domain: Enron 工作邮件、活动通知

patterns.name: 未能归并的局部激活
patterns.trigger: « Thanksgiving»、« black»«out»、« fee»；« rights»、« DH»«HR»、« Department»；« Judge»、« application»、« asylum»；以及案件名称中的词片段
patterns.context: 这些触发分别出现在酒店条款、法律机构名称、移民诉讼正文或案件标题中；无法从现有片段确定比局部词汇关联更统一的条件。

en.description: Covers deadlines and ruling language in court orders, legal filings and procedural headings, immigration applications, and precise deadlines and event schedules in emails. The commonality leans toward dates, times, filings, and case matters in procedural texts, but not a single trigger word.

patterns.name: Deadlines and court language in rulings
patterns.context: A deadline appears in the body of an order or ruling, or the court decides or orders something about a document; activation concentrates on dates, court instructions, and related wording.

patterns.name: Precise times and deadline requirements in emails
patterns.context: An email asks recipients to submit information by a specific time that day; punctuation and digits in the time activate most strongly.

patterns.name: Filed in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Describes a party filing an application, petition, or other legal document; appears across multiple cases and document types.

patterns.name: Procedural categories in legal document captions
patterns.context: Case captions or case titles in uppercase typography identify an original disciplinary proceeding or habeas corpus petition.

patterns.name: Applications and status adjustment in immigration cases
patterns.context: Case facts describe entry, immigration status, and applications to the government for adjustment of status.

patterns.name: Event and auction dates and times in emails
patterns.context: Promotes an event and lists its start date and time; time punctuation and digits are prominent.

10_1774.description: 涵盖法院命令中的截止日期与裁定措辞、法律文书提交及程序标题、移民申请，以及邮件中的精确截止时间和活动日程。共同点偏向程序性文本中的日期、时刻、提交和案件事项，但并非单一触发词。

patterns.name: 法庭裁定中的期限与法院措辞
patterns.context: 命令或裁定正文中出现截止日期，或法院对文书作出决定、命令时；激活集中于日期、法院指示和相关措辞。

patterns.name: 邮件中的精确时间与截止要求
patterns.trigger: “BY 2:00 PM TODAY”，尤其时间中的“:”和数字
patterns.context: 邮件要求收件人当天某一具体时刻前提交信息；时间标点和数字处激活最强。

patterns.name: 法律程序中的 filed
patterns.context: 描述当事人提交申请、请愿书或其他法律文件；多个案件和法律文书类型中均出现。

patterns.name: 法律文书标题中的程序类别
patterns.trigger: “ORIGINAL PROCEEDING IN DISCIPLINE”“ON APPLICATION FOR A WRIT OF HABEAS CORPUS”
patterns.context: 案件标题或案由以大写排印，标明原始纪律程序或人身保护令申请。

patterns.name: 移民案件中的申请及身份调整
patterns.context: 叙述入境、移民身份以及向政府申请身份调整的案件事实。

patterns.name: 邮件中的活动与拍卖日期时间
patterns.context: 宣传活动并列出开始日期和时间；时间标点及数字突出。

en.concept: Formatted text and local subword fragments
en.description: Activation is most noticeably concentrated on time, date, and colon-separated number formats; it also appears in uppercase headings and structured fields. There are isolated responses to auctions, legal phrasing, long technical subword fragments, and fragments within Polish words, making it difficult to assign a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Times and clock times after a colon
patterns.context: A time expression places a colon, numbers, a time-of-day marker, or a date next to one another; activation is distributed across the time digits and their formatting symbols.
patterns.domain: Email deadlines, Wikipedia service hours, legal dates and time limits

patterns.name: All-uppercase headings or formatted fields
patterns.context: Uppercase headings, table fields, email instructions, or document section labels, often accompanied by line breaks, padded spaces, or punctuation.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, email, calendar data, and web entries

patterns.name: Auction terms in auction and event notices
patterns.context: JDF charity auction notice; Auction is split into multiple tokens, with both occurrences strongly activating.

patterns.name: Specific names, pronouns, and handover phrasing
patterns.context: Legal narratives mention parties, filing an application, or handover phrasing; activation falls on pronouns and litigation-action words.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings and immigration law texts

patterns.name: Fragments within a specific long technical word
patterns.context: A StackExchange technical Q&A splits the long compound word multithreading; strong activation is concentrated on the “ith” fragment.

patterns.name: Fragments within Polish words
patterns.context: In a Polish sentence, activation falls within the tokenized word nadmiernie (excessively); there is no clear shared context with the other samples.

patterns.name: Time zone database fields
patterns.context: Structured fields appear in iCalendar/time zone rule text; these markers activate only weakly.

patterns.name: Insurance/benefit plan terms
patterns.context: A benefits plan promotional heading in email; Enrollment and several uppercase word fragments activate strongly.

10_1774.concept: 格式化文本与局部词片段
10_1774.description: 激活较明显地集中在时间、日期及冒号数字格式；也见于大写标题和结构化字段。另对拍卖、法律措辞、技术长词片段及波兰语词内片段有孤立响应，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 冒号后时间与钟点
patterns.context: 时间表达中冒号、数字、时段标记或日期相邻；激活分布在时间数字及其格式符号上。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的截止时间、维基百科服务时间、法律日期与时限

patterns.name: 全大写标题或格式化字段
patterns.trigger: 「NO FURTHER MOTIONS FOR EXTENSION OF TIME TO FILE」「THE APPELLANT’S BRIEF」「PLEASE SEND A LIST」「BEGIN:DAYLIGHT」「DEFERRAL ENROLLMENT」「Fares」
patterns.context: 大写标题、表格字段、邮件指令或文档分节标签，常伴随换行、空格填充或标点。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、邮件、日历数据及网页条目

patterns.name: 拍卖与活动通知中的拍卖词
patterns.context: JDF 慈善拍卖通知，Auction 被拆分为多个 token，两个出现位置均强激活。

patterns.name: 特定姓名代词及移交措辞
patterns.context: 法律叙述中出现当事人、递交申请或移交措辞；激活落在代词及诉讼行为词上。
patterns.domain: 法律裁判及移民法文本

patterns.name: 特定技术长词内部片段
patterns.context: StackExchange 技术问答中，长复合词 multithreading 被拆分；强激活集中于「ith」片段。

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 波兰语句子中，激活落在被切分的词 nadmiernie（过度地）内部；与其余样本缺少明显共同语境。

patterns.name: 时区数据库字段
patterns.context: iCalendar/时区规则文本中出现结构化字段；这些标记仅为弱激活。

patterns.name: 保险/福利计划术语
patterns.context: 邮件中的福利计划宣传标题，Enrollment 和若干大写词片段较强。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件／员工福利宣传

en.description: Activations are scattered across fragments within Polish and Hungarian words, times and judicial vocabulary in legal documents, punctuation and formatting, and an auction word in one email; no stable shared trigger explains all fragments.

patterns.name: Emphasized time/deadline expressions
patterns.context: Duration, date, or deadline information appears around trigger locations; the specific word classes triggered vary across examples, and some time expressions are unmarked.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary text, immigration law provisions, judicial opinions

patterns.name: Polish subword fragments within words
patterns.context: Activation is scattered within Polish words, mostly on token or subword fragments; no consistent meaning or syntactic position is evident.

patterns.name: Fragments within Hungarian words
patterns.context: Activation occurs within or at the ends of Hungarian words; the fragments involve different words and lack stable semantic or grammatical commonalities.

patterns.name: Local fragments in judicial documents
patterns.context: Appears in judicial records such as court opinions, sentencing hearings, or prison sentences; apart from “in,” the activated words differ.

patterns.name: Punctuation and line breaks
patterns.context: Appears in legal provisions, legal opinions, and emails; some markers correspond to layout or line breaks, with no stable condition extending beyond the genre.
patterns.domain: Legal text, emails, and formatted text

patterns.name: Auction event words in emails
patterns.context: Appears in a charity email promoting the start date of an online auction.

10_1774.description: 激活分散于波兰语、匈牙利语词内片段、法律文书的时间与司法词语、标点排版，以及一封邮件的拍卖词；未见能解释全部片段的稳定共同触发。

patterns.name: 被强调的时间/期限表达
patterns.trigger: «nadm«ier»10nie»（波兰语“过度地”）；«72»3« hours»4« advance»6« notice»4；«180»4« days»4；«July»1« 24»1, 2000
patterns.context: 触发位置周围有时长、日期或期限信息；各例中触发的具体词类并不一致，且有些时间表达未标记
patterns.domain: 议会文本、移民法条文、司法判决

patterns.name: 波兰语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在波兰语单词内部，多为分词或子词片段；未见一致的词义或句法位置

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活位于匈牙利语词内部或词尾；片段涉及不同词，缺少稳定的语义或语法共性
patterns.domain: EuroParl 匈牙利语议会文本

patterns.name: 司法文书中的局部片段
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见、量刑听证或监禁判决等司法记录中；除“in”外，激活词并不相同

patterns.name: 标点与换行
patterns.context: 出现在法律条文、法律意见及邮件文本中，部分标记对应排版或换行；没有显示稳定的文体外共同条件
patterns.domain: 法律文本、邮件及版式文本

patterns.name: 邮件中的拍卖活动词
patterns.context: 出现在慈善机构邮件对在线拍卖开始日期的宣传中

en.concept: Prominent proper names and labels in formatted documents
en.description: Activation occurs mainly in formatted legal texts: case captions, court document templates, precedent disclaimers, and benefits and immigration law provisions; it also activates strongly on uppercase names such as UNION and RECEPTION in email event headings. A likely common factor is formatted headings/legal document structure rather than a single word meaning.

patterns.name: Union/event labels in headings
patterns.context: Appears in event names or uppercase headings in email bodies; often preceded or followed by line breaks, dates, or location information

patterns.name: U.S. federal appellate case citations and captions
patterns.context: Formatted captions in legal decisions or court documents, typically consisting of case names, docket numbers, appellate court, circuit, and decision date

patterns.name: Typeset fields and template phrasing in legal documents
patterns.context: Signature/title fields or blank formatting at the start of a document, or procedural template language; activation also falls on spaces, numbers, and ordinary legal words
patterns.domain: FreeLaw court orders or litigation documents

patterns.name: Precedential-effect language in decision notices
patterns.context: Standard disclaimer in a decision or disposition opinion stating that the document has no binding precedential effect

patterns.name: Veterans' education benefit eligibility notice
patterns.context: Describes a VA notice informing an individual that they qualify for education benefits and specifying the number of months available

patterns.name: Statutory language on removal enforcement proceedings
patterns.context: Legal provision or citation requiring a non-detained alien to receive written notice of transfer after a removal order takes effect

10_1774.concept: 格式化文书中的醒目专名与标签
10_1774.description: 激活主要出现在格式化法律文本：判例案头、法院文书模板、先例免责声明及福利和移民法条文；另在邮件活动标题的 UNION、RECEPTION 等大写名称中强烈激活。共同因素可能是格式化标题/法律公文结构，而非单一词义。

patterns.name: 标题中的联合/活动标签
patterns.context: 出现在邮件正文的活动名称或大写标题中；前后常有换行、日期或地点信息

patterns.name: 美国联邦上诉判例引注与案头信息
patterns.context: 法律判决或法院文件中，常见案件名称、案号、上诉法院、巡回区和判决日期组成的格式化案头

patterns.name: 法律文书中的排版字段与模板措辞
patterns.context: 文书开头的署名/职务栏、空白排版，或程序性模板语言；激活也落在空格、数字及普通法律词上
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法院命令或诉讼文件

patterns.name: 判决说明中的先例效力措辞
patterns.context: 判决或处置意见中的标准免责声明，说明文件不具约束性先例效力

patterns.name: 退伍军人教育福利资格通知
patterns.context: 叙述 VA 通知个人符合教育福利资格及可领取月数
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 行政/退伍军人福利案件

patterns.name: 递解执行程序的法条措辞
patterns.context: 规定递解令生效后，非羁押外国人须收到书面移交通知的法律条文或引文

en.description: Activation is distributed across legal document headings, procedures, and statutory provisions, fragments within Polish words, and uppercase promotional headings in email; there is no clear cross-domain commonality, and local activations often fall on prominent formatting or specific word fragments.

patterns.name: Formatting markers in judicial documents
patterns.context: Uppercase headings or formatted fields such as the case caption, party identities, and judgment conclusion at the top of a page; blank padding and line breaks are also prominent

patterns.name: Fragments within Polish words
patterns.context: Activation falls inside tokenized Polish words, for example jas-no, statystycz-nych, nad-mier-nie; these are not stable complete-word boundaries

patterns.name: Sentencing procedure and hearing records
patterns.context: Procedural account in a criminal case involving a presentence investigation, hearing, and whether the record was filed

patterns.name: Tables and campaign/event promotional headings
patterns.context: Prominent abbreviations or all-uppercase event headings in email, often presented as split word fragments; topics include charity auctions, election registration, or party reservations

patterns.name: Immigration removal provisions
patterns.context: Requirements for notice, transfer time, and location after a final removal order takes effect
patterns.domain: FreeLaw immigration statutes or cited decisions

patterns.name: Veterans' education benefit eligibility
patterns.context: Describes the Department of Veterans Affairs issuing a certificate of eligibility and the number of months of education benefits

10_1774.description: 激活分布在法律文书的标题、程序与法条，以及波兰语词内片段和邮件里的大写宣传标题；跨领域共性不明确，局部常落在醒目格式或特定词片段上。

patterns.name: 司法文书中的格式标记
patterns.context: 页首案名、当事人身份及判决结论等大写标题或排版字段；空白填充和换行也明显

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的波兰语词内部，例如 jas-no、statystycz-nych、nad-mier-nie；不是稳定的完整词边界

patterns.name: 量刑程序及听证记录
patterns.context: 刑事案件中量刑前调查、听证及记录是否归档等程序叙述

patterns.name: 表格与竞选/活动宣传标题
patterns.context: 邮件中醒目的缩写或全大写活动标题，常以断开的词片段呈现；主题涉及慈善拍卖、选举报名或聚会预订

patterns.name: 移民递解规定
patterns.context: 最终递解令生效后，规定通知、交接时间与地点等要求
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 移民法条文或判决引文

patterns.name: 退伍军人教育福利资格
patterns.context: 叙述退伍军人事务部门签发资格证明及教育福利月份数
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 行政福利/退伍军人权益案件

en.concept: Tendency toward legal documents and procedural narratives
en.description: Activation spans multiple languages and genres; the clearest clustering involves legal procedures, adjudicative language, and eligibility status, with additional occurrences in date scheduling, email rescheduling, and Polish discussion. It is difficult to reduce to a single semantic or stable lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Factual or judgment clauses introduced by that
patterns.context: A complete statement follows that, often describing a court order, eligibility, procedural status, or investigative conclusion; [2] instead appears near the Polish substring “danych statystycznych, które,” a superficial similarity that does not establish the same grammatical pattern.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, parliamentary speeches, and general emails

patterns.name: Legal procedures and adjudicative language
patterns.context: Legal case narratives, court orders, hearings, and criminal proceedings; includes formal adjudicative wording and procedural case records.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal documents and legal news reports

patterns.name: Months, dates, and time scheduling
patterns.context: Specific dates or relative time expressions establish when a proceeding occurred or schedule a meeting or call.

patterns.name: Eligibility, entitlement, or status determination
patterns.context: States that someone has legal capacity or qualifies for benefits.
patterns.domain: Criminal law reporting, veterans' benefits administrative records

patterns.name: Degree or inference expressions in Polish
patterns.context: Appears in parliamentary discussion such as “z danych statystycznych, które mamy dzisiaj przed sobą, jasno wynika,” meaning “clearly,” emphasizing a conclusion drawn from statistical data.

patterns.name: Polish medical protection and excessive prolongation
patterns.context: Used near “przedłużający… chronionym przed nadmiernie…,” concerning protection of patients and some form of excessive prolongation.

patterns.name: Polite postponement or follow-up in business emails
patterns.context: Reschedules a planned call and says they will get in touch later or next week.

patterns.name: Vietnamese document description text
patterns.context: A Markdown page overview describes documentation for saving the current version of a webpage; activation is distributed within Vietnamese words, with no clear feature shared with the other passages.

patterns.name: Case number and party caption format
patterns.context: Case number, parties, and state name formatted in the opening caption of a court document.

10_1774.concept: 法律文书与程序叙述倾向
10_1774.description: 激活跨越多语种与文体；较明显的聚集是法律程序、裁判措辞及资格状态，也涉及日期安排、邮件改期和波兰语论述。另有越南语文档说明。难以归结为单一语义或稳定词法触发。

patterns.name: that 引导的事实或判断从句
patterns.context: that 后接完整陈述，常说明法院命令、资格、程序状态或调查结论；[2] 中则出现于波兰语子串“danych statystycznych, które”附近，只有表面相似，不能确定同一语法模式
patterns.domain: 法律文书、议会发言及一般邮件

patterns.name: 法律程序与裁判文书措辞
patterns.context: 法律案件叙述、法院命令、听证及刑事程序；包括正式裁判用语和案情程序记录
patterns.domain: 美国法律文书及新闻法律报道

patterns.name: 月份、日期与时间安排
patterns.context: 具体日期或相对时间表达，交代程序发生时间或安排会议、通话

patterns.name: 资格、权益或状态认定
patterns.context: 说明某人具备法律能力或符合资格、可获得福利
patterns.domain: 刑事法律报道、退伍军人福利行政记录

patterns.name: 波兰语中的程度或推断表达
patterns.context: 出现在“z danych statystycznych, które mamy dzisiaj przed sobą, jasno wynika”一类议会论述中，意为“明确地”，强调由统计数据得出的结论

patterns.name: 波兰语医疗保护与过度延长
patterns.context: 用于“przedłużający… chronionym przed nadmiernie…”附近，涉及对患者的保护及某种过度延长
patterns.domain: 波兰语议会或政策论述

patterns.name: 商务邮件中的委婉延期或后续联络
patterns.context: 安排原定通话改期，并告知稍后或下周再联系

patterns.name: 越南语文档说明文字
patterns.trigger: “Trang web này lưu tài liệu của phiên bản hiện tại”
patterns.context: Markdown 页面概览中，描述网页保存当前版本的文档；激活分布在越南语词内，缺少与其他段明确共享的特征
patterns.domain: Github 文档／网页说明，越南语

patterns.name: 案号与当事人标题格式
patterns.context: 法院文书开头的案号、当事人及州名排版标题

en.description: Primarily responds to the headers, litigation identity information, procedural orders, and deadlines of U.S. legal documents; it also responds to word fragments in Polish statistical speeches and the COPYRIGHT HOLDER field in source-code copyright templates.

patterns.name: Procedural deadlines in court orders
patterns.context: A court order, ruling, or decision specifies a deadline for filing, notice, or performance; activation is distributed across procedural wording and nearby deadlines

patterns.name: Headers and case information in appellate court documents
patterns.context: Typeset headers, case numbers, panel, and procedural information in appellate court decisions or dockets; activation often falls around uppercase headings, line breaks, and case names

patterns.name: Litigants and attorney signature information
patterns.context: A legal filing lists counsel, party identities, or docket source, often adjacent to the judge's name, court name, and date

patterns.name: Orders to court clerks to file the record
patterns.context: An appellate proceeding requires the court clerk to file the record within a specified deadline; this passage also exhibits the procedural-deadline pattern in court orders

patterns.name: Fragments within Polish words in statistical discussion
patterns.context: A Polish parliamentary speech discusses reports, data, and statistical results; activation falls on several tokenized word fragments rather than English legal formatting

patterns.name: Copyright holder field in a Github copyright template
patterns.context: A comment template in a source file header containing the placeholders YEAR, PACKAGE, and a copyright holder field

10_1774.description: 主要响应美国法律文书的版头、诉讼身份信息及程序命令与期限；另响应波兰语统计发言中的词片段，以及源码版权模板里的 COPYRIGHT HOLDER 字段。

patterns.name: 法院裁定正文中的程序期限
patterns.trigger: “within” + 天数/日期，如 “within 120 days”“within FIFTEEN DAYS”；以及 “shall”“ORDER”“date of this order”
patterns.context: 法院命令、裁定或判决正文中规定提交、通知或履行期限；激活分布在程序性措辞及期限附近

patterns.name: 法院上诉案文书的版头与案情信息
patterns.trigger: “COURT OF APPEALS”“Appeal from”“Judgment of Sentence”“In re”“No.”，以及法院、地区、当事人和日期等标题信息
patterns.context: 上诉法院判决或案卷的排版式抬头、案件编号、合议庭及程序信息；激活常落在大写标题、换行和案名周围

patterns.name: 诉讼当事人与律师署名信息
patterns.trigger: 律师姓名、律所和身份说明，如 “Attorney”“for Appellee”“for Appellant”“LLP”“of counsel”“respondent”
patterns.context: 诉讼文书中列出代理律师、当事人身份或案卷来源，常与法官姓名、法院名称和日期相邻

patterns.name: 法庭记录员及提交记录的命令
patterns.context: 上诉程序要求法院记录员在指定期限内提交记录；此段同时含有裁定正文期限模式

patterns.name: 波兰语统计论述中的词内片段
patterns.trigger: “danych statystycznych”及其被拆分标记的词内片段，如 «any»、«yst»、«cz»；另有 «jas»
patterns.context: 波兰语议会发言中讨论报告、数据和统计结果；激活落在若干被分词切开的词片段，而非英语法律格式
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录／波兰语发言

patterns.name: Github 版权模板中的版权持有人字段
patterns.trigger: “COPYRIGHT H” + “OL” + “DER”，组成 “COPYRIGHT HOLDER”；以及模板标题 “SOME DESCRIPTIVE TITLE”
patterns.context: 源码文件头部的注释模板，含占位符 YEAR、PACKAGE 和版权持有人字段

en.concept: Procedural formatting in documents and clauses
en.description: Most strongly responds to court orders and litigation procedure texts, especially filing documents, deadlines, dates, ORDER, and document layout; it also covers court personnel listings, two passages of multilingual European Parliament text, and hotel promotional terms.

patterns.name: Deadlines and filings in legal orders
patterns.context: A court order or appellate proceeding specifies that a party or court staff must file materials such as a brief or record by a particular deadline; often accompanied by uppercase command words, dates, and line-break formatting.

patterns.name: Court procedural rulings and litigation participants
patterns.context: Discusses court rulings, appellant motions, hearings, or party obligations; even without an explicit filing deadline, the context is legal procedure.
patterns.domain: U.S. court decisions and legal rules

patterns.name: Formatting and end matter metadata in judicial documents
patterns.context: The title, blank lines, or issuance/filing date of a court order, especially in the document's closing section.

patterns.name: Romance-language affixes and in-sentence elements in European Parliament text
patterns.context: In multilingual European Parliament corpora, activation falls within tokenized words; the Polish passage concerns statistics and questions, while the Romanian passage concerns the Palestinian people and their suffering.

patterns.name: Attorney and judge names/titles in legal documents
patterns.context: Listings of attorneys involved in a case and the presiding judge, including location abbreviations, parenthetical argued markers, and uppercase surnames.

patterns.name: Package restrictions in hotel promotions
patterns.context: Hotel or resort offer terms emphasizing fees, room types, applicable dates, and additional conditions in all caps.

10_1774.concept: 文书与条款中的程序性格式
10_1774.description: 最明显地响应法院命令和诉讼程序文本，尤其是提交文件、期限、日期、ORDER及文书排版；另覆盖法院人员列名、两段欧洲议会多语种文本，以及酒店促销条款。

patterns.name: 法律命令中的时间期限与提交文件
patterns.context: 法院命令或上诉程序中，规定当事人或法院工作人员在特定期限内提交 brief、record 等材料；常伴随大写命令词、日期和换行格式。

patterns.name: 法院程序裁定及诉讼参与者
patterns.context: 讨论法院裁定、上诉人动议、听证或当事人义务；即使没有明确提交期限，也处于法律程序语境。
patterns.domain: 美国法院裁判文书与法律规则

patterns.name: 裁判文书的格式与末尾元数据
patterns.context: 法院命令的标题、排版空行或文书签发/归档日期，尤其是文末格式区域。

patterns.name: 欧洲议会文本中的罗曼语词缀与句内成分
patterns.context: 多语种欧洲议会语料中，激活落在被分词切开的词内部；波兰语段落涉及统计数据和问题，罗马尼亚语段落涉及巴勒斯坦人民及其苦难。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会多语种政治文本

patterns.name: 法律文书中的律师及法官姓名/头衔
patterns.context: 案件参与律师和审理法官的列名，含地点缩写、括号中的 argued 标注及姓氏大写格式。

patterns.name: 酒店促销广告中的套餐限制
patterns.trigger: “reservations” “Must travel before” “blackout dates” “Free Room Type” “NO RESORT FEE”
patterns.context: 酒店或度假村优惠条款，以全大写强调费用、房型、适用日期及附加条件。

en.description: The examples span multiple languages and genres: judicial texts, business notices, promotional copy, and parliamentary discussion. Local triggers vary and include dates and times, procedural boilerplate, punctuation, fragments within words, and emphasized terms; there is no stable common trigger pattern across passages.

patterns.name: Sentence/clause conclusions and connective expressions
patterns.context: In a Polish parliamentary report, expresses a judgment or inference meaning “it is clear... it follows from this...”; activation falls mainly on “jasno”.

patterns.name: English function words and time expressions
patterns.context: Email describing a deadline, work arrangements, and sending a table; activation is concentrated around “end of the day Wednesday”.

patterns.name: Procedural boilerplate and name punctuation in judicial orders
patterns.context: A court order contains fixed legal phrasing and uses commas and abbreviation periods around the judge's name and title; activation is relatively dense in this judicial document passage.

patterns.name: Scheduling notices and time formats
patterns.context: A notice schedules a meeting or make-up class time, with a date, clock time, and follow-up notice; activation is concentrated on “later”.

patterns.name: Fragments within German words and word continuations
patterns.context: In German academic discussion, words are split into subwords or continue across fragments; activation covers within-word fragments, with no clear single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Decision dates, procedure, and hearings
patterns.context: A criminal case describes procedural steps, a decision, and dates; activation highlights “hearing” and nearby verbs and time information.

patterns.name: Abbreviations and periods in legal citations
patterns.context: An immigration ruling cites precedent using case names, institutional abbreviations, and formal citation punctuation; activation falls especially on “v.”.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, judicial decisions and legal citations

patterns.name: Formal Czech expressions and word-form fragments
patterns.context: Czech parliamentary text contains formal expressions about deadlines, thanks, and success; activation is distributed across several word fragments with diacritics.

patterns.name: Promotional terms and uppercase restrictions
patterns.context: A hotel or travel offer lists booking and travel dates, applicable restrictions, and emphasized uppercase terms; activation is concentrated on blackout- and resort-related words.

patterns.name: Phone calls, reported speech, and time in legal narratives
patterns.context: A case narrative recounts a caller's identity and statement, as well as an expected discharge time; activation highlights “about” and the time expression following it.

10_1774.description: 片段分属多种语言和文体：司法文本、商务通知、促销文案及议会论述等。局部触发各异，涉及日期时间、程序套语、标点、词内片段和强调条款；没有跨段稳定的共同触发模式。

patterns.name: 句子/分句结论与连接表达
patterns.context: 在波兰语议会报告语句中，表达“显然……由此得出……”的判断或推论；激活主要落在“jasno”。

patterns.name: 英语功能词与时间表达
patterns.context: 邮件中描述截止时间、工作安排及表格发送；激活明显集中于“end of the day Wednesday”一带。

patterns.name: 司法命令中的程序套语与姓名标点
patterns.trigger: “It is further ORDERED that”以及“Lerma, Sr.,”
patterns.context: 法院命令中出现固定法律措辞，并在法官姓名及头衔周围使用逗号、缩写句点；激活在该司法文书片段中较密集。

patterns.name: 排期通知与时间格式
patterns.trigger: “scheduled for Tuesday, March 13, 2001 at 3:30 p.m.”；“announced later”
patterns.context: 通知安排会议或补课时段，附带日期、钟点及后续通知；激活集中在“later”。

patterns.name: 德语词内形态片段与词语延续
patterns.context: 德语学术论述中，词被分成子词或跨片段延续；激活覆盖词内片段，未见明确的单一语义触发点。

patterns.name: 裁判日期、程序与听证会
patterns.trigger: “court ordered a pre-sentence investigation”; “A sentencing hearing was held”
patterns.context: 刑事案件叙述程序步骤、裁判及日期；激活突出“hearing”及其附近的动词和时间信息。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的缩写与句点
patterns.context: 移民诉讼判决援引先例时出现案件名、机构缩写和正式引证标点；激活尤其落在“v.”。

patterns.name: 捷克语正式表达及词形片段
patterns.trigger: “lhůta”, “děkování”, “úspěšné”及其带变音符号的子词片段
patterns.context: 捷克语议会文本中出现期限、致谢和成功等正式表达；激活分布在多个含变音符号的词内片段。

patterns.name: 促销条款与大写限制语
patterns.context: 酒店或旅行优惠说明中，列出预订、出行日期、适用限制和大写强调条款；激活集中于 blackout 和 resort 相关字词。

patterns.name: 法律叙事中的电话、转述与时间
patterns.trigger: “telephone call”, “represented that”, “was due to come out of the hospital in about a week”
patterns.context: 案件事实叙述中转述来电者身份、陈述及预计出院时间；激活突出“about”及其后的时间表达。

en.description: Activations are distributed across calendar scheduling, invitations, reunions, and meeting postponements in emails, as well as court procedures, orders, and agency responsibilities in legal texts; two additional Polish passages contain fragments within words. Shared trigger features are unclear.

patterns.name: Calendar invitations and scheduling in emails
patterns.context: Scheduling information in invitations or notices, including dates, times, locations, and attendance confirmation; high activations also occur on time expressions and nearby words.

patterns.name: Ruling and order language in legal documents
patterns.context: Conditional procedural provisions, orders, rulings, and filing deadlines in court documents; activation may fall on pronouns, imperatives, dates, and legal terms.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw legal opinions and court orders

patterns.name: Legal representation and fiduciary duties
patterns.context: Legal narratives involving lawyers or agents acting for parties or clients and handling funds.

patterns.name: Fragments within Polish prose
patterns.context: Continuous Polish prose; highlights often fall on fragments within words split by tokenization, with no consistent English lexical or formatting trigger shared with other passages.

patterns.name: Party and reunion emails
patterns.context: Personal emails discuss reunions, reservations, or postcards; activation concentrates on event names and related object words.

patterns.name: Meeting postponement notices
patterns.context: An all-caps notice announces a meeting cancellation or postponement and explains that it will be rescheduled later.

10_1774.description: 激活分布于邮件中的日程、邀请、重聚会和会议延期，以及法院程序、命令、代理责任等法律文本；另见两段波兰语词内片段。共同触发特征不明确。

patterns.name: 邮件中的日历邀请与安排
patterns.trigger: «Mark your calendar»、«for Nov. 30th 6:00 pm to 9:00 pm»、«scheduled for Tuesday, March 13, 2001»、«Location information»、«confirm your attendance»
patterns.context: 邀请或通知中的日期、时间、地点、出席确认等安排信息；高激活也落在时间表达及周边词语上。

patterns.name: 法律裁定与命令措辞
patterns.trigger: «it»（“If ... hearing, it shall determine”中的 it）、«THE APPELLANT’S BRIEF WILL BE CONSIDERED BY THIS COURT»、«It is further ORDERED»、«GRANTED»、«shall be filed»
patterns.context: 法院文书中的条件性程序规定、命令、裁定及提交期限；激活可落在代词、命令语、日期和法律术语上。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法律意见与法院命令

patterns.name: 法律代理与受托责任
patterns.trigger: «Mr. McArthur»、«shall take action»、«protect the interests»、«respondent’s clients»、«make disbursements»
patterns.context: 涉及律师或代理人对当事人、客户采取行动及处理资金的法律叙述。

patterns.name: 波兰语正文中的词内片段
patterns.context: 波兰语连续正文；高亮多落在被分词切开的词内片段，未见与其他段一致的英文词汇或格式触发。

patterns.name: 聚会与重聚会邮件
patterns.context: 私人邮件谈及重聚会、预订或明信片；激活集中在活动名称及相关物件词。

patterns.name: 会议延期通知
patterns.trigger: «ALL CURRENTLY SCHEDULED BUDGET MEETINGS ARE BEING POSTPONED»、«RESCHEDULED AT A LATER DATE»
patterns.context: 以全大写格式发布会议取消或延期，并说明之后改期。

en.description: Activation is scattered across the Polish word jasno (“clearly”), court orders and ruling boilerplate and the names in them, and also appears in an employment agency name, a business event invitation, and a description of forest regions; there is no stable shared trigger across these contexts.

patterns.name: Polish “clearly”
patterns.context: Means “clearly/obviously” in a Polish sentence, followed by an explanation or judgment

patterns.name: Legal orders and ruling boilerplate
patterns.context: Body text or formatted heading of a court ruling, appellate proceeding, or order

patterns.name: Personal names in legal documents
patterns.context: Names appear in ruling captions, attorney/clerk signatures, or court records
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, proper names in court documents

patterns.name: Employment services agency name
patterns.context: Mentions an agency that provides employment opportunities to former inmates in a probation context

patterns.name: Business event invitation wording
patterns.context: Email invites recipients to add an event on a particular date to their calendar

patterns.name: Description of forest regions
patterns.context: In Polish, describes residents or regions of northern Europe and discusses forests

10_1774.description: 激活分散于波兰语“jasno（清楚地）”、法院命令与裁定套语及其中的人名，也出现在就业机构名称、商务活动邀请和森林地域描述中；这些上下文之间没有稳定共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 波兰语“清楚地”
patterns.context: 波兰语句子中表示“清楚地／显然地”，后接说明或判断

patterns.name: 法律命令与裁定套语
patterns.trigger: «DEC»1«ISION & ORDER»；«ORDER»；«this»9« order»；«THE»3« APPE»3LL«ANT»2«’»3«S»4 BRI«EF»2；«appeal»3« is»3« dismissed»2
patterns.context: 法院裁定、上诉程序或命令的正文与格式化标题

patterns.name: 法律文书中的人物姓名
patterns.context: 姓名出现在裁定标题、律师／书记员署名或法院记录中

patterns.name: 就业服务机构名称
patterns.context: 缓刑监管背景下，提及为前囚犯提供就业机会的机构

patterns.name: 企业活动邀请语
patterns.context: 邮件邀请收件人将某一日期的活动加入日历

patterns.name: 森林地域描述
patterns.context: 波兰语中描述欧洲北部居民或地区，并谈及森林

en.concept: Heterogeneous word fragments and legal-document cues
en.description: Activation is distributed across procedural language and layout in English court documents, legal proper names and body text, as well as email announcements; it also appears in fragments within Polish words. Fragment boundaries, capitalization, and layout may be common factors, but the passages lack a single stable lexical trigger.

patterns.name: English word fragments or within-word boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on complete words, constituent word fragments, or prefixes/infix substrings, without a consistent meaning or syntactic position.

patterns.name: Court document formatting and legal procedural language
patterns.context: Court orders, docket headings, or decision body text; formal document formatting also includes courts, deadlines, dates, and filing markers.

patterns.name: Polish orthography and within-word substrings
patterns.context: Activation is located in letter fragments within Polish words; some fragments cross morpheme boundaries or adjoin Polish diacritics, with no stable semantic condition evident.
patterns.domain: Polish parliamentary speeches, prayers, or texts

patterns.name: Names, proper nouns, and uppercase strings
patterns.context: Uppercase proper names in legal case captions or court personnel names; activation appears within portions of names and may also be an artifact of tokenization.

patterns.name: Numbers, identifiers, and document layout
patterns.context: Activation appears near identifiers, separator lines, line breaks, and docket dates; it accompanies the layout structure of legal documents, but the trigger is not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Common words or fixed terms in English legal texts
patterns.context: Some ordinary words and legal/probation terms activate in accounts of immigration status applications or probation supervision; no common semantic trigger can be confirmed.
patterns.domain: Immigration law and criminal justice decisions

patterns.name: Auction announcement wording in email
patterns.context: Email promotes an online auction for a charity; activation is scattered across proper names and event announcement words.

10_1774.concept: 异质词片段与法律文书线索
10_1774.description: 激活分布于英文法院文书的程序用语与版式、法律专名和正文，以及邮件公告；另见波兰语词内片段。片段边界、大小写和排版可能是共同因素，但各段缺少单一稳定词义触发。

patterns.name: 英文单词片段或词内边界
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词、词的组成片段或词首/词内子串上，且没有一致的词义或句法位置。

patterns.name: 法院文书格式与法律程序措辞
patterns.trigger: «this» Court« within»…« days»…« date»…« order»（[2][6]）；«Do not» publish（[2][6]）；«V»«.»10（[4]）
patterns.context: 法院命令、案卷标题或判决正文；同时出现法院、期限、日期、发布标记等正式文书格式。

patterns.name: 波兰语正字法与词内子串
patterns.context: 激活位于波兰语词内部的字母片段；有些片段跨越词素或与波兰语变音符号邻接，未显示稳定的词义条件。
patterns.domain: 波兰语议会发言、祷文或文本

patterns.name: 姓名、专名与大写字母串
patterns.context: 法律案名或法院人员姓名中的大写专名，激活出现在姓名内部片段；也可能只是词形分段效应。
patterns.domain: 法律案卷标题、判决署名

patterns.name: 数字、编号及文书版式
patterns.context: 编号、分隔线、换行及案卷日期附近出现激活；与法律文书的排版结构相伴，但触发点并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 英文法律文本中的常见词或固定术语
patterns.context: 移民身份申请事实陈述或缓刑监管叙述中，部分普通词和法律/监管术语激活；缺少可确认的共同语义触发。
patterns.domain: 移民法与刑事司法判决

patterns.name: 邮件中的拍卖公告用语
patterns.trigger: J«DF» Cyber« Help»… Juvenile Diabetes Foundation… Cyber Auction… «Auction»（[1]）
patterns.context: 邮件宣传慈善机构网络拍卖，激活散布于专名及活动公告词语中。

en.description: The strongest tokens belong to varied situations with no clear shared semantics: Polish jasno, phrases in legal narratives, proper names and split word fragments, as well as email notices and medical terminology; apart from the two Polish passages, each pattern appears only once.

patterns.name: Polish expression for “clearly”
patterns.context: The Polish adverb jasno (“clearly”) appears, often before a verb or together with wynika (“it is evident/it follows”); both examples occur mid-sentence.

patterns.name: English phrase about a week
patterns.context: In a legal narrative, indicates that something will happen in about a week; the surrounding passage discusses discharge and follow-up arrangements.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, legal testimony or case narrative

patterns.name: Within-word letter sequence “mien”
patterns.context: Appears in the Polish word odmienny (different), describing a way of looking at forests.

patterns.name: Within-word letter sequence “ahn”
patterns.context: Appears within the German word angelehnt (based on, drawing on); the passage discusses Kant, Bell, and anti-skeptical ideas.

patterns.name: reception in an event invitation
patterns.context: An email subject lists a calendar date, time, and event name; reception is split into subword fragments.

patterns.name: CARAWAY in a name
patterns.context: Appears as an uppercase surname before the judge's signature in a court decision.

patterns.name: Within-word letter sequence “au”
patterns.context: Appears within Cyber Auction in an email about a charity event; the surrounding text mentions a date and start time.

patterns.name: Address change phrase
patterns.context: A legal case narrative states that a party filed a notice of change of address.

patterns.name: Medical term fragment “atore”
patterns.context: Appears within the medical term Hepatorenal Syndrome.

10_1774.description: 激活最强的 token 分属多种无明显共同语义的情形：波兰语 jasno、法律叙述短语、专名及拆分词片段，以及邮件通知和医学术语；除两段波兰语外，各模式仅见一次。

patterns.name: 波兰语“明确”表达
patterns.context: 出现波兰语副词 jasno（“明确地”），常位于动词前或与 wynika（“可见/得出”）连用；两例均为句中语境。

patterns.name: 英语 about a week 短语
patterns.context: 在法律叙述中表示某事将在大约一周后发生，附近谈到出院及后续安排。

patterns.name: 词内字母序列“mien”
patterns.context: 出现在波兰语 odmienny（不同的）一词中，描述看待森林的方式。

patterns.name: 词内字母序列“ahn”
patterns.context: 出现在德语 angelehnt（借鉴、依凭）一词内部；段落讨论康德、贝尔与反怀疑论观念。

patterns.name: 活动邀请中的 reception
patterns.context: 邮件主题列出日历日期、时间和活动名称，reception 被拆分成子词片段。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件，企业活动通知

patterns.name: 姓名中的 CARAWAY
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决的法官署名前，作为大写姓氏。

patterns.name: 词内字母序列“au”
patterns.context: 出现在邮件中关于慈善活动的 Cyber Auction 一词内，附近提到日期与开始时间。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件，慈善活动通知

patterns.name: 地址变更短语
patterns.context: 法律案件叙述中说明当事人提交地址变更通知。

patterns.name: 医学术语片段“atore”
patterns.context: 出现在 Hepatorenal Syndrome（肝肾综合征）这一医学术语内部。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要，临床研究

en.description: Activation often falls on fragments within split words, commonly names, proper nouns, and long words; other scattered patterns occur in legal procedure terms, event dates and times, Russian word forms, and sports briefs and charity emails. Semantics are not uniform across domains.

patterns.name: Continuation of letter fragments within words
patterns.context: Activation falls on consecutive fragments of the same word, especially when a word is split into multiple subword tokens; the same phenomenon occurs in English, German, and other languages.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in names and proper nouns
patterns.context: When people’s names, place names, or institution names are split into multiple tokens, individual fragments may activate; some fragments are also ordinary words.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, legal case names, and other texts rich in proper nouns

patterns.name: Procedural words in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in case captions or formal legal documents describing case history and litigation dates; the strongest activation is concentrated on the split fragments of “Reargument.”
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions or docket captions

patterns.name: Event invitations and calendar scheduling
patterns.context: Event dates and times occur alongside invitations, with additional wording asking readers to mark their calendars.

patterns.name: Russian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on multiple fragments within Bulgarian Cyrillic words, especially fragments of the word “съществена.”

patterns.name: Scattered word fragments and phrases
patterns.context: These activations occur respectively in a sports injury brief, a charity auction promotion, and a court caption, with no consistent specific semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Sports briefs, charity emails, legal documents

patterns.name: Philosophical terms and German morphological fragments
patterns.context: In German academic sentences discussing Kant, Bayle, and anti-skeptical thought, fragments within several philosophical proper names or terms activate.

10_1774.description: 激活多落在被拆分的词内片段，常见于人名、专名及长词；另有法律程序词、活动日期时间、俄语词形，以及体育简讯和慈善邮件中的零散片段。各领域语义并不统一。

patterns.name: 词内字母片段续写
patterns.context: 激活落在同一词的连续片段上，尤其是词被切成多个子词 token 时；同一现象见于英语、德语及其他语言文字。

patterns.name: 名字与专名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 人名、地名或机构名被拆成多个 token 时，片段可逐一激活；有些片段同时属于普通词。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、法律案名及其他专名密集文本

patterns.name: 法律文书中的程序词
patterns.context: 出现在案件标题或案件历史、诉讼程序日期等正式法律文书语境中；最强激活集中在“Reargument”的拆分片段。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决或案卷标题

patterns.name: 活动邀请与日历安排
patterns.context: 活动日期、时间及邀请事项相邻出现，另有要求读者标记日历的语句。

patterns.name: 俄语词形片段
patterns.context: 激活落在保加利亚语西里尔字母词的多个词内片段上，尤其是“съществена”一词的片段。

patterns.name: 零散词片段及短语
patterns.context: 这些激活分别出现在体育伤病简讯、慈善拍卖宣传和法院抬头中，未见一致的特定语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 体育简讯、慈善邮件、法律文书

patterns.name: 哲学术语及德语形态片段
patterns.context: 在论述康德、巴伊勒及反怀疑论思想的德语学术句子中，若干哲学专名或术语的词内片段激活。

en.description: Activation often falls on substrings within words in different Slavic languages; English examples separately hit an event name, a legal notice reference, an investigation heading, and last in a business email, with no unified English semantics or stable lexical pattern.

patterns.name: Substrings within Slavic words
patterns.context: Activation falls within words in Polish, Czech, or Bulgarian, with no fixed position or meaning; in this sample set, they mainly occur in political and parliamentary texts, as well as one religious text

patterns.name: English calendar and event invitations
patterns.context: Email or promotional notice introduces an event, date, or invitation; activation is concentrated on a local substring of an event name or compound word

patterns.name: this in legal notices
patterns.context: A formal legal document contains the referential phrase “this Notice”; the surrounding context concerns rules, deadlines, and filing objections

patterns.name: Investigation in an investigation passage
patterns.context: An encyclopedia section heading introducing an aviation accident investigation

patterns.name: Local activation on last in energy records
patterns.context: A company email records when natural gas production began flowing; activation falls on “last” in “last week”

10_1774.description: 激活多落在不同斯拉夫语词内部的子串；英语样本则分别命中活动名称、法律通知指称、调查标题和业务邮件中的 last，未见统一英语语义或稳定词法模式。

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语词内子串
patterns.context: 激活落在波兰语、捷克语或保加利亚语的词内部，且位置和词义不固定；该批样本中主要见于政治、议会文本，也有宗教文本

patterns.name: 英文日历与活动邀请
patterns.context: 邮件或宣传通知中介绍活动、日期或邀请；激活集中于活动名称或复合词的局部子串

patterns.name: 法律通知中的 this
patterns.context: 法律文书中出现正式通知的指称短语“this Notice”，相邻语境涉及规则、期限和提交异议

patterns.name: 调查词中的 Investigation
patterns.context: 百科条目小节标题，介绍航空事故调查

patterns.name: 能源记录中 last 的局部激活
patterns.context: 公司邮件记录天然气生产开始流动的时间；激活落在“last week”中的“last”

en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual text and often fall on fragments within words or components of compound words; Polish “jasno” appears twice, alongside scattered patterns in legal documents, medical headings, religious text, and auction notices.

patterns.name: Root word expressing clarity/emphasis
patterns.context: “jasno” means clearly or explicitly; it appears in sentences expressing a position or drawing a conclusion from data.

patterns.name: Specific segments within English compounds
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of English words, hyphenated compounds, or uppercase legal boilerplate; the specific meanings of the fragments are not uniform.

patterns.name: Fragments within Slavic words
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within Slovak, Czech, or Polish words; token boundaries do not always align with complete word meanings.

patterns.name: Auction-related word segments
patterns.context: Appears in promotional language for fundraising events and calendar dates.

10_1774.description: 激活散见于多语种文本，常落在词内片段或复合词成分；波兰语“jasno”出现两次，另有法律文书、医学标题、宗教文本及拍卖通知中的零散模式。

patterns.name: 明确/强调语气的词根
patterns.context: “jasno”意为清楚、明确；出现在表达立场或根据数据得出结论的句子中

patterns.name: 英文复合词内部的特定词段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文词、连字符复合词或大写法律程式用语的内部片段；片段间具体词义不统一

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在斯洛伐克语、捷克语或波兰语的词内子词段，分词边界与完整词义并不总一致
patterns.domain: 斯拉夫语议会文本、宗教文本

patterns.name: 拍卖相关词段
patterns.context: 出现在筹款活动及日历日期的宣传语中
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、慈善活动通知

en.description: Primarily responds to “testing” and its technical, experimental, product, legal, or medical contexts; also activates on “November,” some weekday names and numbers in date lines, DENIED in legal rulings, and whitespace and line breaks in email/document layouts.

patterns.name: testing and surrounding words
patterns.context: “testing” itself is marked in [5]–[8] and [10], with stronger markings in [6], [7]–[8], and [10]; [5] concerns a statistical genetics test, [6] product testing, [7] well testing, [8] semiconductor manufacturing testing, and [10] a biomedical experiment.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain technical, legal, and medical texts

patterns.name: November in dates
patterns.context: The month November is strongly marked in date formats; it appears in [1], [2], [4], and [9]. Activation does not appear to depend strongly on a particular year or fixed date format.
patterns.domain: Email date lines, legal rulings, webpage or post timestamps

patterns.name: DENIED in rulings
patterns.context: Appears in a formal ruling sentence in which the Supreme Court denies certiorari; the subsequent “IED” is also marked. Seen only in this legal context.

patterns.name: Document layout and whitespace
patterns.context: Whitespace alignment in email content or headers, and line breaks and nearby separator lines in legal documents, are marked; [1] is especially prominent, but whitespace also appears locally in [3] and [9].

patterns.name: Other date/weekday text
patterns.context: Weekday names appear in date lines; they partially overlap with the November date pattern, but the weekdays themselves occur only in [4] and [9].

10_1778.concept: 测试与文档日期/格式特征
10_1778.description: 主要对“testing”及其技术实验、产品、法律或医学语境反应；另对日期行中的 November、部分星期和数字、法律判决中的 DENIED，以及邮件/文书排版空白与换行有激活。

patterns.name: testing及其周边词
patterns.trigger: “testing”，以及部分上下文中的 “beta testing”“operations testing”“testing whether”“testing of”
patterns.context: “testing”本身在[5]–[8]、[10]均被标记，且在[6]、[7]–[8]、[10]带有较强标记；[5]为统计遗传学检验，[6]为产品测试，[7]为井的测试，[8]为半导体制造测试，[10]为生物医学实验。
patterns.domain: 跨领域技术、法律、医学文本

patterns.name: 日期中的 November
patterns.context: 日期格式中月份 November 被强标记；[1]、[2]、[4]、[9]出现。激活并不明显取决于特定年份或固定日期格式。
patterns.domain: 邮件日期行、法律判决、网页或帖子时间戳

patterns.name: 判决中的 DENIED
patterns.context: 出现在最高法院拒绝准许上诉的正式判决句中，后续“IED”也有标记；仅见于该法律语境。

patterns.name: 文档排版与空白符
patterns.context: 邮件内容或标题中的空白对齐，以及法律文书中的换行、分隔线附近出现标记；[1]尤其突出，但空白本身也在[3]、[9]局部出现。
patterns.domain: 邮件与法律文书的格式/版面

patterns.name: 其他日期/星期文字
patterns.context: 星期名称出现在日期行；与 November 日期模式部分重合，但星期本身只有[4]、[9]。

en.description: Strong triggers mainly occur on November in dates and on testing in technical, medical, and legal contexts; local patterns also include medical abstracts, enumerated causes of action, patent language, and email indexes. Whether date/title-format signals are independent is unclear.

patterns.name: November in dates
patterns.context: Occurs in date strings, often adjacent to a weekday, day, or year; activation is especially concentrated on the month word itself.
patterns.domain: Email dates, legal decision dates, and dates in ordinary text

patterns.name: The word testing
patterns.context: The form testing occurs in technical or research contexts; it may be preceded by modifiers such as operations or beta, refer to testing in a legal dispute, or denote an examination in research.
patterns.domain: Email, legal documents, patents, medical and biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: Format signals in dates and title-style typography
patterns.context: Dates, patterns formed by repeated characters, or uppercase title-style typography; apart from date fragments co-occurring with November, titles and repetition patterns show no clear shared semantics.
patterns.domain: Dates and title/decorative text in email

patterns.name: Medical paper titles and research terminology
patterns.context: Title-style phrases are followed by descriptions of epidemiological or genetic research methods; no date or testing trigger words were observed.

patterns.name: Legal litigation terminology
patterns.context: Lists multiple infringement claims or causes of action, followed by discussion of a preliminary injunction and a dispute over test wells for licensing.

patterns.name: Patent disclosures and semiconductor manufacturing
patterns.context: Common patent language about disclosures, embodiments, and figures transitions to semiconductor product manufacturing processes.

patterns.name: Indexing and beta testing in Enron emails
patterns.context: An email explains distribution of an index to recipients and mentions a testing period and its end date.

patterns.name: Neurodegenerative disease and miRNA research
patterns.context: Discusses Alzheimer’s-related cells, stress, miRNA changes, and neurodegenerative processes; testing also appears.

10_1778.concept: 日期中的 November 与 testing
10_1778.description: 强触发主要落在日期中的 November，以及技术、医学和法律语境的 testing；另有医学摘要、诉因列举、专利措辞和邮件索引等局部模式。日期/标题格式信号是否独立，无法确定。

patterns.name: 日期中的 November
patterns.context: 出现在带日期的日期串中，常与星期、日、年份相邻；激活尤其集中在月份词本身。
patterns.domain: 邮件日期、法律判决日期及普通文本中的日期

patterns.name: testing 一词
patterns.context: 词形 testing 出现在技术或研究语境中；前面可有 operations、beta 等修饰，也可指法律争议中的测试，或研究中的检验。
patterns.domain: 邮件、法律文书、专利、医学与生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 日期及标题式排版中的格式信号
patterns.context: 日期、重复字符组成的图案或大写标题式排版；除与 November 同现的日期片段外，标题和重复模式未见明确共同语义。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的日期及标题/装饰性文本

patterns.name: 医学论文标题及研究术语
patterns.context: 标题式短语后接流行病学或遗传学研究方法描述；未观察到日期或 testing 触发词。

patterns.name: 法律诉讼术语
patterns.context: 多个侵权或诉因名称列举，随后叙述初步禁令及许可测试井的争议。

patterns.name: 专利披露与半导体制造
patterns.context: 专利常见的披露、实施例及附图措辞，转入半导体产品制造过程。

patterns.name: Enron 邮件中的索引与 beta 测试
patterns.context: 邮件说明向收件人分发索引，并提到测试期及结束日期。

patterns.name: 神经退行性疾病与 miRNA 研究
patterns.context: 探讨阿尔茨海默病相关细胞、压力、miRNA 变化及神经退行性过程；同时出现 testing。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学项目摘要

en.description: Activations often occur on long runs of spaces in formatted documents, dates/month names, and legal-document header labels; also observed in uppercase judicial terms in decisions, email titles, and biomedical compound terms, with no single stable semantics.

patterns.name: Repeated spaces or layout padding
patterns.context: Activations fall on long runs of spaces, indentation, or dash padding; typically near headers, formatted text, or separator lines.

patterns.name: Months in date formats
patterns.context: Dates occur in email headers, date lines, or dates mentioned in court orders; activation is especially concentrated on month names and adjacent date formatting.

patterns.name: Legal-document header status labels
patterns.context: An uppercase label appears on an indented header line, followed by a line break and the document body.

patterns.name: Emphasis words in judicial language
patterns.context: Occurs in formal sentences where a court rules on an appeal or motion; the word appears in uppercase.

patterns.name: Uppercase tokens in titles or subject lines
patterns.context: An uppercase title appears after an email-style date line, with characters split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Compound-word fragments in biomedical terminology
patterns.context: A compound term appears in a paper title, followed by discussion of association, statistical power, and population samples.

10_1778.concept: 格式化文本与日期标记
10_1778.description: 激活常见于格式化文档中的长空格、日期/月名和法律文件页眉标签；另见判决大写裁判词、邮件标题及生物医学复合术语，未呈现单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 重复空格或版面填充
patterns.trigger: 连续的 «                        »，以及下划线、等号等填充符
patterns.context: 激活落在长串空格、缩进或横线填充上；通常出现在页眉、格式化文本或分隔线附近。

patterns.name: 日期格式中的月份
patterns.context: 日期出现在邮件标题、日期行或法院命令所述日期中；激活尤其集中于月份名及其相邻日期格式。

patterns.name: 法律文书的页首状态标记
patterns.context: 大写标签位于缩进页首行，后接换行与文书正文。

patterns.name: 法院裁判措辞中的强调词
patterns.context: 出现在法院对上诉或申请作出裁决的正式句子中，词语以大写呈现。

patterns.name: 标题或主题行中的大写分词
patterns.context: 大写标题出现在邮件式日期行之后，字符被拆分成多个 token。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语中的复合词片段
patterns.context: 复合术语位于论文标题，随后讨论关联、统计效能及人群样本。

en.description: Activation centers on “November” in dates, headers, stamps, and publication markers in legal documents, and space padding in emails; isolated cases also include repeated character sequences, a holiday poem title, and a domain options heading.

patterns.name: Month in dates
patterns.context: The month is capitalized in date formats, usually adjacent to a weekday, day, and year; it also appears after “Opinion issued” in legal opinion dates.

patterns.name: Legal document layout markers
patterns.context: Headers, stamps, or title areas of court documents, often accompanied by formatting spaces and line breaks; date patterns also occur in legal documents.

patterns.name: Space padding in email templates/headers
patterns.context: Blocks of spaces repeat, followed by email content or other fields; some excerpts also contain template markers.

patterns.name: Repeated character patterns
patterns.context: Character sequences repeat, followed by a line break and an uppercase heading; they occur in the same excerpt as date patterns and email addresses, but do not form a clear semantic condition.

patterns.name: Holiday poem title
patterns.context: Title case, ending with a line break and followed by “as written by”.

patterns.name: Website domain options heading
patterns.context: A short heading followed by a line break, then an explanation introduced by “The following domain extensions”.

10_1778.concept: 文档格式与标题标记
10_1778.description: 激活集中于日期中“November”，法律文书的页眉、盖章与出版标记，以及邮件中的空格填充；另有重复字符序列、节日诗标题和域名选项标题等孤例。

patterns.name: 日期中的月份
patterns.context: 日期格式中月份被大写，通常紧邻星期、日和年份；在法律意见日期中也出现在“Opinion issued”之后。
patterns.domain: 邮件、网页文本、法律文书

patterns.name: 法律文件版式标记
patterns.trigger: “Filed”“FILED”“NOT FOR PUBLICATION”“COURT OF APPEALS”“Opinion issued”及大量前导空格
patterns.context: 法院文件的页眉、盖章或标题区域，常伴有排版空格和换行；日期模式也见于法律文书。

patterns.name: 邮件模板/报头中的空格填充
patterns.context: 空格成块重复，后接邮件内容或其他字段；部分片段还含模板标记。

patterns.name: 重复字符图案
patterns.context: 字符序列重复出现，后接换行和大写标题；与日期和邮件地址同处一段，但不构成清楚的语义条件。

patterns.name: 节日诗标题
patterns.context: 标题式大小写并以换行结束，后接“as written by”。

patterns.name: 网站域名选项标题
patterns.context: 短标题后换行，接着以“The following domain extensions”引出说明。

en.description: Activations mainly fall on November in dates or Wednesday in date lines; other examples include the year 1976 in a sports title and og within the proper name Pogaru, with no clear unifying pattern.

patterns.name: November in dates
patterns.context: The month name November occurs in a date format; the activation marker falls on the month token.

patterns.name: Full date beginning with Wednesday
patterns.context: The weekday Wednesday is followed by a comma and a full date; the activation falls on the weekday token.

patterns.name: Title beginning with a year
patterns.context: A four-digit year is adjacent to a sports event name at the beginning of a title; the activation falls on the year.

patterns.name: Substring og within a word
patterns.context: The activation falls on the substring within the proper name Pogaru, not on a standalone word.

10_1778.concept: 日期与数字/词片段
10_1778.description: 激活主要落在日期中的月份 November 或日期行的 Wednesday；另有赛事标题年份 1976 与专名 Pogaru 内的 og，未见能统一解释的明确模式。

patterns.name: 日期中的 November
patterns.trigger: « November» 后接数字日期、年份，如 “November 12, 2008”
patterns.context: 月份名称 November 出现在日期格式中；激活标记落在月份 token 上。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、邮件、法律意见书

patterns.name: Wednesday 开头的完整日期
patterns.context: 星期 Wednesday 后跟逗号及完整日期；激活落在星期 token 上。

patterns.name: 年份开头的标题
patterns.context: 四位年份紧邻体育赛事名称，作为标题开头；激活落在年份上。
patterns.domain: 维基百科体育赛事标题

patterns.name: 词内子串 og
patterns.context: 激活落在专名 Pogaru 的词内子串，而非独立词。

en.concept: Legal document formatting and rights statements
en.description: Primarily responds to large blocks of layout whitespace in legal document headers, as well as heading markers such as the court, decision year, and publication/precedential status; also responds to “has” and proprietary rights and usage restrictions in a data disclaimer.

patterns.name: Whitespace layout in legal documents
patterns.context: Indentation and alignment whitespace before headers or titles, often appearing alongside line breaks and court-heading formats

patterns.name: Court decision headings and publication status
patterns.context: Court names, docket/year information, and markers of official publication or precedential status on the first page or in the header of a decision
patterns.domain: FreeLaw legal opinions, especially appellate court documents

patterns.name: Data usage restrictions and proprietary rights statements
patterns.context: Restrictions on the use and distribution of exchange market data and ownership statements; activation centers on “has” and related legal language

10_1778.concept: 法律文书格式与权利声明
10_1778.description: 主要响应法律文书页眉中的大段排版空白，以及法院、判决年份和发布/先例状态等标题标记；另在一段数据免责声明中响应“has”及专有权、使用限制措辞。

patterns.name: 法律文书的空白排版
patterns.context: 页眉或标题前的缩进、对齐空白，常与换行及法院标题格式同时出现

patterns.name: 法院判决标题与发布状态
patterns.trigger: 「Filed」「Washington」「2016 IL App」「[DO NOT PUBLISH]」「COURT OF APPEALS」「2018 IL App」「In the United States Court」「NOT PRECEDENTIAL」
patterns.context: 判决首页或页眉中的法院名称、案卷/年份信息，以及是否正式发布或具有先例效力的标记
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法律判决，尤其上诉法院文书

patterns.name: 数据使用限制与专有权声明
patterns.trigger: 「Furthermore, you acknowledge that」「has exclusive and valuable property rights in this data」；同段还有「without the express written consent」
patterns.context: 对交易所市场数据的使用、传播限制及所有权声明，激活集中于「has」及相关法律措辞
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的商业/法律免责声明

en.description: All passages contain a marked \left in mathematical typesetting; most use it for a left parenthesis or brace in a formula, and a few for angle brackets. The trigger appears to be the LaTeX left delimiter rather than specific subject matter.

patterns.name: LaTeX left delimiter
patterns.context: \left appears in mathematical formulas, often paired with \right; it is sometimes followed by parentheses, braces, or other delimiters.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics/theoretical physics formulas, plus PubMed Central mathematical formulas

patterns.name: Left parentheses and braces in formulas
patterns.context: Used as delimiters enclosing an expression in a formula; activation marks \left and related delimiters.

patterns.name: Special left delimiters
patterns.context: A quantity is represented by angle brackets in an information-theoretic expression.

patterns.name: Textual left delimiter
patterns.context: Braces enclose a set of basis vectors in geometric algebra.
patterns.domain: Geometric algebra explanatory text and formulas

10_1778.concept: LaTeX 左定界符 \left
10_1778.description: 所有段落都在数学排版中出现被标记的 \left；多数用于公式内左括号或花括号，少数用于角括号。触发似乎是 LaTeX 左定界符，而非具体学科内容。

patterns.name: LaTeX 左定界符
patterns.context: 数学公式中出现 \left，常与 \right 成对；有时后接括号、花括号或其他定界符。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学/理论物理公式，另有 PubMed Central 数学公式

patterns.name: 公式中的左括号与花括号
patterns.context: 作为公式内括起表达式的定界符；激活标注落在 \left 及相关定界符处。

patterns.name: 特殊左定界符
patterns.context: 信息论表达式中以角括号表示的量。
patterns.domain: 信息论/编码理论，LaTeX 公式

patterns.name: 文本式左定界符
patterns.context: 花括号用于包住几何代数中的基向量集合。
patterns.domain: 几何代数说明文字及公式

en.description: Activation is concentrated on HTML markup, navigation-bar boundary comments, and link lists; it also appears on table headings, email header addresses, and symbolized numerical comparisons in a DNA abstract.

patterns.name: HTML navigation bar fragment
patterns.context: In HTML, after a list and a `div` close, an anchor and comment separator markers are used to skip the navigation bar; often adjacent to line breaks and ``, ``
patterns.domain: HTML page templates in GitHub source code

patterns.name: HTML table heading markers
patterns.context: Table header cells use alignment, colspan, and font-size attributes and contain bold headings
patterns.domain: HTML documents or generated API documentation in GitHub

patterns.name: HTML list links and language names
patterns.context: Hyperlinks in an HTML list point to a media preferences page, with localized language names as link text
patterns.domain: Webpages or UI localization resources in GitHub

patterns.name: HTML links and survey archive list
patterns.context: Survey or archive entries are listed as links with bracketed numbers

patterns.name: Numerical comparisons in DNA research
patterns.context: Compares changes in the number of water molecules in different drug and DNA systems, using less-than or greater-than-zero relations

patterns.name: Addresses and contacts in email headers
patterns.context: Email addresses, CC fields, or return paths appear in an email header or recipient list

10_1778.concept: 结构化文本边界与标记
10_1778.description: 激活主要集中在 HTML 标记、导航栏边界注释与链接列表；另见表格标题、邮件头地址，以及 DNA 摘要中的符号化数值比较。

patterns.name: HTML 导航栏片段
patterns.trigger: `END OF TOP NAVBAR`、`END OF BOTTOM NAVBAR`，以及 `<a name="skip.navbar.top">`、`<a id="skip.navbar.top">`、`<a name="skip.navbar.bottom">` 等
patterns.context: HTML 中列表、`div` 结束后出现用于跳过导航栏的锚点和注释分隔标记；常与换行及 ``、`` 相邻
patterns.domain: GitHub 源码中的 HTML 页面模板

patterns.name: HTML 表格标题标记
patterns.context: 表格表头单元格使用对齐、跨列和字体大小属性，包含加粗标题
patterns.domain: GitHub 中的 HTML 文档或生成式 API 文档

patterns.name: HTML 列表链接及语言名称
patterns.context: HTML 列表中的超链接，链接到媒体偏好设置页面，链接文本是本地化语言名称
patterns.domain: GitHub 中的网页或界面本地化资源

patterns.name: HTML 链接及调查归档列表
patterns.context: 以链接和方括号编号列出调查或归档条目

patterns.name: DNA 研究中的数值比较
patterns.context: 比较不同药物与 DNA 体系的水分子数变化，出现小于或大于零的关系

patterns.name: 邮件头中的地址及联系人
patterns.context: 邮件头或收件人列表中出现电子邮件地址、抄送字段或退信路径

en.concept: Proper names and marker fragments in structured text
en.description: Primarily responds to dense formatting of email recipient lists, names, and email addresses; also has local activation on HTML tags, generic type parameters, the x86_64 architecture marker, and “high-speed pursuit” in legal text.

patterns.name: Email addresses and recipient fields
patterns.context: Names, email addresses, and email header fields appear densely, especially in recipient lists or address-book-like text; activation often falls on names, parts of addresses, and separators.
patterns.domain: Enron email, email address books, or email headers

patterns.name: Angle brackets and markup language tags
