patterns.context: Angle brackets enclose HTML tags at the beginning of a webpage document header.

patterns.name: Generic types and type parameters
patterns.context: Type names and angle-bracketed type parameters appear in function signatures, return values, or container declarations; they may also be adjacent to ordinary code identifiers.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A and Java source code

patterns.name: x86_64 architecture marker in code
patterns.context: Appears as a test-platform description in a technical discussion comparing clang and gcc compilation results and instruction-count differences.

patterns.name: High-speed pursuit wording in legal rulings
patterns.context: While recounting a police pursuit and witness testimony, activation centers near the phrase “high-speed pursuit”.

10_1778.concept: 结构化文本中的专名与标记片段
10_1778.description: 主要响应邮件收件人列表、姓名与邮箱地址的密集格式；另对 HTML 标签、泛型类型参数、x86_64 架构标记及法律文本中的“high-speed pursuit”有局部激活。

patterns.name: 邮箱地址与邮件收件人字段
patterns.trigger: 邮箱地址中的 @、域名片段，以及邮件头中的 <...>、逗号分隔姓名和地址；如 «AA»«m»«iral»«i»«@»、«m»«fe»«252»«@»«air»«mail»、«From»:
patterns.context: 姓名、邮箱地址及邮件头字段密集出现，尤其在收件人列表或地址簿式文本中；激活常落在姓名、地址局部和分隔符上。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、邮件地址簿或邮件头

patterns.name: 尖括号与标记语言标签
patterns.context: 尖括号包围 HTML 标签，处于网页文档头部的开端。
patterns.domain: 旧式 HTML 文档/源码

patterns.name: 泛型类型与类型参数
patterns.context: 类型名及尖括号类型参数出现在函数签名、返回值或容器声明中；也可能与普通代码标识符相邻。
patterns.domain: 编程问答与 Java 源码

patterns.name: 代码中的 x86_64 架构标记
patterns.context: 在比较 clang 与 gcc 编译结果、指令数差异的技术讨论中，作为测试平台说明出现。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的高速追逐表述
patterns.context: 叙述警察追逐事件及证人证言时，激活集中于短语“high-speed pursuit”附近。

en.description: Most excerpts are code, JSON, HTML, or technical text, with activation on structural symbols, fields, identifiers, and proper names; other examples include date/time-zone codes, encyclopedia links, and British political prose, with no common lexical cue.

patterns.name: Structured code and markup languages
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across field names, punctuation, indentation, tags, and code identifiers; the context is structured, parseable code or markup, not a fixed keyword.
patterns.domain: JSON, Java, JavaScript/React, Dart/Flutter, HTML, and other technical text

patterns.name: Technical proper names and identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in code fields, class names, chart titles, instruction descriptions, or webpage excerpts; the proper names vary and share no evident semantic content.
patterns.domain: Technical documentation, code, and webpage content

patterns.name: Dates, time zones, and timestamps
patterns.context: Time zones and date/time are expressed as code or data, with activation across identifiers, numbers, and time-zone strings.

patterns.name: Linked encyclopedia entry names
patterns.context: A phrase appears as Markdown link text and in a URL pointing to an English Wikipedia entry.
patterns.domain: Hacker News posts or link references

patterns.name: British politics and postal service discussion
patterns.context: Ordinary prose discusses the British Postal Services Act, privatization, and Labour critics; there is no clear code structure.

10_1778.concept: 技术与结构化文本片段
10_1778.description: 多数片段是代码、JSON、HTML或技术文本，激活落在结构符号、字段、标识符和专名上；另有日期时区代码、百科链接及英国政治散文，缺少共同词义线索。

patterns.name: 结构化代码与标记语言
patterns.trigger: JSON/代码中的标点、字段和值，如 «Feature»、«Collection»、«properties»、«class»、«public»、«import»、«<td>»、«<div»
patterns.context: 激活分散在字段名、标点、缩进、标签和代码标识符上；上下文为结构化、可解析的代码或标记文本，并非某个固定关键词。

patterns.name: 技术专名与标识符
patterns.context: 出现在代码字段、类名、图表标题、指令说明或网页片段中；专名本身种类不一，未见共同语义。
patterns.domain: 技术文档、代码与网页内容

patterns.name: 日期、时区与时间戳
patterns.context: 以代码或数据表达时区及日期时间，激活覆盖标识符、数字和时区字符串。
patterns.domain: 编程问答或日期时间数据

patterns.name: 带链接的百科条目名称
patterns.context: 词组出现在指向英文维基百科条目的 Markdown 链接文本及 URL 中。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 帖文或链接引用

patterns.name: 英国政治与邮政叙述
patterns.context: 普通散文中讨论英国邮政服务法案、私有化及工党批评者；没有明显代码结构。

en.description: Primarily responds to litigation narratives in U.S. opinions: guilty pleas and convictions, statutory sentencing, court disputes, motions, and party names; also includes political commentary focused on “Republican Party”.

patterns.name: Legal rulings and litigation arguments
patterns.context: Appears in passages describing facts, procedural history, grounds for dispute, or court analysis, often with party names, courts, statutes, and citations
patterns.domain: U.S. legal rulings, especially criminal, immigration, civil litigation, and appellate decisions

patterns.name: Legal wording on guilty pleas, convictions, and penalties
patterns.context: Describes a defendant’s guilty plea, criminal conduct, conviction, or sentencing, and related legal consequences

patterns.name: Procedural or evidentiary disputes in rulings
patterns.context: Recounts an application, objection, or disputed event raised by a party, and explains how the court or another body handled it
patterns.domain: Facts and procedural history in judicial decisions; some involve banking transaction disputes

patterns.name: Party names and possessives adjacent to legal terms
patterns.context: Legal proper names and possessives often appear next to litigation terms such as petition, motion, and argues; activation sometimes falls on name fragments, punctuation, or formatting symbols
patterns.domain: Names of people and organizations and litigation narratives in legal documents

patterns.name: Party name in political commentary
patterns.context: Repeatedly mentions a political party and comments on its relationship to a person’s position; this passage is not a legal ruling

10_1778.concept: 法律判决中的诉讼叙述
10_1778.description: 主要响应美国判决书中的诉讼叙述：认罪定罪、法条量刑、法院争议、动议及当事人姓名；另有一段以“Republican Party”为焦点的政治评论。

patterns.name: 法律判决与诉讼论述
patterns.context: 置于法院裁判的事实、程序经过、争议理由或法院分析段落中，常有当事人姓名、法院、法条和引证
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决，尤其刑事、移民、民事诉讼与上诉裁判

patterns.name: 认罪、定罪与刑罚法律语句
patterns.context: 描述被告认罪、犯罪事实、定罪或量刑，以及相关法律后果

patterns.name: 判决中的程序或证据争议
patterns.trigger: “motion to suppress”“Notice to Appear”“challenges”“trial court erred”“stop payment”
patterns.context: 叙述当事人提出的申请、异议或争议事件，并交代法院或其他机构的处理
patterns.domain: 司法裁判事实与程序史；部分涉及银行交易争议

patterns.name: 当事人姓名及所有格紧邻法律术语
patterns.context: 法律专名和所有格常紧挨 petition、motion、argues 等诉讼词汇；激活有时落在姓名片段、标点或格式符号上
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的人名、机构名与诉讼叙述

patterns.name: 政治评论中的政党名称
patterns.context: 重复提及政党，并以其与人物立场关系作评论；该段不是法律裁判

en.description: Activations occur mainly near party names, legal relationships, and litigation actions in legal decisions, and also respond to quotations and formatting boundaries; they also occur on identifiers, symbols, and line breaks in two code snippets. The legal excerpts cover diverse topics and are difficult to classify under a single area of law.

patterns.name: People or entity names in legal text
patterns.context: Triggers cluster around personal names, party references, and organization/trust names; usually within court decision narratives or legal claims. Also observed in party-related phrases such as “the c[r]ib petitioner”.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Legal relationships and litigation actions
patterns.context: Activates when describing legal relationships and procedural actions such as obligations, payments, requests, exclusion of evidence, transfer of rights, fraud, or case disposition; often co-occurs with party names.
patterns.domain: Reasoning in decisions, litigation facts, and legal conclusions

patterns.name: Punctuation and boundaries in legal citations or decision formatting
patterns.context: Occurs in quotations, citations, parenthetical asides, or line breaks between decision paragraphs/code lines; this pattern is weak and may co-occur with adjacent legal terms or formatting boundaries.

patterns.name: Identifiers and structural boundaries in code
patterns.context: In code snippets, activates on variable/function identifiers, operators, brackets, and line breaks/indentation; no clear connection to legal semantics.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code (JavaScript-style configuration code and C code)

patterns.name: Local salient triggers in legal terminology
patterns.context: These words occur in different legal narratives concerning immigration eligibility/evidence, bankruptcy proceedings, or changes to insurance beneficiaries; the only commonality is specialized legal vocabulary, with no stable single theme.
patterns.domain: Immigration law, bankruptcy law, insurance, and other case facts

10_1778.concept: 文本实体与结构边界
10_1778.description: 主要在法律判决中的当事人名称、法律关系和诉讼行为附近激活，也对引文及格式边界有反应；另在两段代码的标识符、符号和换行处激活。法律片段主题多样，难以归为单一法域。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的人名或实体名称
patterns.trigger: “plaintiff”, “Movants”, “Daniels”, “Sarwar”, “Mark D. Johnson Trust”, “Defendant”, “Yeatmans”及被拆分标记的人名片段
patterns.context: 触发集中在人名、当事人称谓和机构/信托名称附近；通常处于法院判决叙述或法律主张中。也见于“the c[r]ib petitioner”等当事人相关表述。

patterns.name: 法律关系与诉讼行为
patterns.trigger: “deny … its duty … to defend”, “payments … to the Movants”, “promise … implied … to pay”, “motion … to suppress”, “assignment … of the Note and the Deed”, “transfer in fraud”, “dismissed … complaint with prejudice”
patterns.context: 在描述义务、付款、请求、证据排除、权利转让、欺诈或案件处置等法律关系和程序行为时激活；常与当事人名称同现。
patterns.domain: 判决理由、诉讼事实与法律结论

patterns.name: 法律引文或判决格式中的标点与边界
patterns.trigger: 引号、括号及句末引文标记，如“"explored"”、“(Abel)”、“[9]”、“"Mark D. Johnson Trust"”，以及“↵”附近的片段
patterns.context: 出现在引述、引用、括号补充或判决段落/代码行换行处；本模式较弱，且可能与相邻法律词语或格式边界共同出现。
patterns.domain: 法律文书排版与引用格式

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与结构边界
patterns.context: 在代码片段中，变量/函数标识符、运算符、括号和换行缩进处激活；与法律语义无明显联系。
patterns.domain: Github 源代码（JavaScript 风格配置代码与 C 代码）

patterns.name: 法律术语的局部显著触发
patterns.context: 这些词分别出现在移民资格/证据、破产程序、保险受益人变更等不同法律事实叙述中；共同点只是法律专门词汇，未见稳定的单一主题。
patterns.domain: 移民法、破产法、保险及其他判例事实

en.concept: Legal documents and structured text markers
en.description: Primarily responds to rulings, requests, parties, obligations, and statutory/citation formatting in legal decisions and litigation texts; other heterogeneous triggers include a team roster in sports reporting and a few code and JSON fields.

patterns.name: Statutory citations
patterns.context: Numbers or paragraph markers appear next to legal terms, decision citations, or statute names; occurs in legal text

patterns.name: Rulings and court actions
patterns.context: Describes how a court rules on a pleading, motion, or order in a court opinion

patterns.name: Legal claims and debt relationships
patterns.context: States a party’s claim, allegation, or debt in a legal dispute

patterns.name: Legal party names and possessives
patterns.context: Names of parties, institutions, or entities involved in a case appear in legal narratives, often with possessives or attribution of claims

patterns.name: Legal obligations and performance
patterns.context: Discusses payment, services, property improvements, or payment obligations inferred from conduct

patterns.name: Legal citations and procedural formatting
patterns.context: Near citations, paragraph breaks, court orders, and citation formatting in rulings

patterns.name: Sports team names and roster
patterns.context: Sports news context in which a player completes a suspension and can return to the team roster

patterns.name: Object properties and indentation in code
patterns.context: In JavaScript object initialization and code that checks a safe-integer condition

patterns.name: JSON fields and data records
patterns.context: Keys, values, counts, and object arrays in serialized records

10_1778.concept: 法律文书与结构化文本标记
10_1778.description: 主要响应法律判决与诉讼文本中的裁决、请求、当事人、义务及法条/引文格式；另有体育报道中的球队阵容，以及代码和JSON字段等少量异质触发。

patterns.name: 法条编号
patterns.context: 数字或段落标记紧邻法律术语、判决引文或法条名称；在法律文本中出现

en.concept: Legal litigation narratives and proper-name terminology
en.description: Activations occur mainly on wording about allegations, numbers of offenses, guilty pleas and sentencing, and party claims in legal texts; other examples include two unrelated StackExchange question topics and a scientific passage about astatine isotopes and treatment.

patterns.name: The quantifier two in legal documents
patterns.context: Describes the number of offenses, charges, or cases involving a defendant in legal decisions or case narratives; also occurs in the structure “two ...” followed by a legal entity
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, criminal and bankruptcy court documents

patterns.name: Legal charges and plea language
patterns.context: Often co-occurs with case-number terms and defendant references when a court recounts charges, guilty pleas, sentencing, or trial facts

patterns.name: Legal claims and disputes over rights
patterns.context: Judicial opinions discuss party claims, causes of action, legal rights, or remedies; activation falls on specialized legal terms or litigants
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, civil, constitutional, and litigation opinions

patterns.name: API method name and failed invocation
patterns.context: A callback method name appears in code, followed by a StackExchange debugging question about clicking an icon without triggering the callback

patterns.name: StackExchange badges and edits
patterns.context: Asks whether editing a question counts toward the rules for a particular site badge

patterns.name: Radioactive isotopes and treatment
patterns.context: Discusses astatine isotopes, anions, and their use in targeted radionuclide therapy
patterns.domain: ArXiv, nuclear chemistry or medical physics

10_1778.concept: 法律诉讼叙述与专名术语
10_1778.description: 主要激活于法律文本中关于指控、罪名数量、认罪判刑及当事人主张的措辞；另见两个不同的 StackExchange 问答主题，以及一段砹同位素与治疗的科学文本。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的数量词 two

patterns.domain: FreeLaw，刑事及破产等司法文书

patterns.name: 法律指控与认罪措辞
patterns.context: 法院叙述指控、认罪、判刑或审理事实时，常与案件数量词及被告称谓同现

patterns.name: 法律主张与权利争议
patterns.context: 司法意见讨论当事人主张、诉讼请求、法律权利或救济；激活落在专门法律术语或诉讼参与者上

patterns.name: API 方法名及调用失败
patterns.context: 代码中出现回调方法名，紧接着是 StackExchange 上关于点击图标却未触发回调的调试问题

en.concept: Names and terms related to legal participants
en.description: Most legal passages activate on party, defendant, or group nouns and their possessives; other isolated patterns include the At isotope, a Java callback, the Keep editor, and a ship name, with no unified trigger.

patterns.name: Possessive nouns in legal text
patterns.context: In legal narratives, ’s follows a person or group noun, especially before matters in legal documents such as request, arguments, or motion; activation falls on the possessive noun and ’s.

patterns.name: Names and criminal defendant designations in legal rulings
patterns.context: A court opinion or ruling’s factual narrative includes litigants, defendants, or party designations; the word form is not always the same, and activation may fall on the designation or a name fragment.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw court opinions, including bankruptcy and criminal cases

patterns.name: Children as a litigant group
patterns.context: Claims in a constitutional lawsuit brought by schoolchildren; the passage also contains possessives and legal claims, but the noun for children is a prominent trigger.

patterns.name: At-211 isotope marker
patterns.context: In scientific descriptions of astatine isotopes and radionuclide therapy, the chemical symbol At is adjacent to isotope/anionic notation.

patterns.name: Java options callback method name
patterns.context: A coding question describes a click on an icon failing to trigger the onOptionsItemSelected() callback; activation centers on Selected in the method name and nearby parentheses.

patterns.name: Keep editor interface name
patterns.context: A question about an image display issue in a dialog mentions Keep editor; activation falls on the editor name.

patterns.name: Case property or ship name
patterns.context: Legal discussion involving immigration enforcement and forfeiture lists ship names; activation falls on the end of a proper name.

10_1778.concept: 名称与法律参与者相关词语
10_1778.description: 多数法律段落在当事人、被告或群体名词及其所有格处激活；另有 At 同位素、Java 回调、Keep 编辑器和船名等孤立模式，未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的所有格名词
patterns.context: 法律叙述中，所有格 ’s 紧接人或群体名词，尤其后接 request、arguments、motion 等法律文书中的事项；激活落在所有格名词及 ’s 上。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的人名与刑事被告称谓
patterns.context: 法院意见书或判决的事实叙述中，出现诉讼参与人、被告或当事人称谓；不总是同一词形，激活可落在称谓或人名片段上。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法院判决，含破产与刑事案件

patterns.name: 儿童作为诉讼群体
patterns.context: 关于学校儿童提出的宪法诉讼主张；该段也出现所有格及法律主张，但儿童名词是突出触发点。

patterns.name: At-211 同位素标记
patterns.context: 砹同位素和放射性核素治疗的科学说明中，化学元素符号 At 与同位素/阴离子记号相邻。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 科学论文，放射化学

patterns.name: Java 选项回调方法名
patterns.context: 代码问答中，描述点击图标未触发 onOptionsItemSelected() 回调；激活集中于方法名的 Selected 及括号附近。

patterns.name: Keep 编辑器界面名称
patterns.context: 询问对话框里的图像显示问题，提及 Keep editor；激活落在编辑器名称上。

patterns.name: 案件财产或船名
patterns.context: 移民执法与没收相关法律论述中，列举船只名称；激活落在专名末尾。

en.concept: Proper names and identifiers in specialized texts
en.description: Activations are scattered across proper names, abbreviations, statutory citations, and code/API identifiers in specialized texts, often falling near capitalization boundaries, abbreviations, or special symbols; there is no cross-domain unifying semantic theme.

patterns.name: Kaon symbols and mathematical notation
patterns.context: A particle-physics sentence contains K mesons and their charged/excited-state notation, near terms for photoproduction amplitudes and baryons.

patterns.name: Astatine and anion symbols
patterns.context: When discussing astatine isotopes, halogens, or radionuclide therapy, At is followed by charge/ionization chemistry notation.

patterns.name: Java method names and call chains
patterns.context: In Android/Java code or debugging descriptions, a camelCase callback method name is tokenized while discussing an icon click that fails to trigger the callback.

patterns.name: Qt class names and compound identifiers
patterns.context: In a Qt/C++ GUI question, the class name QTextEdit is split at capitalization boundaries, near a question about deleting a character.

patterns.name: CamelCase API/control names
patterns.context: In application-interface or editor-related Q&A, compound API and control names contain internal capitalization boundaries.

patterns.name: Party and organization names
patterns.context: Litigation narratives mention party names, banks, or mortgage institutions; activation falls on name fragments.

patterns.name: Legal rulings and instruction terminology
patterns.context: An appellate opinion examines, item by item, whether the trial court erred, admitted evidence, or gave a jury instruction.

patterns.name: Bankruptcy proceedings and statutory chapters
patterns.context: Discusses plan confirmation, res judicata, ownership of claims, and a trustee’s authority after conversion of a bankruptcy case.

patterns.name: The acronym GAL in litigation
patterns.context: A court-appointed guardian ad litem represents a child’s interests, and the record notes the appointment and submission of a report.

patterns.name: Government and criminal statutory citations
patterns.context: A criminal case cites statutes and recounts a government motion and the dismissal of charges.

10_1778.concept: 专业文本中的专名与标识符
10_1778.description: 激活分散于专业文本中的专名、缩写、法条及代码/API 标识符，常落在大小写边界、缩写或特殊符号附近；没有跨领域统一语义主题。

patterns.name: Kaon 符号与数学记号
patterns.context: 粒子物理句中出现 K 介子及其带电/激发态记号，邻近光生振幅、重子等术语。

patterns.name: 砹元素及负离子符号
patterns.context: 讨论砹同位素、卤素或放射性核素治疗时，At 后接电荷/离子化学记号。

patterns.name: Java 方法名及调用链
patterns.context: Android/Java 代码或调试叙述中，驼峰式回调方法名被分词，讨论点击图标未触发回调。

patterns.name: Qt 类名与复合标识符
patterns.context: Qt/C++ GUI 问题中，类名 QTextEdit 按大小写边界拆成片段，并邻近删除字符的提问。

patterns.name: 驼峰式 API/控件名称
patterns.context: 应用界面或编辑器相关问答中，复合 API 名称和控件名称内部出现大写边界。

patterns.name: 当事人与机构名称
patterns.context: 诉讼事实叙述中出现当事人姓名、银行或房贷机构名称；激活落在名称片段上。

patterns.name: 法律裁判与指令术语
patterns.context: 上诉意见逐项审查审判法院是否犯错、是否准许证据或给出陪审团指令。

patterns.name: 破产程序与法定章节
patterns.context: 讨论计划确认、既判力、诉权归属及破产案件转换后的受托人权限。

patterns.name: 诉讼中的 GAL 缩写
patterns.context: 法院指定诉讼监护人代表儿童利益，并记载其任命及提交报告。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 家事/儿童权益判决

patterns.name: 政府与刑事法条引用
patterns.context: 刑事案件中引用法条并叙述政府提出动议、指控被驳回。

en.description: Activation occurs in both types of context: class names, controls, and event identifiers in programming Q&A; and terms related to appeals, motions, judgments, claims, and arbitration in legal opinions. The domains differ, and no reliable shared trigger feature is apparent.

patterns.name: Class names and control/event identifiers in code
patterns.context: Appears in code, API names, or technical explanations adjacent to code in programming Q&A; identifiers often consist of multiple mixed-case segments and involve Java, Android, Flutter, Qt, and related technologies.

patterns.name: Legal proceedings and judicial procedure
patterns.context: Appears in court opinions or case fact narratives discussing appeals, motions, judgments, convictions, requests, claims, or arbitration; often uses formal legal language and party designations.

10_1778.concept: none
10_1778.description: 两类语境均有激活：编程问答中的类名、控件与事件标识符；法律意见中的上诉、动议、判决、索赔及仲裁术语。二者领域不同，未见可靠的共同触发特征。

patterns.name: 代码中的类名与控件/事件标识符
patterns.context: 出现在编程问答的代码、API 名称或紧邻代码的技术说明中；标识符常由多个大小写片段组成，涉及 Java、Android、Flutter、Qt 等。

patterns.name: 法律诉讼与司法程序表述
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见或案件事实叙述中，讨论上诉、动议、判决、定罪、请求、索赔或仲裁；常有正式法律文体及当事人称谓。

en.concept: Proper names and specialized terminology fragments
en.description: Activations occur mainly on API/control identifiers in programming Q&A and litigation-procedure terms in legal decisions; other examples include Bear/Colt proper names, legal webpage copy, and occasional activations near line breaks and parentheses. Triggers may reflect both distinctive word fragments and domain terminology.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and callbacks
patterns.context: CamelCase APIs, control names, or callback names appear in code or technical Q&A; activations cluster on fragments within the identifiers.

patterns.name: Legal terminology and litigation procedure
patterns.context: Procedural motions, parties, arbitration, or appeal-related terms appear in court opinions; fragments within some words also activate.

patterns.name: Bear/Colt proper names and split fragments
patterns.context: Web text involves the pairing of Bear and Colt or a site name; activation falls on the proper names and their subword fragments.

patterns.name: Legal-document formatting and form language
patterns.context: Legal-document information or a document-purchase page; ordinary document terms and promotional button text occur together, with unclear trigger relationships.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or structural boundary markers
patterns.context: Occasional activations near line breaks and parentheses, such as numbered/citation parentheses in decisions; also seen in other kinds of paragraphs, possibly reflecting a weak boundary effect.

10_1778.concept: 专名与专业术语片段
10_1778.description: 主要在编程问答中的 API/控件标识符和法律判决中的诉讼程序词上激活；另见 Bear/Colt 专名、法律网页文案及少量换行括号边界激活。触发因素可能兼有特殊词片与领域术语。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与回调
patterns.context: 代码或技术问答中出现驼峰式 API、控件名或回调名；激活集中在标识符内部片段。

patterns.name: 法律术语与诉讼程序
patterns.context: 法院意见中出现程序性动议、当事人、仲裁或上诉相关词语，部分词内部片段也被激活。

patterns.name: Bear/Colt 专名及切分片段
patterns.context: 网页文本涉及 Bear 与 Colt 的配对或站点名，激活落在专名及其子词片段上。

patterns.name: 法律文书格式与表单措辞
patterns.context: 法律文件说明或文档购买页面；普通文书词及促销式按钮文本同时出现，触发关系不明确。

patterns.name: 句首或结构边界标记
patterns.context: 换行及括号附近偶有激活，如判决中的编号/引文括号；也见于其他类型段落，可能是弱的边界效应。

en.concept: Proper names and terminology markers in documents
en.description: Activation occurs mainly around Pro Se party designations and court-document fields in legal judgments; it also responds to judgment-record advertisements, programming callback names, antibody targets, and particle-decay terminology, so it cannot be assigned to a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Pro Se parties in legal judgments
patterns.context: A party appears as self-represented (pro se) in an appeal or review document; often adjacent to a name, Petitioner, or Appellant.

patterns.name: Counts or case numbers in legal judgments
patterns.context: Discusses the number of counts of conviction in a criminal judgment, or an isolated number in the judgment text; the commonality is weak.

patterns.name: Advertisement for purchasing court opinions/records
patterns.context: After describing judgment footnotes or a brief ruling, an advertisement offers the complete court record for purchase.

patterns.name: UI callback method name
patterns.context: A programming Q&A discusses an icon click failing to trigger Android's onOptionsItemSelected callback.

patterns.name: Antibody target description
patterns.context: An introduction to a medical paper discusses natalizumab and its molecular target.

patterns.name: Particle physics decays and invariants
patterns.context: Discusses B-meson decays, lepton asymmetry, and dilepton invariant mass.

patterns.name: Date/procedural headings in legal judgments
patterns.context: Near date lines and case-procedure headings in court documents.

patterns.name: Court and judge information in legal documents
patterns.context: Lists the court, circuit, or judge in a judgment heading or case narrative.

10_1778.concept: 文书中的专名与术语标记
10_1778.description: 激活主要见于法律判决中 Pro Se 当事人标记及法院文书字段；另响应判决记录广告、编程回调名、抗体靶标和粒子衰变术语，不能归为单一语义。

patterns.name: 法律判决文书中的 Pro Se 当事人
patterns.context: 法律上诉或复审文书中，当事人以自行诉讼（pro se）身份出现；常邻近姓名、Petitioner 或 Appellant。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的数量或案件计数
patterns.context: 刑事判决论述定罪罪名数量，或判决文本中的孤立编号；共同点较弱。

patterns.name: 法院意见／记录的购买广告
patterns.context: 说明判决脚注或简短裁决内容后，接购买完整法院记录的广告。

patterns.name: 界面回调方法名
patterns.context: 代码问答中，讨论点击图标未触发 Android 的 onOptionsItemSelected 回调。

patterns.name: 抗体靶标描述
patterns.context: 医学论文引言中介绍 natalizumab 及其针对的分子靶标。

patterns.name: 粒子物理衰变与不变量
patterns.context: 讨论 B 介子衰变、轻子不对称性及 dilepton 不变质量。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的日期／程序标题
patterns.context: 法院文书的日期行和案件程序标题附近。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的法院与法官信息
patterns.trigger: «Eastern»2 District of North Carolina；«District Judge»；«Fourth»4« Circuit»2
patterns.context: 判决抬头或案情段落中列出法院、巡回区或法官。

en.description: High-activation points are scattered across proper names, technical identifiers, or formatted word fragments in different domains: Union, Android callbacks and SDK, code class names, Qt controls, astrophysics symbols, and legal terms and rules. No unified semantic trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Union and correspondence in a legal opinion
patterns.context: Discusses the Board’s and ALJ’s findings about the relationship between a letter exchanged by the union and Arnold, and whether the return offer was unconditional.

patterns.name: Android menu-item callback
patterns.context: Describes an Android debugging issue in which clicking an icon fails to trigger the onOptionsItemSelected callback.

patterns.name: SDK version labels in the Android manifest
patterns.context: The minSdkVersion and targetSdkVersion attributes in AndroidManifest XML.

patterns.name: CSS class for a folder submission button
patterns.context: JavaScript/jQuery constructs an Add folder button, with a class name composed of fragments such as NB-modal-submit, green, and add-folder.

patterns.name: Qt text-editing control
patterns.context: Asks how to delete the final character in Qt’s QTextEdit; surrounding text mentions a C++ GUI.

patterns.name: Sco X-1 in astrophysics
patterns.context: Discusses neutron-star rotation, beat-frequency models, and observational challenges to explanations of peak separation.

patterns.name: Exotic baryon physics terminology
patterns.context: Introduces photoproduction amplitudes, the Rarita-Schwinger formalism, and spin states, near terms related to exotic baryons.

patterns.name: Menu-item text font settings
patterns.context: Compares font and color settings for the MenuItemTextNormal element, asking why the color can be changed but the font cannot.

patterns.name: Court and judicial titles
patterns.context: In federal appellate proceedings, discusses a judge’s replacement, a panel decision, and a motion by the Secretary.

patterns.name: Rule 37 sanctions and extreme circumstances
patterns.context: Discusses a defendant’s appellate claim, default judgment, and the threshold for imposing sanctions under Rule 37.

10_1778.concept: 专名与技术标识
10_1778.description: 高激活点分散在不同领域的专名、技术标识或格式化词片：Union、Android 回调与 SDK、代码类名、Qt 控件、天体物理符号及法律称谓和规则。未见统一语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 法律意见中的 Union 与信函
patterns.context: 讨论 Board、ALJ 对工会与 Arnold 之间信件关系的认定，且出现 return offer 是否 unconditional 的问题。

patterns.name: Android 菜单项回调
patterns.context: 描述点击图标却没有触发 onOptionsItemSelected 回调的 Android 调试问题。

patterns.name: Android 清单中的 SDK 版本标签
patterns.context: AndroidManifest XML 中 minSdkVersion 和 targetSdkVersion 属性。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答／Android 配置

patterns.name: 文件夹提交按钮的 CSS 类
patterns.context: JavaScript/jQuery 构造 Add folder 按钮，类名由 NB-modal-submit、green、add-folder 等片段组成。

patterns.name: Qt 文本编辑控件
patterns.context: 询问 Qt 的 QTextEdit 如何删除末尾字符；周边提到 C++ GUI。

patterns.name: 天体物理中的 Sco X-1
patterns.context: 讨论中子星自转、拍频模型与观测对峰间距解释的挑战。

patterns.name: 奇异重子物理术语
patterns.context: 介绍光产生振幅、Rarita-Schwinger 形式及自旋态，邻近奇异重子相关词语。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 强子／粒子物理论文

patterns.name: 菜单项文字字体设置
patterns.context: 比较 MenuItemTextNormal 元素的字体和颜色设置，询问为何能改颜色却不能改字体。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答／UI 样式

patterns.name: 法院与司法人员称谓
patterns.context: 联邦上诉程序中，法官更替、合议庭决定及 Secretary 的动议。

patterns.name: Rule 37 制裁与极端情形
patterns.context: 讨论被告上诉主张、缺席判决，以及依据 Rule 37 施加制裁的门槛。

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly in U.S. court judgments, including motions, appellate arguments, evidentiary procedures, and criminal convictions and sentencing; it also appears around callback method names and permission handling in Android Q&A. patterns.name: Motions and rulings in legal judgments

10_1778.description: 主要响应联邦刑事上诉判决中关于被告上诉、定罪、认罪及刑罚的表述，尤其是毒品犯罪和量刑；另对一段量刑减责论证及两段无关的网页 CSS、TLS 技术问答有强激活。

patterns.name: 联邦刑事上诉意见书
patterns.context: 法院意见书开头或论述中，交代被告对定罪或刑罚提出上诉；常伴随法官署名、案件背景
patterns.domain: 美国联邦刑事上诉判决（FreeLaw）

patterns.name: 刑事量刑与罪名描述
patterns.context: 描述认罪、罪名、刑期或量刑争议，尤其是毒品犯罪、再入境、虚假陈述等案件

patterns.name: 法律论证中的责任减刑
patterns.context: 上诉人主张法院在量刑时应给予减刑或存在裁量错误

patterns.name: CSS 属性与样式修复
patterns.context: 展示 CSS 声明，并给出移除某样式以修复页面显示问题的建议

patterns.name: TLS/SSL 安全协议配置
patterns.context: 代码注释说明服务器协议兼容性，并通过 .NET 配置禁用 SSL 3
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答／网络安全配置

en.concept: Judgment and biomedical narrative passages in professional prose
en.description: Most activation comes from federal criminal appellate opinions, especially PER CURIAM openings, defendant appeals, convictions and sentencing, sentencing guidelines, and legal citations; three other passages concern HER2 therapy, SOD1/Bcl-2, and anti-CD3 transplant therapy, with distinct topics.

patterns.name: Opening formula in federal appellate opinions
patterns.context: Appears in appellate court opinions, often after judges' signatures or case citations, introducing an overview of the judgment or sentence.

patterns.name: Criminal sentencing and appellate review
patterns.context: A criminal defendant appeals a conviction or sentence, and the text discusses sentencing, sentencing guidelines, or appellate issues.
patterns.domain: Federal criminal judgments and sentencing guidelines

patterns.name: Legal citations, statutes, and litigation procedure
patterns.context: Includes case or statutory citations and procedural accounts of reversal, remand, or dismissal; need not co-occur with sentencing topics.

patterns.name: HER2-targeted therapy terminology
patterns.context: Discusses targeted therapy against HER2 and its dimerization partners, and its effects on patient outcomes.

patterns.name: SOD1 and Bcl-2 protein interaction
patterns.context: Introduces ALS-related SOD1 mutations and their interaction with anti-apoptotic proteins.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, neurodegenerative disease and molecular biology

patterns.name: Anti-CD3 antibodies and transplant rejection
patterns.context: Describes antibody therapy to suppress organ transplant rejection and mentions intestinal inflammation or human observations.

patterns.name: Specific legal passage details to retain
patterns.context: These are specific offenses or facts from different criminal cases. Although they occur in a legal context, the excerpts alone do not support classifying them as the same offense or argument.
patterns.domain: Federal criminal case facts and charges

patterns.name: Unexplained local activation within excerpts
patterns.context: Proper names and nearby text may contribute to activation, but the samples alone cannot establish whether the neuron responds to a particular name, a truncated word form, or another local feature.
patterns.domain: Names and case narrative fragments in legal texts

10_1778.concept: 专业文体中的判决与生物医学叙述片段
10_1778.description: 多数激活来自联邦刑事上诉意见，尤其是PER CURIAM开篇、被告上诉、定罪与量刑、量刑指南及法律引文；另有三段分别涉及HER2治疗、SOD1/Bcl-2及抗CD3移植治疗，主题不同。

patterns.name: 联邦上诉意见开篇句式
patterns.context: 出现在上诉法院意见书中，常在法官署名或案件引文之后，引出对判决或量刑的概述。

patterns.name: 刑事案件量刑与上诉审查
patterns.context: 刑事被告就定罪或刑期提出上诉，文本讨论量刑、量刑指南或上诉问题。
patterns.domain: 联邦刑事判决及量刑指南

patterns.name: 法律引文、法规与诉讼程序
patterns.context: 出现判例或法规引文，以及撤销、发回、驳回等程序性叙述；不要求与量刑主题同时出现。
patterns.domain: 司法意见书与法律论证

patterns.name: HER2靶向治疗术语
patterns.context: 讨论针对HER2及其二聚化伙伴的靶向治疗及其对患者结局的影响。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文，肿瘤治疗

patterns.name: SOD1与Bcl-2蛋白相互作用
patterns.context: 介绍ALS相关SOD1突变及其与抗凋亡蛋白的相互作用。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文，神经退行性疾病与分子生物学

patterns.name: 抗CD3抗体与移植排斥
patterns.context: 描述抑制器官移植排斥的抗体治疗，并提及小肠炎症或人类观察。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文，免疫学与移植

patterns.name: 需保留的法律片段细节
patterns.context: 这些是不同刑事案件中的具体罪名或事实，虽处于法律语境，却不能仅凭片段归为同一种罪名或论点。
patterns.domain: 联邦刑事案件事实与指控

patterns.name: 未解释的片段内局部激活
patterns.context: 专名及其附近文字可能贡献激活，但仅凭样本无法确定神经元是否对特定姓名、被截断的词形或其他局部特征响应。
patterns.domain: 法律文本中的人名与案情片段

en.concept: Criminal justice rulings (with some medical terminology)
en.description: Primarily responds to language in U.S. criminal justice documents concerning defendants’ appeals, convictions, pleas, charges, punishments, and procedural rulings, as well as sentencing statutes; two biomedical examples concern ALS/SOD1 protein mechanisms and HER2-targeted therapy.

patterns.name: Charges and punishments in criminal appellate judgments
patterns.context: In criminal judgments or appellate documents, states a defendant’s conviction, plea, charges, or punishment; specific offense and sentencing terms are common

patterns.name: Statutes and sentencing enhancements
patterns.context: Federal criminal cases discussing statutory application, sentencing guidelines, or sentencing enhancement factors
patterns.domain: U.S. federal criminal law and sentencing documents

patterns.name: Procedural and adjudicative language in legal documents
patterns.context: Describes litigation procedure, rulings on motions, remands, or the form of a court’s decision; need not be adjacent to charges or punishment

patterns.name: Disease-related proteins and apoptosis mechanisms
patterns.context: Discusses SOD1 protein, ALS, and protein interactions or apoptosis mechanisms

patterns.name: Cancer-targeted therapy terminology
patterns.context: Describes treatments targeting HER2 or its dimerization partners and their efficacy

10_1778.concept: 刑事司法裁判表述（兼杂医学术语）
10_1778.description: 主要响应美国刑事司法文书中关于被告上诉、定罪、认罪、罪名、刑罚及程序裁定的表述，也响应量刑法条；另有两例生物医学文本，分别涉及ALS/SOD1蛋白机制和HER2靶向治疗。

patterns.name: 刑事上诉判决中的罪名与刑罚
patterns.context: 刑事判决或上诉文书中，陈述被告的定罪、认罪、罪名或刑罚；常见具体罪名及量刑词语

patterns.name: 法律条文与量刑增强
patterns.context: 联邦刑事案件讨论法条适用、量刑指南或量刑增强因素
patterns.domain: 美国联邦刑法及量刑文书

patterns.name: 法律文书中的程序及裁判用语
patterns.context: 描述诉讼程序、动议裁定、发回重审或法院裁判方式；未必紧邻罪名或刑罚

patterns.name: 疾病相关蛋白与凋亡机制
patterns.context: 讨论SOD1蛋白、ALS及蛋白相互作用或凋亡机制

patterns.name: 癌症靶向治疗术语
patterns.context: 说明靶向HER2或其二聚化伙伴的治疗及疗效
patterns.domain: 肿瘤医学综述或研究文本

en.concept: Local features of legal appellate documents, with domain miscellany
en.description: Primarily responds to case summaries and judicial-document formatting in federal appellate judgments, where parties appeal convictions, sentences, or immigration rulings; also covers procedural history, sentencing-guideline provisions, Qt code, and biomedical mechanisms and experiments.

patterns.name: Overview of appellants/petitioners and rulings
patterns.context: At the start of a legal opinion or in a case-facts summary, states that a party appeals or seeks review of a conviction, sentence, or administrative decision; common pattern: name + appeals/seeks review/challenges + his/her + ruling

patterns.name: Sentence length and offenses
patterns.context: In criminal appellate summaries, a sentence number appears with month or sentence, followed by offenses or grounds for conviction such as drug charges, false statement, or illegal re-entry

patterns.name: Circuit court opinion format
patterns.context: Heading, judicial signature, or opening format of a court judgment; not present in every legal passage

patterns.name: Government motions and proceedings after remand
patterns.context: In the procedural history of a criminal case, describes a government motion, proceedings after remand, or dismissal of a charge

patterns.name: Sentencing-guideline enhancements and sex-offense language
patterns.context: Cites a U.S. sentencing-guideline provision and describes an applicable enhancement; appears in sentencing analysis rather than case summaries

patterns.name: Qt button code and text/click signals
patterns.context: Python/Qt code creates a button, sets its text, and connects a click event

patterns.name: Receptor dimerization and targeted therapy
patterns.context: Discusses receptor activation mechanisms and treatments such as monoclonal antibodies and kinase inhibitors

patterns.name: Arachidonic acid metabolism and airway inflammation experiments
patterns.context: Describes treating guinea pigs with inhibitors or antibodies to study lipoxygenase products, airway inflammation, or functional abnormalities

10_1778.concept: 局部法律上诉文书特征，兼有领域杂项
10_1778.description: 主要响应联邦上诉判决中当事人对定罪、刑罚或移民裁定提出上诉的案件摘要及司法文书格式；另覆盖程序史、量刑指南条款、Qt代码和生物医学机制/实验文本。

patterns.name: 上诉/复审当事人及裁判概述
patterns.trigger: « appeals»、« seeks» review、« challenges»，以及相邻的« his»、« her»、« sentence»、« conviction»
patterns.context: 法律意见开头或案件事实摘要中，交代当事人对定罪、刑罚或行政决定提出上诉/复审；常见句式为姓名 + appeals/seeks review/challenges + his/her + 裁判结果
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院判决

patterns.name: 刑罚长度及罪名
patterns.context: 刑事上诉摘要中，刑期数字与 month、sentence 连用，并接 drug charges、false statement、illegal re-entry 等罪名或定罪缘由

patterns.name: 巡回法院意见格式
patterns.context: 法院判决的标题、法官署名或意见开头格式；并非所有法律段落都出现

patterns.name: 政府动议及发回后程序
patterns.trigger: « the»« Government»'s« motion»、« on remand»、« charge»…« dismissed»
patterns.context: 刑事案件程序经过中，说明政府提出动议、发回后处理或某项指控被撤销

patterns.name: 量刑指南增强及性犯罪表述
patterns.context: 引用美国量刑指南条款并说明适用增强；出现于量刑分析而非案件摘要
patterns.domain: 联邦刑事量刑法律文书

patterns.name: Qt 按钮代码及文本/点击信号
patterns.context: Python/Qt 代码中创建按钮、设置按钮文字并连接点击事件

patterns.name: 受体二聚化与靶向治疗
patterns.trigger: « activation»…« homodimerization»、« heterodimerization»、« HER»、« tyrosine kinase inhibitors»
patterns.context: 讨论受体激活机制及单克隆抗体、激酶抑制剂等治疗方式
patterns.domain: 生物医学综述/研究文本

patterns.name: 花生四烯酸代谢与气道炎症实验
patterns.trigger: « lipoxygenase»、« arachidonic acid»、« guinea pigs»、« LTB4»
patterns.context: 描述用抑制剂或抗体处理豚鼠，以考察脂氧合酶产物、气道炎症或功能异常
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究计划/实验描述

en.concept: Criminal appeals and sentencing in legal judgments
en.description: Primarily responds to stock language in federal criminal appellate judgments concerning defendants’ appeals, convictions, and punishments, as well as sentence-reduction disputes and statutory citations; also responds to individual references to sex-offense sentencing enhancements and government dismissal of charges, and to HER2-targeted therapy and dimerization terminology in one medical paper.

patterns.name: Stock language in federal criminal appellate decisions
patterns.context: An appellate court opinion states that a defendant appeals a conviction or sentence and introduces the issues in dispute; often followed by district court erred, motion, or sentence.

patterns.name: Sentencing mitigation or appellate disputes
patterns.context: States that a defendant argues the sentencing court improperly denied a reduction, a request, or other relief; focuses on the sentence and grounds for appeal.

patterns.name: Criminal statutes and sentencing-guideline citations
patterns.context: A legal opinion cites criminal statutes or sentencing guidelines, often in connection with convictions, charges, sentencing enhancements, or immigration consequences.

patterns.name: Criminal convictions and sentencing facts
patterns.context: Describes a defendant’s offenses, plea, prior convictions, or sentence imposed.

patterns.name: Sex-offense sentencing enhancement
patterns.context: A sentencing-guideline enhancement provision describes conduct involving a sex offense.

patterns.name: Government motion to dismiss charges
patterns.context: States that the district court dismissed a charge on the government’s motion.

patterns.name: Cancer-targeted therapy and receptor dimerization
patterns.context: Introduces targeted therapies and drugs directed at HER2 or its dimerization partners.

10_1778.concept: 法律判决语境中的刑事上诉与量刑
10_1778.description: 主要响应联邦刑事上诉判决中关于被告上诉、定罪与刑罚的套语，以及减刑争议和法条引用；另响应性犯罪量刑增强、政府撤销指控的个别表述，并在一段医学论文中响应 HER2 靶向治疗与二聚化术语。

patterns.name: 联邦刑事上诉裁判套语
patterns.trigger: “PER CURIAM”、 “On direct appeal”、 “appeals his sentence”、 “On appeal”
patterns.context: 上诉法院意见中交代被告上诉、定罪或刑罚，并引出争议事项；常接着写 district court erred、motion 或 sentence。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦刑事上诉判决

patterns.name: 量刑减轻或上诉争议
patterns.trigger: “two-level reduction”、“downward departure”、“mitigating-role”、“denying his motion”、“denying his request”
patterns.context: 说明被告主张量刑法院拒绝减刑、请求或其他救济有误；内容围绕刑罚及上诉理由。

patterns.name: 刑事法条与量刑指南引用
patterns.context: 法律意见中引用刑事成文法或量刑指南，常与定罪、指控、增强量刑或移民后果有关。

patterns.name: 犯罪定罪及刑罚事实
patterns.trigger: “135-month sentence”、“120-month imprisonment sentence”、“guilty plea conviction”、“prior conviction”
patterns.context: 叙述被告的罪名、认罪、既往定罪或判处的刑期。

patterns.name: 性犯罪量刑增强
patterns.context: 量刑指南增强条款描述涉及性犯罪的行为。

patterns.name: 政府提出撤销指控
patterns.context: 指出地方法院依政府动议撤销某项指控。

patterns.name: 肿瘤靶向治疗与受体二聚化
patterns.trigger: “HER2 or its dimerization partners”、“monoclonal antibody trastuzumab”、“tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKI)”
patterns.context: 介绍针对 HER2 或其二聚化伙伴的靶向疗法及药物。

en.concept: Defendants and adjudicative narratives in legal judgments
en.description: Occurs mainly in criminal appellate judgments, particularly possessive forms referring to defendants, appeals of convictions and sentences, and courts denying motions; it also appears in button event-handling code and targeted cancer therapy. Some legal passages contain only generic legal terms, making more specific trigger patterns difficult to determine.

patterns.name: Possessive his in legal judgments
patterns.context: In a legal opinion or judgment summary, refers to the defendant and introduces the defendant's sentence, conviction, request, or plea; common in appellate narratives

patterns.name: Denials or discretionary rulings in legal opinions
patterns.context: A court denies a sentence reduction, dismisses a motion, or considers a prosecution motion; activation often occurs near the judicial act and its arguments

patterns.name: Appellate and criminal judgment terminology
patterns.context: Describes a defendant's appeal, conviction, sentencing, plea, or judgment outcome; co-occurs with formulaic legal-document narration

patterns.name: GUI button event-handling code
patterns.context: Code sets button text and connects a click event to a handler or listener
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A; Qt/Python and Android/Java code

patterns.name: Targeted cancer therapy
patterns.context: Introduces monoclonal antibodies and tyrosine kinase inhibitors targeting HER2 or its dimerization partners, and their efficacy

10_1778.concept: 法律判决中的被告与裁决叙述
10_1778.description: 主要见于刑事上诉判决，尤其被告所有格、上诉定罪量刑及法院拒绝动议；另见按钮事件处理代码和抗癌靶向治疗。部分法律段落仅有通用法律术语，难以确定更具体触发模式。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的所有格 his
patterns.trigger: his（段 1、7、9、10）；his 在“his sentence”“his convictions”“his plea”等搭配中
patterns.context: 法律意见书或判决摘要中，指涉被告，并引出其刑罚、定罪、请求或认罪；常见于上诉叙述

patterns.name: 法律意见中的拒绝或裁量裁决
patterns.trigger: “denying his”“refusing to grant”“denied Jay's motion”“Government's motion”
patterns.context: 法院拒绝减刑、驳回动议或处理检方动议；触发位置常在司法裁决动作及其论元附近

patterns.name: 上诉及刑事判决术语
patterns.context: 描述被告上诉、定罪、量刑、认罪或判决结果；与法律文书程式化叙述共现

patterns.name: GUI 按钮事件处理代码
patterns.context: 代码中设置按钮文本，并将点击事件连接到处理函数或监听器
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答；Qt/Python 与 Android/Java 代码

patterns.name: 靶向抗癌治疗
patterns.context: 介绍针对 HER2 或其二聚化伙伴的单克隆抗体、酪氨酸激酶抑制剂及疗效

en.description: Primarily responds to criminal appellate narratives, defendant sentencing, and challenges to district court rulings in U.S. appellate judgments; also covers statutory citations, sentencing arguments, offense facts, procedural requests, stock judgment language, and docket formatting.

patterns.name: Appellate review of lower-court rulings
patterns.context: In a criminal appeal narrative, states that a defendant appeals, describes the judgment or sentence received, and raises an objection to a district court ruling
patterns.domain: U.S. federal and state court opinions, commonly criminal appeals

patterns.name: Criminal defendant and sentencing narrative
patterns.context: Summarizes a defendant’s identity, charges, plea or conviction, and sentence; usually connected to the background of an appellate case

patterns.name: Court procedural boilerplate and formatting
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning or end of a judgment or near a judicial signature; includes paragraphs and pagination markers in formatted documents

patterns.name: Statutory and sentencing-guideline citations
patterns.context: Cites federal statutes, sentencing guidelines, or related legal authority in legal reasoning or judgment background

patterns.name: Offense facts and evidence narratives
patterns.context: Describes case facts and charges such as drug offenses, firearms offenses, illegal re-entry, or false statements

patterns.name: Dispute over the effect of dismissal
patterns.context: The appellant argues that the court did not clarify whether dismissal barred a subsequent prosecution, a specific procedural issue

patterns.name: Sentencing enhancement for threatening to use a weapon
patterns.context: Discusses increased punishment under the sentencing guidelines for threatening to use a weapon

patterns.name: Financial burden of a litigation request
patterns.context: The defendant requests that the government cover the cost of obtaining a trial transcript

patterns.name: Arrest, search, and seized items
patterns.context: Describes the circumstances of an arrest and physical evidence seized, such as cocaine

patterns.name: Dismissals and motions in civil or other appeals
patterns.context: The conclusion records dismissal of a case on the appellant’s motion, without clearly indicating that it is a typical criminal appellate narrative

patterns.name: Citations and docket locator information
patterns.context: Judgment citations, case numbers, and other document metadata, possibly adjacent to the judgment text or pagination

10_1778.concept: 美国刑事上诉判决文本
10_1778.description: 主要响应美国上诉法院判决中的刑事上诉叙述、被告判刑及对地区法院裁定的异议；也覆盖法条引用、量刑论证、犯罪事实、程序请求、判决套语和案卷版式。

patterns.name: 上诉法院审查下级法院裁定
patterns.trigger: “appeals”“On appeal”“direct appeal”，以及“district court erred”“denying his motion/request”等
patterns.context: 刑事案件上诉叙述中交代被告上诉、所受判决或刑罚，并提出对地区法院裁定的异议
patterns.domain: 美国联邦及州法院意见书，常见于刑事上诉

patterns.name: 刑事被告与判刑叙述
patterns.context: 概述被告身份、罪名、认罪或定罪及刑期；通常与上诉案件背景相连

patterns.name: 法院程序性套语与版式
patterns.trigger: “PER CURIAM”“CURIAM:”“Circuit Judge”“District Judge”“Dismissed on Appellant's Motion”及标题、换行和页码等
patterns.context: 出现在判决开头、法官署名或结尾处；包括格式化文书中的段落与分页标记

patterns.name: 法条与量刑指南引用
patterns.context: 法律论证或判决背景中引用联邦法条、量刑指南或相关法律依据

patterns.name: 犯罪事实与证据叙述
patterns.trigger: “cocaine base”“firearm and drug trafficking offenses”“illegal re-entry after deportation”“false statement”
patterns.context: 交代涉毒、枪支、非法再入境或虚假陈述等案情及指控

patterns.name: 关于驳回效力的争议
patterns.trigger: “whether the dismissal was with or without prejudice”
patterns.context: 上诉人主张法院未说明驳回是否妨碍再次起诉，属于具体程序争点

patterns.name: 威胁使用武器的量刑加重
patterns.context: 讨论依据量刑指南对威胁使用武器施加加重处罚

patterns.name: 诉讼请求的经济负担
patterns.trigger: “request for a transcript at Government expense”
patterns.context: 被告请求由政府承担取得庭审记录的费用

patterns.name: 逮捕、搜查及涉案物品
patterns.context: 叙述逮捕背景及查获可卡因等物证

patterns.name: 民事或其他上诉案件的驳回与动议

patterns.name: 引证与案卷定位信息
patterns.context: 判决引证、案号等文书元数据，附近可能衔接判决正文或分页内容

en.concept: Legal judgment language primarily, with biomedical terminology
en.description: Activations occur primarily in language about facts, offense statutes, sentencing, and procedural rulings in legal appellate judgments; two other passages concern HIV drug regimens and adherence, and one concerns the MAPK/ERK pathway and inhibitors. No clear cross-domain shared pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Legal tokens in judgment headings, case facts, or appellate arguments
patterns.context: In legal judgments, describes a defendant, appeal, sentence, or court ruling; strong activations may occur on ordinary function words in a sentence, such as for or his, or near case-fact terms.

patterns.name: Criminal charges and statutory citations
patterns.context: Lists drug, firearms, or other charges and U.S. Code provisions in a criminal case; may also appear in government motions, conviction, or sentencing narratives.

patterns.name: Appellate procedure and court-decision language
patterns.context: Concerns district court rulings, remands, appellate arguments, or procedural relief; activations often occur on procedural terms or requests.

patterns.name: Tenofovir/emtricitabine combination drug names and HIV prevention or treatment research
patterns.context: Describes PrEP, HIV, ART regimens, or medication-adherence studies; the two drug names appear together.

patterns.name: MAPK/ERK pathway and inhibitors
patterns.context: Describes pathway activation, ERK phosphorylation, and specific inhibitors in biomedical research.

10_1778.concept: 法律判决措辞为主，另含生物医学术语
10_1778.description: 激活主要出现在法律上诉判决的案情、罪名法条、量刑和程序裁定措辞；另有两段涉及 HIV 药物方案与依从性，一段涉及 MAPK/ERK 通路及抑制剂。跨领域共同规律不明显。

patterns.name: 判决标题、案情或上诉论述中的法律 token
patterns.trigger: «appeals»3« his»5« 135»2«-»5«month»4« sentence»5« for»10；«On»2 direct« appeal»1«,»2« Defendant»2« challenges»3；«his»9« request
patterns.context: 法律判决文本中，叙述被告、上诉、刑期或法院裁决；强激活可落在句中普通功能词，如 for、his，也可出现在案情词附近。

patterns.name: 刑事罪名与法条列举
patterns.context: 刑事案件中列出毒品、枪支或其他罪名及美国法典条款；同时可能出现在政府动议、定罪或量刑叙述中。

patterns.name: 上诉程序与法院裁判措辞
patterns.trigger: «district»1« court»3« erred»2« in»4；«dismissal»3«↵↵»2«was»4« with»3« or»1« without»5« prejudice
patterns.context: 围绕地方法院裁定、发回重审、上诉主张或程序性救济展开；激活常见于程序用语或请求内容。

patterns.name: tenofovir/emtricitabine 组合药名及 HIV 预防或治疗研究
patterns.context: 描述 PrEP、HIV、ART 方案或服药依从性研究；两种药名并列出现。

patterns.name: MAPK/ERK 通路与抑制剂
patterns.context: 生物医学研究中叙述通路激活、ERK 磷酸化及特定抑制剂。

en.concept: Specific technical terms and procedural descriptions
en.description: Activations occur in HIV/HBV research or treatment texts containing tenofovir/emtricitabine, as well as in federal criminal appeals, sentencing, and drug-conviction judgments; sporadic activations also occur in Android button-listener code and myeloma drug treatment.

patterns.name: Tenofovir/emtricitabine in drug names
patterns.context: Generic drug names are split into multiple tokens; appear in drug regimens for HIV/HBV prevention, antiviral treatment, or clinical research.

patterns.name: Appeals and sentencing in federal criminal judgments
patterns.context: Federal judgments describe a defendant’s appeal, court ruling, sentence, or sentencing request; triggers are distributed across adjacent legal sentences.

patterns.name: Criminal convictions and drug charges
patterns.context: Lists a defendant’s convictions and drug offenses in case facts or at the beginning of a judgment.

patterns.name: Java Android button-click code
patterns.context: An Android example creates a button, sets its text, and configures a click listener.

patterns.name: Myeloma drug names
patterns.context: A medical case report describes a patient receiving several treatment cycles.

10_1778.concept: 特定技术名词与程序描述
10_1778.description: 激活见于含 tenofovir/emtricitabine 的 HIV/HBV 研究或治疗文本，也见联邦刑事上诉、量刑与毒品定罪判决；另对 Android 按钮监听代码及骨髓瘤药物治疗有零星激活。

patterns.name: 药物名称中的 tenofovir/emtricitabine
patterns.context: 药物通用名被拆分成多个 token；出现在 HIV/HBV 预防、抗病毒治疗或临床研究的药物方案中。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、NIH 研究描述

patterns.name: 联邦刑事判决的上诉与量刑
patterns.context: 联邦判决叙述被告上诉、法院裁决及刑期或量刑请求；触发分散在相邻法律句子中。

patterns.name: 刑事定罪及毒品指控
patterns.context: 案件事实或判决开篇列举被告的定罪与毒品罪名。

patterns.name: Java Android 按钮点击代码
patterns.context: Android 示例代码中创建按钮、设置文本并配置点击监听器。

patterns.name: 骨髓瘤治疗药名
patterns.context: 病历描述患者接受多个疗程的药物治疗。

en.concept: Procedural and adjudicative narratives in case-law documents
en.description: Responds mainly to appeals, criminal convictions and sentencing, and review of immigration relief in U.S. case law; it also covers legal citations, sentencing guidelines, and judgment boilerplate. A separate Qt button-code passage has a different topic.

patterns.name: Narratives of legal appeals
patterns.context: Describes a party appealing or seeking review of a judgment, sentence, or immigration decision, often followed by the court's ruling and reasoning

patterns.name: Criminal judgments and sentences
patterns.context: Criminal charges, pleas, sentencing, drug or firearm facts, and sentencing disputes

patterns.name: Denial of an immigration relief application
patterns.context: An immigration applicant seeks review of an immigration judge's denial of asylum or related relief

patterns.name: Case citation format
patterns.context: A U.S. case reporter volume, page number, and year citation appears at the beginning of a paragraph

patterns.name: Citation to sentencing-guideline provisions
patterns.context: The court explains application of sentencing guidelines and the enhancement for a specific offense characteristic

patterns.name: Case caption or procedural boilerplate
patterns.context: Opening language in a judgment concerning the panel, court procedure, or origin of the case

patterns.name: Buttons and text labels in code
patterns.context: Python/Qt UI code creates a button, sets its displayed text, and connects a click event

10_1778.concept: 判例文书中的程序与裁判叙述
10_1778.description: 主要响应美国判例中的上诉、刑事定罪量刑及移民救济复审叙述，也覆盖法律引注、量刑指南和判决套语；另有一段 Qt 按钮代码，主题不同。

patterns.name: 法律上诉案件叙述
patterns.context: 描述当事人对判决、刑罚或移民裁决提起上诉或申请复审，常接法院的裁定与理由

patterns.name: 刑事判决与刑罚
patterns.context: 刑事案件的罪名、认罪、量刑、毒品或枪支事实及量刑争议

patterns.name: 移民救济申请被拒
patterns.context: 移民申请人请求复审移民法官拒绝庇护或相关救济的决定

patterns.name: 判例引证格式
patterns.context: 段首出现美国判例报告卷号、页码与年份的引证

patterns.name: 量刑指南条文引用
patterns.context: 法院说明量刑指南适用及特定犯罪情节的加重幅度

patterns.name: 案件标题或法院程序套语
patterns.context: 判决开头的合议庭、法院程序或案件来源说明

patterns.name: 代码中的按钮与文本标签
patterns.context: Python/Qt 界面代码中创建按钮、设置显示文本并连接点击事件

en.description: Primarily responds to appeals, sentencing, drug and firearms offenses, pleas, and procedural dispositions in federal criminal legal texts; it also responds to signaling pathways and clinical drug research in biomedical texts, with no clear shared pattern across domains.

patterns.name: Federal criminal appeals and sentencing
patterns.context: A judicial opinion describes a defendant’s appeal, sentence, or challenge to a district court ruling; includes parties, charges, and procedural motions.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal appellate court judgments, primarily criminal cases

patterns.name: Drug- and firearm-related criminal case facts
patterns.context: In charging or judgment facts, describes drug quantities, firearm-related charges, or possession of drugs with intent to distribute; often accompanied by a defendant’s name and statutory citations.

patterns.name: Plea, conviction, and sentencing dispositions
patterns.context: Describes case dispositions such as a criminal plea, plea agreement, counts of conviction, or dismissal of charges; also appears in legal news reporting.

patterns.name: Structure and formatting of legal documents
patterns.context: Headings, judicial signatures, paragraphs, and pagination fragments in court opinions; weak triggers, often co-occurring with criminal appellate content.

patterns.name: Molecular pathway and inhibitor research
patterns.context: Discusses cellular signaling pathway activation, phosphorylation, or inhibitors and their effects on drug resistance.

patterns.name: Clinical trials and drug regimens
patterns.context: Introduces PrEP clinical studies, adherence substudies, and antiviral drug combinations.

10_1778.concept: 法律与医学专业文本片段
10_1778.description: 主要响应联邦刑事法律文本中的上诉、判刑、毒品枪支罪名、认罪与程序处置；另对生物医学文本中的信号通路和临床药物研究有响应，跨领域共享模式不明显。

patterns.name: 联邦刑事上诉与量刑
patterns.trigger: “appeals”“On appeal”“sentence”“sentencing guidelines”“motion to dismiss”“motion to suppress”
patterns.context: 描述被告上诉、判刑或对地区法院裁决提出异议的司法意见；包含案件当事人、罪名及程序性动议。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院判决，主要是刑事案件

patterns.name: 毒品与枪支刑事案件事实
patterns.trigger: “cocaine base”“firearm and drug trafficking offenses”“methamphetamine”“possession with intent to distribute”
patterns.context: 在起诉或判决事实中说明毒品数量、枪支相关罪名或持有毒品意图分销；常伴随被告姓名和法律条文。

patterns.name: 认罪、定罪与量刑处置
patterns.context: 叙述刑事案件的认罪、认罪协议、指控计数或指控撤销等案件处置；也出现于法律新闻报道。

patterns.name: 诉讼文书的结构与格式
patterns.trigger: “PER CURIAM:”“Circuit Judges”“Circuit Judge”“¶/换行及空白分隔”
patterns.context: 法院意见书的抬头、法官署名、段落与分页等版式片段；触发较弱，常与刑事上诉内容共现。

patterns.name: 分子通路与抑制剂研究
patterns.context: 讨论细胞信号通路活化、磷酸化或抑制剂及其对耐药性的影响。

patterns.name: 临床试验与药物方案
patterns.context: 介绍PrEP临床研究、依从性子研究及抗病毒药物组合。

en.description: Activation spans two types of material: procedural and sentencing narratives in criminal appellate opinions, and button event binding in UI programming; it also occurs in Android full-screen/orientation configuration and iOS button-layout styling.

patterns.name: Procedural legal language in appellate cases
patterns.context: A criminal judgment or appellate opinion states the defendant, charges, sentence, motions, plea, or appellate issues; typically uses formal legal-document phrasing

patterns.name: Setting up a button click listener
patterns.context: Code creates or configures a UI button and connects a click callback or listener

patterns.name: Full-screen and screen-orientation configuration
patterns.context: Configuration code for Activity windows or device display behavior

patterns.name: Setting button geometry and border style
patterns.context: Code sets a button's size and position, as well as the layer border color

10_1778.concept: 程序与界面操作语境
10_1778.description: 激活覆盖两类材料：刑事上诉意见中的程序与量刑叙述，以及 UI 编程中按钮事件绑定；另见 Android 全屏/方向配置和 iOS 按钮布局样式。

patterns.name: 上诉案件的程序性法律表述
patterns.trigger: “appeals his … sentence”“Prior to entering his plea”“entered a conditional guilty plea”“On direct appeal, Defendant challenges”及“PER CURIAM”
patterns.context: 刑事案件判决或上诉意见中，陈述被告、罪名、量刑、动议、认罪或上诉争点；通常为正式法律文书句式

patterns.name: 按钮点击监听器设置
patterns.context: 代码中创建或配置 UI 按钮，并连接点击回调或监听器

patterns.name: 全屏与屏幕方向配置
patterns.context: Activity 窗口或设备显示行为的配置代码

patterns.name: 按钮几何与边框样式设置
patterns.context: 通过代码设置按钮的尺寸位置及图层边框颜色

en.description: Multiple strong activations fall on the DB letter string or its embedded forms (DBMD, InnoDB, MDB, N2DB, GDB), across medical, biological, software, and hardware texts; sporadic activations also occur in email IDs and web instructions, indicating the pattern is not tied to a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Duchenne/Becker muscular dystrophy abbreviations
patterns.context: In medical texts, an abbreviation or disease name appears in a patient, disease, care, or monitoring context; activation is especially concentrated on “DB” in “DBMD”.

patterns.name: ARALIP mutant database abbreviation
patterns.context: At the end of a database or directory name describing information about Arabidopsis acyl-lipid metabolism mutants.

patterns.name: DB in cell line names
patterns.context: Appears within the cell line name “MDBK cells”, in a biological context involving the cell cycle and replication experiments.

patterns.name: Database configuration and storage engine identifier
patterns.context: As part of a storage engine name in database server configuration instructions.

patterns.name: DB marker near message queue code
patterns.context: “MDB looks like” appears after Java message queue code; the code involves JMS, queues, and message-driven beans.

patterns.name: N2DB hardware decoding marker
patterns.context: An abbreviated label for hardware data bus buffer control, alongside N2MD, N2IO, and N2V.

patterns.name: DB in email identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in the opaque identifier string of an email Message-ID, with no visible semantic database usage.

patterns.name: GDB in paths/filenames
patterns.context: Appears in the URL path and filename of GNU debugger documentation.

patterns.name: Interface/step text not classifiable as a DB pattern
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across web-style instruction text and adjacent content; the visible excerpts contain no clear DB string or semantic association.

10_1806.description: 多处强激活落在 DB 字母串或其嵌入形式（DBMD、InnoDB、MDB、N2DB、GDB）上，横跨医学、生物学、软件与硬件文本；另有邮件 ID 和网页指令中的零散激活，说明模式并非单一语义。

patterns.name: Duchenne/Becker 肌营养不良缩写
patterns.context: 医学文本中，缩写或病名出现在患者、疾病、护理或监测语境；激活尤其集中在“DBMD”中的“DB”。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: ARALIP mutant 数据库缩写
patterns.context: 数据库名称或目录名称的结尾，描述 Arabidopsis 酰基脂质代谢突变体信息。
patterns.domain: 植物生物学、数据库介绍

patterns.name: 细胞系名称中的 DB
patterns.context: 出现在“MDBK cells”细胞系名称内，处于细胞周期、复制实验的生物学语境。

patterns.name: 数据库配置与存储引擎标识
patterns.context: 作为存储引擎名称的一部分，出现在数据库服务器配置说明中。

patterns.name: 消息队列代码附近的 DB 标记
patterns.context: Java 消息队列代码之后出现“MDB looks like”；代码涉及 JMS、队列和消息驱动 bean。

patterns.name: 硬件解码标记 N2DB
patterns.context: 作为硬件数据总线缓冲控制的缩写标签，与 N2MD、N2IO、N2V 并列。

patterns.name: 邮件标识符中的 DB
patterns.context: 出现在邮件 Message-ID 的不透明标识字符串中，没有可见的语义性数据库用法。

patterns.name: 路径/文件名中的 GDB
patterns.context: 出现在 GNU 调试器文档的 URL 路径及文件名中。
patterns.domain: 开发者论坛、软件文档链接

patterns.name: 无法归入 DB 模式的界面/步骤文字
patterns.trigger: “The following libraries should be there”“Step 4”“Verify the Built”
patterns.context: 激活分布在网页式指令文字及其相邻内容中；可见片段没有明确的 DB 字符串或语义关联。

en.description: The most consistent local cue is the DB/db string, especially in databases, technical identifiers, and abbreviations; it also appears in the DBMD abbreviation for muscular dystrophy and the MDBK cell line. There is also activation on format tokens in a construction note and email timestamp, indicating more than one pattern.

patterns.name: Muscular dystrophy and DBMD abbreviation
patterns.context: Medical abstracts or research-network text about Duchenne/Becker muscular dystrophy; activation falls on disease-name fragments and DB in the abbreviation.

patterns.name: DB in database abbreviations
patterns.context: DB or db appears in strings such as database names, storage engines, technical identifiers, email IDs, and file paths; casing and surrounding context vary.
patterns.domain: Bioinformatics databases, software configuration/code, hardware documentation, email metadata, web paths

patterns.name: Cell-cycle term MDK
patterns.context: In a cell-cycle experiment context, DB occurs within the cell-line name MDBK; the context also mentions DNA replication and synchronized cells.

patterns.name: “should be there” in library-operation instructions
patterns.context: Procedural text resembling an installation or build guide; salient tokens include should, be, there, Step, Verify, etc., with no DB topic apparent.

patterns.name: Date and time separator format in email headers
patterns.context: Email-header-style timestamps, with colons and hyphens separating the time and time zone; the same passage also contains email routing fields and IDs.

10_1806.concept: DB/db 字符串及技术标识符
10_1806.description: 最一致的局部线索是 DB/db 字符串，尤其数据库、技术标识符与缩写；也出现在肌营养不良的 DBMD、细胞系 MDBK 中。另对一段构建说明及邮件时间戳中的格式词元激活，说明模式不止一个。

patterns.name: 肌营养不良及 DBMD 缩写
patterns.context: 杜氏/贝克肌营养不良的医学摘要或研究网络文本；激活落在疾病名称片段及缩写中的 DB。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: 数据库缩写中的 DB
patterns.context: DB 或 db 出现在数据库名称、存储引擎、技术标识符、邮件 ID、文件路径等字符串中；大小写和周围语境不一。
patterns.domain: 生物信息数据库、软件配置/代码、硬件文档、邮件元数据、网页路径

patterns.name: 细胞周期术语 MDK
patterns.context: 细胞周期实验语境中，DB 位于细胞系名称 MDBK 内；上下文还提到 DNA 复制和同步细胞。

patterns.name: 库操作说明中的 should be there
patterns.trigger: “libraries should be there”及“Step 4. Verify the Built”
patterns.context: 类似安装或构建指南的步骤说明；显著 token 为 should、be、there、Step、Verify 等，未见 DB 主题。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的日期与时间分隔格式
patterns.context: 邮件头式时间戳，冒号和连字符分隔时间及时区；同段还包含邮件路由字段和 ID。

en.concept: DB strings and sporadic frequent fragments
en.description: The most prominent repeated cue is the DB string, spanning medical abbreviations and database, code, hardware, and news contexts; there are also hyphens in mathematics or timestamps and Between in paper titles, which are difficult to group into one semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Fragment within DB/DMD abbreviations
patterns.context: DB appears in disease or database-name abbreviations; some examples also contain MD, but DB appears in other contexts as well.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, NIH project descriptions, plant databases, code, computer hardware, and news text

patterns.name: Hyphen in numeric ranges
patterns.context: In isolated mathematical text, a hyphen connects a symbol and a number.

patterns.name: Separator in email timestamps
patterns.context: A minus sign followed by digits in an email-header timestamp.

patterns.name: Between in a title phrase
patterns.context: The preposition Between occurs in a title between two research-variable phrases.

10_1806.concept: DB字符串及零散高频片段
10_1806.description: 最突出的重复线索是 DB 字符串，跨医学缩写及数据库、代码、硬件和新闻等语境；另有数学或时间戳中的连字符，以及论文标题中的 Between，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: DB/DMD 缩写内部片段
patterns.context: DB出现在疾病或数据库名称缩写中；部分示例同时有 MD，但其他语境也出现 DB
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、NIH 项目介绍、植物数据库、代码、计算机硬件及新闻文本

patterns.name: 数字范围中的连字符
patterns.trigger: «-»9，位于“*l - 10 for l.”的数值/符号序列中
patterns.context: 孤立数学文本中连字符连接符号与数字

patterns.name: 邮件时间戳中的分隔符
patterns.context: 邮件头时间戳中的减号与后续数字

patterns.name: 标题短语中的 Between
patterns.trigger: «Between»9，出现在标题“Daily Associations Between Kissing and Affect During the Transition”中
patterns.context: 标题中介词 Between 位于两个研究变量短语之间
patterns.domain: 医学/行为研究论文标题

en.description: Activations are scattered across tokenized subword fragments, Virtual phrases, networking and database terminology, code punctuation, and mathematical symbols; similar surface cues occur, but semantic and stylistic differences are too large to confirm a unified trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Tokenized subwords in proper nouns
patterns.context: Proper nouns or ordinary words are split into multiple subword tokens, especially where the segmentation itself forms a salient subword fragment; «rist», «Duc», «Kom», «is», and «verse» activate strongly in the examples

patterns.name: Phrases beginning with Virtual
patterns.context: Virtual appears at the beginning of a phrase or proper noun; in the fifth excerpt it is followed by split extensible and a network name

patterns.name: Communications and networking terminology
patterns.context: Technical terms appear in descriptions related to communications and networking

patterns.name: DB fragment in proper nouns
patterns.context: The letter string DB occurs in the disease abbreviation DMD and the database proper noun MongoDB, in different contexts

patterns.name: Punctuation and formatting in code comments
patterns.context: Semicolons, hyphens, periods, and comment markers are dense near code comments or class definitions

patterns.name: Symbol patterns in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Short mathematical or typeset fragments, with variable l, minus signs, numbers, and punctuation together

10_1806.description: 激活分散于切分后的词片段、Virtual短语、网络与数据库术语、代码标点及数学符号；相似表面线索存在，但语义和文体差异大，无法确认统一触发模式。

patterns.name: 专名中的切分子词
patterns.context: 专名或普通词被分成多个子词 token，尤其是分段本身形成较突出的词片段；例中 «rist»、«Duc»、«Kom»、«is»、«verse» 激活较强
patterns.domain: 邮件、医学摘要、议会文本

patterns.name: Virtual 开头的短语
patterns.context: Virtual 出现在短语或专名开头；在第5段后接被拆分的 extensible 及网络名称

patterns.name: 通信网络技术词汇
patterns.context: 通信、网络相关描述中出现技术术语

patterns.name: 专名中的 DB 片段
patterns.context: 字母串 DB 出现在疾病缩写 DMD 与数据库专名 MongoDB 中，周围语境不同

patterns.name: 代码注释中的标点与格式
patterns.context: 代码注释或类定义附近，分号、连字符、句点及注释标记密集出现

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的符号模式
patterns.context: 简短数学或排版片段，变量 l、减号、数字与标点并列

en.description: The most stable pattern is capitalized word-initial Be-, appearing with various endings across text domains; isolated high activation on in, conventional, and Vote lacks shared morphological or contextual evidence.

patterns.name: Word-initial Be- subword token
patterns.context: Capitalized Be occurs at the beginning of a word and is followed by different endings, forming words such as Beards, Behind, Beauty, Begrüßung, Beaver, Beach, Beigoma, etc. High activation is concentrated on Be, while activation on endings is weaker or more variable; sometimes following context also activates more weakly.
patterns.domain: Web text, titles, German parliamentary text, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Within-word occurrence of the preposition in
patterns.context: Lowercase in occurs as a standalone preposition in a scientific abstract, followed by response; later in the same passage, “in humans” also activates.

patterns.name: conventional prefix
patterns.context: The whole word conventional activates strongly, as does the preceding sentence-initial In; the following text is a technical description of a communications network.

patterns.name: Title word Vote
patterns.context: Vote is capitalized and standalone in a news headline, in the structure “Leaders Vote to Close...”.

10_1806.description: 最稳定的模式是大写词首 Be-，跨多种词尾与文本领域出现；另有孤立的 in、conventional、Vote 高激活，缺乏共同词形或语境证据。

patterns.name: 词首 Be- 子词元
patterns.context: 大写 Be 位于词首，后接不同词尾，可组成 Beards、Behind、Beauty、Begrüßung、Beaver、Beach、Beigoma 等。高激活集中在 Be，而词尾激活较弱或变化较大；有时后续词境也出现较弱激活。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、标题、德语议会文本及百科条目

patterns.name: 介词 in 的词内出现
patterns.context: 小写 in 作为独立介词，出现在科学摘要中，后接 response；同段稍后“in humans”也有激活。

patterns.name: conventional 前缀
patterns.context: conventional 整词强激活，前面的句首 In 也有较强激活；后续是通信网络的技术描述。

patterns.name: 标题词 Vote
patterns.context: 新闻标题中 Vote 大写且独立成词，处于“Leaders Vote to Close...”结构内。

en.concept: Multiple subword fragments and formatting features
en.description: Activations are scattered across fragments within English and Finnish words, number sequences, and academic proper nouns; medical abstracts, mathematical text, parliamentary text, and conference schedules have different triggering cues, making it difficult to attribute them to a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Number sequences
patterns.context: Consecutive Arabic numerals separated by spaces, resembling a list or numbered sequence; no other context.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within specific words
patterns.context: Activations fall on split English word fragments, especially fragments within words; semantic and morphological conditions vary across examples.
patterns.domain: English biomedical terms in PubMed abstracts and general academic vocabulary

patterns.name: Fragments within Finnish words
patterns.context: Finnish words are split into subword fragments; activations involve fragments within longer words and committee-related word forms.

patterns.name: Bisalbuminuria and bisalbuminemia word family
patterns.context: Similar terms such as bisalbuminuria and bisalbuminemia appear in medical case report titles, with activations across fragments within the words.
patterns.domain: PubMed case reports involving nephrotic syndrome

patterns.name: Local word fragments in formal mathematical text
patterns.context: Several common English word fragments and mathematical variables activate near theorems, conditions, or symbolic expressions, with no single clear trigger word.

patterns.name: Conference date and time records
patterns.context: Fragments such as the event title, date, and time activate together in a conference entry.
patterns.domain: Public health conference schedules or footnotes

patterns.name: Thromboxane and vasoconstriction terminology
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across biochemical terms such as vascular endothelium, thromboxane, constriction, and 5-hydroxytryptamine.
patterns.domain: PubMed biomedical abstracts involving the rat basilar artery

10_1806.concept: 多类词片段与格式特征
10_1806.description: 激活散布于英文及芬兰语词内片段、数字序列和学术专名中；医学摘要、数学文本、议会文本与会议日程均有不同触发线索，难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 数字序列
patterns.context: 连续空格分隔的阿拉伯数字，像列表或编号序列；无其他上下文。
patterns.domain: 来源标注为 PhilPapers 的孤立文本片段

patterns.name: 特定词内的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的英文词片段上，尤其是单词内部的片段；各段语义与词形条件并不统一。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要中的英文生物医学术语，以及一般学术词汇

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 芬兰语词被拆为子词片段；激活分别涉及较长词中的词内片段及委员会相关词形。

patterns.name: 白蛋白尿与白蛋白血症词族
patterns.context: 医学病例标题中出现 bisalbuminuria、bisalbuminemia 等相近术语，激活覆盖词内片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed 病例报告，涉及肾病综合征

patterns.name: 形式化数学文本中的局部词片段
patterns.context: 定理、条件或符号表达附近，多个常见英文词片段和数学变量均有激活，未见单一明确触发词。

patterns.name: 会议日期时间记录
patterns.context: 会议条目中，活动标题、日期与时间等片段同时激活。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生会议日程或脚注

patterns.name: 血栓烷与血管收缩术语
patterns.context: 激活分布在血管内皮、血栓烷、收缩及 5-hydroxytryptamine 等生化术语中。
patterns.domain: PubMed 生物医学摘要，涉及大鼠基底动脉

en.description: Most activations fall on optic: it usually refers to the optic nerve/optic chiasm, but also to optical components of intraocular lenses, optical waveguides, or the optic tectum; contexts span ophthalmology, neuroscience, and photonics, with one unexplained excerpt.

patterns.name: Optic nerve anatomy and pathology
patterns.context: Discusses the anatomy, injury, atrophy, or regeneration of retinal ganglion cells, the optic nerve, and the optic chiasm; includes ophthalmology and neuroscience literature.

patterns.name: Optic component of an intraocular lens
patterns.context: Optic refers to the optical component of an intraocular lens, not the optic nerve; appears in discussions of surgical procedures or lens design.

patterns.name: Optic in optical waveguides
patterns.context: Part of the term optical/optic waveguide, discussing connections between optical fibers and integrated waveguides; activation is annotated on optic.

patterns.name: Optic tectum-related terminology
patterns.context: Related to hypothalamic/midbrain networks and neuron teaching models; optic-tectum is a compound anatomical term.

patterns.name: Unclassifiable remaining excerpt
patterns.context: There is no obvious optic trigger in the cosmological parameter and power spectrum context, so the provided excerpt does not explain why this segment is listed as highly activated.

10_1806.description: 多数激活落在 optic：常指视神经/视交叉，也指人工晶状体光学部件、光学波导或 optic tectum；跨眼科、神经科学与光子学语境，另有一段无法解释。

patterns.name: 视神经解剖与病变
patterns.trigger: «optic»10（以及同句中的 optic nerve、optic nerve head、optic chiasm）
patterns.context: 讨论视网膜神经节细胞、视神经及视交叉的解剖、损伤、萎缩或再生；包括眼科与神经科学文献。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、眼科/神经科学

patterns.name: 人工晶状体的 optic 部件
patterns.context: optic 指人工晶状体的光学部件，而非视神经；出现在手术操作或晶状体设计讨论中。

patterns.name: 光学波导中的 optic
patterns.context: 作为 optical/optic waveguide 术语的一部分，讨论光纤与集成波导的连接；激活标注落在 optic。

patterns.name: 视顶盖神经元相关术语
patterns.context: 与下丘脑/中脑网络及神经元教学模型相关，optic-tectum 是复合解剖术语。

patterns.name: 无法明确归类的余段
patterns.trigger: “EE power spectrum”等；未见标注的 optic
patterns.context: 宇宙学参数与功率谱语境中没有明显的 optic 触发项，无法由给定片段解释该段被列为高激活的原因。

en.concept: Text dense with numbers and symbols
en.description: Activations span multiple text types: mathematical problems notably contain numbers, punctuation, variables, powers, and operators; other examples include numerical/symbolic content in scientific papers, chemical formulas, citation inequalities, physics terminology, and patent boilerplate. No trigger condition unifies all excerpts.

patterns.name: Ordinary mathematical numbers and punctuation
patterns.context: Punctuation appears adjacent to numbers in number sequences or lists; no specific mathematical content is required
patterns.domain: Mathematical text, problems, or numerical data

patterns.name: Variables in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Variables appear in polynomial, exponential, or fractional expressions, often with problem wording such as “Determine y”, “What is the x'th term”, or “Simplify”

patterns.name: English math problem prompts
patterns.context: Introduces a calculation, simplification, or term-finding problem; tokens near some prompts activate weakly, while strong activations mainly fall on numbers, symbols, and variables

patterns.name: Minus signs and arithmetic operators
patterns.context: Operators occur between numbers, variables, or powers to form expressions; minus signs also appear in negative numbers and fractions in parentheses

patterns.name: Scientific notation and Greek symbols
patterns.context: A timescale is expressed as an approximate value and in scientific notation in a derivation of platelet half-life

patterns.name: Patent boilerplate in background descriptions
patterns.context: Describes existing vehicle designs based on patent documents; the sentence continues while describing the front-wheel structure

patterns.name: Chemical formulas and atmospheric composition of celestial bodies
patterns.context: Lists hydrocarbons detected in Titan’s atmosphere and mentions the Voyager 1 flyby

patterns.name: Citations and relational symbols in mathematical papers
patterns.context: Presents a mathematical result using author citations and inequalities, with reference markers nearby

patterns.name: Electron gas physics terminology and parameters
patterns.context: Discusses the validity range of a simulation and explains the ratio of a dimensionless parameter to particle spacing and the Bohr radius

10_1806.description: 激活覆盖多类文本：数学题中尤见数字、标点、变量、幂与运算符；另有科学论文中的数值/符号、化学式、引文不等式、物理术语及专利套语，未见能统一解释全部片段的触发条件。

patterns.name: 普通数学数字与标点
patterns.context: 数字序列或数字列表中，标点紧邻数字出现；不要求特定数学内容
patterns.domain: 数学文本、题目或数值数据

patterns.name: 代数表达式中的变量
patterns.context: 变量出现在多项式、指数或分式表达式中，常伴随“Determine y”“What is the x'th term”“Simplify”等题目措辞

patterns.name: 英文数学题目提示语
patterns.context: 引出数学计算、化简或求项的问题；部分提示语附近的 token 激活较弱，强激活主要落在数字、符号和变量上

patterns.name: 负号与算术运算符
patterns.context: 运算符夹在数字、变量或幂之间，组成算式；负号也出现在负数及括号内的分式中

patterns.name: 科学记数法与希腊符号
patterns.context: 在血小板半衰期的推导中，将时间尺度写成近似数值与科学记数法
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文中的定量计算

patterns.name: 专利背景叙述中的套语
patterns.trigger: “In recent years,”“a study about a vehicle,”“as disclosed in below-identified Patent Document 1”
patterns.context: 以专利文件为依据介绍既有车辆方案，句子在说明前轮结构处延续

patterns.name: 化学式与天体大气成分
patterns.context: 列举泰坦大气中检测到的烃类，并提及旅行者1号飞掠

patterns.name: 数学论文的引文与关系符号
patterns.context: 以作者引文和不等式陈述数学结果，周围含有参考文献标记

patterns.name: 电子气物理术语与参数
patterns.trigger: “finite temperature”“high degeneracy”“Brueckner parameter rs=a/aB”及“mean interparticle distance”
patterns.context: 讨论模拟有效性范围，并解释无量纲参数与粒子间距、玻尔半径的比值

en.description: Strong activations occur on text containing groups of algebraic power-expression simplification problems, especially power-expression answers after assumptions that variables are positive, new problems beginning with “Simplify”, and negative or fractional exponents written with **.

patterns.name: Answers to power-expression simplification problems
patterns.context: The preceding text contains an algebraic expression with variables, fractional exponents, and nested multiplication/division; variables are first declared positive, followed by the simplified power expression as the answer.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics; symbolic algebra exercises or problem solutions

patterns.name: Simplify prompt
patterns.context: Begins the next algebra simplification problem, followed by an expression with powers, variables, and parentheses; often appears after the previous answer.

patterns.name: Powers and exponent notation
patterns.context: Nested algebraic expressions use double asterisks for exponentiation; exponents are often negative or fractional, and the same variable recurs within an expression.
