patterns.domain: Symbolic mathematics / machine-readable or programmatic problem text

10_1806.description: 对成组的代数幂式化简题文本有强激活，尤其是变量正值假设后的幂式答案、以“Simplify”开头的新题，以及用 ** 表示的负或分数指数。

patterns.name: 幂式化简题的答案
patterns.trigger: “assuming … is positive.” 后换行，给出形如变量的幂（如 «f»3«**(…)，«h»3«**(…)，«t»3**(…)）
patterns.context: 前文是含变量、分数指数及嵌套乘除的代数式；先声明变量为正，再输出化简后的幂式答案。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics；符号代数练习或题目解答

patterns.name: Simplify 提示
patterns.context: 作为下一道代数化简题的开头，后接含幂、变量及括号的表达式；多出现在前一道答案之后。

patterns.name: 幂与指数符号
patterns.context: 嵌套代数式把双星号用作乘方符号，指数常为负数或分数，且同一变量反复出现。
patterns.domain: 符号数学／机器可读或程序化题目文本

en.description: Primarily covers numbers, variables, and symbols in mathematical problem expressions, especially differentiation, power-expression simplification, comparison, and common-denominator problems; it also responds to paper citation numbers, digits in web date links, and numbers in ordinal decimal lists.

patterns.name: Differentiating algebraic expressions
patterns.context: A mathematical expression asks for differentiation with respect to a specified variable, or asks for a first or second derivative; activations also fall on numbers, variables, and symbols within the expression

patterns.name: Simplifying exponential expressions
patterns.context: Asks to simplify an algebraic expression containing variable powers and fractions, often with the condition that variables are positive; activations are distributed over exponents and expression numbers

patterns.name: Numerical comparison and true/false judgments
patterns.context: Asks to compare fractions or negative numbers, or determine whether a proposition is true or false; markers concentrate on values and comparison operands

patterns.name: Common denominators and least common multiples
patterns.context: Asks for the least common multiple of two numbers or the common denominator of fractions, followed by a numerical answer

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols or number strings
patterns.context: In short mathematical Q&A excerpts, activations fall on isolated symbols, numbers, or judgment words and cannot be fully assigned to a specific operation type

patterns.name: Literature citation identifiers
patterns.context: A mathematics paper cites authors and MR reference numbers; activations fall on citation markers, number identifiers, and fragments within names

patterns.name: Numbers in URLs and blog timestamps
patterns.context: Blog page metadata contains an election-related title, comment links, and timestamps; markers fall on link identifiers and date/time numbers

patterns.name: Decimals in number lists
patterns.context: Numbers are ordered and separated by colons, followed by decimal values; the context and purpose are unclear
patterns.domain: Github text, possibly a numerical table or output

10_1806.description: 主要覆盖数学题中表达式数字、变量与符号，尤其求导、幂式化简、比较及公分母问题；也响应论文引文编号、网页日期链接数字和序号小数表中的数字。

patterns.name: 代数式求导
patterns.trigger: “Differentiate”“derivative”“wrt”“with respect to”，以及多项式中被标记的数字、变量和运算符
patterns.context: 数学表达式要求对指定变量求导，或询问一阶、二阶导数；激活还落在表达式内部的数字、变量和符号上

patterns.name: 指数式化简
patterns.trigger: “Simplify”“assuming … is positive”，以及幂、分数、括号中的指数表达式
patterns.context: 要求化简含变量幂和分数的代数式，常附变量为正的条件；激活分布在指数和表达式数字上

patterns.name: 数值比较与真假判断
patterns.trigger: “Which is greater”“Which is bigger”“True”“Is … >=”，以及被比较的数值
patterns.context: 要求比较分数或负数、判断命题真假；标记集中于数值和比较对象

patterns.name: 公分母与最小公倍数
patterns.context: 询问两个数的最小公倍数或分数的公分母，问题后给出数值答案

patterns.name: 数学符号或数字串
patterns.context: 短小的数学问答片段中，激活落在孤立符号、数字或判断词上，不能完全归入具体运算类型

patterns.name: 文献引文编号
patterns.context: 数学论文引用作者和 MR 文献编号；激活落在引用标记、编号数字及姓名内部片段

patterns.name: 网址与博客时间戳数字
patterns.context: 博客页面元数据含竞选相关标题、评论链接和时间戳；标记落在链接编号与日期时间数字

patterns.name: 数字列表中的小数
patterns.context: 数字按序号排列并以冒号分隔，后接小数值；上下文用途不明
patterns.domain: Github 文本，可能为数值表或输出

en.description: Responds to descriptions of localities and institutions, including sites, buildings, facilities, and transport stations and their uses; also appears in energy policy reporting and scientific equipment descriptions. Although trigger words vary, most fall on descriptions of specific places, facilities, or infrastructure.

patterns.name: Grounds and associated facilities
patterns.context: Refers to grounds within a school, estate, or historic site used for sports, events, or training; may also appear alongside associated facilities such as a house or facilities.

patterns.name: Railway stations and service areas
patterns.context: Describes a station name, the railway line it is on, its location, service area, or function as a transport hub.

patterns.name: Buildings, houses, and their locations
patterns.context: Describes a building’s structure, history, or purpose, or its relationship to places such as a lake, street, or campus.
patterns.domain: Architecture, campus, and local encyclopedias; the first excerpt describes architectural design

patterns.name: Facilities and site amenities
patterns.context: Describes facilities owned by a property or site, and amenities for activities such as games or projects.

patterns.name: Energy policy and utilities
patterns.context: Discusses the policy context, emissions, and waste disposal of nuclear power, or the business conditions of an electric utility.

patterns.name: Scientific instruments and automation equipment
patterns.context: Introduces key equipment used to automate scientific workflows and its purpose.

10_1806.description: 响应地方与机构介绍中场地、建筑、设施及交通站点等实体和用途；也见于能源政策报道与科研设备说明，触发词虽分散，但多落在具体地点、设施或基础设施的描述中。

patterns.name: grounds及其关联设施
patterns.context: 指学校、庄园或历史地点内供运动、活动或训练使用的场地；也可能与 house、facilities 等配套设施并列出现。

patterns.name: 铁路车站与服务范围
patterns.context: 介绍车站名称、所在线路、位置、服务区域或交通枢纽功能。

patterns.name: 建筑、房屋及其地点关系
patterns.context: 描述建筑及其结构、历史、用途，或建筑与湖泊、街道、校园等地点的关系。
patterns.domain: 建筑、校园与地方百科；第1段为建筑设计叙述

patterns.name: 设施及场地配套
patterns.context: 描述地产或场所拥有的设施，以及供游戏、项目等活动使用的配套。

patterns.name: 能源政策与公用事业
patterns.context: 讨论核电的政策情境、排放与废物处置，或电力公司的经营状况。

patterns.name: 科研仪器与自动化设备
patterns.context: 介绍用于自动化科研流程的关键设备及其用途。

en.concept: Encyclopedic descriptions of places and facilities
en.description: Strongly responds to encyclopedia-style introductions to places and facilities: buildings, sites, transportation, or institutions often described with proper names, locations, components, uses, and dates; also responds to email news-headline links.

patterns.name: Building and urban-facility names
patterns.context: Describes the construction, location, use, or preservation of a building, facility, or site, often with proper names and institutions.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic geography, architecture, and institutional entries

patterns.name: Railway stations and lines
patterns.context: Introduces a railway branch, the area served by a station, its closure date, and the subsequent use of the station building.

patterns.name: Places, neighborhoods, and geographic locations
patterns.context: Proper place names paired with geographic categories such as villages, neighborhoods, bays, or administrative districts; often found in place introductions.

patterns.name: Medical institutions and church districts
patterns.context: Entries on medical facilities or dioceses describing institutional affiliation, location, or cathedral.

patterns.name: Dated historical developments
patterns.context: Specific years or dates give the timing of construction, closure, commencement of work, or the age of a site.

patterns.name: Facility components and spatial descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the shape, number, composition, and relative positions of building complexes, walls, neighborhoods, or sites.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic descriptions of architecture, military sites, and urban spaces

patterns.name: Headline links and email newsletter text
patterns.context: An email or news-link list composed of headlines, URLs, and line breaks rather than continuous encyclopedic prose.

10_1806.description: 强烈响应百科式地点与设施介绍：建筑、遗址、交通或机构常与专名、位置、组成、用途及年代并述；也响应邮件新闻标题链接。

patterns.name: 建筑与城市设施名称
patterns.context: 叙述建筑、设施或遗址的建造、位置、用途、保存状况，常伴随专名和机构名。
patterns.domain: 百科地理、建筑与机构条目

patterns.name: 铁路车站及线路
patterns.context: 介绍铁路支线、车站服务范围、关闭时间及车站建筑后续用途。

patterns.name: 地点、街区与地理定位
patterns.context: 专名地名与村庄、街区、海湾或行政区等地理类别搭配；多见于地点介绍。

patterns.name: 医疗机构及教会行政区
patterns.context: 医疗设施或教区条目中，说明机构隶属、所在地或主教座堂。

patterns.name: 带日期的历史沿革
patterns.context: 以具体年份或日期交代建造、关闭、开始工作或遗址年代。

patterns.name: 设施组成与空间描述
patterns.trigger: “U-shaped complex”, “square towers”, “four blocks”, “two large coastal guns”
patterns.context: 描述建筑群、墙体、街区或遗址的形状、数量、构成及相对位置。
patterns.domain: 建筑、军事遗址与城市空间百科

patterns.name: 标题链接与邮件通讯文本
patterns.trigger: “One Third of US Plants Given a Free Ride on Pollution”, “Dark Cloud Covers Florida Solar Initiatives”
patterns.context: 以标题、网址和换行组成的邮件或新闻链接列表，而非连续百科正文。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的新闻链接

en.concept: Mathematical power expressions and architectural descriptions
en.description: Activations cluster in two groups: mathematical variable power-expression simplification problems and architecture-related text. The latter covers historic sites, modern residential buildings, and lakeside spatial design, across varied contexts and styles.

patterns.name: Variables and exponents in mathematical power-expression simplification problems
patterns.context: Asks to simplify variable expressions with rational exponents, multiplication/division, and nested powers; assumptions that variables are positive often follow, and then an answer or next problem is given.

patterns.name: Descriptions of historic buildings and sites
patterns.context: Encyclopedic narration describes a specific building, site, or historic facility, often including its date, architectural features, or components.

patterns.name: Architectural features of modern residential buildings
patterns.context: Introduces the floors, units, appearance, or sales context of a specific modern apartment building.

patterns.name: Spatial design relating buildings to lakeshores
patterns.context: Discusses how a building layout responds to the spatial relationship between the lakeshore and the lake.

10_1806.description: 激活集中于两类：数学变量幂式化简题，及建筑相关文字；后者涵盖历史遗址、现代住宅楼和湖岸空间设计，语境与文体各异。

patterns.name: 数学幂式化简题中的变量与指数
patterns.context: 要求化简含有理数指数、乘除和嵌套幂的变量表达式；正值假设常紧随其后，随后给出答案或下一题。

patterns.name: 历史建筑与遗址的介绍
patterns.trigger: 建筑名称及其构造、历史、保存或用途描述，如“was constructed”“battery”“courtyard”“Trajanic basilica”
patterns.context: 百科式叙述具体建筑、遗址或历史设施，常包含年代、建筑特征或组成部分。

patterns.name: 现代住宅楼的建筑特征
patterns.context: 介绍具体现代公寓楼的楼层、单元、外形或销售背景。

patterns.name: 建筑与湖岸关系的空间设计
patterns.context: 讨论建筑布局如何回应湖岸与湖泊之间的空间关系。

en.description: All fragments come from DM Mathematics: under a Simplify instruction, algebraic expressions composed of variable multiplication/division and integer or fractional exponents are simplified, often with an assumption that variables are positive; a variable-power-form answer follows, then the next problem begins.

patterns.name: Simplifying algebraic power expressions
patterns.context: Asks to simplify an algebraic expression containing repeated variables, fractional exponents, or negative exponents; the fragment often also continues with “assuming [variable] is positive.”

patterns.name: Positive-value assumption
patterns.context: A variable is declared positive in a power-expression simplification problem, usually to handle fractional or negative exponents; the word positive itself is also marked.

patterns.name: Variable powers in simplified results
patterns.context: A result or intermediate answer to the preceding problem, with variables carrying fractional, negative, or larger numerical exponents; usually followed by the next Simplify problem.
patterns.domain: Continuous text of mathematical answers and problems

10_1806.description: 所有片段均来自 DM Mathematics：在 Simplify 指令下化简由变量乘除和整数或分数指数构成的代数式，常附变量为正的假设；随后出现变量幂形式的答案，再开始下一题。

patterns.name: 化简代数幂表达式
patterns.trigger: “Simplify”后紧接由变量、乘除及幂构成的长表达式
patterns.context: 要求化简含重复变量、分数指数或负指数的代数式；片段中还常接“assuming [变量] is positive.”

patterns.name: 正数假设条件
patterns.trigger: “assuming w is positive”“assuming k is positive”“assuming s is positive”“assuming g is positive”“assuming p is positive”“assuming i is positive”“assuming z is positive”“assuming t is positive”“assuming d is positive”“assuming n is positive”
patterns.context: 幂表达式化简题中声明变量为正，通常用于处理分数指数或负指数；文本中 positive 一词本身也被标记。

patterns.name: 化简结果的变量幂
patterns.context: 前一题的结果或中间答案，变量带有分数指数、负指数，或较大的数字指数；通常后接下一条 Simplify 题目。
patterns.domain: 数学答案与题目连续文本

en.description: Primarily responds to descriptions of buildings, venues, places, and institution names in encyclopedic entries, and also appears in list-style fields; there are also clear patterns for mathematical power-expression simplification problems and patent-style descriptions of device structures, which differ substantially in style and vocabulary.

patterns.name: Proper names and descriptions of buildings/facilities
patterns.context: Encyclopedic contexts introduce a building, venue, historic site, or its use, location, and history; activations are distributed across related nouns and proper-name fragments
patterns.domain: Wikipedia architecture, history, and venue entries

patterns.name: Place and institution names
patterns.context: Encyclopedic entries describe a place, administrative area, community boundary, headquarters location, or project site; related proper-name fragments and nearby words activate
patterns.domain: Wikipedia geography, community, media network, and business entries

patterns.name: List- and table-style entries
patterns.context: Section headings, field labels, or list-style information in an encyclopedic entry, rather than continuous prose

patterns.name: Rational-power expressions and simplification instructions
patterns.context: Symbolic math problems ask for simplification or an expression; activations cluster near variables, numbers, and operators

patterns.name: Patent-style device structure descriptions
patterns.context: Technical patent prose describes component connections, relative positions, and device construction

10_1806.description: 主要响应百科条目中建筑、场馆、地点及机构专名的描述，也见于列表式字段；另有明显的数学幂式化简题和专利装置结构描述模式，三者文体与词汇差异较大。

patterns.name: 建筑/设施的专名与描述
patterns.trigger: “studios”“courtyard”“complex”“Arena”“crypt”“House”“Hotel”“Park”等设施或建筑名词，常与专名相邻
patterns.context: 百科语境中介绍建筑、场馆、历史遗址或其用途、位置和历史；激活点分布在相关名词和专名片段上
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 建筑、历史与场馆条目

patterns.name: 地名与机构名
patterns.trigger: “North Dakota”“Fargo”“Jerusalem”“Shikun Chabad”“National Highway 8”等地名、机构或区域专名
patterns.context: 百科条目陈述地点、行政区、社区边界、总部位置或项目地点；相关专名片段及其邻近词激活
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 地理、社区、媒体网络与商业条目

patterns.name: 列表与表格样式的条目
patterns.context: 百科条目中的分节标题、字段标签或列表式信息，而非连续叙述
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目中的列表/信息栏

patterns.name: 有理数幂表达式与化简指令
patterns.trigger: “Simplify”、变量 i、s、q，以及形如“**(-1/…)”“**(…)”的幂和分数表达式
patterns.context: 符号化数学题目中要求化简或给出表达式；激活集中在变量、数字和运算符附近

patterns.name: 专利式装置结构描述
patterns.context: 以技术专利文体描述部件连接、相对位置和装置构造
patterns.domain: USPTO Backgrounds，医疗/机械装置专利

en.concept: Entities and relations in technical descriptions
en.description: Mainly responds to numbered technical components, device structures, and spatial relationships in patent descriptions, often accompanied by figure references; it also responds to specialized technical statements about semiconductor heating and fuel-cell diagnosis. News descriptions of locations and algebraic simplification are clear outliers.

patterns.name: Patent-style numbered technical components
patterns.context: Descriptions of technical devices, components, or systems, often alongside FIG., diagrams, structures, operations, or components; activation may fall on component names, numbers, or nearby functional words.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background sections and embodiments concerning thermal management, sensors, motors, semiconductors, fuel cells, loading platforms, and medical devices

patterns.name: Spatial and connection relationships between device components
patterns.context: Describes the relative positions, connections, movement, or heat transfer between components; common in patent technical descriptions.

patterns.name: Figure references and structural descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces patent figures, describes what they show, or locates numbered components.

patterns.name: Motion and excitation-signal descriptions
patterns.context: For sensors, rotors and stators, or electrical drives, describes motion relationships and excitation/control signals.

patterns.name: Heating treatment in semiconductor processing
patterns.context: Describes process conditions in which a substrate is placed above a hot plate and heated from the back side.

patterns.name: Fuel-cell performance diagnosis
patterns.context: Discusses stack performance degradation and diagnosis using cell voltage outputs.

patterns.name: Reports concerning a stadium and the Taliban
patterns.context: Activates in news-style passages about an Afghan soccer field and a site of Taliban executions, leaning toward descriptions of concrete locations and entities.

patterns.name: Algebraic expressions and simplification
patterns.context: Power expressions, multiplication/division, and simplification instructions appear in symbolic math problems; there is no clear shared context with patent device descriptions.

10_1806.concept: 技术说明中的实体与关系
10_1806.description: 主要响应专利说明中带编号的技术部件、装置结构及位置关系，常伴随附图引导；另对半导体加热、燃料电池诊断等专门技术语句有反应。新闻场所叙述和代数化简是明显离群模式。

patterns.name: 专利式技术部件编号
patterns.trigger: “evaporator 114”“drive amplifier 22”“heater”“pit 4”“louver 11”“fuel cell stack”“power module 19”“instrument 10”等部件名及其编号
patterns.context: 技术装置、部件或系统的说明中，常与 FIG.、示意图、结构、操作、组件等描述并列；激活可落在部件名、数字或邻近功能词上。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景与实施例，涉及热管理、传感器、电机、半导体、燃料电池、装卸平台及医疗器械

patterns.name: 装置部件的空间与连接关系
patterns.trigger: “to one another”“located remotely from”“placed above”“recessed in the floor”“secured within the housing”“from its back surface”等
patterns.context: 描述部件之间的相对位置、连接、运动或热量传递；常见于专利技术说明。

patterns.name: 附图及结构展示措辞
patterns.trigger: “FIG. 3 is a schematic conceptual diagram”“FIG. 1 illustrates”“exploded view”“FIG. 1 shows a perspective view”等
patterns.context: 专利文本引入附图、说明视图内容或为部件编号定位。

patterns.name: 运动与激励信号描述
patterns.context: 涉及传感器、转子与定子或电气驱动时，说明运动关系及激励/控制信号。

patterns.name: 半导体加工中的加热处理
patterns.context: 描述基板置于热板上方、从背面供热的工艺条件。

patterns.name: 燃料电池性能诊断
patterns.trigger: “fuel cell stack”“stable operation”“measuring voltage output from each unit cell”等
patterns.context: 讨论电堆性能劣化以及通过单体电压输出进行诊断。

patterns.name: 体育场及塔利班相关报道
patterns.context: 在关于阿富汗足球场及塔利班处决地点的新闻式段落中激活，偏向具体场所与实体叙述。

patterns.name: 代数表达式与化简
patterns.trigger: “c”“r”变量、幂与分式，以及“assuming c is positive”“Simplify”等
patterns.context: 符号化数学题中出现幂、乘除与化简指令；与专利设备描述没有明显共同语境。

en.concept: Responses to specific word fragments and terminology
en.description: Activations occur on mathematical variables, fragments within proper names, and technical patent terms. No single stable lexical meaning or syntactic trigger is apparent; the feature may primarily respond to specific word fragments and domain vocabulary.

patterns.name: Variable tokens in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Algebraic expressions in DM Mathematics problems, especially dense expressions involving powers, fractions, and parentheses; variable letters themselves and their repetitions are marked, across varied expression structures.

patterns.name: Fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Subword fragments within proper names or labels, appearing in university names, stadium names, and parliamentary language markers. Some activations depend on fragment boundaries rather than whole words.

patterns.name: Technical terms in patent text
patterns.context: Device components, structures, and technical objects in patent background or explanatory text; multiple nouns occur across different invention topics.

10_1806.description: 激活分布于数学变量、专名内部词片和专利技术名词，未见单一稳定的词义或句法触发条件；可能主要响应特定词片及领域词汇。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的变量 token
patterns.context: DM Mathematics 题目中的代数式，尤其是幂、分数、括号等密集表达式；变量字母本身及其重复出现被标记，表达式结构各异。

patterns.name: 专名中的词片
patterns.context: 专名或名称内部的子词片；分别出现在大学校名、体育场名称和议会语言标记中。部分标记依赖词片边界而非完整词。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的技术名词
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明性文字中的设备部件、结构及技术对象；多个名词在不同发明主题中出现。

en.concept: Entities and relations in technical descriptions
en.description: Mainly responds to fluid or air transport and discharge between equipment, pipes, and chambers in engineering text; also responds to patent-style component relations and figure references, and covers geothermal descriptions and two types of encyclopedia entries about venues and campuses.

patterns.name: Fluid or gas flow in technical systems
patterns.context: Describes the source, transport, discharge, or circulation of fluid, air, steam, or condensate between equipment, pipes, chambers, and the outside environment.
patterns.domain: Patent background sections and engineering technical descriptions

patterns.name: Patent device structures and component relationships
patterns.context: Patent-style technical descriptions enumerate physical components and explain their connections, positions, containment, or functions.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background and device descriptions

patterns.name: Numbered figures and component locations
patterns.context: Figure numbers, reference numerals, and component names appear together to locate structures by number; common in patent figure descriptions.

patterns.name: Geothermal resources and geological conditions
patterns.context: Introduces the distribution of geothermal steam, hot water, or brine resources and relates them to near-surface thermal gradients.
patterns.domain: Geothermal engineering or geoscience patent background

patterns.name: Venue facilities and seating
patterns.context: Introduces display equipment, venue facilities, and special seating areas at a baseball stadium.

patterns.name: University branch-campus locations
patterns.context: Introduces a university branch campus and its research park in a location heading or entry-style text.

10_1806.concept: 技术说明中的实体与关系
10_1806.description: 主要响应工程文本中设备、管线及腔室间流体或空气的输送排放，也响应专利式部件关系、图号定位；另涵盖地热说明及两类百科场馆、校园介绍。

patterns.name: 技术系统中的流体或气体流动
patterns.trigger: “air … exhausted through … to the atmosphere”（1）；“receiving fluid … from a suction port and discharging fluid through a discharge port”（2）；“steam supply line”“condensate return line”（6）；“purifies outside air … supplies it into the chamber … discharges it to the outside”（10）
patterns.context: 描述流体、空气、蒸汽或冷凝液在设备、管线、腔室与外界之间的来源、输送、排放或循环。
patterns.domain: 专利背景与工程技术说明

patterns.name: 专利装置结构及部件关系
patterns.trigger: “stationary chamber portion”“suction port”“discharge port”（2）；“cylinder”“fluid tube”“pump”“abdominal reservoir”（5）；“frame assembly”“sheet metal housing”“components”“louver”（7）
patterns.context: 以专利式技术描述列举实体部件，并说明连接、位置、容纳或功能关系。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景与装置说明

patterns.name: 编号图示与部件定位
patterns.trigger: “FIG. 1 illustrates”“dock … 1”“dock wall 2”“dock floor 3”“A pit 4”（3）；“depicted in FIG. 1A”“housing 10”“A louver 11”（7）
patterns.context: 图号、附图标记与部件名称并列，借编号定位结构；常见于专利图示说明。

patterns.name: 地热资源与地质条件
patterns.trigger: “steam and/or hot aqueous liquid”“geothermal … water or brine”“thermal gradient near the earth’s surface”（9）
patterns.context: 介绍地热蒸汽、热水或盐水资源的分布，并关联地表附近的热梯度。
patterns.domain: 地热工程或地球科学专利背景

patterns.name: 场馆设施与座席介绍
patterns.trigger: “video display”“video board”“Minor League Baseball”“AutoZone Park contains several special seating sections”（4）
patterns.context: 介绍棒球场的显示设备、场馆设施和特殊座席区域。
patterns.domain: 百科全书式体育场馆条目

patterns.name: 大学分校地点介绍
patterns.trigger: “Carnegie Mellon Silicon Valley”“is located on NASA’s Ames Research”（8）
patterns.context: 以地点标题或条目式文字介绍大学分校及其所在研究园区。
patterns.domain: 百科全书式机构与地点条目

en.concept: Specific entities and relations in structured descriptions
en.description: Activations occur in structured or explanatory text, especially descriptions of components, positions, and connections in patents. They also cover institutional addresses, building and facility lists, crisis reporting, and exponent-based algebra problems, with no stable shared vocabulary.

patterns.name: Addresses and institution names
patterns.context: Author affiliations and mailing addresses following academic paper abstracts, with institution names, place names, and address fields listed consecutively.

patterns.name: Equipment components and positional descriptions in patents
patterns.context: Patent background or specification text describing device structure, connections, positions, or fluid circuits using numbers, figure references, and component names.

patterns.name: Housing and venue facility lists
patterns.context: Descriptions of the floors, rooms, facilities, seating, and other spatial arrangements in buildings or venues, often presented as lists or promotional text.

patterns.name: Facility unavailability during a crisis
patterns.context: Accounts of medical facilities ceasing operations or being unable to provide services during a conflict or emergency.

patterns.name: Powers and variables in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Math problems asking to simplify algebraic expressions containing variables, negative exponents, and fractional exponents, with conditions on the variables.

10_1806.concept: 结构化描述中的具体实体与关系
10_1806.description: 激活见于结构化或说明性文字，尤其是专利中对部件、位置和连接的描述；也覆盖机构地址、建筑设施清单、危机报道及指数代数题，未见稳定的共同词项。

patterns.name: 地址与机构名称
patterns.trigger: “Instituto de Física, Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul”
patterns.context: 学术论文摘要后出现作者单位和邮寄地址，机构名、地名及地址字段连续排列。

patterns.name: 专利中的设备部件与位置描述
patterns.trigger: “pit … recessed in the floor”；“evaporator … compensation chamber”；“cylinder … fluid tube”；“connector … male housing … lock arm”；“steam supply line … heat exchanger”
patterns.context: 专利背景或说明书以编号、图号和部件名描述设备结构、连接关系、位置或流体回路。

patterns.name: 住房与场馆设施清单
patterns.trigger: “en suite bathrooms and storage areas”；“basement … cellar/games room”；“Amenities”；“seating sections”
patterns.context: 介绍建筑或场馆的楼层、房间、设施、座位等空间配置，常以清单或宣传性文字呈现。

patterns.name: 危机中的设施不可用
patterns.context: 叙述冲突或紧急情境下，某地的医疗设施停止运作或无法提供服务。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的幂与变量
patterns.context: 数学题要求化简含变量、负指数和分数指数的代数式，并附带变量条件。

en.description: Activations are distributed across patent-style component labels and structural descriptions, proper names/institution names, spatial facility arrangements, and several installation or public-service statements; there are also paper address formats and Romanian parliamentary proper names. No single stable trigger is evident across passages.

patterns.name: Patent claims/component numbering
patterns.context: Technical descriptions use component names, reference numbers, and spatial or connection relationships to describe a device, common in patent background sections or claims.

patterns.name: Place and institution names
patterns.context: Geographic, institutional, or organizational proper names occur in news, academic affiliations, or encyclopedic narratives; activation positions vary across passages.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary text, medical text, paper affiliations, encyclopedia

patterns.name: Building and spatial-layout descriptions
patterns.context: Lists the components, uses, and spatial layout of a place, building, or vehicle.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic stadium introductions, patents, property descriptions

patterns.name: Functional facilities and service provision
patterns.context: Mentions the availability, improvement, or arrangement of public facilities, equipment, or services; activation is weak and cross-domain.

patterns.name: Italian subword fragment
patterns.context: Tokenized/subword tokens in Romanian parliamentary data; activation is concentrated near European Parliament proper names.

patterns.name: Address fields and citation format
patterns.context: Author address lists at the end of papers or in metadata format, with formatted fields and institutional addresses side by side.

patterns.name: Ordinal numbers and floor descriptions
patterns.context: Describes room arrangements and listed facilities by floor.

patterns.name: Installation actions
patterns.context: States that a device, facility, or monument will be or has been installed; examples come from different narratives.

10_1806.concept: 结构化实体与设施描述
10_1806.description: 激活分布在专利式部件标号与结构描述、专名/机构名、空间设施配置及若干安装或公共服务表述中；另有论文地址格式和罗马尼亚语议会专名。跨段未见单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求/部件编号
patterns.trigger: 编号与技术部件相邻，如“housing 1”“trunk 3”“(9) A return line”“evaporator 114”；也包括“has”“includes”等引出部件的结构
patterns.context: 技术说明以部件名称、数字标号和空间/连接关系描述装置，常见于专利背景或权利要求

patterns.name: 地名及机构名
patterns.trigger: 专名与行政或机构名称，如“European Parliament”“Aleppo”“Syrian Arab Republic”“Milano Bicocca”“Carnegie Mellon University”“Silicon Valley”
patterns.context: 地理、机构或组织专名出现在新闻、学术署名或百科叙述中；该模式在各段触发位置并不一致
patterns.domain: 议会文本、医学文本、论文署名、百科

patterns.name: 建筑及空间配置描述
patterns.context: 逐项描述场所、建筑或车辆的组成、用途和空间布局
patterns.domain: 百科体育场介绍、专利、房产介绍

patterns.name: 功能设施与服务保障
patterns.context: 提及公共设施、设备或服务的可用性、改进或配置；触发较弱且跨领域
patterns.domain: 百科、公共卫生、灾害救援

patterns.name: 意大利语子词片段
patterns.trigger: 拆分的意大利语词形，如“Fâşia Gaza”后出现的“Parlamentul European”“rămâne”“îngrijorat”
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语议会语料中的分词/子词 token；激活集中在欧洲议会专名附近

patterns.name: 地址字段及引文格式
patterns.trigger: “address:”“author:”“- '… Italy'”以及换行、连字符和引号
patterns.context: 论文末尾或元数据式作者地址列表，格式化字段和机构地址并列

patterns.name: 序数与楼层叙述
patterns.context: 按楼层说明房屋房间配置，并列设施

patterns.name: 安装行为
patterns.context: 说明将要安装或已经安装某项设备、设施或纪念物；实例分属不同叙述

en.description: Primarily responds to equipment components and facilities that are numbered, located, connected, or functionally described in technical text. It also responds to venue and residential layouts, proper names and word forms in Romanian parliamentary text, and place names and expressions of hospital incapacity in conflict reporting.

patterns.name: Components and structures in patent technical descriptions
patterns.context: Device or system structure and operation described through numbered components, positions (“lower portion”, “upper portion”, “first end”), and relations such as connection, flow, and installation; activations often fall on components, media, positions, and relational words.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background or technical description

patterns.name: Building and residential facilities and spatial layouts
patterns.context: Descriptions of the arrangement of spaces, rooms, and facilities in venues or residences, often with details on floors, uses, quantities, or sizes.

patterns.name: Specific word forms in Romanian political news
patterns.context: Romanian sentences discussing the European Parliament’s concern for Gaza and Palestinians; activations involve proper names and Romanian word forms with diacritics.

patterns.name: Reporting on damage to medical facilities in Aleppo
patterns.context: Reports of medical facilities being unable to operate during a conflict or emergency; activations in the passage concentrate on the place name and expressions of absence or incapacity after “without”.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central humanitarian crisis or public health text

10_1806.description: 主要响应技术说明中被编号、定位、连接或描述功能的设备部件与设施；另也响应场馆和住宅空间配置、罗马尼亚语议会文本中的专名及词形，以及冲突报道中的地点和医院失能表达。

patterns.name: 专利技术描述中的部件与结构
patterns.trigger: 反复出现的部件名词及其空间/功能关系，如“station wagon”“rear region”“trunk”“floor assembly”“condenser”“vapor line”“stationary chamber portion”“suction port”“fluid flow line”“tubular body”“inlet device”“steam trap”“condensate tank”“loading dock”“pit”
patterns.context: 以编号部件、位置（“lower portion”“upper portion”“first end”）和连接、流动、安装等关系，说明设备或系统结构与运行；激活常落在部件、介质、位置和关系词上。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景或技术说明

patterns.name: 建筑房屋设施与空间配置
patterns.context: 介绍场馆或住宅中空间、房间及设施的配置，常伴随楼层、用途、数量或大小描述。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 场馆介绍、房产/住宅文案

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语政治新闻中的特定词形
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语句子讨论欧洲议会对加沙及巴勒斯坦人的关切；激活涉及专名与带变音符号的罗马尼亚语词形。

patterns.name: 阿勒颇医疗设施受损报道
patterns.trigger: “eastern part of Aleppo”“without any functioning hospitals”
patterns.context: 报道冲突或紧急情况下医疗设施无法运作；本段激活集中在地点名及“without”后的缺失/失能表达。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 人道危机或公共卫生文本

en.description: Activations are distributed across various patent structural descriptions, place and facility introductions, parliamentary text, and paper addresses; there is no stable lexical or semantic trigger shared across passages.

patterns.name: Vehicle trunk structure
patterns.context: Describes the structural relationship between the rear of a car, the trunk, and the passenger compartment.

patterns.name: Evaporator and compensation chamber
patterns.context: Describes the components and operation of an evaporator and its chamber in a heat-pipe system.

patterns.name: Institutional location and building space
patterns.context: Introduces the building where an institution or campus is located and the space it occupies.

patterns.name: Romanian political text
patterns.context: A Romanian sentence discusses the European Parliament's concern about the situation of the Palestinian people.

patterns.name: Fluid chamber and power source
patterns.context: Describes fluid passages, suction/discharge ports, and an external power source.

patterns.name: Baseball-stadium facilities
patterns.context: Introduces the stadium's video-display equipment and spectator seating facilities.

patterns.name: Package heat dissipation and solder balls
patterns.context: Describes electrical connections and heat-dissipation structures in electronic packaging.

patterns.name: TFT pixel circuit
patterns.context: Explains how a pixel device connects through a TFT switch to a driver and charges or discharges.

patterns.name: Italian address fields
patterns.context: Institutional, street, city, and country addresses in a paper's closing section or author information.

patterns.name: Loading dock and pit
patterns.context: Patent figure descriptions of a loading platform and a recessed floor pit.

10_1806.description: 激活分布于多种专利结构说明、地点设施介绍、议会文本及论文地址中；没有跨段稳定共享的词法或语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 车辆后备箱结构
patterns.context: 描述汽车后部、后备箱与乘客舱之间的结构关系。

patterns.name: 蒸发器与补偿腔
patterns.context: 描述热管系统中蒸发器及其腔室的组成和运行。

patterns.name: 机构地点与建筑空间
patterns.context: 介绍机构或园区所在建筑及其占用空间。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语政治文本
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语句子讨论欧洲议会对巴勒斯坦人民处境的关切。

patterns.name: 流体腔室与动力源
patterns.context: 描述流体通路、吸排口及外部动力来源。

patterns.name: 棒球场设施
patterns.context: 介绍球场的视频显示设备及观众座席设施。

patterns.name: 封装散热与焊球
patterns.context: 描述电子封装的电连接与散热结构。

patterns.name: TFT像素电路
patterns.context: 说明像素器件经TFT开关连接驱动器并充放电。

patterns.name: 意大利地址字段
patterns.context: 论文末尾或作者信息中的机构、街道、城市与国家地址。

patterns.name: 装卸码头与地坑
patterns.context: 专利图示说明装卸平台及地面凹陷坑体。

en.description: Activations span diverse entities and contexts: place names, political statements, addresses, security, venue seating, and patent structures. A few passages share references to vents, air discharge, or facility failure, but this does not explain the remaining passages.

patterns.name: Missing, non-functioning, or discharged objects
patterns.context: Expressions involving without, functioning, exhausted, discharged, and similar words describe unavailable facilities or gas discharged from a system.
patterns.domain: Humanitarian relief reports; patent technical descriptions

patterns.name: Vents and escaping air
patterns.context: In technical descriptions, vent occurs near references to air, discharge, or escape.

patterns.name: Silicon Valley in a place name
patterns.context: Focus on Silicon Valley in university campus names, place headings, and location descriptions.

patterns.name: Shikun Chabad in a place name
patterns.context: A proper name in a description of a Jerusalem neighborhood, appearing after the place heading.

patterns.name: Rio Grande do Sul in an institutional address
patterns.context: The name of a Brazilian state appears in paper author and mailing addresses.

patterns.name: Italian “suppongo” followed by a political institution
patterns.context: In an Italian parliamentary discussion, suppongo is followed by references to the European Parliament and committee oversight.

patterns.name: Security and access control in restricted areas
patterns.context: Descriptions of people entering or leaving, restricted access, or management of secure areas.

patterns.name: Park facilities and audience seating
patterns.context: Entries about sports venues list seating facilities for spectators.

patterns.name: Male and female connector housings and locking arms
patterns.context: Patents describing connector structure and its connection and locking mechanisms.

patterns.name: Threads and vent holes in dental posts
patterns.context: Dental restoration patents describing dental post fixation and air release during insertion.

10_1806.description: 激活覆盖多种互不相同的实体与语境：地点专名、政治语句、地址、安保、场馆座席及专利结构；少数片段共同涉及 vent、空气排出或设施失效，但不足以解释其余段落。

patterns.name: 缺失、未能运作或排出的对象
patterns.trigger: “without any functioning hospitals”；“air … exhausted through a stack … to the atmosphere”；“air … discharged to the atmosphere”
patterns.context: 围绕 without、functioning、exhausted、discharged 等词，描述设施不可用或气体从系统排出。
patterns.domain: 人道救援报道；专利技术说明

patterns.name: 通风口及空气逸出
patterns.trigger: “vent … to permit escape of the air”；“vent to the atmosphere”
patterns.context: 技术描述中，vent 与空气、排出或逸出过程相邻。

patterns.name: 地点名中的 Silicon Valley
patterns.context: 大学校区名称、地点标题及其位置介绍中，重点落在 Silicon Valley。

patterns.name: 地点名中的 Shikun Chabad
patterns.context: 耶路撒冷社区介绍中的专名，位于地点标题之后。

patterns.name: 机构地址中的 Rio Grande do Sul
patterns.trigger: “Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul”
patterns.context: 论文作者地址及邮政地址中出现巴西州名。

patterns.name: 意大利语「suppongo」后接政治机构
patterns.context: 意大利语议会讨论中，suppongo 后转入欧洲议会及委员会监督。

patterns.name: 受限区域的安保与出入控制
patterns.trigger: “Access to areas such as the unit's kitchen and secure external area”；“Visitors … bags searched”
patterns.context: 描述人员出入、限制进入或安全区域管理。

patterns.name: 公园设施与观众座席
patterns.trigger: “AutoZone Park contains several special seating sections”
patterns.context: 体育场馆条目中列举供观众使用的座席设施。

patterns.name: 连接器的公母壳体及锁臂
patterns.trigger: “male and female housings”；“male housing … has a lock arm”
patterns.context: 专利中描述连接器结构及其连接、锁定机制。

patterns.name: 牙桩中的螺纹与通气孔
patterns.trigger: “external thread”；“A vent … permit escape of the air during insertion”
patterns.context: 牙科修复专利描述牙桩固定及插入时排气。

en.description: Activations often occur in names and descriptions of places, institutions, and facilities, especially venues, buildings, campuses, transportation locations, and their internal structures; weaker or isolated patterns include medical facilities, humanitarian contexts, Romanian parliamentary speeches, and address formatting.

patterns.name: Specific subwords in proper or compound names
patterns.context: Activation often falls on words or subword fragments within proper names, especially names of places, buildings, campuses, sports facilities, and addresses; sometimes proper names provide only a local clue, insufficient to show that these words share a narrower semantics.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entries, institutional introductions, addresses, parliamentary records, paper affiliations

patterns.name: Facility- and building-related words
patterns.context: Occurs when describing physical facilities, building spaces, or their structures and components; paragraph 9 is a technical construction description in a patent, not a general public-facility introduction.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia, medical/humanitarian reporting, patent technical text

patterns.name: Geographic locations and address information
patterns.context: Occurs when describing where an institution or place is located, place names, transportation distances, or mailing addresses.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, campus introductions, paper contact addresses

patterns.name: Sports venues and events
patterns.context: Introductions to sporting events, teams, or university sports facilities; activation is concentrated on venue names and arena descriptions.

patterns.name: Access to and impairment of medical facilities in conflict
patterns.context: Mentions access to medical facilities and staff in emergencies, as well as the cessation of operations at hospitals in Aleppo.

patterns.name: Romanian function words and parliamentary forms of address
patterns.context: Activation occurs across several Romanian words in a Romanian parliamentary speech fragment, making it difficult to infer shared triggers from English passage patterns.

patterns.name: Internal structures and connecting components in technical patents
patterns.context: Describes the relationships among cavities, surfaces, slots, and terminals inside a connector housing; its connection to facility usage in other passages may be only a weak lexical association.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background or technical descriptions

patterns.name: Headings, entry structure, and address formatting
patterns.context: Occurs near encyclopedia subheadings, entry sections, or paper address blocks; evidence is insufficient to determine whether formatting itself is an independent trigger, and activation mainly falls on nearby content words.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia page structure, paper address blocks

10_1806.description: 激活多见于地点、机构及设施名称和说明，尤其场馆、建筑、校园、交通地点及其内部结构；另有医疗设施、人道主义语境、罗马尼亚语议会发言和地址排版等较弱或孤立模式。

patterns.name: 专名或复合名中的特定子词
patterns.trigger: “Arena”“Valley”“Library”“Chapel”“Airport”“Genova”等地点、设施或机构名中的词；也包括人名/机构名中的子词，如 “Barclays”“Oettinger”“Amos”
patterns.context: 激活常落在专名内部的词或词片段，尤其是地点、建筑、校园、体育设施及地址等名称；有时专名只提供局部线索，无法证明这些词共享更窄语义
patterns.domain: Wikipedia条目、机构介绍、地址、议会记录、论文署名

patterns.name: 设施及建筑相关词
patterns.context: 在介绍实体设施、建筑空间或其构造与组成部分时出现；第9段是专利中的技术构造描述，不是一般公共设施介绍
patterns.domain: 百科、医疗人道主义报道、专利技术文本

patterns.name: 地理位置与地址信息
patterns.context: 在说明机构或地点所在位置、地名、交通距离或邮寄地址时出现
patterns.domain: 百科条目、校园介绍、论文联系地址

patterns.name: 体育场馆与赛事
patterns.context: 体育赛事、球队或大学体育设施的介绍；激活集中于场馆名及竞技场描述

patterns.name: 医疗设施在冲突中的可及性与失能
patterns.context: 谈及紧急状况中医疗设施和工作人员的可及性，以及阿勒颇医院停止运作
patterns.domain: 公共卫生或人道主义医学文本

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语功能词及议会称呼
patterns.context: 激活出现在罗马尼亚语议会发言片段，跨多个罗马尼亚语词，难以从英语段落模式推导共同触发条件

patterns.name: 技术专利中的内部结构与连接部件
patterns.trigger: “female housing”“hollow box”“internal cavity”“interior surfaces”“latch groove”“contact terminals”
patterns.context: 描述连接器壳体内部空腔、表面、卡槽和端子的位置关系；与其他段落的设施用法可能仅有词面上的弱关联

patterns.name: 标题、条目结构与地址排版
patterns.context: 在百科小标题、条目分节或论文地址块附近出现；证据不足以判断排版本身是否独立触发，主要激活仍落在相邻内容词
patterns.domain: 百科页面结构、论文地址块

en.description: Activations span structural descriptions of patent devices and housings, addresses and place names, “warehouse” in a station context, and accounts related to facility conditions and accessibility. These patterns cross domains, with no single stable semantic trigger apparent.

patterns.name: Device structures and components in patents
patterns.context: Descriptions of component installation, construction, position, and function within housings, tubular bodies, or connectors; often include figure labels and claim-style technical wording.

patterns.name: Place-name fragments in institutional or location names
patterns.context: Place names occur in addresses, institutional affiliations, or location descriptions; some activations fall on tokenized fragments of place names.
patterns.domain: Academic addresses or encyclopedia geography descriptions

patterns.name: The term warehouse
patterns.context: The word itself receives very strong activation in historical descriptions of railway branches and station facilities; nearby context mentions station buildings and locations.

patterns.name: Facility sanitation and accessibility
patterns.context: Accounts of poor workplace conditions, or whether medical facilities are accessible and operational in emergencies.
patterns.domain: Legal case facts, public health or humanitarian reports

10_1806.description: 激活覆盖专利中装置与壳体的结构描述、地址及地名、车站语境中的“warehouse”，以及设施条件和可达性相关叙述；这些模式跨领域，未见单一稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: 专利中的装置结构与部件
patterns.context: 描述部件在壳体、管状主体或连接器中的安装、构造、位置及功能；常含附图标号和权利要求式技术措辞。

patterns.name: 机构或地点名称中的地名片段
patterns.context: 地名出现在地址、机构署名或地点介绍中；部分触发落在切分后的地名 token 上。
patterns.domain: 学术地址或百科地理介绍

patterns.name: 仓库这一词项
patterns.context: 铁路支线、车站设施的历史描述中，词本身获得极强激活；邻近语境提及车站建筑和地点。

patterns.name: 设施卫生与无障碍状况
patterns.context: 叙述工作场所恶劣条件，或紧急情况下医疗设施是否可达、是否运作。
patterns.domain: 法律诉讼事实、公共卫生或人道主义报告

en.concept: Proper names and structured entity descriptions
en.description: Activations occur across proper names and name fragments, and are common in addresses, geographic entries, legal opinion templates, patent component descriptions, and sports venue information; formats and content vary widely.

patterns.name: Word endings or name fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across components of proper names, such as place names, organization names, and facility names; in a few examples, fragments within or at the boundaries of words activate especially strongly.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, paper affiliations, legal documents, patent texts

patterns.name: Address and geographic location fields
patterns.context: In address lines or sentences describing where an organization or place is located, place names and address components activate.
patterns.domain: Paper author addresses, encyclopedia geography descriptions

patterns.name: Location, transportation, and facilities in place entries
patterns.context: Appears when describing the administrative affiliation of a town or region, airport flights, and local public facilities; triggers include place names and facility names.

patterns.name: Standardized legal opinion format
patterns.context: Appears in the templated layout of immigration appeal opinions, including the heading, filing date, and list of judges; attorney or judge surname fragments also activate.

patterns.name: Patent device components and end descriptions
patterns.context: Appears when describing cylindrical devices, components installed at the top, bottom, or ends, and structural relationships such as exhaust ports in combustion chambers.

patterns.name: Sports venue and event sponsorship information
patterns.context: Activates in sports event or sports entries when sponsors and venues are listed and the venue is said to host a competition.

10_1806.concept: 专名与结构化实体描述
10_1806.description: 激活分布于专名和名称片段，并常见于地址、地理条目、法律判决书模板、专利部件描述及体育场馆信息；各类格式和内容差异较大。

patterns.name: 专名中的词尾或名称片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在地名、机构名、设施名等专名的组成部分；在少数例子中，词内或词边界处的片段激活尤强。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、论文地址、法律文书、专利文本

patterns.name: 地址与地理位置字段
patterns.context: 处于地址行或说明某机构、地点所在位置的句子中，地名及地址组成部分被激活。
patterns.domain: 论文作者地址、百科地理介绍

patterns.name: 地点条目的位置、交通与设施介绍
patterns.context: 介绍城镇或地区的行政归属、机场航班及当地公共设施时出现；触发点包括地点名和设施名称。

patterns.name: 法律判决书的固定格式
patterns.trigger: 「Respondent.」「On Petition for Review」「Board of Immigration Appeals」「Submitted」「Before」
patterns.context: 出现在移民上诉案件的判决书抬头、提交日期和法官名单等模板化版式中；律师或法官姓氏片段也激活。

patterns.name: 专利装置部件与端部描述
patterns.trigger: 「at one end」「at the other end」「exhaust port」「tubular body」「inlet device」
patterns.context: 描述圆筒状装置、其上下或两端安装部件，以及燃烧室的排气口等结构关系时出现。

patterns.name: 体育场馆与赛事赞助信息
patterns.context: 赛事或体育条目中，列出赞助商、场馆并说明场馆承办比赛时激活。

en.concept: Proper names and formatted text fragments
en.description: Activations span Romanian parliamentary passages, patent structural descriptions, encyclopedia place names and technology parks, academic addresses and equipment models, email signatures, and personal names. They often fall on tokenized proper names, terminology, numbers, and punctuation, with no unified semantic pattern apparent.

patterns.name: Marked fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on tokenized fragments within proper names or domain terms; the trigger position varies across contexts.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary text, encyclopedias, institutional addresses, academic papers

patterns.name: Romanian word fragments
patterns.context: Romanian words are split into subwords, with activations distributed across ordinary words and fragments of proper names.

patterns.name: Structural and functional descriptions in patents
patterns.context: Technical terms and modal/copular verbs in patent background paragraphs describe components, positions, and structural relations.

patterns.name: Place and institution names
patterns.context: Place and institution names occur in geography or public-service descriptions, alongside everyday encyclopedia prose.

patterns.name: Parliamentary turns and forms of address
patterns.context: Parliamentary speeches address members or committee members and include procedural language for handing over the floor or addressing someone directly.

patterns.name: Proper names and number formats in addresses
patterns.context: Institutional abbreviations, street addresses, postal codes, and city names appear together in paper footers or address fields.

patterns.name: Names, schools, and mailing addresses
patterns.context: Email signature blocks list personal titles, departments, schools, and mailing information.

patterns.name: Microscopy equipment and models
patterns.context: Methods sections list microscopy procedures, equipment manufacturers, models, and locations.

patterns.name: Technology companies and building numbers
patterns.context: Encyclopedia descriptions of technology-company clusters and institutions occupying buildings, floors, or numbered buildings.

patterns.name: Possible word-final or sentence-boundary responses
patterns.context: Markers are distributed across punctuation, line breaks, common words, and proper names, with no clear, stable syntactic condition across the corpus.

10_1806.concept: 专名与格式化文本片段
10_1806.description: 激活分布于罗马尼亚语议会片段、专利结构描述、百科地名与科技园区、学术地址和设备型号、邮件签名及人物专名；常落在被切分的专名、术语、数字和标点上，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 专名内部的标记性片段
patterns.context: 专名或领域术语中，激活落在分词后的词片段上；不同语境里触发位置并不一致。
patterns.domain: 议会文本、百科、机构地址、学术论文

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语词语被切分成子词，激活分散在普通词及专名片段中。
patterns.domain: 罗马尼亚语欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 专利结构与功能描述
patterns.context: 专利背景段落用技术名词和情态／系动词描述部件、位置及结构关系。

patterns.name: 地名与机构名称
patterns.context: 地理或公共服务介绍中出现地名、机构名；同时含有日常百科叙述。

patterns.name: 议会轮次与称谓
patterns.context: 议会发言中称呼议员或委员，并出现交接发言、直接致辞等程序语句。
patterns.domain: 罗马尼亚语欧洲议会记录

patterns.name: 地址中的专名与数字格式
patterns.context: 论文页脚／地址字段中，机构缩写、街道地址、邮编和城市名集中出现。

patterns.name: 姓名、学校与邮寄地址
patterns.context: 邮件签名区列出个人职衔、院系、学校及邮寄信息。

patterns.name: 显微镜设备与型号
patterns.context: 方法部分列出显微镜检查方式、设备厂商、型号和地点。

patterns.name: 科技公司与建筑编号
patterns.context: 百科描述科技公司聚集区及机构占用建筑、楼层或建筑编号。

patterns.name: 可能的词尾或句界响应
patterns.context: 标记分散在标点、换行、常见词和专名中；没有跨语料稳定的明确句法条件。

en.concept: Proper names and domain-specific word fragments in multilingual text
en.description: Activations are scattered across facilities, chapels, and place names in English encyclopedias, as well as legal headings, academic affiliations, and two types of Romanian parliamentary text; triggers often fall on local subwords of proper names or domain terms. Another passage about flights and hospitals is difficult to classify.

patterns.name: Final e in proper names
patterns.context: When French place names are segmented into subwords, activation falls on the final e of the proper name.

patterns.name: Organization or facility names
patterns.context: When describing airports, hospitals, health centers, or campus facilities in towns, activations cluster on facility names or facility-related nouns.

patterns.name: Subwords in place names and proper names
patterns.context: When personal names, place names, universities, or other proper names are split into multiple tokens, some fragments activate; the trigger position is not fixed.
patterns.domain: Academic author affiliations and U.S. legal opinion headings

patterns.name: Court opinion layout and procedural heading
patterns.context: In the court, district, date, and panel format at the beginning of U.S. federal appellate opinions, “Before” is especially salient.

patterns.name: Chapel names
patterns.context: Activates in entries about Welsh communities when describing local chapels and their construction or worship activities.

patterns.name: Romanian parliamentary speech phrasing
patterns.context: Sentences in parliamentary dialogue requesting that Nicholson speak or granting him the floor.

patterns.name: Romanian political issues and statements about suffering
patterns.context: Political statements discussing Gaza, the European Parliament, and the situation of the Palestinian people.

10_1806.concept: 多语文本中的专名与领域词片段
10_1806.description: 激活散见于英文百科中的设施、礼拜堂和地名，以及法律抬头、学术署名和两类罗马尼亚语议会文本；触发常落在专名或领域词的局部子词，另有一段航班与医院叙述难以归类。

patterns.name: 专名中的词尾 e
patterns.context: 法语地名被切分为子词时，激活落在专名末尾的 e。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科中的地名条目

patterns.name: 机构或设施名称
patterns.context: 描述城镇中的机场、医院、健康中心或校园设施时，激活集中在设施名称或设施类名词上。

patterns.name: 地名及专名中的子词
patterns.context: 人名、地名、大学或其他专名被拆分成多个 token 时，部分片段激活；触发位置并不固定。
patterns.domain: 学术作者署名与美国法律判决抬头

patterns.name: 法院判决的版式与程序抬头
patterns.context: 美国联邦上诉判决开头的法院、地区、日期和合议法官格式中，「Before」尤其显著。

patterns.name: 礼拜堂名称
patterns.context: 威尔士社区条目介绍当地礼拜堂及其建造或礼拜活动时激活。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科地方条目

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语议会发言措辞
patterns.context: 议会对话中请求 Nicholson 发言或授予其发言权的句子。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语议会记录

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语政治议题与受苦表述
patterns.context: 谈及加沙、欧洲议会及巴勒斯坦人民处境的政治表述。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语议会记录

en.concept: Key entities in proper names and document templates
en.description: Responds to proper names and compound names, fixed legal document headings and signature layouts, component and function descriptions in patents (including figure numbers), and event and venue names in sports entries.

patterns.name: Proper names and place names
patterns.context: Place names, airports, organizations, and other proper names appear in introductory entries or sentences; proper names may also be split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Legal document headings and judge names
patterns.context: Standardized heading, date, and judge-list layout in documents concerning immigration appeals.

patterns.name: Organization, company, and building proper names
patterns.context: Organization or company names and the buildings or building numbers where they are located appear in narrative text.

patterns.name: Structural and functional descriptions in patents
patterns.context: Device structure, component locations, connections, or functions are described using component names, often with patent-style passive voice and embodiment phrasing.

patterns.name: Component numbers in parentheses
patterns.context: In patent claims or specifications, numbers in parentheses serve as reference numerals for device components.

patterns.name: Proper names of sports events and venues
patterns.context: Event, sponsor, or competition venue names appear in brief, entry-like descriptions.

10_1806.concept: 专名及文档模板中的关键实体
10_1806.description: 响应专名与复合名称、法律文书固定标题和署名版式、专利中的部件及功能描述（含附图编号），也响应体育条目中的赛事和场馆名。

patterns.name: 专名与地名
patterns.context: 地名、机场、机构等专名出现在介绍性条目或句子中，专名内部也可能被拆成多个 token

patterns.name: 法律文书标题与法官姓名
patterns.trigger: «Respondent»；«On Petition for Review of an Order»；«Before»: … 法官姓氏
patterns.context: 移民上诉案件文书的固定标题、日期和法官名单版式

patterns.name: 机构、公司与建筑专名
patterns.context: 机构或公司名称及其所在建筑、楼号在叙述中出现

patterns.name: 专利中的结构与功能描述
patterns.trigger: «hollow profile shell»、«cavity»；«tubular body»、«inlet device»；«external thread»、«vent»；«anesthetic filter arrangement»、«filter housing»
patterns.context: 以部件名称描述装置结构、位置、连接方式或功能，常见专利式被动语态和实施例措辞

patterns.name: 括号中的部件编号
patterns.context: 专利权利要求或说明书中，括号内数字作为附图标记关联装置部件

patterns.name: 体育赛事与场馆专名
patterns.context: 赛事、赞助商或比赛场馆名称出现在简短条目式叙述中

en.description: Activations often fall on proper names and their subwords, institutions or place names, and address formats. They also occur in medical institution/facility terms, parliamentary forms of address, patent functional descriptions, and pseudo-Latin fragments; there is no stable shared semantic condition across passages.

patterns.name: Institutional proper names, places, and entity names
patterns.context: Occurs in proper names or institutional addresses, often on tokenized fragments within proper names, punctuation after proper names, or city/state names in addresses; does not consistently correspond to a fixed word form.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including papers, medical materials, parliamentary records, patents, and encyclopedias

patterns.name: Institution and place address formats
patterns.context: Addresses, city and state names, and postal code formats follow academic units, companies, or institution names; activations often occur near proper-name fragments and punctuation.
patterns.domain: Author addresses and institutional source information in papers and medical materials

patterns.name: Medical and facility-related terms
patterns.context: Occurs when describing medical institutions, cells, emergency facilities, and personnel; wording varies and there is no consistent medical syntax.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, public health materials, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Place-name or noun fragments in continuous text
patterns.context: Place names in encyclopedia or news-style prose, as well as cemetery names; activations favor subwords within proper names rather than a consistent semantic category.

patterns.name: Functional structural descriptions in patents
patterns.context: Descriptions of dental post structure and its function, material retention, and air release.

patterns.name: Romanian parliamentary speech format
patterns.context: Formal expressions in which a parliamentary chair or speaker names someone and gives them the floor; activations concentrate near forms of address and personal names.

patterns.name: English-language literature address fields
patterns.context: A correspondence address or affiliation follows the main text; activations mainly fall on Syracuse and address formats.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in pseudo-Latin text
patterns.context: In continuous pseudo-Latin placeholder text, activations occur on subword fragments within words, with no apparent shared condition with other passages.
patterns.domain: Placeholder content in web pages or Q&A text

patterns.name: Word activations not explained by a unified pattern
patterns.context: These activations are scattered across physics, patent, and biographical contexts and cannot reliably be grouped under the proper-name, address, or medical patterns above.

10_1806.description: 激活多落在专名及其子词、机构或地名和地址格式，亦见医疗机构/设施用语、议会称谓、专利功能描述及伪拉丁碎片；不同段落间没有稳定的共同语义条件。

patterns.name: 机构专名、地点与实体名称
patterns.trigger: 人名、机构名、地名等专名片段，如“Collection”“Syracuse”“Aleppo”“Nicholson”“Silicon Valley”“Mogadishu”“Ke rep esi”
patterns.context: 处在专名或机构地址中，常见于专名内部的分词片段、专名后的标点，或地址中的城市/州名；并非稳定对应某一固定词形。
patterns.domain: 论文、医学材料、议会记录、专利、百科等多种文体

patterns.name: 机构与地点地址格式
patterns.context: 学术单位、公司或机构名称后出现的地址、城市州名和邮编格式；激活常落在专名片段及标点附近。
patterns.domain: 论文和医学材料中的作者地址、机构来源信息

patterns.name: 医学与设施相关词语
patterns.context: 描述医疗机构、细胞或应急设施和人员时出现；各处用词并不相同，也没有一致的医学句式。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、公共卫生材料、百科条目

patterns.name: 连续文本中的地名或名词片段
patterns.context: 百科或新闻性叙述中的地名，以及墓地名称；激活偏向专名内部子词，而非一致的语义类别。

patterns.name: 专利中的功能性结构描述
patterns.context: 描述牙科桩的结构及其功能、材料保持和排气过程。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语议会发言格式
patterns.context: 议会主席或发言人点名并给予发言机会的正式表达；激活集中在称谓和人名附近。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录，罗马尼亚语

patterns.name: 英语文献地址栏
patterns.context: 正文后接通讯地址或单位信息；激活主要落在 Syracuse 及地址格式中。

patterns.name: 拉丁文假文本的子词碎片
patterns.context: 连续的伪拉丁占位文本中出现的词内子词片段，未显示与其他段落主题相同的条件。
patterns.domain: 网页或问答文本中的占位内容

patterns.name: 未能统一解释的词语激活
patterns.context: 这些激活分散在物理、专利和传记语境中，不能可靠归入上述专名、地址或医疗模式。

en.concept: Proper-name fragments and local features of technical texts
en.description: Activations occur across subword fragments of proper names and also in descriptions of facility accessibility or unavailability, dental vent structures, mechanical housings and cavities, Java paths, and local details such as building numbers and years; corpus styles vary substantially.

patterns.name: Token fragments in place and organization names
patterns.context: Activations fall on local subwords of proper names, especially place names, personal names, and organization names; nearby text often mentions administrative areas, transportation, organizations, or author addresses.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news, parliamentary records, academic papers

patterns.name: Facility accessibility and unavailability
patterns.context: Discusses whether hospitals, public facilities, or workplaces can be used, whether facilities are functioning, or whether safety conditions are lacking; accessible is the core trigger in paragraphs 3 and 4.
patterns.domain: Public health, humanitarian affairs, labor law

patterns.name: Dental implants and vent holes
patterns.context: Describes the structure of dental posts or implants and venting during insertion; «vent» appears in dental device descriptions.

patterns.name: Mechanical components and cavities
patterns.context: Patent-style structural descriptions of housings, components, their relative positions, or the cavities they form.

patterns.name: Maven/Java configuration paths
patterns.context: Sets the Java executable path in a Windows batch configuration; activations cluster on variable names and path fragments.

patterns.name: European Parliament titles and name fragments
patterns.context: Titles, institutional forms of address, and personal names in Czech parliamentary text; overlaps with the general proper-name fragment pattern, but this style appears only in this passage.

patterns.name: Campus buildings and year numbers
patterns.context: Describes an institution occupying building space over time; activations cluster on building numbers and year digits.

10_1806.concept: 专名片段与技术文本局部特征
10_1806.description: 激活分布于专名的子词片段，也出现在设施可达性或缺失、牙科通气结构、机械壳体与腔体、Java路径，以及楼号年份等局部内容上；不同语料文体差异明显。

patterns.name: 地名与机构名中的分词片段
patterns.trigger: 专名内部或边界处的片段，如 «Ess»onne、«Or»ly、Mog«ad»ish«u»、«Kisma»ay«o»、«Ale»ppo、«Taj»4«ani»、«Mell»on、«Bell»ater«ra»
patterns.context: 激活落在专名的局部子词上，尤其是地名、人名、机构名；周围常有行政区、交通、机构或作者地址等信息。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、议会记录、学术论文

patterns.name: 设施可达性与缺失
patterns.context: 谈论医院、公共设施或工作场所时，描述能否使用、设施是否正常运作，或安全条件是否缺失；其中 accessible 在第3、4段为核心触发词。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生、人道事务、劳动法律

patterns.name: 牙科植体与通气孔
patterns.context: 描述牙科柱体/植体的结构及插入时排气；«vent» 出现在牙科器件说明中。

patterns.name: 机械构件与腔体
patterns.context: 专利式结构说明，描述壳体、构件及其相对位置或形成的空腔。

patterns.name: Maven/Java配置路径
patterns.context: Windows 批处理配置中设置 Java 可执行文件路径，激活集中于变量名和路径片段。

patterns.name: 欧洲议会称谓与姓名片段
patterns.context: 捷克语议会文本中的职务、机构称谓和人名；与一般专名片段模式重叠，但仅此段有该文体。

patterns.name: 校园楼宇与年份编号
patterns.context: 叙述机构占用建筑空间及时间，激活集中在楼号和年份数字。

en.concept: Proper names, addresses, and entity relationships
en.description: Primarily responds to proper names and their organization, location, and address information, especially institutional affiliations, material sources, and address formats in papers; also responds to descriptions of places and facilities in encyclopedias, spatial relationships between patent components, and product category lists.

patterns.name: Organization and place-name addresses
patterns.context: Proper names often appear as segmented multiword forms followed by a place, postal code, or country; also includes place names in sentences describing locations or sources.
patterns.domain: Paper author addresses, material source descriptions, encyclopedia geography and biography entries

patterns.name: Supplier and sample source
patterns.context: Methods or experimental materials passages identify the source of animals, reagents, or cells, alongside organization names and locations.

patterns.name: Address fields and postal format
patterns.context: Structured address lines in institutional affiliations or correspondence addresses, often with abbreviations, postal codes, state names, or country names.

patterns.name: Encyclopedia descriptions of places and public facilities
patterns.context: Encyclopedic statements describe a person's burial place, town services, or the relationship between an administrative area and an airport.

patterns.name: Components and spatial relationships in patents
patterns.context: Describes device components, their installation locations, and the spatial relationships formed between components.

patterns.name: Product categories and structural lists
patterns.context: Uses parallel lists to describe refrigerator types and the relative positions of freezer and refrigerator compartments.

10_1806.description: 主要响应专名及其机构、地点和地址信息，尤其是论文中的机构署名、材料来源与地址格式；也响应百科地点/设施介绍，以及专利中的部件空间关系和产品分类枚举。

patterns.name: 机构与地名地址
patterns.trigger: 机构、大学、城市等专名及其相邻地址标点，如 «São» «Paulo»、«Georgia» «Institute» «of» «Technology»、«Ham»«d»«ard» «University»、«International» «Inc»、«Lag»«una»
patterns.context: 专名常以被拆分的多词形式出现，后接地点、邮编或国家；也包括句中介绍所在位置或来源的地名。
patterns.domain: 论文作者地址、材料来源说明、百科地理与人物条目

patterns.name: 供应商与样本来源
patterns.context: 方法或实验材料段落中说明实验动物、试剂或细胞的采购来源，并伴随机构名称及所在地。

patterns.name: 地址字段与邮政格式
patterns.context: 机构署名或通信地址中的结构化地址行，常有缩写、邮编、州名或国家名。

patterns.name: 百科地点与公共设施介绍
patterns.context: 以百科式陈述介绍人物埋葬地点、城镇服务设施或行政区与机场的位置关系。

patterns.name: 专利中的部件与空间关系
patterns.context: 描述设备构件、部件安装位置以及构件之间形成的空间关系。

patterns.name: 产品分类与结构枚举
patterns.context: 用并列枚举说明冰箱类型及冷冻室、冷藏室的相对位置。

en.description: Primarily responds to proper names, organizations, and place names, especially organizations and locations in paper affiliation addresses; also responds to descriptions of laboratory instruments and equipment and school campus facilities. One passage also shows local activation on wording about hospitals becoming nonfunctional in a conflict area.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in proper names, organizations, and places
patterns.context: Activations cluster on proper names and the names of organizations and places, often spanning segmented word fragments; no fixed word form is required.
patterns.domain: Paper author affiliations and addresses, person or place descriptions, organization descriptions

patterns.name: Laboratories and research equipment
patterns.context: Activations occur around equipment names, instrument names, and words such as laboratory in descriptions of experimental methods or research facilities.
patterns.domain: Spectroscopy, laboratory equipment descriptions, research project descriptions

patterns.name: Organization addresses and affiliation format
patterns.context: Formatting markers and organization/address components co-occur in paper metadata, author affiliations, or affiliation addresses; some place and organization words are also activated as subwords.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, author information, and organization addresses

patterns.name: Place names and administrative divisions
patterns.context: Place names occur in different contexts, such as news, humanitarian affairs, and paper addresses; subword fragments within some place names also activate.

patterns.name: Campus, schools, and facility descriptions
patterns.context: Institutional facilities, student numbers, or building locations appear in descriptions of schools or campuses; these triggers partially overlap with other proper-name patterns.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic descriptions of educational institutions or campuses

patterns.name: Disruption of urban medical services

en.concept: Proper names and fragments in structured text
en.description: Activations occur in various formatted proper names and structured fields: addresses and institution names, location labels, legal decision headings, and judges’ names. Other examples include descriptions of hospital incapacity in crisis reporting, within-word pseudo-Latin fragments, and base-arithmetic operators and answers. There is no single stable lexical meaning.

patterns.name: C 语言问答及程序入口
patterns.context: StackExchange 问题标题后接 C 代码示例与头文件引用。

en.description: Activates mainly on underscore-separated identifiers in code and nearby declarations, assignments, and comments, and also on author emails in code file headers. Biomedical paper titles are difficult to fit into these patterns.

patterns.name: Underscores and digits in C/C++ identifiers
patterns.context: Code identifiers are split into multiple tokens, commonly in underscore-separated variable, struct, or member names; no requirement for a particular API is apparent.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code and code snippets

patterns.name: Code comments and documentation
patterns.context: Comments or documentation embedded in code describe variables, data, types, or formulas; they may appear alongside underscore-containing identifiers.
patterns.domain: Source-code comments, code documentation, and Q&A code

patterns.name: Code structure and syntax markers
patterns.context: Near declarations, preprocessor directives, member access, or assignments in source code; activations occur across multiple languages and code structures.

patterns.name: Author attribution and email
patterns.context: Copyright or creator metadata in source-file headers, with names, emails, and angle-bracket formatting.

patterns.name: Specific code identifier pcmanticore
patterns.context: Occurs in the username portion of an email address in copyright information; this proper name is one of the few triggers not sufficiently explained by common code structures or underscore-identifier patterns.

patterns.name: Compound terms in biomedical titles
patterns.context: A phrase composed of technical vocabulary appears in a paper title; it differs superficially from the other examples.

patterns.name: Visible numbers and dimension expressions
patterns.context: Numbers occur in variable names, array indices, dimensions, code parameters, or technical formulas; some may simply be part of ordinary code syntax.

10_2024.description: 主要对代码中的下划线分隔标识符及其周围的声明、赋值和注释激活，也见于代码文件头的作者邮箱。生物医学论文标题难以纳入这些模式。

patterns.name: C/C++ 标识符中的下划线与数字
patterns.context: 代码标识符被拆成多个 token，常见于下划线分隔的变量名、结构体名或成员名；未显示出必须出现某个特定 API 的条件。

patterns.name: 代码注释与文档说明
patterns.trigger: 如「/**」「Returns _path without trailing slash」「#1D list of training labels」「Channel Frequency =」
patterns.context: 注释或文档文本夹在代码中，描述变量、数据、类型或公式；可能与下划线标识符同时出现。
patterns.domain: 源码注释、代码文档及问答代码

patterns.name: 代码结构与语法标记
patterns.context: 源码中的声明、预处理指令、成员访问或赋值附近；激活跨多种语言及代码结构出现。

patterns.name: 作者署名与邮箱
patterns.trigger: 「Copyright (c) 2016 Claudiu Popa <pcmant…@gmail.com>」以及「Created by: Joerg Wunsch <joerg@FreeBSD.org>」
patterns.context: 源文件头部的版权或创建者元数据，姓名、邮箱及尖括号格式同时出现。

patterns.name: 特定代码标识符 pcmanticore
patterns.context: 出现在版权信息的邮箱用户名中；这是少数无法由常见代码结构或下划线标识符模式充分解释的专名触发。

patterns.name: 生物医学标题中的复合术语
patterns.trigger: 「Multivalent 3D Display of Glycopolymer Chains for Enhanced…」
patterns.context: 论文标题中出现由专业词汇构成的短语；与其他代码段表面上不同。

patterns.name: 可见的数字及维度表达
patterns.context: 数字出现在变量名、数组索引、维度、代码参数或技术公式中；部分数字也可能只是普通代码语法的一部分。

en.description: Activations occur mostly on underscores in code identifiers and nearby fragments, especially save-related APIs; they also appear in LaTeX labels, escaped strings, and cryptographic function names, with limited cross-domain consistency.

patterns.name: Save-related APIs and events
patterns.context: Discusses saving database records, sending save signals, or retrieving content after saving; also includes save function names in code.

patterns.name: Underscores in compound identifiers
patterns.context: Occurs within code identifiers, often adjacent to function, variable, or API names; activation falls on the underscore and surrounding fragments.

patterns.name: LaTeX structure in technical text
patterns.context: Near LaTeX commands, labels, and formula environments in mathematical papers.

patterns.name: Tabs and escaped strings in code
patterns.context: When testing string escaping and its msgid representation.

patterns.name: Specific numerical-operation naming in code
patterns.context: Declarations of signed-number addition functions and related type names in C/Rust cryptography library code.

10_2024.concept: 代码标识符与结构标记
10_2024.description: 激活多出现在代码标识符的下划线及其邻近片段，尤其是 save 相关 API；另见 LaTeX 标签、转义字符串和密码学函数名，跨领域统一规律有限。

patterns.name: save 相关 API 与事件
patterns.context: 讨论保存数据库记录、发送保存信号或保存后获取内容；也包括代码中的保存函数名。

patterns.name: 复合标识符中的下划线
patterns.trigger: «_»，尤其是«entity_delete_multiple»、«tab_width»、«sample_per_part»等标识符中的下划线
patterns.context: 出现在代码标识符内部，常与函数名、变量名或 API 名相邻；激活落在下划线及其周围片段。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的 LaTeX 结构
patterns.context: 数学论文中，LaTeX 命令、标签及公式环境附近。

patterns.name: 代码中的制表符与转义字符串
patterns.context: 测试字符串转义及其 msgid 表示时。

patterns.name: 代码中的特定数值运算命名
patterns.context: C/Rust 密码学库代码中的有符号数加法函数声明及其相关类型名。

en.description: Activations span code identifiers, Java call stacks, CSS/spelling markers, whitespace, and sporadic word fragments in scientific and web text. A few repeated fragments such as the and Mar may have local associations, but overall there is no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Data-structure identifiers
patterns.context: Defines or initializes datasets and database adapters in VB/.NET code; fragments of identifiers and type names activate

patterns.name: Register variable declarations
patterns.context: Consecutive declarations of register integer variables and field reads in C/C++-style code

patterns.name: Type names in Java stack traces
patterns.context: A Java exception stack trace containing a Gson reflective type-adapter call chain

patterns.name: CSS fonts and spelling markers
patterns.context: CSS style declarations and Word-style spelling markers; split properties or marker strings appear

patterns.name: String/subword fragment “the”
patterns.context: The definite article the in ordinary English and scientific text; contexts vary widely, and activation does not consistently fall on the same meaning or topic

patterns.name: “Mar” fragment
patterns.context: One instance is in the proper name Marval, another appears near a paper citation; they may also be unrelated coincidental fragments

patterns.name: Multiple-space/indentation markers
patterns.context: Whitespace or formatting spaces near code indentation and line breaks are marked; also occurs across different content types

patterns.name: Sporadic words in English prose
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across forum/web prose and product descriptions, with no stable shared local semantic or syntactic condition

patterns.name: Mathematics/physics noun fragments
patterns.context: Descriptions in string theory papers of the worldsheet, partition function, and bosonic string field theory

patterns.name: Medical imaging and production description
patterns.context: Introduces a contrast agent for cardiopulmonary imaging and its large-scale production

patterns.name: Animal communication and food sources
patterns.context: Discusses long-distance, low-frequency communication by whales and its possible transmission of information about food

patterns.name: Automotive maintenance forum narrative
patterns.context: A car owner describes problems after cleaning rubber seals and cites an automotive detailing forum

patterns.name: Task-list recommendations
patterns.context: Discusses task-list software and the desire to move secondary tasks to the background

patterns.name: App and promotion report
patterns.context: Reports on a secondhand-sales app and information about its promotional award

10_2024.description: 激活覆盖代码标识符、Java 调用栈、CSS/拼写标记、空白，以及科学和网页文本中的零散词片段。少数重复片段如 the、Mar 可能有局部关联，但整体缺乏统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 数据结构标识符
patterns.context: VB/.NET 代码中定义或初始化数据集及数据库适配器；标识符与类型名的词片段被激活

patterns.name: 寄存器变量声明
patterns.context: C/C++ 风格代码中连续声明 register 整数变量并读取字段

patterns.name: Java 堆栈跟踪中的类型名
patterns.context: Java 异常堆栈跟踪，包含 Gson 反射式类型适配器调用链

patterns.name: CSS 字体及拼写标记
patterns.context: CSS 样式声明以及 Word 风格的拼写标记；出现被拆分的属性或标记串

patterns.name: 字符串/子词片段「the」
patterns.trigger: « the»、« the»1 bosonic；« the»9 agent；« the»1 whales
patterns.context: 普通英文及科学文本中定冠词 the；所在语境差异很大，且激活并不总落在同一词义或主题上
patterns.domain: 科学论文、医学宣传、散文

patterns.name: 「Mar」词片段
patterns.context: 一处是专名 Marval，另一处在论文引用附近出现 Mar；也可能是不同词片段偶合

patterns.name: 多词空格/缩进标记
patterns.context: 代码缩进、换行附近的空白或排版空格被标记；同时出现在不同内容类型中

patterns.name: 英文叙述中的零散词语
patterns.context: 激活散落在论坛/网页叙述、产品介绍等普通文本中，未见稳定共享的局部语义或句法条件

patterns.name: 数学/物理名词片段
patterns.context: 弦论论文中关于世界面、配分函数与玻色弦场论的描述

patterns.name: 医学成像与生产描述
patterns.context: 介绍一种用于心肺成像的造影剂及其规模化生产
patterns.domain: 医学/生物技术宣传材料

patterns.name: 动物沟通与食物来源
patterns.context: 讨论鲸鱼长距离低频通信及其可能传递食物信息

patterns.name: 汽车维护论坛叙述
patterns.context: 车主叙述清洗橡胶密封件后出现问题，并引用汽车美容论坛

patterns.name: 任务清单建议
patterns.context: 讨论任务清单软件及将次要任务移至后台的愿望

patterns.name: 应用与促销报道
patterns.context: 报道二手销售应用及其促销获奖信息

en.description: Activations are scattered across scientific writing, French names, English names or word fragments, and code identifiers; the second passage highlights “other important”, the first highlights “its”, and the remaining highlights lack verifiable common trigger conditions.

patterns.name: “Val/val” string in proper names or names
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of the French parliamentary speaker name “Valdivielso”; may be sensitive to subword fragments within names

patterns.name: “other” followed by a description of importance
patterns.context: In scientific abstract-style text, other modifies important transcription factors; the preceding text mentions confirming known findings and further identifying unreported targets

patterns.name: Fragmentary or low-confidence cues
patterns.context: Occurs in fragments after newlines, historical organization names, personal names, athlete names, and code identifiers; there is no shared local semantic or syntactic condition
patterns.domain: Forum text, encyclopedias, sports reporting, and code

patterns.name: Markers and identifier fragments in code configuration
patterns.context: Occurs in security policy settings, field names, or camel-case identifiers; activation falls on split word fragments and nearby punctuation
patterns.domain: Configuration text in StackExchange technical Q&A

patterns.name: Function words and general scientific vocabulary
patterns.context: These highlighted words are scattered across scientific writing and other contexts; apart from the phrase combination in the second passage, there is no stable shared context
patterns.domain: Scientific abstracts and other mixed corpora

10_2024.description: 激活分散于科研表达、法语人名、英文姓名或词片段及代码标识符；第2段突出“other important”，第1段突出“its”，其余高亮缺少可验证的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 专名或名称中的“Val/val”字串
patterns.trigger: «Val»（[4]）；«Val»不是唯一可能的片段，但此处是最强标记
patterns.context: 出现在法语议会发言中人名“Valdivielso”的开头；可能对名称内部的子词片段敏感

patterns.name: “other”及后续重要性描述
patterns.context: 科研摘要式文字中，other 修饰 important transcription factors，前文提到确认既有发现并进一步识别未报告的对象

patterns.name: 碎片化或低置信线索
patterns.context: 分别处于换行后的残片、历史社团名称、人名、运动员姓名及代码标识符内部；缺少共同的局部语义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、百科、体育报道及代码

patterns.name: 代码配置中的标记与标识符片段
patterns.context: 出现在安全策略配置项、字段名或驼峰式标识符中，激活落在被拆分的词片段及标点附近
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答中的配置文本

patterns.name: 功能词与通用科研词
patterns.context: 这些高亮词分散于科研文字及其他语境；除第2段的短语组合外，没有稳定共享的上下文
patterns.domain: 科研摘要及其他混合语料

en.description: All passages contain within-word subword-fragment activations, covering URLs, proper names, ordinary words, and technical terms; the fragments and contexts vary, with no stable semantic or domain-level commonality.

patterns.name: Multiple within-word subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within proper names, ordinary words, or technical terms, with no fixed position; sometimes multiple adjacent subwords activate consecutively. No stable syntactic position, word sense, or domain condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: URLs, papers, reviews, parliamentary records, medicine, sports, lists, and biology texts

10_2024.description: 所有段都出现词内子词片段激活，覆盖网址、专名、普通词和专业术语；片段及语境多变，未见稳定的语义或领域共性。

patterns.name: 词内多子词片段
patterns.trigger: 被标记的 token 常是单词内部的片段，如 «assets»、«change»、«I»、«cb»、«Y»、«dr»、«lx»、«Mark»、«ward»、«Planet»、«Pop»、«Merc»、«i»、«Val»、«div»、«iel»、«so»、«chain»、«likely»、«is»、«Rob»、«o»、«define»、«its»、«signaling»、«the»、«best»、«offensive»、«leads»、«Bern»、«Pierre»、«Stur»、«mit»、«ogen»、«dec»、«ap»、«crust»、«sh»
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、普通词或技术词的词内片段上，片段位置不固定；有时相邻多个子词连续激活。未见稳定的句法位置、词义或领域条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：网址、论文、评论、议会记录、医学、体育、名单及生物学文本

en.concept: Rare word fragments and proper names
