en.description: Activations mostly fall on subword fragments within rare proper names, URLs, or compound words; “rim” and “div” recur in different contexts, but there are also one-off brand names and title segmentation, with no unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Fragments containing “rim”
patterns.context: Occurs in different word forms, including species names, organization names, and usernames; there is no stable syntactic or semantic condition.

patterns.name: Fragments containing “div”
patterns.context: Embedded in proper names or Italian words, occurring in unrelated contexts.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in proper names and rare strings
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of rare place names, URLs/random character sequences, or personal names, with no consistent context or meaning.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia, web links, technical discussions, animal lineage texts

patterns.name: “Pop” fragment in a product name
patterns.context: Activates when the brand name recurs in a description of popcorn texture and branding.

patterns.name: Split fragments in Italian titles
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across several subword fragments in uppercase Italian titles; there is also local activation on “il” and “divino” in the body, but not enough to establish a stable Italian-language pattern.

10_2024.description: 激活多落在罕见专名、URL或复合词内部的子词片段；“rim”“div”等在不同语境重复出现，但也有仅见一次的品牌名和标题切分，未见统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 含“rim”的词片
patterns.context: 出现在物种名、组织名及用户名等不同词形中；没有稳定的句法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 生物学、历史/社会组织、网络评论

patterns.name: 含“div”的词片
patterns.context: 嵌在专名或意大利语词语中，出现于互不相同的上下文。
patterns.domain: 演员/人物名单、意大利语哲学文本

patterns.name: 专名及罕见字符串内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在罕见地名、URL/随机字符序列或人名的内部片段，没有一致的上下文或词义。
patterns.domain: 维基百科、网页链接、技术讨论、动物谱系文本

patterns.name: 商品名中的“Pop”词片
patterns.context: 在关于爆米花口感与品牌的介绍中，品牌名重复出现时激活。

patterns.name: 意大利语标题中的切分片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在意大利语大写标题的多个子词片段；正文另有“il”“divino”等局部激活，但不足以确定稳定的意大利语模式。
patterns.domain: 意大利语哲学书目/学术文本

en.concept: Fragmented word forms and symbol patterns
en.description: Activations often fall on fragments of proper names or terms split by tokenization, especially forms containing shrimp-related words; other cases include formula numbers and punctuation, Italian word forms, code identifiers, immunology abbreviations, and legal case names, with no unified cross-domain semantics.

patterns.name: Fragments/subwords within proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on split word or proper-name fragments; examples include personal names, ethnic-group names, and animal names, with no unified meaning

patterns.name: Shrimp-related words
patterns.context: High activation occurs near crustaceans, shrimp, and their taxonomic names; may also overlap with fragmented proper names

patterns.name: Popcorn in a proper name or brand
patterns.context: The Pop subword in the brand name Planet Popcorn activates strongly; surrounding text discusses popcorn products

patterns.name: Numbers and separators in formulas
patterns.context: Activation occurs near numbers, commas, slashes, and formula boundaries in mathematical expressions

patterns.name: Italian word-form fragments
patterns.context: In Italian titles and body text, activation is distributed across mixed-case word fragments

patterns.name: Code identifiers and assignment structures
patterns.context: Activation occurs near identifiers, equals signs, and explanatory text in code comments or variable declarations

patterns.name: Immunology markers and abbreviations
patterns.context: Activation occurs near alphanumeric combinations and high/low markers in cell-population phenotypes and flow-sorting abbreviations

patterns.name: Case-name fragments in legal citations
patterns.context: Name subword fragments activate in case names cited in court opinions

10_2024.concept: 碎片化词形与符号模式
10_2024.description: 激活常落在分词切开的专名或术语片段上，尤其含虾类词形；另见公式数字标点、意大利语词形、代码标识符、免疫学缩写及法律案件名，跨领域无统一语义。

patterns.name: 专名内部的碎片/子词
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词切开的词或专名片段上；对象包括人名、族名、动物名等，没有统一词义

patterns.name: 虾类相关词语
patterns.context: 甲壳动物、虾及其分类名称附近出现高激活；也可能与碎片化专名重叠

patterns.name: 专名或品牌中的 Popcorn
patterns.context: 品牌名 Planet Popcorn 中的 Pop 子词强激活，周边讨论爆米花产品

patterns.name: 公式中的数字与分隔符
patterns.context: 数学表达式中数字、逗号、斜线及公式边界附近激活

patterns.name: 意大利语词形片段
patterns.context: 意大利语标题及正文中，激活分布于大小写混杂的词片段

patterns.name: 代码标识符与赋值结构
patterns.context: 代码注释或变量声明中，标识符、等号及其说明文字附近激活
patterns.domain: 软件代码、汇编/寄存器说明

patterns.name: 免疫学标记与缩写
patterns.context: 细胞群体表型和流式分选缩写中，字母数字组合及高低标记附近激活

patterns.name: 法律引文中的案件名片段
patterns.context: 法院意见引用的案件名中，姓名子词片段激活

en.description: Activations are scattered across local fragments of proper names, usernames, identifiers, URLs, terminology, numbers, Chinese strings, and punctuation, spanning many domains and styles; no stable semantic or thematic condition is apparent, suggesting a response to specific tokenization fragments or character boundaries.

patterns.name: Character and subword segmentation in username/name fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword or character fragments in proper names, usernames, identifiers, URLs, or domain-specific terms; often occurs at model tokenization boundaries, with no stable semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: forums, code, history, mathematics, food, marine biology

patterns.name: Local characters in numbers and digit strings
patterns.context: Activation occurs on numbers, identifiers, or digit strings, but across different contexts and without a unified numerical meaning.

patterns.name: Chinese characters and Chinese tokenization fragments
patterns.context: Chinese strings in a UTF-8 regex example; markers fall on several Chinese characters or their tokenization fragments.

patterns.name: Parentheses, punctuation, and formatting boundaries
patterns.context: Markers occur at symbol boundaries in code, mathematical notation, or URLs; may relate to tokenization of adjacent characters.

10_2024.description: 激活分散在专名、用户名、标识符、网址、术语、数字、中文字符串及标点的局部片段上，跨越多种领域与文体；未呈现稳定的语义或主题条件，更像对特定分词片段/字符边界的响应。

patterns.name: 用户名/名称片段中的字符与子词切分
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、用户名、标识符、网址或领域术语的子词/字符片段上；常见于模型分词边界处，未见稳定的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：论坛、代码、历史、数学、食品、海洋生物学

patterns.name: 数字及数字串中的局部字符
patterns.context: 数字、编号或数字串处出现激活，但分布于不同语境，未显示统一数值意义。

patterns.name: 中文字符与中文分词片段
patterns.context: UTF-8 正则示例中的中文字符串；标记落在若干中文字符或其分词片段上。
patterns.domain: 编程问答，涉及 Unicode/正则表达式

patterns.name: 括号、标点及格式边界
patterns.context: 标记出现在代码、数学记号或网址的符号边界；可能与相邻字符的分词有关。

en.description: Activations are scattered across local fragments in URLs, proper nouns, usernames, common words, code identifiers, and medical and chemical terms. The commonality may be a specific subword/character fragment rather than a shared semantic topic.

patterns.name: Tokenized substrings in domains
patterns.context: Contiguous substrings in URLs or software names are split into tokens, especially in domains, URL paths, and project names; a consistent semantic topic is not required.

patterns.name: Local substrings in personal or proper names
patterns.context: Marked word segments occur within proper names such as people and organizations; the surrounding text is a cast list or historical narrative.

patterns.name: English suffix -fty
patterns.context: An English word-ending fragment embedded in a username; a singleton, surrounded by a Hacker News comment.

patterns.name: Task-list-related phrases
patterns.context: Discusses to-do software, priorities, and task tracking; markings include list and newline characters, and it is unclear whether the trigger is topic or formatting alone.

patterns.name: Spelling fragment related to bershop / barber
patterns.context: Appears in the word “barbershop,” describing a visit to a barbershop; only one example.

patterns.name: hydr fragment within a medical term
patterns.context: Within the medical term “hydronephrosis,” discussing diagnosis after treatment; there is a clear indication of a local-substring trigger.

patterns.name: Identifiers and symbol fragments in code
patterns.context: In JavaScript/jQuery example code, markings fall on comment symbols, URLs, and variable/identifier fragments.

patterns.name: titrant fragment in a measurement term
patterns.context: Appears in an academic abstract about chemical analysis methods and titrants; only one example.

10_2024.description: 激活分散在 URL、专名、用户名、普通词、代码标识符及医学和化学术语的局部片段；共同点可能是特定子词/字符片段，而非统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 域名中的分词/子串
patterns.context: 网址或软件名称中的连续子串被拆分标记，尤其是域名、URL 路径和项目名；不要求语义主题一致。

patterns.name: 人名或专名中的局部子串
patterns.context: 人名、组织名等专名内部出现被标记的词段；所在句为演员表或历史叙述。

patterns.name: 英语词尾 -fty
patterns.context: 嵌在用户名中的英语词尾片段，单例，周围是 Hacker News 评论。

patterns.name: 任务列表相关短语
patterns.context: 谈论待办事项软件、优先级和任务记录；标记包括 list 及换行符，不能确定是否由主题或格式单独触发。

patterns.name: 词尾 bershop / barber 相关拼写片段
patterns.context: 出现在 “barbershop” 一词中，描述去理发店；仅此一例。

patterns.name: 医学词内部的 hydr 片段
patterns.context: 医学术语“hydronephrosis”内部，讨论治疗后诊断；局部子串触发迹象较明确。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与符号片段
patterns.context: JavaScript/jQuery 示例代码中，标记落在注释符号、URL 和变量/标识符片段上。

patterns.name: 计量术语中的 titrant 片段
patterns.context: 出现在化学分析方法与滴定剂的学术摘要中；仅此一例。

en.description: Activations often fall on split fragments within proper names, brands, URLs, and compound words; they also occur in academic formatting, medical terminology, Italian text, and ordinary English words. There is no unified semantic or syntactic pattern across passages.

patterns.name: Specific endings/stems in marked noun phrases
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of URLs, product names, or English compounds; some fragments may be words split across tokens, such as hiphop, Dropbox, MyShopify, barbershop, Iconoclast.
patterns.domain: Technology links, forum dialogue, bibliographic text

patterns.name: Internal fragments in proper names and non-English words
patterns.context: Activation occurs in personal names, game names, Italian words, or other proper names, usually on split word-internal fragments; the examples have no obvious shared meaning.
patterns.domain: Gaming websites, paper author lines, philosophical texts

patterns.name: Academic formatting and paper metadata
patterns.context: Near LaTeX or LaTeX-like formatting or author lists, activation is distributed across formatting commands, symbols, and fragments of author names.

patterns.name: Common English words and syntactic fragments
patterns.context: Several high-frequency words in ordinary English prose also have positive activation; there is no clear consistent syntactic position or semantic category.

patterns.name: Urological terms and anatomical names
patterns.context: In medical abstracts, activation falls on word-internal fragments of terms or phrases such as hydronephrosis, in situ, and ileal.

patterns.name: Italian function words and abstract philosophical terms
patterns.context: In Italian philosophical titles, function words and word-internal fragments activate alongside other proper names.

patterns.name: Business difficulties and performance descriptions
patterns.context: Occurs in accounts of corporate restructuring, business difficulties, and quarterly sales performance; activation also covers ordinary function words, so a stable semantic feature cannot be identified.

10_2024.description: 激活多落在拆分后的专名、品牌、网址及复合词内部片段，也见于学术格式、医学术语、意大利语文本和普通英语词；跨段缺乏统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 标记名词短语中的特定词尾/词干
patterns.context: 激活落在网址、产品名或英文复合词的内部片段；部分片段可能是跨 token 切分的词，如 hiphop、Dropbox、MyShopify、barbershop、Iconoclast。
patterns.domain: 科技链接、论坛对话、书目文本

patterns.name: 专名与非英语词的内部片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在人名、游戏名、意大利语或其他专名中，通常是被拆开的词内片段；各例之间没有显然共享的语义。
patterns.domain: 游戏网页、论文作者行、哲学文本

patterns.name: 学术格式和论文元数据
patterns.context: LaTeX/类 LaTeX 的排版或作者列表附近，激活分布在格式命令、符号和作者姓名片段上。

patterns.name: 英文常见词和句法片段
patterns.context: 普通英语散文中若干高频词也有正激活；没有明显一致的句法位置或语义类别。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、商业新闻/评论

patterns.name: 泌尿外科术语及解剖名称
patterns.context: 医学摘要中，激活落在 hydronephrosis、in situ、ileal 等术语或短语的词内片段上。

patterns.name: 意大利语虚词与抽象哲学词
patterns.context: 意大利语哲学题名中，虚词和词内片段与其它专名同时激活。
patterns.domain: 哲学书目/意大利语文本

patterns.name: 商业困境与业绩表述
patterns.context: 公司结构变化、经营困难及季度销售表现的叙述中出现；激活也覆盖普通功能词，不能确定为稳定语义特征。

en.description: Activations are distributed across heterogeneous fragments: URL subwords, split novel text, guy, school-grade vocabulary, sports commentary, code variables, and online opinions. No single semantic or syntactic feature spans all examples.

patterns.name: Subwords in links and URLs
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on several character fragments in URLs, domains, and paths; the specific fragments vary across links.

patterns.name: Mixed-case tokenized text
patterns.context: In literary text, words are split into multiple subwords with varying capitalization, and punctuation and newlines are also marked; activations cover many fragments.

patterns.name: guy in the middle or at the end of a sentence
patterns.context: guy appears in colloquial discussions or comments; in 4 it is the username crafty guy, while in 7 and 9 it is a common noun.

patterns.name: High-school students and study-related words
patterns.context: Narratives about high-school students, school, grades, and studying; activations cover multiple content words.

patterns.name: American football commentary vocabulary
patterns.context: Sports discussions contain words about defense, teams, fans, seasons, or games.

patterns.name: Registers and variables in low-level code
patterns.context: In code comments or assembly-like fragments, variable names, register names, assignment symbols, and technical terms all activate.

patterns.name: Informal opinions combining praise and criticism
patterns.context: A first-person online comment clarifies a joke or criticism, then expresses a positive opinion of someone.

patterns.name: Segmented numbers and hyphens
patterns.context: Scores in sports sentences appear split into numbers, a hyphen, and numbers; this local activation is weak, and it is uncertain whether it reflects an independent pattern.

10_2024.description: 激活分布于多种异质片段：网址子词、拆分的小说文本、guy、学校成绩词汇、体育评论、代码变量及网络评价；未见贯穿所有段的单一语义或句法特征。

patterns.name: 链接与网址中的子词
patterns.context: 激活集中在 URL、域名和路径的若干字符片段；不同链接中的具体片段并不一致。

patterns.name: 大小写混杂的分词文本
patterns.context: 文学文本中，单词被拆成多个大小写不一的子词，标点与换行也被标记；激活覆盖许多片段。

patterns.name: 句中或句末的 guy
patterns.context: 口语化讨论或评论中出现 guy；在 4 中是用户名 crafty guy，在 7、9 中是普通名词。

patterns.name: 高中生与学习相关词语
patterns.context: 围绕高中生、学校、成绩和学习的叙述；激活覆盖多个内容词。

patterns.name: 美式橄榄球评论词汇
patterns.context: 体育讨论中出现防守、球队、球迷、赛季或比赛等词。
patterns.domain: 体育评论（橄榄球/冰球语境）

patterns.name: 低级代码中的寄存器和变量
patterns.context: 代码注释或汇编风格片段中，变量名、寄存器名、赋值符号及技术术语均有激活。

patterns.name: 褒贬并置的非正式评价
patterns.context: 第一人称网络评论先澄清玩笑或批评，再表达对某人的正面评价。

patterns.name: 分段数字与连字符
patterns.context: 体育语句中的比分以数字、连字符和数字拆分呈现；该局部激活较弱且不确定是否有独立规律。

en.description: Activations involve internal fragments of URLs and proper names, decimal fragments in numbers, and several scattered evaluative and degree words. They span domains and parts of speech, and some passages lack stable, discernible common trigger conditions.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in proper names and technical terms
patterns.context: In longer brand, product, URL, or compound names, activation falls on split word fragments; the names themselves belong to different semantic types.

patterns.name: Numbers and decimal notation
patterns.context: In answers to numerical conversion problems or numbers related to units, values are split across multiple tokens; activation is concentrated on decimal digit fragments.

patterns.name: Personal evaluations and expressions of degree
patterns.context: Discussions of people include evaluations of appearance or personality and comparative degree words; these occur in only a few sentences, and the specific trigger words are inconsistent.

patterns.name: High-intensity or high-degree words
patterns.context: Emphatic words occur when describing scores, degree, or performance; triggers are scattered, with no stable shared syntactic environment.

10_2024.description: 激活涉及网址和专名内部片段、数值小数片段，以及若干分散的评价词和程度词。跨领域、跨词类，部分段落缺乏稳定可辨的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 专名与技术词的内部片段
patterns.context: 在较长的品牌、产品、网址或化合物名称内部，激活落在被拆分的词片段上；名称本身语义类型不一。
patterns.domain: 网址、科技产品、科学术语

patterns.name: 数字与小数表示
patterns.context: 数值换算题的答案或单位相关数字中，数值被拆成多个 token；激活集中在小数数字片段。

patterns.name: 人物评价与程度表达
patterns.context: 人物讨论中出现外貌或性格评价、程度比较词；只在个别句子中出现，具体触发词并不一致。

patterns.name: 高强度或高程度词
patterns.context: 描述成绩、程度或表现时出现强调性词语；触发词分散，未见稳定的共同句法环境。

en.description: Activations are scattered across numeric and base-notation text, proper-name substrings, common English words, email formats, URLs, literary cheering, and Spanish chat. No single semantic trigger is consistent across examples.

patterns.name: Encoded text and marker symbols
patterns.context: Appears in base-arithmetic problems, answers, or binary-style number strings; activations fall on local digits, symbols, and prompt text.

patterns.name: Local strings in personal and proper names
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across subword fragments in proper names, personal names, company names, or URLs, with no stable shared semantic context.

patterns.name: Common English words and local phrases
patterns.context: In English narratives or expository text, common words and adjacent phrases activate at multiple positions; not limited to one fixed word.

patterns.name: Document structure and email formats
patterns.context: Appears in formatted text such as email disclaimers and forwarded-message headers; activations involve formatting markers, fields, and proper names.

patterns.name: URLs and link text
patterns.context: Links embedded in web pages or discussion posts; activations are distributed across protocols, domains, paths, and their word fragments.

patterns.name: Cheering and singing expressions
patterns.context: In literary narratives of people cheering or singing, activations fall on interjections and related action words.

patterns.name: Word fragments in Spanish chat
patterns.context: In a Spanish Ubuntu IRC conversation, a sentence about being unable to access a hard drive; activations fall on substrings within words.

patterns.name: Mixed low-intensity local activations
patterns.context: These isolated fragments show some activation, but the samples do not establish a stable, independent trigger pattern.

10_2024.description: 激活分散于数字与进位制文本、专名子串、英语常见词、邮件格式、网址、文学欢呼及西班牙语聊天，未见跨段稳定的单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 编码文本与标记符号
patterns.trigger: “In base 9, what is -24707245 + 5?”、“In base 16, what is 4 - 124f30?”及数字片段“1101”“101”“0”
patterns.context: 出现在进位制算术题、答案或二进制样式的数字串中；激活落在数字、符号及提示语的局部。

patterns.name: 人名及专名中的局部字符串
patterns.context: 激活分散在专名、人名、公司名或网址的子词片段上，没有稳定的共同语义上下文。

patterns.name: 英语常见词与局部短语
patterns.trigger: “in prosperous suburbs”、“attend good schools”、“get excellent grades”、“pretty good”
patterns.context: 位于英语叙述或说明性文字中，常见词及相邻短语多个位置都有激活；并非只限某个固定词。

patterns.name: 文档结构与邮件格式
patterns.trigger: “This e-mail is the property of…”、“-----Original Message-----”、“From:”、“Sent:”
patterns.context: 出现在邮件免责声明及转发邮件头等格式化文本中，激活涉及格式标记、字段和专名。

patterns.name: 网址及链接文本
patterns.context: 嵌在网页或讨论帖中的链接；激活分布在协议、域名、路径及其中的词片段。

patterns.name: 欢呼及歌唱表达
patterns.context: 人物欢呼或歌唱的文学叙述中，激活落在感叹词和相关动作词上。

patterns.name: 西班牙语聊天中的词片段
patterns.context: Ubuntu IRC 西班牙语对话中，关于无法访问硬盘的句子；该处激活落在词内子串。

patterns.name: 混合低强度局部激活
patterns.context: 这些孤立片段虽有少量激活，但无法从样本中确认稳定、独立的触发模式。

en.description: Activations are distributed across URLs and Markdown links, split code identifiers, and several specific English sentences, names, slogans, and poems; no single meaning or topic explains all fragments.

patterns.name: URLs and link markers
patterns.context: Triggers are concentrated in URLs, Markdown links, or URL fragments, often spanning multiple tokens such as the protocol, domain, and path; contexts include sites such as Shopify, GitHub, and Raspberry Pi.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and package paths
patterns.context: Split identifiers, dot-separated package names, or method names in code; occur in jQuery/PHP code snippets and Java package import statements.

patterns.name: Syntax/function words in multiword sequences
patterns.context: In ordinary English sentences, activation covers consecutive function and content words; topics concern fans' views of a player's destination and high school students, schools, and grades.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, news, or narrative prose

patterns.name: Personal names and family narratives
patterns.context: In historical or family relationship narratives, names are split into subwords while kinship, conjecture, and time and place are also described.

patterns.name: Social identity terms in quotations
patterns.context: A news narrative describes a camp near a railway and its slogan; activation falls on the quoted phrase and nearby scene description.

patterns.name: Second person and self-reference in poetry
patterns.context: In Shakespearean lines, archaic second-person possessive and reflexive words recur in discussion of the self, desire, and self-harm.

10_2024.description: 激活分布于网址与 Markdown 链接、拆分的代码标识符，以及若干特定英文句子、姓名、标语和诗句；没有单一词义或主题能解释所有片段。

patterns.name: 网址与链接标记
patterns.trigger: «http»、«https»、«://»、«www»及 URL 中的路径和域名片段
patterns.context: 触发集中出现在 URL、Markdown 链接或网址残片中，常跨越协议、域名、路径等多个 token；上下文包含 Shopify、GitHub、Raspberry Pi 等站点。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与包路径
patterns.context: 代码中被拆分的标识符、点分隔包名或方法名；出现在 jQuery/PHP 代码片段和 Java 包导入语句中。

patterns.name: 多词序列中的句法/虚词
patterns.context: 普通英文句子中，激活覆盖连续的功能词和内容词；主题分别是球迷对球员去向的看法，以及高中生、学校和成绩。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、新闻或叙述性散文

patterns.name: 人物姓名与家族叙述
patterns.context: 历史或家族关系叙述中，姓名被拆分成子词，且同时描述亲属关系、推测和时间地点。

patterns.name: 引语中的社会身份用语
patterns.context: 描述铁路附近营地及其标语的新闻叙述；激活落在引语词组和邻近场景描写上。

patterns.name: 诗歌中的第二人称与自我指涉
patterns.context: 莎士比亚诗句中，古英语第二人称所有格与反身词反复出现，讨论自我、欲望与自我伤害。

en.concept: Boundary fragments in code and text
en.description: Activations are distributed across punctuation, boundaries, and identifier subwords in various code fragments, as well as common English function words and words associated with poetic meter. There is no single semantic topic; locally, activations may favor tokenization boundaries and common short fragments.

patterns.name: Code punctuation and structural boundaries
patterns.context: In code or code fragments, punctuation occurs at the boundaries of statements, calls, arguments, or blocks; examples appear across languages and positions.

patterns.name: Function words and phrase transitions in natural language
patterns.context: In ordinary English narratives, common words occur in clause transitions, expressions of degree, or predicate phrases; specific words and contexts vary considerably.

patterns.name: Meter and emphasis words in poetry
patterns.context: Verse contains words with rhythmic or emphatic functions, including Old English poetic language and interjections.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within code identifiers
patterns.context: Some fragments activate when code identifiers, package names, API names, or variable names consist of multiple morphemes; may overlap with code-structure patterns.

patterns.name: Specific vocabulary combinations in narratives
patterns.context: Continuous expressions about kinship, personal identity, or uncertain conjecture in genealogical narratives; beyond general English transitions, there is no clear shared topic.

10_2024.concept: 代码与文本的边界片段
10_2024.description: 激活分布于多种代码片段中的标点、边界和标识符子词，也见普通英语功能词及诗歌格律词；无单一语义主题，局部可能偏向分词边界与常见短片段。

patterns.name: 代码标点与结构边界
patterns.context: 代码或代码片段中，标点出现在语句、调用、参数或块的边界；不同语言和位置均有出现。

patterns.name: 自然语言中的功能词与短语衔接
patterns.context: 普通英语叙述中，常见词位于从句衔接、程度表达或谓语短语中；具体词和语境差异较大。

patterns.name: 诗歌中的格律与强调词
patterns.context: 韵文中出现带节奏或强调作用的词，包含古英语诗歌用语及感叹词。

patterns.name: 代码标识符内部的子词片段
patterns.trigger: «im»、«In»、«Inquiry»、«export»、«strip» 等标识符或路径中的片段
patterns.context: 代码标识符、包名、API 名或变量名由多个词素构成时，部分片段被激活；可能与代码结构模式重叠。

patterns.name: 叙述中的具体词汇组合
patterns.context: 家谱叙述中关于亲属关系、人物身份或不确定推测的连续表达；除一般英语衔接外没有明显共享主题。

en.description: Activations span math problems, code, forums, email, genealogical narratives, and poetry, falling respectively on problem prompts and numbers, code identifiers, name fields, proper names, and archaic English pronouns; no single stable meaning or grammatical function is apparent.

patterns.name: Base-system prompts in math problems
patterns.context: When asking for arithmetic results in a given base, activation falls near the beginning of the prompt and the base number; problems include subtraction, addition, and other operations.

patterns.name: Unit-conversion prompts in math problems
patterns.context: In problems converting units of measurement such as liters and micrograms, unit abbreviations, values, and some answer digits activate.

patterns.name: Numbers and calculation results in math problems
patterns.context: In integer or decimal addition and subtraction problems, activation is scattered across problem numbers and digit fragments in the results; it is not limited to one operation.

patterns.name: Tokenization fragments in Java package names
patterns.context: Reverse-domain names and project names in Java package/import declarations are split into subwords, and activation falls on these fragments.

patterns.name: Forum quotations and sports commentary
patterns.context: First-person comments in quoted posts; sentences discuss fans, player affiliation, or team prospects.

patterns.name: Names and fields in email headers
patterns.context: Forwarded email headers contain fields such as From, Sent, To, cc, and Subject, as well as names, dates, or addresses; activation often falls on name subwords and field words.

patterns.name: Names and places in genealogical narratives
patterns.context: When discussing relatives, marriage, name origins, and places, proper names and related narrative words activate.

patterns.name: Second person and self-related themes in poetry
patterns.context: A poetic, archaic-English-style second-person monologue describes the self, desire, or self-harm.

10_2024.description: 激活跨数学算题、代码、论坛、邮件、家谱叙述和诗歌，分别落在题目提示与数字、代码标识符、姓名字段、专名及古英语代词等局部 token 上；看不出单一稳定的词义或语法功能。

patterns.name: 数学题中的进制提示
patterns.context: 在询问某进制下的算术结果时，激活落在题目开头及进制数附近；题目包含减法、加法等。

patterns.name: 数学题中的单位换算提示
patterns.context: 转换升、微克等计量单位的题目中，单位缩写、数值及部分答案数字被激活。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与运算结果
patterns.context: 整数或小数的加减题中，激活分散在题目数字和计算答案的数字片段上；不局限于某一种运算。

patterns.name: Java 包名中的分词片段
patterns.context: Java package/import 声明中的反向域名及项目名被拆分成子词，激活落在这些片段上。

patterns.name: 论坛引用与体育评论
patterns.context: 引用帖中的第一人称评论；句子谈及球迷、球员归属或球队前景。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的人名和字段
patterns.context: 邮件转发头部含 From、Sent、To、cc、Subject 等字段及姓名、日期或地址；激活常落在姓名子词和字段词上。

patterns.name: 家谱叙述中的姓名与地点
patterns.context: 讨论亲属、婚姻、姓名来源及地点时，专名和相关叙述词被激活。

patterns.name: 诗歌中的第二人称与自我主题
patterns.context: 诗体、古英语风格的第二人称独白，描述自我、欲望或自我伤害。

en.description: Activations are scattered: contrastive words, discussions of intention, archaic pronouns, numeric strings, and various proper-name or string fragments all respond. Numeric problems and rare subwords are prominent, but do not form a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Contrastive or additive conjunctions
patterns.context: Appears after preceding text to introduce a contrast, conjecture, or turn in a poem; activations fall on the word but and nearby tokens.

patterns.name: Numbers and decimal strings
patterns.context: Digits and punctuation in numbers, calculations, or rounding problems; several activations fall within number strings.

patterns.name: Questions and expressions of intention
patterns.context: Questions and statements discussing plans, intentions, or judgments, especially those containing what or think.

patterns.name: Proper names or rare string fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments in proper names, URLs, or code identifiers; there is no clear shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Web pages, emails, code, and personal narratives

patterns.name: Archaic second person in poetry
patterns.context: Archaic poetic lines contain second-person possessives and related words, with strong activation on local tokens.

10_2024.description: 激活分布较散：转折词、意向讨论、古体代词、数值串及多种专名或字符串片段均有响应；数值题和罕见子词较突出，但不足以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 转折或补充连接词
patterns.context: 出现在前文之后，引出转折、推测或诗句中的转折；激活落在 but 一词及邻近 token 上。

patterns.name: 数字与小数串
patterns.context: 数字、计算式或舍入题中的数字及标点；若干激活落在数字串内部。

patterns.name: 疑问与意向表达
patterns.trigger: “what’s in their agenda”“what would they like”“I really think”
patterns.context: 讨论计划、意图或判断的问句与陈述，尤其包含 what、think 等词。

patterns.name: 专名或罕见字符串片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、网址或代码标识符的子词片段上；没有明显统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 网页、邮件、代码及人物叙述

patterns.name: 诗歌中的古体第二人称
patterns.context: 古体诗行中出现第二人称所有格及相关词语，局部 token 激活较强。

en.description: Activates relatively consistently after a closing brace in code samples when followed by a newline and blank line. Other activations are scattered near but, list labels, code identifiers, and technical terms, with no stable shared condition.

patterns.name: Code block closure and structural boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls after a closing brace in code, especially when a function, method, or control block ends and is followed by a blank line/new member or statement; languages and code contents vary.

patterns.name: Contrast after list items and separators
patterns.context: In narrative text, but introduces an addition, concession, or alternative explanation; in a few examples, activation is stronger near but itself.
patterns.domain: Web narratives, forums, or personal writing

patterns.name: Values following list or field labels
patterns.context: Comments, Q&A, or product text contain labels, question items, or short sections followed by specific content; activations at these positions are scattered.

patterns.name: Local activations on ordinary words or identifiers in technical text
patterns.context: In code or technical discussions, activation falls near local identifiers, error logs, option names, or device names; no shared semantic trigger condition is evident.

10_2024.description: 代码样本中较一致地在右花括号闭合、换行并接空行时激活。其余激活散落在 but、清单标签、代码标识符及技术名词附近，缺乏稳定共享条件。

patterns.name: 代码块闭合与结构边界
patterns.context: 激活落在代码中的右花括号后，尤其是函数、方法或控制块结束并接空行/新成员或语句时；语言和代码内容各异。

patterns.name: 列举项与分隔符后的转折
patterns.context: 在叙述性文字中，but 引出补充、让步或替代解释；少数例子中 but 本身附近有较强激活。
patterns.domain: 网页叙述、论坛或个人文字

patterns.name: 清单或字段标签后的值
patterns.context: 评论、问答或商品文字中出现标签、问题项或简短栏目，并接续具体内容；这些位置的激活较分散。

patterns.name: 技术文本中普通词或标识符的局部激活
patterns.context: 代码或技术讨论中，激活落在局部标识符、错误日志、选项名或器件名附近；未见共同语义触发条件。

en.description: Activations span math problems, code, legal texts, forums, and news, occurring on numbers and answers, in-word tokenization fragments, proper names, common words, and formatting markers. Apart from a numerically dense pattern in math exercises, the examples have no stable shared semantic or syntactic trigger.

patterns.name: Numbers and answer formats in math problems
patterns.context: Math exercises contain numbers, decimals, fractions, or unit conversions; activations are distributed across problem numbers, operation-related words, and answer numbers, rather than corresponding only to a fixed math word.

patterns.name: Local fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activations fall on words or name fragments split into multiple tokens; these examples occur in company names and business reporting, but do not yet show that a particular word sense is the trigger.

patterns.name: Time expressions and word fragments in forum narratives
patterns.context: Forum posts contain text such as times, usernames, or album names; high-activation points are scattered across these local fragments, with no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: Various words in sports-statistic narratives
patterns.context: In accounts of player season statistics and substitution scenarios, activations involve common words, numeric statistics, and tokenized team names; they cannot be reduced to a single sports term.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in legal texts
patterns.context: In formal legal provisions, fragments within long words activate after tokenization; nearby wording concerns property rights, airport land, and administrators.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and code structure
patterns.context: Activations appear around identifiers, preprocessor directives, and code formatting in C/C++ header files.

patterns.name: Names and place names in genealogical narratives
patterns.context: When discussing family relationships, marriage locations, and possible surnames, tokenized fragments of names and place names activate.

patterns.name: Words and punctuation in medical software recommendations
patterns.context: A forum reply quotes recommendations about hospital software and procurement channels; activations cover common words and quotation formatting, with no clear single trigger.

10_2024.description: 激活跨数学题、代码、法律文本、论坛及新闻等多种语料，落在数字和答案、词内分词片段、专名、普通词与格式标记上。除数学练习中的数值密集模式外，各段没有稳定共享的语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数值与答案格式
patterns.context: 数学练习题里出现数字、小数、分数或单位换算；激活分布在题目数字、运算相关词及答案数字上，并不只对应某个固定数学词。

patterns.name: 英语词内的局部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分为多个 token 的词语或名称片段上；这些例子处于公司名称及商业报道语境，尚不足以表明特定词义是触发条件。

patterns.name: 论坛叙述中的时间表达及词片段
patterns.context: 论坛帖子中出现时间、用户名或专辑名称等文本；高激活点散布在这些局部片段上，缺乏明确共同语义。

patterns.name: 体育数据叙述中的多种词语
patterns.context: 球员赛季统计和补位情境中，激活涉及常见词、数字统计及分词后的队名；不能归结为单一体育术语。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的分词片段
patterns.context: 正式法律条文中，长词被拆分后其中片段激活；同时附近有关于产权、机场用地和行政人员的措辞。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与代码结构
patterns.context: C/C++ 头文件中的标识符、预处理指令及代码排版附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 家谱叙述中的人名与地名
patterns.context: 讨论家族关系、婚姻地点及可能姓氏时，姓名和地名的分词片段激活。

patterns.name: 医疗软件建议中的词语与标点
patterns.context: 论坛回复引用建议内容，涉及医院软件及采购渠道；激活覆盖普通词和引用格式，尚无清晰单一触发项。

en.concept: Symbols and numeric fragments in structured text
en.description: Activates across base-arithmetic, rounding, and linear-equation problems in mathematics exercises (including answers), and also responds to webpage migration notices, code identifiers, and medical table borders. Numbers, symbols, and structured text are common across these types, but there is no single clear semantic theme.

patterns.name: Answer output in base-arithmetic problems
patterns.context: The problem asks for addition or subtraction in a specified base; activation often falls on answer digits after a newline and on adjacent digit positions

patterns.name: Precision and answer format in rounding problems
patterns.context: In rounding problems and their brief numerical answers, activation is concentrated on precision phrases and answer digits

patterns.name: Variables and answers in linear-equation solving
patterns.context: Exercises solving single-variable linear equations, where the unknown may be a letter or a combination of digits and letters, with the answer usually on a separate line

patterns.name: Migration notice and URL in comments
patterns.context: A migrated-comments notice is followed by a Hacker News discussion-page link

patterns.name: Character fragments in Java package names
patterns.context: Dot-separated identifiers in Java package/import declarations

patterns.name: Robot kinematics parameter identifiers
patterns.context: Configuration parameter names beginning with min_ in C++ code, along with kinematics classes and parameter-lookup calls

patterns.name: Table borders and male fields
patterns.context: Fields and numeric columns in ASCII-style tables in medical articles or datasets

10_2024.concept: 结构化文本中的符号与数值片段
10_2024.description: 激活分布于数学练习的进制运算、舍入与线性方程题（含答案），也响应网页迁移提示、代码标识符及医学表格边框；各类中常见数字、符号和结构化文本，但无单一明确语义。

patterns.name: 进制算术题中的答案输出
patterns.trigger: “In base … what is”及其后的数位串；答案处出现二进制、十六进制样式的数串
patterns.context: 题目要求在指定进制下做加减，激活常落在题干换行后的答案数字及其相邻数位

patterns.name: 舍入题的精度与答案格式
patterns.trigger: “rounded to … decimal places”“nearest …”“three dps”；答案中的数字、小数点及负号
patterns.context: 舍入题目及其紧随的简短数值答案中，激活集中在精度短语和答案的数字字符

patterns.name: 线性方程求解的变量与答案
patterns.trigger: “Solve … for r/m/d/o”中的变量字母及等号、系数、运算符；随后单独给出的答案
patterns.context: 一元线性方程求解练习，未知数可能是普通字母或数字与字母组合，答案通常另起一行

patterns.name: 搬迁评论提示及URL
patterns.context: 评论区被迁移的提示文本之后跟随 Hacker News 讨论页链接

patterns.name: Java 包名中的字符片段
patterns.context: Java package/import 声明中的点分隔标识符

patterns.name: 机器人运动学参数标识符
patterns.context: C++ 代码中以 min_ 开头的配置参数名及运动学类、参数查找调用

patterns.name: 表格边框与男性字段
patterns.context: 医学文章或数据表中，ASCII 样式表格的字段与数值列

en.description: Primarily responds to numerical-operation problems in mathematics exercises, especially rounding, negative-number arithmetic, equations, and base arithmetic; there is also one Java package name and one Hacker News link that do not fit the math pattern.

patterns.name: Numerical rounding problems
patterns.context: A decimal or integer is given, with a request to round to a specified precision or number of places; activation also appears near the problem answer.

patterns.name: Linear equations with negative numbers
patterns.context: Requests to solve single-variable linear equations containing negative numbers and variables.

patterns.name: Integer arithmetic in different bases
patterns.context: A base is specified, and addition or subtraction involving positive and negative numbers is requested; the problem and answer contain non-decimal numeral representations.

patterns.name: Arithmetic and difference problems with negative numbers
patterns.context: Asks about numerical addition or subtraction, the difference or distance between two numbers, often involving negative numbers and sometimes decimals or large integers.

patterns.name: Java package name identifiers
patterns.context: A Java source-code package declaration is followed by an import; activation is concentrated on the components of the package-name identifier.

patterns.name: Hacker News URL
patterns.context: A comment says the discussion has moved to the linked page; activation is concentrated on the URL's domain, path, and query parameters.

10_2024.concept: 数学题及结构化标识符
10_2024.description: 主要响应数学练习中的数值运算题，尤其舍入、负数算术、方程和进制运算；另有一次 Java 包名和一次 Hacker News 链接，无法并入数学模式。

patterns.name: 舍入数值题
patterns.trigger: "rounded to"、"Round … to … decimal places/dp/dps"，以及"nearest integer"、"nearest 10000"
patterns.context: 给出小数或整数并要求按指定精度或位数舍入；激活还出现在题目答案附近。

patterns.name: 带负数的线性方程
patterns.context: 要求求解含负数和变量的一元线性方程。

patterns.name: 不同进制的整数运算
patterns.context: 指定进制，询问含正负数的加法或减法；题目与答案中出现非十进制数字表示。

patterns.name: 带负数的算术及差值题
patterns.context: 询问数值加减、两个数的差或距离，常含负数，也有小数或较大的整数。

patterns.name: Java 包名标识符
patterns.context: Java 源码的 package 声明后接 import；激活集中于包名标识符各部分。

patterns.name: Hacker News URL
patterns.context: 评论说明已移至链接所指页面，激活集中于 URL 的域名、路径及查询参数。

en.description: Activations cover several structures: identifiers and syntax in code, institutional wording and case metadata in legal texts, numeric symbols in math problems, and names and family relationships in narratives; there is no clear unified trigger.

patterns.name: Lowercase letter sequences in Java package names
patterns.context: Activations concentrate around package-name components and separators, especially tokens that split continuous lowercase characters into subwords.

patterns.name: Prepositions and administrative wording in legal texts
patterns.context: Appears within the administrative title “Administrator” and near formal wording such as title and site in legal texts.

patterns.name: Numbers and symbol sequences in math problems
patterns.context: Sequences of numbers, minus signs, operators, and punctuation; some problems involve sorting or base representations.

patterns.name: C++ error handling and buffer code
patterns.context: C++ code structures involving namespaces, error-handling functions, variable declarations, and client read calls.

patterns.name: Personal names and family relationships in narratives
patterns.context: Narrative about Jess's descendants and daughter, and her participation in competitions; names and their possessive forms stand out.

patterns.name: Case citations and docket numbers
patterns.context: Sentences in legal opinions about the precedential effect of cases, containing court-rule citations and docket, document, page, and date fields.

10_2024.concept: 结构化文本中的特殊子串
10_2024.description: 激活覆盖多种结构：代码中的标识符与语法、法律文本中的机构措辞和判例元数据、数学题中的数值符号，以及叙事中的姓名和家族关系；没有明显统一触发特征。

patterns.name: Java 包名中的小写字母序列
patterns.context: 激活集中在包名各部分及分隔符附近；尤其是把连续小写字符切分成子词的标记。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的介词及行政措辞
patterns.context: 出现在行政机构称谓“Administrator”内部，及法律文本中 title、site 等正式措辞附近。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与符号序列
patterns.context: 数值、负号、运算符和标点组成的序列；有的题目涉及排序或进制表示。

patterns.name: C++ 错误处理与缓冲区代码
patterns.context: C++ 中的命名空间、错误处理函数、变量声明和客户端读取调用等代码结构。

patterns.name: 人物姓名与家族关系叙述
patterns.context: Jess 的后代、女儿及其参加比赛等叙述，姓名及其所有格形式突出。

patterns.name: 判例引用与案卷编号
patterns.context: 法律意见中关于判例效力的句子，包含法院规则引用及案卷、文件、页码和日期字段。

en.description: Activations are scattered across Java package-name fragments, parts of proper names, HIV-2 text, and numbers and answers in math problems; they also increase near place names and relationship descriptions in a historical investigation passage, making it difficult to assign a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Java package-name tokenization
patterns.context: Appears in reverse-domain package paths in Java import statements; high activation falls on split identifier fragments, especially «im».

patterns.name: Proper names and internal name fragments
patterns.context: Activation often falls on internal subword fragments of people, places, or works; sometimes these are rare proper names or names with unusual token boundaries. They have no shared semantic role across instances.
patterns.domain: Narrative text, encyclopedia entries, and articles on Tibetan Buddhism

patterns.name: HIV-2-related terms
patterns.context: Concentrated in patent-background passages about HIV-2 infection, viral proteins, and genome sequences; hyphens show particularly strong activation.

patterns.name: Answers and numeric fragments in math problems
patterns.context: Appears across consecutive arithmetic, comparison, equation, or base-arithmetic problems; activation falls on answers, digit-string fragments, and some nearby operators or variables.

patterns.name: British historical place names and family-relationship narratives
patterns.context: In passages speculating about a person's name, parents' marriage location, and relationships with relatives, activation occurs near locations, relationship descriptions, and markers of uncertainty.

10_2024.description: 激活分散在Java包名片段、专名内部、HIV-2文本，以及数学题中的数字和答案；另在历史考证段落的地名与关系描述处增强，难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: Java 包名分词
patterns.context: 出现在 Java import 语句的反向域名包路径中；高激活落在被切分的标识符片段，尤以 «im» 最强。

patterns.name: 专名与名字内部片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在人物、地名或作品名的内部子词片段；有时是罕见或分词边界不寻常的专名。各处没有统一的语义角色。
patterns.domain: 叙事文本、百科条目及藏传佛教相关文章

patterns.name: HIV-2相关词项
patterns.context: 集中出现在关于HIV-2感染、病毒蛋白与基因组序列的专利背景段落；连字符激活尤其强。
patterns.domain: 生物医学 / 专利背景

patterns.name: 数学题的答案与数值片段
patterns.context: 出现在连续的算术、比较、方程或不同进制运算题中；激活落在答案、数字串片段及个别运算符/变量附近。

patterns.name: 英国历史地名与家族关系叙述
patterns.context: 在推测人物姓名、父母婚姻地点及亲友关系的段落中，地点、关系描述和不确定性标记附近均有激活。
patterns.domain: 历史人物考证 / 叙事散文

en.description: Activations are scattered across several kinds of formatted text: arbitrary-base arithmetic problems are most prominent; other examples include legal case-file fields, email subjects and transaction inquiries, sports reporting, Java package names, blog metadata, medical abstracts, and proper names and phrases in a novel entry. There is little commonality.

patterns.name: Arbitrary-base arithmetic problems
patterns.context: Repeated “In base N, what is …?” format asks for arithmetic in a given base, with the answer usually on a separate line; activation also falls on some digits, operators, and answers.

patterns.name: Legal citations and case-file fields
patterns.context: Appears in footers of legal opinions or case-file headers, with formatted fields such as court-rule citations, case numbers, document numbers, page numbers, and filing dates.

patterns.name: Enron email subject and transaction-date inquiry
patterns.context: The email header contains the subject “Missing deal?”, and the body asks for the date of a transaction, with sender, cc, and date information.

patterns.name: University of Maine football and player names
patterns.context: A sports-news-style sentence introduces University of Maine graduates entering the NFL and mentions players and teams; there is also activation within names.

patterns.name: Java package names and import paths
patterns.context: Appears in package/import declarations in Java source code; activation is concentrated on segmented identifiers and package paths rather than ordinary prose.

patterns.name: Blog Atom/RSS metadata
patterns.context: A timestamp is followed by a Blogger profile link, email address, and tag field, matching blog Atom/RSS entry metadata.

patterns.name: Infection rates and Asian names in a medical paper
patterns.context: An abstract on treatment outcomes discusses infection rates among school-age children before and after chemotherapy; activation also involves tokenized fragments of author names.

patterns.name: Novel characters and bibliography entries
patterns.context: Between a novel-character introduction and a bibliography, activation occurs on character names, relationships, crime descriptions, and work/author names.

10_2024.concept: 格式化文本中的局部模式
10_2024.description: 激活分散于多种格式化文本：任意进制算术题最明显；另见法律案卷字段、邮件主题与交易询问、体育报道、Java 包名、博客元数据、医学摘要及小说条目中的专名和短语。共同规律不强。

patterns.name: 任意进制算术题
patterns.trigger: «In» « base» 后接进制数，如 « 14»、« 6»、« 4»、« 5»、« 3»；以及题目中的数位串和 «?»
patterns.context: 在重复出现的“In base N, what is …?”格式中，询问给定进制下的算术运算，答案通常另起一行；激活还落在部分数字、运算符和答案上。

patterns.name: 法律引注与案卷字段
patterns.context: 出现在法律意见书页尾或案卷页眉中，包含法院规则引注、案件号、文件号、页码和提交日期等格式化字段。

patterns.name: Enron 邮件主题与交易日期询问
patterns.trigger: «Subject»«:» «Re»«:» «Missing»« deal»«?»；«what» was the trade date on «this»?
patterns.context: 邮件头中出现“Missing deal?”主题，正文询问某笔交易的日期，并带有发件人、抄送和日期信息。

patterns.name: 缅因大学橄榄球及球员姓名
patterns.context: 体育新闻式句子介绍缅因大学毕业生进入 NFL，并提到球员和球队；姓名内部也有激活。

patterns.name: Java 包名与导入路径
patterns.context: 出现在 Java 源码的 package/import 声明中；激活集中于分段的标识符及包路径，而非普通叙述。

patterns.name: 博客 Atom/RSS 元数据
patterns.context: 时间戳后跟 Blogger 个人资料链接、邮件地址和 tag 字段，符合博客 Atom/RSS 条目元数据格式。

patterns.name: 医学论文中的感染率与亚洲姓名
patterns.context: 治疗效果研究摘要中讨论化疗前后学龄儿童感染率，激活还涉及作者姓名的分词片段。

patterns.name: 小说人物与参考文献条目
patterns.context: 小说人物介绍和参考文献列表之间，人物名、人物关系、犯罪描述及作品/作者名均有激活。

en.description: The most stable pattern is broad activation on URLs, domains, paths, and their Markdown link boundaries; other scattered activations fall on subword fragments, proper names, financial amounts, and dates and numbers in tables, with no single language function tying them together.

patterns.name: URL and domain components
patterns.context: A URL appears in body text, as a link target, or in references; activation often covers multiple consecutive tokens in the URL, including protocol, hostname, path, and punctuation.
patterns.domain: Links and citations in HackerNews, StackExchange, Wikipedia, and other text

patterns.name: Markup and link syntax around URLs
patterns.context: A link is enclosed in Markdown square brackets and parentheses, or appears near a newline or link boundary; this occurs alongside URL activation.
patterns.domain: HackerNews link text and Markdown formatting

patterns.name: English word-ending fragments and in-word substrings
patterns.context: A complete word or an internal word fragment appears in ordinary prose or an entry; trigger positions vary, with no consistent semantic category evident.
patterns.domain: News discussions, narrative articles, lists, etc.

patterns.name: Financial numbers and amount formats
patterns.context: Numbers are split across multiple tokens to form dollar amounts, per-unit prices, or financial forecasts; often accompanied by percentage-like decimal precision.

patterns.name: Dates and numeric columns in aligned tables
patterns.context: Numbers appear in space-aligned columns; dates use the YYYY-MM-DD format and are followed by values.

patterns.name: Proper names and word fragments in lists or headings
patterns.context: Proper names such as people and works, or chapter headings, are split into subword fragments; they have no direct connection to the URL pattern.

patterns.name: Scattered activation on short words and punctuation
patterns.context: Local words or punctuation are marked in sentences, but do not form a stable, repeatable semantic or syntactic pattern.

10_2024.description: 最稳定的模式是对 URL、域名、路径及其 Markdown 链接边界的广泛激活；另有分散激活落在词片段、专名、金融金额和表格日期数字上，难以归为同一语言功能。

patterns.name: URL 与域名组成部分
patterns.context: 网址出现在正文、链接目标或参考资料中；激活往往覆盖 URL 的多个连续 token，包括协议、主机名、路径和标点。
patterns.domain: HackerNews、StackExchange、Wikipedia 等文本中的链接与引用

patterns.name: 网址周围的标记和链接语法
patterns.context: 链接以 Markdown 方括号和括号包裹，或在换行、链接边界附近；与 URL 激活同时出现。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 链接文本及 Markdown 格式

patterns.name: 英文词尾片段与词内子串
patterns.context: 普通正文或条目文本中出现完整词或词内片段；触发位置不固定，未见统一语义类别。
patterns.domain: 新闻讨论、叙述性文章、列表等

patterns.name: 金融数字与金额格式
patterns.context: 数字被拆成多个 token，组成美元金额、每单位价格或财务预测；常伴随百分数式小数精度。

patterns.name: 日期及对齐表格中的数字列
patterns.context: 数字出现在空格对齐的多列数据中，日期采用 YYYY-MM-DD 格式，后接数值。

patterns.name: 列表或标题中的专名与词片段
patterns.context: 人物姓名、作品名或章节标题等专名被拆成词片段；缺乏与 URL 模式的直接联系。

patterns.name: 短小词与标点的零散激活
patterns.context: 局部词语或标点在句子中被标记，但未形成稳定、可重复的语义或句法模式。

en.description: Across domains, activations occur on in-word fragments, split proper names, unusual capitalization, and numbers, punctuation, newlines, and list formatting. Trigger locations vary, with no stable semantic topic.

patterns.name: Cross-fragment subword boundaries within specific words
patterns.context: Activations often fall on fragments within proper names, technical terms, or common words, especially when words are split into multiple tokens; there is no unified rule for word meaning or position.
patterns.domain: Across sports reporting, legal narratives, novel entries, medical papers, patents, place names, and miscellaneous text

patterns.name: Periods and numbering formats
patterns.context: Appears in formats dense with punctuation and numbers, such as abbreviations, bibliographic numbers, section numbers, bracketed citations, or serial numbers.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, patents, web links, and citation formats

patterns.name: Mixed or unusual capitalization and tokenization
patterns.context: Local activations occur in uppercase words, abbreviations, or split proper names; paragraphs also include names tokenized with unusual capitalization.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, legal texts, patent text

patterns.name: Tables and space-separated numbers
patterns.context: Numbers and spaces are arranged in table-like rows, with words interspersed among fields.

patterns.name: Newlines and document-structure markers
patterns.context: Activations occur near newlines, item boundaries, or section headings, but not every structural marker activates consistently.
patterns.domain: Web pages, encyclopedia entries, medical literature, and lists

10_2024.description: 跨多领域激活于词内片段、拆分专名、大小写异常，以及数字、标点、换行和列表格式；触发位置多样，未见稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 特定词内的跨片段子词边界
patterns.context: 激活常落在专名、术语或普通词内部的片段，尤其是词被拆成多个 token 时；但没有统一的词义或位置规则。
patterns.domain: 跨体育报道、司法叙述、小说条目、医学论文、专利、地名及杂项文本

patterns.name: 句点与编号格式
patterns.context: 出现在缩写、文献编号、标题编号、方括号引用或序号等标点和数字密集的格式中。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、专利、网页链接及引用格式

patterns.name: 大小写混合或异常分词
patterns.context: 大写词、缩写或被拆开的专名中出现局部激活；段落中也有大小写异常的姓名分词。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、司法文本、专利文字

patterns.name: 表格与空白分隔数字
patterns.context: 数字和空格排列成类似表格的行，词语夹杂在字段之间。

patterns.name: 换行及文档结构标记
patterns.context: 激活出现在换行、条目边界或章节标题附近，但并非每个结构标记都一致激活。
patterns.domain: 网页、百科条目、医学文献及列表

en.description: Activation is most concentrated on URLs, especially domain subwords in youtu.be links, and also appears in GitHub URLs and paths. Other scattered triggers occur in proper names, ordinary words, and tokenized email-header fragments, with no shared semantic condition across corpora.

patterns.name: YouTube link domain
patterns.context: Appears in URLs pointing to YouTube short links, often preceded by video-introduction text; activation is mainly concentrated on tokenized fragments of youtu.be.

patterns.name: GitHub URLs and code paths
patterns.context: Activation appears in GitHub project links or path/hash strings resembling build artifacts; [1] contains a HipHop PHP project URL, while [4] is dense with paths and identifiers.

patterns.name: Specific words or in-word fragments
patterns.context: These words appear respectively in comments about carbon-fiber looms, workstations, NumPy, and rhythm; triggers are scattered, with no shared semantic condition yet evident.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in place names and proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on capitalization/subword fragments in place, institution, or personal names: Kirkdale, St John, Sessions Road, Orono, Maine, Pat Ricard.

patterns.name: Common words and word fragments in narrative text
patterns.context: Appears in ordinary English phrases in a courtroom narrative, involving hindsight, it was, right thing; there is no obvious context shared with the URL pattern.

patterns.name: Structured fields in email headers
patterns.context: Appears in address, date, time, and sender fields in email headers, with multiple fields split into subwords or numeric fragments.

10_2024.description: 激活最集中于 URL，尤其是 youtu.be 链接中的域名子词，也见 GitHub URL 与路径。另有零散触发分布在专名、普通词及邮件头的分词片段中，跨语料没有统一语义条件。

patterns.name: YouTube 链接域名
patterns.context: 出现在指向 YouTube 短链接的 URL 中，URL 前常有视频介绍文本；主要激活集中在 youtu.be 的分词片段。

patterns.name: GitHub URL 与代码路径
patterns.context: 激活出现在 GitHub 项目链接或看起来像构建产物的路径/哈希字符串中；[1] 包含 HipHop PHP 项目 URL，[4] 是密集的路径与标识符。

patterns.name: 特定词语或词内片段
patterns.context: 这些词分别出现在碳纤维织机、工作站、NumPy 和 rhythm 的评论语境中；触发点零散，尚无共同语义条件。

patterns.name: 地名与专名的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活位于地名、机构名或人名的大小写/子词片段中：Kirkdale、St John、Sessions Road、Orono, Maine、Pat Ricard。

patterns.name: 叙述中的常用词及词片段
patterns.context: 出现在法庭叙述中的普通英语短语，涉及 hindsight、it was、right thing；没有明显与 URL 模式相同的上下文。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的结构化字段
patterns.context: 出现在邮件头的地址、日期、时间和发件人字段中，多个字段被拆成子词或数字片段。

en.concept: Formatting and proper-name fragments in text
en.description: Activations are scattered across URLs and code addresses, proper-name subwords, legal and email formatting, numeric dates, technical/task-management content, and medical terms; they also include song entries and typography markers. No single semantic theme accounts for all passages.

patterns.name: Link and URL fragments
patterns.context: In URLs, hyperlinks, or code project addresses, activation is distributed across URL protocol, domain, and path tokens

patterns.name: Subword fragments within proper names
patterns.context: When a person's name or another proper name is split into multiple tokens, internal fragments activate; this does not occur for every proper name
patterns.domain: News reports, email, local news, encyclopedias

patterns.name: Legal citations and case-number formats
patterns.context: Court-rule citations, case numbers, and document headers in legal text; numbers and formatting markers are interleaved

patterns.name: Email header fields and values
patterns.context: Fields, timestamps, acknowledgment addresses, and recipient information in email headers

patterns.name: Technical names and version/parenthetical markers
patterns.context: Technical project names, implementation names, and abbreviations or version markers in parentheses

patterns.name: Task-management vocabulary
patterns.context: Discussion of writing down tasks, prioritizing them, and putting low-priority tasks in the background

patterns.name: Biochemical drug names and dosages
patterns.context: Drug names are split into multiple fragments, near concentrations and chemical-reaction descriptions

patterns.name: Numerical and date expressions
patterns.context: Numeric expressions composed of years, dates, quantities, and their punctuation

patterns.name: Song categories and multilingual titles
patterns.context: Song titles or lyric-language fragments, and song-category lists in Wikipedia

patterns.name: Short punctuation and typography markers
patterns.context: Newlines, separators, or special markers activate sporadically, possibly related to adjacent formatted content; no stable condition can be determined in isolation

patterns.name: Medical chemistry abbreviations and reaction fragments
patterns.context: Chemical/physiological discussion of arachidonic acid and related products; specific activation points are scattered

patterns.name: Body-text word fragments that do not fit a stable pattern
patterns.context: Appears in ordinary body text in a criminal-trial report, with no specific trigger condition identifiable across passages

10_2024.concept: 文本中的格式与专名片段
10_2024.description: 激活散见于URL和代码地址、专名子词、法律与邮件格式、数字日期、技术/任务管理及医学术语，也包括歌曲条目与排版标记；没有单一语义主题能覆盖全部段落。

patterns.name: 链接与URL片段
patterns.context: 网址、超链接或代码项目地址中，激活分布在URL的协议、域名和路径 token 上

patterns.name: 专名内部的子词片段
patterns.context: 人名或其他专名被分词成多个 token 时，名称内部部分片段激活；并非所有专名都出现
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、邮件、地方新闻、百科

patterns.name: 法律引用及案件编号格式
patterns.context: 法律文本中的法院规则引文、案号和文件页眉；数字与格式标记交错出现

patterns.name: 邮件头字段和值
patterns.context: 邮件头部的字段、时间戳、回执地址及收件人信息

patterns.name: 技术名称与版本/括号标记
patterns.context: 技术项目名称、实现名称及括号中的缩写或版本标记

patterns.name: 任务管理词汇
patterns.context: 讨论将任务写下来、按优先级安排并把低优先级任务置于后台

patterns.name: 生化药物名称及剂量
patterns.context: 药物名称被拆成多个片段，邻近浓度和化学反应描述

patterns.name: 数值与日期表达
patterns.context: 年份、日期、数量及其标点构成的数字表达

patterns.name: 歌曲类别与多语言标题
patterns.context: 歌曲标题或歌词语言片段，及维基百科中歌曲类别列表

patterns.name: 短标点与排版标记
patterns.context: 换行、分隔符或特殊标记零散激活，可能与相邻格式化内容有关，无法单独确定稳定条件

patterns.name: 医学化学缩写与反应片段
patterns.context: 花生四烯酸及相关产物的化学/生理讨论；具体激活点较零散

patterns.name: 未能归入稳定模式的正文词片段
patterns.context: 出现在刑事诉讼报道的普通正文中，缺少跨段可确认的特定触发条件

en.concept: Mixed token fragments and formatting cues
en.description: Activations are scattered across split uppercase abbreviations and proper names, numeric-punctuation sequences, URL fragments, and a few ordinary words and formatting boundaries; no single semantic theme explains all examples.

patterns.name: Numeric chemical formulas/abbreviations and their segmented spellings
patterns.context: Activation falls on several letter fragments of all-caps names or abbreviations, especially when entity names are split into multiple tokens; some examples also contain numbers.
patterns.domain: URLs, email, product documentation, video games, and biomedical text

patterns.name: Coordinates or numeric sequences made of numbers and symbols
patterns.context: Coordinates, identifiers, or values are separated by punctuation and represented as token fragments; activation is concentrated on numbers and adjacent symbols.

patterns.name: Ordinary word fragments in common phrases
patterns.context: In HackerNews text, words occur in everyday expressions about task prioritization, to-do lists, and background processing; there is also «home» in «home»opathic.

patterns.name: Words related to painting media and process
patterns.context: In descriptions of an artist's creative process, words describe painting media or quick sketches.

patterns.name: Word-ending fragments in biological taxonomy names
patterns.context: Appears in Latinized species names in microbiology abstracts, near bacterial species names, phenotypes, and genetic data.

patterns.name: Formatting markers and special boundary tokens
patterns.context: Appears near the ends of HackerNews paragraphs, newlines, and separators; «bent» and «corner» form an unusual concatenated fragment of unclear semantic relation.

patterns.name: Anomalous character-level URL/path fragments
patterns.context: Appears in YouTube short URLs, where the URL is split into characters or short fragments; activation is not limited to complete words.

patterns.name: Item-number tokens that do not fit a clear pattern
patterns.context: Near an isolated number in a Wikipedia references section; context is insufficient to determine whether the trigger relates to numbering, formatting, or something else.

10_2024.concept: 混合的 token 片段与格式线索
10_2024.description: 激活分散于被切分的大写缩写与专名、数字标点序列、网址片段，以及少数普通词和格式边界；没有单一语义主题能解释全部样本。

patterns.name: 数字化学式/缩写及其分段拼写
patterns.context: 激活落在全大写名称或缩写的若干字母片段上，尤其是实体名称被切分成多个 token 时；有些例子同时包含数字。
patterns.domain: 网址、邮件、产品文档、电子游戏与生物医学文本

patterns.name: 数字与符号构成的坐标或数值序列
patterns.context: 坐标、编号或数值被标点分隔并以 token 片段呈现；激活集中在数字及邻近符号。
patterns.domain: 学术论文中的坐标/数学列表

patterns.name: 常见短语中的普通词片段
patterns.context: HackerNews 文字中，词语出现在关于任务优先级、待办事项和后台处理的日常表达里；另有 «home»opathic 中的 «home»。

patterns.name: 画作媒介与绘画步骤相关词
patterns.context: 介绍艺术家创作过程时，词语描述绘画媒介或快速草图。

patterns.name: 生物分类名称中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 出现在微生物学摘要的拉丁化物种名称中，邻近菌种名、表型和遗传数据。

patterns.name: 格式标记与特殊边界 token
patterns.context: 出现在 HackerNews 段落末尾、换行与分隔符附近；«bent»和«corner»形成异常的拼接片段，语义关联不明。
patterns.domain: 论坛文本及语料格式边界

patterns.name: 异常字符级网址/路径片段
patterns.context: 出现在 YouTube 短网址中，URL 被拆成字符或短片段；激活不只落在完整词上。

patterns.name: 无法归入明确模式的项目编号 token
patterns.context: 位于维基百科参考文献区的孤立编号附近；上下文不足以确定编号、格式或其他触发条件。

en.description: Activations are distributed across technical terms and code, legal citations, art bibliographies, task discussions, music performances, medical statistics, and epidemic narratives, and also occur on URLs, proper names, numbers, and tokenized word fragments; the examples lack a shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: PHP/HipHop code and links
patterns.context: Mentions Facebook's open-source PHP implementation and includes a GitHub wiki link; activations are scattered across technical terms and URL tokens

patterns.name: Legal citations and docket fields
patterns.context: Federal appellate procedure rule citations and fields, numbers, and dates in court docket headers

patterns.name: Museums, art catalogs, and names
patterns.context: Art institutions, publications, and artist names appear in bibliographic-style entries

patterns.name: C header files and parameter descriptions
patterns.context: Code comments explain parameter conventions, followed by a C preprocessor header guard macro

patterns.name: Task lists and priorities
patterns.context: Discusses moving less important tasks to the background and recording tasks at the forefront of one's mind

patterns.name: Genode documentation link
patterns.context: A reply expresses thanks and mentions a Genode system article and developer resource link

patterns.name: Performances and musicians' names
patterns.context: Describes a live performance and mentions people such as Caleb, Elton, and Kenny Metcalf

patterns.name: Surgical group and duration statistics
patterns.context: Compares surgical times between two groups, reporting ranges and durations in minutes

patterns.name: Phrase and video URL
patterns.context: The phrase “homeopathic accident and emergency” is followed by a YouTube short link

patterns.name: SARS epidemic and hotel transmission chain
patterns.context: Describes the international spread of the SARS epidemic, case links, and a hotel that had been visited

10_2024.description: 激活分布于技术术语与代码、法律引文、艺术书目、任务讨论、音乐演出、医学统计和疫情叙述，也落在 URL、专名、数字及被切分的词片上；各段缺少共同语义触发条件。

patterns.name: PHP/HipHop 代码与链接
patterns.context: 提及 Facebook 的开源 PHP 实现，并附 GitHub wiki 链接；激活分散在技术名词和 URL token 上

patterns.name: 法律引文及案卷字段
patterns.context: 联邦上诉程序规则引文及法院案卷页眉中的字段、编号和日期

patterns.name: 博物馆、艺术目录与姓名
patterns.context: 艺术机构、出版物及艺术家姓名出现在书目式条目中

patterns.name: C 头文件与参数说明
patterns.context: 代码注释说明参数约定，随后出现 C 预处理器头文件保护宏

patterns.name: 任务清单与优先级
patterns.context: 讨论把较不重要的任务移到后台，以及记录脑中优先考虑的任务

patterns.name: Genode 文档链接
patterns.context: 回复中感谢信息，并提到 Genode 系统文章及开发者资源链接

patterns.name: 演出与音乐人姓名
patterns.context: 叙述现场演出，提到 Caleb、Elton 与 Kenny Metcalf 等人

patterns.name: 手术组别与时长统计
patterns.context: 比较两个组别的手术时间，以范围和分钟单位报告结果

patterns.name: 短语与视频网址
patterns.context: 短语“homeopathic accident and emergency”后跟 YouTube 短链接

patterns.name: SARS 疫情与酒店传播链
patterns.context: 描述 SARS 疫情的国际传播、病例关联及曾到访的酒店

en.description: Activations often occur in structured strings: numeric identifiers, phone numbers and dates, URLs/file paths, markup syntax, and tokenized proper names; they frequently occur in areas dense with punctuation and boundaries. A few ordinary-word activations and cross-domain content indicate that this is not a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Numbers, identifiers, and formatted labels
patterns.context: Numeric sequences occur in phone numbers, dates/case numbers/document page numbers, code line numbers, or statistics; they are often accompanied by structured boundaries such as punctuation, hyphens, or spaces.
patterns.domain: Email, legal documents, code listings, news text

patterns.name: Segmented spellings in proper names
patterns.context: A proper name or word string is split into multiple subword tokens; examples include personal, institutional, project, or product names, with token boundaries sometimes falling within words.
patterns.domain: Email, technology discussions, academic papers, art catalogs

patterns.name: URL and path-like locator strings
patterns.context: Activation appears in links, repository paths, or file paths, especially long locator strings made of slashes, periods, underscores, hyphens, and alphanumeric fragments.
patterns.domain: Web links, software repositories, and code files

patterns.name: Document structure and markup syntax
patterns.context: Formatted text contains section references, Markdown images/captions, anchors, or newline boundary markers; these occur alongside numeric identifiers and short consecutive tokens.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, Markdown transcriptions of medical papers

patterns.name: Dutch and art-institution names
patterns.context: Catalog-style text contains Dutch place and institution names, personal names, and publication information, with proper names and compound words split into subwords.

patterns.name: Email headers and contact information
patterns.context: Near email header fields and recipient contact information, email addresses, names, and dates use structured formats.

patterns.name: Author citations in academic narrative
patterns.context: In paper body text about movement, memory, and research findings, author surnames are split and adjacent to literature-citation markers.

patterns.name: Scattered words in ordinary sentences
patterns.context: Common function words or ordinary phrases appear in news-report sentences, without an obvious proper-name, link, or identifier structure.

10_2024.concept: 结构化字符串与分词边界
10_2024.description: 激活多见于结构化字符串：数字编号、电话与日期、URL/文件路径、标记语法，以及被拆分的专名；常位于标点和边界密集处。少数普通词激活及不同领域内容表明并非单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 数字、编号与格式化标识
patterns.context: 数字序列处于电话号码、日期/案号/文档页码、代码行号或统计数字中；常伴随标点、连字符、空格等结构化边界。
patterns.domain: 邮件、法律文件、代码清单、新闻文本

patterns.name: 专名中的分段拼写
patterns.context: 专名或词串被拆成多个子词 token；包含人名、机构名、项目名或产品名，分词边界可能落在词内部。
patterns.domain: 邮件、科技讨论、学术论文、艺术目录

patterns.name: URL及路径型定位字符串
patterns.context: 激活出现在链接、仓库路径或文件路径内，尤其是由斜杠、点号、下划线、连字符和字母数字片段构成的长定位字符串。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、软件仓库和代码文件

patterns.name: 文档结构与标记语法
patterns.context: 格式化文本中出现章节引用、Markdown 图片/图注、锚点或换行等边界标记；与数字编号及短 token 连续出现。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、医学论文的 Markdown 转录

patterns.name: 荷兰语及艺术机构名称
patterns.context: 目录式文本中出现荷兰地名、机构名、人名及出版信息，专名和复合词被切分成子词。

patterns.name: 邮件头和联系信息
patterns.context: 邮件头字段与收件人联系信息附近，邮箱、姓名和日期采用结构化格式。

patterns.name: 学术叙述中的作者引用
patterns.context: 关于运动、记忆与研究发现的论文正文中，作者姓氏被拆分，且邻接文献引用标记。

patterns.name: 普通句子中的零散词语
patterns.context: 新闻报道句子中出现常见功能词或普通搭配，缺少明显的专名、链接或编号结构。

en.description: Activations are distributed across segmented fragments in strings such as URLs, domains, and emails, and also occur in product names, patent numbers, proper names, medical figure-caption markers, and long number strings; the commonality is mainly local tokens in specially formatted strings rather than a single topic.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in URL/domain structures
patterns.context: Activations fall on tokenized letter fragments in domains or URLs; these include hostnames, paths, filenames, or email addresses and often occur with punctuation and numbers.
patterns.domain: Email headers, web links, technical forums

patterns.name: COOLPIX product name
patterns.context: The product name COOLPIX appears in model details and product-page text, with activations concentrated on letter fragments in the name.

patterns.name: Metropole hotel name
patterns.context: In an account of the Hong Kong SARS event, the place name Metropole Hotel is split into multiple tokens; activations are especially concentrated at the start of the name.

patterns.name: Stoop name fragment
patterns.context: The artist Peter Stoop's name appears in biographical text, with activations concentrated on the initial fragment of the surname.

patterns.name: Patent-number format
patterns.context: A Japanese patent publication number consists of a Sho era designation, digits, and hyphens; activation is strongly concentrated on the final numeric token.

patterns.name: Medical figure captions and image markers
patterns.context: In Markdown-style medical figure captions, image links, and figure-number markers, activations occur near newlines, caption text, and file identifiers.

patterns.name: Number strings and numeric answers
patterns.context: In math Q&A, long numbers are split into consecutive tokens; questions involve integer comparisons or equations, and answer digits activate strongly.

10_2024.concept: 格式化字符串片段识别
10_2024.description: 激活分布于网址、域名、邮箱等字符串的分段片段，也出现在产品名、专利号、专名、医学图注标记和长数字串；共同点主要是特殊格式字符串中的局部 token，而非单一主题。

patterns.name: URL/域名结构中的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在域名或网址中被分词的字母片段上；包含主机名、路径、文件名或邮箱地址，常伴随标点和数字。
patterns.domain: 邮件头、网页链接、技术论坛

patterns.name: COOLPIX 产品名
patterns.context: 产品名 COOLPIX 在型号及产品页面文字中出现，激活集中于名称的字母片段。

patterns.name: Metropole 酒店名称
patterns.context: 香港 SARS 事件叙述中，地点名 Metropole Hotel 被拆分为多个 token；激活尤其集中于名称开头。

patterns.name: Stoop 姓名片段
patterns.context: 艺术家 Peter Stoop 的姓名出现在传记文字中，激活集中于姓氏开头片段。

patterns.name: 专利编号格式
patterns.context: 日本专利公告编号以 Sho 年代号、数字和连字符组成，激活强烈集中在编号末尾数字 token。

patterns.name: 医学图注与图像标记
patterns.context: Markdown 风格的医学图注、图片链接及图号标记中，换行、图注文本和文件标识附近均有激活。

patterns.name: 数字串及数值答案
patterns.context: 数学问答中，长数字被拆成连续 token；问题包含整数比较或算式，答案数字部分激活较强。

en.description: Most passages activate when send/sending is followed by a recipient or content, covering email, legal instructions, spam, text messages, and access-control signals; there are also three local exceptions: send meaning “take children,” ros in atherosclerotic, and COMM in RECOMMENDED.

patterns.name: send meaning to transmit or mail
patterns.context: send is followed by a recipient or content being sent, often with to; includes infinitive, base, and participle forms.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, email, technical explanations, narrative text

patterns.name: Embedded morphological fragment of send
patterns.context: Occurs in “who send their children to ...”, where send means taking children to school; activation is slightly weaker due to context.

patterns.name: ros substring in a proper noun
patterns.context: Occurs inside the medical term “atherosclerotic disease,” not as an independent sense of sending.

patterns.name: Fragment of an uppercase column label
patterns.context: Occurs in all-uppercase, page-like formatting labels on FreeLaw.

10_2063.description: 多数段落在 send/sending 后接收件人或内容时激活，涵盖邮件、法律指令、垃圾邮件、短信及门禁信号；另有 send 表“送孩子”、atherosclerotic 中的 ros、RECOMMENDED 中的 COMM 两个局部例外。

patterns.name: send 表示发送或寄送
patterns.context: send 后接收件对象或发送内容，常与 to 连用；包括不定式、原形和分词形式。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、邮件、技术说明、叙述性文本

patterns.name: send 的嵌入式形态片段
patterns.context: 出现在“who send their children to ...”中，send 表示送孩子去学校；受上下文影响，激活强度略低。

patterns.name: 专名中的 ros 子串
patterns.context: 出现在医学术语“atherosclerotic disease”内部，并非独立的发送词义。

patterns.name: 大写栏目标签片段
patterns.context: 出现在 FreeLaw 页面式的全大写排版标签中。

en.concept: Sending actions and sporadic subword fragments
en.description: The main pattern is the word form send, appearing in contexts involving sending files, letters, or messages, as well as spam, signals, and network packets. There are also the legal layout term COMM and the substring the within the medical word atherosclerotic.

patterns.name: send followed by an object or destination
patterns.context: send is followed by a person, file, letter, text, message, packet, or signal in different syntactic positions; this pattern occurs across multiple domains.
patterns.domain: Business email, legal documents, cybersecurity, patents, medical texts

patterns.name: Recommended for full-text publication label
patterns.context: Appears in the uppercase layout label «RECOMMENDED FOR FULL-TEXT PUBL» as document classification or layout text.

patterns.name: Substring within a medical term
patterns.context: Activation falls on the split medical word «A»«the»«ros»«clerotic»; this is an internal fragment of atherosclerotic, not an independent article.

10_2063.concept: 发送动作及偶发词片段
10_2063.description: 主模式是词形 send，出现在寄送文件、信件或消息，以及发送垃圾邮件、信号、网络数据包等语境；另有法律版面词 COMM 和医学词 atherosclerotic 内部的 the 子串。

patterns.name: send 后接对象或目的地
patterns.context: send 在不同句法位置中后接人、文件、信件、文本、消息、数据包或信号；此模式跨多个领域出现。
patterns.domain: 商业邮件、法律文书、网络安全、专利、医学文本

patterns.name: 推荐全文出版标记
patterns.context: 出现在大写的版面标签 «RECOMMENDED FOR FULL-TEXT PUBL» 中，属于文档分类或排版文本。

patterns.name: 医学术语内部子串
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的医学词 «A»«the»«ros»«clerotic» 中；即 atherosclerotic 的词内片段，而非独立冠词。

en.concept: send word form and fragment matching
en.description: Most passages activate strongly on send/send­ing when it means transmitting content or a signal; objects and domains vary. There are also internal substring overlaps and activation on END in RECOMMENDED-like strings, which cannot reliably be grouped under a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: send: verb of sending/transmitting
patterns.context: The verb send appears in sentences about conveying something to a person, organization, system, or destination; objects include files, letters, spam, packets, text messages, signals, and copies.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, business email, cybersecurity, patents, narrative text

patterns.name: send substring across word boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on the complete English word send and on internal fragments of other words; this may reflect subword/token fragment overlap and does not establish semantic triggering conditions.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, Hungarian film title lists

patterns.name: Special ending marker
patterns.context: Appears in an uppercase segmented string such as «RE»«COMM»«END»«ED»; unlike ordinary uses of send.
patterns.domain: Formatting or marker strings in legal texts

10_2063.description: 多数段在 send/send­ing 表示传送内容或信号时强激活，宾语和领域多样；另有词内片段重合及 RECOMMENDED 式字符串中的 END 激活，无法可靠归入同一语义规律。

patterns.name: send：发送/传递动词
patterns.context: 动词 send 位于表达把东西传给某人、机构、系统或目的地的句子中；宾语包括文件、信件、垃圾邮件、数据包、文本消息、信号及副本。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、商务邮件、网络安全、专利、叙事文本

patterns.name: 跨词边界的 send 子串
patterns.context: 激活落在英语 send 的完整词形中，也落在其他词的词内片段上；该现象可能反映子词/token 片段重合，不能据此确定其语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、匈牙利语片名列表

patterns.name: 特殊结束标记
patterns.context: 出现在类似 «RE»«COMM»«END»«ED» 的大写分段字符串中；与普通词语 send 的语境不同。
patterns.domain: 法律文本中的格式或标记字符串

en.description: Activations are scattered across some proper nouns, medical terms (especially word forms split into multiple parts), official titles, and legal title formatting; the commonality is unclear, and some activations may be related to specific within-word token fragments.

patterns.name: Word form “Montenegrins”
patterns.context: The word is split into multiple subword tokens; one instance is followed immediately by “in Germany”, and the next line repeats the word form followed by “living in”.

patterns.name: Cros- string in a proper noun
patterns.context: The name Crosby’s is followed by “vow: No repeating '13”; activation falls on a token fragment of the name.

patterns.name: Proteinuria word form
patterns.context: The word appears in a medical sentence, followed by a note that the adult also has bisalbuminemia.

patterns.name: Atherosclerosis word form
patterns.context: The disease name occurs in medical contexts such as definitions, precursors, or lower-extremity disease; includes noun and adjective forms.

patterns.name: Official title
patterns.context: Appears as an official title in a parenthetical note about New South Wales.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia political figure or office entries

patterns.name: Plasmid-related word form
patterns.context: The beginning of the phrase Plasmid-associated aggregation.
patterns.domain: PubMed microbiology or molecular biology abstracts

patterns.name: Plasmodium genus name
patterns.context: The complete genus name is followed by berghei, in a context involving mouse infection and Anopheles mosquitoes.

patterns.name: Court of appeals decision formatting
patterns.context: Centered, all-uppercase headings and formatted blank lines in court documents.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal court of appeals legal documents

10_2063.description: 激活分散于若干专名、医学术语（尤见多段拆分的词形）、官职及法律标题版式；共同点不明确，部分激活可能与词内特定分词片段有关。

patterns.name: “Montenegrins”词形
patterns.context: 词被拆成多个子词 token；一次紧接“in Germany”，下一行重复词形并接“living in”。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人口或居住地描述

patterns.name: 专名中的 Cros- 字串
patterns.context: 姓名 Crosby’s 后接 “vow: No repeating '13”；激活落在姓名的分词片段上。
patterns.domain: 网页文本，具体文体不明

patterns.name: 蛋白尿词形
patterns.context: 医学句子中出现该词，随后说明成人同时有 bisalbuminemia。

patterns.name: 动脉粥样硬化词形
patterns.context: 该病名出现在定义、前驱因素或下肢疾病等医学语境；包括名词和形容词形式。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、NIH 医学文本

patterns.name: 官职名称
patterns.context: 作为新南威尔士州括号说明中的官职名称出现。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 政治人物或职务条目

patterns.name: Plasmid 相关词形
patterns.context: Plasmid-associated aggregation 一词的开头。
patterns.domain: PubMed 微生物或分子生物学摘要

patterns.name: 疟原虫属名
patterns.context: 完整属名后接 berghei，涉及小鼠感染及按蚊。

patterns.name: 法院上诉判决版式
patterns.context: 法院文件中居中、全大写的标题和格式化空白行。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院法律文书

en.concept: Scientific abstract titles and specialized terminology
en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly in the titles or opening sentences of scientific abstracts, especially medical and life-science proper terms, research topics, analytical and detection methods, and the period and newline at the end of titles. Locations and title structures also occur.

patterns.name: Period and newline at the end of an abstract title
patterns.context: Activation often spans words in the title and peaks at the period that ends it; the abstract body after the newline usually remains weakly activated.
patterns.domain: Primarily PubMed abstracts; also NIH ExPorter

patterns.name: Medical or biological terminology
patterns.context: Specialized terms and adjacent words in medical and biological titles often activate in clusters, spanning diseases, pathogens, tissues, tests, and clinical cases.
patterns.domain: Medical and life-science abstracts, research project descriptions

patterns.name: Quantitative analysis and detection methods
patterns.context: Appears in contexts involving measurement, analysis, detection, or experimental methods; some titles begin directly with an analytical method.

patterns.name: Explicit geographic locations
patterns.context: Titles identify the country or region where the study population or site is located; only two examples appear, so it is unclear whether location itself is a shared trigger.

patterns.name: Topic–result or purpose statements in titles
patterns.context: Titles or opening sentences use structures such as of, for, and as to link a research topic with significance, a prediction target, or a function.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial prepositional phrase
patterns.context: A prepositional phrase introduces the research topic, followed by tools and testing methods; there is only one example, which may be unrelated to the other title activations.

10_2063.concept: 科研摘要标题与专业术语
10_2063.description: 激活主要集中于科研摘要的标题或首句，尤其是医学与生命科学专名、研究主题、分析检测方法，以及标题末尾句点和换行；另见地点和标题句式。

patterns.name: 摘要标题末尾句点及换行
patterns.trigger: 标题或摘要首句末尾的「.»」以及紧随其后的「↵」
patterns.context: 激活常覆盖标题中的词语，并在标题结束的句点处达到高值；换行后摘要正文通常仍有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: 以 PubMed 摘要为主，也见 NIH ExPorter

patterns.name: 医学或生物学专业词汇
