patterns.context: 医学、生物学标题中的专门术语及其相邻词语常成片激活；覆盖疾病、病原体、组织、检测和临床病例等不同主题。
patterns.domain: 医学与生命科学摘要、研究项目描述

patterns.name: 定量分析与检测方法
patterns.context: 涉及测量、分析、检测或实验方法时出现；有些标题直接以分析方法开头。
patterns.domain: 生物医学及材料/工程研究摘要

patterns.name: 明确地理地点
patterns.context: 标题指出研究对象或研究地点所在国家、地区；目前只见两例，不能确定地点本身是否是共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 流行病学或病例/疾病研究摘要

patterns.name: 标题中的主题—结果或用途表述
patterns.trigger: 「Taxonomic implications of」「prediction of seasonal allergy」「responsible for anion transport」「alternative to mechanical approach」
patterns.context: 标题或首句以 of、for、as 等结构关联研究主题、意义、预测对象或功能。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要及科研文本

patterns.name: 句首介词结构
patterns.context: 以介词短语引出研究主题，随后出现工具和测试方法；只有一个例子，可能与其他标题激活无关。

en.concept: Det word onset and document formatting features
en.description: Most passages begin with Det in paper titles, mainly Detection, with one instance of Detailed; the first passage instead responds to spaces, line breaks, and uppercase formatting in a legal document header, a different triggering mechanism.

patterns.name: Detection word onset
patterns.context: “Detection” is split into Det + ection, and the neuron responds strongly to the initial Det; it is often followed by of or and, forming research-title-like phrases.

patterns.name: Detailed word onset
patterns.context: “Detailed” is split into Det + ailed and appears in the title-like phrase “Detailed analysis of the insertion site...”; it may share an onset trigger with Detection, but the following text differs.

patterns.name: Legal document header and formatting
patterns.context: Large spaces and line breaks, an uppercase court-name header, the file marker “FILED”, and the header abbreviation “FE”; activation is distributed over whitespace and formatting structure rather than an obvious Det onset.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal court of appeals legal documents

10_2063.concept: Det 词首及文书排版特征
10_2063.description: 多数段落在论文标题中以 Det 起始，主要是 Detection，另有 Detailed；第1段则响应法律文书页眉中的空格、换行和大写排版，触发方式不同。

patterns.name: Detection 词首
patterns.context: “Detection”被拆分为 Det + ection，神经元强烈响应词首 Det；后续多接 of 或 and，形成研究标题式短语。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题或摘要

patterns.name: Detailed 词首
patterns.context: “Detailed”被拆分为 Det + ailed，出现在“Detailed analysis of the insertion site...”这一标题式表达中；可能与 Detection 共享词首触发，但后续词不同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题或摘要

patterns.name: 法律文书页眉与排版
patterns.context: 大段空格及换行、法院名称大写页眉、文件标记“FILED”及页眉缩写“FE”；激活分布在空白和排版结构上，而非明显的 Det 词首。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院法律文书

en.description: Primarily responds to hyphen-introduced long- compounds, commonly long-term, and also long-baseline and long-range, across physics, life sciences, and medical texts. It also activates strongly on “12” in a mathematical formula, which is difficult to relate to the main pattern.

patterns.name: long hyphenated compounds
patterns.context: The trigger position is often between long- and the following word; following words include “baseline”, “term”, and “range”, with some examples spanning tokens.
patterns.domain: Physics abstracts, life science papers, and medical abstracts/papers

patterns.name: Number 12 in a mathematical expression
patterns.context: Occurs in the formula fragment “- 12 = 3*z.”, with no nearby long- compound.

10_2063.description: 主要响应连字符引出的 long- 复合词，常见 long-term，也包括 long-baseline、long-range；跨物理、生命科学和医学文本。另对数学公式中的“12”有强激活，难与主模式联系。

patterns.name: long 连字符复合词
patterns.trigger: “long” 后接连字符（如 “long-”）并构成复合词
patterns.context: 触发位置多在 long- 与后续词之间；后续词包括 “baseline”“term”“range”，部分例子跨 token。

patterns.name: 数学表达中的数字 12
patterns.context: 出现在公式片段 “- 12 = 3*z.” 中，附近没有 long- 复合词。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to “to” in hyphen-separated phrases in URL slugs, across news, technology, and general webpage titles; also includes a range expression in a code comment and activation on “186” in repeated numbering, the latter two possibly incidental or accompanying features.

patterns.name: Hyphen-separated “to” in URL slugs

patterns.name: Loop range in a code comment

patterns.name: High-numbered index in repeated numbered entries
patterns.context: One number fragment in a sequence of repeated entry numbers shows the strongest activation; no obvious to structure is present.

patterns.name: Non-salient or irregular triggers
patterns.context: Activation fragments include sporadic words, URL characters, or repeated entries, making stable conditions difficult to determine from the given text.

10_2063.description: 主要对 URL slug 中连字符分隔词组里的“to”强烈响应，跨新闻、技术与一般网页标题；另有代码注释中的范围表达及重复编号中的“186”激活，后两者可能是伴随或偶发特征。

patterns.name: URL slug中的连字符分词“to”

patterns.name: 代码注释中的循环范围

patterns.name: Punctuation, spaces, and special formatting boundaries

patterns.name: Organization names and subject fragments in public records

patterns.name: Sporadic hits unexplained by a unified pattern

10_2063.description: 激活分布于结构边界与格式标记、特定邮件/配置/代码/专利字段，也命中“at least”及 FARM BUREAU；跨领域，未见单一语义触发。

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across words or internal fragments such as normally, organically, usually, operationally, systematically, ever, and breast. Apart from a few adverbs in medical texts and breast cancer terminology, there is no unified semantic or domain pattern.

patterns.name: breast

patterns.context: Appear separately in an institutional/possessive expression and an anatomical term; no clear shared contextual condition.

10_2063.concept: 含 ever 的词与零散词汇触发
10_2063.description: 最明确的重复线索是 ever 字母序列，见于 only ever、evergreen、everolimus。另有 already、normally、radiologically、really 等不同副词及 university’s、dorsi 的孤立高激活，难以归为统一语义模式。

patterns.name: ever 子串
patterns.context: 字母序列 ever 出现在独立副词、单词开头或药名中；不要求特定语义或领域。
patterns.domain: 问答、商务邮件、医学文本

patterns.name: 高激活副词
patterns.context: 不同语境中的副词；没有明显共享的语义条件，可能是独立的词汇触发。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、医学摘要、硬件讨论

patterns.name: 其他零散高激活词
patterns.context: 分别出现在机构/所有格表述和解剖学术语中；无明显共同上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 神经外科论文、医学病例

en.description: Activation cues are scattered: many hits involve normally and nearby words, while others involve numerical quantities, osteochondral medical vocabulary, code identifiers, and domain-specific expressions. Short function words are also often marked, but no unified semantic trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: normally / normally functioning
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences describing perfused myocardium, cell function after gene therapy, or myelin status; activation is concentrated on normally or its neighboring subwords.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, abstracts, and popular science text

patterns.name: Numbers and quantities
patterns.context: Numbers appear in specific quantities such as memory size, bone-cutting dimensions, or mailbox capacity; activation is distributed across the numbers and adjacent numeric subwords.

patterns.name: Bone- and cartilage-related medical vocabulary
patterns.context: Involves bone cutting, bone microstructure, cartilage repair, and related tissue or surgical content; activation often falls on internal subwords of related long words or nearby words.

patterns.name: Operational words or identifiers in computer code
patterns.context: Occurs in memory allocation APIs or Java GUI initialization code, with identifiers often in camel case or snake case.

patterns.name: Descriptions of nerve or tissue damage
patterns.context: Describes neuropathological changes after local injection and compares them with normal myelinated regions.

patterns.name: Breast cancer treatment data
patterns.context: Data collection and survival analysis involve patients and different treatment regimens.

patterns.name: Automatically generated mailbox capacity warning
patterns.context: Notifies users that their mailbox is nearing its capacity limit and gives the current usage.

patterns.name: Repair and regeneration statements in patents
patterns.context: Patent background describes a system for repairing damaged articular cartilage.

patterns.name: Grammatical connectors and adjacent punctuation
patterns.context: These short words are marked in sentences across multiple domains, possibly due to adjacent word boundaries, punctuation, or tokenization positions; on their own, they do not form a stable semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: GUI window layout and display
patterns.context: Code sets a window layout, adds panels, resizes the window, and displays it.

10_2063.description: 激活线索分散：多处命中 normally 及其邻近词，另有数字量值、骨软骨医学词汇、代码标识符和各类领域专属表达。短功能词也常被标记，但目前看不出统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: normally / normally functioning
patterns.context: 出现在描述灌注心肌、基因治疗后细胞功能或髓鞘状态的句子中；激活位置集中在 normally 或其相邻子词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、摘要及科普文本

patterns.name: 数字与量值
patterns.context: 数字出现在内存大小、骨切割尺寸或邮箱容量等具体量值中；激活分布在数值及相邻数字子词。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、医学摘要、电子邮件

patterns.name: 骨与软骨相关医学词汇
patterns.context: 涉及骨切割、骨微结构、软骨修复等组织或手术内容；激活多落在相关长词的内部子词或邻近词。

patterns.name: 电脑代码中的操作词或标识符
patterns.context: 出现在内存分配 API 或 Java GUI 初始化代码中，标识符常以驼峰或下划线形式出现。

patterns.name: 神经或组织损伤描述
patterns.context: 描述局部注射后的神经组织病理变化，并与正常髓鞘区域对照。

patterns.name: 乳腺癌治疗数据
patterns.context: 数据收集与生存分析涉及患者及不同治疗方案。

patterns.name: 自动生成的邮箱容量警告
patterns.context: 通知用户邮箱接近容量上限，并给出当前占用量。

patterns.name: 专利中的修复与再生表述
patterns.context: 专利背景描述用于修复受损关节软骨的系统。

patterns.name: 语法连接词及标点邻接
patterns.trigger: «),»、« and»、« of»、« to» 等短功能词
patterns.context: 这些短词在多个领域的句子中被标记，可能与邻接的词界、标点或分词位置有关，单独看不构成稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: GUI 窗口布局与显示
patterns.context: 代码设置窗口布局、添加面板、调整大小并显示窗口。

en.description: Activation is primarily on the English string end, especially in medical terms such as endocardium, endplate, end point, and endocortical; it also covers several ordinary words containing the letter sequence end. Other sporadic patterns include Java’s toByteArray, always-on, and internal fragments of Polish words.

patterns.name: end morpheme in anatomical or medical terms
patterns.context: Appears within specialized terms or at word boundaries; activation centers on end and the following morpheme, and does not necessarily mean the end of a sentence or an ending.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, involving myocardium, intervertebral discs, valves, and bone tissue

patterns.name: end substring in other English words
patterns.context: The relevant words contain the letter sequence end, but their meanings and syntactic positions vary; these may also be sporadic highlights.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, medical mesh descriptions, patent backgrounds

patterns.name: to in a Java method call
patterns.context: The Java toByteArray method converts a ByteArrayOutputStream to a byte array.

patterns.name: always in an always-on phrase
patterns.context: Describes an always-on display in wearable device or phone feature descriptions.

patterns.name: Polish surname ending
patterns.context: An internal letter fragment is marked in a Polish political institution’s name; this differs from the English morpheme pattern.

10_2063.description: 主要在英文字符串 end 上激活，尤其是医学术语中的 endocardium、endplate、end point、endocortical；也覆盖若干含 end 字母序列的普通词。另有 Java 的 toByteArray、always-on 和波兰语词内片段等零散模式。

patterns.name: 解剖或医学术语中的 end 词素
patterns.context: 出现在专业术语内部或词边界处；激活集中于 end 及其后的词素，未必表示句末或结束
patterns.domain: 生物医学，涉及心肌、椎间盘、瓣膜和骨组织

patterns.name: 其他英文词中的 end 子串
patterns.context: 相关词含有 end 字母序列，但语义和句法位置各异；也可能只是零散高亮
patterns.domain: 技术问答、医学网格描述、专利背景

patterns.name: Java 方法调用中的 to
patterns.context: Java 代码中将 ByteArrayOutputStream 转为字节数组的 toByteArray 方法

patterns.name: always-on 短语中的 always
patterns.context: 穿戴设备或手机功能介绍中描述常亮显示

patterns.name: 波兰语人名词尾
patterns.context: 波兰语政治机构名称中，词内字母片段被标记；与英文词素模式不同

en.concept: Operations and changes in technical text
en.description: The clearest trigger pattern is method calls involving set/conversion in code, especially Android image, UI, and graphics APIs. Other examples concern memory alignment, layout occlusion, myocardial perfusion, and two independent patent texts on semiconductor wafers and cartilage repair.

patterns.name: Method calls and property setting in code
patterns.context: Trigger words occur in method names or call chains in code identifiers, especially when an object is used to set properties such as images, values, or graphics contexts.
patterns.domain: Android, Java, Python, and other code; technical Q&A

patterns.name: Word width and memory alignment
patterns.context: Technical questions about 32/64-bit systems, contiguous memory allocation, and data alignment.

patterns.name: Android layout and screen content
patterns.context: Describes Android UI content in a scroll view being obscured by the navigation bar and discusses layout parameters.

patterns.name: Myocardial perfusion and cardiac anatomy terminology
patterns.context: A medical abstract discusses myocardial blood flow and perfusion changes in different regions.

patterns.name: Increasing wafer diameter
patterns.context: Describes circular wafers made from ingots and the industry trend toward increasing their diameter.

patterns.name: Cartilage repair patent language
patterns.context: Patent background describes an absorbable cartilage repair system and its repair objectives.
patterns.domain: Patent background; biomaterials and medical devices

10_2063.concept: 技术文本中的操作与变化
10_2063.description: 最明显的触发模式是代码中的 set/转换类方法调用，尤见 Android 图像、界面和图形 API；另有内存对齐、布局遮挡、心肌灌注，以及两段各自独立的半导体晶圆和软骨修复专利文本。

patterns.name: 代码中的方法调用与属性设置
patterns.context: 触发词出现在代码标识符的方法名或调用链中，尤其是对象设置图像、数值、图形上下文等属性时。
patterns.domain: Android、Java、Python 等程序代码及技术问答

patterns.name: 位宽与内存对齐
patterns.context: 围绕 32/64 位系统、连续内存分配及数据对齐提出技术问题。
patterns.domain: 计算机系统与内存管理问答

patterns.name: Android 布局与屏幕内容
patterns.context: 描述 Android 界面中导航栏遮挡滚动视图内容，并讨论布局参数。

patterns.name: 心肌灌注与心脏解剖术语
patterns.context: 医学摘要中讨论心肌血流及不同区域的灌注变化。

patterns.name: 晶圆直径增长
patterns.context: 描述由晶锭制成的圆形晶圆及其直径不断增大的行业趋势。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术；半导体制造

patterns.name: 软骨修复专利措辞
patterns.context: 专利背景中描述可吸收的软骨修复系统及其修复目标。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术；生物材料与医疗器械

en.description: Activation occurs in biomedical words such as normally and endocardium, as well as in Android image/list code. Other sporadic triggers include memory alignment, layout obstruction, and clinical questionnaires. No single semantic pattern spans all passages.

patterns.name: Word-form fragment in normally
patterns.context: The neuron activates strongly on normally, covering the full spelling or word form at token boundaries; surrounding passages concern normal myelination, normally perfused myocardium, and normal retinal vascular development.

patterns.name: Android list image resource code
patterns.context: Android/Java code sets images, thumbnails, or adapters for list items; activation is distributed across code tokens such as set in method names.

patterns.name: Image- and list-item-related vocabulary
patterns.context: UI code involving image names, video thumbnails, list items, or list views; adjacent to Android resource-setting code, though not all examples describe the same operation.

patterns.name: Memory alignment and contiguous allocation
patterns.context: Discusses whether data still needs byte-boundary alignment in an already allocated and aligned contiguous memory block.

patterns.name: Android layout height and content obstruction
patterns.context: Android ScrollView content is obscured by the bottom navigation bar; discusses layout settings such as wrap_content and match_parent.

patterns.name: endocardium in medical terminology
patterns.context: Appears in biomedical texts on myocardial blood flow, endocardium, and aortic valve endocarditis; the term spans token boundaries.

patterns.name: Pelvic floor and urogenital questionnaire terminology
patterns.context: Lists questionnaires related to urogenital conditions, pelvic organ prolapse, and urinary incontinence in follow-up or symptom-assessment contexts.

patterns.name: Local nerve injury and myelin descriptions
patterns.context: Describes demyelination, axonal injury, and normally myelinated axon regions after local injection.

patterns.name: Echocardiography and aortic valve
patterns.context: Lists echocardiographic features or abnormalities of aortic valve endocarditis.

10_2063.description: 激活既见于生物医学词语 normally、endocardium 等，也见于 Android 图片/列表代码；另有内存对齐、布局遮挡及临床问卷等零散触发。未见单一贯穿全部片段的语义模式。

patterns.name: normally 的词形片段
patterns.context: 神经元在 normally 一词上强激活，涵盖完整拼写或分词边界处的词形；周围内容分别涉及正常髓鞘、正常灌注心肌和视网膜血管正常发育。

patterns.name: Android 列表图片资源代码
patterns.context: Android/Java 代码中为列表项设置图片资源、缩略图或 adapter；激活分布在方法名的 set 等代码 token 上。

patterns.name: 图像和列表项相关词汇
patterns.context: 围绕图像名称、视频缩略图、列表项或列表视图的 UI 代码；与 Android 资源设置代码相邻，但不都属于同一操作。

patterns.name: 内存对齐与连续分配

patterns.name: Android 布局高度与内容遮挡

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 endocardium
patterns.context: 出现在心肌血流、心内膜及主动脉瓣心内膜炎等生物医学文本中；该术语跨越分词边界。

patterns.name: 盆底及泌尿生殖问卷术语

patterns.name: 局部神经损伤与髓鞘描述

patterns.name: 超声心动图与主动脉瓣

en.description: Activation spans several types of technical text: GUI/Android code and layouts, medical anatomy, clinical definitions and treatment, and IT industry commentary. Shared features are weak; common triggers include specialized terminology, parameters, and operation descriptions.

patterns.name: Android layout and view operations
patterns.context: Appears in Android UI code or discussion involving adding, measuring, laying out, scroll views, or list adapters.

patterns.name: Image resources and text-control code
patterns.context: UI code snippets contain control calls and text or image settings; passage 1 focuses on Android image resources, while passage 6 focuses on Qt/Python GUI.

patterns.name: Medical anatomy and surgical material descriptions
patterns.context: Uses medical terminology to describe mesh placement, anatomical structures, or bone lesions.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central / PubMed Abstracts; medical papers

patterns.name: Obstetric definitions and pregnancy outcomes
patterns.context: Medical studies define stillbirth using gestational age and birth-weight criteria.

patterns.name: Chemotherapy regimen and tumor response
patterns.context: Describes medication cycles for liver cancer treatment and tumor changes after treatment.
patterns.domain: PubMed Abstracts; case or clinical abstracts

patterns.name: IT hardware and data management trends
patterns.context: Summarizes business IT personnel, the importance of data management, and hardware trends.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC; IT commentary or industry articles

10_2063.description: 激活覆盖多类技术文本：GUI/Android 代码与布局、医学解剖及临床定义和治疗、IT 行业评论。共同点较弱，常见触发是专业术语、参数或操作描述。

patterns.name: Android 布局与视图操作
patterns.context: 出现在 Android UI 代码或讨论中，涉及添加、测量、布局、滚动视图或列表适配器。

patterns.name: 图像资源与文本控件代码
patterns.context: 代码片段中出现界面控件调用、文本或图像设置；第1段偏 Android 图像资源，第6段偏 Qt/Python GUI。

patterns.name: 医学解剖与手术材料描述
patterns.trigger: “Dual Mesh”、“3-cm to 5-cm overlap”、“normal fascia”、“iliac crest”；“subchondral bone cysts”、“osseous microarchitecture”
patterns.context: 以医学术语描述网片放置、解剖结构或骨组织病变。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central / PubMed Abstracts；医学论文

patterns.name: 产科定义与妊娠结局
patterns.trigger: “Stillbirth was defined as fetal death”、“20 weeks' gestation”、“birth weight was above 400 g”
patterns.context: 医学研究中给出死产定义及孕周、出生体重判据。

patterns.name: 化疗方案与肿瘤反应
patterns.trigger: “5-fluorouracil”、“continued for 5 days then discontinued for 2 days”、“portal tumor thrombus”、“HCC”
patterns.context: 描述肝癌治疗用药周期及治疗后的肿瘤变化。

patterns.name: IT 硬件与数据管理趋势
patterns.trigger: “manage data”、“constant upward curve”、“ever cheaper, ever more powerful hardware”

en.description: Primarily responds to property-setting calls in code that begin with set, often involving Android controls, list images, and layouts. There is also sporadic activation for position/size thresholds and range or definition words in medical text; their relationship is uncertain.

patterns.name: set* method calls in code
patterns.context: In Android, Java, Python/Qt, and other code, object methods set image resources, list adapters, layout parameters, control values, or settings; multiple examples combine set with a property name.

patterns.name: Control layout dimensions and content fitting
patterns.context: Discussions of ScrollView occlusion, layout height, or status bar height involve dimension parameters and fitting content to a parent container. Related to setter calls but also includes problem descriptions.

patterns.name: Positions and boundary conditions
patterns.context: Ranges are tested using positions or thresholds: code checks index boundaries, while medical text defines a condition using a birth-weight threshold.

patterns.name: List item image handling
patterns.context: Retrieves an item from a video list and sets its thumbnail; adjacent to the code setter pattern, but specifically concerns displaying list images.

patterns.name: Coverage area of medical surgical mesh
patterns.context: Describes overlap between surgical mesh and normal fascia and its extension toward the iliac crest.

patterns.name: Occurrence and gestational age in medical definitions
patterns.context: A medical paper states a stillbirth definition and gestational-age criteria; activation is scattered, with no clear connection to code setters.

patterns.name: UI touch listener
patterns.context: Android code binds a touch listener to a button and forwards touch events.

patterns.name: Text and control initialization
patterns.context: Initializes control properties such as text, font size, and frame style.

10_2063.description: 主要响应代码中以 set 开头的属性设置调用，常涉及 Android 控件、列表图像和布局；另对位置/尺寸阈值、医学文本中的范围与定义词有零散激活，彼此联系不确定。

patterns.name: 代码中的 set* 方法调用

patterns.name: 控件布局尺寸与内容适配
patterns.context: 讨论 ScrollView 遮挡、布局高度或状态栏高度时，涉及尺寸参数及内容/父容器适配。与 setter 调用相关但也包含问题叙述。

patterns.name: 位置与边界条件
patterns.context: 以位置或阈值判断范围：代码检查索引边界；医学文本以出生体重阈值描述定义。

patterns.name: 列表项图像处理
patterns.context: 从视频列表取得单项并设置缩略图；与代码 setter 模式相邻，但具体语义是列表图像展示。

patterns.name: 医学手术网片覆盖范围
patterns.context: 描述手术网片与正常筋膜的重叠及向髂嵴延伸范围。

patterns.name: 医学定义中的发生与胎龄

en.description: Primarily responds to get/set APIs, adapters, and method syntax in Android/Java code; there are also sporadic activations on Android devices/logs, medical clinical outcomes and statistics, and patent terminology for chemotherapy side effects.

patterns.name: Android/Java method calls and identifiers
patterns.context: Method names, API identifiers, and adjacent parentheses, types, or objects in Java/Android code; activations often fall on get, set, or fragments of method names.

patterns.name: Parentheses and syntax structures in Android code
patterns.context: Near Java method declarations, callbacks, or code blocks; in addition to API names, parentheses, line breaks, indentation, and modifiers also activate.

patterns.name: Android devices, applications, and runtime logs
patterns.context: Mentions Android phones or device functions, or Android resource-loading exception stack information; not limited to source code.

patterns.name: Clinical results and complications in medical papers
patterns.context: Reports surgical or treatment results, risks, complications, and clinical efficacy, often with comparisons or statistical statements.

patterns.name: Chemotherapy drugs and lists of side effects
patterns.context: Patent background explains that antitumor treatment and chemotherapy are limited by adverse reactions, followed by a list of toxicities.

patterns.name: Quantity retrieval patterns in code
patterns.context: In Android adapter or callback code, get methods retrieve counts, items, or context objects; overlaps with general code-structure patterns.

patterns.name: Medical statistical figures and significance reporting
patterns.context: Medical abstracts present proportions, p-values, or statistical comparisons between groups, usually embedded in results sentences.

patterns.name: General Java collection and adapter operations
patterns.context: An Android application passes a data collection to an adapter or sets an adapter or click listener for a list.

patterns.name: Resource image-loading exception
patterns.context: An Android runtime error stack trace contains Drawable/Bitmap resource-stream creation calls.

10_2063.concept: Android/医学技术文本中的方法与结果术语
10_2063.description: 主要响应 Android/Java 代码中的 get/set API、适配器与方法语法；另对 Android 设备/日志、医学临床结果与统计、专利化疗副作用词汇有零散激活。

patterns.name: Android/Java 方法调用与标识符
patterns.context: Java/Android 代码中方法名、API 标识符及其相邻括号、类型或对象；激活常落在 get、set 或方法名片段上。

patterns.name: Android 代码中的括号与语法结构
patterns.context: Java 方法声明、回调或代码块附近；除 API 名称外，括号、换行、缩进和修饰符也有激活。

patterns.name: Android 设备、应用与运行时日志
patterns.context: 提及 Android 手机或设备功能，或 Android 资源加载异常栈信息时；不是仅限源码。

patterns.name: 医学论文的临床结果与并发症
patterns.context: 报告手术或治疗的结果、风险、并发症和临床效果时，常伴随比较或统计语句。

patterns.name: 化疗药物与副作用列举
patterns.context: 专利背景中说明抗肿瘤治疗及化疗受不良反应限制，随后列举毒性表现。

patterns.name: 代码中的数量获取模式
patterns.context: Android 适配器或回调代码中，get 方法用于取得数量、项目或上下文对象；与一般代码结构模式重叠。

patterns.name: 医学统计数字与显著性报告
patterns.context: 医学摘要中呈现比例、p 值或组间统计比较，通常嵌在结果句中。

patterns.name: 一般 Java 集合与适配器操作
patterns.context: Android 应用将数据集合交给适配器，或为列表设置适配器、点击监听器。

patterns.name: 资源图像加载异常
patterns.context: Android 运行时错误堆栈中出现 Drawable/Bitmap 资源流创建调用。

en.concept: Heterogeneous subword fragments and structural patterns
en.description: Covers methods, keywords, and structural symbols in Android/Java code; numbers and units in electronic device specifications; bone marrow side effects and surgical/resection outcomes in medical text; and dates and steps in migration emails. Trigger points are not uniform across segments.

patterns.name: Android API method names and call chains
patterns.context: Android/Java code contains method fragments such as get, set, and on, usually adjacent to parentheses, objects, class names, or callback methods.

patterns.name: Java declarations and structural syntax
patterns.context: Declarations and syntax structures in Java methods, constructors, callbacks, or adapter code; activation falls on keywords, punctuation, and indentation.

patterns.name: Numbers and units in device specifications
patterns.context: Numbers, units, and model/specification fragments appear together in consumer electronics descriptions.

patterns.name: Cancer treatment and adverse reactions in medical text
patterns.context: Medical text lists chemotherapy drugs, treatment effects, or side effects; activation is concentrated on bone marrow-related words and some symptom words.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of cancer treatment in patent background

patterns.name: Gastric cancer surgery outcome descriptions
patterns.context: Paper abstracts discuss gastric cancer surgery staging, invasiveness, postoperative complications, and efficacy.

patterns.name: Liver resection and recurrence treatment outcomes
patterns.context: Paper abstracts report liver resection rates and the safety and feasibility of repeat treatment.

patterns.name: Dates and steps in migration notices
patterns.context: An email uses numbered items to explain Outlook migration dates and preparation steps users must take.

10_2063.concept: 异质性词片段与结构模式
10_2063.description: 覆盖Android/Java代码中的方法、关键字和结构符号，电子设备规格中的数字单位，以及医学文本中的骨髓副作用、手术/切除结局和迁移邮件中的日期步骤；各段触发点并不统一。

patterns.name: Android API 方法名与调用链
patterns.context: Android/Java 代码中出现 get、set、on 等方法名片段，通常邻接括号、对象、类名或回调方法。

patterns.name: Java 声明与结构性语法
patterns.context: Java 方法、构造器、回调或适配器代码中的声明和语法结构；激活落在关键字、标点及缩进上。

patterns.name: 设备规格中的数字与单位
patterns.context: 消费电子产品描述中，数字、单位及型号/规格片段相邻出现。

patterns.name: 医学肿瘤治疗与不良反应
patterns.context: 医学叙述列举化疗药物、治疗效果或副作用；激活集中于骨髓相关词及部分症状词。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的肿瘤治疗描述

patterns.name: 胃癌手术结局描述
patterns.trigger: «low»；stage T1a gastric cancer；minimally invasive；postoperative complication rate
patterns.context: 论文摘要讨论胃癌手术分期、侵入性、术后并发症及疗效。

patterns.name: 肝脏切除与复发治疗结果
patterns.context: 论文摘要报告肝脏切除率及重复治疗的安全性、可行性。

patterns.name: 迁移通知中的时间与步骤
patterns.trigger: «m»9«igration»；THE EVENING OF : April 23rd；press the "Save My Data" button
patterns.context: 邮件以编号说明 Outlook 迁移日期和用户需执行的准备步骤。

en.description: The strongest and most repeated trigger is “undergone,” covering uses involving surgery, repair, examination, or experiencing change. There are also sporadic activations on several terms, place names, and common subword fragments, with no unified context.

patterns.name: gone through/experienced
patterns.context: Typically follows a present-perfect or past-perfect construction and refers to experiencing change, surgery, treatment, repair, investment, etc.; this is the most stable pattern.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, encyclopedias, general explanatory prose

patterns.name: Fragments in specific nouns or abbreviations
patterns.context: Activates in place names, technical terms, or concept names, with no consistent local syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, medical cases, explanations of political concepts

patterns.name: General predicates or structural words
patterns.context: Appears in accounts of marriage recognition and in sentences explaining causal relationships; each occurs only once, making conditions difficult to determine.

patterns.name: Unidentified subword fragments and proper nouns
patterns.context: Appears in word-initial segments or proper nouns, with no shared context; the reason for activation is unclear.

10_2268.concept: undergone及经历变化
10_2268.description: 最强且反复的触发是“undergone”，涵盖接受手术、修复、检查或经历变化等用法。另有若干术语、地名及普通词片段的零散激活，缺少统一上下文。

patterns.name: gone through/experienced
patterns.context: 在现在完成时或过去完成时结构中，通常后接变化、手术、治疗、修复、投资等经历；为最稳定的模式。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、百科、一般说明文

patterns.name: 特定名词或缩写中的片段
patterns.trigger: “Lag” in “Lagoon”; “The” in “The chloroplast”; “pigment” in “retinitis pigmentosa”; “liquid” in “Liquid democracy”
patterns.context: 在地名、专业术语或概念名称中激活，未见一致的局部句法条件。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、医学病例、政治概念说明

patterns.name: 一般谓词或结构词
patterns.context: 分别出现在婚姻承认的叙述和解释因果关系的句子中；各仅见一次，难以确定条件。

patterns.name: 未明词片段及专名
patterns.context: 出现在词首分词或专名中，缺乏共同上下文；激活原因不明。

en.concept: “undergone” and contexts of experience or change
en.description: The most stable pattern is the word form “undergone,” especially “had undergone” in medical abstracts describing prior treatment, surgery, or examination; it also appears in accounts of institutional programs, brand investment, and changes in tourism. There are also isolated activations on the initial fragment “Lagoon” and the sentence-initial “The”.

patterns.name: Exact phrase “had undergone”
patterns.context: The common structure is “had undergone”; it appears in medical abstracts followed by surgery, implantation, or treatment, and also in encyclopedic accounts of brand development.

patterns.name: Exact word “undergone”
patterns.context: “undergone” as a past participle describing prior experience or change; it often precedes “intensive educational program,” “boom,” and similar phrases, but not always with “had.”
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, popular science, and medical texts

patterns.name: Lag- substring in a place-name list
patterns.context: Appears in the geographic attraction name “Lagoon of Khenifiss”; this is more likely a local activation on “Lagoon” due to cross-word segmentation than a syntactic pattern shared with other passages.
patterns.domain: Lists of place names in encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Article “The”
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence introducing “chloroplast NADH dehydrogenase F”; a single instance, making it difficult to determine whether it is triggered by the word itself or the proper-name context.

10_2268.concept: undergone 及其经历/变化语境
10_2268.description: 最稳定模式是词形“undergone”，尤以医学摘要中“had undergone”描述既往治疗、手术或检查为主；也用于机构项目、品牌投资和旅游业变化。另有孤立的“Lagoon”词首分片与句首“The”激活。

patterns.name: 精确短语“had undergone”
patterns.context: 常见结构为“had undergone”；出现在医学摘要中，后接手术、植入或治疗经历，且也见于百科品牌发展叙述。

patterns.name: 精确词“undergone”
patterns.context: “undergone”作为描述既往经历或变化的过去分词；常接 intensive educational program、boom 等，但并非都带 had。

patterns.name: 地名列表中的 Lag- 子串
patterns.context: 出现在地理景点名称“Lagoon of Khenifiss”中；更可能是跨词分片后对“Lagoon”的局部激活，而非与其他段共享的句法模式。
patterns.domain: 百科条目中的地名列表

patterns.name: 冠词“The”
patterns.context: 位于句首并引出“chloroplast NADH dehydrogenase F”；单例，难以判断是否由词本身或专名语境触发。

en.description: The most stable trigger is “undergone,” appearing in constructions about experiencing change, surgery, investment, or social transformation; there are also sporadic activations in titles, proper names, and a few medical or statistical contexts, with no clear shared pattern.

patterns.name: “undergone” and change
patterns.context: In perfect or passive constructions, it is typically followed by an object denoting change, experience, treatment, investment, or another event; the word itself repeatedly activates strongly across contexts from multiple domains.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias and academic texts, including medicine, social sciences, and organizational profiles

patterns.name: Local fragments in technical terms or entity names
patterns.context: Local activations occur in proper names, titles, or within words; no stable contextual link to “undergone” is apparent.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entry titles, proper names, and biological terminology

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in disease names
patterns.context: Appears in case descriptions such as “high myopia” and “retinitis pigmentosa,” as sporadic activations on fragments within disease names.

patterns.name: Fragments in age and year expressions
patterns.context: Occurs in expressions involving age, birth years, and “menarche”; activation is weak and does not form a clear consistent pattern.

patterns.name: Fragments in quantitative or statistical expressions
patterns.context: Adjacent to statistics such as case counts, proportions, defect sizes, and comorbidities; beyond the shared occurrence of “undergone,” no stable trigger is evident.

10_2268.concept: “undergone”语境
10_2268.description: 最稳定的触发是“undergone”，出现在经历变化、手术、投资或社会变迁等结构中；另有标题、专名和少量医学术语或统计语境中的零散激活，缺少共同的明确模式。

patterns.name: “undergone”及其变化
patterns.context: 在完成时或被动结构中，通常接续变化、经历、治疗、投资或其他事件的宾语；该词本身在多个领域的语境中反复强激活。
patterns.domain: 百科与学术文本，包括医学、社会科学及组织介绍

patterns.name: 术语或实体名称中的局部片段
patterns.context: 专名、标题或词内切分位置出现局部激活；未见与“undergone”稳定的上下文联系。
patterns.domain: 百科词条标题、专名及生物学术语

patterns.name: 疾病名称中的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在“high myopia”和“retinitis pigmentosa”等病例描述中，呈现为疾病名内部片段的零散激活。

patterns.name: 年龄及年代表述中的片段
patterns.context: 位于年龄、出生年代及“menarche”相关表述中，激活较弱且不构成明显一致模式。

patterns.name: 数量或统计表述中的片段
patterns.context: 与病例数量、比例、缺损尺寸及合并症等统计信息相邻；除共同出现“undergone”外，未见稳定触发项。

en.concept: Subword fragments within specific words (especially ive)
en.description: Activations most consistently fall on the in-word fragments ive/ational in words such as Effective, Objective, and Informational. The rest are scattered across terms, proper nouns, legal citations, sports entries, and medical-abstract word fragments, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: In-word Effect…ive fragment
patterns.context: The word is split into Effect + ive and appears at the beginning of a sentence or title-like phrase; contexts concern management, personnel handoffs, and date scheduling.

patterns.name: In-word Objective fragment
patterns.context: The word is split into Object + ive and is followed by the study objective and content.

patterns.name: In-word informational fragment
patterns.context: The word is split and used as a modifier in a travel-guide title.

patterns.name: Ball-sport terms and their context
patterns.context: Softball appears repeatedly in the title and body; the text later discusses the bombing of Darwin and Australia’s entry into World War II, with activation also falling on “Darwin”.

patterns.name: Split proper nouns or biomedical word fragments
patterns.context: Isolated subwords or term fragments with no consistent local trigger; they occur in an encyclopedia entry on chloroplast biology and a vasculitis research abstract, respectively.

patterns.name: Legal citation number fragments
patterns.context: Occurs only in the format of federal case citations at the beginning of a sentence segment.

patterns.name: He…el medical word fragment
patterns.context: Pain and weight are mentioned near the end of the abstract, followed by a repetition of “Body weight”.

10_2268.concept: 特定词内子词片段（尤其 ive）
10_2268.description: 激活最稳定地落在 Effective、Objective、Informational 等词的词内片段 ive/ational；其余分散于术语、专名、法律引文、运动条目及医学摘要词片段，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: Effect…ive 词内片段
patterns.context: 词被拆分为 Effect + ive，出现在句首或标题式短语开头；上下文分别涉及管理、人员交接、日期安排

patterns.name: Objective 词内片段
patterns.context: 词被拆分为 Object + ive，后接研究目的和研究内容

patterns.name: informational 词内片段
patterns.context: 词被拆分，作为旅游指南标题中的修饰语

patterns.name: 球类运动词及其语境
patterns.context: 标题和正文反复出现 softball；后文讲到达尔文轰炸及澳大利亚加入二战，激活也落在“Darwin”

patterns.name: 切分的专名或生物医学词片段
patterns.context: 孤立的子词或术语片段，没有一致的局部触发条件；分别出现在叶绿体生物学条目和血管炎研究摘要中

patterns.name: 法律引文编号片段
patterns.context: 仅出现于句段起始的联邦判例引文格式中

patterns.name: He…el 医学词片段
patterns.trigger: «He»«el»«pain»；可能对应被切分的词，但无法从片段确定完整词
patterns.context: 摘要结尾附近提到疼痛与体重，随后重复“Body weight”

en.description: Activations show several local subword-fragment patterns: Effect/ive, ive in Objective, word-initial Sw, legal citation 730, and ball in Softball. There is insufficient evidence to group them as a single semantic or stylistic feature.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment “Effect”
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the word-initial fragment Effect; in these passages, the continuations form “Effective” or “Infective,” respectively. However, the internal fragment in “Objective” in passage 4 is also strong, so this does not establish detection of the complete word “Effective” alone

patterns.name: ive in Objective
patterns.context: In the objective statement of a medical research abstract, “ive” after “Object” activates most strongly

patterns.name: Word-initial Sw
patterns.context: Forms “Swamp,” “Switched,” and “Swimming,” with different continuations; the only shared trigger supported by the evidence is the word-initial fragment “Sw”

patterns.name: Legal citation number
patterns.context: Appears at the start of citation numbers such as “730 F.2d 61”; other markers in the same passage do not show a clear shared pattern

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in Softball
patterns.context: Activation falls on a subword fragment in “Softball,” in an entry about Queensland softball and its history

10_2268.concept: none
10_2268.description: 激活呈现多个局部词片段模式：Effect/ive、Objective 中的 ive、Sw 词首、法律引文 730，以及 Softball 的 ball；没有足够证据将它们归为同一语义或文体特征。

patterns.name: 词首片段“Effect”
patterns.trigger: «Effect»2«ive»10；第1段另有« management»，第2段有« immediately»，第3段后接日期
patterns.context: 激活集中在词首 Effect；在这几段里后续分别拼成“Effective”或“Infective”，但第4段“Objective”的内部片段也同样强，不能据此认定只识别完整词“Effective”

patterns.name: Objective 中的 ive
patterns.context: 在医学研究摘要的目标陈述中，Object 后的“ive”激活最强

patterns.name: Sw 词首
patterns.context: 分别构成“Swamp”“Switched”“Swimming”，后续词形不同；共同触发证据仅为词首片段“Sw”

patterns.name: 法律引文编号
patterns.context: 出现在“730 F.2d 61”一类判例引文编号开头；同段其余标记未显示清晰共享模式

patterns.name: Softball 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在“Softball”的分词片段，位于昆士兰垒球条目及历史叙述中

en.concept: Mixed subword fragments and contextual features
en.description: Activations most consistently fall on the word-initial subword Ind-, but the meanings of the following words vary widely; there are also independent responses to cloud-computing rental contexts, the Pelotas subword fragment, and the word certain in combinatorics.

patterns.name: Cloud-computing rental context
patterns.context: Describes a cloud service provider offering rentable compute instances; several related words activate together, with «can» strongest.

patterns.name: Pelotas subword fragment
patterns.context: The proper noun Pelotas is split into multiple subword fragments and repeated after a line break.

patterns.name: Words beginning with Ind-
patterns.context: The initial subword Ind activates strongly; subsequent words and contexts vary, including Indiana, Indirect, Indications, Indocyanine.

patterns.name: Combinatorics terms
patterns.context: Mathematical discussion of integers, combinatorial counting problems, and trees; «certain» is strongest.

10_2268.concept: 混合的词片段与语境特征
10_2268.description: 激活最一致地落在 Ind- 词首子词上，但其后词义跨度很大；另对云计算租赁语境、Pelotas 的子词片段及组合数学中的 certain 等词有独立响应。

patterns.name: 云计算租赁语境
patterns.context: 描述云服务提供商提供可租用的计算实例；多个相关词同时激活，«can»最强。

patterns.name: Pelotas 子词片段
patterns.context: 专名 Pelotas 被拆分为多个子词片段，且在换行后重复出现。

patterns.name: Ind- 起始词
patterns.context: 词首子词 Ind 激活很强；后续词义和语境各异，包括 Indiana、Indirect、Indications、Indocyanine。
patterns.domain: 维基百科、专利背景、医学摘要

patterns.name: 组合数学词语
patterns.context: 关于整数、组合计数问题和树的数学论述；«certain»最强。

en.concept: Academic text structure and title markers
en.description: Activations span various academic titles, section/document markers, medical research objectives and methods, and scientific prose and citations; they also occur in webpage titles and subwords of proper nouns. There is no stable single semantic trigger; the feature may combine title capitalization, structural markers, and subword/function-word characteristics.

patterns.name: Capitalized function words in titles
patterns.context: In title-like phrases, content words or sentence-initial function words are capitalized; activations concentrate near the title beginning and word boundaries.

patterns.name: First word in a title or title field
patterns.context: At the beginning of a title or structured-abstract field, title words are capitalized; may also involve the common title word “To”.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in numbers, abbreviations, and proper nouns
patterns.context: Some fragments activate when proper nouns, abbreviations, or marked literature citations are split into subwords; the trigger is unclear.
patterns.domain: Addresses/institution names, scientific papers and citations

patterns.name: Academic title and section-heading format
patterns.context: In titles or section headings, especially title capitalization, section names, and nearby Markdown/LaTeX markers.

patterns.name: Numbering and equation markers in scientific papers
patterns.context: Near appendices, equations, section headings, or paper-structure markers; marker symbols and numbering may be more relevant than the body text.

patterns.name: Title-like research objective statements
patterns.context: A structured abstract or project description begins with an objective field, followed by a research verb or objective content.

patterns.name: Clinical research participants and inclusion criteria
patterns.context: Sentences describing informed consent, clinical stability, and study inclusion/exclusion criteria.

patterns.name: Syntactic function words in academic prose
patterns.context: Common function words in academic discussion, appearing in methods, background, or results descriptions; these examples alone do not establish stable conditions.

patterns.name: Academic paragraph closure and reference markers
patterns.context: Reference citations at the end of discussion paragraphs; may respond to citation markers or paragraph-closing language.

patterns.name: Acknowledgments and document-ending separator
patterns.context: An acknowledgments heading after the paper appendix, followed by a Markdown separator line.

patterns.name: Abstract/section summary language
patterns.context: A paper summary or section overview contains a summarizing statement such as “show how…”, followed by a section heading.

patterns.name: Pharmacy clinical roles and service titles
patterns.context: A medical paper title describing pharmacy residents providing weekend antimicrobial-related services.

patterns.name: Technical terms in mathematics paper titles
patterns.context: Mathematical technical terms in a title are split into subwords; activation may relate to title format or word fragments.

patterns.name: Scientific topic terms and compound terminology
patterns.context: Scientific prose discussing the formation of two-dimensional crystals and their kinetic and thermodynamic parameters.

10_2268.concept: 学术文本结构与标题标记
10_2268.description: 激活分布在多种学术标题、章节/文档标记、医学研究目的与方法，以及科学正文和引用中；也见于网页标题和专名子词。没有稳定的单一语义触发，可能混合标题大小写、结构标记与子词/功能词特征。

patterns.name: 标题中的功能词大写
patterns.context: 标题式短语中，实词或句首功能词采用大写；激活集中在标题开头和词界附近。

patterns.name: 标题或标题字段的首词
patterns.context: 标题或结构化摘要字段的开头，标题词使用大写；也可能涉及标题中常见的“To”。

patterns.name: 数字、缩写和专名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 专名、缩写或带标记的文献引用被拆成子词时，部分片段激活；触发条件不明确。
patterns.domain: 地址/机构名称、科学论文及引用

patterns.name: 学术标题与章节标题格式
patterns.context: 标题或章节标题中，尤其是标题大小写、章节名以及标题附近的 Markdown/LaTeX 标记。

patterns.name: 科学论文中的编号与公式标记
patterns.context: 附录、公式、节标题或论文结构标记附近；标记符号及编号可能比正文更相关。

patterns.name: 标题式研究目的表述
patterns.context: 结构化摘要或项目简介以目的字段起始，随后出现研究动词或目的内容。

patterns.name: 医学研究参与者与纳入标准
patterns.context: 描述知情同意、临床稳定状态和研究纳入/排除条件的句子。

patterns.name: 学术正文中的句法功能词
patterns.context: 学术论述中的常见功能词，出现在方法、背景或结果说明中；仅凭这些例子难以确定稳定条件。

patterns.name: 学术段落收束与参考文献标记
patterns.context: 讨论段落末尾的参考文献引用，可能对引文标记或段落收束语有响应。

patterns.name: 致谢与文档结束分隔线
patterns.context: 论文附录之后的致谢标题及其后的 Markdown 分隔线。

patterns.name: 摘要/章节总结语
patterns.context: 论文总结或章节概述中，出现“show how…”等总结性陈述，随后进入章节标题。

patterns.name: 药学临床角色与服务标题
patterns.context: 医学论文标题中描述药学住院医师提供周末抗菌药物相关服务。

patterns.name: 数学论文的专业标题词
patterns.context: 标题中的数学专业术语被拆分为子词；其触发可能与标题格式或词片段有关。

patterns.name: 科学主题词与复合术语
patterns.context: 讨论二维晶体形成及其动力学、热力学参数的科学正文。

en.concept: Scientific paper text and structural markers
en.description: Activations span mathematical physics, biomedicine, and paper metadata; visible triggers include the mathematical condition x>0, title and section/book markers, scientific proper nouns and abbreviations, and specific discussion in body text. The passages have no single stable theme.

patterns.name: x>0 condition in equations or mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: Appears in LaTeX equations, especially near statements about function continuity or subsequent mathematical conclusions; this condition receives strong activation.

patterns.name: Document titles and structural markers
patterns.context: Appears near paper metadata, section headings, or Markdown/LaTeX-style structural markers; activations occur in titles, abstracts, and section boundaries.
patterns.domain: Document structure in ArXiv and biomedical papers

patterns.name: Rare or anomalous proper nouns and terms in scientific papers
patterns.context: Appears in specialized terms, abbreviations, and nearby text in biomedical or physics paper bodies; some terms themselves or their subword fragments activate.

patterns.name: References and bibliographic information
patterns.context: Appears in paper front matter or bibliography fields, including author names, reference filenames, or bibliographic labels.

patterns.name: Special word form in an unbiased-estimator title
patterns.context: Appears in an all-caps, hyphen-split paper title, which ends with a line break and abstract metadata.

patterns.name: Expository English fragments before section headings
patterns.context: Ordinary academic prose concerning costs, funding constraints, or administrative procedures; activation words are scattered through sentences rather than limited to titles.

patterns.name: Neuroscience experimental hypothesis statements
patterns.context: Compares patients, unaffected limbs, and healthy controls, and describes brain-region activation during an emotion-regulation task.

patterns.name: Random fields and Ising model terminology
patterns.context: In a mathematical physics paper, an expression is written as the partition function of a random-field Ising model.

patterns.name: Formal differential operators and discussion of continuous functions
patterns.context: Near an equation, a conclusion for positive x is given under a continuity condition.

patterns.name: Dark matter paper title and introduction
patterns.context: Appears in a paper excerpt containing bibliographic fields, a title, and an introduction section marker.

10_2268.concept: 科学论文文本与结构标记
10_2268.description: 激活分布跨数学物理、生物医学及论文元数据；可见触发包括 x>0 数学条件、标题与章节/书目标记、科学专名缩写及正文中的特定论述。段间没有单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: 公式或数学排版中的 x>0 条件
patterns.context: 出现在 LaTeX 数学公式中，尤其紧邻关于函数连续性或后续数学结论的表述；此条件字符获得很强激活。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、形式化数学排版

patterns.name: 文档标题与结构标记
patterns.context: 出现在论文元数据、章节标题或 Markdown/LaTeX 风格的结构标记附近；标题、摘要和章节边界中有激活。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 与生物医学论文的文档结构

patterns.name: 科学论文中罕见或格式异常的专名与术语
patterns.context: 出现在生物医学或物理学论文正文的专门术语、缩写及其附近；部分术语自身或分词片段激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与物理学论文

patterns.name: 参考文献与书目信息
patterns.context: 出现在论文前置信息或文献列表字段中，包含作者名、参考文献文件名或书目标签。
patterns.domain: 论文元数据与书目排版

patterns.name: 不偏估计标题中的特殊词形
patterns.context: 出现在全大写、带连字符拆分的论文标题中，且标题以换行和 abstract 元数据结束。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文标题/摘要头部

patterns.name: 分节标题前的论述性英文片段
patterns.context: 普通学术散文正文中，涉及成本、资金限制或行政程序；激活词分散在句中，并非只限标题。
patterns.domain: 医学/公共卫生论文正文

patterns.name: 神经科学实验假设表述
patterns.trigger: "specifically tested the hypothesis"、"schizophrenia patients"、"frontal and amygdala activation"
patterns.context: 比较患者、未患病手足与健康对照，并描述情绪调节任务中的脑区激活。
patterns.domain: 精神病学与神经影像论文

patterns.name: 随机场与 Ising 模型术语
patterns.context: 在数学物理论文中将某个表达式写成随机场 Ising 模型的配分函数。

patterns.name: 形式化微分算子与连续函数论述
patterns.context: 公式附近以连续性为条件给出对正 x 成立的结论。

patterns.name: 暗物质论文的标题与引言
patterns.trigger: "Scalar field dark matter with a cosh potential, revisited"、"Introduction"
patterns.context: 出现在带有书目字段、标题及引言章节标记的论文片段中。

en.concept: Not caring and terminology in research contexts
en.description: The most stable cue is “don’t care” across different contexts; in addition, systematic research language and biomedical terminology activate in research texts. Other scattered topics include communication, risk tradeoffs, colloquial disputes, and regulation, which are difficult to group into one pattern.

patterns.name: “care” followed by negation or an irrelevant object
patterns.context: The trigger mainly falls on care (segments 1 and 2 mark care; segments 5, 6, and 10 mark care), usually in a “don’t care” construction; across different meanings, it indicates indifference to an object or consequence, or whether something is understood.
patterns.domain: Online forums, emails, and general discussion

patterns.name: Systematic research language in research texts
patterns.context: Systematic occurs with a following noun to describe systematically identifying or reviewing a research topic; activation also extends to surrounding research terms.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research paper abstracts and body text

patterns.name: Disease, drug, and physiological mechanism terms in health research
patterns.context: Occurs in scientific discussion of alcohol use, disease mechanisms, drug candidates, or cell therapy; activations involve terms and neighboring words, with no single stable trigger word.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and NIH project text

patterns.name: Research communication and stakeholder engagement
patterns.context: Discusses research evaluation, communication, and conveying information to non-specialists.
patterns.domain: Public health or health research papers

patterns.name: Risk-benefit tradeoffs
patterns.context: Explains a basis for choices, using drug use, fatal risks, and law as examples.

patterns.name: Colloquial dialogue and quotation format
patterns.context: Forum disputes or quoted emails contain colloquial, rebutting, and adversarial language; there is no clear shared trigger.

patterns.name: Taxi regulation and health insurance companies
patterns.context: The same paragraph mentions taxi regulations and companies managing health insurance; their relationship is unclear.

10_2268.concept: 不在意与科研语境中的术语
10_2268.description: 最稳定的线索是不同语境中的“don’t care”；此外，科研文本里系统性研究措辞及生物医学术语也有激活。另有传播、风险权衡、口语争论和监管等零散主题，难以归为一个统一模式。

patterns.name: “care”后接否定或无关对象
patterns.context: 触发主要落在 care（第1、2段标在 care；第5、6、10段标在 care），且周围多是“don’t care”结构；在不同语义中表示不在意对象、后果或理解与否。
patterns.domain: 网络论坛、邮件及一般论述

patterns.name: 科研文本中的系统性研究措辞
patterns.context: systematic 与后续名词共同出现，描述系统地识别或综述研究对象；激活还分布于周围科研术语。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究论文摘要及正文

patterns.name: 健康研究中的疾病、药物及生理机制术语
patterns.context: 处于关于酒精使用、疾病机制、药物候选物或细胞治疗的科学论述中；激活涉及术语及其邻近词，未见单一稳定触发词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与 NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 研究传播与利益相关者参与
patterns.context: 讨论研究评估、传播及面向非专业人士的信息表达。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生或健康研究论文

patterns.name: 风险与收益权衡
patterns.context: 说明选择依据，并以药物使用、致命风险及法律为例。

patterns.name: 口语化对话及引用格式
patterns.trigger: “That’s not a justification”及引述中的“proper English”
patterns.context: 论坛争论或邮件引用中出现口语、反驳及带有对抗性的表达；没有明确共同触发项。

patterns.name: 出租车监管与健康保险公司
patterns.context: 同一段落提到出租车规定及管理健康保险的公司；两者关系不明。

en.concept: Common expressions in relationships and discourse structure
en.description: Activations span prepositional relationship structures, emphasis and qualification, negative judgments, and pronominal expressions; local themes also include biomedical mechanisms, cognitive states, personal accounts of gaming, and inclusion-related disputes. There is no single stable lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Phrases introduced in prepositional/relational structures
patterns.context: Appears in prepositional phrases connecting domains, objects, properties, or abstract relations; specific meanings before and after it vary.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts and theoretical discussion, also forum text

patterns.name: Emphasis or focus words
patterns.context: Introduces focus, qualification, contrast, or concluding emphasis in statements; it does not always serve the same rhetorical function.

patterns.name: Negative/equative judgments of identity or state
patterns.context: Negates, distinguishes, or states a position about a state, preference, or judgment; spans academic definitions and colloquial opinions.

patterns.name: Reference and pronominal expressions
patterns.context: In forums or personal narratives, pronouns refer back to prior objects or express personal opinions or experiences.

patterns.name: Statements of mechanisms, processes, and relationships in research
patterns.context: Describes biological mechanisms, regulatory processes, relationships between research projects, or translational significance.

patterns.name: Cognition, perception, and states of consciousness
patterns.context: Discusses changes in alertness, perception, and distinctions between different states of consciousness or sleep.

patterns.name: Gaming preferences and personal confession
patterns.context: The speaker admits to liking games and says that many things in life serve the purpose of playing games.

patterns.name: Attitude expression in an inclusion-related dispute
patterns.context: Quotes and rebuts the other party’s characterization of their position as opposing inclusivity, then explains their own attitude toward inclusivity.

patterns.name: Local triggers in nonstandard or fragmentary text
patterns.context: These high-activation words are scattered across different contexts, so the samples do not establish a shared, independent semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Forum text, political commentary, biomedical abstracts, and philosophical discussion

10_2268.concept: 关系与论述结构中的常见表达
10_2268.description: 激活分布于介词关系结构、强调与限定、否定判断及代词表达；另见生物医学机制、认知状态、游戏自述和包容性争论等局部主题，缺乏单一稳定的词义触发。

patterns.name: 介词/关系结构中的词组引出
patterns.context: 出现在介词短语中，连接领域、对象、属性或抽象关系；前后具体词义不固定。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要与理论论述，也见论坛文本

patterns.name: 强调或聚焦词
patterns.context: 在陈述中引出重点、限定、转折或总结性强调；并非总是同一种修辞功能。

patterns.name: 身份或状态的否定/等同判断
patterns.context: 对状态、偏好或判断作否定、区别或表态；跨越学术定义和口语意见表达。
patterns.domain: 科研论述、博客/论坛对话

patterns.name: 指称与代词化表达
patterns.context: 论坛或个人叙述中用代词承接前文对象、表达个人意见或经历。

patterns.name: 科研中的机制、过程与关联表述
patterns.trigger: «linking»« extrinsic»« signals»« with»« genetic»« programs»（[6]）；«mechanistic»« and»« translational»« program»（[9]）；«gene»« expression»（[10]）
patterns.context: 描述生物学机制、调控过程、研究项目之间的关联或转化意义。

patterns.name: 认知、知觉及意识状态术语
patterns.context: 讨论警觉性变化、知觉以及不同意识或睡眠状态的区别。

patterns.name: 游戏偏好与个人坦白
patterns.context: 说话者坦承喜欢游戏，并称生活中许多事情都服务于玩游戏。

patterns.name: 包容性争论中的态度表达
patterns.context: 引用并反驳对方将其立场概括为反对包容性，随后说明自己对包容性的态度。
patterns.domain: 技术项目相关论坛争论

patterns.name: 非标准或残缺文本中的局部触发
patterns.context: 这些高激活词分散在不同语境中，不能从样本中确定它们有共同、独立的语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、政治评论、生物医学摘要与哲学论述

en.description: Highlights concentrate on recent and the time phrases that follow it, as well as “I love” expressions of liking in forums; academic exemplification phrase “for instance,” and the Causality word fragment in a citation also appear.

patterns.name: Time modifier recent
patterns.context: Recent modifies following noun phrases such as growth, development, interest, papers, or reports; it may be preceded by degree words or other modifiers.

patterns.name: I love expressions
patterns.context: First person expresses liking in colloquial or online text, followed by that style of thinking, everything, or it.

patterns.name: Instance in an exemplification phrase
patterns.context: Occurs in the exemplification transition “for instance,” followed by a citation or example.

patterns.name: Split fragment of the term Causality
patterns.context: Located in the book-title-like citation Causality after the author name Pearl; the highlight falls on a split word fragment.

10_2268.concept: 近期性与喜爱表达
10_2268.description: 高亮集中于 recent 及其后接名词的时间短语，也集中于论坛中的“I love”喜爱表达；另见学术举例语“for instance,”和引文中的 Causality 词片段。

patterns.name: recent 的时间修饰语
patterns.context: recent 修饰后续的增长、发展、兴趣、论文或报告等名词短语；前后可有程度词或其他修饰语。

patterns.name: I love 的表达
patterns.context: 第一人称在口语或网络文本中表达喜爱，后接 that style of thinking、everything 或 it。

patterns.name: 例示语中的 instance
patterns.context: 出现在“for instance,”这一举例衔接语中，后接引用或例子。

patterns.name: 术语 Causality 的拆分片段
patterns.context: 位于作者姓名 Pearl 之后、书名式引文 Causality 之中；高亮落在被拆分的词片段上。

en.concept: Statements on scientific research progress and significance
en.description: References to recent research, reports, or progress are common; there are also responses to “fundamental,” evaluations of scientific results, and limitations on technical applications, all in scientific or technical explanatory prose.

patterns.name: recent work or finding
patterns.context: Research prose referring to recent prior work, events, reports, or developments; the strongest activations are near “recent” or a nearby related word.
patterns.domain: Academic writing, scientific reporting, and popular-science prose

patterns.name: fundamental property or interest
patterns.context: Scientific descriptions of a property or task, or discussion of research interest; “fundamental” receives high activation in two contexts.

patterns.name: unexpected or noteworthy result
patterns.context: A scientific result or example is characterized as surprising or well known.

patterns.name: technical application limitations
patterns.context: A technical method or material is described in terms of restricted applications and performance problems.

10_2268.concept: 科学研究进展与重要性表述
10_2268.description: 对近期研究、报告或进展的提及较常见；另对 fundamental、科学结果的评价及技术应用限制有响应，均出现在科技或科学说明文中。

patterns.name: recent work or finding
patterns.trigger: “recent” (often followed by a high-activation research-reporting verb or noun, such as “work,” “occurrence,” “report,” “years,” or “scientists”)”
patterns.context: Research prose referring to recent prior work, events, reports, or developments; the strongest activations are near “recent” or a nearby related word.
patterns.domain: Academic writing, scientific reporting, and popular-science prose

patterns.name: fundamental property or interest
patterns.context: Scientific descriptions of a property or task, or discussion of research interest; “fundamental” receives high activation in two contexts.

patterns.name: unexpected or noteworthy result
patterns.context: A scientific result or example is characterized as surprising or well known.

patterns.name: technical application limitations
patterns.context: A technical method or material is described in terms of restricted applications and performance problems.

en.description: Primarily responds to recent and its collocations in academic literature, especially recent work/report/success/results/advances/occurrence, used to introduce background, motivation, or rationale; other general paper-abstract-style questions and methods statements are more weakly related.

patterns.name: Introducing recent literature
patterns.context: In academic text, recent modifies a study, result, advance, or event; activations concentrate on recent and adjacent words.

patterns.name: Research motivation or background setup
patterns.context: Prior work or real-world events introduced by recent are used as research motivation, background, or methodological rationale.

patterns.name: Research questions and methods in academic abstracts
patterns.context: States a paper’s contribution, proof, method, or research objective around an unresolved or understudied question; does not necessarily contain recent.

patterns.name: Evaluative statements about recent research progress
patterns.context: Describes recent results as successes, advances, or findings that can inform current work.

10_2268.concept: 近期研究背景引介
10_2268.description: 主要对学术文献中的 recent 及其搭配起反应，尤其是 recent work/report/success/results/advances/occurrence，用于引出背景、动机或依据；另有若干一般论文摘要式问题与方法陈述，关系较弱。

patterns.name: recent 文献引入
patterns.context: 学术文本中 recent 修饰某项研究、成果、进展或事件；激活集中在 recent 及其相邻词。

patterns.name: 研究动机或背景铺垫
patterns.trigger: “Motivated by” “A recent report” “Built on the recent success” “To cite a recent occurrence” “Our approach combines the recent results” “also inspired by recent advances”
patterns.context: recent 引出的既有工作或现实事件被用作研究动机、背景或方法依据。

patterns.name: 学术摘要中的研究问题与方法
patterns.trigger: “the general analytical result is still lacking” “less studied” “we show” “we provide” “an open problem”
patterns.context: 围绕尚未解决或研究不足的问题，陈述论文贡献、证明、方法或研究目标；不一定含 recent。

patterns.name: 近期研究进展的评价性表述
patterns.context: 把近期成果描述为成功、进展或可供当前工作借鉴的结果。

en.description: All passages activate strongly on recent/recently, typically modifying results, findings, progress, reports, observations, or research work in academic texts; nearby content varies by field.

patterns.name: recent followed by a time or progress word
patterns.context: When reviewing or citing recent research findings or explaining research motivation, especially when a noun follows recent; strong activation is concentrated on recent, while nearby words may also activate more weakly
patterns.domain: Cross-disciplinary academic papers, reviews, and research proposals

patterns.name: present review in an academic overview
patterns.context: Review authors turn to an overview of the current review and recount how understanding in a field has developed

patterns.name: Specific progress expression recent progress
patterns.context: Introduces recent progress in a technology or research direction
patterns.domain: Electronic devices and materials science abstracts

patterns.name: Recency of results or findings
patterns.context: Research papers or project descriptions emphasize recent successes, discoveries, or results
patterns.domain: Graph neural network research, neuroscience projects, immunology research

patterns.name: Recent research and project sources
patterns.context: Research proposals explain the basis of the work, existing observations, or recent developments
patterns.domain: Chromatin biology, optics, and microbiology research proposals

patterns.name: Recent methodological or field developments
patterns.context: Uses recent progress to define an emerging stage of research or summarize changes in understanding of a field
patterns.domain: High-dimensional spectral analysis, transcriptional regulation reviews

patterns.name: Recent report introducing a mechanism
patterns.context: A literature review uses a recent report to introduce an explanation of a mechanism

10_2268.concept: 学术语境中的近期研究
10_2268.description: 全部片段都强烈激活于 recent/recently，通常用于学术文本中修饰成果、发现、进展、报告、观察或研究工作；近邻内容因领域而异。

patterns.name: recent 后接时间或进展词
patterns.context: 在回顾、引述近期研究成果或说明研究动机时，尤其是 recent 后接名词；强激活集中于 recent，邻近词也可能有较弱激活
patterns.domain: 跨领域学术论文、综述与研究计划

patterns.name: 学术回顾中的 present review
patterns.trigger: « In» « the» « present» « review»；另有 « summarize» « the» « recent» « evolution»
patterns.context: 综述作者转入概述当前综述内容，并回顾某领域理解的发展

patterns.name: 特定进展表述 recent progress
patterns.context: 介绍某技术或研究方向近期进展
patterns.domain: 电子器件与材料学摘要

patterns.name: 成果或发现的近期性
patterns.trigger: « recent» « success»、« recent» « discovery»、« recently» « found»
patterns.context: 研究论文或项目叙述强调近期取得的成功、发现或结果
patterns.domain: 图神经网络研究、神经科学项目、免疫学研究

patterns.name: 近期研究与项目来源
patterns.trigger: « recent» « observations»；« recent» « work»；« recent» « development»
patterns.context: 研究计划说明工作的依据、既有观察或近期发展
patterns.domain: 染色质生物学、光学、微生物学研究计划

patterns.name: 近期方法或领域发展
patterns.context: 将近期进展用于界定新兴研究阶段，或概述领域认识变化
patterns.domain: 高维谱分析、转录调控综述

patterns.name: 近期报告引出机制
patterns.context: 文献回顾中以一项近期报告引出机制说明

en.concept: Research progress and problem statements in academic texts
en.description: Strong activations often occur in formal academic or technical text, especially recent/recently describing recent progress and statements of research tasks, problems, or findings; there are also technical narratives from different fields and an NP explanation for beginners.

patterns.name: recent / recently
patterns.context: Describes recent progress, work, successes, or findings in academic or research contexts; nearby words often include “success”, “advances”, “developed”, “work”, “identified”.

patterns.name: Academic tasks and research subjects
patterns.context: Formal, explanatory academic statements concerning research tasks, questions, observations, or methods.
patterns.domain: Paper abstracts, mathematics papers, patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Explanation of NP-complete problems
patterns.context: Explains a theoretical computer science concept for beginners and gives examples such as SAT.

patterns.name: Specific technical narratives that do not form a clear group
patterns.context: The passages respectively discuss robotics, drug screening, pathogen signaling systems, and stochastic differential equations; beyond formal technical style, they share no obvious triggering content.
patterns.domain: Patents, life-science project descriptions, mathematics papers

10_2268.concept: 学术研究进展与问题陈述
10_2268.description: 强激活多见于正式学术或技术文本，尤其是 recent/recently 描述近期进展，以及陈述研究任务、问题或发现；另有不同领域的专门技术叙述和一段面向初学者的 NP 解释。

patterns.name: recent / recently
patterns.context: 在学术或研究语境中，描述近期进展、工作、成功或发现；附近常接 “success”“advances”“developed”“work”“identified”。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、科研项目说明

patterns.name: 学术任务与研究对象
patterns.context: 围绕研究任务、问题、观察或方法展开，常见正式、说明性的学术表述。
patterns.domain: 论文摘要、数学论文、专利背景

patterns.name: NP 完全问题解释
patterns.trigger: “when explaining $NP$ to someone for the first time”及“hard to avoid comparisons”
patterns.context: 面向初学者解释理论计算机科学概念，并举 SAT 等例子。

patterns.name: 未能明确归并的具体技术叙述
patterns.trigger: “impossible to use the same robotic arm”；“ion channels”；“quorum-sensing systems”；“BSDEs”
patterns.context: 各段分别讨论机器人、药物筛选、病原体信号系统及随机微分方程；除正式技术文风外，没有共同的明显触发内容。
patterns.domain: 专利、生命科学项目说明、数学论文

en.concept: Recent academic progress and several formatting markers
en.description: The main responses are to expressions describing recent progress, developments, or success in academic contexts. There are also responses to example markers, citation formats, and first-person negative expressions in online colloquial language; these triggers occur in different local strings.

patterns.name: Expressions related to recent advances
patterns.context: “recent” modifies progress, success, development, or research results, often occurring with “advances in …”; passage 1 instead contains “attention … received” and “potential benefit”.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, mainly in machine learning, statistics, and computational science

patterns.name: Example introductions and list markers
patterns.context: Introduces examples, methods, or supporting literature; triggers fall on example abbreviations, colons, or “such as”.

patterns.name: Author markers in citation formats
patterns.context: “et al.” after author names and journal abbreviations in reference formats.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial I and negative contractions
patterns.context: First-person colloquial expressions, especially “I can't …” followed by personal narration such as “I wanted …”.

10_2268.concept: 近期学术进展及若干格式标记
10_2268.description: 主要对学术语境中描述近期进展、发展或成功的表达有响应，也对举例标记、文献引用格式和网络口语中的第一人称否定表达有响应；这些触发分布在不同局部词串中。

patterns.name: recent advances 相关表述
patterns.context: “recent”修饰进展、成功、发展或研究成果，常与“advances in …”搭配；第1段则是“attention … received”及“potential benefit”。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，主要为机器学习、统计与计算科学

patterns.name: 举例引出与列举标记
patterns.context: 用于引出实例、方法或文献依据；触发落在示例缩写、冒号或“such as”上。

patterns.name: 文献引用格式中的作者标记
patterns.context: 作者姓名后的“et al.”及期刊缩写等参考文献格式。

patterns.name: 英文句首 I 与否定缩写
patterns.context: 第一人称口语表达，尤其是“I can't …”及随后“I wanted …”的个人叙述。

en.description: Activations are scattered across papers, patents, legal lists, and emails: highlighting recently in research progress, defect/existing-method wording in patent background sections, lists of legal personnel and locations, and formal apologies, along with several isolated words and phrases; there is no unified semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Research progress statements introduced by recently
patterns.context: recently appears in a sentence followed by researchers proposing, developing, or discovering something; both contexts contain the structure “We have recently…”

patterns.name: applicants have observed in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: In patent background sections, stating defects of existing devices or solutions, or the lack of a convenient approach

patterns.name: Negative evaluation of a technical solution using cumbersome
patterns.context: Describing the inconvenience of a system or method for a particular use (here, rinsing semiconductor equipment); the contrastive word however appears nearby

patterns.name: Surname-style reference Anderson after a name
patterns.context: In patent documents, near patent numbers and inventor names when listing prior art or patents

patterns.name: Statements that a method is well known in the field
patterns.context: Introducing an existing method and its standing in the field in a technical background; method names and technical-field wording appear nearby

patterns.name: Lists of legal personnel names and locations
patterns.context: Lists of lawyers, officials, or institutional personnel in legal documents, with U.S. cities and state/region abbreviations after names

patterns.name: confusion in notices of apology and inconvenience
patterns.context: After stating that an error has been identified and corrected, expressing regret for confusion or inconvenience caused to recipients

patterns.name: Other scattered paper and patent-background wording
patterns.context: Appears respectively in an introduction to graph representation learning, an issue with model order, an error-order expression, and itemized statements in patent backgrounds; no shared local trigger condition is evident
patterns.domain: ArXiv papers and USPTO patent backgrounds

10_2268.concept: none
10_2268.description: 激活分散于论文、专利、法律名单和邮件：突出 recently 的研究进展、专利背景中的缺陷/既有方法措辞、法律人员地点列举及正式道歉，并有若干孤立词句；没有统一语义触发模式。

patterns.name: recently 引导的研究进展表述
patterns.context: 句中出现 recently，后接研究者提出、开发或发现某事；两处上下文均有“We have recently…”结构

patterns.name: 专利背景中的 applicants have observed
patterns.context: 专利背景技术中，陈述现有设备或方案的缺陷、缺少便利做法

patterns.name: 技术方案的负面评价词 cumbersome
patterns.context: 描述系统或方法在特定用途（此处为冲洗半导体设备）上的不便；转折词 however 邻近

patterns.name: 人名后的姓氏式称谓 Anderson
patterns.context: 专利文献中列举既有技术或专利时，专利号及发明人姓名附近

patterns.name: 方法在领域内知名的表述
patterns.context: 技术背景介绍某种已有方法及其领域地位；邻近方法名称和技术领域措辞

patterns.name: 法律人员姓名与地点列举
patterns.context: 法律文书中的律师、官员或机构人员名单，姓名后列出美国城市及州/地区缩写

patterns.name: 道歉与不便通知中的 confusion
patterns.context: 通知说明错误已识别并纠正后，以 regret 表达对收件人造成困惑或不便的歉意

patterns.name: 其他零散论文与专利背景措辞
patterns.context: 分别出现在图表示学习的引言、模型阶数问题、误差阶表达式及专利背景的分项陈述中；未见共同的局部触发条件
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文及 USPTO 专利背景

en.concept: Progress and problems in technical research narratives
en.description: Activations commonly occur in technical or academic exposition: introducing systems and methods and their limitations, emphasizing recent progress, complexity, or unresolved problems; they also cover literature reviews and accounts of scientific discoveries. The trigger patterns are varied.

patterns.name: Recent progress or research trends
patterns.context: Reviews existing work in a field and emphasizes recent progress, research drivers, or research questions prompted by new work

patterns.name: Complexity and negative evaluation
patterns.context: Lists disadvantages, complexity, or burden of using systems, knowledge, or methods

patterns.name: System, method, or technical object
patterns.context: Introduces a technical system or research method and describes its function, application, or limitations

patterns.name: Accounts of discoveries and scientific history
patterns.context: Recounts scientific discoveries and subsequent discoveries in chronological order

patterns.name: Identifying or observing a problem
patterns.context: Points out shortcomings, difficulties, or unresolved problems in existing solutions

patterns.name: Citing or listing relevant literature
patterns.context: Reviews a research field or lists relevant works in academic discussion

patterns.name: Specific objects and action-word fragments
patterns.context: Descriptions of specific technical or research objects in the passages; no shared local trigger form is evident
patterns.domain: Optical systems, quantum physics, graph methods, engineering patents

10_2268.concept: 技术研究叙述中的进展与问题
10_2268.description: 激活常见于技术或学术说明：介绍系统、方法及其局限，强调近期进展、复杂性或待解问题；也覆盖文献回顾和科学发现叙述。各触发模式较分散。

patterns.name: 近期进展或研究趋势
patterns.trigger: “recent”及其后续描述，如“recent advances”“recent work”“recent success”；另有“very recent”“recently”语境
patterns.context: 回顾某领域已有工作，并强调新近进展、研究驱动因素或新工作引出的研究问题

patterns.name: 复杂性及负面评价
patterns.context: 列举系统、知识或方法的缺点、复杂程度或使用负担

patterns.name: 系统、方法或技术对象
patterns.trigger: “system”“methods”“method”“scheme”“techniques”等，常伴随用途、组成或限制说明
patterns.context: 介绍技术系统或研究方法，并描述其功能、应用或局限

patterns.name: 发现与科学史叙述
patterns.context: 按时间顺序叙述科学发现及后续发现

patterns.name: 提出或观察到问题
patterns.trigger: “applicants have observed that”“A difficulty … is how to”
patterns.context: 指出现有方案的不足、困难或待解决问题

patterns.name: 引述或列举相关文献
patterns.context: 学术论述中回顾研究领域或列举相关著作

patterns.name: 特定对象与动作词片段
patterns.trigger: “eye is looking and focused”“higher order level spacing”“$n$ photons”“law enforcement”“different dimensions”
patterns.context: 各段中的具体技术或研究对象描述；未见共同的局部触发形式
patterns.domain: 光学系统、量子物理、图方法、工程专利

en.concept: Problem and evaluation statements in technical backgrounds
en.description: Common in background discussions, introducing a research field, existing method, or system before identifying problems, limitations, complexity, or performance; also responding to broad-scope, evaluation, contrast, and example-related expressions. A few passages share only these writing functions.

patterns.name: Contrastive statements of problems or limitations
patterns.context: After introducing a method, system, or research background, identifying difficulties, defects, scaling bottlenecks, or unresolved problems; often includes evaluations such as however, problem, or failure.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, academic paper introductions, and technical discussions

patterns.name: Research-field and method background
patterns.context: Overview of a field, related technology, or existing method, and its research standing, applications, or background.

patterns.name: Complexity and scalability
patterns.context: Directly discussing the complexity or scalability of an algorithm or system, or evaluating complexity alongside performance.
patterns.domain: Machine learning, statistics, and computational methods

patterns.name: Broad fields or application scope
patterns.context: Emphasizing that researchers, professional sources, or applications span multiple fields, are numerous, or are widespread.
patterns.domain: Academic writing, patent backgrounds, and forum posts

patterns.name: Contrastive or additive transitions
patterns.context: Introducing a contrast, progression, or subsequent development after a statement; activation falls on a connective or nearby, but need not correspond to the same topic.
patterns.domain: Technical descriptions, papers, and informal writing

patterns.name: Evaluation of expected and actual performance
patterns.context: Evaluating whether a method, theory, or technology succeeds, performs well, or falls short of expectations.

patterns.name: Waiting to develop awareness or understanding
patterns.context: Describing how people need time to understand the impact of a paradigm shift; weakly related to other technical-background passages.

patterns.name: Examples of methods and systems
patterns.context: Expanding on a previously mentioned method, defect, or system by giving examples or lists.

10_2268.concept: 技术背景中的问题与评价论述
10_2268.description: 常见于背景论述中，介绍研究领域、既有方法或系统后，指出问题、局限、复杂度或性能；也响应范围广、评价、转折及举例等邻近表达，少数段落只共享这些写作功能。

patterns.name: 问题或局限的转折说明
patterns.trigger: “complicated by the fact” “bottleneck” “shortcomings” “cumbersome, however” “hur[d]led by” “central problem” “complex, bulky, and expensive”
patterns.context: 在介绍方法、系统或研究背景后，指出其困难、缺陷、规模瓶颈或待解决问题；常带 however、problem、failure 等评价。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、学术论文引言与技术讨论

patterns.name: 研究领域及方法背景
patterns.trigger: “in this field” “fundamental tools” “investigations about” “researches and techniques related to” “well-known”
patterns.context: 概述领域、相关技术或既有方法，并说明其研究地位、应用或背景。

patterns.name: 复杂度与可扩展性
patterns.context: 直接讨论算法或系统的复杂度、可扩展性，或将复杂度与性能并列评价。
patterns.domain: 机器学习、统计与计算方法

patterns.name: 广泛领域或应用范围
patterns.trigger: “various fields” “numerous researchers” “various sources of expertise” “widely it would be used”
patterns.context: 强调研究者、专业来源或应用范围跨领域、数量众多或传播广泛。
patterns.domain: 学术论述、专利背景及论坛文字

patterns.name: 转折或递进连接表达
patterns.context: 在陈述后引入转折、递进或后续发展；激活落在连接词或其附近，但未必对应同一主题。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、论文与非正式文字

patterns.name: 关于预期与实际表现的评价
patterns.context: 评价方法、理论或技术是否成功、表现良好或未达预期。

patterns.name: 等待形成认知或理解
patterns.trigger: “we can even get a feel for the space”
patterns.context: 描述范式变化后，人们需经过一段时间才能理解其影响；与其他技术背景段落关联较弱。

patterns.name: 方法、系统的实例陈述
patterns.context: 以举例或列举方式展开先前提及的方法、缺陷或系统。

en.concept: Background explanations and descriptions of difficulties
en.description: Activations span several fields and commonly appear in paper or patent backgrounds introducing recent progress, existing methods and limitations, and problems involving difficulty, burden, or scale. Other local patterns include exemption conditions with “without,” luck, automation, and marketing, which are difficult to reduce to a single semantic category.

patterns.name: without ever/without having to
patterns.context: Describes users completing an action without directly contacting a service provider or reading an entire article; may also express a more general exemption condition

patterns.name: Recent progress and research background
patterns.context: Academic-style introduction of a field, method, or technology’s existing progress and significance, often in background or introduction paragraphs

patterns.name: Difficulty, complexity, or burden
patterns.context: Points out that existing processes or systems are difficult to handle because of scale, workload, or operational complexity
patterns.domain: Patent background, system and process descriptions

patterns.name: Examples and prior art in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Patent background sections describe existing technology, give examples, or point out limitations of prior solutions

patterns.name: Cross-disciplinary lists
patterns.context: Explains that a research topic spans multiple disciplines and lists the fields

patterns.name: Difficulty matching large volumes of assets
patterns.context: Costs, labor, and asset records in distributed enterprises are difficult to reconcile, involving large numbers of records or assets

patterns.name: Process automation and reduced interpersonal contact
patterns.context: Envisions outsourcing or automating business processes so customers can make purchases, return items, or file complaints themselves

patterns.name: PID controller performance and classical methods
