patterns.context: Introduces PID controller parameter design and a known tuning method

patterns.name: Speech recognition and dictation
patterns.context: Describes devices and technical progress for computers to record or organize spoken content

patterns.name: Accidental success and luck
patterns.context: Contrasts personal ideas with observing real-world opportunities, suggesting that the former may be due purely to luck

patterns.name: Insufficient effectiveness of a patent solution
patterns.context: Patent background points out that prior solutions fail to meet requirements observed by the inventor; the sentence is incomplete later on

patterns.name: Burdensome fluid-processing system
patterns.context: Describes a fluid-processing system and flushing semiconductor equipment, evaluating the system as inconvenient to operate

patterns.name: Question-based content strategy
patterns.context: Recommends using easy-to-answer questions related to the content to attract social media users

patterns.name: Graph neural networks and dynamic graphs
patterns.context: Studies dynamic graph methods for encoding the temporal evolution of relational data
patterns.domain: Machine learning and graph learning papers

10_2268.concept: 背景说明与困难表述
10_2268.description: 激活跨多个领域，常见于论文或专利背景中介绍近期进展、既有方法与局限，以及指出困难、繁重或规模问题；另有 without 免除条件、运气、自动化与营销等局部模式，难归于单一语义。

patterns.name: without ever/without having to
patterns.trigger: “without”后接“ever”“having to”，或“without”引出的免除某种接触、操作或额外要求的表达；强激活落在 without（以及第3、10段中的 having）
patterns.context: 描述用户无需直接接触服务提供者，或无需阅读整篇文章即可完成某事；也可能是更一般的免除条件

patterns.name: 近期进展与研究背景
patterns.trigger: “recent success”“recent advances”，以及“fundamental tools”“field”“researchers”等研究背景词；第1、2、5段中相关词语激活
patterns.context: 论文式介绍领域、方法或技术的既有进展和重要性，常出现在背景或引言段

patterns.name: 困难、复杂或繁重
patterns.context: 指出既有流程或系统因规模、工作量或操作复杂而难以处理
patterns.domain: 专利背景、系统与流程描述

patterns.name: 专利背景中的例示与既有技术
patterns.trigger: “For example”“well-known in this field”及“solutions described previously”；这些既有方法或方案的介绍处有激活
patterns.context: 专利背景部分陈述已有技术、举例或指出既有方案的局限

patterns.name: 跨领域列举
patterns.context: 说明研究议题涉及多个学科，并列举领域

patterns.name: 大量资产造成的匹配困难
patterns.context: 分布式企业的成本、劳动与资产记录难以匹配，涉及大量记录或资产

patterns.name: 流程自动化与减少人际接触
patterns.context: 设想外包或自动化业务流程，使顾客可自行完成购买、退货或投诉

patterns.name: PID控制器性能与经典方法
patterns.context: 介绍PID控制器参数设计及一种已知调参方法

patterns.name: 语音识别与听写
patterns.context: 描述计算机记录或整理口述内容的设备和技术进展

patterns.name: 偶然成功与运气
patterns.context: 对个人构想与观察现实机会作对比，认为前者可能纯靠运气

patterns.name: 专利方案效果不足
patterns.context: 专利背景中指出先前方案无法满足发明人观察到的要求；句子后续内容不完整

patterns.name: 流体处理系统笨重
patterns.context: 描述流体处理系统及冲洗半导体设备时，评价系统操作不便
patterns.domain: 半导体与流体处理专利

patterns.name: 提问式内容策略
patterns.trigger: “Ask A Question”“Ask an engaging question”及“easy enough”
patterns.context: 建议用易回答、与内容相关的问题吸引社交媒体用户

patterns.name: 图神经网络与动态图
patterns.context: 研究动态图方法以编码关系数据的时间演化
patterns.domain: 机器学习与图学习论文

en.description: Activations span heterogeneous phrases: negative dis- stems, evaluations of computational burden, uncertainty about terminology or statements of being a beginner, lists of disciplines, technical citations, references to luck, and differential-algebra terminology; there is no clear unified semantic or stylistic condition.

patterns.name: dis-/disappointment and negative feelings
patterns.context: The stem dis- combines with a subsequent negative-emotion word; examples describe a response as disheartening and a business outcome as disappointing

patterns.name: Computational cost and efficiency limits
patterns.context: Describing the computational burden, scope of applicability, and efficiency issues of existing solutions

patterns.name: Terminology uncertainty and self-positioning as a beginner
patterns.context: The questioner is unsure whether a term is common, or says the question may be basic and mainly concerns terminology

patterns.name: Mathematics/science field names and discipline lists
patterns.context: Scientific or academic texts listing fields, disciplines, or interdisciplinary directions
patterns.domain: Academic papers and research project abstracts

patterns.name: Terms or citation fragments in academic references
patterns.context: Reference entries containing speech recognition, neural networks, and journal names
patterns.domain: Technical literature citations in patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Statements of accidental success near luck
patterns.context: Attributing the chance of discovery or success to pure luck

patterns.name: Differential algebra statements
patterns.context: Discussing solvability, differential field towers, and specialized differential algebra content

10_2268.concept: none
10_2268.description: 激活覆盖异质短语：负面失望词干、计算负担评价、术语不确定或基础性自述、学科列举、技术引文、luck表述及微分代数术语；没有明显统一的语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: dis-/失望及负面感受
patterns.context: 词干 dis- 与后续负面情绪词组合；分别描述回应令人灰心，以及商业上失望

patterns.name: 计算成本与效率限制
patterns.trigger: «computational»8« effort»4«,»10« work»5« with»8« a»6« very»7« limited»5« and»5« inefficient»2« matrix»2
patterns.context: 描述既有方案的计算负担、适用范围和效率问题

patterns.name: 术语不确定及基础性自我定位
patterns.trigger: «just»10« missed»2；«mostly»3« a»7« matter»6« of»9« terminology»4；«quite»5« basic»4
patterns.context: 提问者不确定术语是否常见，或说明问题可能基础、主要是术语问题

patterns.name: 数学／科学领域名称与学科列举
patterns.trigger: «e»4«.»4«g»3«.,»10« computer»9« science»6«,»9« statistics»5« and»8« mathematics»6；«physical»9« and»6 biological»7« sciences»4
patterns.context: 科学或学术文本列举领域、学科或跨学科方向
patterns.domain: 学术论文与研究项目摘要

patterns.name: 学术参考文献中的术语或引文片段
patterns.trigger: «Ph»2«on»3«eme»3« recognition»2« using»5 time«-»3«delay»3« neural»3« networks»3；«IEEE»5« Trans»4«.»10 Ac«oust»1«ics»1«.»4« Speech»2
patterns.context: 参考文献条目中出现语音识别、神经网络及期刊名称
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的技术文献引文

patterns.name: luck附近的偶然成功表述
patterns.context: 把发现机会或成功归因于纯粹运气

patterns.name: 微分代数领域表述
patterns.trigger: «differential»2« algebra»2« field»4；«ascending» tower»1« of differential» fields»3
patterns.context: 讨论可解性、微分域塔及微分代数专业内容

en.description: Activations most consistently fall on commas, periods, line breaks, and adjacent tokens. They also cover within-word subword fragments, technical terms, legal citation formats, and a few content words that are semantically inconsistent with one another.

patterns.name: Commas at word boundaries
patterns.context: Activation occurs after or near commas, especially on punctuation and subword fragments following commas; for example, [1] «,»6«↵»2«if» and [2] «,»2« N»2«.»10«C»
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, citations, and legal documents

patterns.name: Periods and abbreviation punctuation
patterns.context: Periods themselves or letters and punctuation immediately following them often activate; this is not limited to sentence endings
patterns.domain: References, legal citations, patent texts, and general text

patterns.name: Tokenization or subword-fragment boundaries
patterns.context: When a word is split into multiple tokens, some subword fragments activate; the word meanings are not consistent
patterns.domain: General text, technical terminology, and patent texts

patterns.name: Line breaks and paragraph beginnings
patterns.context: Line-break markers or the beginnings of new paragraphs after line breaks show weaker activation; also appears in legal text with layout and pagination
patterns.domain: Forum posts, papers, and legal documents

patterns.name: Technical literature citations and terminology
patterns.context: Technical references mix authors, titles, journal names, and abbreviations; activation is concentrated on terminology fragments and punctuation
patterns.domain: Speech recognition and neural network literature

patterns.name: Legal case citation formats
patterns.context: Activations occur near case names, state abbreviations, volume numbers, or citation punctuation
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Complex terms in patent technical descriptions
patterns.context: Complex terms or their internal fragments activate in descriptions of technical processes, computational difficulty, or system information management

patterns.name: Emphasis words in abstract discussion
patterns.context: Some content words also activate when discussing opportunity, luck, research fields, or statistical learning, but their meanings are inconsistent

patterns.name: List and example punctuation
patterns.context: Punctuation and adjacent tokens activate near example abbreviations and lists of disciplines

10_2268.concept: 标点与词片段边界
10_2268.description: 激活最稳定地落在逗号、句点、换行及其邻接 token；另外覆盖词内分词片段、技术术语、法律引文格式，以及少量语义上不一致的内容词。

patterns.name: 词界上的逗号
patterns.trigger: 逗号 «,»，以及逗号附近的标点
patterns.context: 逗号后或附近出现激活，尤以逗号后的标点、词片段为明显；如 [1] «,»6«↵»2«if»、[2] «,»2« N»2«.»10«C»
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本、引文与法律文书

patterns.name: 句号与缩写标点
patterns.context: 句点本身或紧接句点的字母、标点容易激活；并非只限句末
patterns.domain: 参考文献、法律引文、专利及一般文本

patterns.name: 分词或词片段边界
patterns.context: 单词被拆分成多个 token 时，某些词片段获得激活；所涉词义不统一
patterns.domain: 一般文本、技术术语与专利文本

patterns.name: 换行与段落起始
patterns.context: 换行标记或换行后新段开头出现较弱激活；也见于排版、分页的法律文本
patterns.domain: 论坛帖子、论文与法律文书

patterns.name: 技术文献引用与术语
patterns.context: 技术参考文献中作者、题名、刊名及缩写混排，激活集中在术语片段和标点
patterns.domain: 语音识别与神经网络文献

patterns.name: 法律案件引文格式
patterns.context: 判例名称、州名缩写、卷号或引文标点相邻时出现激活

patterns.name: 专利技术说明中的复杂词
patterns.context: 技术过程、计算难度或系统信息管理的描述中，复杂术语或其内部片段激活

patterns.name: 抽象论述中的强调词
patterns.context: 谈论机会、运气、研究领域或统计学习时，若干内容词也出现激活，但彼此语义不一致

patterns.name: 列表与举例标点
patterns.context: 举例缩写及并列学科列表附近，标点和相邻 token 激活

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions of doubt, negation, questioning, and limitations of methods or claims, often appearing in first-person qualifications and technical discussions; also includes a legal-evidence passage and dis- word-form triggers, which cannot be unified into a single theme.

patterns.name: Uncertainty, doubt, and questioning
patterns.context: Expressing uncertainty or doubt about a term, claim, method, or assumption, or identifying its limitations; often accompanied by contrastive terms such as “but” or “however”

patterns.name: Negative or absent responses
patterns.context: Describing no response, not having encountered a usage, or not finding relevant information

patterns.name: Retrospection and self-qualification
patterns.context: A first-person speaker qualifies their judgment, experience, or knowledge

patterns.name: Professional technical problems, methods, or complexity
patterns.context: Discussing algorithms, computational cost, technical steps, models, or the properties and limitations of methods
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic papers and patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Legal evidence and case citations
patterns.context: Legal text stating that evidence may rebut testimony and citing case law

patterns.name: Relaying another person's view and responding with rebuttal or requests for evidence
patterns.context: First acknowledging or assuming that a claim may be true, then asking for evidence or expressing reservations

patterns.name: Research questions and limitations in academic writing
patterns.context: Introducing research questions, applicability conditions, or method defects; formal tone

patterns.name: Lexical triggers in dis- prefixed words
patterns.context: Activation falls inside negative-evaluation words with dis-, but the contexts vary, so it is unclear whether this is a stable trigger independent of doubt or negation patterns

patterns.name: Other technical discussions
patterns.context: Topics vary; these snippets alone do not establish that the topic words themselves are triggers
patterns.domain: Mathematical physics, software Q&A, and programming discussions

10_2268.concept: 质疑与局限表达
10_2268.description: 主要响应怀疑、否定、质疑及对方法或主张的局限说明，也常见于第一人称自我限定和技术论述；另有法律证据段及 dis- 词形触发，不能归并成单一主题。

patterns.name: 不确定性、怀疑与质疑
patterns.trigger: “not sure”“dubious”“I’ve never heard”“hasn’t helped”“need to see some citations”“fragile”“suffers from errors”
patterns.context: 对术语、主张、方法或假设表示不确定、怀疑，或指出其局限；常带有“but”“however”一类转折
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、问答、学术论文

patterns.name: 否定或缺失的回应
patterns.trigger: “lack of response”“not ... sure”“never heard”“never seen”“hasn’t helped”
patterns.context: 描述没有回应、没有见过某种用法，或没有找到相关信息

patterns.name: 事后反思与自我限定
patterns.trigger: “I’d need to see”“I’m a little dubious”“Perhaps I’ve just”“I’ve never”“I’m not sure”
patterns.context: 第一人称发言者限定自己的判断、经验或知识范围

patterns.name: 专业技术问题、方法或复杂度
patterns.context: 讨论算法、计算成本、技术步骤、模型或方法的性质与局限
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文与专利背景

patterns.name: 法律证据与判例引述
patterns.trigger: “objective evidence”“witness’s story”“testimony”“Anderson v. City of Bessemer City”
patterns.context: 法律文本中陈述证据可能反驳证词，并引用判例

patterns.name: 转述他人观点并提出反驳或索证
patterns.trigger: “It may be true ... but”“Perhaps ... wrong cars”“need to see some citations”
patterns.context: 先承认或假设某主张可能成立，随后要求证据或表达保留

patterns.name: 学术写作中的研究问题与限制
patterns.trigger: “The central problem”“Such problems occur”“assumption is usually valid ... but rather fragile”“suffers from errors”
patterns.context: 介绍研究问题、适用条件或方法缺陷；语气较正式

patterns.name: dis- 前缀词中的词汇触发
patterns.context: 激活落在带 dis- 的负面评价词内部，但上下文不同，不能确定是独立于怀疑或否定模式的稳定触发

patterns.name: 其他技术性讨论
patterns.context: 专业主题各异；仅凭这些片段无法确认主题词本身是触发条件
patterns.domain: 数学物理、软件问答与编程讨论

en.concept: Explanatory and interrogative expressions across varied contexts
en.description: Activations are distributed across several registers: introductions and lists of fields in academic texts, first-person questions and self-qualification in online discussions, and reader-directed questions or invitations. Other instances include commentary on opportunity and luck, lists of legal institutions, event recruitment copy, and discussions of gaming history. No single meaning or theme clearly spans all passages.

patterns.name: Field terms and lists in academic discussion
patterns.context: Formal academic register; introduces research fields, methods, or application scope, often with cross-disciplinary lists and citations.

patterns.name: First-person questions and uncertainty in conversation
patterns.context: In informal discussion, speakers use the first person to state limitations of knowledge, conjectures, or questions.

patterns.name: Reader-directed questions or calls to action
patterns.context: At the end of web copy or a conversation, asks readers a question, invites them to submit questions, or raises a topic for discussion.

patterns.name: Judgments about success, opportunity, and luck
patterns.context: Discusses how to spot opportunities, come up with ideas, and how outcomes are affected by luck.

patterns.name: Lawyer names and institutional addresses in legal documents
patterns.context: Names, law firm names, corporate designations, and city and state names are listed consecutively, without a complete expository sentence.

patterns.name: Participants and regional preferences in event promotion
patterns.context: Promotional or recruitment copy lists participants and states a preference for local and regional applicants.

patterns.name: Discussion of gaming history and authenticity
patterns.context: Recalls changes in understanding of gaming or computer history and questions whether a premise is authentic.

10_2268.concept: 多样语境中的说明与提问表达
10_2268.description: 激活分布在多种语体：学术文本的领域介绍与列举、网络讨论中的第一人称疑问和自我限定、面向读者的提问邀请；另见机会与运气的评论、法律机构名单、活动招募文案及游戏史讨论。没有明显贯穿全部片段的单一词义或主题。

patterns.name: 学术论述中的领域词与列举
patterns.trigger: “fundamental tools”, “statistical machine learning”, “various fields”, “branches of natural sciences”
patterns.context: 正式论文语体；介绍研究领域、方法或应用范围，常伴随跨领域列举和引文。

patterns.name: 对话中的第一人称疑问与不确定表达
patterns.trigger: “I’m not sure”, “I’ve never heard”, “I believed”, “I’m thinking”, “I’m speaking entirely from a layman’s view”
patterns.context: 非正式讨论中，发言者用第一人称说明知识局限、猜想或疑问。

patterns.name: 面向读者的提问或行动邀请
patterns.trigger: “Have a question”, “Submit it”, “Does timing play a much”
patterns.context: 网页文案或对话结尾处向读者提问、邀请提交问题，或抛出待讨论问题。

patterns.name: 对成功、机会与运气的判断
patterns.context: 谈论如何发现机会、提出想法以及结果受运气影响。
patterns.domain: 创业或个人经验类讨论

patterns.name: 法律文书中的律师姓名及机构地址
patterns.trigger: “LLP”, “Jerry Wertheim”, “Jones, Snead, Wertheim & Wentworth”, “Santa Fe, NM”
patterns.context: 姓名、律所名称、公司形式和城市州名连续列出，无完整论述句。

patterns.name: 活动宣传中的参与者与地域偏好
patterns.trigger: “non-profits and performers”, “Preference is given to local and regional applicants”
patterns.context: 宣传或招募文案列举参与方，并说明优先考虑本地及区域申请者。

patterns.name: 游戏史与真实性讨论
patterns.trigger: “make the game more playable”, “why would a computer even exist in the 1940s?”, “pencil-and-paper”
patterns.context: 回忆对游戏或计算机历史的理解变化，并质疑设定是否真实。

en.description: Activations are scattered across dis- negative-evaluation words, expressions of field scope, legal abbreviations and names, and a range of specialized compounds and ordinary words; aside from several local word-form and stylistic cues, no unified semantic or domain pattern emerges.

patterns.name: disingenuous word forms
patterns.context: Activation falls inside words beginning with dis- that express negative evaluation; examples include disheartening and disingenuous.

patterns.name: Field-specific expressions
patterns.context: When discussing the scope of a problem, academic fields, or branches of natural science, triggers cluster around field-scope words such as domain/field/branch and nearby expressions.
patterns.domain: Patent technology, machine learning papers, mathematics papers

patterns.name: Abbreviations in legal citations
patterns.context: Activation falls on letters and periods in state-name or legal-institution abbreviations, appearing in legal texts such as case citations or lawyer lists.

patterns.name: Compound technical terms and within-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across local fragments of compound words, affixes, or specialized terms, surrounded by technical concepts or academic discussion; these fragments have no evident unified meaning or stable position.
patterns.domain: Science fiction/military discussion, programming, patents, academic papers

patterns.name: Legal person and place entities
patterns.context: Activations are distributed around names, city/state names, and court names, co-occurring with legal-abbreviation activations in the same passage.
patterns.domain: Lawyer lists or court information in U.S. legal documents

patterns.name: Ordinary words and phrase fragments
patterns.context: These activations fall on function words, ordinary evaluative words, field-specific content words, or different positions within phrases; the available snippets do not support a consistent trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Online discussions, academic, technical, and legal texts

10_2268.concept: none
10_2268.description: 激活分散于 dis- 负面评价词、领域范围表达、法律缩写及名称，也遍布多种专业复合词和普通词语；除若干局部词形与文体线索外，未呈现统一语义或领域模式。

patterns.name: disingenuous词形
patterns.context: 激活落在以 dis- 开头、表达负面评价的词内部；包括 disheartening 和 disingenuous。

patterns.name: 领域特定表达
patterns.trigger: «domain»8« specific»4« issue»6（第7段）；«fields»8« such»3（第8段）；«branches»6« of»8« natural»5« sciences»5（第9段）
patterns.context: 在谈论问题适用范围、学科领域或自然科学分支时，触发词集中于 domain/field/branch 等领域范围词及邻近表达。
patterns.domain: 专利技术、机器学习论文、数学论文

patterns.name: 法律引文缩写
patterns.context: 激活落在州名或法律机构缩写的字母、句点组合中，出现在判例引文或律师名单等法律文本中。

patterns.name: 复合技术术语与词内片段
patterns.context: 激活散布在复合词、词缀或专业术语的局部片段中，周围是技术概念或学术论述；这些片段未见统一词义或稳定位置。
patterns.domain: 科幻／军事论述、编程、专利、学术论文

patterns.name: 法律人名地名实体
patterns.context: 激活分布在人名、城市／州名及法院名称附近，且与同段的法律缩写激活并存。
patterns.domain: 美国法律文书中的律师名单或法院信息

patterns.name: 普通词语与短语碎片
patterns.trigger: «surprising»（第1段）；«the military»、«understands»（第2段）；«access»（第5段）；«witness’s story»、«testimony»（第6段）；«predictable»（第7段）；«great importance»、«environmental sciences»（第8段）；«various»（第9段）；«argued»（第10段）
patterns.context: 这些激活落在语法词、普通评价词、领域内容词或短语中的不同位置，现有片段不足以归纳出一致的触发条件。
patterns.domain: 跨网络讨论、学术、技术及法律文本

en.concept: Description and evaluation of technical methods
en.description: Often provides an overview, comparison, or evaluation of methods, theories, models, and their applications in technical descriptions or discussions; commonly includes “in” domain phrases and judgments such as limitations or lack of widespread adoption. Topics vary widely, with a few formatting and personal-experience exceptions.

patterns.name: Statements of methods, principles, or methodology
patterns.context: Introduces a method’s use, principles, applicability, advantages and disadvantages, or comparison with other methods; often includes general judgments and explanatory clauses.
patterns.domain: Patent background, academic papers, and technical discussions

patterns.name: Technical fields or application areas introduced by “in”
patterns.context: After a technical concept or method, an “in” phrase specifies its field, application context, or use case; activation is not limited to a particular discipline.
patterns.domain: Academic papers and patent technical texts

patterns.name: Frequent phrases: methods using / using methods
patterns.context: “using methods” is followed by an established technique or a borrowed disciplinary method, in patent background describing a technical solution.

patterns.name: Negative or critical evaluations
patterns.context: States that people lack ability, that a condition or feedback is absent, that a technology is not widely adopted, or that the speaker has not seen an effective alternative; some are negative evaluations, others are qualified observations.
patterns.domain: Patents, academic papers, and Hacker News discussions

patterns.name: Body text near formatting markers and section headings
patterns.context: Body text follows a section heading, separator, or line break; these markers may not themselves be the main trigger, and occur in only a few samples.
patterns.domain: Hacker News and ArXiv document formatting

patterns.name: Patent-specific SAR and room electromagnetics
patterns.context: Uses an analogy with room acoustics to explain electromagnetic field propagation and absorption, for determining SAR.

patterns.name: Special case: physician data-entry burden
patterns.context: First describes information being collected on paper and later entered into a system, then evaluates physicians as poor at data entry.

patterns.name: Special case: personal experience and feedback on Hacker News
patterns.context: A forum poster speaks in the first person about receiving no peer response that day and expresses disappointment.

patterns.name: Special case: CNN and fluid mechanics
patterns.context: Reviews applications of CNNs in fluid mechanics and their potential advantages.
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic papers / machine learning and fluid mechanics

10_2268.concept: 技术方法的说明与评价
10_2268.description: 多在技术说明或讨论中，对方法、理论、模型及其领域应用作概述、比较或评价；常见 in 领域短语，也出现不足、未普及等判断。主题跨度很大，另有少数格式与个人经历特例。

patterns.name: 方法、原理或方法论的陈述
patterns.trigger: “using methods”, “approach”, “theory”, “estimator”, “model-based”, “It has been hypothesized”, “I’ve never encountered something that works as well”
patterns.context: 介绍某方法的使用、原理、适用性、优缺点或与其他方法的比较；常出现概括性判断和解释性从句。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、学术论文及技术讨论

patterns.name: “in”引出的技术领域或应用范围
patterns.trigger: “in basic physics”, “in material science”, “in optics”, “in signal processing”, “in wireless communications”, “in fluid mechanics”, “in computer-based public key exchange systems”
patterns.context: 技术概念或方法之后，以 in 短语说明所在领域、应用背景或使用场景；激活并不局限于某一个学科。
patterns.domain: 学术论文与专利技术文本

patterns.name: 高频短语 methods using / using methods
patterns.trigger: “using methods known in the art”以及“using methods from room acoustics”
patterns.context: using methods 后接已知技术或借用的学科方法，且处在专利对技术方案的背景介绍中。

patterns.name: 否定或不足的评价
patterns.trigger: “not particularly adept”, “lack of positional order”, “lack of response”, “not been widely used”, “haven’t seen one”
patterns.context: 陈述人员能力不足、缺乏某种条件或反馈、技术未普及，或个人未见到有效替代方案；有的属于负面评价，有的只是限定性观察。
patterns.domain: 专利、学术论文与 Hacker News 讨论

patterns.name: 形式标记与段落标题附近的正文
patterns.context: 段落标题、分隔线或换行后进入正文；这些标记本身可能不是主要触发因素，只有少数样本出现。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 与 ArXiv 文档排版

patterns.name: 专利中的 SAR 与房间电磁学特例
patterns.trigger: “determination of SAR”, “‘room electromagnetics’”, “propagation and absorption of electromagnetic fields”
patterns.context: 通过房间声学类比说明电磁场传播与吸收，用于 SAR 的确定。

patterns.name: 医生数据录入负担特例
patterns.trigger: “physicians are not particularly adept at data entry”
patterns.context: 先描述纸笔收集信息及之后录入系统，再评价医生不擅长数据录入。
patterns.domain: 专利背景／医疗信息系统

patterns.name: Hacker News 中的个人经历与反馈特例
patterns.trigger: “complete lack of response I got from fellow hackers”
patterns.context: 论坛发帖者以第一人称谈论当天没有收到同行回应，并表达失望。

patterns.name: CNN 与流体力学特例
patterns.trigger: “Increasing attention being received by CNNs in fluid mechanics”
patterns.context: 综述 CNN 在流体力学中的应用及其潜在优势。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文／机器学习与流体力学

en.description: Primarily responds to source, basis, or method relations introduced by from, as well as data processing and academic technical discussion; also appears in physics research topics, statements of research attention, and disheartening in forum posts. Several strongly activated words lack a unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Research-field sources following “from”
patterns.context: Activation falls near from and its following phrase, involving researchers' origins or the sources of theories and methods; the precise semantics differ across examples.

patterns.name: data / big data and data processing
patterns.context: Discussing data entry, storage, analysis, or migration; activations occur on these words and in related sentences.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, machine learning research, technical discussions

patterns.name: Physics research topics
patterns.context: Introducing a physics field, research topic, or related method; activation does not always fall on the same physics term.

patterns.name: Statements of research importance and attention in literature
patterns.context: Academic or technical descriptions stating that a research topic is important, has attracted attention, or that a problem is increasingly being addressed.

patterns.name: Cause, source, or basis relations
patterns.context: Describing the source, basis, or means used for an interest, reasoning ability, or technical method.

patterns.name: Researchers and expansion across fields
patterns.context: Researchers from multiple fields are attracted to areas such as statistical learning; strong activation occurs near from.

patterns.name: Migration and lack of response in a forum narrative
patterns.context: A post first mentions migrating to documents, then describes receiving no replies from other hackers; strong activation is concentrated on the subword fragment heart in disheartening.

patterns.name: Scattered activations on descriptive words
patterns.context: These words occur in different contexts, and the snippets do not support a stable, shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: Explicit technical terms and reasoning statements
patterns.context: Appears in technical descriptions of different topics; beyond academic/technical style, there is no clear shared trigger condition.

10_2268.concept: 来源与技术研究论述
10_2268.description: 主要响应 from 引出的来源、依据或方法关系，以及数据处理和学术技术论述；也见于物理研究主题、研究关注度表述及论坛帖子中的 disheartening。若干强激活词缺乏统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: “from”后接研究领域来源
patterns.context: 激活落在 from 及其后续短语附近，涉及研究者的来源或理论、方法所借鉴的来源；不同例子中具体语义不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利技术背景

patterns.name: data / big data 与数据处理
patterns.context: 讨论数据的录入、存储、分析或迁移，触发分布在这些词及相关句子中。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、机器学习研究、技术讨论

patterns.name: 物理学研究主题
patterns.trigger: applied and fundamental physics、fluid mechanics、nonlinear classical and quantum
patterns.context: 介绍物理学领域、研究主题或相关方法；激活不总落在同一物理术语上。

patterns.name: 文献中的研究重要性与关注度表述
patterns.context: 学术或技术说明中陈述研究主题的重要性、受到关注，或某问题日益受到处理。

patterns.name: 原因、来源或依据关系
patterns.trigger: partly originates from、by exploiting、uses ... methods from
patterns.context: 描述某种兴趣、推理能力或技术方法的来源、依据或所利用的手段。

patterns.name: 研究者及领域扩展
patterns.context: 统计学习等学术领域吸引来自多个领域的研究者；from 附近强激活。

patterns.name: 迁移及缺少回应的论坛叙述
patterns.trigger: migrate to a google doc；lack of response ... from fellow hackers
patterns.context: 帖子先提到迁移到文档，随后叙述未收到其他黑客回应；强激活集中在 disheartening 的 heart 子词。

patterns.name: 描述性词汇的零散激活
patterns.context: 这些词出现在不同语境中，无法从片段建立稳定、共同的触发条件。

patterns.name: 明确技术术语及推理表述
patterns.context: 出现在不同主题的技术说明中，除学术／技术文体外没有明确共享触发条件。
patterns.domain: 物理、机器学习、知识推理研究

en.concept: Statements of fields and importance in technical backgrounds
en.description: Often activates when neurons introduce research fields, methods, and systems in academic or patent backgrounds, especially with evaluative wording about importance or attention; also covers medical data entry and introductions to data mining and deep learning.

patterns.name: Statements of importance in academic paper introductions
patterns.context: Introduces a research field, method, or subject in the simple present or present perfect, emphasizing its importance, level of attention, or research value
patterns.domain: ArXiv abstracts and introductions; PubMed abstracts

patterns.name: Descriptions of methods and systems in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Explains technical methods, systems, and their applications through definitions, classifications, or background information

patterns.name: Medical information recording and data entry
patterns.context: Describes entering collected medical information into a system and contexts in which medical staff enter data
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background; medical information management

patterns.name: Introduction to data mining and machine learning fields
patterns.context: Introduces technical methods for discovering knowledge from data and related research fields
patterns.domain: Technical papers or patent-style descriptions of research fields

10_2268.concept: 技术背景中的领域与重要性陈述
10_2268.description: 神经元常在学术或专利背景中介绍研究领域、方法与系统时激活，尤其伴随重要性、关注度等评价措辞；也覆盖医疗数据录入和数据挖掘、深度学习领域介绍。

patterns.name: 学术论文引言中的重要性表述
patterns.trigger: “universal theoretical framework”“paramount importance”“great importance”“wide-spread interest”“attracted considerable attention”
patterns.context: 以一般现在时或现在完成时介绍研究领域、方法或对象，并强调其重要性、关注度或研究价值
patterns.domain: ArXiv 摘要及引言、PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: 专利背景中的方法与系统说明
patterns.trigger: “methods known in the art”“Another approach”“the present invention relates to”“systems”“methods which are referred to as”
patterns.context: 以定义、分类或背景介绍的方式说明技术方法、系统及其应用

patterns.name: 医疗信息记录与数据录入
patterns.trigger: “information must later be entered into the system”“physicians”“data entry”
patterns.context: 描述收集医疗信息后录入系统，以及医务人员录入数据的情境
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，医疗信息管理

patterns.name: 数据挖掘与机器学习领域介绍
patterns.context: 介绍从数据中发现知识的技术方法及相关研究领域
patterns.domain: 技术论文或专利式研究领域说明

en.description: Often activates in expressions of negation, lack of understanding, or lack of ability or properties; also covers degree emphasis, interactions with others, and statements about disciplines and importance. Additional activations occur on machine-learning terminology and isolated physics, statistics, and ordinary words.

patterns.name: Expressing a lack of understanding or ability
patterns.context: Describes someone not understanding a task, lacking a skill, or a field/system lacking a property; commonly occurs in expressions of negation or absence.
patterns.domain: Hacker News comments, medical-system patents, physics papers

patterns.name: Negation and negative suffixes
patterns.context: Negative words and nearby tokens activate noticeably; sometimes activation falls on “n't” in a contraction or a word related to negative meaning.

patterns.name: Statements of academic fields and their importance
patterns.context: Introduces a research topic’s discipline, scope of application, foundational status, or importance, often with abstract nouns and domain terminology.

patterns.name: Expressions of degree and emphasis
patterns.context: Uses degree adverbs, superlatives, or emphatic phrases to highlight a quality in an evaluation or discussion; sometimes paired with negation.

patterns.name: Interactions involving other people or audiences
patterns.context: Mentions other people, groups, responses, or offers advice to readers; no specific domain is required.

patterns.name: Machine-learning and data-technology terminology
patterns.context: Machine learning, data analysis, or related technology names appear directly; activation clusters near the terminology, but not every scientific passage belongs to this category.

patterns.name: Unexplained activation in scientific prose
patterns.context: Ordinary words and technical prose in fluid mechanics papers activate in ways not fully explained by the negation, lack, or field-description patterns above.

patterns.name: Unexplained word-form and local activations
patterns.context: An isolated word or local phrase triggers activation, without enough context for a unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: Unexplained local expressions in statistical physics
patterns.context: General statements in theoretical physics introductions; their surface connection with other passages is limited.

patterns.name: Unexplained local expressions in Bayesian statistics
patterns.context: Sentences in statistical learning papers involving formulas, researchers, and disciplinary origins; aside from domain terms, they are difficult to group into a more specific shared pattern.

10_2268.concept: 否定与缺乏相关表达
10_2268.description: 激活常见于否定、不了解或缺乏能力/性质的表达，也涉及程度强调、他人互动及学科领域与重要性表述；另有机器学习术语和若干孤立的物理、统计及普通词激活。

patterns.name: 表示缺乏理解或能力
patterns.trigger: “no idea”, “slightest understanding”, “not particularly adept”, “haven't seen”, “lack of positional order”
patterns.context: 描述某人不了解工作、缺乏技能或某领域/系统缺少性质；常见于否定或缺失表达。
patterns.domain: HackerNews评论、医疗系统专利、物理学论文

patterns.name: 否定与否定后缀
patterns.context: 否定词及其附近 token 有明显激活；有时落在缩写中的 n't 或否定语义相关词上。

patterns.name: 学术研究领域及其重要性表述
patterns.context: 介绍研究主题的学科归属、应用范围、基础地位或重要性，常伴随抽象名词和领域术语。

patterns.name: 程度与强调表达
patterns.context: 在评价或论述中用程度副词、最高程度表达或强调性短语突出属性；有时与否定搭配。

patterns.name: 面向他人或对象的互动叙述
patterns.trigger: “have you considered”, “people who”, “response I got from fellow hackers”, “multiple people”
patterns.context: 谈及他人、群体、回应或向读者提出建议；不要求特定领域。

patterns.name: 机器学习与数据技术术语
patterns.context: 直接出现机器学习、数据分析或相关技术名称；激活集中在术语附近，但并非所有科学段落都属于此类。

patterns.name: 未解释的科学叙述激活
patterns.context: 流体力学论文中的普通词和专业叙述出现激活，难以由上述否定、缺乏或领域归属模式完整解释。

patterns.name: 未解释的词形及局部激活
patterns.context: 孤立词或局部短语触发，缺乏足够上下文支持统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 未解释的统计物理局部表达
patterns.context: 理论物理介绍中的一般性陈述；与其他段的表面联系有限。

patterns.name: 未解释的贝叶斯统计局部表达
patterns.context: 统计学习论文中涉及公式、研究者与学科来源的句子，除领域词外难以归入更具体的共同模式。

en.concept: Mixed features of academic contexts and negative expressions
en.description: Activations show several local patterns: methods, academic fields and theoretical terminology, as well as negative expressions of experience in HackerNews/Q&A, especially n't and never. Common connectives such as from and in also activate strongly in papers, but cannot be unified into a stable semantic rule; some snippets have no clear interpretation.

patterns.name: methods
patterns.context: “methods” describes research or technical approaches; examples include “using methods from room acoustics” and “technical methods to discover knowledge.”

patterns.name: Negative expressions of not having experienced or done something
patterns.context: Negating having seen, done, or experienced something, with activations concentrated near the contraction n't and never; contexts involve personal experience or judgment.

patterns.name: Field terminology and theory names
patterns.context: Disciplinary or theoretical statements in scientific and technical passages; triggers are scattered across room electromagnetics, physics, fluid mechanics, and quantum theory contexts.

patterns.name: Descriptions of machine learning and research fields
patterns.context: Academic statements introducing applications, research fields, or researchers' origins; trigger words are often common prepositions or field terms, with no single fixed collocation.

patterns.name: Long-distance relational words and syntactic connectives
patterns.context: Connecting sources, fields, or bases within their respective syntactic structures; no clear unified local semantic condition.

10_2268.concept: 学术语境与否定表达的混合特征
10_2268.description: 激活呈多个局部模式：methods、学术领域与理论用语，以及 HackerNews/问答中否定经历表达（尤其 n't、never）。另有 from、in 等常见连接词在论文中强激活，无法归并为稳定语义规律；部分片段无清晰解释。

patterns.name: methods
patterns.context: “methods”用于描述研究或技术手段；出现于“using methods from room acoustics”和“technical methods to discover knowledge”等表达。
patterns.domain: 专利技术背景、数据挖掘介绍

patterns.name: 未曾经历或未做过的否定表达
patterns.context: 对未见过、未做过或未经历之事的否定表达，激活集中在缩写 n't 及 never 附近；语境为个人经验或判断。

patterns.name: 领域术语及理论名称
patterns.context: 科学技术文段中的学科或理论表述；触发分散在房间电磁学、物理学、流体力学及量子理论语境。

patterns.name: 机器学习与研究领域描述
patterns.context: 介绍应用、研究领域或研究者来源的学术表述；触发词本身多为常见介词或领域词，未呈现单一固定搭配。

patterns.name: 远距离关系词与句法连接
patterns.context: 在各自句法结构中连接来源、领域或依据；没有明显统一的局部语义条件。

en.concept: First-person expressions and local word forms
en.description: Activation often falls on first-person experiences, lack of knowledge, or uncertainty in forum posts, especially the contraction ending in “haven’t”; it also covers function words in academic and patent texts, narrative expressions of cognition, class discussions, repeated emphasis, and several fragments. No single semantic pattern explains all cases.

patterns.name: Colloquial local collocations with “haven’t”
patterns.context: The negative contraction “haven’t” appears in first-person statements about experiences, attempts, or knowledge; activation concentrates on the ending “'t,” sometimes also marking the preceding “haven.”

patterns.name: First-person expressions of uncertainty or requests for help
patterns.context: The speaker uses the first person to acknowledge uncertainty, unfamiliarity, or lack of expertise; activation falls on “I,” a contraction, or a negative word.

patterns.name: First-person opinions, experiences, and evaluations
patterns.context: First-person narration of personal experience, judgment, ability, or cognition; not limited to negative sentences.

patterns.name: Function words and domain terminology in academic prose
patterns.context: In academic or patent-style explanations, ordinary function words, prepositions, conjunctions, and nearby technical terms are marked; no stable trigger based on a single term is apparent.

patterns.name: First-person expressions of cognition in narratives
patterns.context: A narrator expresses not knowing something in response to an event or experience; unlike technical self-evaluation in forums, the context is storytelling.

patterns.name: Discussion of social-class labels
patterns.context: Discusses upbringing, social status, or occupational class labels; activation is distributed across neighboring words rather than a clear fixed substring.

patterns.name: Local emphasis through repeated quantifiers or words
patterns.context: Complains that managers keep demanding more features or output, with repetition creating emphasis.

patterns.name: Unclear technical fragments and sentence-initial fragments
patterns.context: Local tokens from code/Q&A fragments or truncated sentences; there is insufficient context to infer a shared semantic trigger.

10_2268.concept: 第一人称表达与局部词形
10_2268.description: 激活较常落在论坛中的第一人称经验、无知或不确定表达，尤其 haven’t 的缩写尾部；也覆盖学术及专利文本的功能词、叙事认知表达、阶层讨论、重复强调和若干残片，未见单一语义模式解释全部现象。

patterns.name: haven’t 的口语化局部搭配
patterns.context: 否定缩写 haven’t 出现在第一人称对经历、尝试或了解情况的陈述中；激活集中在缩写尾部“'t”，有时前面的 haven 也标记。

patterns.name: 第一人称不确定或求助表达
patterns.context: 说话者用第一人称承认不确定、不熟悉或缺乏专业知识；激活落在 I、缩写或否定词上。

patterns.name: 第一人称观点、经验与评价
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述个人经验、判断、能力或认知；并非只限于否定句。

patterns.name: 学术论述中的功能词及领域术语
patterns.context: 学术或专利式说明中，普通功能词、介词、连词及其邻近的专业术语被标记；看不出稳定的单一术语触发。

patterns.name: 叙事中的第一人称认知表达
patterns.context: 叙述者面对事件或经历时表达不知道；不同于论坛中的技术性自我评价，语境是故事叙述。

patterns.name: 社群阶层标签相关讨论
patterns.context: 讨论出身、社会地位或职业阶层标签；激活分布在邻近词而非明显固定子串。

patterns.name: 连续量词或重复词的局部强调
patterns.context: 抱怨管理者不断要求增加功能或产出，重复词形成强调。

patterns.name: 不明的技术片段与句首残片
patterns.context: 代码／问答残片或截断句子的局部 token；没有足够上下文归纳为同一语义触发。

en.description: Activation is scattered across common function words in English texts from different domains, statements of academic importance, patent template sentences, lists of proper nouns, colloquial negation, and word fragments and formatting markers; it also covers science-fiction military technology and casual climate discussion, with no single semantic theme.

patterns.name: English function words and prepositions
patterns.context: In ordinary English sentences, activation mainly falls on common prepositions, negative words, and other function words; surrounding semantics and grammatical positions vary.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, papers, Q&A, and forum texts

patterns.name: Statements about research and importance
patterns.context: In academic contexts, describes research fields, theoretical frameworks, research attention, or importance; activation may also fall on common words in the sentence rather than specialized terms.

patterns.name: Legal and patent-style background statements
patterns.context: Formal descriptions of background technology, existing methods, or unmet needs, often using template phrasing to introduce a new solution or need.

patterns.name: Named entities and list-style enumeration
patterns.context: People, organizations, company names, and locations appear consecutively, with commas, abbreviations, and punctuation within proper names.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia introductions and legal document signatures/addresses

patterns.name: Colloquial negation and personal judgments
patterns.context: First-person, informal communication expresses uncertainty, negation, or personal preferences.
patterns.domain: StackExchange Q&A and Hacker News comments

patterns.name: Word-token morphology and split fragments
patterns.context: A word is split into multiple tokens; activation falls on a local word fragment, while sentence topics vary.

patterns.name: Formatting markers and characters
patterns.context: Activation occurs near Q&A tags, legal abbreviations, citations, or formatting markers, and may reflect formatting rather than topic.
patterns.domain: Web Q&A, legal documents, and academic citations

patterns.name: Science-fiction and military-technology discussion
patterns.context: Discusses science fiction, human enhancement, and the military’s understanding or repurposing of advanced technology.

patterns.name: Residence and casual climate discussion
patterns.context: Uses second-person and hypothetical phrasing to discuss regional climate, living experience, and personal preferences.

10_2268.concept: 英文句法与文本结构片段
10_2268.description: 激活分散在跨领域英文文本的常见功能词、学术重要性表述、专利模板句、专名列举、口语否定及断词和格式标记；也覆盖科幻军事技术与气候闲谈，未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 英文功能词与介词
patterns.context: 主要在普通英文句子中，激活落在常见介词、否定词等功能词上；前后语义和语法位置并不一致。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文散文、论文、问答和论坛文本

patterns.name: 研究与重要性表述
patterns.trigger: “fundamental tools”“field attracts numerous researchers from various fields”（2）；“universal theoretical framework”“paramount importance”“applied and fundamental physics”（3）；“Increasing attention being received”（1）
patterns.context: 学术语境中陈述研究领域、理论框架、研究关注度或重要性；激活也可能落在句中常见词上，而非专属术语。

patterns.name: 法律专利式背景陈述
patterns.trigger: “Another approach”；“uses the concept”；“theory which studies”；“methods from”（4）；“There is an unmet need, therefore, for a simple”（7）
patterns.context: 以背景技术、已有方法或未满足需求为主题的正式说明，常用引入新方案或需求的模板句式。

patterns.name: 实体名称与名录式列举
patterns.trigger: “Yahoo, Google, IBM, Lockheed Martin, Oracle, Boeing and Microsoft”（9）；“Edward S. Wisneski, Patton Boggs, … Washington, DC”（8）
patterns.context: 人名、机构名、公司名及地点连续出现，伴随逗号、缩写和专名内部标点。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia介绍与法律文书署名/地址

patterns.name: 口语否定与个人判断
patterns.trigger: “I'm not very sure what is your problem”（6）；“I'm not so … it doesn't matter to me”（10）
patterns.context: 第一人称、非正式交流中表达不确定、否定或个人偏好。

patterns.name: 分词形态与断词片段
patterns.context: 词被拆成多个 token；激活落在局部词片段，所在句子主题各异。

patterns.name: 格式标记与字符
patterns.context: 激活出现在问答标签、法律缩写、引文或排版标记附近，可能反映格式而非主题。
patterns.domain: 网页问答、法律文书与学术引文

patterns.name: 科幻与军事技术论述
patterns.context: 讨论科幻、人类增强及军事对先进技术的理解或再利用。

patterns.name: 居住地与气候闲谈
patterns.context: 以第二人称和假设口吻谈地区气候、生活体验及个人偏好。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on degree adverbs or degree expressions, especially “overly,” “very,” “so,” “extremely,” and “from” in cross-domain contexts; these passages respectively concern self-evaluation, academic scope, caution, and busyness, and their trigger words and meanings do not fully align.

patterns.name: Negative self-evaluation modified by “overly” and other degree adverbs
patterns.context: Degree adverbs intensify statements about one’s own ability, certainty, or level of concern; [1] and [4] directly contain “not overly,” while the others merely feature degree adverbs in similar self-report contexts
patterns.domain: StackExchange Q&A and colloquial forum posts

patterns.name: Generalized statements about fields, branches, or applications in academic texts
patterns.context: Discusses theories, research fields, or applications, emphasizing coverage across multiple fields, disciplinary branches, or sources; trigger positions vary

patterns.name: Excessive caution
patterns.context: The speaker self-evaluates as possibly being too cautious

patterns.name: Degree adverbs emphasizing busyness
patterns.context: Uses a degree adverb to emphasize that physicians are extremely busy and have no time to enter data

10_2268.concept: 程度强化表达
10_2268.description: 激活主要落在程度副词或程度表达上，尤其是 overly、very、so、extremely，以及跨领域语境中的 from；这些段落分别涉及自我评价、学术范围、谨慎和忙碌，触发词与语义并不完全一致。

patterns.name: “overly”及程度副词修饰的负面自我评价
patterns.trigger: « overly»10（[1]、[4]）；另有 « very»10 sure（[2]）及 « so»10 concerned（[6]）
patterns.context: 程度副词加强对自身能力、确定性或担忧程度的表述；[1]、[4]直接出现“not overly”，其余只是程度副词出现在相近的自述语境中

patterns.name: 学术文本中领域、分支或应用范围的泛化表达
patterns.trigger: « applied»10 and fundamental physics（[3]）；branches of « physics»10（[7]）；originates « from»10（[5]）；researchers « from»10 various fields（[8]）
patterns.context: 讨论理论、研究领域或应用时，强调覆盖多个领域、学科分支或来源；触发位置并不完全一致

patterns.name: 过度谨慎
patterns.context: 说话者以自我评价方式表示自己可能过于谨慎

patterns.name: 程度副词强调忙碌
patterns.context: 以程度副词强调医生非常忙、没有时间录入数据

en.concept: Statements evaluating importance and problem status
en.description: Activations occur across multiple genres. Prominent cues include academic evaluations of research importance, attention, potential, and technical challenges; other scattered patterns include unmet needs in patents, informal evaluations of efficiency or understanding, commercial projects, and crime narratives. No unified lexical trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Statements of widespread interest and importance
patterns.context: Academic discussion emphasizes that a topic has attracted broad attention or is significant; common collocations include wide, interest/importance, years/progress.

patterns.name: Unmet needs in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: After describing an existing problem, the background section introduces a required solution using unmet need.

patterns.name: Potential and attention around technical methods
patterns.context: Introducing a technical method's capabilities, advantages, or growing attention; here, the application of CNNs to fluid mechanics.

patterns.name: Informal evaluation of efficiency
patterns.context: In a Q&A opening, using the first person to evaluate one's own lack of proficiency or efficiency at doing something.

patterns.name: Introducing foundational research topics
patterns.context: A paper introduction describes its research subject as fundamental, important, or noteworthy.

patterns.name: Criticism of lack of understanding
patterns.context: Commenting that others do not understand the author's work or the subject being discussed, in a tone of dissatisfaction.

patterns.name: Commercial companies and project reporting
patterns.context: News-style account of companies proposing or competing for large infrastructure construction projects.

patterns.name: Criminal experience and personal testimony
patterns.context: After recounting a crime, expressing the first-person witness's attitude or feelings.

patterns.name: Technology maturity and precision challenges
patterns.context: Discussing quantum technology development, equipment requirements, or engineering challenges yet to be overcome.

10_2268.concept: 评价重要性与问题状态的表述
10_2268.description: 激活分布于多种文体，较突出的线索是学术文本对研究重要性、关注度、潜力及技术挑战的评价；另有专利未满足需求、口语效率或理解评价、商业项目与犯罪叙述等零散模式，未见统一词法触发。

patterns.name: 广泛兴趣与重要性表述
patterns.context: 学术论述中强调某主题受到广泛关注或具有重要意义，常见搭配为 wide、interest/importance、years/progress。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的未满足需求
patterns.context: 背景技术描述现有问题后，以 unmet need 引出所需解决方案。

patterns.name: 技术方法的潜力与关注
patterns.context: 介绍某技术方法的能力、优势或日益受到关注；此处指 CNN 在流体力学中的应用。

patterns.name: 口语化效率评价
patterns.context: 问答开场中以第一人称评价自身做某事不够熟练或高效。

patterns.name: 基础研究主题的引介
patterns.trigger: “fundamental and wide-ranging importance”“The study of first-order phase transitions is a fascinating subject”
patterns.context: 论文导言将研究对象描述为基础、重要或引人关注的主题。

patterns.name: 缺乏理解的批评
patterns.context: 评论他人不理解作者或所讨论工作的内容，语气带有不满。

patterns.name: 商业公司与项目报道
patterns.context: 新闻式叙述公司提出或竞争大型基础设施建设项目。

patterns.name: 犯罪经历与个人见证
patterns.trigger: “these horrible crimes”“I have never felt that way”
patterns.context: 叙述犯罪事件后，以第一人称表达亲历者态度或感受。

patterns.name: 技术成熟度与精度挑战
patterns.context: 讨论量子技术的发展、设备要求或尚待克服的工程挑战。

en.description: Primarily responds to statements in introductions emphasizing a research field’s importance, interest, or challenges; also activates on technical-progress background, contrasts between foundational and emerging fields, and specific expressions in business, design advice, personal narratives, and programming help.

patterns.name: Statements of research interest and background
patterns.context: Introduces a field’s longstanding importance, research challenges, or broad attention in an introduction or abstract, often followed by a field specification such as “in physics.”
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic paper introductions, especially physics and quantum systems research

patterns.name: Technical progress as motivation for research
patterns.context: An academic introduction uses advances in technical capabilities as background before introducing a method or simulation work.
patterns.domain: ArXiv engineering, computing, and machine-learning papers

patterns.name: Foundational knowledge paired with emerging technology
patterns.context: Describes a discipline, education, or research field, pairing “fundamental” with applications, emerging technologies, or importance.
patterns.domain: Educational institution introductions and academic papers

patterns.name: Entrepreneurship and business vocabulary
patterns.context: In business education or entrepreneurship contexts, involves founding businesses, entrepreneurship, venture capital, or products.

patterns.name: Advice on design services and client collaboration
patterns.context: Addresses designers or freelancers, discussing client requirements, designer collaboration, and quality of deliverables.

patterns.name: Denial or uncertainty in a narrative
patterns.context: A first-person narrative expresses not knowing something or having limited information; in this example, it directly follows an account of an injured person being rescued.

patterns.name: Personal admission of insufficient research
patterns.context: Recounts a personal experience, admitting to insufficient research beforehand and mentioning an undiscovered risk or complication.
patterns.domain: Personal accounts, reports of medical experiences

patterns.name: Simple implementation requests in programming questions
patterns.context: The questioner describes a specific implementation difficulty in Android game development, distinguishing irrelevant details from the current problem.

10_2268.concept: 重要性与动机陈述
10_2268.description: 主要响应引言中强调研究领域重要性、兴趣或挑战的表述；另对技术进步背景、基础与新兴领域并列，以及商业、设计建议、个人叙述和编程求助中的若干特定表达有激活。

patterns.name: 研究兴趣与背景陈述
patterns.trigger: “has been for decades a topic of primary interest”“has attracted the wide-spread interest in recent years”“is a big challenge of current research”
patterns.context: 引言或摘要中概述某领域长期重要性、研究挑战或广泛关注，常接“in physics”等领域说明。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文引言，尤其物理与量子系统研究

patterns.name: 技术进步引出研究动机
patterns.trigger: “With advances in computing power and computational algorithms”
patterns.context: 论文引言以技术能力进步作为背景，转入某方法或模拟工作的介绍。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 工程、计算与机器学习论文

patterns.name: 基础知识与新兴技术并列
patterns.context: 描述学科、教育或研究领域时，将 fundamental 与应用、新兴技术或重要性并列。
patterns.domain: 教育机构介绍及学术论文

patterns.name: 创业与商业活动词汇
patterns.context: 商业教育或创业语境，涉及创办企业、创业、风险投资或产品。

patterns.name: 设计服务与客户协作建议
patterns.trigger: “tell the client that you can get a designer”“work with them”“pixel perfect design”
patterns.context: 面向设计师或自由职业者，讨论客户要求、设计师协作与交付质量。

patterns.name: 叙述中的否认或不确定
patterns.context: 第一人称叙事中表达不知道某事、承认信息有限；本例紧接受伤者获救经历。

patterns.name: 个人承认未做充分调查
patterns.trigger: “I admit I didn’t research it much”“I never got told about the risks”
patterns.context: 引述个人经历，承认事前研究不足并提及未获知风险或并发症。
patterns.domain: 个人陈述、医疗经历报道

patterns.name: 编程问题中的简单实现需求
patterns.trigger: “simple space invaders type shooter”“I’m having trouble making the bullets kill the enemies”
patterns.context: 提问者描述安卓游戏开发中的具体实现困难，区分不关心的细节与当前问题。

en.description: Activation is distributed across several genres: it prominently covers English negation; several papers introduce research topics, their importance, or academic interest; other cases involve data mining, blue-collar identity, programming help, and scattered technical or physics content. No single semantic theme explains all passages.

patterns.name: Negative words in expressions of negation
patterns.context: Negative words appear in negative statements in spoken or written English; strong activation does not require the following content to be the same.
patterns.domain: Narratives, forum comments, Q&A, and technical texts

patterns.name: Statements of research interest in academic introductions
patterns.context: Introduces the significance, generality, or importance of a research topic, commonly in paper introductions.

patterns.name: Use of “interest” in academic prose
patterns.context: “interest” refers to research attention or broad attention in academia, rather than personal interest.

patterns.name: Introduction to the field of data mining
patterns.context: Explains big data and methods for knowledge discovery, introducing them as a research field.
patterns.domain: Data science or technical expository prose

patterns.name: Discussion of blue-collar social identity
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship between upbringing, background, social status, and occupational class labels.

patterns.name: Imperative or subjectless “do”
patterns.context: “do” in the phrase “to do with ...,” continuing a comparison of background and social status.

patterns.name: Bullets and enemies in video-game programming
patterns.context: The questioner describes bullet and enemy logic in an Android space shooter game.

patterns.name: Uncertain requests for help in technical Q&A
patterns.context: The respondent says they are unsure what the questioner’s problem is, following a request for help.

patterns.name: Fragments not explained by a shared topic
patterns.context: These include an expression of unawareness in a personal narrative, an introduction to phase-transition research, content from a Hamiltonian model and Vlasov equation paper, and research interest in open quantum systems; apart from local words or genre, they cannot be grouped into one specific topic.

10_2268.concept: 英语否定与学术引言词汇
10_2268.description: 激活分布于多种文体：显著覆盖英语否定表达；数篇论文引言强调研究主题、重要性或学术兴趣；另有数据挖掘、蓝领身份、程序求助及零散技术或物理内容，未见单一语义主题能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 否定表达中的否定词
patterns.context: 否定词出现在口语或书面英语的否定陈述中；强激活不要求后续内容相同。
patterns.domain: 叙事、论坛评论、问答与技术文本

patterns.name: 学术引言中的研究兴趣表述
patterns.context: 介绍研究主题的意义、普遍性或重要性，常见于论文引言。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文，尤以物理学为主

patterns.name: 学术文体中的 interest 用法
patterns.context: interest 表示研究关注或学术界的广泛关注，而非个人兴趣。

patterns.name: 数据挖掘领域介绍
patterns.context: 解释大数据及其知识发现方法，并将其引入为一个研究领域。
patterns.domain: 数据科学或技术性说明文

patterns.name: 蓝领阶层的社会身份讨论
patterns.context: 讨论 upbringing、background、social status 与职业阶层标签之间的关系。

patterns.name: 祈使式或缺省主语的 do
patterns.context: 短语 “to do with ...” 中的 do，承接前文比较背景与社会地位的关系。

patterns.name: 电子游戏编程中的子弹与敌人
patterns.context: 提问者描述 Android 太空射击游戏中的子弹与敌人逻辑。

patterns.name: 技术问答中的不确定求助回应
patterns.context: 回答者表示不确定提问者的问题所在，接续求助内容。

patterns.name: 未能由共同主题解释的片段
patterns.context: 分别是个人叙述中的不知情表达、相变研究介绍、哈密顿模型与 Vlasov 方程论文内容、开放量子系统研究兴趣；除局部词语或文体外，无法归并为同一具体主题。

en.concept: Negation and statements of research interest
en.description: Activation mainly occurs in negative first-person expressions of limited knowledge or experience, and in paper introductions declaring a topic important or widely studied; there are also activations on line breaks, function words, and scattered word forms that do not form a stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Negative self-report
patterns.context: A first-person statement of limited knowledge, experience, or confidence; commonly uses a negative contraction (especially “n't”), but no fixed sentence pattern is required.
patterns.domain: Hacker News discussions, StackExchange Q&A, and narrative texts

patterns.name: General statements of research interest
patterns.context: Academic introductions describe a research topic’s importance, attention, or broad interest.

patterns.name: Isolated function words or word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls near sentence beginnings/line breaks or on common function words and word-form fragments; surrounding text does not always fit other patterns, and the trigger cannot be determined further from the samples.

10_2268.concept: 否定与研究兴趣表述
10_2268.description: 激活主要出现在否定式第一人称表达认知或经验不足处，也出现在论文引言宣称主题重要、受广泛关注处；另有换行、功能词和零散词形激活，无法归为稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 否定式自述
patterns.trigger: "I can't imagine"、"I don't know"、"I've never encountered"、"haven't seen"、"I'm not too familiar"、"I'm not very sure"、"I'm not so concerned"
patterns.context: 第一人称陈述认知、经验或把握不足；常见为缩写否定词（特别是 n't），但不要求固定句式。

patterns.name: 一般性研究兴趣表述
patterns.trigger: "has been for decades a topic of primary interest"、"appears in many branches of physics"、"has attracted the wide-spread interest in recent years"
patterns.context: 学术引言中介绍研究主题的重要性、关注度或广泛兴趣。

patterns.name: 孤立的功能词或词形片段
patterns.context: 激活落在句首/换行附近或常见功能词、词形片段上，周围文本并不总符合其他模式；触发条件无法从样本中进一步确定。

en.description: Activations are scattered across ArXiv paper introductions and HackerNews/narrative texts, commonly appearing in academic writing about research interest, challenges, and quantum terminology, and also in colloquial uses of don’t, lack of knowledge, or unfamiliar information, as well as technical, learning, and narrative content; no single semantic trigger spans all passages.

patterns.name: Broad interest and research-importance statements in academic introductions
patterns.context: In academic paper introductions presenting a research topic, challenge, or state of the field, activations cover common function words and words such as interest, importance, and research; they are not limited to a particular technical term.
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic papers, especially physics/quantum research introductions

patterns.name: Activation on the negative contraction don’t
patterns.context: In colloquial or informal English, don’t is segmented, with activation concentrated on the contraction suffix token 't; segment 2's «haven«'t»10» also shows a similar contraction suffix, though the form is haven’t.

patterns.name: Expressions of not knowing about unfamiliar people or things
patterns.context: Local high activation occurs when informally expressing unfamiliarity, lack of understanding, or unawareness; apart from don’t, the specific words vary across passages.

patterns.name: Discussion of emerging technologies and technical applications
patterns.context: When discussing technological maturity, the relationship between technology and business, system uses, or technical capabilities, related words and surrounding function words activate; these occur in different contexts, with no single fixed collocation.
patterns.domain: ArXiv technical papers, HackerNews technology discussions

patterns.name: Advice on learning and knowledge accumulation
patterns.context: Informal advice or a summary directed at readers, discussing knowledge accumulation, learning, and their effects.

patterns.name: Open quantum systems and environmental coupling terminology
patterns.context: Quantum physics papers discuss open quantum systems, environments, and their dynamics; this pattern co-occurs with academic introductory statements about interest, but the terminology itself is not present in every academic passage.

patterns.name: Judgments about the credibility of online information sources
patterns.context: Discussing how to regard unfamiliar online authors or their opinions, emphasizing that the source is unfamiliar.

patterns.name: Complaints that managers do not understand the work
patterns.context: First-person plural narration complains that managers do not understand employees' work, while describing requirements for features and products.

patterns.name: Survival and violent events in a narrative
patterns.context: Recounting someone's survival after a terrorist attack or shooting and seeking help; high activation mainly falls on I and don’t in the narrative.

patterns.name: Standalone technology-business classification and company examples
patterns.context: Distinguishing companies primarily in technology from companies that use technology, and listing companies; in addition to the tech/business word group, proper nouns also activate.

patterns.name: Quantum device precision and fault-tolerance theory
patterns.context: Discussing precision requirements for quantum devices and quantum fault-tolerance theory.

patterns.name: Open quantum dynamics in paper metadata and titles
patterns.context: Localization, spacetime, and open quantum dynamics terminology appears in paper titles, abstracts, introductions, and other structures.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper metadata and physics abstracts

patterns.name: Descriptions of blog-system feature requirements
patterns.context: Describing requirements for a website to display recent user content and allow comments, and judging whether a blogging system meets these properties.

patterns.name: Cautious statements about trusting strangers' opinions
patterns.context: Discussing whether to believe the opinion of someone one does not know well, with a parenthetical clarification.

10_2268.concept: 英语语境中的强调性表述
10_2268.description: 激活分散在ArXiv论文引言与HackerNews/叙事文本中，常见于学术写作的研究兴趣、挑战及量子术语，也见于口语里的don’t、不了解或陌生信息，以及技术、学习和叙事内容；未见覆盖全部段落的单一语义触发。

patterns.name: 学术引言中的宽泛兴趣与研究重要性表述
patterns.context: 学术论文引言介绍研究主题、挑战或研究现状时，激活覆盖常见功能词及兴趣、重要性、研究等词；不局限于某个专业术语。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文，尤其物理/量子研究引言

patterns.name: 对否定缩写 don’t 的激活
patterns.context: 口语或非正式英文语境中，don’t 被拆分标注，激活集中在缩写后缀 token 't；段2的 «haven«'t»10» 也出现类似缩写后缀，但词形为 haven’t。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 论坛对话、Pile-CC 叙事

patterns.name: 描述陌生人或事物“不知道”的表达
patterns.context: 非正式表达不熟悉、不了解或不知情时有局部高激活；除 don’t 外，各段具体词语并不一致。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 论坛对话、Pile-CC 叙事

patterns.name: 新技术发展与技术应用的讨论
patterns.context: 谈及技术成熟、技术与商业的关系、系统用途或技术能力时，相关词和周边功能词出现激活；分属不同语境，未见单一固定搭配。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 技术论文、HackerNews 科技讨论

patterns.name: 学习与知识积累的劝诫
patterns.context: 面向读者的非正式劝诫或总结，谈知识积累、学习及其影响。

patterns.name: 量子开放系统与环境耦合术语
patterns.context: 量子物理论文中讨论开放量子系统、环境及其动力学；此模式与学术引言兴趣表述同时出现，但术语本身并非所有学术段共有。

patterns.name: 关于网络信息来源可信度的判断
patterns.context: 讨论对网上陌生作者或其意见应如何看待，强调来源不熟悉。

patterns.name: 对管理者不理解工作内容的抱怨
patterns.context: 第一人称复数叙述，抱怨管理者不了解员工工作，同时描述对功能和产品的要求。

patterns.name: 叙事中的生存与暴力事件
patterns.trigger: «How» she «survived» the «urban terrorism», the «gunshots»；“I don’t know”
patterns.context: 叙述某人经历恐怖袭击、枪击并求助后的生存情况；高激活主要落在叙述中的 I 和 don’t。

patterns.name: 单独的科技商业分类与公司举例
patterns.context: 区分主营科技的企业与使用科技的企业，并列举公司；除 tech/business 词群外，专名也有激活。

patterns.name: 量子器件精度与容错理论
patterns.context: 论述量子器件的精确度要求以及量子容错理论。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 量子计算/技术论文

patterns.name: 论文元数据与题目中的开放量子动力学
patterns.context: 论文标题、摘要引言等结构中出现局域化、时空及开放量子动力学术语。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据与物理摘要

patterns.name: 对博客系统功能需求的描述
patterns.trigger: «recent» user-generated entries；«users» to comment on them；«blogging» «system»
patterns.context: 描述网站展示近期用户内容并允许评论的需求，并判断博客系统是否满足这些属性。

patterns.name: 关于信任陌生人意见的谨慎表述
patterns.context: 讨论是否应相信一位并不熟悉的人所表达的观点，带有括号式补充说明。

en.concept: Negation and experiential judgments, alongside research and technical phrasing
en.description: The clearest signal is the negative contraction “n't” (especially in “haven't” and “don't”) and “never”; other activations occur on wording about the importance of academic research, technology receiving attention or maturing, and scattered proper nouns, paragraph boundaries, and words from varied contexts.

patterns.name: “haven’t/don’t” knowing or doing
patterns.context: “n't” in a negative auxiliary contraction, followed by expressions such as “the slightest understanding,” “seen one,” or “know,” indicating not knowing, not having seen, or not understanding something
patterns.domain: Hacker News discussions; personal narratives or opinions

patterns.name: “never”
patterns.context: Indicates that something has never happened or that a certain experience has never been gained, followed respectively by “stop learning” and “got told about the risks”
patterns.domain: Hacker News motivational comments; Pile-CC news narratives

patterns.name: Wording about research importance in academic texts
patterns.context: Introduces a research topic, field, and its importance in a paper introduction or abstract

patterns.name: Statements about attention to or development of research/technology
patterns.context: Describes a technology or research field as receiving attention or maturing, often adjacent to “attention” or “technology”

patterns.name: Proper names or entity terms
patterns.context: Appears in different contexts in “Local Area Networks” and a list of company names, with no shared syntactic condition
patterns.domain: Patent technical background; Hacker News business discussions

patterns.name: Near paragraph/sentence beginnings and line breaks
patterns.context: Often occurs at paragraph boundaries, after headings, or at the beginning of new sentences, though some line breaks show no clear activation; may be a secondary positional effect
patterns.domain: Various online texts, news, and academic texts

patterns.name: Other one-off word activations
patterns.context: Distributed across different sentences about management complaints, design experience, learning advice, and medical experiences, with no stable shared trigger

patterns.name: Physics research topic terms
patterns.context: Introduces the challenges and current state of research on nonequilibrium quantum systems in a quantum dynamics paper; partially overlaps with other academic-phrasing patterns

patterns.name: Discussion of technology/company categories
patterns.context: Discusses the distinction between technology companies and companies that use technology; activation is concentrated on several words and names and does not form an independent, stable trigger

10_2268.concept: 否定与经验判断，兼有研究/技术措辞
10_2268.description: 激活最突出的线索是缩写否定词n't（尤见haven't、don't）及never；另有学术研究重要性、技术受关注/成熟等措辞，以及零散专名、段落边界和语境各异的词语激活。

patterns.name: haven’t/don’t 知道或做到
patterns.trigger: “haven't”中的 “n't” 标为 10；另有 “don’t”中的 “n't” 标为 9
patterns.context: 否定助动词缩写中的 n't，后接“the slightest understanding”“seen one”“know”等表达不知道、没见过或不理解的内容
patterns.domain: HackerNews 讨论；个人叙述或观点

patterns.name: never
patterns.context: 表示从未发生或未曾获得某种经验，分别接“stop learning”和“got told about the risks”
patterns.domain: HackerNews 励志评论；Pile-CC 新闻叙述

patterns.name: 学术文本中的研究重要性措辞
patterns.context: 论文引言或摘要中介绍研究主题、研究领域及其重要性

patterns.name: 研究/技术受关注或发展的表述
patterns.context: 技术或研究领域被描述为获得关注、趋于成熟，常与“attention”“technology”相邻

patterns.name: 专有名称或实体词
patterns.context: 在不同语境中分别出现在“Local Area Networks”和公司名称列表内，缺乏共同句法条件
patterns.domain: 专利技术背景；HackerNews 商业讨论

patterns.name: 段落/句首及换行附近
patterns.trigger: 换行符“↵”出现激活（如 [4]、[6]、[7]），另有 [2] 的“Introduction”附近“↵”
patterns.context: 常位于段落边界、标题后或新句起始，但也有换行未明显激活；可能是次要位置效应
patterns.domain: 多种网络文本、新闻及学术文本

patterns.name: 其余单次词语激活
patterns.context: 分布在管理抱怨、设计经验、学习建议、医疗经历等不同句子中，未见稳定的共享触发条件

patterns.name: 物理学研究主题词
patterns.context: 量子动力学论文中介绍非平衡量子系统研究的挑战与现状；与其他学术措辞模式有部分重合

patterns.name: 技术/公司分类讨论
patterns.trigger: “Another distinction”“business that uses tech”及公司名“Cisco”
patterns.context: 讨论科技企业与使用科技的企业之区别，激活集中在若干词及名称上，未构成独立稳定触发

en.concept: English function words and discourse flow
en.description: Activations span multiple contexts: common in n't negative contractions; also found in ArXiv introductions' statements of research importance, news quotations, patent communication-technology backgrounds, and forum discussions of design evaluations and social class.

patterns.name: n't in negative contractions
patterns.context: The suffix n't in contracted negatives, especially haven’t, can’t, and don’t; these forms occur in multiple passages, but the marker falls at different positions within the word.
patterns.domain: News narratives, forum conversations, and general English text

patterns.name: Statements of research significance in academic introductions
patterns.context: ArXiv paper introductions present a research topic, long-standing interest, current challenges, or fundamental importance; activation covers a continuous span of academic discourse rather than a single technical term.

patterns.name: Quotations and changes of direction in news reports
patterns.context: News narratives include a person's statement or introduce expert judgment and reported information; the context shifts to new information after a quotation or paraphrase.

patterns.name: Communication technology descriptions in patent technical backgrounds
patterns.context: Describing applications, evolution, and technical requirements of wireless communication technologies, including line-of-sight fixed wireless and millimeter waves.

patterns.name: Personal evaluation of system-design experience
patterns.context: Using the first person to discuss designing a system collaboratively, compare approaches, and evaluate their effectiveness; this passage also contains the negative-contraction pattern.

patterns.name: Discussion of social class and background
patterns.context: Comparing upbringing with current social status and discussing whether the label “blue collar” is appropriate.

10_2268.concept: 英文功能词与论述语流
10_2268.description: 激活横跨多种语境：常见于 n't 否定缩略词；也见于ArXiv引言的研究重要性论述、新闻引述、专利通信技术背景及论坛中的设计评价和社会阶层讨论。

patterns.name: 否定式缩略词中的 n't
patterns.context: 缩略否定词中的词尾 n't，尤其 haven’t、can’t、don’t；这些形式在多个段落出现，但标记具体落在词内不同位置。
patterns.domain: 新闻叙事、论坛对话及一般英文文本

patterns.name: 学术引言的研究意义陈述
patterns.context: ArXiv论文引言中，介绍研究主题、长期关注、当前挑战或基础重要性；激活覆盖一串连续的学术论述词，并非只落在某个专门术语上。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文摘要或引言

patterns.name: 新闻报道中的引述与消息转折
patterns.context: 新闻叙述包含人物表态或引入专家判断、报道信息；上下文在引述或转述后转向新消息。

patterns.name: 专利技术背景中的通信技术描述
patterns.context: 描述无线通信技术的应用、演进和技术需求，涉及视距固定无线及毫米波。

patterns.name: 对系统设计经验的个人评价
patterns.context: 以第一人称谈多人协作设计系统，比较做法并评价其有效性；本段也出现否定缩略词模式。

patterns.name: 社会阶层与背景讨论
patterns.context: 比较成长背景与当前社会地位，并讨论“blue collar”这一称谓是否恰当。

en.description: The most prominent recurring cue is the syllable or letter sequence kin in strings such as Hodgkin, Burkinensis, Lumpkin, and Akinpelu. There are also several unrelated activations containing OT, MALT, hormonal, and other terms, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: kin in bacterial taxonomic names
patterns.context: A syllable fragment in bacterial genus and species names; the strongest point falls on kin.

patterns.name: kin in fungal toxin compound terms
patterns.context: A long compound name in a biotransformation study title; a specific word form or tokenization position may be the trigger.

patterns.name: kin in names
patterns.context: A contiguous letter fragment within a personal name, not a standalone word; the name differs from the surrounding words.
patterns.domain: Legal documents; lyrics or online text

patterns.name: kin in lymphoma terms
patterns.context: The final syllable of Hodgkin; appears in medical text related to non-Hodgkin lymphoma.
patterns.domain: Medical papers and clinical trial abstracts

patterns.name: kin in film actor names
patterns.context: An intra-word fragment in the actor surname Culkin; the activation marker actually falls on ay, which may be related to the adjacent name Culkin, but the correspondence is uncertain.

patterns.name: Oxytocin abbreviation OT
patterns.context: Activation falls on the abbreviation OT, adjacent to the full name Oxytocin; no clear connection to the kin strings in other segments.

patterns.name: Unclassified fragments
patterns.context: These activations are scattered across medical proper nouns, common words, and title fragments, and are difficult to explain through the kin word form or shared semantics.

10_2362.concept: 含 kin 字符串片段
10_2362.description: 最突出的重复线索是 Hodgkin、Burkinensis、Lumpkin、Akinpelu 等字符串中的 kin 音节或字母序列；另有多处无关激活，含 OT、MALT、hormonal 等，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 细菌分类学名称中的 kin
patterns.context: 细菌属种名中的音节片段；最强点落在 kin。

patterns.name: 真菌毒素化合物词中的 kin
patterns.context: 生物转化研究标题中的长化合物名；可能是特定词形或分词位置触发。

patterns.name: 姓名中的 kin
patterns.context: 人名内部的连续字母片段，并非独立词；姓名与周围词语不同。
patterns.domain: 法律文书；歌词或网络文本

patterns.name: 淋巴瘤词中的 kin
patterns.context: Hodgkin 一词的末尾音节；出现在非霍奇金淋巴瘤相关医学文本中。
patterns.domain: 医学论文及临床试验摘要

patterns.name: 影片演员姓名中的 kin
patterns.context: 演员姓氏 Culkin 的词内片段；激活标记实际落在 ay，可能与紧邻姓名中的 Culkin 有关，但对应关系不确定。

patterns.name: 催产素缩写 OT
patterns.context: 激活落在缩写 OT，紧邻 Oxytocin 全称；与其他段中的 kin 字符串无明显联系。

patterns.name: 不可明确归类的片段
patterns.context: 这些激活分散在医学专名、普通词、标题片段中，难以由 kin 词形或共同语义解释。

en.concept: Subword fragments in kin strings and medical texts
en.description: Activations often fall on tokenized kin strings, appearing in species names, surnames, lymphoma terminology, and actor or person names. Other high activations are common in medical literature titles and terminology, but show no consistent semantic trigger.

patterns.name: kin strings in biomedical terminology
patterns.context: The trigger appears in proper names or terms across different fields: species names, surnames, lymphoma terminology, actor names, and personal names; it does not require the same meaning or syntactic role.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; PubMed, PubMed Central, FreeLaw, Wikipedia, Pile-CC

patterns.name: Medical literature titles or abstract openings
patterns.context: In medical or life-sciences texts, titles, abstract openings, or term introductions often contain sequences of proper names, technical terms, and noun phrases; no unified semantic topic is apparent.

patterns.name: Narratives about lacrimal glands and dry eye
patterns.context: Discusses insufficient lacrimal gland function, immune-related processes, hormonal effects, and physiological states; activations fall on specific terms in medical passages.

patterns.name: Legal case numbers and party names
patterns.context: Case-file headers or citation-style formatting, including case numbers, line breaks, and names; the triggered fragment occurs within a personal name.

patterns.name: Film titles and actor names
patterns.context: Film entries with titles, work types, and cast lists; the trigger appears in a title or name.

patterns.name: Song titles and personal names
patterns.context: Song- or TV-program-related text containing titles, production information, and personal names; the specific highlighted fragments have no obvious shared meaning.

10_2362.concept: kin 字符串及医学文本中的词片段
10_2362.description: 激活常落在分词后的 kin 字符串上，出现在菌种名、姓氏、淋巴瘤术语及演员或人物名中；其余高激活多见于医学文献标题和术语，但未呈现一致的语义触发规律。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语中的 kin 字符串
patterns.trigger: «kin»，以及分词后呈现为 «kin» 的词内片段
patterns.context: 触发形式出现在不同领域的专名或术语里：菌种名、姓氏、淋巴瘤术语、演员名和人名；不要求词义或句法角色相同。

patterns.name: 医学文献标题或摘要开头
patterns.context: 医学或生命科学文本中，标题、摘要开头或术语介绍处出现较多连续的专名、技术词与名词短语；本身未见统一的语义主题。

patterns.name: 泪腺与干眼相关叙述
patterns.context: 讨论泪腺功能不足、免疫相关过程、激素影响及生理状态；激活落在医学段落中的具体术语。

patterns.name: 法律案号与当事人姓名
patterns.context: 案卷页眉或引文式排版，包含案号、换行和姓名；触发片段位于人名内部。

patterns.name: 电影标题及演员姓名
patterns.context: 电影条目中标题、作品类型及演员名单；触发片段出现在标题或姓名中。

patterns.name: 歌曲标题与人名
patterns.context: 歌曲/电视节目相关文本中出现标题、制作信息及人物姓名；具体高亮片段没有明显共同语义。

en.description: Activations occur in split technical terms and proper names: bacterial genus names, toxin terms, Hodgkin, glutamate, and anesthetic fragments. Also observed are antimicrobial-resistance title structures, legal case numbers, and actor names, which are difficult to unify under a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Bacterial genus names ending in -ovibrium
patterns.context: Multiple subword fragments in the genus name Desulfovibrio are marked in bacterial taxonomy names; adjacent species names also activate.

patterns.name: Fragmented triggers in biomedical terms
patterns.context: A fragment within a long technical term activates when the term is split into subwords; this example concerns toxin conversion.

patterns.name: Numeric formats in legal case numbers or citations
patterns.context: A formatted citation in a court document containing numbers, case numbers, and names; activations fall on numeric and surname fragments.

patterns.name: Fragments within non-Hodgkin lymphoma
patterns.context: In the disease name “non-Hodgkin lymphoma,” multiple subword fragments of Hodgkin activate.
patterns.domain: Medical papers and clinical trial abstracts

patterns.name: Association between antimicrobial resistance and virulence
patterns.context: An abstract title uses the structure association between X and Y to describe the relationship between antimicrobial resistance and virulence.

patterns.name: Culkin fragment within a proper name
patterns.context: The name Macaulay Culkin is marked at the tokenized-fragment level; no medical or bacteriological context is required.

patterns.name: Glutamate and related receptor terms
patterns.context: Subword fragments of glutamate strongly activate in passages about glutamate, glutamate receptors, and glutamate excitotoxicity.

patterns.name: Fragments within bupivacaine
patterns.context: Multiple subword fragments of the local anesthetic bupivacaine are marked, co-occurring with a study of its electrophysiological effects compared with lidocaine.

10_2362.description: 激活分布于被拆分的专业词与专名：细菌属名、毒素词、Hodgkin、谷氨酸及麻醉药片段；另见抗菌耐药标题结构、法律案号和演员姓名，难以归为统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 基因组成为 -ovibrium 的细菌属名
patterns.context: 细菌分类学名称中，属名 Desulfovibrio 的多个词片段被标记；相邻的物种名也有激活。

patterns.name: 生物医学词中的片段化触发
patterns.context: 长专业词被分成子词时，词内片段激活；此例为毒素转化相关词。

patterns.name: 法律案号或引文中的数字格式
patterns.context: 法院文书中编号、案号及姓名的一段格式化引文；激活分布在数字和姓氏片段上。

patterns.name: 非霍奇金淋巴瘤词内片段
patterns.context: 在“non-Hodgkin lymphoma”这一疾病名称中，Hodgkin 被拆分的多个子词片段激活。
patterns.domain: 医学论文及临床试验摘要

patterns.name: 抗微生物耐药与毒力的关联表述
patterns.context: 摘要标题以 association between X and Y 的结构描述抗菌药耐药与毒力的关系。

patterns.name: 专名内部的 Culkin 片段
patterns.context: 人名 Macaulay Culkin 被分词片段标记；未见医学或细菌学语境要求。

patterns.name: 谷氨酸及其受体相关词
patterns.context: 谷氨酸、谷氨酸受体及谷氨酸兴奋性毒性相关表述中，谷氨酸词的子词片段强烈激活。

patterns.name: bupivacaine 词内片段
patterns.context: 局部麻醉药 bupivacaine 的多个子词片段被标记，并与其和利多卡因的电生理作用研究同现。

en.concept: Subwords in academic titles and proper nouns
en.description: Activations often occur in paper titles, especially “Association between” and biomedical topics; they also appear in glutamate-related terms. Other isolated triggers include titles about new bacterial species or biotransformation, legal numbers and name fragments, and personal names and email salutations.

patterns.name: “Association between” in academic titles
patterns.context: At the start of a research title, followed by two associated variables, characteristics, or outcomes; the following content may concern disease, genes, or clinical outcomes.

patterns.name: Bacterial species identification titles
