patterns.context: The phrase “Isolation and characterization” in microbiology paper titles, followed by a bacterial scientific name and a new-species marker.

patterns.name: Biotransformation titles
patterns.context: Title-style phrasing using “Bioconversion of” to introduce a compound and its transformation product.

patterns.name: Glutamate, receptors, and excitotoxicity
patterns.context: Mentions of glutamate in neuroscience text, particularly when it activates ionotropic receptors or appears in the context of excitotoxicity mechanisms.

patterns.name: Case number fragments in legal citations
patterns.context: Near court case citations or case numbers, where numbers, abbreviations, and names are tokenized; high activation falls on “666” and the name fragment “kin”.

patterns.name: Romanian names and line breaks
patterns.context: After the name “Vlad Muțiu” comes a line break and another name fragment; activation is concentrated on subwords within names.

patterns.name: Titles linking cognitive status and surgical outcomes
patterns.context: A title linking preoperative cognitive status to surgical outcomes in older patients, a clinical instance of the “Association between” title pattern.

patterns.name: Name fragments in email salutations
patterns.context: An email opens by addressing the recipient as “Luiz”, followed by a request; activation is concentrated on subwords in the name.

10_2362.description: 激活常见于论文标题，尤其“Association between”及生物医学主题；也见于谷氨酸相关术语。另有孤立触发：细菌新种/生物转化标题、法律数字与姓名片段，以及人名和邮件称呼。

patterns.name: 学术标题中的“Association between”
patterns.context: 作为研究标题开头，后接两个被关联的变量、特征或结果；后续内容可涉及疾病、基因或临床结局。

patterns.name: 细菌新种鉴定标题
patterns.context: 微生物论文标题中的分词 “Isolation and characterization”，后接细菌学名及新种标记。

patterns.name: 生物转化标题
patterns.context: 标题式表述，以 “Bioconversion of” 引出一种化合物及其转化产物。
patterns.domain: 生物化学/生物技术摘要

patterns.name: 谷氨酸与受体/兴奋毒性
patterns.context: 神经科学文字中提及谷氨酸，特别是其激活离子型受体或作为兴奋毒性机制的语境。
patterns.domain: 神经科学/NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 法律引文中的案号数字片段
patterns.context: 法院判例引文或案号附近，数字、缩写和姓名被切分成 token；高激活落在“666”及姓名片段“kin”。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚人名及换行
patterns.context: 人名 “Vlad Muțiu” 后换行并出现另一姓名片段；激活集中在人名内部的子词。

patterns.name: 认知状态与手术结局标题
patterns.trigger: «Association»8« between»8« Cognitive»3« Status»5« before»2« Surgery»2« and»6« Outcomes»2
patterns.context: 标题中关联术前认知状态与老年患者的手术结局，是“Association between”标题模式的临床特例。

patterns.name: 邮件称呼中的姓名片段
patterns.context: 邮件开头以姓名 “Luiz” 称呼收件人，后接请求语句；激活集中在姓名子词。

en.concept: Title-style proper names and noun phrases
en.description: Primarily responds to Association of/between structures in paper titles, and also to nominalized terms and paired cell types in several medical research titles; religious organization names and personal names with diacritics also occur.

patterns.name: “Association” in paper titles
patterns.context: At the beginning of a title, followed by a research subject, variable, or relationship; occurs in multiple PubMed titles

patterns.name: Nominalized expressions in research titles
patterns.context: Title-style phrases centered on a research action, process, or challenge; activation falls on some title words and connecting words

patterns.name: Contrasting cell categories in medical titles
patterns.context: Normal and neoplastic stem cells listed in contrast

patterns.name: Special spellings or diacritics in personal names
patterns.context: Activation occurs within a Wikipedia personal name and includes characters with diacritics

patterns.name: Religious organization names
patterns.context: The name begins with Association of, followed by a type of religious organization

10_2362.concept: 标题式专名与名词短语
10_2362.description: 主要响应论文标题中的 Association of/between 结构，也响应若干医学研究标题中的名词化术语、细胞对举；另见宗教组织名及带变音符号的人名。

patterns.name: 论文标题中的“Association”
patterns.context: 作为标题开头，后接研究对象、变量或关联关系；多个 PubMed 标题中出现

patterns.name: 研究标题中的名词化表达
patterns.context: 标题式短语，以研究行为、过程或挑战为核心；激活落在标题中的部分词语及连接词

patterns.name: 医学标题中的细胞类别对举
patterns.context: 以对举方式并列正常与肿瘤性干细胞
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题/摘要

patterns.name: 人名中的特殊拼写或变音字符
patterns.context: 激活出现在维基百科人名的词内，包含带变音符号的字符

patterns.name: 宗教组织名称
patterns.context: 名称中以 Association of 开头，后接宗教组织类别

en.concept: Start string and local subword patterns
en.description: The most prominent activation pattern is the string “Start”: it often appears in the “Start Date:” field of email headers, and also in code identifiers or test code. Other activations include fragments of biomedical family names and symbols in mathematical expressions.

patterns.name: “Start Date” field
patterns.context: The beginning of a date field in a record or email header, followed by a numeric date and semicolon; date formats are usually M/D/YY or MM/DD/YY.
patterns.domain: Enron email headers or similar structured text

patterns.name: Start markers in code
patterns.context: Appears at the start of a code identifier or test code, not in a date field: followed by FontMetrics, or Test(function ...).

patterns.name: “Association” in biomedical terms
patterns.context: Part of a protein family name in a paper abstract, followed by a member number.

patterns.name: Variables and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in an algebraic expression with repeated multiplication terms; no “Start” or date field is present.

10_2362.concept: Start 字符串及局部子词模式
10_2362.description: 激活模式以字符串“Start”最突出：多见于邮件头的“Start Date:”字段，也见于代码标识符或测试代码。另有生物医学家族名称片段和数学表达式中的符号激活。

patterns.name: “Start Date”字段
patterns.context: 作为记录或邮件头中的日期字段开头，后接数字日期及分号；日期格式多为 M/D/YY 或 MM/DD/YY。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件头或类似结构化文本

patterns.name: 代码中的 Start 标记
patterns.context: 出现在代码标识符或测试代码开头，而非日期字段：后接 FontMetrics，或 Test(function ...)。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语中的 “Association”
patterns.context: 论文摘要中，作为蛋白质家族名称的一部分，后接成员编号。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的变量与运算符
patterns.trigger: «*»«s»，以及相邻的数字、减号和括号
patterns.context: 出现在含重复乘法项的代数表达式中；未见“Start”或日期字段。

en.description: Activations occur in vulgar colloquial language, medical papers and tables, protein terminology, email spelling, and mathematical formulas. In medical text they often fall on function words; in mathematical segments they cluster on product terms beginning with 4. No unified trigger word is apparent.

patterns.name: Emphatic word in a vulgar phrase
patterns.context: Appears in the imperative phrase “Get Off Your Ass”

patterns.name: Function words and data terms in medical papers
patterns.context: Between descriptions of methods, data, and results in biomedical abstracts or research descriptions; activations are scattered across multiple words

patterns.name: Protein terminology and amino acid descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the processing and secretion of Beta-APP and its amino-terminal peptide

patterns.name: Quoted spelling and personal names
patterns.context: In an email sentence, the quoted word allegedly is split into fragments, with the possessive name Shemin’s nearby

patterns.name: Algebraic expressions beginning with 4
patterns.context: A mathematical expression contains terms with 4 multiplied by a variable, adjacent to subtraction and other product terms

patterns.name: Head circumference and gestational age in a table
patterns.context: A table juxtaposes fetal measurements, followed by a Markdown heading separator

10_2362.description: 激活分布于粗俗口语、医学论文与表格、蛋白质术语、邮件拼写及数学式；医学文本中常落在功能词，数学段集中于以 4 开头的乘积项，未见统一触发词。

patterns.name: 粗俗短语中的强调词
patterns.context: 出现在命令式短语“Get Off Your Ass”中
patterns.domain: 网页预览/口语化或粗俗表达

patterns.name: 医学论文中的功能词与数据词
patterns.context: 生物医学摘要或研究描述中，夹在方法、数据和结果叙述之间；激活分散在多个词上

patterns.name: 蛋白质术语及氨基酸表述
patterns.context: 描述 Beta-APP 的加工、分泌及其氨基端肽

patterns.name: 带引号的拼写词与人名
patterns.context: 邮件句子中，带引号的 allegedly 被拆分，附近出现带所有格的人名 Shemin’s

patterns.name: 以 4 开头的代数式
patterns.context: 数学表达式中出现 4 乘变量的项，并与减法及其他乘积项相邻

patterns.name: 表格中的头围与孕周
patterns.context: 胎儿测量值并列呈现的表格，随后有 Markdown 标题分隔符

en.description: Activations are scattered across proper nouns and content words such as Your, film, Police, File, last, and old, spanning titles, film, news, narrative, and programming text; they cannot be grouped into a single semantic or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: Spelling boundary in Your
patterns.context: Your appears as a complete word; before [1] it follows “Off”, before [2] it follows “Stupid”, and in [7] it appears in the title “Freeze Your Account”.
patterns.domain: Web titles, forum posts, and prose

patterns.name: Film-related words
patterns.context: film appears in film-related narration; nearby text concerns film content or works.

patterns.name: Word-initial Police
patterns.context: Police appears at the beginning of a sentence or as part of a proper noun, referring to police or a police department.

patterns.name: Word-initial File
patterns.context: Appears in the program error name “FileNotFoundError”.

patterns.name: Word-initial last
patterns.context: In the phrase “The last thing”, referring to the final thing that previously happened or was said.

patterns.name: Age suffix old
patterns.context: Appears at the end of the age expression “27-year-old”.

patterns.name: Contextual use of race
patterns.context: Adjacent to “cool” and a riding action; the context refers to horse racing or a race, not ethnicity.

patterns.name: Kumar film titles
patterns.context: The name Kumar is followed by a list of films and titles.

patterns.name: Bloodshed and rescue narrative
patterns.context: Describes a daughter being injured, police arriving, and a rescue team saving someone.

patterns.name: PayPal account freeze title
patterns.context: In the title “How to Get PayPal To Freeze Your Account”, freeze is split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Other sporadic fragments
patterns.context: Appear respectively in an adult video title, a discussion of theme park fast passes, a baseball report, and an app title; there is no evidence that these words share stable semantics.

10_2362.description: 激活分散在专名及内容词上：Your、film、Police、File、last、old 等，覆盖标题、影视、新闻、叙事与编程文本；无法归为单一语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: Your 的拼写边界
patterns.context: Your 单独作为完整词出现；在 [1] 前接 “Off”，在 [2] 前接 “Stupid”，在 [7] 前接标题中的 “Freeze Your Account”。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、论坛帖子与散文

patterns.name: 电影相关词语
patterns.context: film 出现在电影叙述中；邻近处有电影内容或电影作品讨论。

patterns.name: Police 的词首
patterns.context: Police 作为句首或专名组成部分，指警察/警察部门。

patterns.name: File 的词首
patterns.context: 出现在程序报错名称 “FileNotFoundError” 中。

patterns.name: last 的词首
patterns.context: 短语 “The last thing” 中，表示此前最后发生或说过的事。

patterns.name: old 的年龄后缀
patterns.context: 出现在年龄表达 “27-year-old” 的末尾。

patterns.name: race 的语境用法
patterns.context: 与 “cool” 和骑乘动作相邻，语境指赛马/比赛，而非种族。

patterns.name: Kumar 电影作品名
patterns.context: 人名 Kumar 后接电影列表及作品名。

patterns.name: 血腥与救援叙事
patterns.context: 描述女儿受伤、警察到场及救援队救人。

patterns.name: PayPal 账户冻结标题
patterns.context: “How to Get PayPal To Freeze Your Account” 标题中，freeze 被拆成多个 token。

patterns.name: 其余零散片段
patterns.context: 分别处于成人视频标题、主题公园快速通行讨论、棒球报道和应用程序标题中；没有证据表明这些词共享稳定语义。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、论坛、体育报道

en.description: Activations are scattered across several text types: “This” in quotations, Thanksgiving, baseball terms, and isolated instances such as day-to-day, another, squib-blasting, and coaching; there is no single stable trigger condition.

patterns.name: This at the start of a quotation
patterns.context: Direct quotations appear in paragraphs, with “This” at the start of the quotation nearby; [7] also activates on “This wasn’t...” after a quotation.
patterns.domain: Direct quotations in news and encyclopedia narratives

patterns.name: Thanksgiving
patterns.context: Appears in narratives about holiday shopping, celebrations, or holiday sports; strongly activated in [2] and [5].

patterns.name: Baseball-related terms
patterns.context: In the context of baseball games, players, or seasons; the strongest related words include “last” ([9]) and “This” ([7]).

patterns.name: Emphatic this / particular
patterns.context: Expresses the importance of a particular present moment; “this” activates more strongly than surrounding ordinary words.

patterns.name: day-to-day
patterns.context: In a hyphenated compound, activation falls on “day”, describing daily life.

patterns.name: another
patterns.context: In ordinary narration, means an additional or further thing; no stable domain-specific condition is apparent.

patterns.name: squib-blasting
patterns.context: Appears in a description of a TV comedian’s death scene; activation is concentrated in the latter part of the compound.

patterns.name: elite coaching
patterns.context: Appears in quotations about feelings toward a new home and about coaches and players.

10_2362.description: 激活分散于多类文本：引语中的“This”、Thanksgiving、棒球词语，以及day-to-day、another、squib-blasting、coaching等孤例；没有单一稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: 引语开头的 This
patterns.context: 段落中出现直接引语，激活紧邻引语开头的“This”；[7]还在引语后的“This wasn’t...”处激活。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科叙述中的直接引语

patterns.name: Thanksgiving
patterns.context: 出现在节日购物、节庆或体育节日的叙述中；在[2]、[5]均强激活。

patterns.name: 棒球相关词语
patterns.context: 棒球比赛、球员或赛季的语境；强度最高的相关词包括“last”（[9]）及“This”（[7]）。

patterns.name: 强调性的 this / particular
patterns.context: 表达某个当下时刻的重要性；“this”激活强于前后普通词。
patterns.domain: 棒球评论中的口语引语

patterns.name: day-to-day
patterns.context: 连字符复合表达中，激活落在“day”上，描述日常生活。
patterns.domain: 电视节目介绍、娱乐新闻

patterns.name: another
patterns.context: 普通叙述中表示又一个或额外的事物，未见稳定的领域条件。

patterns.name: squib-blasting
patterns.context: 出现在对电视喜剧演员死亡场景的描写中，激活集中在复合词后半部分。
patterns.domain: 娱乐评论、影视场景描述

patterns.name: elite coaching
patterns.context: 在谈新家的感受及教练、球员的引语中出现。

en.description: Activation fragments often occur in sports and athletic descriptions, but also in evaluative quotations, time periods, condolence statements, game retrospectives, and instructions; name fragments and several incomplete contexts have no stable common cue.

patterns.name: Teams, events, and match reports
patterns.context: Mentions teams or competitors, match progress, scores, rounds, or other game details; includes both sports events and video game play
patterns.domain: Sports news, encyclopedia event entries, game reviews

patterns.name: Ball-game terms for players or matches
patterns.context: Ball-sport contexts involving hitting, equipment, field performance, or baseball baserunning and hits
patterns.domain: Baseball, snooker, golf, and other sports content

patterns.name: Evaluative intensifiers in quotations
patterns.context: Adjectives indicating degree, positive evaluation, or strong impact appear in quotations or evaluations; collocations are not fixed

patterns.name: Time or stage markers
patterns.context: Describes years, innings, match stages, opening phases, or event timing; parts of speech and contexts vary

patterns.name: Expressions of loss, comfort, and significance
patterns.context: Offers comfort after a death or major event, and includes expressions of the significance of someone’s participation
patterns.domain: Company statements, personal profiles, or emotional quotations

patterns.name: Encounter retrospectives in game narratives
patterns.context: Uses “when we last saw” to recall a hero’s previous battle, clearly in a role-playing game narrative

patterns.name: Subword fragments in player names
patterns.context: Names are split into multiple tokens; fragments appear within the names of players, coaches, or other people. There is no evidence that name subwords are a stable trigger condition

patterns.name: Disaster-related wording in company statements
patterns.context: Company executives issue statements about events causing casualties or losses and offer comfort to those affected

patterns.name: Technical operating instructions
patterns.context: Advises lowering something first, then restoring it when restarting; the device or object is unclear

patterns.name: Adjacent fragments with no clear pattern
patterns.context: Incomplete contexts or continuations from preceding text; nearby activation fragments show no stable common semantic cue
patterns.domain: Sports text, game reviews, or general commentary

10_2362.description: 激活片段多见于赛事与运动描述，也见于评价性引语、时间阶段、慰问声明、游戏回顾和操作建议；姓名碎片及若干残缺上下文缺少稳定共同线索。

patterns.name: 球队、赛事与比赛报道
patterns.trigger: “against an Ireland B team”“scored a run”“runners on first and second”“won the inaugural event”“attack shooter”
patterns.context: 出现球队或参赛者、比赛过程、比分/回合/赛况等叙述；既包括体育赛事，也包括电子游戏玩法
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、百科赛事条目、游戏评论

patterns.name: 球员或比赛中的球类术语
patterns.trigger: “the ball and hit it”“best ball”“long game”“club face”“driver”“fair”“leadoff double”
patterns.context: 球类运动语境；涉及击球、球具、球场表现，或棒球跑垒与安打
patterns.domain: 棒球、斯诺克、高尔夫等体育内容

patterns.name: 引述中的评价性强化词
patterns.trigger: “an awesome coach”“very best of this level”“great this ball”“devastating event”“grueling fight”
patterns.context: 引述或评价中出现表程度、正面评价或强烈影响的形容词；搭配并不固定
patterns.domain: 新闻引语、百科评价、论坛/评论

patterns.name: 时间或阶段的标示
patterns.context: 叙述年份、比赛局次、开始阶段或事件发生时间；词类和场景各异
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、比赛叙述、评论

patterns.name: 失落、安慰及珍贵性表达
patterns.trigger: “loss of our colleagues, family and friends”“Life is precious”“comforting the loved ones”“his presence means a lot”“it’s priceless”
patterns.context: 谈及死亡或重大事件后的安慰，也包括表达某人参与带来的珍贵意义
patterns.domain: 公司声明、人物报道或情感性引语

patterns.name: 游戏叙事中的遭遇回顾
patterns.trigger: “when we last saw our heroes”“finished a grueling fight with Tucker’s Kobolds”
patterns.context: 以“when we last saw”回顾英雄此前经历的战斗，语境明确为角色扮演游戏式叙事

patterns.name: 球员姓名中的子词片段
patterns.context: 名字被切分为多个 token，片段本身出现在球员、教练或其他人物姓名中；没有证据表明姓名子词是稳定触发条件
patterns.domain: 体育报道、百科人物条目

patterns.name: 公司声明中的灾难事件措辞
patterns.context: 公司高管就造成伤亡或损失的事件发表声明，并安慰受影响者
patterns.domain: 新闻报道中的企业声明

patterns.name: 技术操作指令
patterns.trigger: “turn them down”“time to start up again”
patterns.context: 提醒先调低某物，再在重新启动时恢复；所指设备或对象不明

patterns.name: 无法归入明确模式的邻接片段
patterns.trigger: “retire Abrahams”“essentially an on-rails”“bit more difficult than I would like it to be”
patterns.context: 残缺或承接前文的上下文，激活片段附近未显示稳定的共同语义线索
patterns.domain: 体育文本、游戏评论或一般评论

en.description: Activations often occur in sports contexts, especially match actions, scoring leads, athletic skills, and tactical terms. There are also a few instances of main modifying stage, stay, or series, as well as sporadic activations within proper nouns or words.

patterns.name: main and the competitive stage
patterns.context: Describes someone taking part in a competitive activity while performing on a particular main stage; activation is concentrated on main

patterns.name: main and a key hockey defenseman
patterns.context: main is adjacent to stay and refers to a core defensive player on the team; activation falls on main

patterns.name: main and a game’s core series
patterns.context: main modifies series, in contrast to a spin-off

patterns.name: Expressions related to competitive actions or performance
patterns.context: Descriptions of actions, scoring, or leads in hockey, horse racing, soccer, and other matches

patterns.name: Descriptions of athletic ability and technique
patterns.context: Describes athletes’ movements, skills, kinesiology, or tactical participation
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, scouting analysis, interviews, sports medicine papers

patterns.name: Competition organization or stage terminology
patterns.context: Specialized expressions in team lineups, match stages, or tactical situations

patterns.name: Sporadic activations within names or compounds
patterns.context: Activations occur within tokenized proper nouns or words, with no shared semantic condition apparent

10_2362.concept: 体育竞技与主力/主系列表达
10_2362.description: 激活多见于体育语境，尤其比赛动作、得分领先、运动技能和战术术语；另有 main 修饰 stage、stay、series 的几例，以及若干专名或词内零散激活。

patterns.name: main 与竞技场舞台
patterns.context: 叙述某人同时参加竞技活动并在特定主舞台演出；激活集中在 main

patterns.name: main 与冰球防守主力
patterns.context: main 与 stay 连写，指球队防守核心；激活落在 main

patterns.name: main 与游戏主系列
patterns.context: main 修饰 series，与 spin-off 对照

patterns.name: 竞技动作或表现相关表达
patterns.context: 冰球、赛马、足球等比赛叙述中的动作、得分或领先描述

patterns.name: 体育能力与技术描述
patterns.context: 描述运动员动作、技能、身体运动学或战术参与
patterns.domain: 体育百科、球探分析、访谈、运动医学论文

patterns.name: 比赛组织或阶段术语
patterns.context: 球队阵容、比赛阶段或战术情境中的专门表达

patterns.name: 名称或复合词内部的零散激活
patterns.context: 激活出现在被分词切开的专名或词内部，未见共同语义条件

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in text about sports and movement: walking, gait, exercise physiology, jumping, and coordination training. They also cover sports equipment handling and lists of sports, as well as a toy spinning-top launch activity.

patterns.name: Walking, gait, and exercise physiology
patterns.context: Describes human walking, gait, exercise tests, or physiological responses to exercise, often with experimental parameters or health advice.

patterns.name: Body movement and coordination training
patterns.context: Describes repeated body or limb movements, jumping, or coordination training; some passages explain the meaning of action words.
patterns.domain: Rehabilitation, movement descriptions, and word definitions

patterns.name: Sports equipment handling and sports
patterns.context: Describes using a handle to control a model or piece of equipment, making it move or simulate a sports action.

patterns.name: Lists of sports
patterns.context: Enumerates sports or competitive events in a line-separated list, without continuous descriptions of movement.

patterns.name: Launching a toy spinning top
patterns.context: Explains how players wrap a string around and launch a spinning top; distinct from themes of human movement or gait.

10_2362.description: 激活主要集中于运动及动作相关文本：步行、步态、运动生理、跳跃与协调训练，也覆盖体育器材操控和运动项目列表；另有陀螺发射玩法。

patterns.name: 步行步态及运动生理
patterns.context: 描述人体步行、步态、运动测试或运动生理反应，常伴随实验参数或健康建议。

patterns.name: 身体运动与协调训练
patterns.context: 描述身体或肢体进行重复运动、跳跃或协调性训练；个别段落是对动作词义的解释。
patterns.domain: 康复、运动描述及词语释义

patterns.name: 体育器材操控与运动项目
patterns.context: 描述借助握柄操控模型或器材，使其移动或模拟体育动作。

patterns.name: 运动项目名称列表
patterns.context: 以换行列表形式枚举体育或竞赛项目，没有连续动作叙述。

patterns.name: 玩具陀螺的发射玩法
patterns.context: 说明玩家用绳索缠绕并发射陀螺；与人体运动或步态主题不同。

en.description: Activations mainly occur in sports-related text: sports, athletes, event results, and action descriptions. Strong examples include free dance in ice dancing; sports physiology, athletic equipment, injuries, and horse-racing narratives also occur.

patterns.name: Dance competition results
patterns.context: Descriptions of events, placements, or mistakes in ice dance competitions; especially prominent in segments 1 and 2.

patterns.name: Sports and athlete/event information
patterns.context: Mentions athletes, sports, eligibility, training, or exercise physiology in sports encyclopedias or research papers. Terms are scattered and may not point to the same sport.

patterns.name: Sports action and equipment control
patterns.context: A patent describes how a handheld controller simulates or controls sports actions.

patterns.name: Sports injuries and action descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces a BMX-related injury and describes a jump; this segment also contains incoherent anecdotal text.

patterns.name: Horse-racing progress
patterns.context: Describes horse positions, vying for the lead, and overtaking by race segment.

10_2362.description: 激活主要出现在体育相关文本：运动项目、运动员、赛事成绩与动作描述；强项包括冰舞的 free dance，也见体育生理、运动器材、伤病及赛马叙述。

patterns.name: 舞蹈赛事成绩
patterns.trigger: “fall in the free dance”“free dance”“short dance”“rhythm dance”
patterns.context: 花样滑冰冰舞比赛的项目、名次或失误叙述；段1、2中尤为明显。

patterns.name: 运动项目与运动员/赛事信息
patterns.context: 体育百科或研究论文中提及运动员、运动项目、参赛资格、训练或运动生理。词项分散，未必指向同一种运动。

patterns.name: 体育动作及器材控制
patterns.context: 专利描述手持控制器如何模拟或控制体育动作。

patterns.name: 体育伤病与动作叙述
patterns.context: 介绍 BMX 相关伤情，并具体描述跳跃动作；该片段还含不连贯的轶事文本。

patterns.name: 赛马比赛进程
patterns.context: 按赛段叙述赛马位置、竞逐领先及超越过程。

en.description: Activations mainly fall on vocabulary for sports, movement, and physical activity, spanning dance event disciplines, training and rehabilitation, race walking, event lists, competition divisions, and the history of sports activities. Examples of sports equipment and movement in patents also fit this range.

patterns.name: Dance disciplines and scores
patterns.context: Placements, discipline scores, and medal narratives in pair figure skating or ice dance competitions; activations concentrate on discipline names such as dance/free.

patterns.name: Sports and fitness activity vocabulary
patterns.context: Describes physical activity in exercise, rehabilitation training, or recommendations; activation occurs near activity names or movements, with some examples showing the highest intensity.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, rehabilitation, and exercise physiology

patterns.name: Lists of sports
patterns.context: When competition events, sports, or activity categories are listed in parallel, activations occur near event names and related words.

patterns.name: Race-walking event descriptions
patterns.context: An athlete biography notes participation in a race-walking event and its distance.

patterns.name: Competition divisions and round headings
patterns.context: Competition categories, gender divisions, or round headings separated by line breaks; weight classes also occur.

patterns.name: Sports actions and equipment use
patterns.context: Examples describing equipment use or the performance of sports actions; activities appear alongside sports equipment and ball names.

patterns.name: Historical lists of sports activities
patterns.context: When recounting the introduction or provision of various sports activities by a school or institution, they appear as parallel lists.

10_2362.description: 激活主要落在体育项目、运动动作及身体活动词汇上，涵盖舞蹈赛事分项、训练康复、竞走、项目清单、比赛分组和体育活动史；专利中运动器材与动作举例也符合此范围。

patterns.name: 舞蹈项目及成绩
patterns.context: 花样滑冰双人或冰舞比赛的名次、分项成绩与奖牌叙述；激活集中在 dance/free 等分项名称。

patterns.name: 运动/体能活动词汇
patterns.context: 描述锻炼、康复训练或建议的身体活动；活动名称或运动动作附近激活，部分例子中强度最高。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、康复与运动生理

patterns.name: 体育项目清单
patterns.context: 并列列出比赛项目、运动类别或活动类别时，项目名称及相关词附近激活。

patterns.name: 竞走赛事描述
patterns.context: 运动员简介中说明参加竞走项目及赛事距离。

patterns.name: 赛事分组与轮次标题
patterns.context: 以换行分隔的比赛类别、性别分组或轮次标题；也出现体重级别。

patterns.name: 体育动作与器材操作
patterns.context: 描述操纵器具或执行运动动作的例子；活动与运动器材、球类名称相邻。

patterns.name: 体育活动的历史列举
patterns.context: 叙述学校或机构引入、开展多种体育活动时，以并列列表形式出现。

en.description: Activations are mainly associated with sports and athletic contexts: athletes, track and field, swimming, training tests, events, eligibility, and results. They also cover ice dance reporting, school sports lists, and a few specific sports terms.

patterns.name: Athletes in general
patterns.context: When describing athlete identity, eligibility, or performance; also includes athlete health or training contexts. Covers multiple sports in [1]–[10].
patterns.domain: Sports news, exercise science abstracts, athlete biographies

patterns.name: Track and field and running events
patterns.context: Mentions track and field, race walking, sprinting, or walking and jogging as examples of aerobic exercise; running terms and adjacent words are segmented separately.
patterns.domain: Track and field biographies, sports event reporting, sports medicine

patterns.name: Swimming and lists of sports
patterns.context: Explicitly lists event disciplines, school sports activities, or aerobic activities in exercise advice. Swimming appears in several enumeration contexts.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, school activity descriptions, sports medicine

patterns.name: Training and exercise physiology
patterns.context: Discusses endurance, exercise, strength tests, and repetitive movement in athletic training or research; activations in [3] also include dynamometry terminology, which may not share the same trigger as the others.
patterns.domain: PubMed / PubMed Central sports medicine research

patterns.name: Ice dance events and placements
patterns.context: Describes dance styles, placements, medals, or advancement in ice dance reports; “free dance” recurs in the same paragraph context.

patterns.name: Sports statistics and eligibility
patterns.context: Reports participants, events, divisions, eligibility, and results at the Olympics or other competitions, without requiring a particular sport.

patterns.name: Isolated strength-testing terminology
patterns.context: Isokinetic strength testing that measures peak muscle torque; shares a sports science background with other segments, but the terminology itself is distinctive.

patterns.name: Isolated specialized sports
patterns.context: A national team qualifies for badminton or beach volleyball; unlike most segments, which concern track and field, swimming, or ice dance.
patterns.domain: National team Olympic qualification encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Isolated sports sections and activities
patterns.context: An extracurricular activities section on a school or institutional page, where sports are one of many activities.

10_2362.description: 激活主要关联体育与运动语境：运动员、田径、游泳、训练测试、赛事项目、资格和成绩；另覆盖冰舞报道、学校体育清单及少数具体项目术语。

patterns.name: 泛指运动员
patterns.trigger: athlete / athletes / athlete 的词内片段 «lete»、«ath»
patterns.context: 描述运动员身份、参赛资格或运动表现时；也包括运动员身体状况或训练语境。覆盖 [1]–[10] 中的多种运动领域。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、运动科学摘要、运动员传记

patterns.name: 田径及跑步项目
patterns.context: 出现田径、竞走、短跑或作为有氧锻炼举例的步行与慢跑时；跑步词与相邻词分段标注。
patterns.domain: 田径传记、体育赛事报道、运动医学

patterns.name: 游泳及运动项目清单
patterns.context: 明确列出赛事项目、学校提供的体育活动，或运动建议中的有氧项目。游泳在多种枚举语境中出现。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、学校活动介绍、运动医学

patterns.name: 训练与运动生理
patterns.context: 运动训练或研究中讨论耐力、锻炼、力量测试及重复动作；其中 [3] 的激活也包括测力测试术语，未必与其他触发完全相同。
patterns.domain: PubMed / PubMed Central 运动医学研究

patterns.name: 冰舞赛事与名次
patterns.context: 冰舞赛事报道中描述舞种、名次、奖牌或晋级；“free dance”在同一段落语境中反复出现。
patterns.domain: 花样滑冰百科赛事条目

patterns.name: 体育赛事统计与资格
patterns.trigger: «Olympic» Games、«champions»、«qualified»，及参赛人数、男女组别和队伍资格
patterns.context: 报道奥运或其他比赛的参赛者、项目、组别、资格与结果，不要求具体运动项目相同。

patterns.name: 孤立的力量测试术语
patterns.context: 测量肌肉峰值力矩的等速力量测试；与其他段落共享运动科学背景，但术语本身较独特。

patterns.name: 孤立的特殊运动项目
patterns.context: 国家代表队获得羽毛球或沙滩排球参赛资格；不同于大多数段落的田径、游泳或冰舞。
patterns.domain: 国家队奥运资格百科条目

patterns.name: 孤立的体育栏目与活动
patterns.trigger: «Sport»，随后列出学校提供的 «athlet»«ics» 等课外活动
patterns.context: 学校或机构页面的课外活动栏目，体育只是众多活动之一。

en.description: All passages concern sports or physical activity: sports and parallel lists of events, athletes and results, exercise or rehabilitation plans, event and school programs, and recreational sports. Activations often fall on event names and nearby words.

patterns.name: Names of sports and parallel lists
patterns.context: In contexts involving sports, competitions, or physical activities, especially when multiple events are listed in parallel or an event name is the focus of a sentence; some activations fall within subwords of event names or on adjacent conjunctions.
patterns.domain: Sports news, biographical or event encyclopedias, medical exercise advice, school and tourism promotions, academic discussions

patterns.name: Athletes and competition results
patterns.context: Describes athletes competing, advancing, placing, winning medals, or achieving event results; the event name itself need not be the sole trigger.

patterns.name: Sports training and physical exercise
patterns.context: Describes endurance sports, exercise methods, or physical activity in treatment plans; activities may be listed as medical interventions or training content.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, exercise physiology, and rehabilitation

patterns.name: Sports facilities, events, and participation opportunities
patterns.context: Discusses event offerings, sports available at schools, or competition conditions rather than specific results.
patterns.domain: Community activity promotions, school profiles, sports ethics discussions, and historical encyclopedias

patterns.name: Recreational sports and venue activities
patterns.context: Presents sports as vacation or leisure activities, in an invitational tone or with facility information.

10_2362.description: 所有段落都涉及体育或身体活动：包括项目名称及并列清单、运动员参赛与成绩、锻炼或康复方案、赛事和学校项目设置，以及休闲体育活动。激活常落在项目名及其邻近词上。

patterns.name: 运动项目名称及其并列列举
patterns.trigger: 运动或体育活动名称，如 «swimming», «track and field», «free dance», «rhythm dance», «walking», «jogging», «bicycling», «running race», «Beach Volleyball», «volleyball», «athletics», «basketball», «football», «cricket», «horse-riding», «tennis»
patterns.context: 在运动、比赛或体育活动语境中，尤其是多个项目并列出现，或项目名称处于句子焦点位置时；部分激活落在项目名称内部的子词或相邻连接词上。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、人物或赛事百科、医学运动建议、学校及旅游宣传、学术讨论

patterns.name: 运动员与比赛结果
patterns.context: 描述运动员参赛、晋级、名次、奖牌或赛事成绩；不要求项目名称本身是唯一触发点。
patterns.domain: 体育赛事报道与百科条目

patterns.name: 运动训练与身体锻炼
patterns.context: 描述耐力运动、锻炼方式或治疗方案中的身体活动，活动可作为医学干预或训练内容列举。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、运动生理与康复治疗

patterns.name: 体育设施、赛事与参与机会
patterns.context: 谈及赛事项目设置、学校可参与的体育项目或比赛条件，而非具体成绩。
patterns.domain: 社区活动宣传、学校介绍、体育伦理讨论与历史百科

patterns.name: 体育休闲与场地活动
patterns.context: 将运动作为度假或休闲娱乐项目介绍，带有邀请或设施说明语气。

en.description: Activates mainly in sports contexts: athletes, track and endurance sports, lists of sports, exercise, specific athletic activities, and competitive events. Appears across encyclopedic, medical, patent, and other prose styles.

patterns.name: Track and athlete contexts
patterns.context: Mentions athlete categories, track and field events, or athletes doing endurance sports; sometimes linked to training or competitive performance.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, sports medicine, and nutrition research

patterns.name: Lists of sports
patterns.context: Introduces sports offered by a school, university, or institution, or lists teams’ results in different sports.

patterns.name: Specific actions or performance in sports
patterns.context: Discusses recommended exercises, use of golf-simulating equipment, or dance events and scores in figure-skating competitions.
patterns.domain: Sports medicine, patent background, and figure-skating coverage

10_2362.description: 激活集中于体育语境：运动员、田径与耐力运动，体育项目清单，以及锻炼、具体运动活动和竞赛项目；跨百科、医学、专利等文体出现。

patterns.name: 田径与运动员语境
patterns.context: 提及运动员类别、田径项目，或运动员进行耐力运动；有时与训练或比赛表现相连。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、运动医学与营养研究

patterns.name: 体育项目清单
patterns.context: 学校、大学或机构介绍所提供的体育项目，或列举团队在各项目中的成绩。

patterns.name: 运动项目中的具体动作或表现
patterns.context: 讨论建议进行的锻炼、模拟高尔夫设备的使用，或花样滑冰比赛中的舞蹈项目与成绩。
patterns.domain: 运动医学、专利背景、花样滑冰报道

en.description: Primarily responds to sports and athletic contexts: athletes, participation and competition categories, sports lists, endurance training, and aerobic activity. It also responds to bowling, boxing, golf, and descriptions of related venues.

patterns.name: Descriptions of sports and athletes
patterns.context: Activates in athlete biographies or competition reports describing a sport, participation category, event, or performance; it is not triggered by only one fixed sport name.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, event reports, and biographies

patterns.name: Lists of sports such as swimming and track and field
patterns.context: Activates when listing competition events or school sports, or describing exercise recommendations; often appears in parallel lists of activities.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, school profiles, medical advice

patterns.name: Endurance sports and exercise recommendations
patterns.context: Activates when discussing prolonged exercise, endurance tasks, or recommended aerobic activities; nearby text often mentions exercise methods and training effects.
patterns.domain: Nutrition and exercise science, medical abstracts

patterns.name: Sports events, categories, and equipment-related entries
patterns.context: Occurs in Olympic event directories, event qualification information, or descriptions of golf simulator venues; some words refer to sports, others to specific equipment or venue contexts.

10_2362.description: 主要响应体育及运动语境：运动员、参赛与比赛类别、运动项目清单，以及耐力训练和有氧活动；也响应保龄球、拳击、高尔夫等项目或相关场地描述。

patterns.name: 运动项目与运动员描述
patterns.context: 运动员简介或比赛报道中，描述项目、参赛类别、赛事或比赛表现时激活；并非仅由某一个固定项目名触发。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、赛事报道及人物传记

patterns.name: 游泳及田径等项目清单
patterns.context: 列举比赛项目、学校提供的体育活动，或描述体育锻炼建议时激活；常处于并列项目清单中。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、学校介绍、医学建议

patterns.name: 耐力运动与锻炼建议
patterns.context: 讨论长时间运动、耐力任务或推荐有氧活动时激活，附近常出现运动方式和训练效果。
patterns.domain: 营养与运动科学、医学摘要

patterns.name: 体育赛事、类别及器材相关条目
patterns.context: 出现在奥运项目目录、赛事资格说明或高尔夫模拟场地描述中；有些词是项目，有些是具体器材或场地语境。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、专利背景描述

en.description: Primarily responds to sports and athletics contexts, including athletes, sports, running and endurance, swimming, ball sports, event records, and training exercises. Also appears in sports medicine, school athletics, and rehabilitation narratives.

patterns.name: Athletics and sports terminology
patterns.context: Activates when discussing athletes, sports, participation, or athletic activities; the word may be split across adjacent tokens.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, school athletics profiles, sports medicine, and forum text

patterns.name: Running and endurance sports
patterns.context: Activates when mentioning sprinting, track and field, distance running, or endurance tasks; also includes sports nutrition and training-performance contexts.
patterns.domain: Track-and-field encyclopedias, sports nutrition, and physiology research

patterns.name: Swimming-related events
patterns.context: Activates when swimming appears as a competitive event, a recommended aerobic activity, or a sport pursued after rehabilitation by people with disabilities; other events linked by and may also activate.
patterns.domain: Sports history, lists of sports, health guides, and biographies

patterns.name: Ball sports and other school sports
patterns.context: Activates on sport names in lists of sports or descriptions of school-team results, with no apparent restriction to a particular sport.
patterns.domain: School activity profiles and university sports encyclopedias

patterns.name: Event results and records
patterns.context: Activates in descriptions of competitions, champions, team results, or world records in sports.

patterns.name: Sports training and skill practice
patterns.context: Activates when discussing practice of basic movements, balance, or skill training; the context need not involve formal competition.

patterns.name: Sports word forms split across tokens
patterns.context: When a word is split into subword fragments, activation may fall on fragments of words related to sports or participants; this can co-occur with a sports context but does not independently identify the trigger mechanism.

10_2362.description: 主要响应体育与运动语境，涵盖运动员、体育项目、跑步耐力、游泳、球类、赛事纪录及训练练习；也出现在运动医学、学校体育和康复叙述中。

patterns.name: athletics及体育运动术语
patterns.context: 谈论运动员、体育项目、运动参与或体育活动时激活；词可被拆成相邻 token。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、学校体育介绍、运动医学及论坛文字

patterns.name: 跑步与耐力运动
patterns.context: 提及短跑、田径、长跑或耐力任务时激活；也包括运动营养及训练表现语境。
patterns.domain: 田径百科、运动营养与生理研究

patterns.name: 游泳相关项目
patterns.context: 游泳作为比赛项目、推荐的有氧活动，或残疾人康复后参与的运动出现时激活；有时与 and 相连的其他项目也有激活。
patterns.domain: 体育史、体育项目列表、健康指南及人物传记

patterns.name: 球类及其他学校体育项目
patterns.context: 体育项目列表或校队成绩叙述中出现项目名称时激活，未见必须限定某一运动。
patterns.domain: 学校活动介绍与大学体育百科

patterns.name: 赛事成绩与纪录
patterns.context: 运动项目的比赛、冠军、团队成绩或世界纪录叙述中激活。
patterns.domain: 体育赛事及运动员百科

patterns.name: 运动训练与技能练习
patterns.context: 讨论练习基本动作、平衡或技能训练时激活；不要求语境属于正式体育比赛。

patterns.name: 跨步切分的运动词形
patterns.context: 词被拆分标注时，激活位置可能落在构成运动或参与者相关词语的子词上；该现象可能与体育语境共同出现，但不能单独确定触发机制。

en.description: Primarily responds to sports and athletic contexts: athletes, events and sports introductions, sports lists, and discussions of exercise, endurance activity, and athletic performance; it also covers sports-related language in medical guidelines and research papers.

patterns.name: Track and field and competitive sports
patterns.context: Activates in descriptions of sports, athletes, or events, especially when listing sports or describing competitive experience.

patterns.name: Athletes and event lists
patterns.context: Activates in categorized lists consisting of event headings, athlete names, and identities; no particular sport needs to appear.

patterns.name: Aerobic exercise recommendations
patterns.context: Activates when recommended exercise methods are listed in health guidelines.

patterns.name: Endurance sports and performance
patterns.context: Activates in discussions of prolonged exercise, endurance tasks, and the effects of nutritional supplements on athletic performance.

patterns.name: Endurance athletes as research subjects
patterns.context: In research paper introductions, describes endurance athletes engaging in physical exercise.

10_2362.description: 主要响应体育与运动语境：运动员、项目和赛事介绍，运动项目列表，以及锻炼、耐力活动和运动表现讨论；也覆盖医学指南与科研论文中的运动表述。

patterns.name: 田径及竞技体育项目
patterns.context: 体育项目、运动员或赛事的介绍中，尤其是列举项目或描述竞技经历时激活。

patterns.name: 运动员与赛事列表
patterns.context: 以项目标题、运动员姓名和身份组成的分类列表中激活；不要求出现特定运动项目。
patterns.domain: 体育人物百科条目或分类目录

patterns.name: 有氧运动建议
patterns.context: 在健康指南中列举推荐的锻炼方式时激活。

patterns.name: 耐力运动与表现
patterns.context: 讨论长时间运动、耐力任务及营养补充对运动表现的影响时激活。

patterns.name: 耐力运动研究对象
patterns.context: 科研论文引言中描述耐力运动员进行身体锻炼的情形。

en.description: Primarily responds to sports contexts, especially athletes, track and endurance sports, and names of sports. Also responds to lists of sports, event divisions, and sports-science descriptions. Some activations occur on adjacent numbers, function words, and list formatting.

patterns.name: Lists of sports
patterns.context: Sports, ball sports, or athlete names appear consecutively after a general sports category or person category.

patterns.name: Athletes and competition descriptions
patterns.context: Describes athlete identity, specialization, participation, or events; often appears in athletics, competition, or results contexts.

patterns.name: Sports event lists and division headings
patterns.context: Events or school pages group content by gender, category, or sport; sport names may appear on their own line or in headings.

patterns.name: Specific token fragments in compound sports terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments of sport names or categories; some words are split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Exercise-related physiology and training terms
patterns.context: In endurance sports, training, or exercise physiology research, describes the type or duration of exercise or a body part.

patterns.name: Incidental activation on general words or formatting fragments
patterns.context: Numbers, function words, punctuation, or list formatting adjacent to sports content also show weaker activation, with unclear status as independent semantic triggers.

10_2362.description: 主要响应体育语境，尤其是运动员、田径与耐力运动项目名称，也响应体育项目清单、赛事分组及运动科学描述。少量激活落在相邻数字、功能词和列表格式上。

patterns.name: 体育项目名称列举
patterns.trigger: sports on offer are «athlet»«ics»、«basketball»、«football»、«cricket»；以及 «sports figures» 后列举 hockey、golfers、baseball
patterns.context: 体育总类或人物类别之后，连续出现项目、球类或运动员名称
patterns.domain: 学校体育介绍、专利说明

patterns.name: 运动员与竞赛项目描述
patterns.context: 描述运动员身份、专长、参赛或比赛项目，常出现 athletics、比赛项目或成绩语境

patterns.name: 体育赛事名单及分组标题
patterns.context: 赛事或学校页面按性别、类别、项目分组，项目名可能单独成行或位于标题中

patterns.name: 运动项目复合词中的特定分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在运动名称或运动类别的词片段上；有些词被拆分成多个 token

patterns.name: 与运动相关的生理/训练术语
patterns.context: 耐力运动、运动训练或运动生理研究中，描述运动类型、持续时间或身体部位

patterns.name: 一般词语或格式片段的伴随激活
patterns.trigger: «Five» «hundred» «twenty» «-»«three»、«are»、«athlet»«ics» 后的逗号，以及列表换行符 «↵»
patterns.context: 与体育内容相邻的数字、功能词、标点或列表格式也有较弱激活，难以确定其为独立语义触发

en.description: Primarily responds to words and formatting in athlete, sports, and event contexts, including athlete identity, discipline, competition results, awards, nationality/division, and event tables; it also covers sports nutrition, wheelchair sports, and some biographical or page-related miscellany.

patterns.name: Athlete identity and competitive experience
patterns.context: Describes athletes, competitive experience, discipline, results, or events; common in biographies and sports encyclopedia entries.

patterns.name: Track and field and endurance sports
patterns.context: Includes track and field events, running, or endurance training and performance; sometimes discusses training nutrition.
patterns.domain: Track and field encyclopedias, sports science

patterns.name: Specific sports and event names
patterns.context: Lists sports, event categories, or competition disciplines; not limited to track and field.

patterns.name: Competition results and honors
patterns.context: Describes victories, medals, championships, or qualification for an event.

patterns.name: Athlete divisions and gender/nationality categories
patterns.context: Sports entries specify divisions, nationality, or athlete categories, often in event tables or category labels.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, event tables and categories

patterns.name: Events and divisions in structured event tables
patterns.context: Dense, line-separated results or qualification tables containing events, rounds, gender, and weight classes.

patterns.name: Page structure, categories, and entry formatting
patterns.context: Near encyclopedia entry titles, references, or category fields, often alongside athlete entries.

patterns.name: Specialized sports nutrition and training performance
patterns.context: Discusses dietary supplements and performance effects in training or prolonged endurance activity.

patterns.name: Wheelchair sports and athletes with disabilities
patterns.context: Discusses athletes with spinal cord injuries participating in wheelchair ball sports and related research.

patterns.name: Scholarships and family background
patterns.context: Biographical background preceding a list of sports; not fully aligned with the main sports event/activity activation pattern.

patterns.name: Personal bests in athlete profiles
patterns.context: An athlete biography gives the discipline and personal best, distance, and year.

patterns.name: References and residual web strings
patterns.context: Occurs in references or leftover external-link strings after event titles, with no clear semantic connection to sports.

10_2362.concept: 体育赛事与运动员语境
10_2362.description: 主要对运动员、体育项目与赛事语境中的词语和格式起反应，包括运动员身份、专项、参赛成绩、奖项、国籍/组别及赛事表格；也覆盖运动营养、轮椅运动和少量传记或页面杂项。

patterns.name: 运动员身份与竞赛经历
patterns.context: 描述运动员、参赛经历、专项、成绩或赛事；常见于人物简介和体育百科条目。

patterns.name: 田径与耐力运动
patterns.context: 出现田径项目、跑步或耐力训练与表现；有时讨论训练营养。

patterns.name: 具体体育项目及赛事项目名称
patterns.context: 列举运动项目、项目类别或比赛专项，不限于田径。

patterns.name: 比赛成绩与荣誉
patterns.context: 描述获胜、奖牌、冠军或取得参赛资格。

patterns.name: 运动员类别及性别/国籍分类
patterns.context: 体育条目中标注参赛组别、国籍或运动员类别，常出现在赛事表格或分类标签。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、赛事表格与分类

patterns.name: 结构化赛事表格中的项目与分组
patterns.context: 换行密集的赛事结果或资格表，包含项目、轮次、性别及重量级。

patterns.name: 页面结构、分类与条目格式
patterns.context: 百科条目标题、参考文献或分类栏附近，常伴随运动员条目。

patterns.name: 专项运动营养与训练表现
patterns.context: 讨论运动者训练或长时间耐力活动的饮食补充及表现效果。

patterns.name: 轮椅运动与伤残运动员
patterns.context: 讨论脊髓损伤运动员参与轮椅球类项目及相关研究。
patterns.domain: 运动医学、适应性体育研究

patterns.name: 奖学金与家庭背景
patterns.context: 运动项目列表之前的人物背景叙述；与体育赛事/项目激活主线不完全相同。

patterns.name: 运动员档案中的个人最佳成绩
patterns.context: 运动员简介中给出专项和个人最佳成绩、距离及年份。

patterns.name: 参考文献与网页残留字符串
patterns.context: 出现在赛事标题后的参考文献/外链残留处，缺少清晰的体育语义联系。

en.description: Primarily responds to sports contexts: athletes, track and endurance or sprint events, other sports, event qualification, and medals. Also covers local patterns in school athletics, judo tables, sports-science research, and patents for articulated sports figures.

patterns.name: Athletes and competitive sports contexts
patterns.context: Appears in athlete profiles, competition results, qualification categories, or descriptions of athletic performance; often adjacent to terms for events, gender, country, results, or training.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, event records, sports science

patterns.name: Track and endurance running
patterns.context: Triggered by references to running, track events, athlete specializations, or endurance-sport experiments; includes sprinting, middle- and long-distance running, and track and field in general.
patterns.domain: Track and field, sports science, athlete biographies

patterns.name: Specific sports and equipment
patterns.context: Activates when sports, sporting equipment, or categories of sports figures are listed or described; not limited to track and field.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, school athletics profiles, patent background

patterns.name: Competition and award descriptions
patterns.context: Appears when describing competition qualifications, events, championships, or medals; often accompanied by years, levels, or participant categories.

patterns.name: School or event sports activity sections
patterns.context: Sports are introduced or listed as school extracurricular activities or available options.

patterns.name: Judo qualification tables
patterns.context: Event entries list individual or team qualifications, finals, and men’s events divided by weight class in tables or sections.

patterns.name: Sports figures and movable limbs
patterns.context: Patent background gives examples of sports figures whose arms or legs can be moved using equipment such as a racket or club.
patterns.domain: Patent text, toy or model mechanism descriptions

patterns.name: Human movement conditions in sports science
patterns.context: The study concerns healthy endurance athletes and discusses lower-limb or whole-body movement; this passage is only the opening of the paper’s introduction.

10_2362.description: 主要响应体育与运动语境：运动员、田径及耐力/短跑项目、其他运动、赛事资格与奖牌；也覆盖学校体育、柔道表格、运动科学研究和运动人物模型专利等局部模式。

patterns.name: 运动员与竞技项目语境
patterns.trigger: « athletes»、« athlete»、« runner»、« sprinter»，以及 « men»«'s»« categories»
patterns.context: 在运动员简介、比赛结果、资格分类或运动表现叙述中出现；常与项目、性别、国家、成绩或训练相关词相邻。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、赛事资料、运动科学

patterns.name: 田径与耐力跑
patterns.trigger: « long»« endurance»« tasks» like« running» a« half»« marathon»；« sprint»«ing»；« middle»-«distance»« runner»；« 800»« m»；« 400»« metres»；« track» and« field»；« athlet»«ics»
patterns.context: 谈及跑步、田径项目、运动员专项或耐力运动实验时触发；既包括短跑，也包括中长跑和一般田径。
patterns.domain: 田径、运动科学、运动员传记

patterns.name: 具体体育项目与器材
patterns.trigger: « basketball»、« football»、« cricket»；« disc»«us»« throw»«er»；« swimming»；« rac»«quet»、« stick»、« club»；« hockey»、« golf»、« baseball»
patterns.context: 体育项目、运动器材或体育人物类别被列举、描述时激活，不限于田径。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、学校体育介绍、专利背景

patterns.name: 竞赛及奖项叙述
patterns.trigger: « qualified»、« competed»、« inaugural»、« won»、« title»、« gold»« medal»、« Championships»
patterns.context: 描述赛事参赛资格、比赛、冠军或奖牌等竞技经历时出现，常伴有年份、级别或参赛类别。
patterns.domain: 体育赛事报道与百科条目

patterns.name: 学校或赛事中的体育活动栏目
patterns.context: 体育作为学校课外活动或可参与项目被介绍、罗列。

patterns.name: 柔道资格表格
patterns.trigger: «Individual»« qualification»、« Team» Finals、« J»«udo»，以及 « 60»« kg»、« 66»« kg»
patterns.context: 赛事条目以表格或栏目形式列出个人/团体资格、决赛及按体重划分的男子项目。

patterns.name: 体育模型及可动肢体
patterns.trigger: « a»« rac»«quet»、« stick»、« club»，以及 « hockey»« players»、« golf»«ers»、« baseball»« players»
patterns.context: 专利背景中举例说明可借助球拍、球杆等器具活动手臂或腿的运动人物模型。
patterns.domain: 专利文本、玩具或模型机构说明

patterns.name: 运动科学中的人体运动条件
patterns.trigger: « endurance»« athletes»« performing»« lower»-«body» or « whole»-«body»« exercise»
patterns.context: 研究对象是身体健全的耐力运动员，讨论下肢或全身运动；本段仅为论文引言开头。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、运动生理学

en.description: Primarily responds to sports contexts: athlete biographies and events, results, and awards; it also responds to sports lists and event tables, as well as endurance performance, sports nutrition, and wheelchair sports research.

patterns.name: Athlete career profiles
patterns.context: An entry describes a person's sport, nationality, competitive career, personal bests, or awards; also includes specific events such as sprinting and throwing.

patterns.name: Sports directories and event schedules
patterns.context: Line-separated lists of sports, events, or qualification schedules; activations are distributed across event names, table labels, and adjacent formatting tokens.

patterns.name: Endurance performance and nutrition

patterns.name: Scholarships and extracurricular sports

patterns.name: 轮椅运动员与相关研究
patterns.context: 研究脊髓损伤运动员或轮椅体育项目时出现。

patterns.name: 健身力量训练动作顺序
patterns.context: 按难度或训练次序列举力量训练动作。

en.description: All passages are in sports or exercise contexts: athletes, sports and movements, event schedules, training programs, and athletic performance. Also includes sports medicine and nutrition research, adaptive sports, and school athletics profiles.

patterns.name: Sports, exercise, and athlete-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Describes people and activities involving sports participation, exercise, training, or competition; activation can occur on these words themselves or nearby sports, movement, and conditioning terms.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, fitness discussions, sports medicine, and nutrition research

patterns.name: Specific sports and movements
patterns.context: Lists specific sports, event disciplines, training movements, or competition categories; includes both general sports and equipment-based training and fitness exercises.

patterns.name: Athletic performance, training programs, and physiological research
patterns.context: Discusses exercise duration, intensity, training schedules, performance, or metabolism and interventions during exercise; sports terms and research descriptions co-occur.
patterns.domain: Exercise physiology, clinical research, sports nutrition

patterns.name: Wheelchair athletes and adaptive sports
patterns.context: The sport is practiced by wheelchair users and occurs near “athletes” and a spinal cord injury context.

patterns.name: Sports event lists and layout structure
patterns.context: Event schedules or results pages use line-separated headings and classifications for qualifying rounds, finals, gender, or divisions rather than continuous prose.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, event schedules or results tables

patterns.name: Sports facilities/extracurricular sports sections
patterns.context: A school or institution introduces extracurricular activities and lists available sports.

patterns.name: Unclear trigger in an athlete biography
patterns.context: A biographical sentence introduces a retired athlete and their specialty; activation involves identity and track-and-field specialization, but there is insufficient evidence that general biographies also trigger it.

10_2362.description: 各段都处于体育或锻炼语境：涵盖运动员、项目与动作、赛事赛程、训练方案及运动表现，也包括运动医学营养研究、适应性体育和学校体育介绍。

patterns.name: 运动、锻炼与运动员相关词汇
patterns.context: 描述参与运动、锻炼、训练或竞赛的人与活动；激活可出现在这些词本身，也可出现在附近的运动项目、动作和身体训练词汇。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、健身讨论、运动医学及营养研究

patterns.name: 具体运动项目与动作
patterns.context: 列举具体运动、赛事项目、训练动作或竞赛类别；既包括普通体育项目，也包括器械训练和健身动作。
patterns.domain: 体育、健身训练、竞技运动

patterns.name: 运动表现、训练方案与生理研究
patterns.context: 讨论运动时长、强度、训练安排、运动表现或运动期间的代谢与干预；运动相关术语和研究描述共同出现。
patterns.domain: 运动生理、临床研究、运动营养学

patterns.name: 轮椅运动员与适应性体育
patterns.context: 运动项目由轮椅使用者参与，且紧邻“athletes”及脊髓损伤背景。
patterns.domain: 适应性体育、残障运动研究

patterns.name: 体育赛事名单与版面结构
patterns.context: 以分行标题和资格赛、决赛、性别或级别分类构成赛事赛程或结果页面，而非连续叙述。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、赛事赛程或结果表

patterns.name: 体育设施／课外体育栏目
patterns.context: 学校或机构介绍课外活动，并列出可参加的体育项目。

patterns.name: 不完全明确的运动员传记触发
patterns.trigger: “retired Romanian athlete”“specialised in the sprinting events”
patterns.context: 人物传记句中介绍退役运动员及其专项；激活涉及身份和田径专项描述，但没有足够证据表明一般人物传记也会触发。

en.description: All segments concern sports or physical activity: sport names, athletes and disciplines, competition categories and qualifications, extracurricular sports, and training, endurance performance, and sports medicine contexts. Formats range from directory lists to narrative text.

patterns.name: Sports or exercise activity lists
patterns.context: Sport names or related training activities appear in parallel lists, classification entries, participation recommendations, or training instructions; some activations fall on subword fragments within names.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, athlete profiles, fitness training, and sports health texts

patterns.name: Sports directories and classification labels
patterns.context: Directories of sports in encyclopedia entries, gender divisions, person categories, or other structured classifications; sports and athlete categories occur alongside list formatting.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia directories, categories, and entry formats

patterns.name: Athlete identity and competitive discipline
patterns.context: A person is described as an athlete, or their competitive discipline, event, and athlete identity appear together.
patterns.domain: Athlete biographies and competitive sports materials

patterns.name: Competition qualification and weight classes
patterns.context: Countries qualify to compete, and athlete quotas are listed by gender and weight class.

patterns.name: Sports and physical condition research
patterns.context: Sports appear alongside wheelchair use, athletes, or medical conditions such as spinal cord injuries.

patterns.name: Endurance activities and nutrition advice
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship between prolonged endurance exercise, athletic performance, and diet or carbohydrate supplementation.
patterns.domain: Nutrition, sports performance, and health information

patterns.name: Fitness sequences by intensity
patterns.context: Explains that a workout starts with high-intensity movements, followed by more difficult movements, and ends with easier ones.

patterns.name: Extracurricular sports
patterns.context: Schools or institutions describe extracurricular sports available to participants, followed by a list of sports.

patterns.name: Standalone sports headings/event names
patterns.context: Appears as a standalone heading or list item, without requiring nearby athlete descriptions, training, or health context.

10_2362.description: 各段均围绕体育或身体活动：运动项目名、运动员与专项、赛事分类和资格、课外运动，以及训练、耐力表现和运动医学语境。格式从目录清单到叙述文本不等。

patterns.name: 体育项目或运动名称列表
patterns.trigger: “Aquatics - Diving and Swimming”“Athletics Track & Field”“Basketball”“Tennis”“running”“swimming”“brisk walking”“jogging”“bicycling”等运动名称；另有“gym”“workout”“squats”“deadlifts”“bench press”“bicep curls”
patterns.context: 运动项目名称或相关训练活动出现在并列列表、分类条目、参与建议或训练说明中；有些激活落在名称内部的分词片段上。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、运动员简介、健身训练与运动健康文本

patterns.name: 体育类目录与分类标签
patterns.trigger: “Athletics Track & Field”“Men”“Women”“Category: Russian male discus throwers”“Category: Soviet male discus throwers”“Category: 1950 births”
patterns.context: 百科条目中的项目目录、性别分组、人物类别或其他结构化分类；项目及运动员类别与列表格式并现。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 目录、分类和条目格式

patterns.name: 运动员身份与竞技项目
patterns.trigger: “retired Romanian athlete”“specialised in the sprinting events”“Croatian sprinter who specializes in the 400 metres”“disc(us) throwers”“athletes”
patterns.context: 人物被描述为运动员，或其竞技专项、比赛项目与运动员身份相邻出现。
patterns.domain: 运动员传记和竞技体育资料

patterns.name: 赛事资格及体重级别
patterns.trigger: “has qualified one athletes”“68 kg men’s categories”“49 kg women’s category”
patterns.context: 国家获得参赛资格，并按性别和体重级别列出运动员名额。
patterns.domain: 奥运会或国际赛事资料

patterns.name: 运动与身体状况研究
patterns.trigger: “wheelchair basketball”“wheelchair rugby”“athletes with a spinal cord injury”
patterns.context: 运动项目与轮椅使用、运动员或脊髓损伤等医学条件并列出现。

patterns.name: 耐力活动与营养建议
patterns.trigger: “targeted ketogenic diet”“carbohydrates”“long endurance tasks”“running a half marathon”“performance”
patterns.context: 讨论长时间耐力运动、运动表现以及饮食或补充碳水化合物的关系。
patterns.domain: 营养、运动表现与健康科普

patterns.name: 分级强度的健身顺序
patterns.trigger: “strenuous squats and deadlifts”“difficult bench press and dips”“relatively easy bicep curls”
patterns.context: 说明一次健身训练中先做高强度动作，再做较难动作，最后做较容易动作。

patterns.name: 课外体育活动
patterns.context: 学校或机构介绍可参加的课外运动，后接运动项目清单。

patterns.name: 单独出现的体育标题/项目名
patterns.context: 作为独立标题或清单项目出现，不要求附近出现运动员描述、训练或健康语境。
patterns.domain: 体育项目列表或赛事目录

en.description: Activates on sports-related vocabulary and contexts: athletes and disciplines, sports lists, competitions and medals, endurance performance, athlete-group research, and exercise training.

patterns.name: Sports and athletic category vocabulary
patterns.context: Triggered when listing, describing, or discussing sports, athletes, competitions, and training; often near sport names, gender divisions, event categories, or athletic performance.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, sports nutrition, and sports medicine

10_2362.description: 对体育相关词汇和语境激活：涵盖运动员及专项、体育项目清单、赛事与奖牌、耐力运动表现、运动员群体研究及锻炼训练。

patterns.name: 运动项目与体育类别词汇

patterns.domain: 体育百科、运动营养与运动医学

en.description: Primarily responds to sports and their names, also covering athlete records, event medals, and training performance. A few triggers occur in wheelchair-sports research and game-related terms such as billiards and pinball.

patterns.name: Lists and classifications of sports
patterns.context: Lists or tables enumerate events, sports, gender categories, or competition qualifications; activation often falls on sport names, classification labels, and item separators.

patterns.name: Athlete biographies and competitive records
patterns.context: Biographies or list entries describe athletes’ specialties, rankings, participation, and medals; activation also occurs around names and career records.

patterns.name: Sports training and athletic performance
patterns.context: Discusses exercise schedules, training movements, endurance sports, or sports nutrition and performance; usually appears in explanatory prose rather than directories.
patterns.domain: Fitness and sports nutrition articles, forums

patterns.name: Wheelchair sports and athletes with disabilities
patterns.context: Academic papers discuss athletes with spinal cord injuries and wheelchair sports; activation occurs near sport names and athlete groups.

patterns.name: Sports-related game terminology
patterns.context: Game descriptions mention elements such as billiards and pinball; unlike the other examples, these are not real-world sports contexts but still contain specific sport or competitive-activity terms.

10_2362.description: 主要响应体育项目及其名称，也覆盖运动员履历、赛事奖牌和训练表现；少数触发于轮椅体育研究及游戏中的桌球、弹珠台等竞技项目词汇。

patterns.name: 体育项目列表与分类
patterns.trigger: «Sports»；«The following is a list of sports»；«Sport»；项目名称前后的换行与分类标题，如«Men»、«Women»
patterns.context: 列表或表格中按项目罗列赛事、运动项目、性别分类或参赛资格；激活常落在项目名、分类标签及条目分隔处。

patterns.name: 运动员传记与竞技履历
patterns.context: 人物传记或名单条目描述运动员专项、排名、参赛经历和奖牌；激活也出现在姓名及履历周边。

patterns.name: 体育训练与运动表现
patterns.context: 讨论锻炼安排、训练动作、耐力运动或运动营养和表现；通常处于解释性正文，而非名录。
patterns.domain: 健身与运动营养文章、论坛

patterns.name: 轮椅体育及残疾运动员
patterns.context: 学术论文讨论脊髓损伤运动员及轮椅体育，项目名和运动员群体附近激活。

patterns.name: 体育相关游戏项目词汇
patterns.context: 游戏介绍中提到桌球和弹珠台等元素；与现实体育语境不同，但仍出现具体运动/竞技项目词。

en.description: Activations cluster in sports contexts: athletes and track-and-field disciplines, sports and competitions, as well as training, endurance exercise, and exercise physiology research; also covers research on wheelchair athletes.

patterns.name: Track and field and athlete biographies
patterns.context: Introduces an athlete's event, discipline, or career, often in biographical entries and category lists; track and field, sprinting, discus, and similar sports terms are especially common.

patterns.name: Sports lists and competition categories
patterns.context: Sports headings, competition categories, participant lists, or result descriptions; mostly encyclopedia-style entries and lists.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia sports entries and competition lists

patterns.name: Endurance exercise and exercise physiology
patterns.context: Describes training movements, exercise duration, or nutrition and metabolism during exercise; not limited to competitive track and field.
patterns.domain: Fitness discussions, nutrition articles, and medical research

patterns.name: Wheelchair sports and athletes with disabilities
patterns.context: Discusses athletes with spinal cord injuries and wheelchair ball sports in research-paper contexts.

10_2362.description: 激活集中于体育语境：运动员与田径专项、体育项目和赛事，以及训练、耐力运动和运动生理研究；也覆盖轮椅运动员研究。

patterns.name: 田径与运动员传记
patterns.trigger: “disc”“throwers”“athlete”“specialised in the sprinting events”“sprinter who specializes in the 400 metres”
patterns.context: 介绍运动员的项目、专项或生涯，常见于人物条目和分类列表；尤其出现田径、短跑、铁饼等项目词。

patterns.name: 体育项目列表与赛事分类
patterns.trigger: “list of sports”“Athletics Track & Field”“Taekwondo”“Tennis”“Commonwealth Games”“Bronze Medal”“Silver Medal”
patterns.context: 体育项目标题、比赛类别、参赛名单或成绩叙述；多为百科式条目和列表。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 体育条目、赛事列表

patterns.name: 耐力运动与运动生理
patterns.trigger: “long endurance tasks like running a half marathon”“gym”“squats”“deadlifts”“bench press”“exercise”“cycle ergometer exercise”
patterns.context: 描述训练动作、运动持续时间或运动期间的营养与代谢；并不局限于竞技田径。
patterns.domain: 健身讨论、营养文章、医学研究

patterns.name: 轮椅运动与残疾运动员
patterns.trigger: “wheelchair basketball”“wheelchair rugby”“athletes with a spinal cord injury”
patterns.context: 讨论脊髓损伤运动员及轮椅球类运动，出现在研究论文语境。

en.description: Primarily responds to athletes, sports, and competition information in sports-related text, also covering training movements, sports nutrition, rankings and records, medals, athlete biographies, and school sports lists; appears across different text styles.

patterns.name: Athletes and sports competition contexts
patterns.context: Describes athletes, sports, participation history, results, and medals in athlete profiles, competition results, or sports lists.
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, sports research, and event reports

patterns.name: Sports names
patterns.context: Specific sports or training movements appear; includes both competitive sports and fitness training.

patterns.name: Sports performance and training nutrition
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship between prolonged exercise, dietary supplementation, and athletic performance.

patterns.name: Sports statistics, rankings, and records
patterns.context: Lists competition qualifications, rankings, records, participation years, or medal results.

patterns.name: Athlete biographies and career history
patterns.context: An entry opens with an individual's retirement status, nationality, national team, or athletic career.

patterns.name: School extracurricular sports lists
patterns.context: Section headings and lists of sports offered in school descriptions.

patterns.name: Athlete groups in association studies
patterns.context: Research text focuses on a specific group of athletes with disabilities and discusses study findings or associations.

10_2362.description: 主要对体育相关文字中的运动员、运动项目和赛事信息起反应，也覆盖训练动作、运动营养、排名纪录、奖牌、运动员履历及学校体育列表；不同文体均有出现。

patterns.name: 运动员与体育赛事语境
patterns.context: 体育人物简介、赛事结果或体育项目列表中，描述运动员、项目、参赛经历、成绩与奖牌。
patterns.domain: 体育百科、体育研究与赛事报道

patterns.name: 体育项目名称
patterns.trigger: “wheelchair basketball”, “wheelchair rugby”, “sprinting”, “Taekwondo”, “Tennis”, “swimming”, “track and field”, “gym”, “squats”, “deadlifts”, “bench press”, “discus thrower”
patterns.context: 出现具体运动或训练动作；既包括竞技项目，也包括健身训练。

patterns.name: 运动表现与训练营养
patterns.context: 讨论长时间运动、饮食补充与运动表现之间的关系。

patterns.name: 体育统计、名次与纪录
patterns.trigger: “qualified”, “68 kg men’s categories”, “inaugural … Games”, “records”, “top-20”, “top-10”, “World Championships”, “world junior record”, “gold medal”, “Bronze Medal”, “Silver Medal”
patterns.context: 列举赛事资格、排名、纪录、参赛年份或奖牌成绩。

patterns.name: 运动员个人简介与履历
patterns.trigger: “retired Romanian athlete”, “represented”, “retired male discus thrower”, “best known for winning”
patterns.context: 人物条目以退役身份、国籍、代表队或运动生涯开篇。

patterns.name: 学校课外体育活动列表
patterns.trigger: “Extracurricular Activities”, “Sport”, “The main sports on offer are”
patterns.context: 学校介绍中的栏目标题及其提供的体育项目列表。

patterns.name: 相关性研究中的运动员群体
patterns.trigger: “wheelchair basketball and wheelchair rugby athletes with a spinal cord injury”
patterns.context: 研究性文字中以特定残障运动员群体为对象，讨论研究结果或相关性。

en.description: The neuron primarily responds to sports names, competition and medal narratives, results tables, and training and fitness content; it activates in list headings, athlete profiles, fitness advice, and sports medicine texts.

patterns.name: Sports and competition table headings
patterns.context: Lists, tables, or section headings list sports, gender divisions, or competition content; line breaks and bullet points are common.

patterns.name: Athlete participation and medal narratives
patterns.context: Describes athletes competing, representing a country, or earning placements and medals, often with years and sport names.

patterns.name: Sports training and fitness guidance
patterns.context: Discusses strength training, endurance exercise, athletic performance, or injury prevention; trigger words appear near training movements or fitness plans.
patterns.domain: Fitness advice, sports nutrition, and medical abstracts

patterns.name: Sports records and results tables
patterns.context: Uses headings and numbers to list track-and-field events, results, locations, and record indicators.

patterns.name: Wheelchair sports and spinal cord injury research
patterns.context: Research compares wheelchair athletes and spinal cord injury-related conditions; activations cluster around specific sport names.

10_2362.description: 神经元主要响应体育语境中的项目名、赛事与奖牌叙述、成绩表，以及训练和体能内容；在列表标题、运动员简介、健身建议和运动医学文本中均有触发。

patterns.name: 体育项目与赛事表格标题
patterns.context: 名单、表格或小节标题，列出体育项目、性别组别或赛事内容；常有换行与项目符号。

patterns.name: 运动员参赛与奖牌叙述
patterns.context: 描述运动员参加赛事、代表国家或获得名次奖牌，常带年份和项目名称。

patterns.name: 运动训练与体能指导
patterns.context: 讲述力量训练、耐力运动、运动表现或伤病预防；触发词落在训练动作或体能方案附近。
patterns.domain: 健身建议、运动营养与医学摘要

patterns.name: 体育纪录与成绩表
patterns.context: 以小标题和数字列出田径项目、成绩、地点及纪录标记。

patterns.name: 轮椅运动与脊髓损伤研究
patterns.context: 研究讨论中比较轮椅运动员及脊髓损伤相关情况，触发集中在具体运动项目名。

en.description: Responds to sports-related vocabulary: sports and gender categories, athlete specializations and event results in biographies, as well as sports medicine research, fitness movements, and endurance-sport nutrition. Triggering terms vary by context.

patterns.name: Lists and classifications of sports
patterns.context: Sport names appear consecutively, often arranged by gender, category, or event section on separate lines; activation highlights sport names and some classification terms.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia sports event entries, directories, or table fragments

patterns.name: Competition narratives in athlete biographies
patterns.context: Introduces athletes, their specializations, represented countries, event participation, and medal results; activation often falls on sport, event, and ranking terms.

patterns.name: Research contexts involving athletes or sports participants
patterns.context: Sports and athlete groups appear in academic discussions of correlations or physical conditions.

patterns.name: Fitness movements and sequencing
patterns.context: Describes a workout sequence that moves from a more difficult or heavier exercise to other movements.

patterns.name: Endurance sports and sports nutrition
patterns.context: Discusses prolonged exercise, running performance, and the effect of consuming carbohydrates before exercise.

10_2362.description: 对体育及运动相关词汇有反应：体育项目和性别分类、运动员传记中的专项与赛事成绩，也包括体育医学研究、健身动作和耐力运动营养；触发词随语境而变。

patterns.name: 体育项目列表与分类
patterns.context: 项目名称连续列举，常按性别、类别或赛事栏目换行排列；激活突出项目名及部分分类词
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 体育赛事条目、目录或表格残片

patterns.name: 运动员传记中的竞赛叙述
patterns.context: 介绍运动员及其专项、代表国家、赛事参赛经历和奖牌成绩；激活常落在运动项目、赛事和名次词上

patterns.name: 运动员或体育参与者的研究语境

en.description: Primarily responds to sports contexts, especially sports, track and field, swimming, ball sports, athletes, and competition results; also covers sports category headings and exercise-health advice. Sporadic activations occur in the tail of encyclopedia entries and biographical background. Though not a unified word class, these often appear in sports biographies.

patterns.name: Sports category lists and layout headings

patterns.name: Athletes and sports biographical information

patterns.name: Specific ball sports

patterns.name: Swimming and water sports

patterns.name: Sports, health, and training advice

patterns.name: Competition placements, medals, and results

patterns.name: Sports-related references and category tails

patterns.name: Sporadic non-sports background narrative

patterns.name: Injuries and associations in sports research

en.concept: Mixed subword fragments and formatting features
en.description: Activations are scattered across subwords in technical terms and proper names, common function words, code/formatting structures, and a few collocations and numbers; they span corpora and domains, with no stable, unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Cross-word boundaries / intra-word suffix fragments
patterns.context: Activations often fall on multiword terms, compounds, or intra-word fragments; sometimes they cover a continuous fragment, and sometimes only part of one is marked.

patterns.name: Specific terms or entity names
patterns.context: Subword fragments in domain terms, proper names, or identifiers may trigger activation, but these entities have no obvious semantic connection to one another.
patterns.domain: Philosophy, medicine, biomedicine, software, and code

patterns.name: Sentence-initial and function words / connectives
patterns.context: Common prepositions, articles, conjunctions, or infinitive markers also activate, usually in titles or technical phrases; they do not explain activation on their own.
patterns.domain: Paper titles, abstracts, and general text

patterns.name: Formatting markers, code structures, and line breaks
patterns.context: Line breaks, spaces, dividers, brackets, or paragraph markers activate in structured text; this is especially noticeable in formats such as code comments, references, and mailing lists.

patterns.name: Local collocations of common words
patterns.context: A few general words are marked in fixed collocations or common phrases, but there is insufficient evidence for a unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Numbers and dates/identifiers
patterns.context: Activations occur near years, times, or list numbers, possibly related to local formatting.

patterns.name: Specialized fragments in medical text
patterns.context: Biomedical vocabulary is split into subwords, with multiple fragments activating; these include diseases, experimental subjects, or examination names.

10_2447.concept: 混合的词片段与格式特征
10_2447.description: 激活分散于专业术语和专名的子词、普通功能词、代码/排版结构及少数搭配与数字；跨语料、跨领域，缺少稳定统一的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 跨词边界/词内后缀片段
patterns.trigger: 词语被切成多个子词片段并分别标记，如 «ency»10«cl»3«ical»1、«B»1«ened»5ict、«West»5« Nile»4« virus»8« infection»3
patterns.context: 激活常落在多词术语、复合词或词内片段上；有时覆盖连续片段，有时只标出其中一部分。

patterns.name: 特定术语或实体名称
patterns.trigger: «Natural»2 «Environment»1；«West Nile virus infection»；«metal-organic frameworks»、«carboxylic acid ligands»；«CommonJS Formatter»；«Visual»ization« Tool»kit
patterns.context: 领域术语、专名或标识符中的词片段可能触发，但这些实体彼此无明显语义联系。
patterns.domain: 哲学、医学、生物医学、软件与代码

patterns.name: 句首及功能词/连接语
patterns.context: 普通介词、冠词、连词或不定式标记也会激活，通常处于标题或专业短语中，不能单独解释激活。
patterns.domain: 论文标题、摘要及一般文本

patterns.name: 格式标记、代码结构与换行
patterns.context: 结构性文本中，换行、空格、分隔线、括号或段落标记出现激活；在代码注释、参考文献和邮件列表等格式中尤其明显。

patterns.name: 常见词的局部搭配
patterns.context: 少量一般词在固定搭配或常用短语中被标记，未见足够证据表明有统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 数字与日期/编号
patterns.context: 年份、时间或列表编号附近出现激活，可能与局部格式有关。

patterns.name: 医疗文本中的专门片段
patterns.context: 生物医学词汇被拆分为子词后多段激活，包含疾病、实验对象或检查名称。

en.description: Activations are scattered across subwords within words, medical terms, news phrases, code markers and identifiers, event notices, and email formats, with no single stable semantic interpretation. Code line breaks and parenthesized numbering also elicit clear responses.

patterns.name: Continuation of specific word forms or boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur within split words or on affixes; this also includes split forms such as “«Natur»al”, “«B»aur”, and “«B»enedict”.

patterns.name: Medical and biomedical terminology
patterns.context: Specialized terms in medical, biological, or biomedical data contexts; activations occur on term segments and adjacent components.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, PubMed Central, NIH project text

patterns.name: English news phrases and political reporting
patterns.context: Common phrases and political expressions in news headlines or reports; no clear unified specialized semantics.

patterns.name: Code structure markers and identifiers
patterns.context: Code comments, class names, function names, and code line breaks; activations occur on both formatting markers and identifier fragments.

patterns.name: Word segments in event notices
patterns.context: Within-word fragments in event invitations, especially “Lunch” and the proper noun “Regency”; no stable shared semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Common email word segments and numbering formats
patterns.context: Transactional expressions, expense reimbursement content, and parenthesized numbering in everyday email; activations are especially strong on parenthesized numbering.

10_2447.description: 激活分散于词内子词、医学术语、新闻短语、代码标记与标识符、活动通知及邮件格式，未见单一稳定语义；代码换行和括号编号也有明显响应。

patterns.name: 特定词形或词界续写
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的单词内部或词缀上；该片段还出现“«Natur»al”“«B»aur”“«B»enedict”等拆分形式。

patterns.name: 医学与生物医学术语
patterns.context: 医学、生物学或生物医学数据语境中的专业术语；激活分布在术语词段及其相邻成分。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、PubMed Central、NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 英文新闻短语及政治报道
patterns.trigger: «No»2« fines»1«":»3« Prosec»1«utor»1 General seeks« to»4« lock»9« up»3 Ukraine«'s»4
patterns.context: 新闻标题或报道中，常见短语和政治相关表达；没有明显统一的专业语义。

patterns.name: 代码结构标记与标识符
patterns.context: 代码注释、类名、函数名和代码换行等结构；激活既落在格式标记，也落在标识符片段。

patterns.name: 活动通知中的词段
patterns.context: 活动邀请文本中的词内片段，尤其是“Lunch”和专名“Regency”；未见稳定的共同语义条件。

patterns.name: 邮件常用词段及编号格式
patterns.context: 日常邮件中的事务性表达、费用报销内容及括号编号；括号编号处激活尤其强。

en.concept: Medical text and local word-form/format features
en.description: Activations occur in biomedical vocabulary and abstracts, as well as legal, philosophical, news, code, business-notice, and chemical entries; some hits are within-word token fragments or line breaks and separators. Incarceration-related semantics recur in a news passage and a social-medicine passage, but the other triggers lack a unified semantics and may reflect word-form and formatting effects.

patterns.name: Fragments within biomedical terms
patterns.context: Activations may occur on complete medical words, within-word substrings, or adjacent function words; common settings include research abstracts, titles, and article text on viral infection, medical data, imaging, psychiatric symptoms, or population health.

patterns.name: Token boundaries and within-word continuations
patterns.context: Activations on fragments of words or names split by tokenization; a fragment may continue after a marker token. No specific semantics are required, and this often overlaps with other activation patterns.

patterns.name: Lockup/incarceration expressions in phrases
patterns.context: Involves detention, asylum seekers, or restrictions on personal liberty in law-enforcement contexts; the two examples are a news quotation and a research title, semantically related but triggered by different forms.

patterns.name: Local word fragments in proper nouns and titles
patterns.context: Words and their tokenized fragments in philosophical text titles or proper nouns; there is no stable common theme, and these may be triggered by local word forms alone.

patterns.name: Specific word in legal narratives
patterns.context: In criminal case narratives introducing law-enforcement personnel, activations concentrate on “Agent”; other activations in the same passage are scattered across narrative words.

patterns.name: Code comments and layout separators
patterns.context: In header comments of code files, consecutive line breaks and long separator lines receive strong activations, alongside program names, module names, and other code text.

patterns.name: Lunch and venue in event notices
patterns.context: Business event invitations describing a Brown Bag lunch, hotel, and banquet hall; activations occur on within-word fragments, with no stable connection to themes in other passages.

patterns.name: Chemical formulas and compound entries
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry first gives a molecular formula, then lists possible compounds it may refer to; activations include the initial characters of chemical formulas and chemistry-related words.

10_2447.concept: 医学文本及局部词形/格式特征
10_2447.description: 激活分布在生物医学词汇及摘要中，也出现在法律、哲学、新闻、代码、商务通知和化学条目；部分命中是词内 token 片段或换行、分隔线。拘押语义在新闻与社会医学两段重复，但其余触发缺少统一语义，可能混有词形和格式效应。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语内部片段
