patterns.context: Describes the effect of immobilizing microsphere composites on a gold electrode on electrochemical performance

patterns.name: Astrophysical objects and angular parameters
patterns.context: Introduces the definition of a blazar and the angle at which its relativistic jet points toward the observer

patterns.name: Paper titles and formatted file paths
patterns.context: After a title, drawing commands and coordinate sequences resembling EPS/PostScript appear
patterns.domain: ArXiv document titles and embedded graphics code

patterns.name: Encoding metadata and character mapping
patterns.context: Records glyph, encoding, width, and anchor information as fields and values

10_2958.concept: 科学文本中的性质与限制描述
10_2958.description: 主要响应科学文本中描述药物/抗体局限、给药递送、吸收分布及效果性质的表达；也激活于电化学材料、天体物理、图形代码和字体元数据等异质片段。

patterns.name: 药物或抗体的局限与适用性
patterns.trigger: “their applicability”“drawbacks that limit”“properties that limit its efficacy”“concerns with drugs designed for oral administration”
patterns.context: 讨论疗效、给药或应用时，描述药物/抗体的局限、障碍、毒性或吸收问题
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及资助项目文本

patterns.name: 药物递送、靶向与体内分布
patterns.trigger: “target … into the liver and central nervous system”“liver deposition”“oral routes”“parenteral route”
patterns.context: 讨论药物或载体经何种途径给药、到达何处及其生物利用度或分布
patterns.domain: 药剂学、药物递送与成像研究

patterns.name: 定量结果与程度表达
patterns.trigger: “maximal effect”“40% and 2%”“average diameter”“500 nm”“short serum half-life”
patterns.context: 科学摘要中报告效果大小、材料尺寸或药代性质；可能与药物局限主题并存
patterns.domain: 生物医学及材料科学摘要

patterns.name: 电极表面积与电子传递
patterns.trigger: “increase the electrode surface area”“accelerate the electron transfer rate”
patterns.context: 描述微球复合材料固定到金电极后对电化学性能的作用

patterns.name: 天体物理对象及角度参数
patterns.context: 介绍 blazar 的定义与相对论喷流指向观测者的角度

patterns.name: 论文标题及格式化文件路径
patterns.trigger: “Ion Temperature Equilibration in Collisionless Shocks”“gsave newpath … moveto … lineto”
patterns.context: 标题后出现类似 EPS/PostScript 的绘图命令与坐标序列
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文档标题及嵌入式图形代码

patterns.name: 编码元数据与字符映射
patterns.context: 以字段和值记录字形、编码、宽度及锚点信息

en.concept: Technical descriptions of results and limitations
en.description: Activations are primarily concentrated on drug or treatment delivery, absorption, and efficacy limitations, as well as quantitative effects, intensity, or maximum tolerated doses; astrophysical paper structure/terminology and electrochemical performance descriptions also appear, so no single semantic pattern fully explains them.

patterns.name: Drug delivery and bioavailability limitations
patterns.context: Discusses administration, absorption, or limited efficacy of drugs, antibodies, or recombinant proteins; activation often falls near “their/its” and “limit(s).”

patterns.name: Maximum values, intensity, or upper bounds
patterns.context: Quantifies experimental effects, beam intensity, or maximum clinical dose; nearby text often contains numbers, units, or dosage terminology.
patterns.domain: Technical writing in biomedicine and physics

patterns.name: Targeted therapy and clinical trials
patterns.context: Describes targeted drug or antibody delivery, administration, cancer treatment, or clinical research; not all words form a single local trigger.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, patent background, and NIH trial records

patterns.name: Paper structure and astrophysical terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in ArXiv paper titles, introductions, or astrophysics body text; its connection to drug-limitations and maximum-value patterns is unclear.

patterns.name: Electrode surface and electron transfer
patterns.context: Describes changes in surface area and electron-transfer performance after microspheres are immobilized on a gold electrode.

10_2958.concept: 技术性结果与限制描述
10_2958.description: 激活主要聚集于药物或治疗的递送、吸收与疗效限制，以及量化效果、强度或耐受剂量上限；另见天体物理论文结构/术语和电化学性能描述，不能由单一语义模式完全解释。

patterns.name: 药物递送与生物利用度限制
patterns.trigger: “their”后接负面药代/递送性质，如“poor solubility”“poor intestinal epithelium permeability”“toxicity”“poor bioavailability”“limits its clinical use”“short serum half-life”；也包括“drawbacks that limit their applicability”
patterns.context: 讨论药物、抗体或重组蛋白的给药、吸收、疗效受限；激活常落在“their/its”及“limit(s)”附近。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、药剂学与临床治疗

patterns.name: 最大值、强度或上限
patterns.context: 定量描述实验效果、束流强度或临床剂量上限，附近常出现数值、单位或剂量术语。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与物理学的技术文体

patterns.name: 靶向治疗及临床试验
patterns.trigger: “target … into the liver and central nervous system”“administration”“clinical trials”“treatment”“TRAIL”
patterns.context: 描述药物或抗体的靶向递送、给药方式、癌症治疗或临床研究；并非所有词都构成同一个局部触发。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、专利背景及 NIH 试验记录

patterns.name: 论文结构与天体物理术语
patterns.trigger: “Introduction”“Blazars”“Active Galactic Nuclei”“relativistic jet”“Supernova Remnant-Solar Wind Connection”
patterns.context: 出现在 ArXiv 论文标题、引言或天体物理正文；与药物限制和最大值模式的联系不明确。

patterns.name: 电极表面与电子传递
patterns.trigger: “increase the electrode surface area and accelerate the electron transfer rate”
patterns.context: 描述微球固定于金电极后，表面积及电子传递性能的变化。
patterns.domain: 材料化学与电化学摘要

en.description: Primarily responds to wording that describes shortcomings of therapies, drugs, or delivery methods and their limits on applicability, application, clinical use, or efficacy. Other local patterns include maxima/upper bounds, small angles of astronomical jets, increases in electrode surface area, and the distance of closest approach of particle trajectories.

patterns.name: Limitations/shortcomings and their consequences
patterns.context: Describes drawbacks of a therapy, drug, or delivery method, often going on to state that they limit applicability, application, use, or efficacy.
patterns.domain: Biomedical and drug-delivery papers, background or discussion statements

patterns.name: Maximum or upper bound
patterns.context: Quantifies the maximum experimental effect or equipment capability; followed by values, intensity, or other metrics.
patterns.domain: Biomedical experimental abstracts and particle physics equipment descriptions

patterns.name: Astrophysical description of small angles
patterns.context: Describes the orientation angle of a blazar's relativistic jet and gives an angular threshold.

patterns.name: Electrode surface area
patterns.context: Describes changes in surface area and properties such as electron transfer after microspheres are immobilized on an electrode.

patterns.name: Distance of closest approach of particle trajectories
patterns.context: Specifies a positional requirement for a charged-particle trajectory relative to the beam axis and gives a distance threshold.

10_2958.description: 主要响应描述疗法、药物或递送方式缺陷及其对适用性、应用、临床使用或疗效的限制；另见最大值/上限、天体喷流小角度、电极表面积增加及粒子轨迹最近接近距离等局部模式。

patterns.name: 限制/缺点及其后果
patterns.context: 说明某疗法、药物或递送方式的不足，并常进一步说其限制 applicability、application、use 或 efficacy。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与药物递送论文，背景或讨论性陈述

patterns.name: 最大值或上限
patterns.context: 量化实验效果或设备能力的最大值；后接数值、强度等指标。
patterns.domain: 生物医学实验摘要及粒子物理设备描述

patterns.name: 小角度的天体物理描述
patterns.context: 描述 blazar 相对论喷流的指向角度，并给出角度阈值。

patterns.name: 电极表面积
patterns.context: 描述微球固定到电极后，表面积及电子传递等性能的变化。

patterns.name: 粒子轨迹的最近接近距离
patterns.context: 规定带电粒子轨迹相对束流轴的位置要求，并给出距离阈值。

en.concept: Academic expressions of limitations and upper bounds
en.description: Often responds to limitations on application/clinical use and barriers to drug delivery, absorption, and stability in academic texts; it also responds to maximum-value quantification, paper-structure markers, and physical geometry descriptions, along with domain terms that cannot be grouped together.

patterns.name: Expressions limiting application/use
patterns.context: Identifies a defect or cost that limits an object's application, use, or clinical utility; often follows the transition word “However”
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, patent background, and environmental science

patterns.name: Administration and bioavailability barriers
patterns.context: Describes limitations on oral drug delivery, absorption, or routes of administration

patterns.name: Insufficient delivery stability or efficiency
patterns.context: A delivery system or therapeutic molecule is difficult to apply because of instability, degradation, or low transport efficiency

patterns.name: Maximum/upper-bound quantification
patterns.context: Reports the maximum experimental effect or device capability, often adjacent to numbers, percentages, or units
patterns.domain: Medical experimental abstracts, particle physics instrument descriptions

patterns.name: Research document structure markers
patterns.context: Line breaks, punctuation, and formatting markers appear near paper metadata or section headings

patterns.name: Physical spatial angles or geometric quantities
patterns.context: Describes the direction of an astronomical jet or the position of a particle track relative to the beam axis

patterns.name: Contrast markers
patterns.context: Introduces a problem, limitation, or contrast; it is not sufficient by itself to explain all activations

patterns.name: Local patterns that cannot be clearly categorized
patterns.context: The available snippets do not establish a stable connection between the phrases containing these words and the other patterns

10_2958.concept: 受限与上限的学术表述
10_2958.description: 常在学术文本中响应应用/临床使用受限及药物递送、吸收和稳定性障碍；也响应最大值量化、论文结构标记与物理几何描述，另有无法归并的领域词项。

patterns.name: 限制应用/用途的表述
patterns.context: 指出某物的缺陷或成本限制其应用、使用或临床用途；常见于转折词 “However” 后
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、专利背景及环境科学

patterns.name: 给药与生物利用度障碍
patterns.context: 描述药物口服递送、吸收或给药途径受到的限制
patterns.domain: 药物递送、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 递送稳定性或效率不足
patterns.context: 递送系统或治疗分子因不稳定、降解或传输效率低而难以应用

patterns.name: 最大值/上限量化
patterns.trigger: “maximal … effect”, “maximum … intensity”, 数值上限表达
patterns.context: 报告实验效应或设备能力的最大值，常紧邻数字、百分比或单位
patterns.domain: 医学实验摘要、粒子物理仪器描述

patterns.name: 科研文档结构标记
patterns.context: 论文元数据或章节标题附近，伴有换行、标点及格式标记

patterns.name: 物理空间角度或几何量
patterns.context: 天体喷流方向或粒子径迹相对束流轴的位置描述
patterns.domain: 天体物理、实验粒子物理

patterns.name: 标记性转折
patterns.context: 转入问题、限制或对比陈述；并非单独足以解释所有激活

patterns.name: 未能明确归类的局部模式
patterns.context: 这些词所在句段中，无法从现有片段确定其与其他模式的稳定联系
patterns.domain: 核物理、天体物理、生物医学

en.concept: Parameters and limitation expressions in scientific texts
en.description: Activations occur on numbers, units, variables, and extreme-value expressions in scientific texts, as well as wording about drug absorption and limitations on applications in biomedicine; a graphics-source path command also triggers.

patterns.name: Restricted drug delivery and absorption
patterns.context: Discusses limitations involving degradation, solubility, permeability, absorption, or toxicity of oral drugs; also includes limitations on the use of antibodies in humans.

patterns.name: Quantification of effects and proportions
patterns.context: Describes experimental or delivery effects, with results quantified as percentages.

patterns.name: Scientific parameters, numbers, and units
patterns.context: Presents measurements, ranges, angles, units, or formula parameters in scientific papers; often adjacent to mathematical symbols and LaTeX markers.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, particle physics, particle experiments, and neutrino physics

patterns.name: Maximum values or extreme parameters
patterns.context: Indicates intensity limits or small angles and other extreme or boundary properties, often adjacent to numerical or symbolic expressions.

patterns.name: Document source and path fragments
patterns.context: Graphics-drawing commands and path coordinates are mixed into paper excerpts rather than normal prose.

10_2958.concept: 科学文本中的参数与限制表达
10_2958.description: 激活见于科学文本的数值、单位、变量和极值表达，也见于生物医学中描述药物吸收及应用限制的措辞；另对一段图形源码路径命令有响应。

patterns.name: 药物递送与吸收受限
patterns.context: 讨论口服药物的降解、溶解性、渗透性、吸收或毒性等限制；也包括抗体在人类应用中的局限。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与专利背景

patterns.name: 效果与比例的量化
patterns.context: 描述实验或递送效果，并以百分比量化结果。

patterns.name: 科学参数、数值与单位
patterns.context: 科学论文中呈现测量值、范围、角度、单位或公式参数；常邻近数学符号、LaTeX 标记。
patterns.domain: 天体物理、粒子物理、粒子实验与中微子物理

patterns.name: 最大值或极端参数
patterns.context: 说明强度上限或角度较小等极值、边界性质，常与数值或符号表达式相邻。

patterns.name: 文档源码与路径片段
patterns.context: 论文片段中混入图形绘制命令和路径坐标，而非正常正文。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文档或图形源码残片

en.description: Activations often fall on capitalized words, abbreviations, proper names, or intraword subword fragments. They may also occur in titles, sentence-initial positions, and boundary punctuation. Some content words in scientific and media texts cannot be consistently explained this way; no single domain or semantic theme is evident.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments of capitalized abbreviations or proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on all-caps abbreviations, proper names, or word-initial/internal subword fragments of ordinary words, especially tokenized fragments containing capital letters. Nearby text often has names, title formatting, or sentence-initial formatting.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including emails, grant abstracts, encyclopedia entries, medical abstracts, and news podcast descriptions.

patterns.name: Capitalized words in sentence-initial and title-style text
patterns.context: Words beginning with capitals appear at the start of a fragment, sentence, or title. Some activations also extend to adjacent punctuation, line breaks, or the same proper name.
patterns.domain: Emails, abstracts, encyclopedia entries, titles, and media copy.

patterns.name: Proper names such as organizations, products, and people
patterns.context: Occurs in brand/product credits, organization or person names, place names, and other proper names. Activations often fall on components of names rather than general semantic words.
patterns.domain: Email signatures and product promotions, organization descriptions, news headlines, and encyclopedia entries about places.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of medical or scientific terms
patterns.context: In research abstracts or medical descriptions, terms, abbreviations, and subword fragments of longer words activate; the vocabulary itself is not consistent.
patterns.domain: NIH grant abstracts, PubMed medical abstracts, and research service descriptions.

patterns.name: Sentence-final or paragraph-boundary punctuation
patterns.context: Weak to moderate activations occur near line breaks, periods, or commas, often alongside title/list formatting or text boundaries.
patterns.domain: Emails, encyclopedia entries, abstracts, and news headlines.

patterns.name: General capitalized entities or content words
patterns.context: In a few passages, activations fall on domain-specific content words, paragraph topic words, or person pronouns, without a shared local word-form or semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, research proposals, and media descriptions.

10_2993.description: 激活常落在大写开头、缩写、专名或词内分词片段，也可出现在标题、句首和边界标点；少数科研及媒体文本中的内容词无法由此稳定解释，未见单一领域或语义主题。

patterns.name: 大写缩写或专名的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在全大写缩写、专名或普通词的词首/内部子词片段上，尤其是带大写字母的分词 token；周围常有名称、标题或句首格式。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括邮件、资助摘要、百科、医学摘要及新闻播客介绍。

patterns.name: 句首与标题式文本中的大写词
patterns.context: 片段开头、句首或标题中出现大写开头的词；部分激活也延伸到相邻标点、换行或同一专名。
patterns.domain: 邮件、摘要、百科条目、标题及媒体文案。

patterns.name: 组织、产品与人名等专有名词
patterns.context: 出现在品牌/产品署名、机构或人名、地名等专名中；激活常在名称组成部分而非一般语义词上。
patterns.domain: 邮件签名与产品宣传、机构介绍、新闻标题、百科地名条目。

patterns.name: 医学或科研术语的内部片段
patterns.context: 在研究摘要或医学描述中，术语、缩写及较长词的分词片段获得激活；但这些词汇本身并不统一。
patterns.domain: NIH 资助摘要、PubMed 医学摘要及科研服务描述。

patterns.name: 句末或段落边界标点
patterns.context: 换行、句号或逗号附近出现弱到中等激活，常伴随标题/列表格式或文本边界。
patterns.domain: 邮件、百科条目、摘要及新闻标题。

patterns.name: 一般大写实体或内容词
patterns.context: 少数段落中，激活落在领域内容词、段落主题词或人物代词上，缺少共同的局部词形或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、科研申请、媒体介绍。

en.description: Activations occur on in-word subwords, word-initial fragments, and proper-name/title content words across texts from multiple domains, with occasional line breaks and punctuation. There are no stable semantic, disciplinary, or syntactic conditions; overall, the feature appears to respond broadly at the token-fragment level.

patterns.name: Within-word and word-initial token boundaries
patterns.context: Activations often fall on subword fragments within words or word-initial fragments, commonly followed by unmarked morpheme continuations; specific word meanings and syntactic positions vary widely
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English text; news, abstracts, encyclopedias, emails, etc.

patterns.name: Word fragments in proper names and titles
patterns.context: Triggered in company/design names, people and place names, article titles, or salient content words in sentences; no stable restriction by word meaning or part of speech is evident
patterns.domain: Email subjects, news headlines, place-name entries, scientific texts, and podcast descriptions

patterns.name: Term or method fragments in scientific abstracts
patterns.context: Terms, abbreviations, proper names, and ordinary words in scientific abstracts, project descriptions, or service descriptions can all trigger; the pattern cannot be reduced to terminology from a single discipline

patterns.name: Formatting and title boundaries
patterns.context: A small number of activations occur near line breaks, punctuation, or title/list-like boundaries, but activations also occur within body-text words, so boundaries alone cannot explain all examples
patterns.domain: Emails, titles, directory-style or abstract-style text

10_2993.description: 激活分布于多领域文本的词内子词、词首片段及专名/标题内容词，偶见换行和标点；没有稳定语义、学科或句法条件，整体更像分词片段层面的广泛响应。

patterns.name: 分词内部及词首式边界
patterns.trigger: “«”紧邻词素或词首片段，如 «ING»、“« d»”“« CON»”，以及词首专名片段“«Pat»”“«Ass»”“«H»”
patterns.context: 激活常落在单词内部的子词片段或词首片段，周围常有未标记的词素续接；具体词义和句法位置变化很大
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语文本；新闻、摘要、百科、邮件等

patterns.name: 专名与标题中的词片段
patterns.context: 在公司/设计名、人物与地点名、文章标题或句中重要内容词中触发；未见稳定的词义或词性限定
patterns.domain: 邮件标题、新闻标题、地名条目、科研文本及播客介绍

patterns.name: 科研摘要中的术语或方法片段
patterns.context: 科研摘要、项目说明或服务描述中的术语、缩写、专名与普通词均可触发，不能归结为单一学科术语

patterns.name: 格式与标题边界
patterns.context: 少量激活出现在换行、标点或类似标题/清单的边界附近，但激活也出现在正文词语内部，边界本身不足以解释全部样例
patterns.domain: 邮件、标题、目录式或摘要式文本

en.concept: Applications word forms and miscellaneous words
en.description: The most stable trigger is Applications, found in varied contexts such as scientific application descriptions, book titles, and patent numbers. Other isolated strong activations include Plasma, she, Bernstein, and hearing, with no unifying semantic or stylistic explanation.

patterns.name: Applications as a title-like word
patterns.context: The word form Applications appears in technology, research, or project text, usually as a title-like noun within a sentence, followed by in/of or a specific application target; it also occurs in citation titles.
patterns.domain: Research funding abstracts, patent backgrounds, bibliographic citations

patterns.name: Descriptions of practical applications and uses
patterns.context: Describes what applications a prototype, method, or model will be used for, often alongside will, used, include, or a specific application area.

patterns.name: Applications in titles
patterns.context: Appears in a noun phrase in a book title, rather than in a plan for applications in body text.

patterns.name: International patent application numbers
patterns.context: Applications appears with International, WO, and strings of numbers/dates, as part of a patent document number list.

patterns.name: Applications in bibliographic titles
patterns.context: Occurs in a research paper title or topic phrase, referring to applications of a model; the surrounding content concerns project evaluation.

patterns.name: Plasma, a section name unrelated to Applications
patterns.context: Part of a product name in a promotional email, adjacent to product descriptions such as Screen and Banner Towers; apparently unrelated to the Applications word forms in other segments.

patterns.name: Personal pronoun she
patterns.context: Refers to a journalist in a podcast report description, followed by wrote and the article source; no clear shared context with other activation segments is evident.

patterns.name: Author surname Bernstein
patterns.context: Appears as a book author's name in a news headline/clipping list.
patterns.domain: Clipping summaries in business news emails

patterns.name: Hearing-loss topic word
patterns.context: Appears with unilateral and loss in a medical paper title, describing adult unilateral hearing loss.

patterns.name: Unexplained high-activation words
patterns.context: Occur respectively at the start of continuations in a project name, a demographic study, garbled/title text in an email, and a medical abstract; beyond their local content, no common trigger condition unifies them.

10_2993.description: 最稳定的触发是 Applications，见科研应用说明、书名和专利编号等不同语境；另有 Plasma、she、Bernstein、hearing 等孤立强激活，缺少统一语义或文体解释。

patterns.name: Applications 标题式词
patterns.context: 词形 Applications 出现在科技/研究或项目文本中，通常作为句中标题式名词，后接 in/of 或具体应用对象；也见于引文标题。
patterns.domain: 科研资助摘要、专利背景、书目引文

patterns.name: 应用落地与用途说明
patterns.trigger: « will»4 « be»2 ... « used»1 ... « applications»1；« Applications»10 « in»6 « cancer»2 « detection»2；« Applications»10 « will»4 « include»2
patterns.context: 描述原型、方法或模型将用于何种应用，常伴随 will、used、include 或具体应用领域。
patterns.domain: 科研项目摘要、技术说明

patterns.name: 标题中的 Applications
patterns.context: 出现在书籍标题的名词短语中，而非正文中的应用计划。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的参考文献

patterns.name: 国际专利申请编号
patterns.context: Applications 与 International、WO 及编号/日期串连用，属于专利文献编号列表。

patterns.name: 书目标题中的应用词
patterns.context: 位于研究文献题名或主题短语中，指模型的应用；相邻内容涉及项目评估。
patterns.domain: 人口学/生育率研究摘要

patterns.name: 非 Applications 的栏目名 Plasma
patterns.context: 在产品宣传邮件中作为产品名称的一部分，邻接 Screen、Banner Towers 等商品描述；与其他段的 Applications 词形无明显关系。

patterns.name: 人物代词 she
patterns.context: 播客报道简介中指代一位记者，后接 wrote 及文章出处；与其他激活段未见明确共同语境。

patterns.name: 作者姓 Bernstein
patterns.context: 出现在新闻标题/剪报列表中，作为书籍作者姓名。
patterns.domain: 商业新闻邮件中的剪报摘要

patterns.name: 听力损失主题词
patterns.context: 医学论文标题中与 unilateral、loss 连用，描述成人单侧听力损失。

patterns.name: 未解释的高激活词
patterns.context: 分别位于项目名称、人口学研究、邮件中乱码/标题文字及医学摘要的词首续接处；除所属局部内容外，未见可统一解释的共同触发条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple domains: medical terminology, proper names and identifiers, technical and statistical titles, amounts, legal citations, and code comments. Apart from a few local words or formatting patterns, there is no consistent semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Hearing and hearing impairment
patterns.context: Words related to hearing loss, hearing impairment, or hearing aids; the marked area focuses on “hearing” and nearby text.

patterns.name: 333 identifier and title line break
patterns.context: A short title or entry opening, where the number “333” is repeatedly marked, followed by a line break.

patterns.name: Optical fiber multiplexing terminology
patterns.context: Technical description of mode-division multiplexing in optical fibers; “multiplex” is the strongest trigger.

patterns.name: Science education program name
patterns.context: Describes a proposed program, BASE (Broadening Access to Science Education), that will offer an annual residential summer science program.

patterns.name: Currency amounts and financial figures
patterns.context: Statements of a company’s cash revenue; strong activations cluster around the currency unit “reais” and the dollar sign.

patterns.name: Observations in a statistical test title
patterns.context: A comparison between statistical tests and a title about the question of the number of factors; activation falls on “Observations”.

patterns.name: Regulatory citation format
patterns.context: A citation fragment composed of numbers, a court case reporter abbreviation, and a line break.

patterns.name: Alcoholic liver disease and tissue damage
patterns.context: Explains that some heavy drinkers develop tissue damage and organ dysfunction; activations fall near “in”, “develop”, and “injury”.

patterns.name: Update instruction in a code comment
patterns.context: A short comment beginning with a hash sign, asking that a project or resource be updated only once.

10_2993.description: 激活分散于多个领域：医学术语、专名与编号、技术及统计标题、金额、法律引文和代码注释。除若干局部词语或格式外，没有一致的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 听力及听觉障碍
patterns.context: 听力损失、听觉障碍或助听器相关词语；标记重点落在“hearing”及其附近。

patterns.name: 333 标识符及标题换行
patterns.context: 短标题或条目开头，编号“333”被重复标记，后接换行。

patterns.name: 光纤多路复用术语
patterns.context: 光学纤维中模式分复用的技术描述；“multiplex”是最强触发词。

patterns.name: 科学教育项目名称
patterns.context: 描述拟议项目 BASE（Broadening Access to Science Education）将提供年度住宿制暑期科学项目。

patterns.name: 货币金额及财务数字
patterns.context: 公司现金收入的金额陈述；强激活集中在货币单位“reais”和美元符号附近。

patterns.name: 统计检验标题中的观察项
patterns.context: 统计检验之间的比较及关于因子数量问题的标题；激活落在“Observations”。

patterns.name: 法规编号格式
patterns.context: 由数字、法院判例报告缩写和换行组成的引文编号片段。

patterns.name: 酒精性肝病及组织损伤
patterns.context: 说明部分酗酒者会发展出组织损伤及器官功能障碍；激活分别落在“in”“develop”和“injury”附近。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的更新指令
patterns.context: 以井号开头、要求某项目或资源仅更新一次的简短注释。

en.description: The most stable pattern is a double hyphen at the beginning of segments from various text types. Other isolated triggers include a wood-grain phrase, an internal fragment of a name, a mathematical expression, and a hearing-aid phrase, with no apparent shared semantics.

patterns.name: Double-hyphen marker
patterns.context: A double hyphen occurs at the beginning of a segment; it may be followed by a line break, a source-code comment, or text
patterns.domain: GitHub code, emails, and other text

patterns.name: Repeated Wood grain phrase
patterns.context: “Wood grain” appears as a sentence-initial topic phrase and recurs in the immediately following definition sentence

patterns.name: Tokenized fragment within a name
patterns.context: Only some fragments are marked near a person's name and its punctuation or initials

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and decimal expressions
patterns.context: Mathematical expressions composed of equals signs, numbers, decimal points, and plus/minus signs

patterns.name: hearing aids phrase
patterns.context: “hearing aids” occurs as a noun phrase in a sentence, followed by a reason for repair

10_2993.description: 最稳定的模式是多类文本开头的双连字符；另有木纹词组、人名内部片段、数学符号表达式及助听器词组等孤立触发，彼此缺乏明显共同语义。

patterns.name: 双连字符标记
patterns.context: 双连字符位于片段开头；其后可能接换行、源码注释或文本

patterns.name: Wood grain 词组重复
patterns.context: “Wood grain”作为句首主题词并在紧接的定义句中重现

patterns.name: 名字中的切分片段
patterns.context: 人名及其标点、首字母附近，仅姓名中部分片段被标记

patterns.name: 数学符号与小数表达式
patterns.context: 等号、数字、小数点和正负号构成的数学表达式

patterns.name: hearing aids 词组
patterns.context: “hearing aids”作为句中名词短语，后接维修原因

en.description: The strongest examples are dominated by mixed strings of numbers, variables, operators, and exponents in math problems. Other activations are scattered across optical fiber terminology, encyclopedia titles, text about Uganda’s population, and genetics terminology; no shared, clear semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Specific symbols and number strings in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Long mixed strings of operators, variables, numbers, and exponents appear in math problems or expressions; some fragments stop midway through a formula or immediately after an instruction.

patterns.name: Multiplexing in a mode name
patterns.context: The phrase “Mode division multiplexing” appears at the beginning of an abstract about fiber-optic communications, followed by “in optical fibers”.

patterns.name: Proper name Union Live
patterns.context: Repeated as an entry title, followed by “is a 2-”; no clear mathematical context.

patterns.name: Uganda and population issues
patterns.context: The country name appears as the sentence-initial subject, followed by “faces problems of rapid population growth and low contrace…”.
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter, population and reproductive health-related text

patterns.name: Genetics term heterozygous mutation
patterns.context: A medical abstract describes a mutation in the SAM domain; the fragment continues with “in the SAM domain of p”.

10_2993.description: 最强样本以数学题中的数字、变量、运算符及幂次混合串为主；其余激活分散在光纤术语、百科标题、Uganda人口文本和遗传学术语上，未见共同的明确语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的特定符号与数字串
patterns.context: 数学题或表达式中出现较长的运算符、变量、数字和幂次混合串；若干片段停在公式中途或紧接题目指令。

patterns.name: 模式名称中的 multiplexing
patterns.context: 短语“Mode division multiplexing”出现在光纤通信主题的摘要开头，后接“in optical fibers”。

patterns.name: 专名 Union Live
patterns.context: 作为条目标题重复出现，随后接“is a 2-”；没有明显数学上下文。

patterns.name: Uganda 与人口问题
patterns.context: 国家名作句首主语，后接“faces problems of rapid population growth and low contrace…”。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter，人口与生殖健康相关文本

patterns.name: 遗传学术语 heterozygous mutation
patterns.context: 医学摘要中描述 SAM domain 的突变，片段以“in the SAM domain of p”继续。

en.description: Activations span mathematical formulas, PHP identifiers, English titles, and prose. Clearer local cues include mathematical typesetting symbols, English to, infinitival contexts, and all-caps titles, but no single word meaning or style explains all passages.

patterns.name: English preposition to
patterns.context: Appears in English sentences, especially infinitival constructions such as “desire to have” and “goal … is to address”. Local context supports this pattern, but does not establish that the trigger must be an infinitive.

patterns.name: Structural markers in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Inside formulas or mathematical derivations; activations are scattered across line breaks, delimiters, and mathematical tokens rather than a single mathematical word.

patterns.name: Code namespace/identifier fragments
patterns.context: Several path or name fragments activate in PHP namespaces and underscore-connected identifiers.

patterns.name: Title-style English phrase
patterns.context: Several ordinary English words show weak activations in the sentence-initial title “Ten things you might not know about fish”; no clear shared trigger word is evident.

patterns.name: Fragments in personal names
patterns.context: A proper name in a narrative sentence; the same sentence also contains ordinary English narrative words, so it is unclear whether the activation is caused by the name or its context.

patterns.name: All-caps section title
patterns.context: The title is dominated by the all-caps, tokenized “PLANNING AND EVALUATION (P&E)”.

10_2993.description: 激活跨越数学公式、PHP 标识符、英语标题与散文；较明确的局部线索包括数学排版符号、英语 to、不定式语境及全大写标题，但没有一个词义或文体能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 英语介词 to
patterns.context: 出现在英语句中，尤其是“desire to have”“goal … is to address”这类不定式结构；只有局部上下文支持，不足以确认必须是不定式。
patterns.domain: 英语散文、技术/项目文档

patterns.name: 数学公式中的结构标记
patterns.trigger: «↵»、«$$»、«\in»、« orall»、«	heta»、«\mathbb» 等 LaTeX 符号与命令
patterns.context: 公式或数学推导内部；激活分散在换行、分隔符和数学 token 上，并非单一数学词。

patterns.name: 代码命名空间/标识符片段
patterns.context: PHP 命名空间及下划线连接的标识符中，若干路径或名称片段激活。

patterns.name: 标题式英语短语
patterns.context: 句首标题“Ten things you might not know about fish”中多个普通英语词有较弱激活；未见明确共同触发词。

patterns.name: 人名中的片段
patterns.context: 叙事句中的专名；同句还有普通英语叙述词，无法判断激活是否由人名或上下文导致。

patterns.name: 全大写章节标题
patterns.context: 标题以全大写、被切分成子词的“PLANNING AND EVALUATION (P&E)”为主。

en.concept: Symbols and numerical values in structured text
en.description: Activations primarily fall on structured, non-continuous prose: mathematical formulas, table values and labels, index symbols, and legal document titles. Specific content and domains vary, with no unified word-meaning trigger.

patterns.name: Numbers and symbols in LaTeX mathematical expressions
patterns.context: In mathematical formulas or proofs, numbers, variables, operators, and LaTeX commands are interleaved; the specific formulas differ between passages.
patterns.domain: StackExchange math Q&A, PubMed scientific papers

patterns.name: Numeric columns and alignment structure in tables
patterns.context: Data are arranged in tables using spaces, line breaks, or Markdown/plain-text formatting, with values aligned in columns and often accompanied by category names or headers.
patterns.domain: Enron emails, PubMed tables, StackExchange data

patterns.name: Labels for paired matrices and their inverses
patterns.context: Two adjacent table rows have labels indicating matrices or transformation operations, with numbers arranged to the right.

patterns.name: Numbered brackets and subscript symbol tables
patterns.context: Symbols and indices are arranged in rows and columns, with corresponding zero values afterward; the text need not be natural-language sentences.

patterns.name: Legal document titles and case layout
patterns.context: Uppercase names, party roles, state names, and court sources are laid out in blocks, with blank lines or separator lines between them.

patterns.name: Local responses to standalone number strings or numeric cells
patterns.context: In multi-row numeric tables, responses fall on standalone numeric tokens; the numbers do not appear to share a common numerical meaning.

10_2993.concept: 结构化排版文本中的符号与数值
10_2993.description: 激活主要落在结构化、非连续散文文本：数学公式、表格数值与标签、索引符号及法律文书标题；具体内容和领域不一，未见统一词义触发。

patterns.name: LaTeX数学表达式中的数字与符号
patterns.context: 数学公式或证明中，数字、变量、运算符和 LaTeX 命令交错出现；不同段具体公式内容各异。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 数学问答、PubMed 科学论文

patterns.name: 表格中的数值列与对齐结构
patterns.trigger: 如“0.4071 China”“12 84 0.4 006 Poland”，以及反复出现的数值行、百分比和列标题
patterns.context: 以空格、换行或 Markdown/纯文本排版成表，数值按列排列，常伴随分类名称或表头。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、PubMed 表格、StackExchange 数据

patterns.name: 成对矩阵及其逆矩阵的标注
patterns.context: 表格中两行相邻，行标签指示矩阵或变换操作，右侧排列数字。

patterns.name: 带编号的方括号及下标符号表
patterns.context: 符号与索引按行列形式排列，后续对应零值；不必是自然语言句子。

patterns.name: 法律文书的标题与案情版式
patterns.trigger: “JAMES DEAN GRAYSON”“APPELLANT”“THE STATE OF TEXAS”“FROM THE 396TH DISTRICT”
patterns.context: 大写姓名、当事人身份、州名和法院来源分块排版，中间有空行或分隔线。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法律判决/诉讼文书

patterns.name: 单独数字串或数值单元格的局部响应
patterns.context: 在多行数字表中，响应落在独立的数值 token 上；看不出这些数字具有共同数值意义。

en.description: Responses are primarily to LaTeX mathematical formulas and typesetting structure; there are also sporadic activations on source macros, numeric lists, citation keys, and academic prose. Domains and triggers vary.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical typesetting commands
patterns.context: Mathematical content is typeset using LaTeX commands and formulas; activations fall on commands, parentheses, and nearby formula markers.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics papers; including physics formulas, group theory, and other mathematical content

patterns.name: Structural markers in formula environments
patterns.context: In multiline or aligned formulas, activations cluster on line breaks, alignment symbols, superscripts/subscripts, and other structural syntax rather than a single mathematical topic.

patterns.name: Macro and command fragments in LaTeX source
patterns.context: In configuration or macro-processing source, markings appear near command names, macro names, and their delimiters.

patterns.name: Comma-separated numeric lists
patterns.context: Numbers are comma-separated and arranged within braces, continuing across lines with commas and line breaks.
patterns.domain: Data or constant lists in GitHub code

patterns.name: Citation identifiers
patterns.context: A bracketed citation key containing letters, hyphens, and numbers follows discussion in the body text; activation also covers numbers within the key and nearby punctuation.

patterns.name: Common words in academic prose
patterns.context: In non-formula academic prose, activations are distributed across general words and phrases; no consistent semantic or syntactic trigger is apparent.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central medical/scientific paper body text

patterns.name: Mathematical paper prose and theorem structure
patterns.context: Activations occur around mathematical paper narratives, theorem references, and theorem statements, but do not consistently correspond to a single term.

patterns.name: Sentence-final punctuation and asterisk markers
patterns.context: Sporadic activations occur near sentence-final punctuation or emphasis markers on defined terms; their relation to other clear patterns is uncertain.

10_2993.concept: 学术文本中的结构化标记
10_2993.description: 主要响应 LaTeX 数学公式及排版结构；另对源码宏、数字列表、文献键和学术正文词句有零散激活，跨领域且触发不一。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学排版命令
patterns.context: 数学内容以 LaTeX 命令和公式排版；激活落在命令、括号及邻近公式标记上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文；覆盖物理公式、群论与其他数学内容

patterns.name: 公式环境中的结构标记
patterns.context: 多行公式或对齐公式中，激活集中于换行、对齐符、上下标等结构语法，而非单一数学主题。

patterns.name: LaTeX 源码中的宏与命令片段
patterns.context: 配置或宏处理源码中，标记出现在命令名、宏名及其分隔符附近。

patterns.name: 逗号分隔的数值列表
patterns.context: 数字按逗号分隔并排列在花括号内，行间以逗号和换行延续。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码中的数据或常量列表

patterns.name: 文献引用标识符
patterns.context: 正文论述后附带方括号包围的带字母、连字符和数字的引用键；激活也覆盖键内数字及邻近标点。

patterns.name: 学术正文中的常见词
patterns.trigger: “forensic entomology” could refer to many other activities, the phrase almost always denotes；this population has been found to suffer from dental anxiety
patterns.context: 非公式的学术散文中，激活分布在一般词语及短语上；没有明显一致的词义或句法触发点。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学/科学论文正文

patterns.name: 数学论文正文与定理结构
patterns.trigger: fundamental domains、introduced by Margulis、On the other hand；In this paper, we will prove；[thm:main] Let
patterns.context: 数学论文叙述、定理引用和定理陈述附近出现激活，但没有稳定对应的单一词项。

patterns.name: 句末标点及星号标记
patterns.context: 句末或定义术语的强调标记附近出现零星激活；与其他明确模式的关系不清楚。

en.description: Strong responses are primarily to commands, mathematical environments, and structural markers in LaTeX source; there are also responses to column-aligned data and repeated separators in C-style comment banners.

patterns.name: LaTeX typesetting and mathematical markers
patterns.context: LaTeX commands, environments, mathematical symbols, and structural markers occur in formulas, matrices, figures, tables, or document source.

patterns.name: Aligned tables/columnar data
patterns.context: Short fields are arranged in columns across multiple lines, with underscores, commas, and whitespace alignment; no explicit LaTeX environment is present.

patterns.name: Comment separator banners
patterns.context: A C-style block comment contains decorative separators made of repeated hyphens, equals signs, and slashes.

10_2993.description: 主要对 LaTeX 源码中的命令、数学环境及结构标记强响应；也响应列式对齐数据和 C 风格注释横幅中的重复分隔符。

patterns.name: LaTeX 排版与数学标记
patterns.context: LaTeX 命令、环境、数学符号和结构标记出现在公式、矩阵、图表或文档源码中。

patterns.name: 对齐的表格/列式数据
patterns.context: 短字段在多行中按列排列，含下划线、逗号和空白对齐；没有明确 LaTeX 环境。

patterns.name: 注释分隔横幅
patterns.context: C 风格块注释中出现重复横线、等号和斜杠构成的装饰性分隔符。

en.description: Activations cover various texts containing numbers, parentheses, and structured representations: LaTeX formulas, matrices and tables, scientific measurements, code output, and lists. Logical and astronomical prose also appears. The commonality is weak, making it difficult to assign a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical symbols and structure
patterns.context: LaTeX commands, parentheses, or environments appear in mathematical formulas, often adjacent to variables, matrices, or relations.

patterns.name: Matrix or array representations
patterns.context: Matrices, arrays, or tables are written, discussed, or presented as data; they are not necessarily LaTeX formulas.
patterns.domain: Math Q&A, scientific papers, and data tables

patterns.name: Numbers and measurement values
patterns.context: Numbers occur in mathematical objects, tables, scientific measurements, or sequences in various forms.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, science, data, and programming text

patterns.name: Parentheses and indexed symbols
patterns.context: Parentheses enclose variables, indices, logical expressions, or numbers; often accompanied by formula or list structure.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, logic, R code, and Q&A

patterns.name: R code and console output
patterns.context: R code, time filtering, and console results appear together, followed by the text `Variation The prior`.

patterns.name: Natural science units and observed parameters
patterns.context: Descriptions of radio arrays or astronomical spectra report frequencies, wavelengths, resolution, and instrument parameters.

patterns.name: Logical reasoning phrasing
patterns.context: The body text discusses reasoning methods in propositional logic, followed by a formula.

patterns.name: Mathematical definitions and quantified conditions
patterns.context: Mathematical properties or conditions are stated using quantifiers, variables, and formulas.

patterns.name: Astronomical observation narrative
patterns.context: Describes observed objects, telescopes, locations, dates, and spectroscopic instruments.

patterns.name: Table rows and dash placeholders
patterns.context: Astronomical values are displayed in aligned columns, with dashes indicating missing values or empty entries.

patterns.name: Counting sequences or permutation output
patterns.context: Text requests all results satisfying an ordering condition, followed by a bracketed sequence of integers.

patterns.name: English Q&A prompts
patterns.context: A StackExchange-style question or explanatory body text; the wording itself has no prominent shared theme.

patterns.name: Cost/objective quantity in a formula
patterns.context: A paper formula defines a cost quantity and includes a summation and state and control variables.

patterns.name: Large integer and decimal data columns
patterns.context: Tables contain columns of integers, decimals, and dashes; their relation to formulas or natural language is unclear.

patterns.name: Time and date formats
patterns.context: Time filters, console dates, or observation dates appear in various formats.

10_2993.concept: 结构化数学与数值文本
10_2993.description: 激活覆盖多种含数字、括号和结构化表示的文本：LaTeX 公式、矩阵与表格、科学测量、代码输出及列表；也见逻辑和天文叙述。共同点较弱，难以归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学符号与结构
patterns.context: 数学公式中出现 LaTeX 命令、括号或环境，常与变量、矩阵、关系式相邻。
patterns.domain: 数学、逻辑及科学论文/问答

patterns.name: 矩阵或数组表达
patterns.context: 矩阵、数组或表格被书写、讨论，或作为数据呈现；不一定是 LaTeX 公式。
patterns.domain: 数学问答、科学论文及数据表

patterns.name: 数字与计量数值
patterns.context: 数字出现在数学对象、表格、科学测量或序列中，形式各异。
patterns.domain: 数学、科学、数据与编程文本

patterns.name: 括号与索引式符号
patterns.context: 括号包围变量、索引、逻辑式或数字；常与公式或列表结构相伴。
patterns.domain: 数学、逻辑、R 代码及问答

patterns.name: R 代码及控制台输出
patterns.context: R 代码、时间筛选与控制台结果相邻，后接文字 `Variation The prior`。

patterns.name: 自然科学单位与观测参数
patterns.context: 射电阵列或天文光谱描述中报告频率、波长、分辨率及仪器参数。

patterns.name: 逻辑推理措辞
patterns.context: 正文讨论命题逻辑的推理方法，随后给出公式。

patterns.name: 数学定义与量词条件
patterns.context: 以量词、变量和公式陈述数学性质或条件。

patterns.name: 天文观测叙述
patterns.context: 描述观测对象、望远镜、地点、日期及光谱仪器。

patterns.name: 表格行与破折号占位
patterns.context: 以对齐列展示天体相关数值，破折号表示缺值或空项。

patterns.name: 计数序列或排列输出
patterns.context: 文字要求输出满足顺序条件的全部结果，随后列出方括号中的整数序列。

patterns.name: 英文问答提示语
patterns.trigger: `I am trying to Express`、`We can use all the rules`
patterns.context: StackExchange 口吻的提问或解释性正文；表达本身并无显著共同主题。

patterns.name: 公式中的代价/目标量
patterns.context: 论文公式定义代价量，并出现求和及状态、控制变量。

patterns.name: 大型整数及小数数据列
patterns.context: 表格中成列出现整数、小数和破折号，内容与公式或自然语言关系不明显。

patterns.name: 时间与日期格式
patterns.context: 时间筛选、控制台日期或观测日期以多种格式出现。

en.description: Activations occur across several types of structured content: scientific approximate values, code preprocessor directives and code examples, mathematical formulas, medical tables, and narratives involving dollar amounts. No single word meaning or topic accounts for all of them.

patterns.name: Approximation symbols and scientific values
patterns.context: A mathematical approximation symbol followed by a value, often with units, subscripts/superscripts, or formula formatting; activations cluster around the symbols and values.

patterns.name: Preprocessor directives in code
patterns.context: C/C++ header files or source code, including preprocessor directives such as #define, #ifdef, and #endif and adjacent identifiers.

patterns.name: Test commands and shell code blocks
patterns.context: After instructions on running tests, a shell command example with a shebang begins; code-block boundaries and command prompts also activate.

patterns.name: JavaScript example code
patterns.context: A fenced JavaScript code block in API documentation, with the example beginning with code elements such as const and require.

patterns.name: Clinical stages and values in tables
patterns.context: Compact medical table rows in which stage labels appear alongside grouped values, parenthetical values, and aligned blank columns.

patterns.name: Integral formulas and asymptotic expressions
patterns.context: Displayed formulas in mathematical papers, containing integrals, limits, variables, and logarithmic terms; activation occurs around the formatted expressions.

patterns.name: Amounts and investment-return narratives
patterns.context: Dollar amounts appear alongside units such as million in discussions of investments, share values, or differences in returns.

10_2993.description: 激活分布于多种结构化内容：科学近似数值、代码预处理指令与代码示例、数学公式、医学表格和美元金额叙述；没有单一词义或主题能覆盖全部。

patterns.name: 近似符号与科学数值
patterns.context: 数学近似符号后跟数值，常有单位、上下标或公式排版；激活集中在符号和数值附近。

patterns.name: 代码中的预处理指令
patterns.context: C/C++ 头文件或源码中，#define、#ifdef、#endif 等预处理指令及其相邻标识符。

patterns.name: 测试命令与 shell 代码块
patterns.context: 说明如何运行测试后，进入带 shebang 的 shell 命令示例；代码块边界及命令提示符也有激活。

patterns.name: JavaScript 示例代码
patterns.context: API 文档中的 JavaScript fenced code block，示例以 const、require 等代码元素开头。

patterns.name: 表格中的临床分期与数值
patterns.context: 压缩的医学表格行，分期标签和成组的数值、括号值及空白列对齐出现。

patterns.name: 积分公式与渐近表达式
patterns.context: 数学论文中的显示公式，包含积分、上下限、变量及对数项；具体表达式排版处触发。

patterns.name: 金额与投资回报叙述
patterns.context: 讨论投资、持股价值或收益差额时，美元金额与 million 等单位并列。

en.description: Activations occur in number-dense or formatted content: mathematical formulas and problems, tables and financial fields, and market figures. They also appear in code test commands and virology genome counts. Triggers are distributed across numbers, operators, formatting symbols, and nearby labels, with no single stable word-level trigger.

patterns.name: Mathematical expressions and variable operations
patterns.context: Math problems, function definitions and evaluations, differentiation, or number theory questions; activations are scattered across formula characters, variables, numbers, and problem text, with no unique fixed trigger token

patterns.name: Numbers and statistics in tables
patterns.context: Values are arranged in tables using spaces or column alignment, or appear as financial metric fields; there are many separators, percentages, decimals, and field names

patterns.name: Rise and fall figures in financial market reporting
patterns.context: In market news, numbers are adjacent to verbs describing rises or falls, indices/yields, and percentage or point units

patterns.name: Code test command fragments
patterns.context: Introduces how to run a module test, followed by a code block or shell command; activations cluster on code markers, line breaks, and command content

patterns.name: Genome counts in biomedical papers
patterns.context: Quantitative descriptions of HCMV genome size, number of encoded genes, and number of genes required for replication; values are adjacent to biological units or genes

patterns.name: Experimental measurements in biomedical tables
patterns.context: Comparisons before and after axotomy or genotype experiment results; aligned measurement data follow text labels, but the relationship between specific fields and values is incomplete
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper figures/tables and experimental data

patterns.name: Financial metric labels and company information
patterns.context: A company financial overview is listed in label-value format, with percentages, dollar signs, and formats such as million

10_2993.concept: 数字密集的结构化文本
10_2993.description: 激活见于数字密集或格式化内容：数学公式与题目、表格及财务字段、市场行情数字，也见代码测试命令和病毒学基因组数量。触发分散在数值、运算符、格式符及邻近标签，未见单一稳定词项。

patterns.name: 数学表达式及变量运算
patterns.trigger: 如“a(q) = -20* q - 8”“What is a(-241)?”, “derivative of s(p) wrt p”, “Is v(d) a composite number?”；也包括紧邻公式的函数变量、运算符和数值
patterns.context: 数学题、函数定义与求值、求导或数论问题；激活散布在公式字符、变量、数字及题目文字上，未见唯一固定触发 token

patterns.name: 表格中的数字与统计值
patterns.context: 数值被空格或列对齐排成表格，或作为财务指标的字段值；有大量分隔符、百分数、小数和字段名
patterns.domain: 论文数据表、股票/财务资料

patterns.name: 金融市场报道中的涨跌数字
patterns.trigger: “up to 1.32 per cent”“80.65 points or 0.79 per cent”“yields fell”“Dow Jones … 51.966 points”
patterns.context: 市场新闻中，数字与涨跌动词、指数/收益率和百分比或点数单位相邻

patterns.name: 代码测试命令片段
patterns.context: 介绍如何运行某个模块测试，随后出现代码块或 shell 命令；激活集中于代码标记、换行及命令内容
patterns.domain: 软件仓库文档、代码说明

patterns.name: 生物医学论文中的基因组数量
patterns.context: HCMV 基因组大小、编码基因数及复制所需基因数等量化描述，数值与生物学单位或 genes 相邻

patterns.name: 生物医学表格中的实验测量值
patterns.trigger: “PS exposed on proximal axon”“wild-type”及其后的成列小数值
patterns.context: 轴突切断前后比较或基因型实验结果，文字标签后接对齐的测量数据；具体字段与数值关系不完整
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文图表/实验数据

patterns.name: 财务指标标签与公司信息
patterns.trigger: “EPS Gr:”“Shares Out:”“Book Value:”“Market Cap:”及其后的金额、数量
patterns.context: 以标签—数值形式列出公司财务概况，伴随百分数、美元符号、million 等格式
patterns.domain: 邮件中的股票/公司资料

en.concept: Numbers and symbols in structured text
en.description: Sensitive to structured symbols and numerical values: mathematical formulas, financial figures, code punctuation, scientific measurements, and cancer statistics all trigger. A possible commonality is text dense in numbers and symbols, though the cross-domain pattern is not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Punctuation and arithmetic structures in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Variables, functions, powers, and arithmetic symbols are densely interleaved in math problems or formula snippets; highlights often fall near parentheses, equals signs, numbers, or multiplication signs.

patterns.name: Numbers and decimals in financial markets
patterns.context: Numbers occur within descriptions of prices, price changes, and trading in financial market reports or stock-price news.

patterns.name: Code structures in technical text
patterns.context: Activations involve indentation, declarations, pointers, member names, and punctuation structures in code, comments, or API documentation.

patterns.name: Scientific measurements with numbers
patterns.context: An astrophysics paper reports total mass and uncertainty using mathematical notation.

patterns.name: Cancer-related statistics
patterns.context: Quantitative statistics accompany discussion of cancer research or disease burden in public-health-related text.

10_2993.concept: 结构化文本中的数值与符号
10_2993.description: 对结构化符号和数值敏感：数学公式、金融数字、代码标点、科研量值及癌症统计均触发；共同点可能是数字与符号密集的文本，但跨领域模式并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的标点与运算结构
patterns.context: 数学题目或公式片段中，变量、函数、幂和算术符号密集交错；高亮常落在括号、等号、数字或乘号附近。

patterns.name: 金融行情中的数字与小数
patterns.context: 金融市场报道或股价消息中，数字嵌在价格、涨跌幅和交易叙述里。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的代码结构
patterns.context: 代码、注释或 API 文档中，激活涉及缩进、声明、指针、成员名及标点结构。

patterns.name: 带数字的科研量值
patterns.context: 天体物理论文中以数学记号报告总质量和不确定度。

patterns.name: 癌症相关统计数字
patterns.context: 公共卫生相关文字中，癌症研究或疾病负担叙述搭配数量统计。

en.description: The strongest responses cluster around variable exponents, multiplication/division, and coefficients in algebra problems. Weaker responses also occur on numbers, decimals, ratios, and mathematical symbols in texts about astronomical measurements, commercial amounts and dates, and medical statistics, suggesting an inclination toward numerical formulas and their formatting.

patterns.name: Asterisks and variable exponents in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: In math problems or solution materials, asterisks indicate multiplication, and variables are followed by exponents, fractional coefficients, or polynomial terms; often adjacent to instructions such as Solve, Factor, Find, Determine and equations.

patterns.name: Numbers, operators, and punctuation in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Formulas or problems are arranged across lines, interleaving numerical and variable terms; activations are scattered around coefficients, operators, equals signs, and line breaks rather than limited to a particular variable or single symbol.

patterns.name: Mass values and uncertainty notation in astrophysics
patterns.context: Paper text reports measured mass, with values followed by uncertainties and a scientific-notation multiplication sign; triggers mainly fall on mass values and adjacent symbols.

patterns.name: Angular scales and percentage figures in astronomical observations
patterns.context: Describes the size of an observed region and the proportion of sources, including numbers, approximation signs, angular units, or percent signs.

patterns.name: Amount and date figures in press releases
patterns.context: Technology business news reports a funding amount and publication date; activations fall near quantity expressions and date figures.

patterns.name: Decimals and P-values in medical statistics
patterns.context: A research abstract reports statistical test results, with numbers in decimal form appearing in P-values and other statistics.

10_2993.description: 最强响应集中于代数题中的变量幂次、乘除与系数；另对天文测量、商业金额日期及医学统计等文本里的数字、小数、比例和数学符号也有较弱响应，似偏向数字公式及其排版。

patterns.name: 代数式中的星号与变量幂次
patterns.context: 数学题或解题材料中，星号表示乘法，变量后跟幂次、分数系数或多项式项；常与 Solve、Factor、Find、Determine 等指令及方程相邻。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字、运算符及标点
patterns.context: 公式或题目跨行排列，数值与变量项交错；激活散布在系数、运算符、等号及换行附近，而不仅限于某个变量或单一符号。

patterns.name: 天体物理质量数值与误差表示
patterns.context: 论文叙述测量质量，数值带误差并接科学计数法乘号；触发主要落在质量数值及相邻符号。

patterns.name: 天文观测的角尺度与百分比数字
patterns.context: 描述观测覆盖的区域大小及源的比例，包含数字、近似号、角分单位或百分号。

patterns.name: 新闻稿中的金额和日期数字
patterns.context: 科技商业新闻叙述融资金额和发布日期；激活落在数量表达及日期数字附近。

patterns.name: 医学统计结果中的小数与 P 值
patterns.context: 研究摘要报告统计检验结果，数字以小数形式出现在 P 值和其他统计量中。

en.description: Responds to number-dense expressions: one group comprises approximate quantities, ratios, percentages, and scale data in papers; another comprises polynomials, coefficients, and variable powers in math problems.

patterns.name: Statistical quantities and ratios
patterns.context: Statements about disease counts, proportions, sample sizes, costs, or observation counts; numbers often appear with approximately, million, %, etc.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, medical and public health project abstracts

patterns.name: Polynomials and exponential forms
patterns.context: Polynomials, powers, and arithmetic operations in math problems or formulas; activations fall on exponents and formula fragments

10_2993.description: 对数字密集表达均有反应：一类是论文中的近似数量、比例、百分数及规模数据；另一类是数学题里的多项式、系数和变量幂次。

patterns.name: 统计数量与比例
patterns.trigger: “approximately”“∼”“$\sim$”、百分号“%”及附近的数字、数量单位
patterns.context: 在说明患病人数、比例、样本规模、费用或观测数量的陈述中；数字常与 approximately、million、% 等搭配
patterns.domain: 科研论文、医学与公共卫生项目摘要

patterns.name: 多项式与指数形式
patterns.trigger: “y**5”“o**4”“b**5”等变量幂，以及“*”“/”连接的系数与项
patterns.context: 数学题或公式中出现多项式、幂次和算术运算；激活落在幂次数字及公式片段上
patterns.domain: 数学题目与代数表达式

en.description: Primarily responds to quantities and numerical expressions: especially prominent for approximation symbols and their numbers in scientific literature; also covers amounts, percentages, scale estimates, and numbers in legal citations.

patterns.name: Approximation symbols for orders of magnitude and statistics
patterns.context: In scientific or technical text, `∼` introduces an approximate quantity, ratio, or measurement; activation falls on the symbol and adjacent number tokens.

patterns.name: Estimated amounts and economic losses
patterns.context: Amounts appear in statements about impacts, assets, debt, loans, or costs; segment 10 also contains an estimated cost beginning with `$`, but the value is not shown.
patterns.domain: Public health abstracts, business news, and email

patterns.name: Large numbers and statements of scale
patterns.context: Quantity words or numbers quantify population, proportion, capacity, or group size, often accompanied by estimation language such as approximately or estimated.
patterns.domain: Scientific, public health, business, and technical descriptions

patterns.name: Numbers and abbreviations in legal citations
patterns.context: Numbers are embedded in court case citations, interspersed with state names, court abbreviations, page numbers, and legal reporter abbreviations; distinct from other quantity patterns.

10_2993.description: 主要对数量和数值表达起反应：科学文献中尤其突出于近似符号及其数字；也覆盖金额、百分比、规模估算和法律引注中的数字。

patterns.name: 约数、统计量的量级符号
patterns.context: 科学或技术文本中，`∼` 引出近似数量、比例或测量值；激活落在符号及相邻数字 token 上。

patterns.name: 估算性金额与经济损失
patterns.context: 金额出现在影响、资产、债务、贷款或成本的陈述中；段10也有以 `$` 起始的估算费用，但数值未展示。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生摘要、商业新闻与电子邮件

patterns.name: 大数及其规模表述
patterns.context: 数量词或数字用于量化人数、比例、容量或群体规模，常伴随 approximately、estimated 等估算措辞。
patterns.domain: 科学、公共卫生、商业及技术说明

patterns.name: 法律引注中的数字与缩写
patterns.context: 数字嵌在法院判例引注中，夹有州名、法院缩写、页码及法律报告集缩写；与其他数量模式不同。

en.concept: Math problem formatting and numerical scientific text
en.description: Primarily responds to the format of math problems that define polynomial functions and derivatives with “Let” and ask for a calculation or solution, as well as line breaks at problem boundaries. A few activations involve approximate values, percentages, observed regions, and star counts in astronomy papers.

patterns.name: Defining polynomial functions in math problems
patterns.context: Introduces a function and its derivative in a math problem or exercise, often followed by a request to solve or factor; activations often fall on variables, powers, coefficients, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Imperative questions in math problems
patterns.context: Requests a calculation, root-finding, determination, or factorization as part of a math exercise; often adjacent to a polynomial or number-theory expression.

patterns.name: Line breaks and problem boundaries in math problems
patterns.context: Problem text is separated by line breaks; a segment may contain a fragment of a preceding problem followed by a new problem. Positive activations occur on line breaks and nearby text.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, formatting of problem corpora

patterns.name: Approximate angular scales and observed regions in astronomy papers
patterns.context: Describes the sky coverage of observations using units such as arcminutes and approximate values.

patterns.name: Percentage statistics in astronomy papers
patterns.context: Reports the proportion of targets in a sample, within a description of observations or sample statistics.

patterns.name: Catalogs and star counts
patterns.context: Describes the contents of a star catalog and the number of stars.

10_2993.concept: 数学题格式与数值科学文本
10_2993.description: 主要响应数学题中以“Let”定义多项式函数、导数并要求计算或求解的格式，也对换行题目边界有反应。少量激活涉及天文论文中的近似数值、百分比、观测区域及星表恒星计数。

patterns.name: 数学题中定义多项式函数
patterns.trigger: “Let”以及“be the first derivative of”，尤其是“Let [变量]([变量]) be the first derivative of [多项式]”
patterns.context: 在数学题或练习中引入函数及其导数，常接着询问求解、因式分解等；激活常落在变量、幂次、系数和标点上。

patterns.name: 数学题的命令式提问
patterns.context: 作为数学练习的一部分，要求计算、求根、判断或因式分解；常与多项式或数论表达式相邻。

patterns.name: 数学题中的换行与题目边界
patterns.trigger: “↵”及其后紧接的“Let”“Find”等新题起始语
patterns.context: 题目文本以换行分隔，可能在一个片段内出现前题残片后接新题；换行及其附近文本有正激活。

patterns.name: 天文论文中的近似角尺度与观测区域
patterns.context: 描述观测覆盖的天区范围，使用角分等单位及近似数值。

patterns.name: 天文论文中的百分比统计
patterns.context: 报告样本中目标的比例，置于观测或样本统计描述中。
patterns.domain: ArXiv，天文学与天体物理论文

patterns.name: 星表目录与恒星计数
patterns.context: 描述星表的组成及恒星数量。

en.description: Primarily responds to numbers, mathematical symbols, and quantitative expressions: especially approximations, ratios, units, and sample counts in scientific papers; also strongly activates on code labels, algebraic expressions, and number-dense spans such as monetary amounts.

patterns.name: Approximation and quantity expressions in mathematics
patterns.context: In scientific paper text, represents orders of magnitude, approximate quantities, ratios, distances, or time; numbers are often adjacent to mathematical symbols and units

patterns.name: Number formats in star catalogs and astronomical counts
patterns.context: Astronomy papers describe observations, stellar samples, spatial ranges, or quantities; values are linked to object names and units

patterns.name: Percentages and monetary values
patterns.context: Values appear with a percent sign, currency symbol, or quantifier such as million in statements about losses, ratios, or statistics

patterns.name: XML/HTML tags and attribute values
patterns.context: In code or configuration snippets, tags, attributes, quotation marks, and line-break indentation appear consecutively

patterns.name: Numbers and algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Equations or algebra problems composed of variables, integers, operators, and equals signs; numbers and symbols alternate

patterns.name: Sample sizes and statistical values in genetics research
patterns.context: When papers discuss genetic risk, variants, or meta-analysis, numbers quantify sample sizes and numbers of findings

patterns.name: Loss and disaster amounts following place names
patterns.context: In disaster descriptions, locations, descriptions of losses, and monetary amounts appear together

10_2993.description: 主要响应数字、数学符号及量化表达：尤其是科学论文里的近似值、比例、单位和样本计数；也对代码标签、代数式及金额等数字密集片段强烈激活。

patterns.name: 数学中的近似／数量表达
patterns.trigger: “\sim”及其后的数字、百分比或单位，如“$\sim 10^{10}$”“$\sim 50$ kpc”“$\sim 95$ per cent”“$\sim 11$ Gyrs”
patterns.context: 科学论文正文中，表示数量级、近似数量、比例、距离或时间；数字常与数学符号、单位相邻

patterns.name: 星表与天体计数中的数字格式
patterns.trigger: “139 000 stars”“204 sources”“16 RR Lyrae stars”“$∼ 50$ kpc”
patterns.context: 天文学论文描述观测、星体样本、空间范围或数量；数值与对象名、单位相连

patterns.name: 百分比与金额数值
patterns.context: 数值带百分号、货币符号或 million 等量词，出现在损失、比例或统计陈述中

patterns.name: XML／HTML 标记与属性值
patterns.context: 代码或配置片段中，标签、属性、引号及换行缩进连续出现
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答中的 XML／HTML

patterns.name: 数字与代数表达式
patterns.context: 变量、整数、运算符和等号组成的方程或代数题；数字与符号交错

patterns.name: 遗传学研究中的样本规模与统计数值
patterns.context: 论文讨论遗传风险、变异或 meta-analysis 时，用数字量化样本规模与发现数量

patterns.name: 地名后的损失与灾害数额
patterns.trigger: “Florida City”“a loss of over $17.226 million”“$18.55 million in damage”
patterns.context: 灾害叙述中，地点、损失描述和货币金额相邻

en.description: Activations span several styles: most prominently, systems of equations or polynomial problems introduced by verbal prompts in math exercises; also quantities and observational statistics in astronomy papers, genetic statistics in biomedicine, and legal case citations. Shared cues are weak.

patterns.name: Algebra problems with systems of equations
patterns.context: Problems ask for solutions to systems of equations in variables, often containing minus signs, multiplication, powers, and line breaks between problems.

patterns.name: Higher-degree polynomial equations and root-finding
patterns.context: A polynomial relation is given, followed by a question about a variable or function value; distinct from the explicit simultaneous linear equations described above.

patterns.name: Quantities and observational descriptions in astronomy papers
patterns.context: Scientific notation, orders of magnitude, and units occur in descriptions of observations, samples, or celestial-object catalogs.

patterns.name: Statistics in genetics papers
patterns.context: Describes genetic risk, variant classes, and results from large-scale meta-analyses.

patterns.name: Legal case citations
patterns.context: After an equitable analysis of an injunction, the discussion is supported by a case name, state court reporter, and legal citation.

10_2993.description: 激活覆盖多种文体：最明显的是数学练习中由文字提示引出的方程组或多项式题；另见天文论文的数量级与观测统计、生物医学遗传统计，以及法律判例引证。共享线索较弱。

patterns.name: 联立方程组的代数题
patterns.trigger: “Solve”或“Suppose”，后接由逗号分隔的多个方程、变量和“for w/r”；例如“Solve 9 = 2*w - 3*h, -h = ...”
patterns.context: 题目要求解由变量构成的方程组，常出现负号、乘法、幂次及逐题换行。

patterns.name: 高次多项式方程与求根
patterns.trigger: “Suppose”后给出含变量幂次的多项式表达式并以“= 0”收尾；例如“f**5/3 + ... = 0”
patterns.context: 给定多项式关系，后续询问变量或函数值；不同于前述显式联立一次方程。

patterns.name: 天文论文中的数量与观测描述
patterns.context: 论文叙述观测、样本或星体目录时出现科学记数法、数量级和单位。

patterns.name: 遗传学论文的统计量
patterns.context: 描述遗传风险、变异类别及大规模荟萃分析结果。

patterns.name: 法律判决引证
patterns.context: 禁令衡平分析之后，以案件名称、州法院卷册及判例引证支持论述。

en.concept: Mathematical expressions and symbol structures in astronomy texts
en.description: Primarily responds to variables, exponents, fractions, and algebraic operation instructions in mathematics problems, especially simplifying powers under positive-number assumptions; also covers equation solving and polynomial rearrangement. Two other segments are triggered by astrophysics: AGN continua and dust extinction, and observational records with literature citations.

patterns.name: Simplifying powers under positive-number assumptions
patterns.context: After an assumption of positivity, powers, fractions, or nested products and quotients are given for simplification; activation falls near variables, exponents, operators, and Simplify.

patterns.name: Algebraic equations and solving instructions
patterns.context: An equation composed of variables and coefficients is given with a request to solve; not necessarily simplifying powers.

patterns.name: Polynomial expansion or slope-intercept form
patterns.context: Requests rewriting an expression in a specified form, or expressing and rearranging a polynomial.

patterns.name: Red-tail AGN in astrophysics
patterns.context: Discusses a UV-selected AGN subclass, continuum color, and dust extinction.

patterns.name: Astronomical observation records and literature citations
patterns.context: Cites astronomy literature and describes observations of a specific date, a galactic nuclear region, and an instrument.
patterns.domain: ArXiv, astronomy papers or observation records

10_2993.concept: 数学表达式与天文文本中的符号结构
10_2993.description: 主要响应数学题中变量、指数、分式和代数操作指令，尤其是正数条件下的幂式化简；也覆盖方程求解和多项式整理。另有两段触发于天体物理：AGN 连续谱与尘埃消光，以及带文献引用的观测记录。

patterns.name: 正数条件下的幂式化简
patterns.trigger: “assuming t is positive.”、“assuming n is positive.”、“positive.”、“Simplify”以及变量的负指数幂
patterns.context: 正数假设后给出幂、分式或嵌套乘除式，并要求化简；激活落在变量、指数、运算符及 Simplify 附近。

patterns.name: 代数方程与求解指令
patterns.context: 以变量和系数构成方程，要求解题；不一定是幂式化简。

patterns.name: 多项式展开或斜截式表达
patterns.trigger: “in the form m*x + a and give a.”、“Express”以及含 c 的多项式项
patterns.context: 要求把表达式改写成指定形式，或表达、整理多项式。

patterns.name: 天体物理中的红尾 AGN
patterns.context: 讨论紫外选取的 AGN 子类、连续谱颜色与尘埃消光。

patterns.name: 天文观测记录与文献引用
patterns.context: 引用天文学文献并描述特定日期、星系核球区域和仪器的观测。
patterns.domain: ArXiv，天文学论文或观测记录

en.concept: Text dense in numbers and symbols
en.description: Activations often occur in scientific text containing numbers, especially 10 and quantities or measurements; they also appear in other number-dense astronomical descriptions, mathematical formulas, and a code implementation. A possible commonality is number- or symbol-dense text, but cross-style evidence is limited.

patterns.name: The number 10 and adjacent quantities/measurements
patterns.context: The number 10 occurs near scientific notation, quantity estimates, or measurements; percentages, units, or other numbers may also be present

patterns.name: Values and units in scientific text
patterns.context: Numbers occur near units, percentages, or celestial-object categories; 10 is not necessarily present

patterns.name: Numbers and symbol strings in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Numbers are embedded in variables, operators, and polynomial expressions, alongside problem instructions
patterns.domain: Math competitions or math Q&A text

patterns.name: Code identifiers and implementation syntax
patterns.context: Class implementation declarations, instance variables, and API/code-style descriptions occur in code blocks

10_2993.description: 激活多见于含数字的科学文本，尤其是10及数量、测量值；也出现在其他数字密集的天文表述、数学公式和一段代码实现中。共同线索可能是数字或符号密集，但跨文体证据有限。

patterns.name: 数字 10 及其相邻数量/测量表达
patterns.trigger: “10”或“\sim 10”，以及邻近的百分比、数量或单位，如“10 48 $”，“10^{139 000} stars”
patterns.context: 数字 10 出现在科学记数、数量估计或测量值附近；有时还伴随百分比、单位或其他数字
patterns.domain: 天体物理、天文学和宇宙学论文

patterns.name: 科学文本中的数值与单位
patterns.context: 数字与单位、百分比或天体类别名称相邻；不一定含 10
patterns.domain: 天文学论文及数学题目

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字及符号串
patterns.context: 数字嵌在变量、运算符和多项式表达式中，夹杂题目指令
patterns.domain: 数学竞赛或数学问答文本

patterns.name: 代码标识符与实现语法
patterns.context: 代码块中出现类实现声明、实例变量及 API/代码风格说明

en.concept: Structured symbolic expressions in mathematics and astronomy texts
en.description: Mathematics passages focus on function definitions, polynomial powers, and evaluation prompts; astronomy passages contain astronomical proper names, observational scales, orders of magnitude, and population classifications. The expression types can trigger separately, with no single content theme spanning all of them.

patterns.name: Exponentiation operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in polynomial definitions, usually following variables and coefficients, to denote a power; activation falls near the operator.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics problems and algebraic expressions

patterns.name: Orders-of-magnitude expressions for astrophysical distances or scales
patterns.context: Astronomy papers use approximation symbols to describe distances, radii, or physical scales; other astronomical orders of magnitude and percentage values also occur.

patterns.name: Function definitions in mathematics problems
patterns.context: A function is introduced with Let, followed by an expression composed of variables, coefficients, and powers; may overlap with the exponentiation pattern.

patterns.name: Proper names, abbreviations, and observational data in astronomy papers
patterns.context: In paper text or literature citations, proper names appear alongside instruments, galaxies, or celestial object classes; not all instances include scale expressions.

patterns.name: Answer prompts in mathematics problems
patterns.context: The end of a problem asks for a function value, followed by the next problem number or a new function definition.

patterns.name: Line-of-sight and low-extinction descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the observational line of sight to young stars and the effect of dust extinction on the ultraviolet continuum.

patterns.name: Class and proportion statements in astronomy papers
patterns.context: Summarizes populations of celestial objects such as AGN and variable stars using classification labels or proportions.

10_2993.concept: 数学与天文文本中的结构化符号表达
10_2993.description: 数学段落集中于函数定义、多项式幂及求值提示；天文段落包含天体专名、观测尺度、数量级和群体分类。各类表达形式可分别触发，未见单一内容主题覆盖全部。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的幂运算符
patterns.context: 出现在多项式定义中，通常紧跟变量及系数，表示幂；激活落在运算符附近。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 题目与代数式

patterns.name: 天体物理距离或尺度的数量级表达
patterns.context: 天文论文中用近似符号描述距离、半径或物理尺度；也见其他天文数量级和百分比数值。

patterns.name: 数学题目中的变量函数定义
patterns.context: 以 Let 引入函数，再给出由变量、系数和幂组成的表达式；可能与幂运算模式重叠。

patterns.name: 天文学论文中的专名、缩写与观测数据
patterns.context: 论文正文或文献引文中，专名与仪器、星系或天体类别并列；并非所有实例都包含尺度表达。

patterns.name: 数学题目中的答案提示
patterns.context: 题目末尾要求计算函数值，后接下一题编号或新的函数定义。

patterns.name: 视线方向与低消光描述
patterns.context: 描述年轻恒星的观测视线及尘埃消光对紫外连续谱的影响。

patterns.name: 天文论文中的类别与比例陈述
patterns.context: 以分类标签或比例概述AGN、变星等天体群体。

en.concept: Structural markers and scientific terms in heterogeneous text
en.description: Activations occur across mathematical formulas, legal case citations, and astronomy papers; astronomical passages cover topics ranging from absorption lines and instrument measurements to star formation. Local triggers include formula punctuation, citation commas, and scientific terms, with no single word meaning or unified semantic pattern evident.

patterns.name: Absorption lines/features
patterns.context: Astronomy text discusses spectral absorption, samples of absorption lines, or the location of absorbing material; activations fall on absorption and nearby words

patterns.name: Punctuation and polynomial structures in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Math problems or programmatic mathematical text, especially definitions of polynomials or functions followed by instructions such as Let, Suppose, or Give; activations are distributed across symbols, numbers, and variables

patterns.name: Commas and case-citation format in legal citations
patterns.context: Legal argument is followed by case names, court abbreviations, reporter volumes and pages, and case citations; commas occur within the citation format

patterns.name: Astronomical measurements and band abbreviations
patterns.context: Abbreviations for instruments or bands and measurement values occur nearby when discussing cross-band astrometric calibration, positional offsets, and surface brightness

patterns.name: Galaxy star formation and stellar populations
patterns.context: Discusses the near-infrared spectra, stellar population ages and masses of starburst galaxies, or the cosmic history of star formation

10_2993.concept: 异质文本中的结构标记与科学术语
10_2993.description: 激活跨数学公式、法律判例引文和天文学论文出现；天文段落又涵盖吸收线、仪器测量及恒星形成等不同主题。局部触发包括公式标点、引用逗号和科学术语，未见单一词义或统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 吸收线/吸收特征
patterns.trigger: “absorption”及“absorption lines”，包括“broad and narrow absorption lines”“Na I D absorption lines”
patterns.context: 天文学文本中讨论光谱吸收、吸收线样本，或吸收物质的位置；激活落在 absorption 及其相邻词上
patterns.domain: 天文学/天体物理研究论文

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的标点与多项式结构
patterns.context: 数学题或程序化数学文本，尤其是定义多项式、函数后续接 Let、Suppose、Give 等指令；激活分散在符号、数字和变量上
patterns.domain: 数学题库/形式化数学文本

patterns.name: 法律引文中的逗号及判例格式
patterns.context: 法律论述后附判例名称、法院简称、卷页和判例汇编引文；逗号位于判例引文格式中

patterns.name: 天文测量数值与波段缩写
patterns.context: 讨论波段间天体测量校准、位置偏移和表面亮度时，附近出现仪器或波段缩写及测量值

patterns.name: 星系恒星形成与恒星族群
patterns.context: 讨论星暴星系的近红外光谱、恒星族群年龄与质量，或宇宙恒星形成历史
patterns.domain: 天文学/宇宙学研究论文

en.concept: Technical proper names and marker-dense spans
en.description: Activation spans fall into four categories: US case citations and judicial statements, PHP/HTML interface code, observations and quantitative descriptions in astronomy papers, and test code that creates state objects. Their styles differ markedly, making them difficult to explain with a single meaning or topic.

patterns.name: Legal citations and litigation conclusions
patterns.context: Case names, state names, and reporter volume and page citations appear in decision text or footnotes; brief judicial conclusions also occur

patterns.name: PHP, HTML, and interface event-handling code
patterns.context: HTML attributes, PHP template code, and variables/loops are interspersed, often for forms or web interfaces
patterns.domain: Web development code in StackExchange Q&A

patterns.name: Astronomical observations and quantitative astrophysical descriptions
patterns.context: Concerns observations, celestial object classes, or interstellar gas, interspersed with units, errors, numerical estimates, and paper-style explanations

patterns.name: User/state objects in Python test code
patterns.context: Test or example code creates a state object and sets the user field to empty; the span also contains comments

10_2993.concept: 技术性专名与标记密集片段
10_2993.description: 激活片段分成四类：美国判例引证与裁判语句、PHP/HTML 界面代码、天文学论文中的观测及量化描述，以及创建状态对象的测试代码。它们文体差异明显，难以由单一词义或主题解释。

patterns.name: 法律判决引证与诉讼结论
patterns.context: 判决正文或脚注中出现案件名、州名及判例汇编卷页等引证；也见简短裁判结论

patterns.name: PHP、HTML 与界面事件处理代码
patterns.context: HTML 属性、PHP 模板代码和变量/循环混排，常用于表单或网页界面
patterns.domain: StackExchange 网页开发问答代码

patterns.name: 天文学观测与天体物理量化表述
patterns.trigger: “PACS bands”、“MIPS astrometry”、“surface brightness”；“3 keV”、“cooling time”；“AGN”、“UV-selected”；“Na I D absorption lines”、“SN 2006X”
patterns.context: 围绕观测、天体类别或星际气体展开，夹有单位、误差、数值估计及论文式解释
patterns.domain: 天文学与天体物理论文

patterns.name: Python 测试代码中的用户/状态对象
patterns.context: 测试或示例代码中创建状态对象，并指定用户字段为空；片段还含注释

en.concept: Boundaries and symbols in structured text
en.description: Activates across scientific papers and source code. In paper passages, it favors numbers, decimals, and LaTeX mathematical symbols; in code passages, it favors line breaks, indentation, syntax punctuation, and structural boundaries, with additional local patterns involving Java callbacks, C/C++ macros, and Yii/PHP arrays.

patterns.name: Number and decimal-point formatting
patterns.context: Near numbers, numeric fragments, or decimal points, especially when numbers interleave with symbols, units, or typesetting markers.
patterns.domain: Numeric expressions in ArXiv scientific text and code

patterns.name: Mathematical and scientific symbol typesetting
patterns.context: Around formulas, superscripts and subscripts, LaTeX commands, and mathematical symbols; often adjacent to numbers or physical quantities.
patterns.domain: ArXiv papers in astrophysics, particle physics, and astronomy

patterns.name: Line breaks and indentation in code
patterns.context: Near line breaks, indentation, and statement boundaries in multiline source code; activation often falls on a newline or the following space.

patterns.name: Java anonymous Runnable and callbacks
patterns.context: Anonymous class structures in Java that create a Runnable and implement its run method, usually in event-dispatch or scrolling-callback code.

patterns.name: Code punctuation and bracket boundaries
patterns.context: Near parentheses, semicolons, operators, or statement boundaries in program syntax; not restricted to a particular language.
patterns.domain: Java, PHP/Yii, C/C++ macro code, and other source code

patterns.name: C/C++ macros and memory-allocation expressions
patterns.context: Where function calls, nested parentheses, and pointer/sizeof syntax interleave in macros or complex C-style expressions.

patterns.name: Yii/PHP configuration arrays
patterns.context: Near array entries, string key-value pairs, and static method calls in PHP/Yii code.

10_2993.concept: 结构化文本中的边界与符号
10_2993.description: 跨科学论文与源代码激活。论文段落中偏向数字、小数及 LaTeX 数学符号；代码段中偏向换行缩进、语法标点和结构边界，另有 Java 回调、C/C++ 宏及 Yii/PHP 数组等局部模式。

patterns.name: 数字与小数点格式
patterns.context: 数字、数值片段或小数点附近；尤其数字与符号、单位或排版标记交错时。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 科学文本及代码中的数字表达

patterns.name: 数学与科学符号排版
patterns.context: 公式、上下标、LaTeX 命令及数学符号周围；常与数字或物理量相邻。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文，天体物理、粒子物理与天文学

patterns.name: 代码中的换行与缩进
patterns.trigger: «↵»，以及换行后缩进的代码行，如«        new AnimatedButton();»、«            @Override»
patterns.context: 多行源代码中，换行、缩进和语句边界附近；激活常落在换行或紧随其后的空格。

patterns.name: Java 匿名 Runnable 与回调
patterns.context: Java 中创建 Runnable 并实现 run 方法的匿名类结构，通常处于事件调度或滚动回调代码中。

patterns.name: 代码标点及括号边界
patterns.context: 程序语法结构中，括号、分号、运算符或语句边界附近；本身并不限定某种语言。
patterns.domain: Java、PHP/Yii、C/C++ 宏代码及其他源代码

patterns.name: C/C++ 宏与内存分配表达式
patterns.context: 宏或复杂 C 风格表达式中，函数调用、嵌套括号及指针/sizeof 语法交织处。

patterns.name: Yii/PHP 配置数组
patterns.context: PHP/Yii 代码中的数组条目、字符串键值和静态方法调用附近。

en.concept: Quantitative descriptions of celestial objects in astronomy papers
en.description: Activation occurs mainly in astronomy papers, especially quantitative expressions of celestial object names with their redshifts, times, distances, and proportions; it also covers galaxy structure and star formation, literature citations, and discussions of physical mechanisms or models.

patterns.name: Numbers and dimensional expressions in astrophysics
patterns.context: Appears in continuous scientific discussion, especially quantitative descriptions of values, errors, ratios, redshifts, distances, times, or scales; activation often falls near numbers, symbols, and units.

patterns.name: Celestial object names and classification labels
patterns.context: Celestial object names appear alongside descriptions of their observed properties, redshifts, or classes; segment 5 particularly concerns stellar classifications and their hybrid types.
patterns.domain: Celestial object classification and naming in astronomy papers

patterns.name: Galaxy star formation and structural descriptions
patterns.context: Describes star-forming activity in galaxies, ring structures, or size ratios between galaxies, often with quantitative scales.

patterns.name: Literature citations and author-year references
patterns.context: Cites researchers, years, or reference markers in the text; often adjacent to celestial observations and numerical findings.
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic papers and reference-style prose

patterns.name: Explanations of physical mechanisms or models
patterns.context: Explains astrophysical processes, mechanisms, model predictions, or evolutionary relations, often with timescales or theoretical quantities.

patterns.name: Special mathematical/typographic boundaries and sporadic terminology
patterns.context: Activation falls on truncated sentences, formula boundaries, specialized terminology, or complex typographic spans; these local features do not establish a unified independent semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Mathematical typesetting and local paper contexts

10_2993.concept: 天文学论文中的定量天体描述
10_2993.description: 激活主要出现在天文学论文中，尤其是天体名称及其红移、时间、距离、比例等定量表达；也覆盖星系结构与恒星形成、文献引述及物理机制或模型讨论。

patterns.name: 天体物理中的数字与量纲表达
