patterns.trigger: 数字、数学符号及其相邻单位或变量，如“$z=0.286$”“$∼ 250$ Myr”“$\sim 900$ pc”“$A\sim 1$”
patterns.context: 出现在连续的科学论述中，尤其是数值、误差、比例、红移、距离、时间或尺度的定量描述；激活常落在数字、符号和单位附近。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 天文学与天体物理论文

patterns.name: 天体名称与分类标签
patterns.trigger: “QSO”“IRAS”“GRB”“δ Scuti”“γ Doradus”等天体名称、类别或缩写
patterns.context: 天体名称与其观测性质、红移或类别说明并列；第5段尤其涉及恒星分类及其混合型。
patterns.domain: 天文学论文中的天体分类与命名

patterns.name: 星系恒星形成与结构描述
patterns.context: 描述星系的恒星形成活动、环状结构或星系间的尺寸比值，常伴随定量尺度。

patterns.name: 文献引述与作者年份
patterns.context: 正文中引用研究者、年份或文献标记；常与天体观测结果、数值发现相邻。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文及参考文献式行文

patterns.name: 物理机制或模型解释
patterns.trigger: “shocks”“cooling time”“models have been proposed”“emitted in the aftermath of the merger”“self-similar evolution”
patterns.context: 对天体物理过程、机制、模型预测或演化关系作解释，常配有时间尺度或理论量。
patterns.domain: 天体物理论文中的机制讨论

patterns.name: 特殊数学/排版边界与零散术语
patterns.trigger: 第1段的“E”、第3段的“be settled.”、第5段的“hybrids”及第7段的比值括号与角括号
patterns.context: 激活落在被截断的句子、公式边界、专门术语或复杂排版片段上；这些局部特征无法确定为统一的独立语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 数学排版与论文局部语境

en.description: Most passages come from astronomy papers, with activation near scientific notation, astrophysical values, and units; two math problems also activate around polynomial coefficients, variables, and powers. They may share a general preference for numbers and symbols in formulas, but the trigger is not limited to one domain.

patterns.name: Astrophysical values and scientific notation
patterns.context: When discussing astronomical observations, objects, or cosmology, numeric/unit/formula fragments are marked; activation may fall on numbers, symbols, or units in scientific notation.

patterns.name: Polynomial-solving format in math problems
patterns.context: The problem asks for an unknown polynomial that satisfies a given algebraic equation; activation is distributed across coefficients, powers, and operators.

patterns.name: No clear independent trigger pattern
patterns.context: Although formulas and numbers are present, context is insufficient to confirm that the pattern matches either astrophysical values or math problem solving.

10_2993.description: 多数片段来自天文学论文，激活落在科学记号、天体物理数值与单位附近；两段数学题也在多项式系数、变量和幂次处激活。可能共同偏向公式中的数字与符号，但触发并不局限于单一领域。

patterns.name: 天体物理中的数值与科学记号
patterns.context: 出现天体观测、天体对象或宇宙学讨论时，数值/单位/公式片段被标记；激活可能落在科学记号的数字、符号或单位上
patterns.domain: ArXiv 天体物理与天文学论文

patterns.name: 数学题中的多项式求解格式
patterns.trigger: “Find f such that”“Find q such that”及后续多项式系数、变量和幂次
patterns.context: 题目要求求出使给定代数等式成立的未知多项式；激活散布在系数、幂次及运算符上

patterns.name: 未见明确独立触发模式
patterns.trigger: 片段中公式数值串，如“w_{0}”“w_{11}”“ln{(1+z)}”及误差数值
patterns.context: 虽包含公式和数值，但上下文不足以确认它与天体物理数值模式或数学题求解模式相同

en.concept: Variables and operations in algebra problems
en.description: The neuron mainly responds to symbolic algebra text in DM math exercises: letter variables and their powers, polynomials composed of coefficients and operators, especially instructions to solve, simplify, or expand, equations, and products in parentheses. It also responds to line-break numbering and sporadic relational text.

patterns.name: Letter variables in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Variables embedded in polynomials, products, or equations, usually interleaved with coefficients, powers, and operators; standalone single-letter variables may also activate.

patterns.name: Algebra task instructions
patterns.context: Natural-language prompts asking to solve, simplify, or expand a following algebraic expression; this pattern occurs alongside letter variables and equations.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics textbook-style problems and instructions

patterns.name: Product and polynomial expansion structure
patterns.context: Requests to expand products in parentheses, with multiple factors, variable powers, and coefficients; also includes factor structures in nearby expansion problems.

patterns.name: Equations and root conditions
patterns.context: A polynomial equation is given, with a request to solve or determine the variable value; the equation may contain high powers.

patterns.name: Line breaks and problem numbering in mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: Problems are separated by line breaks, often with numbering, answers, or leftover formatting text; not a stable, independent semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Text fragments describing variable relationships
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of variable relationships or brief textual prompts, without the complete solving-instruction structure common in other passages.

patterns.name: Other algebraic expression fragments
patterns.context: Appears in expressions or truncated problem text where the specific function is difficult to recover locally; remains in a mathematical-symbol context.

10_2993.concept: 代数题中的变量与运算
10_2993.description: 神经元主要响应 DM 数学练习中的符号代数文本：字母变量及其幂、系数与运算符构成的多项式，尤其是求解、整理、展开等指令、方程和括号乘积；对换行编号及零散关系文字也有响应。

patterns.name: 代数表达式中的字母变量
patterns.trigger: 字母变量及其幂，如 «f»、«d»、«q»、«l»、«a»、«m»，以及 «**» 后的指数
patterns.context: 变量嵌在多项式、乘积或方程中，通常与系数、幂次和运算符交错；单字母变量本身也可能获得激活

patterns.name: 代数任务指令
patterns.context: 以自然语言提示要求解、整理或展开后续代数式；该模式与字母变量和方程环境同时出现
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 教材式题目与指令

patterns.name: 乘积与多项式展开结构
patterns.trigger: 含多个括号因子的表达式，如 «(»…«)*(»…«)»，以及反复出现的 «l» 的不同幂
patterns.context: 要求展开括号乘积，表达式含多个因子、变量幂与系数；也包括邻近展开题中的因式结构

patterns.name: 等式与求根条件
patterns.context: 给定多项式方程，要求求解或确定变量取值；方程可含高次幂

patterns.name: 数学排版中的换行与题目编号
patterns.context: 题目由换行分隔，常伴随编号、答案或残留排版文本；并非稳定的独立语义触发条件

patterns.name: 变量关系文字片段
patterns.context: 在变量关系或简短文字提示中出现，未呈现其他片段常见的完整求解指令结构

patterns.name: 其他代数式残片
patterns.context: 出现于表达式或截断的题目文本中，局部难以还原其具体功能；仍处于数学符号上下文

en.concept: Algebraic symbols and instructions in mathematics problems
en.description: Activation is concentrated in symbolic algebra text from DM Mathematics: numbers, operators, variables, and powers in expressions stand out; it also covers prompt words for solving equations, derivatives and function definitions, exponent simplification, greatest common divisors, and primality checks.

patterns.name: Numbers and symbols in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Embedded in polynomials, fractions, exponents, or products of factors; long expressions interleaving coefficients, variables, and powers are especially salient triggers
patterns.domain: Symbolic algebra problems and generated problem text in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Equation-solving instructions and equation terms
patterns.context: Asks to solve a single-variable linear or quadratic equation; numbers, variables, and operators appear near the instruction

patterns.name: Derivatives and function definitions
patterns.context: First defines a variable or function, then identifies a polynomial as its first derivative and asks for a function value or composition
patterns.domain: Calculus and function-evaluation problems in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Function values and polynomial definitions
patterns.context: Defines a polynomial function or variable using Let, then asks to compute a function value; the definition often contains powers, coefficients, and a constant term
patterns.domain: Function-evaluation and algebra-application problems in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Greatest common divisor terminology
patterns.context: Asks for the greatest common divisor of two quantities; although triggered in a mathematics problem, it does not depend on long polynomial structure
patterns.domain: Integer arithmetic problems in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Exponent-expression simplification instructions
patterns.context: Asks to simplify products, quotients, or compound exponent expressions of variable powers, usually with variables p or l
patterns.domain: Exponent and algebra simplification problems in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Primality checks and Boolean answers
patterns.context: First asks whether an object is prime, then gives True; occurs adjacent to surrounding polynomial problem prompts
patterns.domain: Yes/no questions or programmatic Q&A text in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Local prominence of variable letter l
patterns.context: The letter l is a variable embedded in products, powers, or exponent simplifications; it may also be typographically confused with the number 1

10_2993.concept: 数学题中的代数符号与指令
10_2993.description: 激活集中于 DM Mathematics 的符号代数文本：数字、运算符、变量和幂次构成的表达式突出；也覆盖解方程、导数与函数定义、指数化简、最大公因数及素数判断等题干词汇。

patterns.name: 代数表达式中的数字与符号
patterns.context: 嵌在多项式、分式、指数或因式乘积中，尤以系数、变量和幂次交错的长表达式为明显触发条件
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的符号代数题目与题目生成文本

patterns.name: 解方程指令与方程项
patterns.context: 要求针对变量解一元线性或二次方程；数字、变量及运算符在指令附近出现
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的方程求解题

patterns.name: 导数及函数定义
patterns.context: 先定义变量或函数，再将多项式称为其一阶导数，并要求求函数值或复合值
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的微积分与函数代入题

patterns.name: 函数值与多项式定义
patterns.context: 以 Let 定义多项式函数或变量，再要求计算函数值；定义式常含幂、系数和常数项
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的函数代入及代数应用题

patterns.name: 最高公因数术语
patterns.context: 要求求两个量的最大公因数；触发虽出现在数学题中，但不依赖长多项式结构
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的整数算术题

patterns.name: 指数式化简指令
patterns.context: 要求化简变量幂的乘除或复合指数表达式，变量通常为 p 或 l
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的指数与代数化简题

patterns.name: 素数判断与布尔答案
patterns.context: 先提出一个对象是否为素数，再给出 True；与周边多项式题干相邻
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的是非判断或程序化问答文本

patterns.name: 变量字母 l 的局部突出
patterns.context: 字母 l 作为变量嵌在乘积、幂或指数化简式中；该字母也可能与数字 1 的排版相混

en.description: Mainly activates on instruction words and dense algebraic formulas in math exercises, especially simplifying powers, defining functions and differentiating or evaluating them; it also responds to instructions to rearrange or round, and to variable polynomials.

patterns.name: Instructions to simplify powers
patterns.context: Followed by an algebraic expression containing variables, multiplication/division, and exponents; often accompanied by assumptions about positivity and a power-expression answer on the next line.

patterns.name: Derivative and function-expression problems
patterns.context: Defines a function or its derivative, then asks for an evaluation, an expression, or further processing; formulas contain variable powers and coefficients.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, function and calculus exercises

patterns.name: Instructions to rearrange algebraic expressions
patterns.context: An instruction is followed by a complex expression containing letter variables, parentheses, exponents, and operators.

patterns.name: Other math instructions or problem fragments
patterns.context: Contains an instruction to round a number or a standalone solving instruction; nearby are sporadic variables, formulas, or problem text, without clear classification into the specific problem types above.

patterns.name: Polynomial expressions with parameters
patterns.context: An expression appears during expansion or manipulation, without enough context to assign it to a clear instruction pattern.

10_2993.concept: 数学练习题指令与公式
10_2993.description: 主要对数学练习题中的指令词和密集代数公式激活，尤其是化简幂式、定义函数并求导或求值；也响应重排、取整等题目指令及变量多项式。

patterns.name: 化简幂式的指令
patterns.context: 紧接着给出包含变量、乘除与指数的代数式；常伴随正数假设及换行后的幂式答案。

patterns.name: 导数与函数表达式题
patterns.context: 定义函数或其导数，随后要求求值、给出表达式或继续处理；公式中含变量幂、系数。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，函数与微积分练习题

patterns.name: 代数式重排指令
patterns.context: 指令后跟含字母变量、括号、乘方和运算符的复杂表达式。

patterns.name: 其他数学指令或题目残片
patterns.context: 出现数值取整指令或单独的求解指令；附近含零散变量、公式或题目文本，未明显归入上述具体题型。

patterns.name: 含参数的多项式代数式
patterns.context: 表达式展开或运算过程中，未见足以归入某个清晰指令模式的上下文。

en.description: All passages come from DM Mathematics symbolic algebra problems. The neuron activates on dense expressions with variables, coefficients, powers, and fractions, as well as wording for simplifying, expanding, rearranging, solving, and defining functions; some contexts also include assumptions that variables are positive.

patterns.name: Polynomial operation instructions
patterns.context: An instruction word appears before or after a mathematical expression or equation, requesting the corresponding symbolic operation; often accompanied by a line break, answer, or next problem.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, exercises or generated problem text

patterns.name: Assuming variables are positive
patterns.context: A positive-value condition for variables is given before simplifying an algebraic expression; one instance is truncated.

patterns.name: Function definition and evaluation/parameter solving
patterns.context: A function or relation is defined first, followed by a request to differentiate, evaluate at a specific value, or determine a parameter.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, function and algebra problems

patterns.name: Variable powers and complex algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Long expressions composed of variables, integer coefficients, and rational exponents, often to be simplified or expanded; numbers and symbols themselves show no clear, stable semantic category.

patterns.name: Solving equations for variables
patterns.context: Multiple equations appear alongside an explicit request to solve for a specified variable.

10_2993.description: 所有段均来自 DM Mathematics 的符号代数题。神经元对密集的变量、系数、幂与分式表达式，以及化简、展开、重排、求解、定义函数等题目措辞激活；部分上下文还含变量正值假设。

patterns.name: 多项式运算指令
patterns.context: 指令词出现在数学表达式或方程前后，要求执行相应符号运算；常伴随换行、答案或下一道题。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，练习题或题目生成文本

patterns.name: 假设变量为正
patterns.trigger: “assuming b is positive”, “assuming g is”, “assuming u is positive”
patterns.context: 代数式化简前给出变量的正值条件；其中一处条件被截断。

patterns.name: 函数定义与求值/求参数
patterns.trigger: “Let a(g) =”, “Let v(u) =”, “Let u(h) =”, “be the first derivative”, “give k”, “give z”
patterns.context: 先定义函数或给出关系式，再要求求导、求特定函数值或确定参数。

patterns.name: 变量幂与复杂代数式
patterns.context: 变量、整数系数和有理指数构成的长表达式，常要求化简或展开；数字和符号本身没有明显稳定的语义类别。

patterns.name: 解方程与求变量
patterns.context: 出现多个方程并明确要求对指定变量求解。

en.concept: Math problem statements and symbolic derivations
en.description: Mainly responds to symbolic expressions and power simplification in DM math problems, and also covers polynomial rearrangement, instructions to solve for variables, derivative definitions, and numerical solutions to equations.

patterns.name: Variable-power expressions in symbolic algebra problems
patterns.context: Variables and powers combine with multiplication and division to form complex expressions; often accompanied by prompts such as “assuming … is positive” or “Simplify”.

patterns.name: Polynomial expansion or rearrangement
patterns.context: A polynomial product with variable powers and coefficients is to be rearranged or expanded.

patterns.name: “give” instruction in math problems
patterns.context: After an algebraic relation is provided, the problem asks for a variable or parameter to be determined.

patterns.name: Derivative definitions and function notation
patterns.context: Defines a function and its derivative, then introduces an evaluation task.

patterns.name: Equations and numerical solutions
patterns.context: An equation is given or posed, followed by numerical results.

10_2993.description: 主要响应 DM 数学题中的符号表达式和幂运算化简，也覆盖多项式重排、求变量指令、导数定义及方程数值解答等数学题面结构。

patterns.name: 符号代数题中的变量幂表达式
patterns.context: 变量与幂、乘除运算构成复杂表达式；常伴随“assuming … is positive”“Simplify”等提示

patterns.name: 多项式展开或重排
patterns.context: 含变量幂与系数的多项式乘积，要求重排或展开

patterns.name: 数学题中的“give”指令
patterns.context: 在给出代数关系后要求求出变量或参数

patterns.name: 导数定义与函数记号
patterns.context: 定义函数及其导数，随后引入求值任务

patterns.name: 方程与数值解答
patterns.context: 给定或提出方程，并列出数值结果

en.description: Primarily responds to variable powers, coefficients, and operations in algebra problems, especially polynomial expansion; also covers simplification, solving, and exponent expressions. One PHP routing Q&A instance is unrelated.

patterns.name: Polynomial expansion
patterns.context: Asks to expand the product of two polynomials; the expression contains higher powers and integer coefficients.

patterns.name: Symbolic algebra operations and solving
patterns.context: Performs symbolic simplification, equation solving, or manipulation of power expressions in algebra problems; not limited to polynomial expansion.
patterns.domain: Symbolic algebra problems in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: PHP routing and user types
patterns.context: Discusses redirecting by user type and includes PHP route-file code.

10_2993.description: 主要响应代数题中的变量幂、系数与运算，尤其是多项式展开；也覆盖化简、求解和指数式。另有一次 PHP 路由问答，主题不同。

patterns.name: 多项式展开
patterns.trigger: “Expand”及后续由变量、系数、幂和乘法组成的表达式
patterns.context: 要求展开两个多项式乘积；表达式含较高次幂和整数系数。

patterns.name: 符号代数运算与求解
patterns.trigger: 变量幂、分数指数及代数方程；出现“assuming”“Solve”“Simplify”“Suppose”等提示
patterns.context: 在代数题中进行符号化简、解方程或处理幂表达式，不限于多项式展开。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的符号代数题

patterns.name: PHP 路由与用户类型
patterns.trigger: “for my users according to their type”以及“routes.php”“<?php”“redirect user”等
patterns.context: 讨论按用户类型重定向，并附有 PHP 路由文件代码。

en.description: Mainly responds to symbolic algebra expressions containing letter variables, complex multiplication/division, and integer or fractional exponents; it also covers LaTeX matrix-arrow notation and PHP syntax. The patterns share a preference for dense symbolic or code text.

patterns.name: Variables and powers in complex algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on symbolic expressions composed of letter variables, integer or fractional exponents, and nested multiplication/division; often accompanied by instructions or conditions such as Simplify, Expand, Factor, or assuming.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics symbolic algebra problems; numbers 2–5, 8–10.

patterns.name: Arrows and diagram notation in mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: Appears in a LaTeX xymatrix environment containing arrows, matrix nodes, and mathematical objects; activation does not depend on ordinary-language sentences.
patterns.domain: LaTeX source in ArXiv mathematics papers.

patterns.name: PHP code and related punctuation
patterns.context: Located near PHP code or code fragments; the surrounding text concerns WordPress address formats or PHPMailer configuration.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, with English or Portuguese explanations and PHP code.

patterns.name: Polynomial structure in expanded expressions
patterns.context: A math task contains indexed variables, polynomial terms, and products in parentheses; it belongs to the same algebraic content as the power-expression problems in other passages, but uses an expansion format.

10_2993.description: 主要响应含字母变量、复杂乘除和整数或分数指数的符号代数表达式，也覆盖 LaTeX 矩阵箭头标记及 PHP 代码语法；多种模式共同偏向密集符号或代码文本。

patterns.name: 繁复代数式中的变量与幂
patterns.context: 触发集中在由字母变量、整数或分数指数和嵌套乘除组成的符号式；常伴随 Simplify、Expand、Factor 或 assuming 等指令/条件。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的符号代数题目；编号 2–5、8–10。

patterns.name: 数学排版中的箭头与图表标记
patterns.context: 出现在 LaTeX 的 xymatrix 环境中，包含箭头、矩阵节点和数学对象；触发不依赖普通语言句子。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文中的 LaTeX 源码。

patterns.name: PHP 代码及相关标点
patterns.context: 位于 PHP 代码或代码片段附近；正文涉及 WordPress 地址格式，或 PHPMailer 配置。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答，含英语或葡萄牙语说明与 PHP 代码。

patterns.name: 展开式中的多项式结构
patterns.trigger: «Expand»，以及 «g» 后接数字下标、幂和加减项
patterns.context: 数学任务中出现变量下标、多项式项与括号乘积；与其他片段的幂式题同属代数内容，但呈展开形式。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 符号代数题目。

en.description: Activation is concentrated in structured symbolic text: PHP/Objective-C code, LaTeX source, and algebraic expressions; it often falls on operators, parentheses, line breaks, and code/formula markers. It also covers Portuguese question text, making it difficult to assign a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Code-block beginnings and file structure
patterns.context: At the beginning of PHP code fragments, often followed by a line break, indentation, and file contents; present in both PHP examples.

patterns.name: Objective-C collections and loop code
patterns.context: Code in Objective-C that initializes an array, iterates over image numbers, and adds objects to an array.

patterns.name: LaTeX math typesetting commands and structures
patterns.context: LaTeX source in math papers, containing diagram arrows or formulas with summations and fractions; high activation is concentrated on commands, parentheses, and line structure.

patterns.name: Algebraic expressions and operations on unknowns
patterns.context: An algebra problem with variables, coefficients, exponents, equations, or instructions; appears in problem statements or calculation expressions.

patterns.name: Punctuation/operators common to code and math
patterns.context: These symbols are embedded in code or formulas; in isolation, they do not form a unified semantic theme, but activation in multiple passages falls on symbols and nearby variables.

patterns.name: Portuguese forum text and code introduction
patterns.context: Portuguese question text followed by a PHP code example; activation involves both phrases in the text and the beginning of the code block.

10_2993.concept: 结构化代码与公式符号
10_2993.description: 激活集中在结构化符号文本：PHP/Objective-C 代码、LaTeX 源码及代数表达式；常落在运算符、括号、换行和代码/公式标记上。也覆盖葡语提问正文，难以归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 代码块起始与文件结构
patterns.trigger: «<?»、«php»、«↵»及其后的缩进或注释分隔线
patterns.context: PHP 代码片段开始处，常紧接换行、缩进和文件内容；两个 PHP 示例都出现。

patterns.name: Objective-C 集合与循环代码
patterns.context: Objective-C 中初始化数组并遍历图像编号、向数组添加对象的代码。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学排版命令与结构
patterns.context: 数学论文中的 LaTeX 源码，包含图表箭头或带求和、分式的公式；高激活集中于命令、括号和行结构。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学/理论物理文本

patterns.name: 代数表达式与未知量运算
patterns.context: 含变量、系数、乘方、等式或指令的代数题；出现于题目陈述或计算表达式中。

patterns.name: 代码及数学中常见的标点/运算符
patterns.context: 这些符号嵌在代码或公式中；单独看不构成统一语义主题，但多个片段的激活落在符号及邻近变量上。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语论坛文本与代码引入
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语提问正文后接 PHP 代码示例；激活同时涉及正文中的短语及代码块起始。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语 StackExchange 编程问答

en.concept: Mathematical symbol manipulation and problem instructions
en.description: Mainly responds to prompts for simplifying math problems and to complex power expressions, variables, and operators; it also activates on LaTeX commutative-diagram notation and wording for solving systems of linear equations.

patterns.name: Algebraic-expression simplification prompt
patterns.context: A prefix to a long algebraic expression containing variable multiplication/division, powers, and fractional exponents; often followed by an “assuming … is positive” condition and a standalone power expression. Activation is concentrated mainly on the prompt and the mathematical symbols and variable tokens in the expression.

patterns.name: Commutative diagrams in mathematical typesetting
patterns.context: Appears in a LaTeX commutative-diagram fragment containing arrows, objects, and mapping notation.

patterns.name: Solving systems of linear equations
patterns.context: After variables are defined, a system of equations asks for variable r to be solved; no “Simplify” prompt is present.

10_2993.concept: 数学符号处理与题目指令
10_2993.description: 主要响应数学化简题的提示词与复杂幂式、变量和运算符；另对 LaTeX 交换图标记及线性方程组求解措辞有激活。

patterns.name: 代数式化简提示
patterns.context: 作为长串含变量乘除、幂和分数指数的代数表达式前缀，后续常伴随“assuming … is positive”条件及单独的幂表达式；触发强度主要集中于提示词和表达式中的数学符号、变量 token

patterns.name: 数学排版中的交换图
patterns.context: 出现在含有箭头、对象、映射标记的 LaTeX 交换图片段中
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学文本，范畴论式排版

patterns.name: 线性方程组求解
patterns.context: 在定义变量之后，以方程组形式要求对变量 r 求解；没有“Simplify”提示

en.description: Primarily responds to variables, operators, and instructions such as Solve/Simplify/Let/assuming in mathematics problem text; also strongly activates on LaTeX source for a commutative diagram and a HackerNews text combining a poem, comments, and code errors.

patterns.name: Local markers in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Variable symbols appear in algebra problems, powers, and fractional expressions, especially in problem text interleaving natural-language instructions and formulas; this pattern covers multiple variables, with no confirmation that any particular variable is necessary.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics mathematical problem generation/solving text

patterns.name: Structural symbols in formulas
patterns.context: In algebraic equations, operational expressions, or power expressions, symbols are embedded among variables and numbers; appears together with a mathematical problem-solving context.

patterns.name: Mathematical instruction words
patterns.context: Acts as natural-language instructions or conditions in mathematics problems, introducing variable definitions, simplification, or solving; markers occur in the instructions and nearby content.

patterns.name: Diagram source code
patterns.context: A commutative or mapping diagram written in LaTeX using xymatrix and arrow commands; the equation environment contains line breaks, object labels, and arrows.
patterns.domain: LaTeX source in ArXiv mathematics papers

patterns.name: Spans combining poetry with comments/code
patterns.context: A single passage begins with indented poetry and a separator, followed by comment text and Perl-style error messages; triggers are scattered, and no common local trigger can be determined from this passage alone.
patterns.domain: Mixed HackerNews text containing poetry, comments, and code error messages

10_2993.description: 主要响应数学题文本中的变量、运算符及 Solve/Simplify/Let/assuming 等指令；另对 LaTeX 交换图源码和一段诗句、评论与代码错误混杂的 HackerNews 文本有强激活。

patterns.name: 数学表达式局部标记
patterns.trigger: «y»、«u»、«r»、«g»、«a»、«v»、«p»、«n»、«l»、«k»、«c» 等变量前后的标记激活；并伴随“Let”“Solve”“Simplify”“assuming”等文本
patterns.context: 变量符号出现在代数题、幂与分式表达式中，尤其是自然语言指令和公式交错的题目文本；此模式覆盖多个变量，无法进一步确认某个特定变量是必要条件。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 数学题生成/求解文本

patterns.name: 公式中的结构符号
patterns.context: 代数方程、运算表达式或幂次表达式中，符号嵌在变量与数字之间；与数学求解语境同时出现。

patterns.name: 数学指令词
patterns.context: 作为数学题的自然语言指令或条件，引出变量设定、化简或求解；标记出现在指令及其邻近内容。

patterns.name: 矩阵图表源码
patterns.context: LaTeX 中用 xymatrix 和箭头命令编写的交换图或映射图；公式环境含换行、对象标签和箭头。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文 LaTeX 源码

patterns.name: 诗句与评论/代码混杂的片段
patterns.trigger: “Gautama dies near”“a monastry. Two woodpeckers”“fly over the lake.”，以及“Or Wunt's commentary”“Global symbol”
patterns.context: 同一段落中先是缩进的诗句及分隔线，随后接有评论文字和 Perl 风格错误信息；触发成分分散，无法从单段确定共同的局部触发条件。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 混合文本，含诗句、评论和代码错误信息

en.description: The most stable pattern is power-expression algebra simplification under positive-value assumptions; other trigger patterns include algebraic solving for unknowns, code indentation and line breaks, LaTeX arrow diagrams, and astronomical measurement terminology.

patterns.name: “l/lowercase variable” power expressions in algebra
patterns.context: A variable is declared positive, followed by a simplification problem containing variables, fractional exponents, and powers; activation involves both variable tokens and the problem prompt and formula fragments.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols in equation problems
patterns.context: Several equations or expressions are given, with a request to determine an unknown; lacks the “assuming positive / Simplify” power-expression simplification format.

patterns.name: Structural line breaks and indentation in code
patterns.context: Line breaks, indentation, and statement boundaries stand out in code blocks or configuration-file fragments; the code content itself varies.

patterns.name: Arrow symbols and formula typesetting
patterns.context: LaTeX diagram code in a mathematics paper, using arrow commands and matrix-style typesetting.

patterns.name: Astronomical measurement position-offset descriptions
patterns.context: Discusses astrometric calibration and position offsets across different observing bands.

10_2993.concept: 异质的结构化符号片段
10_2993.description: 最稳定的模式是正数条件下的幂式代数化简；另有代数求未知量、代码缩进换行、LaTeX 箭头图和天文测量术语等不同触发模式。

patterns.name: “l/lowercase variable”幂式代数
patterns.context: 变量被声明为正数，随后出现含变量、分数指数和幂的化简题；激活既涉及变量 token，也涉及题目提示语与公式片段。

patterns.name: 方程题中的数学符号
patterns.context: 给出若干等式或表达式，并要求确定未知量；没有“assuming positive / Simplify”的幂式化简格式。

patterns.name: 代码中的结构性换行与缩进
patterns.trigger: «↵»以及缩进空格，如 «        »；并伴随代码标点
patterns.context: 代码块或配置文件片段中，换行、缩进和语句边界突出；代码内容本身各异。

patterns.name: 箭头符号与公式排版
patterns.context: 数学论文中的 LaTeX 图表代码，使用箭头命令及矩阵式排版。

patterns.name: 天文观测位置偏移描述
patterns.context: 讨论不同观测波段间的天体测量校准与位置偏移。

en.concept: Formatting and delimiters in structured text
en.description: Activation is concentrated on structural markers in formatted or symbol-dense text: spaces, headings, and numbers in aligned tables of contents and tables; delimiters and operators in mathematical expressions; and keywords, brackets, and punctuation in code and regular expressions.

patterns.name: Multi-space-aligned table-of-contents or table rows
patterns.context: Near line breaks or page breaks, text fields and numbers are separated by many spaces; table-of-contents entries often contain Roman numerals, titles, and page numbers, while table rows contain labels and statistical values
patterns.domain: Book front matter, tables of contents, and academic tables

patterns.name: Delimiters and structural symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In formulas, matrices, or symbol-dense mathematical expressions; some contexts are organized by line breaks, alignment markers, or braces
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematical typesetting, mathematics problems, and symbolic algebra content

patterns.name: Declarations and bracket structures in code
patterns.context: In code statements or regular expressions, type names, modifiers, punctuation, and brackets form compact program text

10_2993.concept: 结构化文本的排版与分隔符
10_2993.description: 激活集中于排版或符号密集文本中的结构标记：对齐目录和表格的空格、标题与数字，数学表达式的分隔符及运算符，以及代码和正则表达式的关键字、括号与标点。

patterns.name: 多空格对齐的目录或表格行
patterns.trigger: “CONTENTS”、 “CHAPTER”“PAGE”，或以空格填充后排列的标题与页码；也包括表格中字段与数值的列式对齐
patterns.context: 换行或分页附近，文字字段与数字之间有大量空格；目录条目常含罗马数字、标题和页码，表格行含标签与统计数值
patterns.domain: 书籍前置部分、目录及学术表格

patterns.name: 数学公式中的分隔符及结构符号
patterns.context: 公式、矩阵或符号密集的数学表达式中；部分上下文由换行、对齐符或大括号组织
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学排版、数学题及符号化代数内容

patterns.name: 代码中的声明与括号结构
patterns.context: 代码语句或正则表达式中，类型名、修饰符、标点和括号构成紧凑的程序文本
